laager.t: n. 车阵营地（南非用语）

e.en: The settlers formed a {laager} with their wagons for protection.
e.zh: 移民们用马车围成车阵以自卫。

e.en: The team retreated into a defensive {laager} after the criticism.
e.zh: 团队在批评之后退入防守阵地。

e.en: She spends most afternoons in the chemistry {lab}.
e.zh: 她大部分下午都待在化学实验室里。

e.en: Our startup runs a small AI research {lab}.
e.zh: 我们的创业公司有一个小型人工智能研究室。

laban.t: n. 拉班（人名，圣经人物）

e.en: She drank a cool glass of {laban} with lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐时喝了一杯清凉的酸奶饮料。

e.en: Many Middle Eastern dishes are served with {laban} on the side.
e.zh: 许多中东菜肴都会配上酸奶一起食用。

label.t:
n. 标签
v. 贴标签；标注

e.en: Always read the {label} before taking the medicine.
e.zh: 服药前一定要先看说明标签。

e.en: Don't {label} people based on a single mistake.
e.zh: 不要因为一次错误就给人贴标签。

labeled.t:
adj. 已标注的
v. label 的过去式

e.en: Each box is clearly {labeled} with its contents.
e.zh: 每个箱子都清楚地标注了里面的物品。

e.en: The film was unfairly {labeled} as boring by critics.
e.zh: 这部电影被影评人不公平地贴上了无聊的标签。

labeling.t:
n. 标注；标签制作
v. label 的现在分词

e.en: New {labeling} rules require allergens to be listed clearly.
e.zh: 新的标签规定要求清楚列出过敏原。

e.en: Stop {labeling} every disagreement as an attack.
e.zh: 别把每次分歧都说成是攻击。

labelled.t: adj. 已标注的（英式拼写）

e.en: The files are neatly {labelled} by date.
e.zh: 这些文件按日期整齐地贴了标签。

e.en: He was {labelled} a troublemaker for asking questions.
e.zh: 他因为爱提问就被贴上了麻烦制造者的标签。

e.en: Clear {labelling} on food packaging helps consumers choose wisely.
e.zh: 食品包装上清晰的标识有助于消费者明智选择。

e.en: She objected to the {labelling} of her work as amateur.
e.zh: 她反对把她的作品定性为业余之作。

labels.t:
n. 标签（复数）
v. 标注（第三人称单数）

e.en: Print the shipping {labels} before the courier arrives.
e.zh: 在快递员到来之前把运单标签打印出来。

e.en: Many young artists resist the {labels} critics give them.
e.zh: 许多年轻艺术家抗拒评论家给他们贴的标签。

e.en: The doctor explained the anatomy of the {labia} clearly.
e.zh: 医生清楚地讲解了阴唇的解剖结构。

e.en: Mild swelling of the {labia} can have many causes.
e.zh: 阴唇轻微肿胀可能有多种原因。

e.en: The letter P is a {labial} consonant in English.
e.zh: 在英语中字母P是一个唇音辅音。

e.en: Dentists often examine the {labial} surface of the front teeth.
e.zh: 牙医经常检查前牙的唇侧表面。

e.en: His mood is highly {labile} when he's stressed.
e.zh: 他在压力下情绪非常不稳定。

e.en: The compound is chemically {labile} and breaks down quickly.
e.zh: 这种化合物化学性质不稳定,容易分解。

labor.t:
n. 劳动；劳工
v. 努力工作

e.en: Manual {labor} can be exhausting in the summer heat.
e.zh: 在夏日酷暑中做体力劳动会让人筋疲力尽。

e.en: She went into {labor} just before midnight.
e.zh: 她在午夜前开始分娩。

e.en: Modern {laboratories} are equipped with advanced robotic systems.
e.zh: 现代化实验室都配备了先进的机器人系统。

e.en: University {laboratories} often collaborate with private companies.
e.zh: 大学实验室经常与私营企业合作。

e.en: The samples were sent to the {laboratory} for analysis.
e.zh: 样本已被送往实验室进行分析。

e.en: He works as a {laboratory} technician at the hospital.
e.zh: 他在医院担任化验室技术员。

labored.t:
adj. 吃力的；勉强的
v. labor 的过去式

e.en: His breathing became {labored} as he climbed the steep hill.
e.zh: 他爬上陡坡时呼吸变得很费力。

e.en: She {labored} for years on her debut novel.
e.zh: 她为自己的处女作小说辛勤创作了多年。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a farm {laborer} all his life.
e.zh: 他祖父一辈子都做农场工人。

e.en: Every {laborer} on the site deserves fair pay.
e.zh: 工地上的每一位工人都应该得到合理报酬。

e.en: The construction site employs hundreds of {laborers} daily.
e.zh: 这个建筑工地每天雇用数百名工人。

e.en: Migrant {laborers} often lack legal protection abroad.
e.zh: 外来务工人员在国外往往缺乏法律保护。

e.en: Farmers were {laboring} in the fields from dawn to dusk.
e.zh: 农民们从清晨到黄昏都在田里辛勤劳作。

e.en: He's still {laboring} under the impression that we agreed.
e.zh: 他仍然误以为我们已经达成一致。

e.en: Translating the manuscript was a {laborious} task.
e.zh: 翻译这份手稿是一项费力的工作。

e.en: She gave a long and {laborious} explanation of the rules.
e.zh: 她对规则作了冗长而费劲的解释。

e.en: He {laboriously} copied the entire document by hand.
e.zh: 他费力地手抄了整份文件。

e.en: She {laboriously} climbed the stairs with her heavy suitcase.
e.zh: 她拖着沉重的行李箱艰难地爬上楼梯。

labors.t:
n. 劳动；辛劳
v. 努力工作

e.en: After years of {labors}, the project finally launched.
e.zh: 经过多年的辛勤努力,这个项目终于上线了。

e.en: He {labors} every weekend to renovate the old house.
e.zh: 他每个周末都辛苦地翻修那栋老房子。

labour.t:
n. 劳动；劳工
v. 辛苦工作

e.en: The factory relies on cheap {labour} from neighboring countries.
e.zh: 这家工厂依赖邻国的廉价劳动力。

e.en: She was rushed to hospital when she went into {labour}.
e.zh: 她开始分娩时被紧急送往医院。

e.en: His {laboured} breathing worried the doctor.
e.zh: 他吃力的呼吸让医生很担心。

e.en: They {laboured} all summer to finish the barn.
e.zh: 他们辛苦干了整个夏天才把谷仓盖好。

e.en: He started out as a casual {labourer} on building sites.
e.zh: 他最初在建筑工地做散工。

e.en: The {labourer} was paid by the hour.
e.zh: 这名工人按小时领工资。

e.en: Hundreds of {labourers} were hired to build the railway.
e.zh: 修建这条铁路雇用了数百名工人。

e.en: The {labourers} demanded better safety equipment on site.
e.zh: 工人们要求工地配备更好的安全装备。

e.en: He spent the morning {labouring} in the garden.
e.zh: 他上午在花园里辛苦干活。

e.en: She is still {labouring} under a serious misunderstanding.
e.zh: 她仍深陷于一个严重的误解之中。

e.en: British {labourism} shaped much of the country's welfare policy.
e.zh: 英国的工党主义塑造了该国大部分的福利政策。

e.en: Critics argued that {labourism} had lost its working-class roots.
e.zh: 批评者认为工党主义已失去其工人阶级的根基。

labours.t:
n. 劳动；辛劳
v. 努力工作

e.en: His {labours} on the project finally paid off.
e.zh: 他在这个项目上的辛劳终于得到了回报。

e.en: She {labours} every day to support her family.
e.zh: 她每天辛勤工作以养家糊口。

labrador.t: n. 拉布拉多犬；拉布拉多半岛

e.en: Their golden {labrador} loves chasing tennis balls.
e.zh: 他们家的金色拉布拉多犬最爱追网球。

e.en: A friendly {labrador} greeted us at the door.
e.zh: 一只友善的拉布拉多犬在门口迎接我们。

e.en: He tore the {labrum} in his right shoulder while pitching.
e.zh: 他投球时撕裂了右肩的关节盂唇。

e.en: Surgery to repair the {labrum} requires months of recovery.
e.zh: 修复关节唇的手术需要数月的恢复期。

labs.t: n. 实验室（lab 的复数）

e.en: The university just opened three new research {labs}.
e.zh: 这所大学刚开设了三个新的研究实验室。

e.en: Many tech {labs} are experimenting with generative AI.
e.zh: 许多科技实验室都在尝试生成式人工智能。

e.en: The {laburnum} in the front garden bloomed bright yellow.
e.zh: 前花园里的金链花开得金黄灿烂。

e.en: Be careful—every part of a {laburnum} tree is poisonous.
e.zh: 要小心,金链花树的每一部分都有毒。

labyrinth.t: n. 迷宫；错综复杂之物

e.en: The old town is a {labyrinth} of narrow alleys.
e.zh: 这座古城是由狭窄小巷组成的迷宫。

e.en: Filing taxes feels like navigating a bureaucratic {labyrinth}.
e.zh: 报税感觉就像在官僚迷宫里打转。

labyrinthine.t: adj. 迷宫般的；错综复杂的

e.en: The contract has a {labyrinthine} structure of hidden clauses.
e.zh: 这份合同有着错综复杂的隐藏条款结构。

e.en: We got lost in the {labyrinthine} corridors of the museum.
e.zh: 我们在博物馆迷宫般的走廊里迷了路。

e.en: The varnish is made from the resin called {lac}.
e.zh: 这种清漆是用一种叫紫胶的树脂制成的。

e.en: Indian artisans use {lac} to create colorful bangles.
e.zh: 印度工匠用紫胶制作彩色手镯。

lace.t:
n. 蕾丝；鞋带
v. 系带；掺入

e.en: Her wedding dress was trimmed with delicate white {lace}.
e.zh: 她的婚纱镶着精致的白色蕾丝花边。

e.en: Don't forget to {lace} up your boots before hiking.
e.zh: 徒步前别忘了把靴带系好。

laced.t: adj. 系带的；掺有（酒、药）的

e.en: She {laced} her sneakers tightly before the race.
e.zh: 赛跑前她把运动鞋的鞋带系紧。

e.en: The drink was {laced} with a strong sedative.
e.zh: 那杯饮料里被掺了强力镇静剂。

e.en: Sharp rocks can {lacerate} bare feet on the beach.
e.zh: 沙滩上的尖石头可能会划伤光脚。

e.en: His harsh words seemed to {lacerate} her confidence.
e.zh: 他刻薄的话似乎深深刺伤了她的自信。

e.en: The broken glass {lacerated} his hand badly.
e.zh: 碎玻璃把他的手严重划伤。

e.en: Critics {lacerated} the film for its weak script.
e.zh: 评论家狠批这部电影剧本薄弱。

e.en: The deep {laceration} on his arm needed stitches.
e.zh: 他手臂上的深裂伤需要缝合。

e.en: Doctors treated a small {laceration} above her eyebrow.
e.zh: 医生处理了她眉毛上方的一处小裂伤。

e.en: A green {lacewing} landed gently on the windowsill.
e.zh: 一只绿色的草蛉轻轻落在窗台上。

e.en: Gardeners welcome {lacewing} larvae because they eat aphids.
e.zh: 园丁们欢迎草蛉幼虫,因为它们以蚜虫为食。

lacework.t: n. 蕾丝织物；花边制品

e.en: The cathedral's stone {lacework} was carved centuries ago.
e.zh: 这座大教堂的石雕花饰是几个世纪前雕刻的。

e.en: Frost formed delicate {lacework} on the morning windows.
e.zh: 霜在清晨的窗上结出精致的花纹。

e.en: The film was a {lachrymose} drama about lost love.
e.zh: 这部电影是一部关于失恋的催泪剧。

e.en: She gave a {lachrymose} farewell speech at the office.
e.zh: 她在办公室发表了一段催人泪下的告别演说。

lacing.t:
n. 系带；花边
v. 系带；掺入

e.en: He spent ten minutes {lacing} up his hiking boots.
e.zh: 他花了十分钟系好登山靴的鞋带。

e.en: The decorative {lacing} on the corset was hand-stitched.
e.zh: 紧身胸衣上的装饰系带都是手工缝制的。

lack.t:
v. 缺乏；没有
n. 缺少

e.en: The project failed due to a {lack} of funding.
e.zh: 这个项目因缺乏资金而失败。

e.en: Small towns often {lack} reliable public transport.
e.zh: 小城镇往往缺乏可靠的公共交通。

lackadaisical.t: adj. 懒散的；无精打采的

e.en: His {lackadaisical} attitude toward homework worried his parents.
e.zh: 他对作业漫不经心的态度让父母很担忧。

e.en: The team's {lackadaisical} performance cost them the match.
e.zh: 球队懒散的表现让他们输掉了比赛。

lacked.t: v. 缺乏（lack 的过去式）

e.en: The presentation was clear but {lacked} concrete examples.
e.zh: 演讲很清晰但缺少具体的例子。

e.en: He {lacked} the confidence to speak up in meetings.
e.zh: 他缺乏在会议上发言的信心。

e.en: He refused to be treated as the boss's {lackey}.
e.zh: 他拒绝被当作老板的跟班使唤。

e.en: Critics dismissed the senator as a corporate {lackey}.
e.zh: 评论人士批评这位参议员只是企业的走狗。

e.en: The new app is fast but {lacking} key features.
e.zh: 这款新应用运行很快,但缺少关键功能。

e.en: Volunteers were sadly {lacking} at this year's event.
e.zh: 今年的活动遗憾地缺少志愿者。

e.en: The team gave a {lackluster} performance in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中表现平平。

e.en: Critics called the new album {lackluster} and forgettable.
e.zh: 评论家称这张新专辑乏善可陈。

lacklustre.t: adj. 乏味的；黯淡的（英式拼写）

e.en: Sales have been {lacklustre} since the price hike.
e.zh: 涨价以来销售一直不温不火。

e.en: He delivered a {lacklustre} speech to a quiet room.
e.zh: 他对着安静的会场做了一场平淡的演讲。

lacks.t: v. 缺乏（lack 的第三人称单数）

e.en: This phone {lacks} a headphone jack entirely.
e.zh: 这款手机完全没有耳机接口。

e.en: Her argument {lacks} solid evidence to back it up.
e.zh: 她的论点缺乏可靠证据支持。

laconic.t: adj. 简洁的；言简意赅的

e.en: His {laconic} reply made the reporters laugh.
e.zh: 他言简意赅的回答让记者们笑了。

e.en: She sent a {laconic} text: "On my way."
e.zh: 她发来一条简短的短信:"在路上。"

e.en: "Maybe," he answered {laconically}, and walked away.
e.zh: "也许吧。"他简短地回了一句就走了。

e.en: She {laconically} summed up the meeting in three words.
e.zh: 她用三个词简洁地总结了那场会议。

lacquer.t:
n. 漆；清漆
v. 涂漆

e.en: Apply a thin coat of {lacquer} to seal the wood.
e.zh: 涂一层薄薄的漆来封住木头。

e.en: She finished her nails with a glossy red {lacquer}.
e.zh: 她最后涂了一层亮红色的指甲油。

e.en: The {lacquered} box was a gift from Kyoto.
e.zh: 这个漆器盒子是从京都带回的礼物。

e.en: His hair was slicked back and {lacquered} in place.
e.zh: 他的头发向后梳得油亮服帖。

e.en: The doctor examined her blocked {lacrimal} duct.
e.zh: 医生检查了她堵塞的泪管。

e.en: Onions trigger the {lacrimal} glands to produce tears.
e.zh: 洋葱会刺激泪腺分泌泪液。

lacroix.t: n. 拉克鲁瓦（人名/品牌）

e.en: I keep a case of {LaCroix} in the fridge.
e.zh: 我冰箱里常备一箱乐口仕气泡水。

e.en: She popped open a grapefruit {LaCroix} at her desk.
e.zh: 她在办公桌前打开了一罐西柚味乐口仕。

e.en: He plays {lacrosse} for the university team.
e.zh: 他在大学校队打长曲棍球。

e.en: The {lacrosse} stick has a small net at the end.
e.zh: 长曲棍球杆顶端有个小网兜。

e.en: Take a {lactase} pill before eating ice cream.
e.zh: 吃冰淇淋前吃一颗乳糖酶。

e.en: Many adults stop producing enough {lactase} naturally.
e.zh: 许多成年人会自然停止分泌足量的乳糖酶。

lactate.t:
v. 分泌乳汁
n. 乳酸盐

e.en: Cows {lactate} for months after giving birth.
e.zh: 母牛产犊后会泌乳数月。

e.en: Athletes' muscles produce {lactate} during intense exercise.
e.zh: 运动员剧烈运动时肌肉会产生乳酸。

lactating.t: adj. 哺乳期的；分泌乳汁的

e.en: {Lactating} mothers need extra calories each day.
e.zh: 哺乳期的妈妈每天需要摄入额外的热量。

e.en: The vet checked the {lactating} dog and her puppies.
e.zh: 兽医检查了正在哺乳的母狗和小狗们。

e.en: The hospital offers a {lactation} consultant for new moms.
e.zh: 医院为新手妈妈提供哺乳顾问服务。

e.en: Hormones drive milk production during {lactation}.
e.zh: 荷尔蒙在哺乳期推动乳汁分泌。

e.en: My legs burned with {lactic} acid after the sprint.
e.zh: 冲刺后我的腿因乳酸堆积而发烧。

e.en: Yogurt is made through {lactic} fermentation of milk.
e.zh: 酸奶是通过牛奶的乳酸发酵制成的。

e.en: I'm {lactose} intolerant, so I drink oat milk.
e.zh: 我有乳糖不耐受,所以喝燕麦奶。

e.en: Hard cheeses contain very little {lactose}.
e.zh: 硬质奶酪含有的乳糖很少。

e.en: There's a {lacuna} in the historical record around 1840.
e.zh: 1840年前后的史料中存在一段空白。

e.en: The translator marked each {lacuna} in the manuscript.
e.zh: 译者在手稿中标出了每一处缺失。

lacunae.t: n. lacuna 的复数；诸多空缺

e.en: Scholars debate the {lacunae} in the ancient text.
e.zh: 学者们对古文中的若干缺漏处争论不休。

e.en: His report had glaring {lacunae} in the data section.
e.zh: 他报告的数据部分存在明显的空缺。

lacustrine.t: adj. 湖泊的；生于湖中的

e.en: The valley has rich {lacustrine} sediment from an ancient lake.
e.zh: 这片山谷有古湖留下的丰富湖相沉积。

e.en: Geologists study {lacustrine} deposits to reconstruct climates.
e.zh: 地质学家研究湖泊沉积物以重建古气候。

lacy.t: adj. 蕾丝般的；花边状的

e.en: She wore a {lacy} white blouse to the brunch.
e.zh: 她穿了一件蕾丝白衬衫去吃早午餐。

e.en: Frost left {lacy} patterns on the kitchen window.
e.zh: 霜在厨房窗上留下了花边般的图案。

e.en: The {lad} ran across the field after the dog.
e.zh: 那小伙子追着狗跑过田野。

e.en: He's a friendly {lad} from the village down the road.
e.zh: 他是路那头村子里一个友善的小伙子。

lada.t: n. 拉达（俄罗斯汽车品牌）

e.en: His grandfather still drives a battered Soviet-era {Lada}.
e.zh: 他爷爷还开着一辆苏联时代的破拉达车。

e.en: A blue {Lada} rattled past us on the cobbled street.
e.zh: 一辆蓝色拉达在石板路上颠簸驶过。

ladbroke.t: n. 拉德布鲁克（姓氏/地名）

e.en: They rented a flat near {Ladbroke} Grove in London.
e.zh: 他们在伦敦拉德布罗克园附近租了套公寓。

e.en: The cafe sits just off {Ladbroke} Road.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆就在拉德布罗克路旁。

ladbrokes.t: n. 立博（英国博彩公司）

e.en: He placed a small bet on the match at {Ladbrokes}.
e.zh: 他在乐百家给那场比赛下了点小注。

e.en: {Ladbrokes} adjusted the odds after the goalkeeper got injured.
e.zh: 门将受伤后,乐百家调整了赔率。

ladder.t:
n. 梯子；阶梯
n. 排行榜（游戏/体育）

e.en: Hold the {ladder} steady while I change the bulb.
e.zh: 我换灯泡时帮我扶稳梯子。

e.en: She climbed the corporate {ladder} in just five years.
e.zh: 她仅用五年就爬上了公司高位。

ladders.t: n. ladder 的复数；梯子们

e.en: The warehouse has tall {ladders} for the top shelves.
e.zh: 仓库里备有够到顶层货架的高梯子。

e.en: The game has {ladders} that let you skip levels.
e.zh: 游戏里有可以跳关的天梯。

laddie.t: n. 小伙儿；小子（苏格兰用语）

e.en: "Come here, {laddie}," the old man called gently.
e.zh: "过来呀,小家伙。"老人轻声叫道。

e.en: The Scottish coach called every player "{laddie}" at training.
e.zh: 那位苏格兰教练在训练时把每个球员都叫"小子"。

laden.t: adj. 满载的；负担沉重的

e.en: The donkey was {laden} with bags of grain.
e.zh: 那头驴驮满了几袋粮食。

e.en: His email was {laden} with corporate jargon.
e.zh: 他的邮件里充斥着各种企业行话。

ladies.t:
n. lady 的复数；女士们
n. 女厕

e.en: Good evening, {ladies} and gentlemen, welcome to the show.
e.zh: 女士们先生们,晚上好,欢迎来到节目现场。

e.en: The {ladies} at the next table were laughing loudly.
e.zh: 邻桌的女士们笑得很大声。

e.en: The shipper signed the bill of {lading} this morning.
e.zh: 今早托运人签了提单。

e.en: Check the bill of {lading} before unloading the container.
e.zh: 卸货前先核对一下提单。

ladle.t:
n. 长柄勺
v. 用勺舀

e.en: She used a wooden {ladle} to serve the soup.
e.zh: 她用木勺盛汤。

e.en: He'll {ladle} stew into bowls for everyone.
e.zh: 他会给大家每人盛一碗炖菜。

e.en: He poured a {ladleful} of gravy over the mashed potatoes.
e.zh: 他舀了一勺肉汁浇在土豆泥上。

e.en: Each guest got a generous {ladleful} of punch.
e.zh: 每位客人都分到满满一勺潘趣酒。

lads.t: n. lad 的复数；小伙们；哥们

e.en: The {lads} are heading to the pub after work.
e.zh: 小伙子们下班后要去酒吧。

e.en: Come on, {lads}, we can still win this game.
e.zh: 加油啊兄弟们,这场我们还有机会赢。

e.en: An elderly {lady} asked me for directions to the station.
e.zh: 一位老太太向我问去车站的路。

e.en: The {lady} at the front desk handed me a key.
e.zh: 前台的女士递给我一把钥匙。

e.en: A red {ladybird} landed on her sleeve.
e.zh: 一只红色瓢虫落在她的袖子上。

e.en: Gardeners welcome {ladybirds} because they eat aphids.
e.zh: 园丁喜欢瓢虫,因为它们吃蚜虫。

e.en: My daughter caught a {ladybug} in the backyard.
e.zh: 我女儿在后院抓到一只瓢虫。

e.en: A tiny {ladybug} crawled across the open book.
e.zh: 一只小瓢虫爬过摊开的书页。

ladylike.t: adj. 有淑女风度的；端庄的

e.en: Her grandmother insisted on {ladylike} table manners.
e.zh: 她奶奶坚持要她有淑女般的餐桌礼仪。

e.en: She gave a {ladylike} smile and quietly left the room.
e.zh: 她优雅地微笑一下,悄悄离开了房间。

ladyship.t: n. 夫人（对贵妇的尊称）

e.en: Her {ladyship} will see you in the drawing room.
e.zh: 夫人将在客厅接见您。

e.en: The butler announced her {ladyship}'s arrival at the gala.
e.zh: 管家在晚宴上通报了夫人的到来。

lafayette.t: n. 拉法耶特（人名/地名）

e.en: They got married at a small chapel in {Lafayette}.
e.zh: 他们在拉法耶特的一座小教堂结了婚。

e.en: {Lafayette} fought alongside Washington during the Revolution.
e.zh: 拉法耶特在独立战争中与华盛顿并肩作战。

lafontaine.t: n. 拉封丹（法国寓言作家）

e.en: Children still read {LaFontaine}'s fables in French class.
e.zh: 孩子们在法语课上仍在读拉封丹的寓言。

e.en: The professor compared Aesop with {LaFontaine}'s style.
e.zh: 教授把伊索的风格与拉封丹做了比较。

lag.t:
n. 延迟；卡顿
v. 落后；滞后

e.en: There's a noticeable {lag} on the video call today.
e.zh: 今天的视频通话明显有延迟。

e.en: Sales tend to {lag} a few months behind ad spending.
e.zh: 销售通常比广告投入滞后几个月。

lagan.t: n. 带浮标的海底沉货

e.en: The diver recovered {lagan} marked with a buoy offshore.
e.zh: 潜水员打捞起了用浮标标记的海底沉物。

e.en: Maritime law treats {lagan} differently from flotsam.
e.zh: 海事法对沉物的处理与漂浮物不同。

e.en: I'll have a cold {lager}, please.
e.zh: 请给我来一杯冰镇拉格啤酒。

e.en: German {lager} pairs well with sausages and pretzels.
e.zh: 德国拉格啤酒搭香肠和椒盐脆饼正好。

lagerfeld.t: n. 拉格斐（时装设计师姓氏）

e.en: Karl {Lagerfeld} reshaped Chanel during his long tenure.
e.zh: 卡尔·拉格斐在长期任内重塑了香奈儿。

e.en: The exhibit features sketches by {Lagerfeld} from the 1980s.
e.zh: 展览展出了拉格斐八十年代的设计手稿。

laggard.t:
n. 落后者
adj. 迟缓的

e.en: The company was a {laggard} in adopting cloud technology.
e.zh: 该公司在采用云技术方面落后于人。

e.en: Don't be a {laggard} — keep up with the group.
e.zh: 别掉队,跟上大家。

lagged.t: v. lag 的过去式；落后；卡顿

e.en: Europe {lagged} behind Asia in 5G rollout for years.
e.zh: 欧洲在5G部署上多年落后于亚洲。

e.en: My internet {lagged} during the entire presentation.
e.zh: 我整个演讲过程中网都很卡。

lagging.t:
n. 延迟；卡顿
adj. 落后的

e.en: Profits are {lagging} despite strong overall sales.
e.zh: 尽管总销量强劲,利润仍然滞后。

e.en: The video kept {lagging} on my old laptop.
e.zh: 视频在我的旧笔记本上一直卡顿。

e.en: The baker tossed in an extra cookie as {lagniappe}.
e.zh: 面包师额外送了一块饼干作小赠礼。

e.en: In New Orleans, a small gift is called {lagniappe}.
e.zh: 在新奥尔良,这种小赠品叫做"lagniappe"。

lago.t: n. 湖（西班牙/意大利语）

e.en: We rented a cabin by {Lago} di Como last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在科莫湖边租了间小屋。

e.en: The hotel overlooks {Lago} Maggiore at sunset.
e.zh: 日落时分,酒店俯瞰马焦雷湖。

e.en: We snorkeled in a turquoise {lagoon} all afternoon.
e.zh: 我们整个下午都在碧绿的潟湖里浮潜。

e.en: A coral reef separates the {lagoon} from the open sea.
e.zh: 一道珊瑚礁把潟湖与外海隔开。

lagos.t: n. 拉各斯（尼日利亚城市）

e.en: {Lagos} is the largest city in Nigeria by population.
e.zh: 拉各斯是尼日利亚人口最多的城市。

e.en: She booked a direct flight from London to {Lagos}.
e.zh: 她订了从伦敦直飞拉各斯的航班。

lagrangian.t:
n. 拉格朗日量
adj. 拉格朗日的

e.en: The {Lagrangian} describes the dynamics of the entire system.
e.zh: 拉格朗日量描述了整个系统的动力学。

e.en: Physics students must learn to derive the {Lagrangian} equations.
e.zh: 物理系学生必须学会推导拉格朗日方程。

laguna.t: n. 潟湖（西语）；拉古纳（地名）

e.en: We spent the weekend swimming at {Laguna} Beach.
e.zh: 我们在拉古纳海滩游泳度过了周末。

e.en: The artist owns a small studio in {Laguna}.
e.zh: 那位艺术家在拉古纳有间小工作室。

lahore.t: n. 拉合尔（巴基斯坦城市）

e.en: {Lahore} is famous for its Mughal architecture and food.
e.zh: 拉合尔以莫卧儿建筑和美食闻名。

e.en: She grew up in {Lahore} before moving to Karachi.
e.zh: 她在拉合尔长大,后来搬到卡拉奇。

lai.t: n. 中世纪短叙事诗；赖（姓）

e.en: The medieval {lai} was a short narrative poem set to music.
e.zh: 中世纪的莱歌是一种配乐的短篇叙事诗。

e.en: My Vietnamese friend's surname is {Lai}.
e.zh: 我那位越南朋友姓赖。

laid.t: v. lay 的过去式；放置；铺设

e.en: She {laid} the baby gently on the bed.
e.zh: 她把婴儿轻轻地放在床上。

e.en: The company {laid} off two hundred workers last month.
e.zh: 那家公司上个月裁掉了两百名员工。

e.en: The bear returned to its {lair} for the winter.
e.zh: 那只熊回到自己的洞穴过冬。

e.en: The villain plotted from his secret mountain {lair}.
e.zh: 那个反派在他山中的秘密巢穴里密谋。

laird.t: n. 苏格兰地主；庄园主

e.en: The Scottish {laird} owned the entire valley.
e.zh: 那位苏格兰地主拥有整个山谷。

e.en: He inherited the title of {laird} from his father.
e.zh: 他从父亲那里继承了庄园主的头衔。

laity.t:
n. 俗人；非神职人员
n. 外行人

e.en: The bishop urged the {laity} to participate more actively.
e.zh: 主教敦促平信徒更积极地参与。

e.en: Medical jargon often confuses the {laity}.
e.zh: 医学术语常常让外行人感到困惑。

e.en: We rented a cabin by the {lake} for summer.
e.zh: 我们在湖边租了一间小屋过暑假。

e.en: The {lake} freezes solid every January.
e.zh: 这片湖每年一月都会完全结冰。

lakefront.t:
n. 湖滨地带
adj. 临湖的

e.en: They bought a {lakefront} property with a private dock.
e.zh: 他们买下了一处带私人码头的湖畔房产。

e.en: The hotel offers stunning {lakefront} views from every room.
e.zh: 这家酒店每个房间都能看到迷人的湖景。

lakeland.t: n. 湖泊地区；英国湖区

e.en: The English {Lakeland} attracts millions of hikers annually.
e.zh: 英国湖区每年吸引数百万徒步爱好者。

e.en: {Lakeland} terriers are known for their bold personalities.
e.zh: 湖区梗以胆大的性格著称。

laker.t:
n. 湖人队球员
n. 湖上航行的船

e.en: He's been a die-hard {Laker} fan since childhood.
e.zh: 他从小就是死忠湖人队球迷。

e.en: The {Laker} scored thirty points in the final quarter.
e.zh: 那位湖人队球员在末节砍下三十分。

e.en: Minnesota is famous for its ten thousand {lakes}.
e.zh: 明尼苏达州以其上万个湖泊闻名。

e.en: The Great {Lakes} hold a fifth of the world's freshwater.
e.zh: 五大湖拥有全球五分之一的淡水资源。

e.en: We walked along the {lakeshore} at sunset.
e.zh: 我们在日落时沿着湖岸散步。

e.en: Erosion is gradually changing the {lakeshore} each year.
e.zh: 侵蚀正在让湖岸线逐年改变。

lakeside.t:
n. 湖畔
adj. 湖边的

e.en: They had a romantic dinner at the {lakeside} restaurant.
e.zh: 他们在湖畔餐厅享用了一顿浪漫晚餐。

e.en: Our {lakeside} cottage has been in the family for generations.
e.zh: 我们家的湖畔小屋传了好几代了。

lam.t:
v. 潜逃；逃亡
n. 逃亡（on the lam）

e.en: The robber has been on the {lam} for two weeks.
e.zh: 那名劫匪已经潜逃了两周。

e.en: He went on the {lam} after the indictment came down.
e.zh: 起诉书一下来他就跑路了。

lama.t: n. 喇嘛（藏传佛教僧侣）

e.en: The Dalai {Lama} spoke about compassion and inner peace.
e.zh: 达赖喇嘛谈到了慈悲与内心的平静。

e.en: A young {lama} led the morning prayers at the monastery.
e.zh: 一位年轻的喇嘛在寺院里主持了晨祷。

e.en: {Lamarckian} inheritance was largely discredited by modern genetics.
e.zh: 拉马克式遗传基本上已被现代遗传学否定。

e.en: Some epigenetic findings sparked renewed interest in {Lamarckian} ideas.
e.zh: 一些表观遗传学发现重新引发了对拉马克学说的兴趣。

lamarckism.t: n. 拉马克主义（用进废退进化论）

e.en: {Lamarckism} proposed that acquired traits could be inherited.
e.zh: 拉马克主义认为后天获得的性状可以遗传。

e.en: Most biologists rejected {Lamarckism} after Darwin's theory took hold.
e.zh: 达尔文学说确立后,多数生物学家便否定了拉马克主义。

lamb.t:
n. 羔羊；羊羔肉
v. 产羔

e.en: We had roast {lamb} for Easter dinner.
e.zh: 我们复活节晚餐吃了烤羊肉。

e.en: A newborn {lamb} stumbled across the field toward its mother.
e.zh: 一只刚出生的小羊踉跄着穿过田野走向母亲。

lambada.t: n. 兰巴达舞（巴西舞蹈）

e.en: They danced the {lambada} at the Brazilian street festival.
e.zh: 他们在巴西街头节庆上跳起了兰巴达舞。

e.en: The {lambada} became a global craze in the late eighties.
e.zh: 兰巴达舞在八十年代末风靡全球。

e.en: Critics {lambast} the film for its weak plot.
e.zh: 影评人猛烈抨击这部电影情节单薄。

e.en: The senator was quick to {lambast} the new policy.
e.zh: 那位参议员迅速对新政策大加抨击。

e.en: Reviewers continue to {lambaste} the company's poor service.
e.zh: 评论人士持续抨击该公司糟糕的服务。

e.en: She did not hesitate to {lambaste} her opponent on stage.
e.zh: 她毫不犹豫地在台上痛斥对手。

lambda.t:
n. 希腊字母 λ
n. lambda 函数（编程）

e.en: In Python, {lambda} creates a small anonymous function.
e.zh: 在 Python 中,lambda 用于创建小型匿名函数。

e.en: The Greek letter {lambda} often denotes wavelength in physics.
e.zh: 希腊字母 λ 在物理学中常用来表示波长。

lambent.t:
adj. 轻轻闪烁的
adj. （言语）轻快机智的

e.en: A {lambent} flame flickered softly in the fireplace.
e.zh: 壁炉里柔和的火苗轻轻摇曳。

e.en: The lake reflected the {lambent} glow of dawn.
e.zh: 湖面映照着黎明柔和的微光。

lambert.t: n. 兰伯特（亮度单位/姓氏）

e.en: The {lambert} is a unit of luminance rarely used today.
e.zh: 朗伯是一种如今很少使用的亮度单位。

e.en: Mr. {Lambert} teaches advanced calculus at the university.
e.zh: 兰伯特先生在大学教授高等微积分。

e.en: The Archbishop of Canterbury resides in {Lambeth} Palace.
e.zh: 坎特伯雷大主教住在兰贝斯宫。

e.en: {Lambeth} is a vibrant borough on the Thames south bank.
e.zh: 兰贝斯是泰晤士河南岸一个充满活力的行政区。

e.en: {Lambing} season keeps farmers busy through early spring.
e.zh: 产羔季让农场主们忙到初春。

e.en: The shepherd stayed up all night during {lambing}.
e.zh: 产羔期间牧羊人通宵未眠。

lamborghini.t: n. 兰博基尼（意大利跑车品牌）

e.en: He pulled up to the hotel in a yellow {Lamborghini}.
e.zh: 他开着一辆黄色兰博基尼停在酒店门口。

e.en: The new {Lamborghini} can hit 200 mph easily.
e.zh: 这款新兰博基尼可以轻松达到时速 320 公里。

e.en: The {lambs} grazed peacefully on the hillside.
e.zh: 小羊们在山坡上安静地吃着草。

e.en: Spring brings dozens of newborn {lambs} to the farm.
e.zh: 春天会给农场带来几十只新生的小羊羔。

e.en: She wore soft {lambskin} gloves to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着柔软的羔羊皮手套出席晚宴。

e.en: The wallet is made of genuine Italian {lambskin}.
e.zh: 这款钱包由正宗意大利羊羔皮制成。

e.en: This {lambswool} sweater feels incredibly warm and soft.
e.zh: 这件羔羊毛毛衣摸起来又暖又柔软。

e.en: They knit scarves from pure Scottish {lambswool}.
e.zh: 他们用纯正的苏格兰羔羊毛织围巾。

e.en: The legend of the {Lambton} Worm is famous in northern England.
e.zh: 兰姆顿巨虫的传说在英格兰北部很有名。

e.en: {Lambton} County lies on the eastern shore of Lake Huron.
e.zh: 兰姆顿县位于休伦湖东岸。

lame.t:
adj. 蹩脚的；无说服力的
adj. 瘸的

e.en: That excuse sounds pretty {lame} to me.
e.zh: 那个借口在我听来挺烂的。

e.en: The horse went {lame} after the long ride.
e.zh: 那匹马长途奔跑后跛了。

lamely.t: adv. 无说服力地；蹩脚地

e.en: He apologized {lamely} and avoided eye contact.
e.zh: 他敷衍地道了歉,还避开了目光接触。

e.en: The injured deer moved {lamely} through the forest.
e.zh: 那只受伤的鹿一瘸一拐地穿过森林。

e.en: The vet diagnosed the {lameness} as a sprained tendon.
e.zh: 兽医诊断这种跛行是肌腱拉伤。

e.en: Critics pointed out the {lameness} of his rebuttal.
e.zh: 评论者指出他的反驳软弱无力。

lament.t:
v. 哀叹；悲痛
n. 挽歌；悲叹

e.en: Many parents {lament} how much time kids spend online.
e.zh: 许多家长哀叹孩子花在网上的时间太多。

e.en: The song is a {lament} for lost love.
e.zh: 这首歌是对逝去爱情的哀歌。

lamentable.t: adj. 可悲的；令人遗憾的

e.en: The team's performance this season has been {lamentable}.
e.zh: 这支队伍本赛季的表现实在令人惋惜。

e.en: It is {lamentable} that so few students read for pleasure.
e.zh: 如此少的学生为兴趣而阅读,实在令人遗憾。

lamentably.t: adv. 可悲地；令人遗憾地

e.en: The project was {lamentably} underfunded from the start.
e.zh: 这个项目从一开始资金就严重不足,令人遗憾。

e.en: Her cooking skills are {lamentably} poor.
e.zh: 她的厨艺糟糕得让人无奈。

e.en: A deep {lamentation} rose from the mourners at the funeral.
e.zh: 葬礼上,送葬者发出深深的哀叹。

e.en: There was much {lamentation} when the factory closed down.
e.zh: 工厂关闭时引发了许多悲叹。

lamentations.t:
n. 《耶利米哀歌》（圣经）
n. 哀叹（复数）

e.en: The Book of {Lamentations} mourns the fall of Jerusalem.
e.zh: 《耶利米哀歌》为耶路撒冷的陷落而哀悼。

e.en: His {lamentations} echoed through the empty hall.
e.zh: 他的悲叹回荡在空荡的大厅里。

lamented.t: adj. 令人哀悼的；已故的

e.en: She {lamented} the loss of her childhood home.
e.zh: 她为失去童年的家而哀伤。

e.en: The much-{lamented} author left behind several unfinished novels.
e.zh: 这位备受怀念的作家留下了几部未完成的小说。

lamenting.t: v. 哀叹（lament 的现在分词）

e.en: He spent the evening {lamenting} his missed opportunities.
e.zh: 他整晚都在为错过的机会唉声叹气。

e.en: Fans are still {lamenting} the show's sudden cancellation.
e.zh: 粉丝们还在为节目突然停播而惋惜。

e.en: She often {laments} not learning a second language earlier.
e.zh: 她常感叹没能更早学会第二外语。

e.en: The album is filled with mournful {laments} about war.
e.zh: 这张专辑充满了关于战争的悲伤挽歌。

lamina.t:
n. 薄片；薄层
n. 叶片（植物）

e.en: Each {lamina} of the leaf captures sunlight efficiently.
e.zh: 叶片的每一片叶身都能高效吸收阳光。

e.en: The thin {lamina} of bone is easily fractured.
e.zh: 那薄薄的骨板很容易骨折。

e.en: At low speeds, the airflow remains smooth and {laminar}.
e.zh: 在低速下,气流保持平滑的层流状态。

e.en: Engineers designed the wing to maintain {laminar} flow longer.
e.zh: 工程师设计这种机翼是为了让层流维持更久。

laminate.t:
v. 层压；贴膜
n. 层压板

e.en: We chose to {laminate} the kitchen countertops for durability.
e.zh: 为了耐用,我们选择给厨房台面贴上层压板。

e.en: The new {laminate} flooring looks just like real wood.
e.zh: 新铺的强化复合地板看起来跟真木地板一样。

e.en: She handed me a {laminated} card with the safety rules.
e.zh: 她递给我一张过塑的安全须知卡。

e.en: {Laminated} glass shatters into harmless small pieces.
e.zh: 夹层玻璃碎裂时只会变成无害的小碎片。

e.en: The {lamination} protects the document from water damage.
e.zh: 这层覆膜能防止文件被水损坏。

e.en: Poor {lamination} caused the wood panels to peel apart.
e.zh: 层压工艺不佳导致木板剥离开来。

laminin.t: n. 层粘连蛋白（细胞外基质蛋白）

e.en: Researchers study how {laminin} supports cell adhesion in tissues.
e.zh: 研究人员研究层粘连蛋白如何促进组织中的细胞黏附。

e.en: The protein {laminin} forms a cross shape under the microscope.
e.zh: 层粘连蛋白在显微镜下呈十字形结构。

e.en: She turned on the desk {lamp} to read late at night.
e.zh: 她打开台灯,深夜读书。

e.en: The old oil {lamp} still works during power outages.
e.zh: 那盏旧油灯在停电时仍然能用。

e.en: They walked home through soft {lamplight} on cobblestone streets.
e.zh: 他们走过石板路,在柔和的灯光下回家。

e.en: She wrote letters by {lamplight} every winter evening.
e.zh: 每个冬日傍晚,她都在灯光下写信。

e.en: The old {lamplighter} lit each gas lamp at dusk.
e.zh: 年迈的点灯人在黄昏时点亮每盏煤气灯。

e.en: In Victorian London, a {lamplighter} walked the streets every evening.
e.zh: 在维多利亚时代的伦敦,点灯人每晚都走街串巷。

e.en: They dined at a small {lamplit} table by the window.
e.zh: 他们在窗边一张点着灯的小桌上用餐。

e.en: The {lamplit} alley felt quiet and almost magical.
e.zh: 那条灯光照亮的小巷宁静得近乎梦幻。

lampoon.t:
v. 讽刺嘲弄
n. 讽刺文章

e.en: The cartoon was meant to {lampoon} corrupt politicians.
e.zh: 这幅漫画意在讽刺贪腐的政客。

e.en: The magazine published a sharp {lampoon} of the new policy.
e.zh: 那本杂志发表了一篇尖刻讽刺新政策的文章。

e.en: A cat sat quietly under the {lamppost} on the corner.
e.zh: 一只猫静静地坐在街角的路灯柱下。

e.en: He leaned against the {lamppost} waiting for the bus.
e.zh: 他靠着路灯柱等公交车。

e.en: The {lamprey} attaches to fish using its circular mouth.
e.zh: 七鳃鳗用圆形的嘴吸附在鱼身上。

e.en: Scientists tracked the {lamprey} migrating up the river.
e.zh: 科学家追踪七鳃鳗逆流而上的迁徙。

e.en: She bought two matching {lamps} for the bedroom.
e.zh: 她为卧室买了两盏配套的台灯。

e.en: The street {lamps} flickered on as evening fell.
e.zh: 夜幕降临时,街灯一盏盏亮了起来。

e.en: The fabric {lampshade} casts a warm glow over the room.
e.zh: 布制灯罩为房间洒下温暖的光。

e.en: She replaced the cracked {lampshade} with a paper one.
e.zh: 她把裂掉的灯罩换成了一个纸灯罩。

lan.t: n. 局域网（Local Area Network 的缩写）

e.en: All the office computers connect through a wired {lan}.
e.zh: 办公室所有电脑都通过有线局域网连接。

e.en: We hosted a {lan} party to play games together.
e.zh: 我们办了一场局域网聚会一起打游戏。

e.en: They had breakfast on the {lanai} overlooking the ocean.
e.zh: 他们在能看到海景的露台上吃早餐。

e.en: The hotel room opened onto a private {lanai}.
e.zh: 酒店房间通往一个私人露台。

lanark.t: n. 拉纳克（苏格兰地名）

e.en: We drove through {lanark} on our way to Glasgow.
e.zh: 我们去格拉斯哥的路上经过了拉纳克。

e.en: The town of {lanark} has a long Scottish history.
e.zh: 拉纳克镇有着悠久的苏格兰历史。

e.en: She grew up on a small farm in {lanarkshire}.
e.zh: 她在拉纳克郡的一个小农场长大。

e.en: Coal mining once shaped the economy of {lanarkshire}.
e.zh: 煤矿开采曾塑造了拉纳克郡的经济。

e.en: He bought some traditional cheese from a {lancashire} dairy.
e.zh: 他从兰开夏郡的奶酪坊买了些传统奶酪。

e.en: The textile mills of {lancashire} powered Britain's industrial era.
e.zh: 兰开夏郡的纺织厂推动了英国的工业时代。

lancaster.t: n. 兰开斯特（地名/姓氏）

e.en: They visited the historic castle in {lancaster} last summer.
e.zh: 他们去年夏天参观了兰开斯特的古堡。

e.en: The {lancaster} bomber played a key role in WWII.
e.zh: 兰开斯特轰炸机在二战中发挥了关键作用。

lancastrian.t:
n. 兰开斯特人
adj. 兰开斯特（王朝）的

e.en: Her {lancastrian} accent gave away where she grew up.
e.zh: 她的兰开斯特口音透露了她是哪里人。

e.en: The {lancastrian} forces fought against the House of York.
e.zh: 兰开斯特派的军队与约克王朝交战。

lance.t:
n. 长矛
v. 用矛刺；切开（脓包）

e.en: The knight raised his {lance} before charging into battle.
e.zh: 骑士冲锋之前举起了长矛。

e.en: The doctor used a fine needle to {lance} the boil.
e.zh: 医生用细针刺破了脓肿。

lancelot.t: n. 兰斯洛特（亚瑟王传说骑士）

e.en: Sir {lancelot} was the most famous knight of the Round Table.
e.zh: 兰斯洛特爵士是圆桌骑士中最著名的一位。

e.en: Children love hearing the legend of {lancelot} and Guinevere.
e.zh: 孩子们喜欢听兰斯洛特和桂妮薇的传奇故事。

e.en: A mounted {lancer} galloped past the parade crowd.
e.zh: 一名骑着马的长矛骑兵从游行人群旁飞驰而过。

e.en: He drives an old Mitsubishi {lancer} to work every day.
e.zh: 他每天开一辆旧三菱蓝瑟去上班。

lances.t:
n. 长矛（复数）
v. 刺（lance 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The knights couched their {lances} as they charged.
e.zh: 骑士们冲锋时夹紧了长矛。

e.en: Ancient warriors carried wooden {lances} into combat.
e.zh: 古代战士手持木制长矛上战场。

lancet.t: n. 柳叶刀；医用小尖刀

e.en: The surgeon picked up a small {lancet} to drain the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生拿起一把小柳叶刀引流伤口。

e.en: The study was published in {lancet} last month.
e.zh: 那项研究上个月发表在《柳叶刀》上。

lanchester.t: n. 兰彻斯特（姓氏/地名）

e.en: Frederick {lanchester} pioneered early British automobile engineering.
e.zh: 弗雷德里克·兰彻斯特开创了早期英国汽车工程。

e.en: His model is based on {lanchester}'s combat equations.
e.zh: 他的模型基于兰彻斯特战斗方程。

lancia.t: n. 蓝旗亚（意大利汽车品牌）

e.en: He restored a vintage {lancia} from the 1970s.
e.zh: 他修复了一辆二十世纪七十年代的老式蓝旗亚汽车。

e.en: The {lancia} brand is famous for its rally heritage.
e.zh: 蓝旗亚品牌以其拉力赛传统而闻名。

e.en: The doctor recommended {lancing} the abscess immediately.
e.zh: 医生建议立即切开脓肿。

e.en: They spent the weekend in {lancing}, a small coastal town.
e.zh: 他们在沿海小镇兰辛度过了周末。

lancs.t: n. 兰开夏郡（Lancashire 的缩写）

e.en: He moved to {lancs} for a new factory job.
e.zh: 他搬到兰开夏郡找了一份新的工厂工作。

e.en: The match was held at a stadium in {lancs}.
e.zh: 比赛在兰开夏郡的一个体育场举行。

land.t:
n. 陆地；土地
v. 着陆；降落

e.en: The plane is scheduled to {land} at six in the morning.
e.zh: 飞机预计早上六点降落。

e.en: Her family owns a small piece of {land} near the river.
e.zh: 她家在河边拥有一小块土地。

landau.t: n. 一种折篷四轮马车

e.en: A vintage {landau} carriage carried the bride to the church.
e.zh: 一辆复古折篷马车把新娘送到了教堂。

e.en: The duke arrived in a polished black {landau}.
e.zh: 公爵乘着一辆光亮的黑色折篷马车到来。

landed.t:
v. 着陆（land 的过去式）
adj. 拥有土地的

e.en: The plane {landed} smoothly despite the strong winds.
e.zh: 尽管风很大,飞机仍平稳着陆。

e.en: She finally {landed} her dream job at the design firm.
e.zh: 她终于在那家设计公司得到了梦想中的工作。

e.en: The Mars {lander} sent back stunning images of the surface.
e.zh: 火星着陆器传回了令人惊叹的地表图像。

e.en: Engineers tested the {lander} in a simulated lunar environment.
e.zh: 工程师在模拟月球环境中测试了着陆器。

e.en: The {landes} region is known for its vast pine forests.
e.zh: 朗德地区以广阔的松林而闻名。

e.en: They cycled through the {landes} along the Atlantic coast.
e.zh: 他们沿着大西洋海岸骑行穿过朗德。

landfall.t: n. 登陆；(船、飞机)到达陆地

e.en: The hurricane made {landfall} along the Florida coast.
e.zh: 飓风在佛罗里达海岸登陆。

e.en: After weeks at sea, the sailors finally made {landfall}.
e.zh: 在海上漂泊数周后,水手们终于登陆了。

landfill.t:
n. 垃圾填埋场
v. 填埋（垃圾）

e.en: Most plastic packaging still ends up in a {landfill}.
e.zh: 大多数塑料包装最终还是被送到了垃圾填埋场。

e.en: The city is closing its old {landfill} next year.
e.zh: 该市将于明年关闭其旧的垃圾填埋场。

landfilling.t:
v. 进行垃圾填埋
n. 填埋处理

e.en: The country is gradually phasing out {landfilling} of food waste.
e.zh: 该国正在逐步淘汰食物垃圾的填埋处理。

e.en: Recycling reduces the cost of {landfilling} household trash.
e.zh: 回收利用降低了填埋生活垃圾的成本。

e.en: A canyon is a dramatic {landform} carved by rivers.
e.zh: 峡谷是河流冲刷形成的壮观地貌。

e.en: Geographers classify each {landform} by shape and origin.
e.zh: 地理学家根据形状和成因对每种地貌进行分类。

e.en: The largest {landholder} in the county controls thousands of acres.
e.zh: 该郡最大的土地所有者控制着数千英亩土地。

e.en: Each {landholder} must pay annual property tax.
e.zh: 每位土地持有人都必须缴纳年度财产税。

landholding.t:
n. 土地持有
adj. 拥有土地的

e.en: Her family's {landholding} has been passed down for generations.
e.zh: 她家的土地世代相传。

e.en: The reform broke up large {landholding} estates after the war.
e.zh: 战后改革分割了大型土地庄园。

landing.t:
n. 着陆；登陆页
v. 降落中

e.en: The plane made a smooth {landing} despite the storm.
e.zh: 尽管有暴风雨,飞机还是平稳着陆。

e.en: She paused on the {landing} between the two flights of stairs.
e.zh: 她在两段楼梯之间的楼梯平台上停了一下。

landings.t: n. 着陆（复数）；楼梯平台

e.en: The pilot completed three perfect {landings} during training.
e.zh: 飞行员在训练中完成了三次完美着陆。

e.en: All the apartment {landings} were freshly painted last week.
e.zh: 上周所有公寓的楼梯平台都重新粉刷了。

e.en: Both {landladies} agreed to lower the rent this year.
e.zh: 两位女房东都同意今年降低租金。

e.en: The neighborhood {landladies} met monthly to share tenant tips.
e.zh: 附近的女房东们每月聚会分享管理租客的经验。

e.en: My {landlady} fixed the leaky faucet the same day.
e.zh: 我的女房东当天就把漏水的水龙头修好了。

e.en: The {landlady} bakes cookies for new tenants every month.
e.zh: 女房东每个月都为新租客烤饼干。

e.en: Many {landless} farmers moved to cities seeking factory work.
e.zh: 许多无地农民进城寻找工厂工作。

e.en: The reform aimed to support {landless} rural families.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在帮助无地的农村家庭。

e.en: Few young people still use a {landline} at home.
e.zh: 如今很少有年轻人还在家里用座机。

e.en: The office {landline} rang during the quiet meeting.
e.zh: 安静的会议中,办公室的座机响了起来。

e.en: Mountain ranges effectively {landlock} the small mountain nation.
e.zh: 山脉实际上使这个小型山国成了内陆国。

e.en: Border disputes can {landlock} a country and cripple trade.
e.zh: 边境争端可能让一个国家变为内陆国并削弱贸易。

landlocked.t: adj. 内陆的；被陆地包围的

e.en: Switzerland is a wealthy but {landlocked} European country.
e.zh: 瑞士是一个富裕但不靠海的欧洲国家。

e.en: Being {landlocked} makes shipping goods more expensive.
e.zh: 内陆国家的位置让货物运输成本更高。

e.en: My {landlord} raised the rent again this year.
e.zh: 我的房东今年又涨房租了。

e.en: The {landlord} promised to repair the broken heater soon.
e.zh: 房东承诺很快修好坏掉的暖气。

e.en: The novel criticizes the cruelty of nineteenth-century {landlordism}.
e.zh: 这部小说批判了十九世纪地主制度的残酷。

e.en: Reformers fought against {landlordism} in rural communities.
e.zh: 改革者在农村地区反对地主制度。

e.en: Many {landlords} now require renters to carry insurance.
e.zh: 现在许多房东要求租客购买保险。

e.en: The city introduced new rules for {landlords} this month.
e.zh: 该市本月出台了针对房东的新规定。

landlubber.t: n. 不习水性的人；外行水手

e.en: The sailors teased the new recruit as a {landlubber}.
e.zh: 水手们取笑那个新兵是个旱鸭子。

e.en: As a true {landlubber}, he got seasick on the ferry.
e.zh: 作为一个十足的旱鸭子,他坐渡轮就晕船。

landmark.t:
n. 地标
adj. 具有里程碑意义的

e.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous Parisian {landmark}.
e.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎著名的地标。

e.en: The court issued a {landmark} ruling on privacy rights.
e.zh: 法院就隐私权作出了具有里程碑意义的裁决。

landmarks.t: n. 地标（复数）；里程碑事件

e.en: The Eiffel Tower is one of Paris's most famous {landmarks}.
e.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎最著名的地标之一。

e.en: This discovery represents one of the {landmarks} in modern medicine.
e.zh: 这一发现是现代医学的里程碑之一。

e.en: Australia is the smallest continental {landmass} on Earth.
e.zh: 澳大利亚是地球上最小的大陆陆块。

e.en: A huge {landmass} once connected Asia and North America.
e.zh: 曾经有一大片陆地连接亚洲和北美洲。

e.en: The soldier carefully defused the buried {landmine}.
e.zh: 士兵小心地拆除了埋在地下的地雷。

e.en: Bringing up that topic at dinner was a total {landmine}.
e.zh: 晚餐时提起那个话题简直是踩雷。

e.en: The wealthy {landowner} refused to sell his estate.
e.zh: 那位富有的地主拒绝出售他的庄园。

e.en: Every {landowner} must pay annual property taxes.
e.zh: 每位土地所有者都必须缴纳年度房产税。

e.en: {Landownership} laws vary widely from country to country.
e.zh: 各国的土地所有权法律差异很大。

e.en: The reform aimed to redistribute {landownership} more fairly.
e.zh: 这项改革旨在更公平地重新分配土地所有权。

landowning.t:
adj. 拥有土地的
n. 土地所有

e.en: He came from a wealthy {landowning} family in the south.
e.zh: 他出身于南方一个富有的地主家庭。

e.en: The {landowning} class dominated rural politics for centuries.
e.zh: 地主阶级几个世纪以来主导着乡村政治。

e.en: They drove a battered old {landrover} across the savanna.
e.zh: 他们开着一辆破旧的路虎越野车穿越大草原。

e.en: The safari guide parked the {landrover} near the watering hole.
e.zh: 导游把那辆路虎停在水坑附近。

lands.t:
n. 土地；地产（land 的复数）
v. 着陆（第三人称单数）

e.en: The plane {lands} at Heathrow in twenty minutes.
e.zh: 飞机将在二十分钟后降落在希思罗机场。

e.en: The king ruled vast {lands} stretching to the sea.
e.zh: 国王统治着延伸至大海的广阔土地。

landsat.t: n. 陆地卫星（美国地球观测卫星）

e.en: NASA's {Landsat} satellites have monitored Earth since 1972.
e.zh: 美国宇航局的陆地卫星自1972年起一直监测地球。

e.en: Researchers use {Landsat} imagery to track deforestation.
e.zh: 研究人员利用陆地卫星图像追踪森林砍伐情况。

landscape.t:
n. 风景；横屏
v. 美化景观

e.en: The mountain {landscape} took our breath away at sunrise.
e.zh: 日出时山间的景色让我们叹为观止。

e.en: AI is changing the {landscape} of modern software development.
e.zh: 人工智能正在改变现代软件开发的格局。

e.en: The hotel has beautifully {landscaped} gardens around the pool.
e.zh: 酒店泳池周围有精心设计的花园景观。

e.en: They {landscaped} the backyard with stones and native plants.
e.zh: 他们用石头和本地植物美化了后院。

landscaper.t: n. 园林设计师，景观师

e.en: We hired a {landscaper} to redesign our front yard.
e.zh: 我们雇了一位园林设计师重新设计前院。

e.en: The {landscaper} planted dozens of trees along the driveway.
e.zh: 那位景观设计师沿着车道种了几十棵树。

e.en: Iceland's volcanic {landscapes} attract photographers from everywhere.
e.zh: 冰岛的火山景观吸引着世界各地的摄影师。

e.en: The artist painted rural English {landscapes} all his life.
e.zh: 这位艺术家一生都在描绘英国乡村风景。

landscaping.t: n. 景观美化，园林设计

e.en: Good {landscaping} can significantly increase your home's value.
e.zh: 良好的景观设计能显著提升房屋的价值。

e.en: They spent the weekend {landscaping} the new backyard.
e.zh: 他们花了一个周末来打理新后院的景观。

e.en: Constable was a celebrated English {landscapist} of the 1800s.
e.zh: 康斯太勃尔是十九世纪英国著名的风景画家。

e.en: The gallery features works by a contemporary Chinese {landscapist}.
e.zh: 画廊展出了一位当代中国风景画家的作品。

e.en: The painting is a famous work by Sir Edwin {Landseer}.
e.zh: 这幅画是埃德温·兰西尔爵士的著名作品。

e.en: A {Landseer} Newfoundland makes a gentle family dog.
e.zh: 兰西尔纽芬兰犬是一种性情温和的家庭犬。

landslide.t: n. 山体滑坡；压倒性胜利

e.en: Heavy rain triggered a massive {landslide} on the mountain road.
e.zh: 暴雨引发了山路上的大规模山体滑坡。

e.en: The candidate won the election by a {landslide}.
e.zh: 那位候选人以压倒性优势赢得了选举。

e.en: Deforestation has caused frequent {landslides} in the region.
e.zh: 森林砍伐导致该地区频繁发生山体滑坡。

e.en: The party has won three elections by {landslides} in a row.
e.zh: 该党已连续三次以压倒性优势赢得选举。

e.en: A small {landslip} blocked the coastal railway overnight.
e.zh: 一次小型山体滑坡一夜之间阻塞了沿海铁路。

e.en: Engineers inspected the cliff after last week's {landslip}.
e.zh: 工程师在上周滑坡后对悬崖进行了检查。

landsman.t: n. 不谙航海的人；同乡

e.en: The sailors teased the new {landsman} for his seasickness.
e.zh: 水手们取笑那位新来的旱鸭子晕船。

e.en: As a lifelong {landsman}, he had never sailed before.
e.zh: 作为一辈子的旱鸭子,他以前从未航过海。

landward.t:
adv. 向陆地
adj. 朝陆地的

e.en: A cold wind blew {landward} from the open sea.
e.zh: 一阵寒风从大海向陆地方向吹来。

e.en: The harbor's {landward} side is sheltered from storms.
e.zh: 港口靠陆地的一侧可避风躲雨。

e.en: Stay in the right {lane} until your exit appears.
e.zh: 在出口出现之前请保持在右车道行驶。

e.en: They walked down a quiet country {lane} at sunset.
e.zh: 他们在日落时分沿着安静的乡间小路散步。

e.en: The highway widens to four {lanes} past the bridge.
e.zh: 高速公路在桥后扩展为四车道。

e.en: Olympic swimmers competed in eight separate {lanes}.
e.zh: 奥运游泳选手在八个独立泳道中比赛。

e.en: In English class we read {lang} syne carols at Christmas.
e.zh: 英语课上我们在圣诞节读《友谊地久天长》的颂歌。

e.en: Andrew {Lang} collected fairy tales from around the world.
e.zh: 安德鲁·朗收集了世界各地的童话故事。

e.en: We hiked the {Langdale} Pikes in the Lake District last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们在湖区徒步了朗代尔山峰。

e.en: The {Langdale} valley is famous for its dramatic scenery.
e.zh: 朗代尔山谷以其壮丽的景色而闻名。

e.en: Mr. {Langford} taught chemistry at the local high school.
e.zh: 兰福德先生在当地的高中教化学。

e.en: The village of {Langford} sits beside a slow-moving river.
e.zh: 兰福德村坐落在一条缓缓流淌的河边。

e.en: We had afternoon tea at the {Langham} Hotel in London.
e.zh: 我们在伦敦的朗廷酒店享用了下午茶。

e.en: The {Langham} brand operates luxury hotels around the world.
e.zh: 朗廷品牌在世界各地经营着豪华酒店。

langley.t: n. 兰利（地名，美国航天中心）

e.en: The CIA's headquarters is located in {Langley}, Virginia.
e.zh: 中央情报局总部位于弗吉尼亚州兰利。

e.en: NASA scientists work at the {Langley} Research Center.
e.zh: 美国宇航局的科学家在兰利研究中心工作。

e.en: He ordered grilled {langoustine} with garlic butter for dinner.
e.zh: 他点了蒜香黄油烤海螯虾作为晚餐。

e.en: Fresh {langoustine} is a specialty of Scottish coastal restaurants.
e.zh: 新鲜的海螯虾是苏格兰沿海餐厅的特色菜。

e.en: Stephen {Langton} was Archbishop of Canterbury in the 13th century.
e.zh: 斯蒂芬·朗顿是十三世纪的坎特伯雷大主教。

e.en: The school was founded by a man named {Langton} in 1840.
e.zh: 这所学校于1840年由一位名叫朗顿的人创立。

e.en: Spanish is the second most spoken {language} in the world.
e.zh: 西班牙语是世界上使用人数第二多的语言。

e.en: Watch your {language} when the children are in the room.
e.zh: 孩子们在房间里时注意你的言辞。

e.en: She speaks five {languages} fluently, including Mandarin and French.
e.zh: 她能流利地说五种语言,包括普通话和法语。

e.en: Python and JavaScript remain the most popular programming {languages}.
e.zh: Python和JavaScript仍是最流行的编程语言。

langue.t: n. 语言系统（语言学术语）

e.en: Saussure distinguished {langue} from individual speech acts called parole.
e.zh: 索绪尔将语言系统与被称作言语的个体话语行为区分开来。

e.en: In linguistics, {langue} refers to the abstract system of language.
e.zh: 在语言学中,语言系统指的是语言的抽象体系。

languedoc.t: n. 朗格多克（法国地区/产酒区）

e.en: The wines of {Languedoc} are increasingly popular among critics.
e.zh: 朗格多克产区的葡萄酒越来越受到评论家的青睐。

e.en: We rented a stone cottage in the {Languedoc} region of France.
e.zh: 我们在法国朗格多克地区租了一间石头小屋。

languid.t: adj. 慵懒的，无精打采的

e.en: She gave a {languid} wave from her hammock by the pool.
e.zh: 她在泳池边的吊床上慵懒地挥了挥手。

e.en: The afternoon was hot and {languid} after the long lunch.
e.zh: 漫长午餐后的下午又热又慵倦。

e.en: The cat stretched {languidly} in a patch of afternoon sunlight.
e.zh: 那只猫在午后的阳光下慵懒地伸了个懒腰。

e.en: She turned the pages of the book {languidly}, half asleep.
e.zh: 她半睡半醒地懒洋洋地翻着书页。

languish.t: v. 衰弱；憔悴；停滞不前

e.en: Many great novels {languish} unread on dusty library shelves.
e.zh: 许多伟大的小说在落满灰尘的图书馆书架上被冷落。

e.en: Without funding, the project will simply {languish} for years.
e.zh: 没有资金支持,这个项目只会停滞数年之久。

languishing.t: adj. 日渐衰弱的；停滞的

e.en: The bill has been {languishing} in committee for six months.
e.zh: 该法案在委员会中已经搁置了六个月。

e.en: His startup is {languishing} due to a lack of customers.
e.zh: 由于缺乏客户,他的初创公司正陷入困境。

e.en: A pleasant {languor} settled over us after the heavy meal.
e.zh: 饱餐之后一种舒服的倦意笼罩着我们。

e.en: The summer heat brought a familiar {languor} to the village.
e.zh: 夏日的炎热给村庄带来了熟悉的慵懒气息。

e.en: They spent a {languorous} afternoon dozing under the palm trees.
e.zh: 他们在棕榈树下慵懒地度过了一个昏昏欲睡的下午。

e.en: The song has a slow, {languorous} melody perfect for summer.
e.zh: 这首歌有着缓慢慵懒的旋律,非常适合夏日。

e.en: She stretched {languorously} on the couch after a long nap.
e.zh: 她小睡之后在沙发上慵懒地伸了个懒腰。

e.en: The dancer moved {languorously} across the dimly lit stage.
e.zh: 舞者在昏暗的舞台上慵懒地舞动。

e.en: A troop of {langur} monkeys scampered across the temple roof.
e.zh: 一群叶猴在寺庙屋顶上窜来窜去。

e.en: The gray {langur} is considered sacred in many parts of India.
e.zh: 灰叶猴在印度许多地方被视为神圣的动物。

lank.t: adj. 瘦长的；（头发）直而扁塌的

e.en: His {lank} hair fell limply across his pale forehead.
e.zh: 他那稀疏的头发软绵绵地垂在苍白的额头上。

e.en: The {lank} stranger ducked under the low doorway.
e.zh: 那个瘦高的陌生人弯腰穿过低矮的门框。

lanka.t: n. 兰卡（斯里兰卡简称）

e.en: Sri {Lanka} is famous for its tea plantations and beaches.
e.zh: 斯里兰卡以其茶园和海滩而闻名。

e.en: We're flying to Sri {Lanka} for our honeymoon next month.
e.zh: 我们下个月要去斯里兰卡度蜜月。

e.en: The {lanky} teenager towered over his classmates at graduation.
e.zh: 那个瘦高的少年在毕业典礼上比同学们都高出一截。

e.en: He's a {lanky} basketball player with an impressive wingspan.
e.zh: 他是个身材瘦长的篮球运动员,臂展惊人。

largo.t:
adj./adv. (音乐) 广板的
n. 广板乐章

e.en: The orchestra played the {largo} movement with deep feeling.
e.zh: 乐团满怀深情地演奏了广板乐章。

e.en: Handel's famous {largo} brought tears to the audience's eyes.
e.zh: 亨德尔著名的广板让观众感动落泪。

e.en: The cowboy spun his {lariat} and roped the calf cleanly.
e.zh: 牛仔甩动套索,干净利落地套住了小牛。

e.en: She practiced throwing the {lariat} every afternoon at the ranch.
e.zh: 她每天下午都在牧场练习抛套索。

lark.t:
n. 云雀
n. 嬉闹，玩笑

e.en: A {lark} sang sweetly above the meadow at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,一只云雀在草地上空婉转歌唱。

e.en: They drove to the coast on a {lark} that weekend.
e.zh: 那个周末他们一时兴起开车去了海边。

larks.t:
n. 云雀（复数）
n. 玩笑，嬉闹

e.en: The morning air was filled with the songs of {larks}.
e.zh: 清晨的空气中回荡着云雀的歌声。

e.en: The kids got into all kinds of harmless {larks} that summer.
e.zh: 那个夏天孩子们玩了各种无伤大雅的恶作剧。

e.en: Tall blue {larkspur} swayed in the cottage garden.
e.zh: 高大的蓝色飞燕草在小屋花园里随风摇曳。

e.en: She arranged {larkspur} stems in a tall glass vase.
e.zh: 她把飞燕草的花枝插进一只高玻璃花瓶里。

larne.t: n. 拉恩（北爱尔兰港口城市）

e.en: We caught the morning ferry from {Larne} to Scotland.
e.zh: 我们坐上从拉恩开往苏格兰的早班渡轮。

e.en: {Larne} is a busy port town on the Antrim coast.
e.zh: 拉恩是安特里姆海岸上一个繁忙的港口小镇。

e.en: Each butterfly {larva} feeds on milkweed for weeks.
e.zh: 每只蝴蝶幼虫都会以乳草为食长达数周。

e.en: The biologist examined a mosquito {larva} under the microscope.
e.zh: 那位生物学家在显微镜下观察一只蚊子幼虫。

e.en: The pond is full of mosquito {larvae} this summer.
e.zh: 今年夏天池塘里满是蚊子幼虫。

e.en: Scientists studied how the {larvae} develop into adult butterflies.
e.zh: 科学家研究幼虫如何发育成成年蝴蝶。

larval.t: adj. 幼虫的，幼体阶段的

e.en: The frog spends its {larval} stage in the pond.
e.zh: 青蛙的幼虫阶段在池塘中度过。

e.en: Many insects look completely different in their {larval} form.
e.zh: 许多昆虫在幼虫形态时看起来完全不同。

e.en: The doctor examined his {laryngeal} muscles after the surgery.
e.zh: 手术后医生检查了他的喉部肌肉。

e.en: Singers train to control their {laryngeal} tension carefully.
e.zh: 歌手会训练自己仔细控制喉部的紧张度。

e.en: After the {laryngectomy}, he learned to speak using a special device.
e.zh: 喉切除术后,他学会了用特殊设备说话。

e.en: A total {laryngectomy} is sometimes needed to treat advanced throat cancer.
e.zh: 晚期喉癌有时需要做全喉切除术。

e.en: She lost her voice for a week due to {laryngitis}.
e.zh: 她因喉炎失声了一周。

e.en: Teachers often get {laryngitis} from talking all day.
e.zh: 老师因为整天讲话常常患上喉炎。

e.en: Repeated {laryngitises} can damage a singer's vocal cords over time.
e.zh: 反复发作的喉炎会逐渐损伤歌手的声带。

e.en: The clinic recorded several {laryngitises} during the cold winter months.
e.zh: 诊所在寒冷的冬季月份记录到多起喉炎病例。

e.en: The anesthesiologist used a {laryngoscope} to insert the breathing tube.
e.zh: 麻醉师用喉镜插入了呼吸管。

e.en: A flexible {laryngoscope} lets doctors see deep into the throat.
e.zh: 软性喉镜让医生能看到喉咙深处。

e.en: The ENT specialist performed a {laryngoscopy} to check the vocal cords.
e.zh: 耳鼻喉科医生做了喉镜检查以查看声带。

e.en: A {laryngoscopy} revealed a small polyp on her throat.
e.zh: 喉镜检查发现她的喉咙上有一个小息肉。

e.en: The {larynx} contains the vocal cords that produce speech.
e.zh: 喉部包含产生语音的声带。

e.en: Cold air can irritate the {larynx} and cause coughing.
e.zh: 冷空气会刺激喉部并引起咳嗽。

las.t: n. 拉斯（常用于地名，如 Las Vegas）

e.en: We caught a cheap flight to {Las} Vegas last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末抢到了去拉斯维加斯的便宜机票。

e.en: The casinos on the {Las} Vegas Strip never close.
e.zh: 拉斯维加斯大道上的赌场从不打烊。

lasagna.t: n. 千层面（意式烤面食）

e.en: My grandmother makes the best {lasagna} I've ever tasted.
e.zh: 我奶奶做的千层面是我吃过最好吃的。

e.en: I ordered vegetable {lasagna} and a glass of wine.
e.zh: 我点了蔬菜千层面和一杯葡萄酒。

lasagne.t: n. 千层面（lasagna 的变体）

e.en: She baked a huge tray of {lasagne} for the party.
e.zh: 她为派对烤了一大盘千层面。

e.en: Italian {lasagne} traditionally uses fresh egg pasta sheets.
e.zh: 传统意式千层面用的是新鲜鸡蛋面片。

e.en: She gave him a {lascivious} smile across the bar.
e.zh: 她隔着吧台对他露出一个挑逗的笑容。

e.en: The film was banned for its {lascivious} content.
e.zh: 那部电影因内容淫秽而被禁。

e.en: He stared {lasciviously} at the dancers, making them uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他色迷迷地盯着舞者,让她们感到不舒服。

e.en: The villain grinned {lasciviously} at the heroine in the old film.
e.zh: 老电影里反派对女主角淫荡地咧嘴一笑。

e.en: Critics condemned the show for its open {lasciviousness}.
e.zh: 评论家谴责该节目内容露骨淫秽。

e.en: The novel was once banned for alleged {lasciviousness}.
e.zh: 这部小说曾因被指内容淫荡而遭禁。

e.en: The surgeon used a {laser} to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生用激光切除了肿瘤。

e.en: My cat chases the red {laser} dot around the room.
e.zh: 我的猫满屋子追着那个红色激光点跑。

e.en: My uncle still has a {laserdisc} player in the basement.
e.zh: 我叔叔地下室里还放着一台激光影碟机。

e.en: Collectors pay good money for rare {laserdisc} releases.
e.zh: 收藏家愿意花大价钱买稀有的激光影碟版本。

laserjet.t: n. 激光打印机（惠普商标）

e.en: The office {laserjet} jammed again right before the deadline.
e.zh: 办公室的激光打印机又在截止日期前卡纸了。

e.en: I bought a refurbished HP {laserjet} for my home office.
e.zh: 我给家庭办公室买了一台翻新的惠普激光打印机。

e.en: The concert featured spectacular {lasers} cutting through the fog.
e.zh: 演唱会上壮观的激光束穿透烟雾。

e.en: Modern factories use {lasers} to cut steel with high precision.
e.zh: 现代工厂用激光高精度地切割钢材。

lash.t:
v. 鞭打；猛烈抨击
n. 睫毛；鞭子

e.en: She used mascara to darken every {lash}.
e.zh: 她用睫毛膏把每一根睫毛都涂黑。

e.en: Make sure to {lash} the cargo securely before sailing.
e.zh: 启航前一定要把货物牢牢绑紧。

lashing.t:
n. 鞭打；捆绑
v. 鞭打（现在分词）

e.en: The rain was {lashing} against the windows all night.
e.zh: 雨整夜猛烈地拍打着窗户。

e.en: He got a {lashing} from his boss for missing the deadline.
e.zh: 他因错过截止日期被老板狠狠训了一顿。

lasing.t: v. 发出激光（lase 的现在分词）

e.en: The crystal began {lasing} once the pump power exceeded threshold.
e.zh: 当泵浦功率超过阈值时,晶体开始产生激光。

e.en: Engineers measured the {lasing} wavelength of the new diode.
e.zh: 工程师测量了新二极管的激光发射波长。

e.en: The young {lass} sang a beautiful Scottish folk song.
e.zh: 那位年轻姑娘唱了一首动人的苏格兰民谣。

e.en: He proposed to the {lass} he met at the festival.
e.zh: 他向在节日上认识的那个姑娘求了婚。

lassie.t: n. 小姑娘（苏格兰用语）

e.en: Come here, {lassie}, and tell me what's wrong.
e.zh: 过来,小姑娘,告诉我怎么了。

e.en: The old farmer waved at the {lassie} walking down the lane.
e.zh: 老农向走在小路上的小姑娘挥了挥手。

e.en: A strange {lassitude} came over her after the long flight.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,她感到一阵奇怪的倦怠。

e.en: Summer heat brought a heavy {lassitude} to the whole town.
e.zh: 夏日的炎热给整个小镇带来一种沉重的倦怠感。

e.en: The novel describes the {lassitudes} of bored aristocrats in summer.
e.zh: 小说描写了夏日里无聊贵族们的种种倦怠。

e.en: Doctors note that chronic illness brings repeated {lassitudes}.
e.zh: 医生指出,慢性疾病会带来反复发作的倦怠。

lasso.t:
n. 套索
v. 用套索捕捉

e.en: The cowboy threw his {lasso} and caught the runaway calf.
e.zh: 牛仔甩出套索,抓住了那头跑掉的小牛。

e.en: Use the {lasso} tool in Photoshop to select the area.
e.zh: 用 Photoshop 里的套索工具来选中那个区域。

last.t:
adj. 最后的；上一个的
v. 持续，延续

e.en: This is the {last} cookie in the jar.
e.zh: 这是罐子里最后一块饼干了。

e.en: Good batteries should {last} for several years.
e.zh: 好的电池应该能用好几年。

last-minute.t: adj. 最后一刻的，临时的

e.en: He booked a {last-minute} flight to Tokyo.
e.zh: 他临时订了一张飞往东京的机票。

e.en: We made a {last-minute} change to the slides before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前我们临时改了一下幻灯片。

lasted.t: v. 持续（last 的过去式）

e.en: The meeting {lasted} much longer than anyone expected.
e.zh: 会议持续的时间比所有人预期的都长得多。

e.en: Their friendship has {lasted} more than thirty years.
e.zh: 他们的友谊已经维持了三十多年。

e.en: The trip left a {lasting} impression on the children.
e.zh: 这趟旅行给孩子们留下了深刻持久的印象。

e.en: Building {lasting} relationships takes time and trust.
e.zh: 建立持久的关系需要时间和信任。

e.en: The new policy {lastingly} changed how the company hires.
e.zh: 新政策从根本上长期改变了公司的招聘方式。

e.en: Her kindness {lastingly} influenced everyone she met.
e.zh: 她的善良深远持久地影响了每一个见过她的人。

e.en: {Lastly}, please remember to lock the back door.
e.zh: 最后,请记得锁好后门。

e.en: {Lastly}, I want to thank everyone who helped with the project.
e.zh: 最后,我想感谢每一位帮助过这个项目的人。

e.en: This hand cream contains {lanolin} to keep skin soft.
e.zh: 这款护手霜含有羊毛脂,可使皮肤保持柔软。

e.en: {Lanolin} is extracted from the wool of sheep.
e.zh: 羊毛脂是从绵羊的羊毛中提取出来的。

e.en: We met for coffee on {Lansdowne} Road in Dublin.
e.zh: 我们在都柏林的兰斯当路见面喝咖啡。

e.en: The {Lansdowne} estate has been in the family for centuries.
e.zh: 兰斯当庄园在这个家族中已经传承了几个世纪。

e.en: Bright {lantana} flowers attract butterflies to our garden.
e.zh: 鲜艳的马缨丹花吸引蝴蝶来到我们的花园。

e.en: {Lantana} is considered an invasive weed in many tropical regions.
e.zh: 马缨丹在许多热带地区被视为入侵性杂草。

e.en: We took the cable car to see the Big Buddha on {Lantau}.
e.zh: 我们坐缆车去大屿山看大佛。

e.en: Hong Kong's airport is located on {Lantau} Island.
e.zh: 香港的机场位于大屿山岛上。

e.en: She lit a paper {lantern} and hung it on the porch.
e.zh: 她点亮一盏纸灯笼并把它挂在门廊上。

e.en: The old miner carried a kerosene {lantern} into the tunnel.
e.zh: 那位年老的矿工提着煤油灯走进了隧道。

e.en: The lamp uses {lanthanum} to produce a bright white light.
e.zh: 这盏灯利用镧来发出明亮的白光。

e.en: Hybrid car batteries often contain {lanthanum} compounds.
e.zh: 混合动力汽车的电池常含有镧的化合物。

e.en: Every conference attendee got a name badge on a {lanyard}.
e.zh: 每位参会者都拿到一条挂绳和姓名牌。

e.en: He clipped his keys to the {lanyard} around his neck.
e.zh: 他把钥匙扣在脖子上的挂绳上。

lanzarote.t: n. 兰萨罗特（加那利群岛之一）

e.en: We spent a week hiking the volcanic trails of {Lanzarote}.
e.zh: 我们在兰萨罗特岛徒步了一周的火山步道。

e.en: {Lanzarote} is the easternmost of the Canary Islands.
e.zh: 兰萨罗特岛是加那利群岛中最东边的岛。

lao.t:
adj. 老挝的
n. 老挝语

e.en: She is learning to read and write in {Lao}.
e.zh: 她正在学习读写老挝语。

e.en: The menu features traditional {Lao} dishes like sticky rice.
e.zh: 菜单上有糯米饭等传统老挝菜。

e.en: We took a slow boat down the Mekong in {Laos}.
e.zh: 我们在老挝坐慢船顺湄公河而下。

e.en: {Laos} shares borders with Thailand, Vietnam, and China.
e.zh: 老挝与泰国、越南和中国接壤。

laotian.t:
n. 老挝人
adj. 老挝的

e.en: The festival showcased {Laotian} music and silk weaving.
e.zh: 这个节日展示了老挝的音乐和丝绸编织。

e.en: Many {Laotian} families settled in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 许多老挝家庭在这个社区定居。

lap.t:
n. 大腿（坐时）；一圈
v. 舔食

e.en: The cat curled up on her {lap} during the movie.
e.zh: 看电影时,猫蜷缩在她的腿上。

e.en: He finished the final {lap} just ahead of his rival.
e.zh: 他在最后一圈险胜对手冲过终点。

lapa.t: n. 茅草亭（南非户外凉亭）

e.en: We danced all night at a {lapa} in Rio's old quarter.
e.zh: 我们在里约老城区的拉帕街区跳了一整晚舞。

e.en: The thatched {lapa} sheltered the outdoor dining area.
e.zh: 那座茅草凉亭遮蔽着户外用餐区。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a tiny {laparoscope} through a small incision.
e.zh: 外科医生通过一个小切口插入了腹腔镜。

e.en: Modern hospitals rely on the {laparoscope} for minimally invasive surgery.
e.zh: 现代医院依靠腹腔镜进行微创手术。

e.en: She recovered quickly after {laparoscopic} gallbladder surgery.
e.zh: 做了腹腔镜胆囊手术后,她恢复得很快。

e.en: {Laparoscopic} techniques leave only tiny scars.
e.zh: 腹腔镜技术只留下很小的疤痕。

e.en: The doctor recommended a {laparoscopy} to investigate the pain.
e.zh: 医生建议做腹腔镜检查来查清疼痛的原因。

e.en: {Laparoscopy} usually requires only an overnight hospital stay.
e.zh: 腹腔镜手术通常只需住院一晚。

e.en: The trauma patient required an emergency {laparotomy}.
e.zh: 这名外伤病人需要紧急剖腹探查手术。

e.en: A {laparotomy} leaves a longer scar than keyhole surgery.
e.zh: 剖腹手术留下的疤痕比微创手术更长。

e.en: Critics called the senator a {lapdog} of corporate donors.
e.zh: 批评者称这位参议员是企业金主的走狗。

e.en: Her tiny {lapdog} follows her everywhere around the house.
e.zh: 她那只小巧的玩赏狗在家里到处跟着她。

e.en: He pinned a small flag to his suit {lapel}.
e.zh: 他在西装翻领上别了一面小国旗。

e.en: The reporter clipped a microphone to her {lapel}.
e.zh: 记者把麦克风夹在了翻领上。

lapidary.t:
n. 宝石匠
adj. 精雕细琢的

e.en: Her speech had a {lapidary} precision that impressed the judges.
e.zh: 她的演讲措辞精炼,令评委印象深刻。

e.en: The {lapidary} polished the rough sapphire for hours.
e.zh: 宝石匠花了几个小时打磨那颗未加工的蓝宝石。

lapillus.t: n. 火山砾（小块喷出物）

e.en: Each {lapillus} ejected by the volcano was the size of a pea.
e.zh: 火山喷出的每颗火山砾都有豌豆大小。

e.en: Geologists collected a {lapillus} sample from the ash layer.
e.zh: 地质学家从火山灰层中采集了一颗火山砾样本。

e.en: The vintage coat was trimmed with soft {lapin} fur.
e.zh: 这件复古大衣镶有柔软的兔毛。

e.en: She ordered braised {lapin} at the French bistro.
e.zh: 她在那家法式小酒馆点了焖兔肉。

lapis.t: n. 青金石（lapis lazuli 简称）

e.en: She wore a deep blue {lapis} pendant to the gala.
e.zh: 她戴着一枚深蓝色的青金石吊坠去参加晚宴。

e.en: Ancient Egyptians prized {lapis} for jewelry and amulets.
e.zh: 古埃及人视青金石为珍贵的饰品和护身符材料。

laplace.t: n. 拉普拉斯（数学家/变换）

e.en: Engineers use the {Laplace} transform to solve differential equations.
e.zh: 工程师使用拉普拉斯变换来求解微分方程。

e.en: {Laplace} laid much of the foundation for modern probability theory.
e.zh: 拉普拉斯为现代概率论奠定了大量基础。

lapland.t: n. 拉普兰（北欧极地地区）

e.en: We took a sled tour through snowy {Lapland} last December.
e.zh: 去年十二月我们在白雪覆盖的拉普兰乘雪橇游玩。

e.en: The northern lights are stunning in {Lapland}.
e.zh: 在拉普兰看到的北极光十分壮观。

e.en: The Cubs traded for a pitcher from {LaPorte}, Indiana.
e.zh: 小熊队从印第安纳州拉波特换来了一名投手。

e.en: {LaPorte} County hosts a popular county fair every summer.
e.zh: 拉波特县每年夏天都举办热闹的县集会。

lapping.t:
n. 拍打声
v. 舔食；轻拍

e.en: Waves were gently {lapping} against the wooden dock.
e.zh: 海浪轻轻拍打着木码头。

e.en: The puppy was {lapping} water from its bowl.
e.zh: 小狗正从碗里舔水喝。

laps.t:
n. 圈数（复数）
v. 舔食（三单）

e.en: He swims thirty {laps} in the pool every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上在泳池里游三十个来回。

e.en: The leader {laps} the slowest car midway through the race.
e.zh: 领跑者在比赛中段就把最慢的赛车套了一圈。

lapse.t:
n. 失误；失效
v. 逝去；失效

e.en: A brief {lapse} in concentration cost her the match.
e.zh: 短暂的注意力失误让她输掉了比赛。

e.en: Don't let your insurance policy {lapse} this month.
e.zh: 这个月别让你的保险失效。

e.en: His gym membership {lapsed} after he stopped going.
e.zh: 他不再去健身房后,会员资格就失效了。

e.en: She describes herself as a {lapsed} Catholic.
e.zh: 她自称是一名不再虔诚的天主教徒。

lapses.t:
n. 失误（复数）
v. 失效（三单）

e.en: The report noted several security {lapses} at the facility.
e.zh: 报告指出该设施存在多处安全疏漏。

e.en: Her memory occasionally {lapses} when she's very tired.
e.zh: 她非常疲惫时偶尔会记忆短路。

e.en: He kept {lapsing} into French during the conversation.
e.zh: 谈话中他不时不自觉地说起法语。

e.en: The subscription is {lapsing} next week unless renewed.
e.zh: 如果不续订,下周这项订阅就会到期失效。

e.en: She opened her {laptop} to finish the presentation.
e.zh: 她打开笔记本电脑完成了演示文稿。

e.en: My new {laptop} has a battery that lasts all day.
e.zh: 我的新笔记本电脑电池可以用一整天。

e.en: The school provided {laptops} to every student this year.
e.zh: 今年学校为每位学生都配发了笔记本电脑。

e.en: Lightweight {laptops} are perfect for traveling professionals.
e.zh: 轻薄笔记本电脑非常适合经常出差的专业人士。

e.en: A {lapwing} circled overhead, calling sharply.
e.zh: 一只田凫在头顶盘旋,发出尖锐的叫声。

e.en: The wetland is home to nesting {lapwing} pairs each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天,这片湿地都有筑巢的田凫栖息。

larcenous.t: adj. 盗窃的；有盗窃行为的

e.en: The clerk had {larcenous} intentions toward the cash register.
e.zh: 那名店员对收银机起了偷窃的念头。

e.en: Police arrested the man for his {larcenous} behavior at the store.
e.zh: 警方因那名男子在店内的盗窃行为将其逮捕。

e.en: He was charged with petty {larceny} for shoplifting.
e.zh: 他因入店行窃被控小额盗窃罪。

e.en: Grand {larceny} carries much harsher penalties in this state.
e.zh: 在该州,重大盗窃罪的刑罚要严厉得多。

e.en: The {larch} turns a brilliant gold every autumn.
e.zh: 每到秋天,落叶松都会变成灿烂的金黄色。

e.en: Builders prize {larch} wood for its durability outdoors.
e.zh: 建筑商推崇落叶松木材在户外的耐久性。

lard.t:
n. 猪油
v. 涂猪油；堆砌

e.en: Grandma always used {lard} to make her flaky pie crust.
e.zh: 奶奶总是用猪油来做她那层层酥脆的派皮。

e.en: Many traditional pastries rely on {lard} for their texture.
e.zh: 许多传统糕点都靠猪油来获得理想的口感。

e.en: The cottage had a cool stone {larder} for storing food.
e.zh: 那间小屋有一间凉爽的石砌储藏室用来存放食物。

e.en: Before the storm, she stocked the {larder} with canned goods.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前,她在储藏室里囤满了罐头食品。

e.en: They moved into a {large} apartment near the park.
e.zh: 他们搬进了公园附近一套很大的公寓。

e.en: A {large} crowd gathered to watch the fireworks.
e.zh: 一大群人聚集在一起观看烟花。

large-scale.t: adj. 大规模的；大范围的

e.en: The company announced a {large-scale} layoff next quarter.
e.zh: 公司宣布下个季度将进行大规模裁员。

e.en: {Large-scale} farming has transformed the rural landscape.
e.zh: 大规模农业已经改变了乡村面貌。

largely.t: adv. 很大程度上；主要地

e.en: The project was {largely} funded by private donors.
e.zh: 该项目的资金主要来自私人捐助者。

e.en: Her success is {largely} due to years of practice.
e.zh: 她的成功在很大程度上归功于多年的练习。

e.en: He caught a five-pound {largemouth} bass in the lake.
e.zh: 他在湖里钓到了一条五磅重的大口黑鲈。

e.en: {Largemouth} bass thrive in warm, weedy waters.
e.zh: 大口黑鲈在温暖、水草丰茂的水域中繁衍兴旺。

e.en: The {largeness} of the cathedral overwhelmed the visitors.
e.zh: 大教堂的宏大让游客们叹为观止。

e.en: Critics admired the {largeness} of his artistic vision.
e.zh: 评论家们赞叹他艺术视野的宏大。

e.en: The foundation is famous for its {largess} toward universities.
e.zh: 该基金会以对大学的慷慨捐赠而闻名。

e.en: Local charities benefited from the billionaire's {largess}.
e.zh: 当地慈善机构受益于这位亿万富翁的慷慨解囊。

e.en: He thanked the patrons for their unexpected {largesse}.
e.zh: 他感谢赞助人意外的慷慨馈赠。

e.en: The royal {largesse} kept the artists working all winter.
e.zh: 王室的慷慨资助让这些艺术家整个冬天都有活干。

e.en: They bought a {largish} house just outside the city.
e.zh: 他们在城外买了一栋偏大的房子。

e.en: She ordered a {largish} salad for lunch.
e.zh: 她午餐点了一份偏大份的沙拉。

lasts.t:
v. 持续、维持
n. 鞋楦

e.en: A typical movie {lasts} about two hours.
e.zh: 一部典型的电影时长大约两小时。

e.en: Nothing good in life {lasts} forever.
e.zh: 生活中没有什么美好的事物能永远持续。

lat.t:
n. 纬度（latitude 的缩写）
n. 背阔肌

e.en: He pulled hard during the {lat} pulldown exercise.
e.zh: 他做背阔肌下拉时用力很猛。

e.en: The trainer told me to feel the burn in my {lat} muscles.
e.zh: 教练让我感受背阔肌的发力感。

latch.t:
n. 门闩、插销
v. 锁住、抓住

e.en: Make sure the gate {latch} clicks shut behind you.
e.zh: 确保身后的大门门闩咔哒一声扣好。

e.en: The baby couldn't {latch} on properly during feeding.
e.zh: 宝宝喂奶时没法正确含住乳头。

latchkey.t:
n. 大门钥匙
adj. 无人照看的（孩子）

e.en: He grew up as a {latchkey} kid in the eighties.
e.zh: 他在八十年代长大,是个挂钥匙的孩子。

e.en: Many {latchkey} children come home to an empty house.
e.zh: 许多挂钥匙的孩子回到家时屋里空无一人。

late.t:
adj. 迟的、晚的
adj. 已故的

e.en: Sorry I'm {late} — the traffic was terrible.
e.zh: 抱歉我迟到了,堵车堵得很厉害。

e.en: She often works {late} into the night on weekdays.
e.zh: 工作日她经常工作到深夜。

e.en: As a {latecomer} to the market, the company had to innovate.
e.zh: 作为市场的后来者,这家公司不得不靠创新取胜。

e.en: The {latecomer} quietly slipped into a back-row seat.
e.zh: 那个迟到的人悄悄溜进了后排座位。

latecomers.t: n. 迟到者、后来者（复数）

e.en: {Latecomers} will not be admitted until the intermission.
e.zh: 迟到者要等到中场休息时才能入场。

e.en: Several {latecomers} struggled to find empty seats.
e.zh: 几位迟到者费力地找空座位。

e.en: I haven't been sleeping well {lately}.
e.zh: 我最近一直睡得不太好。

e.en: Have you watched any good shows {lately}?
e.zh: 你最近有看什么好看的剧吗?

latency.t:
n. 延迟（网络响应时间）
n. 潜伏性

e.en: The game suffers from high {latency} on slow networks.
e.zh: 在网速慢的情况下,这款游戏延迟很高。

e.en: Engineers worked hard to reduce server response {latency}.
e.zh: 工程师们努力降低服务器响应延迟。

e.en: His constant {lateness} eventually got him fired.
e.zh: 他经常迟到,最终被炒了鱿鱼。

e.en: Despite the {lateness} of the hour, the café was still busy.
e.zh: 尽管夜已深,咖啡馆里仍然很热闹。

e.en: The training revealed her {latent} talent for public speaking.
e.zh: 这次培训显露出她在公共演讲方面潜在的天赋。

e.en: The virus can remain {latent} in the body for years.
e.zh: 这种病毒可以在体内潜伏多年。

later.t:
adv. 稍后、后来
adj. 较晚的

e.en: I'll call you back {later} this afternoon.
e.zh: 今天下午晚些时候我再回你电话。

e.en: We can discuss the details {later} over coffee.
e.zh: 我们可以稍后边喝咖啡边讨论细节。

e.en: The job change was a {lateral} move with no pay raise.
e.zh: 这次换工作是平级调动,薪水没涨。

e.en: He made a quick {lateral} pass to his teammate.
e.zh: 他迅速向队友做了一个横传。

e.en: Researchers study brain {laterality} and how it affects language.
e.zh: 研究人员研究大脑的偏侧性及其如何影响语言能力。

e.en: Most people show strong {laterality} when writing or throwing.
e.zh: 大多数人在写字或投掷时表现出明显的左右偏侧性。

lateralization.t: n. 偏侧化（大脑功能分区）

e.en: Brain {lateralization} explains why language is mainly processed on one side.
e.zh: 大脑的偏侧化解释了为什么语言主要由一侧大脑处理。

e.en: Studies show clear {lateralization} of function in adult brains.
e.zh: 研究显示成人大脑功能存在明显的偏侧化。

e.en: The crab scuttled {laterally} across the wet sand.
e.zh: 螃蟹横着在湿沙上飞快地爬过去。

e.en: Information often spreads {laterally} between teams in a flat company.
e.zh: 在扁平化公司里,信息常在团队之间横向传播。

e.en: Tourists in Rome often visit the famous {Lateran} Basilica.
e.zh: 在罗马的游客常常会参观著名的拉特朗大教堂。

e.en: The {Lateran} Treaty established Vatican City as an independent state.
e.zh: 《拉特朗条约》确立梵蒂冈城为独立国家。

e.en: Have you seen the {latest} update to the app?
e.zh: 你看过这款应用的最新更新了吗？

e.en: The store stays open until midnight at the {latest}.
e.zh: 这家店最晚营业到午夜。

latests.t: n. 最新消息（非标准复数）

e.en: The blog tags its {latests} posts with bright icons.
e.zh: 该博客用醒目的图标标记最新的帖子。

e.en: Editors review the {latests} drafts every Friday afternoon.
e.zh: 编辑们每周五下午审阅最新的草稿。

latex.t:
n. 乳胶
n. LaTeX 排版系统

e.en: She wore thin {latex} gloves while cleaning the kitchen.
e.zh: 她戴着薄乳胶手套清理厨房。

e.en: Many academics write their papers in {latex}.
e.zh: 许多学者用 LaTeX 撰写论文。

e.en: The old wall was built with plaster over wooden {lath}.
e.zh: 那面旧墙是在木条板上抹灰建成的。

e.en: He nailed each thin {lath} carefully to the studs.
e.zh: 他把每根细板条仔细地钉在墙骨上。

lathe.t:
n. 车床
v. 用车床加工

e.en: He shaped the chair leg on a wood {lathe}.
e.zh: 他用木工车床车出椅子腿的形状。

e.en: The factory replaced its old {lathe} with a CNC machine.
e.zh: 工厂用数控机床替换了那台旧车床。

lather.t:
n. 肥皂泡沫
v. 起泡沫

e.en: Work the shampoo into a thick {lather} before rinsing.
e.zh: 把洗发水搓出浓厚泡沫后再冲洗。

e.en: The horse was in a {lather} after the long race.
e.zh: 那匹马跑完长程比赛后浑身是汗。

latin.t:
n. 拉丁语
adj. 拉丁的

e.en: She studied {Latin} for three years in high school.
e.zh: 她在高中学了三年拉丁语。

e.en: The restaurant plays lively {Latin} music every weekend.
e.zh: 那家餐厅每个周末都放欢快的拉丁音乐。

e.en: Legal documents often use stiff {Latinate} vocabulary.
e.zh: 法律文件常用生硬的拉丁语源词汇。

e.en: His writing style is heavy and overtly {Latinate}.
e.zh: 他的写作风格厚重且明显带有拉丁语色彩。

e.en: The {Latinization} of Chinese names helps foreign readers.
e.zh: 中文名字的拉丁化转写有助于外国读者阅读。

e.en: Pinyin is a modern system of {Latinization}.
e.zh: 拼音是一种现代的拉丁化方案。

e.en: The neighborhood has a vibrant {Latino} community.
e.zh: 这个街区有一个充满活力的拉丁裔社区。

e.en: Many {Latino} voters turned out for the election.
e.zh: 许多拉丁裔选民参加了这次选举。

latitude.t:
n. 纬度
n. 自由度、余地

e.en: Singapore lies just north of the equator at low {latitude}.
e.zh: 新加坡位于赤道以北的低纬度地区。

e.en: My boss gives me plenty of {latitude} to experiment.
e.zh: 我的老板给我很大自由度去尝试新方法。

e.en: Climate varies sharply along the {latitudinal} gradient.
e.zh: 气候沿纬度梯度变化十分明显。

e.en: Researchers mapped {latitudinal} differences in plant species.
e.zh: 研究人员绘制了植物种类的纬度差异分布。

latke.t: n. 土豆煎饼（犹太料理）

e.en: Grandma fries a crispy {latke} every Hanukkah.
e.zh: 奶奶每年光明节都会煎酥脆的土豆煎饼。

e.en: Top each {latke} with sour cream and applesauce.
e.zh: 在每张土豆煎饼上加酸奶油和苹果酱。

e.en: Soldiers dug a deep {latrine} behind the camp.
e.zh: 士兵在营地后面挖了一个深坑式厕所。

e.en: The festival set up a portable {latrine} near the entrance.
e.zh: 节日活动在入口附近搭设了简易厕所。

e.en: I ordered an oat milk {latte} on my way to work.
e.zh: 我上班路上点了一杯燕麦奶拿铁。

e.en: She makes a beautiful {latte} with detailed foam art.
e.zh: 她做的拿铁有精致的奶泡拉花。

latter.t:
adj. 后者的、后半的
n. 后者

e.en: Between coffee and tea, I prefer the {latter}.
e.zh: 在咖啡和茶之间，我更喜欢后者。

e.en: He grew quieter in the {latter} years of his life.
e.zh: 在他生命的后期，他变得越来越沉默。

e.en: {Latterly}, she has focused on writing fiction full time.
e.zh: 近来她专心于全职写小说。

e.en: He worked in finance, but {latterly} switched to teaching.
e.zh: 他原本从事金融，最近转行做了教师。

e.en: The professor compared two theories and praised the {latters} clarity.
e.zh: 教授比较了两种理论并称赞后者表述清晰。

e.en: Of all the proposals, the {latters} arguments seemed strongest.
e.zh: 在所有提案中，后者的论点显得最有力。

lattice.t:
n. 格子、点阵
v. 做成格状

e.en: Roses climbed the wooden {lattice} beside the porch.
e.zh: 玫瑰沿着门廊旁的木格子架往上爬。

e.en: The crystal has a regular atomic {lattice} structure.
e.zh: 这种晶体具有规则的原子晶格结构。

e.en: Sunlight filtered through the {latticed} window of the cafe.
e.zh: 阳光透过咖啡馆的格子窗洒了进来。

e.en: She baked a pie with a beautifully {latticed} crust.
e.zh: 她烤了一个表面有漂亮格子纹的派。

e.en: The garden gate featured delicate iron {latticework}.
e.zh: 花园的大门有精致的铁艺格子装饰。

e.en: Vines wove through the wooden {latticework} on the fence.
e.zh: 藤蔓在篱笆的木格架间缠绕生长。

e.en: {Latvia} joined the European Union in 2004.
e.zh: 拉脱维亚于 2004 年加入了欧盟。

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring Riga in {Latvia}.
e.zh: 我们在拉脱维亚的里加度过了一个悠长周末。

latvian.t:
adj. 拉脱维亚的
n. 拉脱维亚人

e.en: Her grandmother still speaks fluent {Latvian} at home.
e.zh: 她的祖母在家里仍然说一口流利的拉脱维亚语。

e.en: The museum showcases traditional {Latvian} folk costumes.
e.zh: 博物馆展出传统的拉脱维亚民族服饰。

e.en: We had dinner at a Hong Kong restaurant called {Lau} Garden.
e.zh: 我们在一家叫刘园的香港餐厅吃了晚饭。

e.en: Professor {Lau} teaches Chinese literature at the university.
e.zh: 刘教授在那所大学教授中国文学。

e.en: Critics {laud} the director for her bold visual style.
e.zh: 影评人称赞这位导演大胆的视觉风格。

e.en: Teachers {laud} students who ask thoughtful questions.
e.zh: 老师们赞扬那些会提出深思熟虑问题的学生。

lauda.t:
n. 劳达（人名）
n. 赞美诗

e.en: Niki {Lauda} won three Formula One world championships.
e.zh: 尼基·劳达曾三度赢得 F1 世界冠军。

e.en: The medieval choir sang a Latin {lauda} at sunrise.
e.zh: 中世纪的合唱团在日出时唱起拉丁赞美歌。

e.en: Donating to the food bank is a {laudable} effort.
e.zh: 向食物银行捐赠是一件值得称赞的善举。

e.en: Her goal of mentoring young coders is highly {laudable}.
e.zh: 她指导年轻程序员的目标非常值得赞扬。

e.en: The team {laudably} finished the project ahead of schedule.
e.zh: 团队令人称道地提前完成了这个项目。

e.en: She {laudably} stayed calm during the heated debate.
e.zh: 在激烈的辩论中她难能可贵地保持了冷静。

laudanum.t: n. 鸦片酊（旧时止痛药）

e.en: Victorian doctors often prescribed {laudanum} for chronic pain.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生常用鸦片酊治疗慢性疼痛。

e.en: The novel's heroine grew dependent on a bottle of {laudanum}.
e.zh: 小说的女主角逐渐依赖上了一瓶鸦片酊。

e.en: The book received {laudatory} reviews from major newspapers.
e.zh: 这本书得到了各大报纸的赞誉性评论。

e.en: His speech was full of {laudatory} remarks about the team.
e.zh: 他的演讲充满了对团队的赞美之词。

lauded.t: v. 称赞，赞扬（laud 的过去式）

e.en: The film was widely {lauded} for its honest storytelling.
e.zh: 这部电影因真挚的叙事而广受赞誉。

e.en: Critics {lauded} her debut album as a masterpiece.
e.zh: 乐评人盛赞她的首张专辑是一部杰作。

lauderdale.t: n. 劳德代尔（地名/姓氏）

e.en: We flew into Fort {Lauderdale} for a beach vacation.
e.zh: 我们飞到劳德代尔堡度海滩假期。

e.en: Spring break crowds fill {Lauderdale} every March.
e.zh: 每年三月春假人潮都会涌入劳德代尔堡。

laugh.t:
v. 笑，发笑
n. 笑声

e.en: That joke made everyone in the room {laugh} loudly.
e.zh: 那个笑话让屋里所有人都大声笑了起来。

e.en: Her warm {laugh} put the nervous interviewee at ease.
e.zh: 她温暖的笑声让紧张的应聘者放松了下来。

e.en: The excuse he gave was frankly {laughable}.
e.zh: 他给出的借口说实话很可笑。

e.en: Their first attempt at the recipe was {laughable}.
e.zh: 他们第一次尝试这个食谱的成果令人发笑。

e.en: The hotel room was {laughably} small for the price.
e.zh: 以那个价格来说，酒店房间小得可笑。

e.en: His prediction turned out to be {laughably} wrong.
e.zh: 他的预测结果错得令人发笑。

e.en: We {laughed} about that mistake for years afterward.
e.zh: 那件糗事我们后来笑了好多年。

e.en: She {laughed} so hard that tears rolled down her cheeks.
e.zh: 她笑得眼泪都顺着脸颊流了下来。

e.en: My uncle is a loud {laugher} at every family dinner.
e.zh: 我叔叔每次家庭聚餐都笑得很大声。

e.en: The home team turned the game into a 40-point {laugher}.
e.zh: 主队把比赛变成了一场净胜 40 分的轻松大胜。

e.en: The kids were {laughing} all the way home from school.
e.zh: 孩子们一路从学校笑着回家。

e.en: She kept {laughing} at his terrible dad jokes.
e.zh: 她一直被他蹩脚的冷笑话逗笑。

e.en: He {laughingly} admitted that he had forgotten her birthday.
e.zh: 他笑着承认自己忘了她的生日。

e.en: The team {laughingly} called their bug-fix sprint a vacation.
e.zh: 团队开玩笑地把修 bug 冲刺称为度假。

e.en: His typo made the company a {laughingstock} online.
e.zh: 他打的错字让公司在网上成了笑柄。

e.en: She refused to be the {laughingstock} of the office.
e.zh: 她不愿成为整个办公室的笑柄。

laughs.t: v./n. 笑（laugh 的复数/第三人称）

e.en: The comedian got plenty of {laughs} during her set.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员在表演中赢得了不少笑声。

e.en: He plays pranks just for {laughs}.
e.zh: 他搞恶作剧只是为了好玩。

e.en: The room filled with {laughter} when the cat tripped.
e.zh: 那只猫绊倒时，整个房间充满了笑声。

e.en: Shared {laughter} brought the old friends close again.
e.zh: 共同的欢笑让老朋友们又亲近起来。

launceston.t: n. 朗塞斯顿（澳洲/英国地名）

e.en: {Launceston} is the second-largest city in Tasmania.
e.zh: 朗塞斯顿是塔斯马尼亚州的第二大城市。

e.en: We took a scenic train ride through {Launceston} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们乘坐观光列车穿越了朗塞斯顿。

launch.t:
v. 启动，发布（产品、应用）
n. 发布；发射

e.en: The startup plans to {launch} its app next month.
e.zh: 这家创业公司计划下个月发布它的应用。

e.en: Engineers watched the rocket {launch} from a safe distance.
e.zh: 工程师们在安全距离外观看火箭发射。

launched.t: v. 启动；已发布（launch 的过去式）

e.en: They {launched} the new website during the conference.
e.zh: 他们在会议期间发布了新网站。

e.en: NASA {launched} a probe to study the outer planets.
e.zh: 美国航空航天局发射了一个探测器去研究外行星。

launcher.t: n. 启动器（应用）；发射器

e.en: I installed a custom {launcher} to organize my Android apps.
e.zh: 我装了一个自定义启动器来整理我的安卓应用。

e.en: The game {launcher} updates automatically before you play.
e.zh: 这款游戏的启动器会在游玩前自动更新。

launches.t: v./n. 启动；发布（launch 的复数/三单）

e.en: The browser {launches} much faster after the latest update.
e.zh: 浏览器在最新更新后启动速度快了许多。

e.en: SpaceX schedules dozens of {launches} every year.
e.zh: SpaceX 每年都安排数十次发射任务。

e.en: They are {launching} a new podcast this Friday.
e.zh: 他们将在本周五推出一档新播客。

e.en: The ceremony for {launching} the ship drew a huge crowd.
e.zh: 船只下水仪式吸引了大批人群。

launchpad.t: n. 启动台（应用入口）；发射台

e.en: Engineers cleared the {launchpad} hours before liftoff.
e.zh: 工程师在升空前几小时清空了发射台。

e.en: The internship became a {launchpad} for her career.
e.zh: 那次实习成了她事业的跳板。

e.en: I usually {launder} my bed sheets every weekend.
e.zh: 我通常每个周末洗一次床单。

e.en: The gang tried to {launder} money through a car wash.
e.zh: 那个团伙试图通过洗车店洗钱。

laundered.t: v. 洗熨过的；洗白的（钱款）

e.en: The cartel {laundered} millions through offshore shell companies.
e.zh: 该贩毒集团通过离岸空壳公司洗了数百万美元。

e.en: She wore a freshly {laundered} white shirt to the interview.
e.zh: 她穿着一件刚洗好的白衬衫去面试。

e.en: Prosecutors identified him as a {launderer} for the syndicate.
e.zh: 检察官认定他是该犯罪集团的洗钱者。

e.en: The bank hired analysts to flag every potential {launderer}.
e.zh: 银行雇佣分析师来标记每一个可能的洗钱者。

e.en: I dropped my sheets off at the {launderette} this morning.
e.zh: 我今早把床单送去了自助洗衣店。

e.en: There's a cheap {launderette} just around the corner.
e.zh: 拐角就有一家便宜的自助洗衣店。

e.en: He was charged with money {laundering} and tax fraud.
e.zh: 他被指控洗钱和逃税。

e.en: {Laundering} delicate fabrics requires cold water and gentle soap.
e.zh: 清洗精细面料需要冷水和温和的肥皂。

e.en: The hotel's {laundress} folded the towels with practiced speed.
e.zh: 酒店的洗衣女工熟练地飞快叠好毛巾。

e.en: Her grandmother worked as a {laundress} during the war.
e.zh: 她祖母在战争期间做过洗衣女工。

e.en: The {laundrette} on Main Street stays open all night.
e.zh: 主街上的自助洗衣店通宵营业。

e.en: I read a novel while waiting at the {laundrette}.
e.zh: 我在自助洗衣店等候时读了一本小说。

laundries.t: n. 洗衣店；要洗的衣物（laundry 的复数）

e.en: Most hotel {laundries} run nonstop during peak tourist season.
e.zh: 大多数酒店洗衣房在旅游旺季会不停运转。

e.en: Industrial {laundries} consume enormous amounts of water each day.
e.zh: 工业洗衣厂每天消耗大量的水。

e.en: I spent Sunday afternoon at the {laundromat} catching up on shows.
e.zh: 我周日下午在自助洗衣店里追剧。

e.en: The {laundromat} accepts both quarters and a payment app.
e.zh: 这家自助洗衣店收硬币也支持手机付款。

e.en: I still need to fold the {laundry} before bed.
e.zh: 我睡前还得把衣服叠好。

e.en: The hotel offers free {laundry} service for long stays.
e.zh: 酒店为长期入住的客人提供免费洗衣服务。

e.en: The {laundryman} delivered our pressed shirts every Friday.
e.zh: 洗衣工每周五送来熨好的衬衫。

e.en: My great-grandfather worked as a {laundryman} in San Francisco.
e.zh: 我曾祖父在旧金山做过洗衣工。

laureate.t:
n. 桂冠诗人；获奖者
adj. 戴桂冠的

e.en: The Nobel {laureate} gave a moving acceptance speech.
e.zh: 这位诺贝尔奖得主发表了感人的获奖致辞。

e.en: She was named poet {laureate} of the United States.
e.zh: 她被任命为美国桂冠诗人。

laurel.t: n. 月桂树；荣誉的象征

e.en: A {laurel} wreath was placed on the champion's head.
e.zh: 一顶月桂花环戴在了冠军头上。

e.en: The garden path is lined with fragrant {laurel} bushes.
e.zh: 花园小径两旁种着芬芳的月桂灌木。

e.en: Don't rest on your {laurels} after one good quarter.
e.zh: 不要因为一个季度的好成绩就吃老本。

e.en: The startup earned its {laurels} with a breakthrough product.
e.zh: 这家初创公司凭借突破性产品赢得了荣誉。

laurentian.t: adj. 劳伦琴的（圣劳伦斯河流域；劳伦地质系的）

e.en: We hiked through the {Laurentian} mountains last autumn.
e.zh: 去年秋天我们在劳伦琴山脉徒步。

e.en: The {Laurentian} plateau stretches across much of eastern Canada.
e.zh: 劳伦琴高原绵延横跨加拿大东部大部分地区。

e.en: The Olympic Committee is headquartered in {Lausanne}, Switzerland.
e.zh: 奥委会总部设在瑞士洛桑。

e.en: We took a ferry across Lake Geneva to {Lausanne}.
e.zh: 我们坐渡轮穿过日内瓦湖去洛桑。

lautrec.t: n. 洛特雷克（法国画家姓氏）

e.en: The exhibit features posters by Toulouse-{Lautrec} from 1890s Paris.
e.zh: 该展览展出了图卢兹—劳特累克1890年代在巴黎创作的海报。

e.en: {Lautrec} captured the nightlife of Montmartre with vivid color.
e.zh: 劳特累克用鲜明的色彩描绘了蒙马特的夜生活。

lav.t: n. 厕所（lavatory 的口语缩写）

e.en: Excuse me, where's the {lav} on this train?
e.zh: 不好意思,这趟列车上的厕所在哪?

e.en: He nipped to the {lav} between meetings.
e.zh: 他在两个会议之间溜去了趟厕所。

e.en: Glowing {lava} streamed down the volcano's slope at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分,炽热的岩浆顺着火山斜坡流下。

e.en: Hardened {lava} forms much of the island's coastline.
e.zh: 凝固的熔岩构成了该岛大部分的海岸线。

e.en: Doctors performed gastric {lavage} to remove the toxins.
e.zh: 医生进行了洗胃以清除毒素。

e.en: Nasal {lavage} can ease congestion during allergy season.
e.zh: 鼻腔冲洗可在过敏季节缓解鼻塞。

e.en: My cousin studies engineering at Université {Laval} in Quebec.
e.zh: 我表弟在魁北克的拉瓦尔大学读工程。

e.en: {Laval} is a large suburb just north of Montreal.
e.zh: 拉瓦尔是蒙特利尔以北的一个大型郊区。

lavatorial.t: adj. 厕所的；下流的（指笑话等）

e.en: The comedian's {lavatorial} humor made half the audience cringe.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员的厕所幽默让一半观众尴尬不已。

e.en: His novel relies too heavily on {lavatorial} jokes.
e.zh: 他的小说过于依赖屎尿屁式的笑话。

lavatories.t: n. 厕所，盥洗室（lavatory 的复数）

e.en: All {lavatories} on the aircraft are currently occupied.
e.zh: 飞机上的所有洗手间目前都有人使用。

e.en: The school's {lavatories} were renovated over summer break.
e.zh: 学校的厕所在暑假期间翻新了。

layer.t:
n. 层；图层
v. 分层叠放

e.en: Add another {layer} of paint once the first one dries.
e.zh: 等第一层漆干了之后，再涂一层。

e.en: A thick {layer} of dust covered the abandoned piano.
e.zh: 那架废弃的钢琴上积了厚厚一层灰。

e.en: She wore a {layered} sweater for the chilly autumn hike.
e.zh: 她穿着一件多层毛衣去秋天寒冷的徒步。

e.en: The novel has a {layered} plot full of hidden meanings.
e.zh: 这本小说情节层层叠叠，充满隐藏的含义。

e.en: {Layering} clothes is the best strategy for unpredictable weather.
e.zh: 多层穿搭是应对多变天气的最佳策略。

e.en: The chef's {layering} of flavors made the dish unforgettable.
e.zh: 主厨层层叠加的味道让这道菜令人难忘。

layers.t: n. 层；图层（layer 的复数）

e.en: The cake has five {layers} of chocolate and cream.
e.zh: 这个蛋糕有五层巧克力和奶油。

e.en: Geologists study the rock {layers} to understand Earth's history.
e.zh: 地质学家研究岩石层来了解地球的历史。

e.en: Her aunt knitted an entire {layette} for the new baby.
e.zh: 她姑姑为刚出生的宝宝织了一整套婴儿用品。

e.en: The hospital gives every newborn a basic {layette}.
e.zh: 医院会给每个新生儿一套基础婴儿用品。

laying.t: v. 铺设；放置（lay 的现在分词）

e.en: Workers are {laying} new fiber cables along the highway.
e.zh: 工人们正沿着高速公路铺设新的光纤电缆。

e.en: The cat enjoys {laying} in the sunny window all afternoon.
e.zh: 那只猫整个下午都喜欢躺在阳光照到的窗边。

e.en: Can you explain quantum physics in {layman} terms?
e.zh: 你能用外行人也能听懂的话解释量子物理吗？

e.en: As a {layman}, I find legal documents very confusing.
e.zh: 作为一个外行人，我觉得法律文件非常难懂。

e.en: The tech company announced a massive {layoff} last week.
