e.zh: 那家科技公司上周宣布了一次大规模裁员。

e.en: He's still recovering financially from his {layoff} last year.
e.zh: 去年被裁员后，他在经济上仍未恢复元气。

e.en: The new office {layout} encourages team collaboration and chats.
e.zh: 新办公室的布局有利于团队协作和交流。

e.en: I love the clean {layout} of this magazine's website.
e.zh: 我喜欢这家杂志网站简洁的版面设计。

layouts.t: n. 布局；版面（layout 的复数）

e.en: The designer prepared three {layouts} for the client to review.
e.zh: 设计师准备了三种版式让客户审阅。

e.en: Modern keyboard {layouts} can be customized to fit personal habits.
e.zh: 现代键盘布局可以根据个人习惯进行自定义。

layover.t: n. 中途停留；转机等候

e.en: We had a six-hour {layover} in Tokyo on the way home.
e.zh: 回家途中我们在东京中转停留了六个小时。

e.en: A short {layover} barely gives time to grab coffee.
e.zh: 短暂的中转时间几乎只够买杯咖啡。

laypeople.t: n. 非专业人士；一般大众

e.en: Scientists must explain climate research clearly to {laypeople}.
e.zh: 科学家必须把气候研究向非专业人士讲清楚。

e.en: Most {laypeople} don't know how vaccines actually work.
e.zh: 大多数普通人并不真正了解疫苗的工作原理。

layperson.t: n. 非专业人士；门外汉

e.en: Even a {layperson} can spot the obvious flaws in this code.
e.zh: 即使是外行也能看出这段代码中明显的问题。

e.en: The article is written for the average {layperson}, not specialists.
e.zh: 这篇文章是写给普通读者的，而不是专家。

lays.t: v. 放置；铺（lay 的三单）

e.en: He {lays} his keys on the same hook every evening.
e.zh: 他每天晚上都把钥匙挂在同一个钩子上。

e.en: The hen {lays} an egg almost every single day.
e.zh: 这只母鸡几乎每天都会下一个蛋。

e.en: She made an easy {layup} to win the basketball game.
e.zh: 她用一个轻松的上篮赢下了这场篮球赛。

e.en: Practicing the {layup} from both sides improves your scoring.
e.zh: 练习左右两侧的上篮能提高你的得分能力。

laywoman.t: n. 非专业女性；女俗众

e.en: As a {laywoman}, she still volunteered actively at the church.
e.zh: 作为一名平信徒，她仍然在教会积极做志愿者。

e.en: The court relied on a {laywoman}'s clear, honest testimony.
e.zh: 法庭采信了一位普通女士清晰而诚实的证词。

e.en: In medieval times, a {lazar} was shunned by the village.
e.zh: 在中世纪，麻风病人会被村庄排斥。

e.en: The old hospital once cared for every {lazar} in town.
e.zh: 那家老医院曾照料镇上所有的麻风病人。

e.en: {Lazard} advised the company on its complex restructuring deal.
e.zh: 拉扎德为该公司复杂的重组交易提供咨询。

e.en: She landed an internship at {Lazard} after graduation.
e.zh: 她毕业后在拉扎德投行获得了一份实习工作。

e.en: The captain stored emergency supplies in the boat's {lazarette}.
e.zh: 船长把应急物资储存在船尾的储物舱里。

e.en: A small {lazarette} held the spare ropes and tools.
e.zh: 一个小型船尾储物舱里放着备用绳索和工具。

e.en: The startup made a {Lazarus}-like comeback after near bankruptcy.
e.zh: 那家初创公司在濒临破产后奇迹般地起死回生。

e.en: Critics called the album his career's {Lazarus} moment.
e.zh: 乐评人称这张专辑是他职业生涯的复活时刻。

e.en: On Sundays I just {laze} around with a good book.
e.zh: 星期天我就喜欢拿本好书懒散地待着。

e.en: They love to {laze} on the beach all afternoon.
e.zh: 他们喜欢整个下午都懒洋洋地躺在沙滩上。

e.en: The cat stretched {lazily} in the warm afternoon sun.
e.zh: 那只猫在午后的阳光里懒洋洋地伸了个懒腰。

e.en: He {lazily} flipped through the magazine without really reading.
e.zh: 他懒洋洋地翻着杂志，并没有真的在看。

e.en: Her {laziness} finally caught up with her at exam time.
e.zh: 考试时她的懒惰终于让她付出了代价。

e.en: Pure {laziness} kept him from cleaning the apartment.
e.zh: 纯粹是懒惰让他迟迟不打扫公寓。

lazinesses.t: n. 懒惰（laziness 的复数，罕用）

e.en: The essay listed common {lazinesses} that ruin productivity at work.
e.zh: 那篇文章列举了几种常见的、毁掉工作效率的懒散习惯。

e.en: She wrote about the small {lazinesses} of everyday life.
e.zh: 她写下了日常生活中那些细小的懒散举动。

lazio.t: n. 意大利拉齐奥大区/足球俱乐部

e.en: {Lazio} drew one-all with their crosstown rivals last weekend.
e.zh: 拉齐奥队上周末与同城对手一比一战平。

e.en: Rome is the capital of the {Lazio} region in Italy.
e.zh: 罗马是意大利拉齐奥大区的首府。

e.en: The pharaoh's mask was inlaid with brilliant blue lapis {lazuli}.
e.zh: 法老的面具镶嵌着鲜艳的青金石。

e.en: She wore earrings made of polished lapis {lazuli}.
e.zh: 她戴着一副打磨过的青金石耳环。

lazy.t: adj. 懒惰的；懒加载的（编程）

e.en: Don't be so {lazy}—get up and finish the homework.
e.zh: 别那么懒，起来把作业做完。

e.en: We spent a {lazy} afternoon by the swimming pool.
e.zh: 我们在游泳池边度过了一个慵懒的下午。

lbc.t: n. 英国 LBC 广播电台

e.en: Listeners called {LBC} all morning to debate the new policy.
e.zh: 整个上午听众都打电话到LBC电台讨论新政策。

e.en: He hosts a popular evening show on {LBC} radio.
e.zh: 他在LBC电台主持一档受欢迎的晚间节目。

lbw.t: n. 板球术语：leg before wicket

e.en: The umpire ruled the batsman out {lbw} on appeal.
e.zh: 裁判在申诉后判击球手腿前阻挡出局。

e.en: He was dismissed {lbw} for just twelve runs.
e.zh: 他仅得十二分就被判腿前阻挡出局。

lcc.t: n. 低成本航空公司（low-cost carrier）

e.en: The library uses {LCC} to organize its enormous research collection.
e.zh: 该图书馆使用美国国会图书馆分类法来整理庞大的研究藏书。

e.en: Each book is shelved according to its {LCC} call number.
e.zh: 每本书都按照美国国会图书馆分类号上架。

e.en: My old laptop's {LCD} screen finally started flickering yesterday.
e.zh: 我那台旧笔记本的液晶屏昨天终于开始闪烁了。

e.en: They replaced the broken {LCD} with a brighter OLED panel.
e.zh: 他们把坏掉的液晶屏换成了更亮的OLED面板。

e.en: {LCH} clears trillions of dollars in derivatives trades each day.
e.zh: 伦敦清算所每天清算数万亿美元的衍生品交易。

e.en: Banks rely on {LCH} to manage counterparty risk efficiently.
e.zh: 各银行依靠伦敦清算所高效管理交易对手风险。

lcy.t: n. 伦敦城市机场代码

e.en: My flight to Zurich departs from {LCY} early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我去苏黎世的航班明天一早从伦敦城市机场起飞。

e.en: {LCY} is the most convenient airport for Canary Wharf bankers.
e.zh: 对金丝雀码头的银行家来说，伦敦城市机场最方便。

e.en: The UN provides aid programs for every {LDC} on the list.
e.zh: 联合国为名单上的每一个最不发达国家提供援助项目。

e.en: Trade barriers hurt exports from many an {LDC}.
e.zh: 贸易壁垒损害了许多最不发达国家的出口。

e.en: The {LDDC} transformed London's docklands into a modern business district.
e.zh: 伦敦码头区开发公司把伦敦码头区改造成了现代商业区。

e.en: Critics debated whether the {LDDC} truly benefited local residents.
e.zh: 评论人士争论伦敦码头区开发公司是否真的让当地居民受益。

ldl.t: n. 低密度脂蛋白（坏胆固醇）

e.en: High {LDL} cholesterol increases your risk of heart disease.
e.zh: 低密度脂蛋白胆固醇过高会增加患心脏病的风险。

e.en: Exercise and diet can lower {LDL} levels naturally.
e.zh: 运动和饮食可以自然地降低低密度脂蛋白水平。

e.en: The {LDP} has dominated Japanese politics for most decades.
e.zh: 自民党在大多数年代主导着日本政坛。

e.en: Voters surprised analysts by handing the {LDP} another majority.
e.zh: 选民让自民党再次获得多数席位，令分析人士感到意外。

e.en: Maintaining an {LDR} requires constant communication and a lot of trust.
e.zh: 维持异地恋需要不断的沟通和大量的信任。

e.en: Their {LDR} finally ended when she moved to Berlin.
e.zh: 她搬到柏林后，他们的异地恋终于结束了。

e.en: The cows grazed peacefully in the green {lea} at sunset.
e.zh: 夕阳下，牛群在绿茵茵的草地上安静地吃草。

e.en: A wildflower-covered {lea} stretched beyond the old farmhouse.
e.zh: 老农舍后面是一片开满野花的草地。

e.en: Heavy rain can {leach} nutrients from the topsoil quickly.
e.zh: 大雨会迅速把表层土壤里的养分冲刷流失。

e.en: Old pipes may {leach} lead into the drinking water.
e.zh: 老旧管道可能会把铅渗入饮用水中。

e.en: The landfill {leachate} contaminated the nearby groundwater supply.
e.zh: 垃圾填埋场的渗滤液污染了附近的地下水。

e.en: Engineers test the {leachate} every month for toxic chemicals.
e.zh: 工程师每月检测渗滤液中的有毒化学物质。

e.en: Heavy rain is {leaching} nutrients from the topsoil.
e.zh: 大雨正在把表土里的养分冲走。

e.en: Acid {leaching} is used to extract copper from low-grade ore.
e.zh: 酸浸法用于从低品位矿石中提取铜。

lead.t:
v. 引导；带领
n. 线索；铅

e.en: She will {lead} the project team starting next Monday.
e.zh: 她将从下周一开始带领项目团队。

e.en: Old paint often contains {lead}, which is dangerous for kids.
e.zh: 旧油漆常含铅,对儿童很危险。

e.en: Most countries have banned {leaded} gasoline for environmental reasons.
e.zh: 出于环保考虑,大多数国家已禁用含铅汽油。

e.en: The old church windows have beautiful {leaded} glass panes.
e.zh: 那座老教堂有漂亮的铅条镶嵌玻璃窗。

e.en: A {leaden} sky hung over the city all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午,铅灰色的天空笼罩着城市。

e.en: His footsteps were {leaden} after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后,他的脚步沉重得像灌了铅。

e.en: Tourists love photographing {Leadenhall} Market in central London.
e.zh: 游客们喜欢拍摄伦敦市中心的利登霍尔市场。

e.en: The film crew shot a Harry Potter scene at {Leadenhall}.
e.zh: 剧组在利登霍尔取景拍摄了一段哈利波特的镜头。

e.en: A good {leader} listens before making big decisions.
e.zh: 优秀的领导者会先倾听再做重大决定。

e.en: She is the current {leader} in the women's marathon.
e.zh: 她目前在女子马拉松比赛中领先。

e.en: Check the {leaderboard} to see who's winning this week.
e.zh: 看一下排行榜,看看本周谁领先。

e.en: His name climbed to the top of the {leaderboard} overnight.
e.zh: 他的名字一夜之间冲上了排行榜榜首。

leaderless.t: adj. 无领导的；群龙无首的

e.en: The team felt {leaderless} after the manager resigned.
e.zh: 经理辞职后,团队感到群龙无首。

e.en: A {leaderless} protest spread quickly across social media.
e.zh: 一场没有领导者的抗议在社交媒体上迅速蔓延。

leaders.t: n. 领导者（leader 的复数）

e.en: World {leaders} gathered in Geneva to discuss climate change.
e.zh: 各国领导人齐聚日内瓦讨论气候变化问题。

e.en: Tech {leaders} are racing to launch new AI products.
e.zh: 科技行业的领军者正争相推出新的人工智能产品。

e.en: Her {leadership} turned the struggling startup into a unicorn.
e.zh: 她的领导力把这家苦苦挣扎的初创公司打造成了独角兽。

e.en: The company announced major changes to its senior {leadership}.
e.zh: 公司宣布对高层领导班子进行重大调整。

leaderships.t: n. 领导职位（leadership 的复数）

e.en: Different {leaderships} brought very different cultures to the firm.
e.zh: 不同届的领导层给公司带来了截然不同的文化。

e.en: The book compares the {leaderships} of three U.S. presidents.
e.zh: 这本书比较了三位美国总统的领导风格。

leading.t:
adj. 领先的；主要的
v. 带领（lead 的现在分词）

e.en: She is a {leading} expert in artificial intelligence ethics.
e.zh: 她是人工智能伦理领域的顶尖专家。

e.en: The path {leading} to the lake is closed for repairs.
e.zh: 通往湖边的小路因维修而关闭。

leadoff.t:
adj. 开头的；首位的
n. 开端

e.en: He hit a home run as the {leadoff} batter.
e.zh: 作为首棒打者,他打出了一支全垒打。

e.en: Her speech was the {leadoff} talk at the conference.
e.zh: 她的演讲是会议的开场发言。

leads.t:
v. 带领（lead 的三单）
n. 销售线索；引线

e.en: This trail {leads} straight to the waterfall.
e.zh: 这条小径直接通向瀑布。

e.en: The sales team is chasing several promising {leads} this week.
e.zh: 销售团队这周正在跟进几个有希望的潜在客户。

e.en: A red maple {leaf} drifted onto the windshield.
e.zh: 一片红色的枫叶飘落在挡风玻璃上。

e.en: I like to {leaf} through magazines while waiting.
e.zh: 等待的时候我喜欢随手翻翻杂志。

leafed.t: v. 翻阅；长叶（leaf 的过去式）

e.en: She {leafed} through the old photo album with a smile.
e.zh: 她微笑着翻阅那本旧相册。

e.en: He quickly {leafed} through the report before the meeting.
e.zh: 开会前他迅速翻阅了一遍报告。

e.en: A tiny green {leafhopper} jumped off the rose bush.
e.zh: 一只小小的绿叶蝉从玫瑰丛上跳走了。

e.en: Farmers spray pesticide to control {leafhopper} damage on rice.
e.zh: 农民喷洒农药来控制叶蝉对水稻的危害。

e.en: The {leafless} trees looked stark against the winter sky.
e.zh: 光秃秃的树木在冬日的天空下显得格外萧索。

e.en: Birds perched on the {leafless} branches outside my window.
e.zh: 鸟儿停在我窗外光秃秃的枝头上。

e.en: A volunteer handed me a {leaflet} about recycling.
e.zh: 一位志愿者递给我一份关于回收的宣传单。

e.en: The clinic's {leaflet} explains the vaccine side effects clearly.
e.zh: 诊所的宣传册清楚说明了疫苗的副作用。

e.en: Activists handed out {leaflets} outside the train station.
e.zh: 活动人士在火车站外派发传单。

e.en: Campaign {leaflets} filled my mailbox before the election.
e.zh: 选举前我的信箱里塞满了竞选传单。

e.en: We rented a house on a quiet, {leafy} street.
e.zh: 我们在一条安静、绿树成荫的街上租了一栋房子。

e.en: Doctors recommend eating more {leafy} green vegetables.
e.zh: 医生建议多吃绿叶蔬菜。

e.en: Their team won the local football {league} last season.
e.zh: 他们的球队上赛季赢得了本地足球联赛冠军。

e.en: His coding skills are in a different {league} from mine.
e.zh: 他的编程水平和我完全不在一个档次。

e.en: He's a former major {leaguer} who now coaches kids.
e.zh: 他曾是大联盟球员,现在指导小朋友打球。

e.en: The bush {leaguer} dreamed of playing in the big stadium.
e.zh: 这位小联盟球员梦想着登上大球场。

e.en: Several professional {leagues} are experimenting with new replay rules.
e.zh: 几个职业联赛正在试行新的回放规则。

e.en: Her singing is {leagues} ahead of the other contestants.
e.zh: 她的歌声远远超过其他参赛者。

leak.t:
v. 泄漏；漏出
n. 漏洞；泄密

e.en: There's a small water {leak} under the kitchen sink.
e.zh: 厨房水槽下面有个小漏水点。

e.en: Someone may {leak} the report to the press tonight.
e.zh: 今晚可能会有人把这份报告泄露给媒体。

e.en: The pipe {leakage} caused serious damage to the basement.
e.zh: 管道渗漏给地下室造成了严重损害。

e.en: Engineers are testing the battery for current {leakage}.
e.zh: 工程师正在测试电池是否有漏电现象。

leaked.t: v. 泄漏（leak 的过去式）

e.en: An internal memo was {leaked} to several news outlets.
e.zh: 一份内部备忘录被泄露给了多家媒体。

e.en: The roof {leaked} all night during the heavy storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨中屋顶漏了一整夜。

e.en: The company is investigating who the {leaker} might be.
e.zh: 公司正在调查泄密者究竟是谁。

e.en: That old faucet is a notorious {leaker} in our house.
e.zh: 那个旧水龙头是我们家出了名的漏水货。

leaking.t: v. 正在泄漏（leak 的现在分词）

e.en: The roof has been {leaking} since last week's storm.
e.zh: 自从上周的暴风雨后屋顶就一直在漏水。

e.en: Someone inside the agency is {leaking} confidential information.
e.zh: 机构内部有人在泄露机密信息。

leaks.t:
n. 泄密事件
v. 泄漏（leak 的三单）

e.en: The plumber fixed three small {leaks} this morning.
e.zh: 水管工今早修好了三处小漏水。

e.en: Recent {leaks} suggest the new phone launches in September.
e.zh: 最近的爆料显示新手机将于九月发布。

e.en: We finally replaced the {leaky} old faucet last weekend.
e.zh: 我们上周末终于换掉了那个漏水的旧水龙头。

e.en: The app has a {leaky} memory bug on Android.
e.zh: 这款应用在安卓上有内存泄漏的问题。

e.en: The old knight remained {leal} to his queen until death.
e.zh: 那位老骑士至死都对女王忠贞不渝。

e.en: She has a {leal} heart that never betrays a friend.
e.zh: 她有一颗忠诚的心,从不背叛朋友。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the spa town of {Leamington}.
e.zh: 我们周末去了温泉小镇利明顿游玩。

e.en: {Leamington} is famous for its Regency architecture and gardens.
e.zh: 利明顿以摄政时期建筑和花园而闻名。

lean.t:
v. 倾斜；倚靠
adj. 精瘦的；精简的

e.en: Try to {lean} forward slightly when you're listening.
e.zh: 听别人说话时身体可以稍微前倾。

e.en: Startups often run on a {lean} budget in the beginning.
e.zh: 创业公司起步阶段通常预算紧张。

e.en: In the myth, {Leander} swam the Hellespont every night.
e.zh: 神话中,利安德每晚都横渡赫勒斯滂海峡。

e.en: The poem retells the tragic love story of {Leander}.
e.zh: 这首诗重述了利安德的悲剧爱情故事。

leaned.t: v. 倾斜；倚靠（lean 的过去式）

e.en: She {leaned} against the doorway and laughed quietly.
e.zh: 她靠在门框上轻声笑了。

e.en: The startup {leaned} heavily on open-source tools to save money.
e.zh: 那家初创公司大量依赖开源工具来节省成本。

leaning.t:
n. 倾向；偏好
v. 倾斜（lean 的现在分词）

e.en: I'm {leaning} toward the blue jacket instead of the black one.
e.zh: 我比较倾向于那件蓝色外套,而不是黑色那件。

e.en: The old fence is {leaning} dangerously after the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨过后,那道旧篱笆斜得很危险。

e.en: The {leanness} of the report made it easy to read.
e.zh: 这份报告内容精炼,读起来很轻松。

e.en: His remarkable {leanness} comes from years of distance running.
e.zh: 他出色的精瘦身材源于多年的长跑训练。

leans.t: v. 倾斜；倚靠（lean 的三单）

e.en: The tower {leans} a little more each year.
e.zh: 那座塔每年都会再倾斜一点点。

e.en: She {leans} liberal on most social issues.
e.zh: 在大多数社会议题上,她偏自由派立场。

leap.t:
v. 跳跃；飞跃
n. 跃进

e.en: Don't {leap} to conclusions without checking the facts first.
e.zh: 不要不查证事实就妄下结论。

e.en: The cat made a graceful {leap} onto the bookshelf.
e.zh: 那只猫优雅地一跃跳上了书架。

leaped.t: v. 跳跃（leap 的过去式）

e.en: The dog {leaped} over the fence and chased the rabbit.
e.zh: 那只狗跳过篱笆去追兔子。

e.en: Stock prices {leaped} after the surprise earnings announcement.
e.zh: 出乎意料的财报公布后,股价大幅跳涨。

leaper.t: n. 跳跃者；跳跃的人或物

e.en: That kangaroo is an impressive {leaper} across open ground.
e.zh: 那只袋鼠在开阔地上跳跃能力惊人。

e.en: As a high {leaper}, she dominated the school track meet.
e.zh: 作为一名跳高好手,她在校运会上独占鳌头。

leapfrog.t:
n. 跳背游戏
v. 跨越式发展

e.en: Developing countries can {leapfrog} older technologies by going mobile-first.
e.zh: 发展中国家可以通过优先发展移动技术来跨越式发展。

e.en: The kids played {leapfrog} on the grass for hours.
e.zh: 孩子们在草地上玩跳背游戏玩了好几个小时。

leaping.t:
v. 跳跃（leap 的现在分词）
adj. 跳跃的

e.en: Dolphins were {leaping} out of the water beside our boat.
e.zh: 海豚在我们船边跃出水面。

e.en: House prices are {leaping} up in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 这一带的房价正在飞速上涨。

leaps.t:
n. 跳跃；飞跃
v. 跳（leap 的三单）

e.en: AI technology has made huge {leaps} in just two years.
e.zh: 人工智能技术仅用两年就取得了巨大飞跃。

e.en: The deer {leaps} effortlessly over the fallen log.
e.zh: 那只鹿轻松地跃过倒下的树干。

lear.t: n. 李尔（莎士比亚《李尔王》中的国王）

e.en: King {Lear} divides his kingdom among his three daughters.
e.zh: 李尔王把自己的王国分给了三个女儿。

e.en: The actor's portrayal of {Lear} earned him a Tony Award.
e.zh: 那位演员饰演的李尔王为他赢得了托尼奖。

e.en: Kids {learn} a new language much faster than adults.
e.zh: 孩子学新语言比大人快得多。

e.en: I want to {learn} how to cook Thai food this year.
e.zh: 今年我想学做泰国菜。

e.en: Most coding skills are {learnable} with enough practice and patience.
e.zh: 大多数编程技能只要有足够的练习和耐心都能学会。

e.en: The model has millions of {learnable} parameters during training.
e.zh: 该模型在训练时有数百万个可学习的参数。

learned.t:
adj. 博学的；有学问的
v. 学到（learn 的过去式）

e.en: I {learned} a lot from my first failed startup.
e.zh: 我从第一次失败的创业中学到了很多。

e.en: She gave a {learned} lecture on ancient Greek philosophy.
e.zh: 她做了一场关于古希腊哲学的博学演讲。

e.en: Please remain seated until the {lavatory} sign turns off.
e.zh: 请保持就座,直到洗手间指示灯熄灭。

e.en: The downstairs {lavatory} needs a new light bulb.
e.zh: 楼下的洗手间需要换一个新灯泡。

lave.t: v. 洗涤；冲洗（文学用法）

e.en: Gentle waves {lave} the rocks at the cove's edge.
e.zh: 轻柔的海浪轻拍着小海湾边缘的岩石。

e.en: The river continues to {lave} the ancient temple steps.
e.zh: 河水不断冲刷着那座古老庙宇的台阶。

lavender.t:
n. 薰衣草
adj. 淡紫色的

e.en: She painted the bedroom walls a soft {lavender} color.
e.zh: 她把卧室墙刷成了柔和的薰衣草紫色。

e.en: Fields of {lavender} bloom across Provence each summer.
e.zh: 每年夏天,普罗旺斯遍地都是盛开的薰衣草。

e.en: Welsh {laver} bread is traditionally served with bacon.
e.zh: 威尔士紫菜面包传统上配培根食用。

e.en: Dried {laver} sheets are essential for making sushi rolls.
e.zh: 干海苔片是制作寿司卷必不可少的。

lavish.t:
adj. 奢华的；丰盛的
v. 挥霍；慷慨给予

e.en: The CEO threw a {lavish} party for the launch.
e.zh: 首席执行官为产品发布举办了一场奢华派对。

e.en: Critics {lavish} praise on her debut novel.
e.zh: 评论家对她的处女作大加赞赏。

e.en: The mansion was {lavishly} decorated with marble and gold.
e.zh: 这座豪宅装饰得极其奢华,处处是大理石和黄金。

e.en: Investors {lavishly} funded the AI startup last year.
e.zh: 投资者去年对这家AI初创公司慷慨注资。

e.en: The wedding's {lavishness} surprised even the wealthiest guests.
e.zh: 婚礼的奢华程度连最富有的宾客都感到惊讶。

e.en: Her novels are admired for their visual {lavishness}.
e.zh: 她的小说因画面感的华丽铺陈而备受赞赏。

lavoisier.t: n. 拉瓦锡（法国化学家）

e.en: {Lavoisier} is often called the father of modern chemistry.
e.zh: 拉瓦锡常被誉为现代化学之父。

e.en: Schoolbooks credit {Lavoisier} with naming oxygen and hydrogen.
e.zh: 教科书将命名氧气和氢气归功于拉瓦锡。

e.en: The new privacy {law} takes effect next January.
e.zh: 新的隐私法将于明年一月生效。

e.en: She decided to study {law} after working as a journalist.
e.zh: 她做过记者后决定学习法律。

e.en: Police arrested the {lawbreaker} after a brief chase downtown.
e.zh: 警方在市中心一番短暂追逐后逮捕了这名违法者。

e.en: He'd never seen himself as a {lawbreaker} before that night.
e.zh: 那晚之前他从未把自己看作违法者。

lawful.t: adj. 合法的；法律允许的

e.en: Only {lawful} permanent residents can apply for this benefit.
e.zh: 只有合法永久居民才能申请这项福利。

e.en: Protesters insisted their gathering was entirely {lawful}.
e.zh: 抗议者坚称他们的集会完全合法。

e.en: The data was collected {lawfully} under the user agreement.
e.zh: 这些数据是依照用户协议合法收集的。

e.en: Officers must {lawfully} obtain a warrant before searching homes.
e.zh: 警官必须依法取得搜查令才能搜查住宅。

e.en: The court will rule on the {lawfulness} of the search.
e.zh: 法院将对搜查的合法性作出裁决。

e.en: Auditors questioned the {lawfulness} of the company's tax scheme.
e.zh: 审计人员对公司税务方案的合法性提出了质疑。

e.en: Solon is remembered as a wise {lawgiver} of ancient Athens.
e.zh: 梭伦被铭记为古雅典一位睿智的立法者。

e.en: The mural depicts Moses as a {lawgiver} on the mountain.
e.zh: 壁画把摩西描绘成山上的立法者。

lawless.t: adj. 无法无天的；不受法律约束的

e.en: The mining town became increasingly {lawless} after the sheriff resigned.
e.zh: 治安官辞职后,这个矿镇变得越来越无法无天。

e.en: Refugees fled the {lawless} border region last month.
e.zh: 难民上个月逃离了无法无天的边境地区。

lawlessness.t: n. 无法无天；法纪败坏

e.en: Years of war left the country in total {lawlessness}.
e.zh: 多年战乱使该国陷入完全无法无天的状态。

e.en: Residents complained about growing {lawlessness} in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 居民抱怨社区里日益严重的违法乱象。

e.en: The {lawmaker} pushed for stricter rules on AI training data.
e.zh: 这位议员推动对AI训练数据制定更严格的规定。

e.en: Every {lawmaker} received thousands of emails about the bill.
e.zh: 每位议员都收到了数千封关于该法案的电子邮件。

e.en: {Lawmakers} debated the climate bill late into the night.
e.zh: 议员们就气候法案辩论到深夜。

e.en: State {lawmakers} voted to expand broadband access in rural areas.
e.zh: 州议员们投票决定扩大农村地区的宽带接入。

lawmaking.t:
n. 立法
adj. 立法的

e.en: Compromise is essential to effective {lawmaking} in a democracy.
e.zh: 在民主制度下,妥协对有效立法至关重要。

e.en: Her book demystifies the {lawmaking} process for ordinary readers.
e.zh: 她的书向普通读者讲清了立法程序。

lawman.t: n. 执法人员（尤指警长）

e.en: The old {lawman} hung up his badge after thirty years.
e.zh: 这位老警长服役三十年后摘下了警徽。

e.en: Townsfolk respected the {lawman} who kept order without violence.
e.zh: 镇民们敬重这位不靠暴力维持秩序的执法官。

e.en: He mows the {lawn} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 他每个周六早上都修剪草坪。

e.en: The kids set up a tent on the front {lawn}.
e.zh: 孩子们在前院的草坪上搭了一顶帐篷。

e.en: My electric {lawnmower} is much quieter than the old gas one.
e.zh: 我的电动割草机比旧的汽油款安静得多。

e.en: The {lawnmower} stalled halfway through the back yard.
e.zh: 割草机在后院割到一半就熄火了。

e.en: Manicured {lawns} stretch across the entire university campus.
e.zh: 修剪整齐的草坪铺满了整个大学校园。

e.en: Drought restrictions mean homeowners can't water their {lawns} daily.
e.zh: 干旱限令意味着房主不能每天给草坪浇水。

e.en: Several states passed new data privacy {laws} this year.
e.zh: 今年有几个州通过了新的数据隐私法。

e.en: The {laws} of physics don't bend for anyone's startup pitch.
e.zh: 物理定律不会为任何人的创业演讲让步。

e.en: The company settled the class-action {lawsuit} for fifty million dollars.
e.zh: 该公司以五千万美元了结了这起集体诉讼。

e.en: She filed a {lawsuit} alleging workplace discrimination.
e.zh: 她提起诉讼,指控工作场所存在歧视。

e.en: The startup faces multiple {lawsuits} over its hiring practices.
e.zh: 这家初创公司因招聘做法面临多起诉讼。

e.en: Frivolous {lawsuits} clog the courts and waste taxpayer money.
e.zh: 无理诉讼堵塞了法院,浪费了纳税人的钱。

e.en: You should call a {lawyer} before signing that contract.
e.zh: 签那份合同之前你应该咨询一下律师。

e.en: Her {lawyer} negotiated a favorable settlement out of court.
e.zh: 她的律师在庭外谈成了一份有利的和解。

e.en: Aggressive {lawyering} dragged the case out for three years.
e.zh: 激进的诉讼策略把这桩案子拖了三年。

e.en: He left big-firm {lawyering} to teach law school instead.
e.zh: 他离开大型律所的律师工作转去法学院任教。

lawyerly.t: adj. 律师式的；咬文嚼字的

e.en: He gave a {lawyerly} answer that avoided any clear commitment.
e.zh: 他给出了一个律师式的回答，避开任何明确承诺。

e.en: Her {lawyerly} caution annoyed the journalists at the press conference.
e.zh: 她那种律师式的谨慎让记者会上的记者们很不耐烦。

e.en: The company hired three {lawyers} to review the merger contract.
e.zh: 公司聘请了三名律师来审查这份并购合同。

e.en: Both sides' {lawyers} met privately to discuss a settlement.
e.zh: 双方律师私下会面，商讨和解事宜。

e.en: Security at the warehouse was surprisingly {lax} that night.
e.zh: 那天晚上仓库的安保松懈得令人意外。

e.en: Teachers complained about the school's {lax} attendance policy.
e.zh: 老师们抱怨学校的考勤制度太松散。

laxative.t:
n. 泻药
adj. 通便的

e.en: The doctor prescribed a mild {laxative} for her constipation.
e.zh: 医生为她的便秘开了一种温和的泻药。

e.en: Prunes work as a natural {laxative} for many people.
e.zh: 对很多人来说，西梅是天然的通便食物。

e.en: The audit revealed serious {laxity} in the bank's compliance procedures.
e.zh: 审计发现该银行的合规程序存在严重松懈。

e.en: Parents criticized the {laxity} of the new discipline rules.
e.zh: 家长们批评新的纪律规定过于松弛。

lay.t:
v. 放置；铺设
adj. 外行的；非专业的

e.en: Please {lay} the documents on the table before you leave.
e.zh: 请在离开前把文件放在桌子上。

e.en: The hens {lay} fresh eggs every morning at sunrise.
e.zh: 母鸡每天日出时分都会下新鲜的蛋。

e.en: His brother is a complete {layabout} who refuses to work.
e.zh: 他哥哥是个十足的懒汉，怎么都不肯工作。

e.en: Don't be a {layabout}—at least help with the dishes.
e.zh: 别这么懒散，至少帮忙洗洗碗吧。

layabouts.t: n. 游手好闲的人（复数）

e.en: The park was full of {layabouts} sunbathing on the grass.
e.zh: 公园里满是躺在草地上晒太阳的闲人。

e.en: She called her teenage sons hopeless {layabouts}.
e.zh: 她把自己十几岁的儿子们叫做没救的懒汉。

layaway.t: n. 预付订金分期购物

e.en: I put the new bicycle on {layaway} until payday.
e.zh: 我先把新自行车预订下来，等发工资再付清。

e.en: Many stores still offer {layaway} plans during the holidays.
e.zh: 许多商店在节假日期间仍提供分期预订服务。

e.en: The truck pulled into a {layby} to let traffic pass.
e.zh: 卡车驶入路边停车带，让后面的车流通过。

e.en: We stopped at a quiet {layby} for a quick picnic.
e.zh: 我们在一个安静的路边停车带停下来野餐。

e.en: She's a quick {learner} who picks up new tools fast.
e.zh: 她学东西很快，新工具上手特别快。

e.en: This app is designed for adult {learner} profiles.
e.zh: 这款应用是为成人学习者设计的。

e.en: The course supports {learners} of all skill levels.
e.zh: 该课程适合各种水平的学习者。

e.en: Young {learners} benefit from interactive lessons.
e.zh: 低龄学习者受益于互动式课程。

learning.t:
n. 学习；知识
v. 学习（-ing 形式）

e.en: Online {learning} has changed how students study.
e.zh: 在线学习改变了学生的学习方式。

e.en: I'm {learning} Spanish through a daily podcast.
e.zh: 我每天通过播客学西班牙语。

e.en: The team shared key {learnings} from the project.
e.zh: 团队分享了项目中的关键收获。

e.en: Document your {learnings} after each sprint review.
e.zh: 每次迭代回顾后记录下你的心得。

learns.t: v. 学习（第三人称单数）

e.en: My daughter {learns} a new word every day.
e.zh: 我女儿每天都学一个新单词。

e.en: The model {learns} patterns from millions of examples.
e.zh: 该模型从数百万样本中学习规律。

lease.t:
n. 租约
v. 租赁；出租

e.en: We signed a two-year {lease} on the apartment.
e.zh: 我们签了这套公寓两年的租约。

e.en: The company decided to {lease} office space downtown.
e.zh: 公司决定在市中心租下办公场地。

leased.t: v. 租赁（过去式）；已租出

e.en: They {leased} a warehouse near the port last month.
e.zh: 他们上个月在港口附近租下了一个仓库。

e.en: The car is {leased}, not owned.
e.zh: 这辆车是租的，不是买的。

e.en: The flat is sold as a {leasehold} property.
e.zh: 这套公寓以租赁产权形式出售。

e.en: Buyers should check the {leasehold} terms carefully.
e.zh: 买家应仔细查看租赁产权的条款。

e.en: The {leaseholder} is responsible for minor repairs.
e.zh: 承租人负责一些小修小补。

e.en: Each {leaseholder} pays an annual ground rent.
e.zh: 每位承租人需缴纳年度土地租金。

leases.t:
n. 租约（复数）
v. 出租

e.en: Most {leases} in this building run twelve months.
e.zh: 这栋楼里大多数租约都是十二个月的。

e.en: The agency {leases} cars to small businesses.
e.zh: 该公司向小企业出租汽车。

leash.t:
n. (狗的) 牵绳
v. 用绳拴住

e.en: Keep your dog on a {leash} in the park.
e.zh: 在公园里请用牵引绳牵着狗。

e.en: The manager kept the project on a tight {leash}.
e.zh: 经理把这个项目管得很紧。

e.en: All dogs must be {leashed} on the trail.
e.zh: 步道上所有的狗都必须用绳牵着。

e.en: She {leashed} the puppy before opening the door.
e.zh: 她在开门前把小狗拴好。

e.en: The pet store sells colorful {leashes} and collars.
e.zh: 宠物店出售各种彩色牵引绳和项圈。

e.en: He {leashes} both dogs before their evening walk.
e.zh: 晚上遛狗前他把两只狗都拴好。

leasing.t:
n. 租赁（业务）
v. 出租（-ing 形式）

e.en: They are {leasing} a new office in Shanghai.
e.zh: 他们正在上海租赁一间新办公室。

e.en: Car {leasing} can be cheaper than buying outright.
e.zh: 租车可能比直接购买更划算。

least.t:
adj. 最少的
adv. 最少地

e.en: This is the {least} expensive option on the menu.
e.zh: 这是菜单上最便宜的选项。

e.en: At {least} ten people showed up to the meeting.
e.zh: 至少有十个人来参加了会议。

leather.t:
n. 皮革
adj. 皮革制的

e.en: He bought a black {leather} jacket for winter.
e.zh: 他买了一件黑色皮夹克过冬。

e.en: The sofa is made of genuine {leather}.
e.zh: 这张沙发是真皮做的。

e.en: The {leatherback} turtle can dive over a thousand meters.
e.zh: 棱皮龟可以下潜超过一千米。

e.en: Volunteers protect {leatherback} nests on the beach.
e.zh: 志愿者们在沙滩上保护棱皮龟的巢。

e.en: He collects {leatherbound} editions of classic novels.
e.zh: 他收藏皮面装订的经典小说版本。

e.en: The library displays a {leatherbound} Shakespeare folio.
e.zh: 图书馆展出一本皮面装订的莎士比亚对开本。

e.en: Years in the sun had {leathered} his face.
e.zh: 多年的日晒把他的脸晒得像皮革一样。

e.en: The countertop has a {leathered} granite finish.
e.zh: 台面采用了皮革面花岗岩工艺。

e.en: The chairs are covered in cheap {leatherette}.
e.zh: 这些椅子包的是廉价的人造革。

e.en: Her wallet is made of black {leatherette}.
e.zh: 她的钱包是用黑色人造革做的。

leatherhead.t: n. 莱瑟黑德（英国地名）

e.en: We took the train to {Leatherhead} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去莱瑟黑德过周末。

e.en: The match was held at a stadium near {Leatherhead}.
e.zh: 比赛在莱瑟黑德附近的体育场举行。

e.en: The old steak was tough and {leathery}.
e.zh: 那块陈年牛排又硬又像皮革。

e.en: Fishermen often have {leathery} skin from the sun.
e.zh: 渔民因常年日晒皮肤往往像皮革一样粗糙。

leave.t:
v. 离开；留下
n. 休假

e.en: Please {leave} your shoes by the front door.
e.zh: 请把鞋子放在前门旁边。

e.en: She's on maternity {leave} until September.
e.zh: 她在休产假，要到九月才回来。

e.en: Broad-{leaved} trees line the riverbank.
e.zh: 阔叶树成排长在河岸边。

e.en: The garden features many fine-{leaved} ferns.
e.zh: 花园里种着许多细叶蕨类植物。

leaven.t:
n. 酵母；发酵剂
v. 使发酵

e.en: A little humor can {leaven} a serious meeting.
e.zh: 一点幽默能让严肃的会议变得轻松些。

e.en: Yeast is the {leaven} that makes bread rise.
e.zh: 酵母是让面包发起来的发酵剂。

e.en: Her speech was {leavened} with personal anecdotes.
e.zh: 她的演讲穿插了一些亲身经历，显得生动。

e.en: This bakery sells traditionally {leavened} sourdough.
e.zh: 这家面包店出售传统发酵的酸面包。

e.en: Baking soda acts as a {leavening} agent in cookies.
e.zh: 小苏打在饼干中起到膨松剂的作用。

e.en: His optimism was a welcome {leavening} in tough times.
e.zh: 在艰难时期，他的乐观给人带来一丝鼓舞。

e.en: The recipe lists several {leavenings} for fluffier cake.
e.zh: 这份食谱列出了几种膨松剂让蛋糕更松软。

e.en: Different {leavenings} produce different bread textures.
e.zh: 不同的发酵剂会产生不同的面包口感。

leavens.t: v. 使发酵（第三人称单数）

e.en: A pinch of salt {leavens} the sweetness nicely.
e.zh: 一小撮盐恰好中和了甜味。

e.en: Yeast {leavens} the dough overnight in the fridge.
e.zh: 酵母在冰箱里整夜发酵面团。

e.en: Every {leaver} gets a small farewell gift.
e.zh: 每一位离职者都会收到一份小小的告别礼物。

e.en: The school threw a party for school {leaver} students.
e.zh: 学校为毕业离校的学生举办了一场派对。

leaves.t:
n. 叶子（复数）
v. 离开（第三人称单数）

e.en: The autumn {leaves} turned bright red and gold.
e.zh: 秋天的树叶变成了鲜艳的红色和金色。

e.en: His train {leaves} at half past seven.
e.zh: 他的火车七点半发车。

leaving.t:
v. 离开（-ing 形式）
n. 离去

e.en: I'm {leaving} for the airport in ten minutes.
e.zh: 我十分钟后就要去机场了。

e.en: Thanks for {leaving} the lights on for me.
e.zh: 谢谢你给我留着灯。

lebanese.t:
adj. 黎巴嫩的
n. 黎巴嫩人

e.en: We had dinner at a great {Lebanese} restaurant downtown.
e.zh: 我们在市中心一家很棒的黎巴嫩餐厅吃了晚餐。

e.en: She is fluent in Arabic and proud of her {Lebanese} roots.
e.zh: 她阿拉伯语很流利，并以自己的黎巴嫩血统为荣。

e.en: {Lebanon} is famous for its mountains and Mediterranean coast.
e.zh: 黎巴嫩以山脉和地中海海岸而闻名。

e.en: The flight to {Lebanon} takes about five hours.
e.zh: 飞往黎巴嫩的航班大约需要五小时。

lebensraum.t: n. 生存空间（德语借词）

e.en: The Nazi ideology of {lebensraum} drove eastward expansion.
e.zh: 纳粹的“生存空间”理念推动了向东扩张。

e.en: Historians still debate the consequences of {lebensraum} policy.
e.zh: 历史学家仍在讨论“生存空间”政策的后果。

e.en: I missed this morning's {lec} on quantum mechanics.
e.zh: 我错过了今天上午那节量子力学课。

e.en: My favorite {lec} of the term was on cognitive bias.
e.zh: 这学期我最喜欢的一节课是讲认知偏差的。

lech.t:
n. 色欲
v. 贪色

e.en: Don't be a {lech} at the office party.
e.zh: 在公司聚会上别做个色狼。

e.en: He's known to {lech} after every new intern.
e.zh: 大家都知道他对每个新来的实习生都色眯眯的。

e.en: The old {lecher} was finally fired for harassment.
e.zh: 那个好色之徒终于因为骚扰被解雇了。

e.en: Nobody trusted the boss, who was a known {lecher}.
e.zh: 没人信任那个出了名好色的老板。

e.en: His {lecherous} stare made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那色眯眯的目光让所有人都不自在。

e.en: The villain is portrayed as a {lecherous} old man.
e.zh: 反派被塑造成一个好色的老头。

e.en: The novel exposes the {lechery} of the royal court.
e.zh: 这部小说揭露了宫廷的淫乱风气。

e.en: He was eventually brought down by his {lechery}.
e.zh: 他最终因好色而身败名裂。

e.en: Egg yolks are a natural source of {lecithin}.
e.zh: 蛋黄是卵磷脂的天然来源。

e.en: Soy {lecithin} is added to chocolate as an emulsifier.
e.zh: 巧克力中添加大豆卵磷脂作为乳化剂。

lecter.t: n. 莱克特（《沉默的羔羊》角色姓氏）

e.en: Hannibal {Lecter} is one of cinema's most chilling villains.
e.zh: 汉尼拔·莱克特是电影史上最令人毛骨悚然的反派之一。

e.en: Anthony Hopkins played {Lecter} with terrifying calm.
e.zh: 安东尼·霍普金斯把莱克特演得冷静得吓人。

e.en: The speaker stepped up to the {lectern} and smiled.
e.zh: 演讲者走到讲台前，微微一笑。

e.en: A glass of water sat ready on the {lectern}.
e.zh: 讲台上放着一杯准备好的水。

lectionary.t: n. 读经表；日课经文集

e.en: The priest read today's passage from the {lectionary}.
e.zh: 神父按今日的读经表诵读了经文。

e.en: Each Sunday's readings come from the {lectionary}.
e.zh: 每个礼拜日的经文都来自读经表。

e.en: The {lector} read the first reading at Mass.
e.zh: 读经员在弥撒中读了第一段经文。

e.en: She volunteered as a {lector} at her local church.
e.zh: 她在当地教堂自愿担任读经员。

lecture.t:
n. 讲座；授课
v. 讲课；训诫

e.en: His {lecture} on climate change was packed.
e.zh: 他关于气候变化的讲座座无虚席。

e.en: Please don't {lecture} me about being late again.
e.zh: 别再因为我迟到而教训我了。

e.en: She {lectured} on neuroscience at three universities.
e.zh: 她在三所大学讲授神经科学。

e.en: My dad {lectured} me for an hour about saving money.
e.zh: 我爸爸为存钱的事教训了我一个小时。

e.en: Our {lecturer} explained the theory with clear examples.
e.zh: 我们的讲师用清晰的例子解释了这个理论。

e.en: She works as a {lecturer} in computer science.
e.zh: 她担任计算机科学讲师。

e.en: The university hired three new {lecturers} this year.
e.zh: 今年这所大学新聘了三位讲师。

e.en: Senior {lecturers} usually supervise graduate students.
e.zh: 资深讲师通常会指导研究生。

lectures.t:
n. 讲座；课程
v. 讲课

e.en: All {lectures} are recorded and posted online.
e.zh: 所有讲座都会录制并上传到网上。

e.en: He {lectures} twice a week on modern history.
e.zh: 他每周讲两次现代史课程。

e.en: She accepted a {lectureship} at Cambridge last autumn.
e.zh: 她去年秋天接受了剑桥的讲师职位。

e.en: The university advertised a new {lectureship} in linguistics.
e.zh: 该大学公开招聘一个语言学讲师职位。

e.en: He spent the morning {lecturing} students on climate change.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在给学生讲授气候变化。

e.en: Stop {lecturing} me about being late to work.
e.zh: 别再训我上班迟到的事了。

led.t:
v. lead 的过去式，带领；导致
n. LED 发光二极管

e.en: She {led} the team to victory in the finals.
e.zh: 她带领球队在决赛中获胜。

e.en: Curiosity {led} him down a strange research path.
e.zh: 好奇心把他引上了一条奇怪的研究之路。

e.en: Tourists wore {lederhosen} during the Munich beer festival.
e.zh: 游客们在慕尼黑啤酒节期间穿着皮短裤。

e.en: His grandfather kept old {lederhosen} in the attic.
e.zh: 他爷爷把旧的皮短裤收在阁楼里。

e.en: A pigeon landed on the window {ledge} outside.
e.zh: 一只鸽子停在窗外的窗台上。

e.en: Climbers rested briefly on a narrow rocky {ledge}.
e.zh: 攀登者在狭窄的岩架上短暂休息。

e.en: The accountant updated the company {ledger} every Friday.
e.zh: 会计每周五都会更新公司的账簿。

e.en: Blockchain acts as a public, tamper-proof {ledger}.
e.zh: 区块链就像一本公开且不可篡改的账本。

leds.t: n. LED 发光二极管（复数）

e.en: Tiny blue {leds} blinked across the server rack.
e.zh: 小小的蓝色 LED 灯在服务器机架上闪烁。

e.en: Modern bulbs use {leds} instead of filaments.
e.zh: 现代灯泡用的是 LED 而不是灯丝。

e.en: We anchored on the {lee} side of the island.
e.zh: 我们在岛的背风一侧抛锚停泊。

e.en: Sheep huddled in the {lee} of the stone wall.
e.zh: 羊群挤在石墙的背风处取暖。

leech.t: n. 水蛭；吸血鬼般的人

e.en: A {leech} attached itself to his ankle in the swamp.
e.zh: 一只水蛭在沼泽里吸附在他的脚踝上。

e.en: Stop being a {leech} and pay your share.
e.zh: 别再当吸血鬼了,付你那份钱吧。

e.en: The architect designed the office to meet {leed} standards.
e.zh: 建筑师按照 LEED 标准设计这栋办公楼。

e.en: Their new headquarters earned a {leed} platinum certification.
e.zh: 他们的新总部获得了 LEED 铂金级认证。

e.en: She moved from London to {leeds} for a new job.
e.zh: 她为了新工作从伦敦搬到了利兹。

e.en: {Leeds} has a thriving music and arts scene.
e.zh: 利兹拥有蓬勃发展的音乐和艺术氛围。

e.en: The soup contained potato, cream, and one chopped {leek}.
e.zh: 这道汤里有土豆、奶油和一根切碎的韭葱。

e.en: He grew a giant {leek} in his garden.
e.zh: 他在花园里种出了一根巨大的韭葱。

e.en: She bought fresh {leeks} at the farmers' market.
e.zh: 她在农夫市集买了新鲜的韭葱。

e.en: Welsh tradition celebrates {leeks} on Saint David's Day.
e.zh: 威尔士在圣戴维节会用韭葱庆祝。

leer.t:
v. 色眯眯地瞟；斜视
n. 媚眼

e.en: He gave her a creepy {leer} from the corner.
e.zh: 他从角落里向她投来令人不适的色眯眯目光。

e.en: Strangers would {leer} at her on the subway.
e.zh: 陌生人会在地铁上色眯眯地盯着她看。

leering.t:
v. 色眯眯地看（进行时）
adj. 觊觎的

e.en: The man was {leering} at passersby outside the bar.
e.zh: 那男人在酒吧外色眯眯地盯着路人看。

e.en: She felt uncomfortable under his {leering} gaze.
e.zh: 她在他色迷迷的目光下感到很不自在。

e.en: I'm a bit {leery} of clicking unknown email links.
e.zh: 我对点击陌生邮件里的链接有些警惕。

e.en: Investors remain {leery} of the volatile crypto market.
e.zh: 投资者对动荡的加密市场仍心存疑虑。

leeward.t:
adj. 背风的
n. 背风面

e.en: The boat drifted toward the {leeward} shore overnight.
e.zh: 船在夜里漂向了背风的那一岸。

e.en: Build the shelter on the {leeward} side of the hill.
e.zh: 把避难所建在山的背风一侧。

e.en: My boss gives me plenty of {leeway} on deadlines.
e.zh: 我老板在截止日期上给我留了很大余地。

e.en: The contract leaves little {leeway} for negotiation.
e.zh: 这份合同没有什么协商的余地。

left.t:
adj. 左边的
v. leave 的过去式，离开

e.en: Turn {left} at the next traffic light.
e.zh: 在下一个红绿灯处左转。

e.en: Only two cookies were {left} in the jar.
e.zh: 罐子里只剩下两块饼干了。

e.en: Click the icon in the {left-hand} corner of the screen.
e.zh: 点击屏幕左上角的那个图标。

e.en: He writes with his {left-hand}, like his mother.
e.zh: 他和母亲一样用左手写字。

e.en: Her question came from totally {leftfield} during the interview.
e.zh: 她在面试时问了一个完全出人意料的问题。

e.en: The startup took a {leftfield} approach to online dating.
e.zh: 这家初创公司用了一种另类的方式做在线约会。

e.en: The newspaper has a slightly {leftish} editorial bias.
e.zh: 这家报纸的社论立场略偏左。

e.en: Most of his colleagues hold {leftish} political views.
e.zh: 他的大多数同事政治观点偏左。

e.en: His writings explored the rise of {leftism} in Europe.
e.zh: 他的著作探讨了欧洲左翼思潮的兴起。

e.en: The professor's lectures often defended modern {leftism}.
e.zh: 这位教授的讲座经常为现代左翼立场辩护。

leftist.t:
n. 左翼分子
adj. 左翼的

e.en: She joined a {leftist} student group at university.
e.zh: 她在大学加入了一个左翼学生社团。

e.en: The {leftist} candidate won the regional election easily.
e.zh: 那位左翼候选人轻松赢得了地区选举。

e.en: Click the {leftmost} tab to view your messages.
e.zh: 点击最左边那个标签页查看你的消息。

e.en: Park your bike in the {leftmost} slot today.
e.zh: 今天把你的自行车停在最左边那个位置。

leftover.t:
adj. 剩下的
n. 剩饭；剩余物

e.en: I packed the {leftover} pizza for tomorrow's lunch.
e.zh: 我把剩下的披萨打包,明天当午餐。

e.en: There's {leftover} paint in the garage from last summer.
e.zh: 车库里还有去年夏天剩下的油漆。

e.en: The boxer threw three quick {lefts} to the body.
e.zh: 那名拳手快速地朝身体打出了三记左拳。

e.en: Take two {lefts} and you'll see the cafe.
e.zh: 连续左转两次,你就能看到那家咖啡馆。

e.en: The party has drifted {leftward} over the past decade.
e.zh: 该党在过去十年间一直向左偏移。

e.en: Swipe {leftward} to delete a message in the app.
e.zh: 在应用里向左滑动就可以删除消息。

e.en: The arrow on the sign pointed {leftwards}.
e.zh: 路牌上的箭头指向左边。

e.en: Public opinion has shifted {leftwards} on healthcare reform.
e.zh: 民意在医保改革问题上已经向左转。

e.en: As a {lefty}, he struggled with right-handed scissors.
e.zh: 作为左撇子,他用右手剪刀很不方便。

e.en: The pitcher is a hard-throwing {lefty} from Texas.
e.zh: 那位投手是来自德州的强力左投。

leg.t: n. 腿；（桌椅的）支脚；赛段

e.en: She broke her {leg} skiing in the Alps.
e.zh: 她在阿尔卑斯山滑雪时摔断了腿。

e.en: The final {leg} of the journey was exhausting.
e.zh: 旅程的最后一段非常累人。

e.en: The two presidents left very different {legacies}.
e.zh: 这两位总统留下的政治遗产截然不同。

e.en: Old {legacies} of code still run in production.
e.zh: 线上还跑着一些遗留的旧代码。

legacy.t:
n. 遗产；遗留（系统）
adj. 旧版的；遗留的

e.en: Her {legacy} as a civil rights leader endures today.
e.zh: 她作为民权领袖的影响一直延续到今天。

e.en: We're slowly migrating away from the {legacy} system.
e.zh: 我们正在逐步迁移,摆脱那套老旧系统。

e.en: It's perfectly {legal} to record public conversations here.
e.zh: 在这里录制公开场合的对话是完全合法的。

e.en: Consult a {legal} expert before signing the contract.
e.zh: 签合同之前请咨询法律专家。

e.en: The terms of service are buried in dense {legalese}.
e.zh: 服务条款写满了晦涩难懂的法律行话。

e.en: She rewrote the contract in plain English, avoiding {legalese}.
e.zh: 她用通俗易懂的英语重写了合同,避开了法律术语。

e.en: Activists campaigned for the {legalisation} of medical cannabis.
e.zh: 活动人士为医用大麻合法化奔走呼吁。

e.en: Public support for {legalisation} has grown steadily.
e.zh: 公众对合法化的支持稳步上升。

legalise.t: v. 使合法化（英式拼写）

e.en: Several countries voted to {legalise} same-sex marriage.
e.zh: 多个国家投票通过了同性婚姻合法化。

e.en: Campaigners want to {legalise} certain therapeutic drugs.
e.zh: 活动人士希望让某些治疗用药物合法化。

legalised.t: v. 使合法化（过去式，英式）

e.en: Portugal {legalised} personal drug use back in 2001.
e.zh: 葡萄牙早在 2001 年就将个人吸毒合法化了。

e.en: The state {legalised} sports betting last year.
e.zh: 该州去年将体育博彩合法化。

legalism.t: n. 墨守法条；法家思想

e.en: His religion emphasized grace over rigid {legalism}.
e.zh: 他的宗教强调恩典,而不是僵化的律法主义。

e.en: Critics accused the judge of cold {legalism}.
e.zh: 批评者指责法官冷冰冰地拘泥于法条。

e.en: His {legalistic} arguments missed the moral point entirely.
e.zh: 他咬文嚼字的论证完全错失了道德层面的重点。

e.en: Avoid overly {legalistic} language in user agreements.
e.zh: 用户协议里要避免过于咬文嚼字的法律措辞。

e.en: Lawyers questioned the {legality} of the surveillance program.
e.zh: 律师们对该监控项目的合法性提出了质疑。

e.en: Check the {legality} of drones before flying abroad.
e.zh: 在国外飞无人机之前先确认其合法性。

e.en: Marijuana {legalization} has reshaped state economies.
e.zh: 大麻合法化重塑了多个州的经济结构。

e.en: They debated the {legalization} of online gambling.
e.zh: 他们就网络赌博合法化的问题展开了辩论。

legalize.t: v. 使合法化；法律上准许

e.en: Several states moved to {legalize} recreational marijuana.
e.zh: 多个州开始推动娱乐用大麻合法化。

e.en: Activists urged Congress to {legalize} same-sex adoption.
e.zh: 活动人士敦促国会将同性收养合法化。

legalized.t:
v. legalize 的过去式
adj. 已合法化的

e.en: Canada {legalized} cannabis nationwide in 2018.
e.zh: 加拿大在 2018 年于全国范围内将大麻合法化。

e.en: Once {legalized}, sports betting apps exploded in popularity.
e.zh: 体育博彩应用一旦合法化,人气立刻爆增。

e.en: You're {legally} required to wear a seatbelt here.
e.zh: 在这里你必须依法系安全带。

e.en: He's {legally} married, though they live apart.
e.zh: 虽然两人分居,但他在法律上仍是已婚。

e.en: The pope sent a {legate} to mediate the dispute.
e.zh: 教皇派出一位特使去调解这场争端。

e.en: A Roman {legate} commanded the northern legion.
e.zh: 一位罗马军团长指挥着北部军团。

e.en: The sole {legatee} inherited the entire estate.
e.zh: 唯一的受遗赠人继承了全部遗产。

e.en: Each named {legatee} received a sealed letter.
e.zh: 每位指定的受遗赠人都收到了一封密封的信。

e.en: The American {legation} in Beijing reopened after the war.
e.zh: 美国驻北京公使馆在战后重新开放。

e.en: Diplomats at the {legation} arranged the prisoner exchange.
e.zh: 公使馆的外交官们安排了这次换囚行动。

legato.t: adj./adv. (音乐) 连奏的；连贯演奏

e.en: The pianist played the melody in smooth {legato}.
e.zh: 钢琴家用流畅的连奏弹出了那段旋律。

e.en: Practice scales {legato} before adding articulation.
e.zh: 先用连奏练好音阶,再加入其他发音处理。

legend.t:
n. 传说；传奇人物
n. 图例（地图、图表）

e.en: Local {legend} says a dragon sleeps beneath the lake.
e.zh: 当地传说湖底沉睡着一条巨龙。

e.en: Serena Williams is a tennis {legend}.
e.zh: 塞雷娜·威廉姆斯是网坛传奇人物。

legendarily.t: adv. 传奇般地；举世闻名地

e.en: The chef is {legendarily} strict about ingredient quality.
e.zh: 这位厨师对食材质量出了名地严格。

e.en: He is {legendarily} bad at remembering names.
e.zh: 他记名字差得是出了名的。

legendary.t: adj. 传奇的；非常著名的

e.en: Michael Jordan had a {legendary} career in basketball.
e.zh: 迈克尔·乔丹在篮球界有着传奇般的职业生涯。

e.en: The cafe is {legendary} for its chocolate croissants.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆的巧克力可颂是出了名的好吃。

legends.t: n. 传奇（复数）；传奇人物们

e.en: Ancient {legends} say a dragon sleeps under the mountain.
e.zh: 古老的传说讲，山下沉睡着一条巨龙。

e.en: Map {legends} explain what each symbol means.
e.zh: 地图图例解释了每个符号的含义。

leger.t: n. 账簿（ledger 的旧拼法）

e.en: The note sits on a {leger} line above the staff.
e.zh: 那个音符位于五线谱上方的加线上。

e.en: High piano notes require many {leger} lines.
e.zh: 钢琴的高音需要画很多加线。

e.en: The magician's {legerdemain} amazed the entire audience.
e.zh: 魔术师的手法令全场观众惊叹不已。

e.en: Accounting {legerdemain} hid the company's real losses.
e.zh: 会计上的花招掩盖了公司真正的亏损。

legged.t: adj. 有…条腿的（常作构词后缀）

e.en: Spiders are eight-{legged} creatures, not insects.
e.zh: 蜘蛛是八条腿的生物，并不是昆虫。

e.en: She sat cross-{legged} on the yoga mat.
e.zh: 她盘腿坐在瑜伽垫上。

e.en: One {legging} of her tights had a small hole.
e.zh: 她紧身裤的一条裤腿上有个小洞。

e.en: The hiker wore a waterproof {legging} over each boot.
e.zh: 徒步者在每只靴子外套了防水护腿。

leggy.t: adj. 腿长的；双腿修长的

e.en: The {leggy} model walked confidently down the runway.
e.zh: 那位长腿模特自信地走过T台。

e.en: My tomato seedlings got {leggy} from too little light.
e.zh: 我的西红柿苗因光照不足而长得又细又长。

leghorn.t: n. 来航鸡（蛋鸡品种）；草编帽

e.en: The white {leghorn} hen lays eggs almost every day.
e.zh: 那只白来航鸡几乎每天都下蛋。

e.en: She wore a wide-brimmed {leghorn} hat to the garden party.
e.zh: 她戴着一顶宽边草帽去参加花园派对。

legibility.t: n. (字迹的) 清晰度；可读性

e.en: Choose a larger font to improve {legibility} on mobile.
e.zh: 选用更大字号可提升手机上的可读性。

e.en: His handwriting lacks {legibility} when he rushes.
e.zh: 他赶时间时写的字就很难辨认。

legible.t: adj. 字迹清楚的；易认的

e.en: Please write your name in {legible} block letters.
e.zh: 请用清晰的印刷体写下你的名字。

e.en: The faded receipt was barely {legible}.
e.zh: 那张褪色的收据几乎看不清了。

e.en: Sign the form {legibly} so we can read your name.
e.zh: 请清楚地签名，以便我们辨认。

e.en: He couldn't write {legibly} with his injured hand.
e.zh: 他受伤的手没法把字写清楚。

e.en: Her fans are {legion} on social media.
e.zh: 她在社交媒体上的粉丝多得数不清。

e.en: A Roman {legion} could include thousands of soldiers.
e.zh: 一支罗马军团可以包含数千名士兵。

legionary.t:
adj. 军团的
n. 军团士兵

e.en: Every Roman {legionary} carried a short sword called a gladius.
e.zh: 每名罗马军团士兵都配带一把名为短剑的兵器。

e.en: The museum displayed a {legionary} helmet from the first century.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一顶一世纪的军团士兵头盔。

legionnaire.t: n. 军团成员；退伍军人

e.en: The French Foreign {legionnaire} served five years in the desert.
e.zh: 那名法国外籍军团士兵在沙漠中服役了五年。

e.en: Each {legionnaire} swore loyalty to the unit, not the country.
e.zh: 每位军团士兵都宣誓效忠部队，而非国家。

legions.t: n. 军团（复数）；大量人群

e.en: The new game has attracted {legions} of devoted players.
e.zh: 这款新游戏吸引了大批忠实玩家。

e.en: Caesar marched his {legions} across the river at dawn.
e.zh: 凯撒在黎明时率领他的军团渡河。

e.en: Congress will {legislate} on climate change next session.
e.zh: 国会将在下个会期就气候变化立法。

e.en: You can't {legislate} good manners.
e.zh: 礼貌是没法用法律规定出来的。

legislated.t: v. legislate 的过去式，已立法

e.en: The state {legislated} a higher minimum wage last year.
e.zh: 该州去年立法提高了最低工资。

e.en: Mandatory seatbelt use was {legislated} decades ago.
e.zh: 强制系安全带几十年前就立法规定了。

legislates.t: v. legislate 的第三人称单数

e.en: Parliament {legislates} on behalf of all citizens.
e.zh: 议会代表全体公民进行立法。

e.en: The EU {legislates} common rules for member states.
e.zh: 欧盟为成员国制定共同的法规。

e.en: They are {legislating} stricter rules on online privacy.
e.zh: 他们正在为网络隐私制定更严格的法规。

e.en: {Legislating} morality rarely changes how people behave.
e.zh: 用法律强制道德很少能改变人们的行为。

legislation.t:
n. 法律；法规
n. 立法行为

e.en: New {legislation} will require labels on AI-generated images.
e.zh: 新法规将要求AI生成的图片必须标注。

e.en: The {legislation} passed with strong bipartisan support.
e.zh: 该法案在两党的强力支持下获得通过。

e.en: Different countries have different {legislations} on data protection.
e.zh: 不同国家在数据保护方面有不同的立法。

e.en: Recent {legislations} aim to curb monopolistic tech behavior.
e.zh: 近期的多项立法旨在遏制科技公司的垄断行为。

legislative.t: adj. 立法的；立法机关的

e.en: The {legislative} branch writes and passes federal laws.
e.zh: 立法部门负责起草和通过联邦法律。

e.en: She works as an aide in the {legislative} office.
e.zh: 她在立法机关办公室担任助理。

legislatively.t: adv. 在立法上；通过立法

e.en: The issue must be addressed {legislatively}, not by executive order.
e.zh: 这个问题必须通过立法解决，而非行政命令。

e.en: Same-sex marriage was recognized {legislatively} in several states.
e.zh: 同性婚姻在多个州通过立法获得了承认。

e.en: Each {legislator} represents about 700,000 constituents.
e.zh: 每位立法者代表约七十万名选民。

e.en: The veteran {legislator} announced her retirement after twenty years.
e.zh: 这位资深议员在任职二十年后宣布退休。

legislators.t: n. 立法者（复数）；议员们

e.en: State {legislators} debated the bill for over six hours.
e.zh: 州议员们就这项法案辩论了六个多小时。

e.en: Voters urged {legislators} to act on housing affordability.
e.zh: 选民敦促议员们就住房负担问题采取行动。

e.en: The state {legislature} convenes every January in the capital.
e.zh: 州议会每年一月在首府召开。

e.en: A bill must pass both chambers of the {legislature}.
e.zh: 法案必须在立法机关的两院都获得通过。

e.en: Several state {legislatures} are considering similar privacy bills.
e.zh: 多个州的立法机构都在审议类似的隐私法案。

e.en: Local {legislatures} often follow trends set by California.
e.zh: 地方立法机构常常跟随加州开创的趋势。

legit.t: adj. 正规的；靠谱的（legitimate 口语缩略）

e.en: Is this discount website {legit} or a scam?
e.zh: 这个折扣网站是真的还是骗人的？

e.en: That taco truck serves {legit} Mexican food.
e.zh: 那辆塔可餐车做的是地道的墨西哥菜。

e.en: The election results gave the new president {legitimacy}.
e.zh: 选举结果赋予了新总统执政的合法性。

e.en: Critics questioned the {legitimacy} of the company's claims.
e.zh: 批评者质疑该公司说法的可信度。

legitimate.t:
adj. 合法的；正当合理的
v. 使合法化

e.en: She has a {legitimate} reason for missing the meeting.
e.zh: 她没参加会议有正当理由。

e.en: Always check that the email comes from a {legitimate} address.
e.zh: 务必确认邮件来自合法的地址。

e.en: The startup {legitimately} earned its place in the market.
e.zh: 这家初创公司凭真本事在市场上立足。

e.en: You can {legitimately} claim a refund within thirty days.
e.zh: 你在三十天内可以合法地申请退款。

legitimating.t: v. legitimate 的现在分词，使合法化

e.en: The court ruling is {legitimating} same-sex unions nationwide.
e.zh: 法院的裁决正在使同性结合在全国范围内合法化。

e.en: Posting awards online helps in {legitimating} the brand.
e.zh: 在网上展示获奖有助于树立品牌的可信度。

e.en: The treaty served as {legitimation} for the new government.
e.zh: 这项条约为新政府提供了合法性依据。

e.en: Public approval is the ultimate {legitimation} of any policy.
e.zh: 公众认可是任何政策最根本的合法性来源。

legitimise.t: v. 使合法化（英式拼法）

e.en: The award helped {legitimise} indie filmmakers in mainstream cinema.
e.zh: 这个奖项帮助独立电影人在主流影坛获得了认可。

e.en: Critics fear the policy may {legitimise} discrimination.
e.zh: 批评者担心该政策可能让歧视行为合法化。

e.en: The summit marked the {legitimization} of cryptocurrency in finance.
e.zh: 这次峰会标志着加密货币在金融领域获得正式认可。

e.en: Public support provided {legitimization} for the protest movement.
e.zh: 公众的支持为这场抗议运动提供了正当性。

e.en: Wide media coverage helped {legitimize} remote work as standard practice.
e.zh: 广泛的媒体报道使远程办公成为公认的常态。

e.en: Don't {legitimize} bullies by responding to their taunts.
e.zh: 别理会霸凌者的挑衅，免得抬高他们的身价。

e.en: The pandemic {legitimized} working from home for many companies.
e.zh: 疫情让许多公司认可了在家办公的合理性。

e.en: His PhD {legitimized} the controversial research method.
e.zh: 他的博士学位让这种有争议的研究方法获得了认可。

e.en: Streaming services are {legitimizing} short-form documentaries as serious art.
e.zh: 流媒体平台正使短篇纪录片获得严肃艺术的地位。

e.en: Critics accused the interview of {legitimizing} extremist views.
e.zh: 批评者指责这次采访为极端观点提供了合理化的平台。

legless.t:
adj. 没有腿的
adj. (英口语) 烂醉的

e.en: A snake is essentially a {legless} reptile.
e.zh: 蛇本质上是一种没有腿的爬行动物。

e.en: After five pints, he was completely {legless}.
e.zh: 喝了五品脱后，他烂醉得站不住了。

e.en: My son built a spaceship out of {lego} bricks.
e.zh: 我儿子用乐高积木拼了一艘宇宙飞船。

e.en: Stepping on a {lego} piece is surprisingly painful.
e.zh: 踩到一块乐高积木真是疼得出奇。

e.en: Exit row seats offer the most {legroom} on the plane.
e.zh: 安全出口排的座位是飞机上腿部空间最大的。

e.en: This compact car has surprisingly good {legroom} in the back.
e.zh: 这辆紧凑型车后排的腿部空间出乎意料地宽敞。

e.en: My {legs} were sore after the long hike.
e.zh: 长途徒步之后我的腿酸得不行。

e.en: This story has {legs} and will dominate the news.
e.zh: 这则新闻有持续性，会主导接下来的报道。

e.en: The peanut is technically a {legume}, not a nut.
e.zh: 花生严格来说属于豆科植物，并不是坚果。

e.en: Lentils are a protein-rich {legume} used worldwide.
e.zh: 扁豆是一种富含蛋白质的豆类，全球都在食用。

e.en: {Leguminous} crops like beans help replenish soil nitrogen.
e.zh: 豆科作物如豆类有助于补充土壤中的氮元素。

e.en: Farmers rotate {leguminous} plants with grains for healthier fields.
e.zh: 农民将豆科植物与谷物轮作以保持土地肥力。

e.en: Our intern did the {legwork} for this research report.
e.zh: 我们的实习生为这份研究报告做了大量基础工作。

e.en: Buying a house involves a lot of {legwork}.
e.zh: 买房子需要做很多跑腿的事情。

lehua.t: n. 夏威夷莱花（ōhiʻa 树的红花）

e.en: Bright red {lehua} blossoms cover the ohia tree.
e.zh: 鲜红的莱花开满了俄西亚树。

e.en: Hawaiian legends say picking a {lehua} flower brings rain.
e.zh: 夏威夷传说称摘下莱花会引来下雨。

e.en: She greeted us at the airport with a flower {lei}.
e.zh: 她在机场用一串花环迎接我们。

e.en: Each guest received a fragrant {lei} of plumeria.
e.zh: 每位宾客都收到了一串芬芳的鸡蛋花花环。

leibnitz.t: n. 莱布尼茨（德国数学家）

e.en: {Leibnitz} developed calculus independently of Newton.
e.zh: 莱布尼茨独立于牛顿之外发展出了微积分。

e.en: The notation we use today comes largely from {Leibnitz}.
e.zh: 我们今天使用的符号大多源自莱布尼茨。

leibniz.t: n. 莱布尼茨（德国数学家）

e.en: {Leibniz} believed we live in the best of all possible worlds.
e.zh: 莱布尼茨认为我们生活在所有可能世界中最好的那一个。

e.en: Modern computing owes a debt to {Leibniz}'s binary system.
e.zh: 现代计算技术得益于莱布尼茨发明的二进制系统。

e.en: He grew up supporting {Leicester} City Football Club.
e.zh: 他从小就是莱斯特城足球俱乐部的球迷。

e.en: We took a train from London to {Leicester} yesterday.
e.zh: 我们昨天坐火车从伦敦去了莱斯特。

e.en: Her family farms a quiet village in {Leicestershire}.
e.zh: 她家在莱斯特郡一个安静的村子里务农。

e.en: {Leicestershire} is famous for its pork pies and cheese.
e.zh: 莱斯特郡以猪肉派和奶酪闻名。

e.en: She studied physics at {Leiden} University in the Netherlands.
e.zh: 她在荷兰莱顿大学学习物理。

e.en: The old canals of {Leiden} are beautiful in spring.
e.zh: 莱顿古老的运河在春天非常美丽。

leinster.t: n. 伦斯特（爱尔兰省份）

e.en: {Leinster} is the most populous province in Ireland.
e.zh: 伦斯特是爱尔兰人口最多的省份。

e.en: He plays rugby for the {Leinster} provincial team.
e.zh: 他为伦斯特省队效力打橄榄球。

e.en: Bach worked as a composer in {Leipzig} for decades.
e.zh: 巴赫在莱比锡担任作曲家长达数十年。

e.en: The {Leipzig} Book Fair attracts readers from across Europe.
e.zh: 莱比锡书展吸引了来自欧洲各地的读者。

e.en: Sand flies can transmit {leishmaniasis} to humans and dogs.
e.zh: 白蛉可以将利什曼病传染给人和狗。

e.en: Doctors diagnosed the traveler with cutaneous {leishmaniasis}.
e.zh: 医生诊断这位旅行者得了皮肤型利什曼病。

e.en: She reads novels in her {leisure} time.
e.zh: 她在闲暇时间读小说。

e.en: The hotel offers many {leisure} activities for guests.
e.zh: 这家酒店为客人提供许多休闲活动。

e.en: He came from a wealthy, {leisured} family in the countryside.
e.zh: 他出身于乡下一个富裕悠闲的家族。

e.en: The novel describes the {leisured} life of Victorian gentlemen.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了维多利亚时代绅士悠闲的生活。

e.en: I love the {leisureliness} of Sunday mornings at home.
e.zh: 我喜欢周日早晨在家的那种悠闲。

e.en: There was a charming {leisureliness} to their conversation.
e.zh: 他们的谈话有一种迷人的从容感。

leisurely.t: adj./adv. 悠闲的；从容不迫地

e.en: We took a {leisurely} walk along the river.
e.zh: 我们沿着河边悠闲地散了步。

e.en: She ate breakfast in a {leisurely} manner.
e.zh: 她不慌不忙地吃着早餐。

e.en: The brand sells comfortable {leisurewear} for working from home.
e.zh: 该品牌出售舒适的居家休闲服。

e.en: Soft fabrics make {leisurewear} perfect for weekends.
e.zh: 柔软的面料让休闲服非常适合周末穿。

e.en: {Leith} is the historic port district of Edinburgh.
e.zh: 利斯是爱丁堡历史悠久的港口区。

e.en: They opened a small cafe down in {Leith}.
e.zh: 他们在利斯开了一家小咖啡馆。

leitmotif.t: n. 主导动机；反复主题

e.en: Loneliness is a recurring {leitmotif} in his novels.
e.zh: 孤独是他小说中反复出现的主题。

e.en: The composer used a haunting {leitmotif} for the villain.
e.zh: 作曲家为反派设计了一段萦绕心头的主题旋律。

leitmotiv.t: n. 主导动机（leitmotif 的变体）

e.en: Memory serves as the central {leitmotiv} of the film.
e.zh: 记忆是这部影片的核心主题。

e.en: Wagner pioneered the operatic {leitmotiv} in the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 瓦格纳在十九世纪开创了歌剧主导动机的手法。

lek.t: n. 列克（阿尔巴尼亚货币）

e.en: I exchanged some euros for Albanian {lek} at the airport.
e.zh: 我在机场把一些欧元换成了阿尔巴尼亚列克。

e.en: Male grouse gather at a {lek} to attract mates.
e.zh: 雄性松鸡聚集在求偶场上吸引配偶。

e.en: In old poetry, a knight often pined for his {leman}.
e.zh: 在古老的诗篇中,骑士常常思念他的情人。

e.en: The medieval ballad mentions the king's secret {leman}.
e.zh: 这首中世纪民谣提到了国王的秘密情人。

e.en: The proof relies on a {lemma} from linear algebra.
e.zh: 该证明依赖于一个来自线性代数的引理。

e.en: Dictionaries list each {lemma} as a separate entry.
e.zh: 词典将每个词目作为单独的词条列出。

e.en: Investors followed the trend like a {lemming} off a cliff.
e.zh: 投资者像旅鼠跳崖一样盲目跟风。

e.en: A {lemming} can survive harsh Arctic winters underground.
e.zh: 旅鼠可以在地下熬过严酷的北极冬天。

lemon.t:
n. 柠檬
n. 次品（俚）

e.en: Squeeze a {lemon} over the grilled fish before serving.
e.zh: 上桌前在烤鱼上挤些柠檬汁。

e.en: That used car turned out to be a complete {lemon}.
e.zh: 那辆二手车结果是个彻头彻尾的次品。

e.en: The kids set up a {lemonade} stand on the corner.
e.zh: 孩子们在街角摆了个柠檬水摊。

e.en: Nothing beats cold {lemonade} on a hot summer day.
e.zh: 炎热夏日里没什么比冰镇柠檬水更棒了。

e.en: The cafe serves three different {lemonades} on its menu.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆菜单上有三种不同的柠檬水。

e.en: We ordered two pink {lemonades} and shared some fries.
e.zh: 我们点了两杯粉红柠檬水,分享了一份薯条。

e.en: Add fresh {lemongrass} to the soup for extra fragrance.
e.zh: 在汤里加些新鲜的香茅,增加香气。

e.en: Thai curries often use {lemongrass} as a key ingredient.
e.zh: 泰式咖喱常以香茅作为关键食材。

e.en: When life gives you {lemons}, make lemonade.
e.zh: 当生活给你柠檬时,就做成柠檬水吧。

e.en: I bought a bag of {lemons} at the farmers market.
e.zh: 我在农夫市场买了一袋柠檬。

lemony.t: adj. 柠檬味的；似柠檬的

e.en: The cake had a fresh, {lemony} flavor we loved.
e.zh: 这蛋糕有一股我们喜欢的清新柠檬味。

e.en: She prefers a light, {lemony} dressing on her salad.
e.zh: 她喜欢沙拉上淋一点清淡的柠檬味酱汁。

e.en: The {lemur} swung gracefully from branch to branch.
e.zh: 狐猴优雅地在树枝间荡来荡去。

e.en: Madagascar is the only place where the ring-tailed {lemur} lives.
e.zh: 马达加斯加是环尾狐猴唯一的栖息地。

len.t: n. 伦（男子名，Leonard 的昵称）

e.en: In Python, {len} returns the number of items in a list.
e.zh: 在 Python 中,len 返回列表中元素的数量。

e.en: My uncle {Len} runs a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 我叔叔莱恩在市中心经营一家小面包店。

e.en: Could you {lend} me twenty dollars until tomorrow?
e.zh: 你能借我二十块钱,明天再还吗?

e.en: Soft lighting can {lend} warmth to any room.
e.zh: 柔和的灯光能为任何房间增添温馨感。

e.en: The {lender} offered a low interest rate on the mortgage.
e.zh: 贷款方为这笔房贷提供了较低的利率。

e.en: Always read the contract carefully before signing with a {lender}.
e.zh: 在与放贷人签约前,务必仔细阅读合同。

lending.t:
n. 放贷；借出
v. lend 的现在分词

e.en: The bank tightened its {lending} rules after the crisis.
e.zh: 危机过后,这家银行收紧了贷款规定。

e.en: Thanks for {lending} me your umbrella this morning.
e.zh: 谢谢你今天早上把伞借给我。

lends.t: v. lend 的第三人称单数

e.en: The library {lends} ebooks to members for free.
e.zh: 图书馆免费向会员出借电子书。

e.en: Her calm voice {lends} authority to the broadcast.
e.zh: 她平静的嗓音为节目增添了权威感。

leprechaun.t: n. 爱尔兰传说中的小妖精

e.en: Irish folklore says a {leprechaun} guards a pot of gold.
e.zh: 爱尔兰民间传说里小妖精守护着一锅金子。

e.en: Her son dressed as a {leprechaun} for the parade.
e.zh: 她儿子打扮成小矮妖参加了游行。

e.en: Modern antibiotics can completely cure {leprosy} today.
e.zh: 现代抗生素如今可以彻底治愈麻风病。

e.en: Historians have studied the spread of {leprosy} in Europe.
e.zh: 历史学家研究过麻风病在欧洲的传播。

leprous.t: adj. 患麻风病的；麻风的

e.en: The old fresco showed a {leprous} beggar at the gate.
e.zh: 那幅古老的壁画描绘了门口一位长满疮的乞丐。

e.en: The bark of the dying tree looked dry and {leprous}.
e.zh: 那棵枯死的树皮看起来干裂且斑驳如疮。

leptin.t: n. 瘦素（一种调节食欲的激素）

e.en: {Leptin} signals to the brain when your body has enough fat.
e.zh: 瘦素会向大脑传递身体脂肪已足够的信号。

e.en: Sleep deprivation can lower {leptin} and increase hunger.
e.zh: 睡眠不足会降低瘦素水平，让人更容易感到饥饿。

e.en: An electron is the most familiar example of a {lepton}.
e.zh: 电子是最常见的轻子例子。

e.en: Physicists detected a rare {lepton} interaction in the data.
e.zh: 物理学家在数据中探测到一次罕见的轻子相互作用。

e.en: Dogs can catch {leptospirosis} from contaminated water.
e.zh: 狗可能因接触受污染的水而感染钩端螺旋体病。

e.en: Hikers were warned about {leptospirosis} after the floods.
e.zh: 洪水过后，徒步者被提醒注意钩端螺旋体病。

les.t:
n. 女同性恋（lesbian 的缩略）
n. 男子名 Les

e.en: My uncle {Les} runs a small fishing boat in Cornwall.
e.zh: 我叔叔莱斯在康沃尔经营一艘小渔船。

e.en: {Les} called to say he'd be late for the meeting.
e.zh: 莱斯打电话说他开会会迟到。

lesbian.t:
n. 女同性恋者
adj. 女同性恋的

e.en: She came out as {lesbian} to her family last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天向家人出柜，表明自己是同性恋。

e.en: The film tells a tender {lesbian} love story set in Paris.
e.zh: 这部电影讲述了一段发生在巴黎的温柔同性爱情故事。

lesbianism.t: n. 女同性恋（行为、倾向）

e.en: The novel openly explores themes of {lesbianism} and identity.
e.zh: 这本小说坦率地探讨了女同性恋与身份认同的主题。

e.en: Her essay traces how {lesbianism} was depicted in 1950s film.
e.zh: 她的文章追溯了女同性恋在五十年代电影中的呈现方式。

e.en: Calling someone a {lesbo} is widely seen as an offensive slur.
e.zh: 叫别人 lesbo 普遍被视为带有侮辱性的称呼。

e.en: She reclaimed the word {lesbo} as a defiant joke among friends.
e.zh: 她在朋友间把 lesbo 这个词当作反讽的玩笑来用。

e.en: The doctor examined a small skin {lesion} on his arm.
e.zh: 医生检查了他手臂上的一小块皮损。

e.en: An MRI revealed a {lesion} on the patient's brain.
e.zh: 核磁共振显示这位病人的大脑上有一处病灶。

e.en: {Lesotho} is a small mountainous country surrounded by South Africa.
e.zh: 莱索托是一个被南非环绕的山地小国。

e.en: We hiked through the highlands of {Lesotho} last spring.
e.zh: 我们去年春天在莱索托高原徒步旅行。

less.t:
adj./adv. 更少的；较少地
prep. 减去

e.en: I drink much {less} coffee since switching to tea.
e.zh: 自从改喝茶后，我咖啡喝得少多了。

e.en: This phone costs {less} than the older model.
e.zh: 这款手机比旧款的还便宜。

e.en: The {lessee} is responsible for repairs under this contract.
e.zh: 根据合同，承租人需负责维修事宜。

e.en: Each {lessee} must sign the agreement before moving in.
e.zh: 每位承租人入住前都必须签署租约。

e.en: Stretching can {lessen} muscle pain after a long run.
e.zh: 拉伸可以减轻长跑后的肌肉酸痛。

e.en: New policies aim to {lessen} the impact on small businesses.
e.zh: 新政策旨在减轻对小企业的冲击。

lessened.t: v. 减少（lessen 的过去式/过去分词）

e.en: The medication {lessened} her headache within an hour.
e.zh: 那种药一小时内就减轻了她的头痛。

e.en: Fears about the storm {lessened} once it changed course.
e.zh: 风暴改道后，人们对它的担忧减轻了。

lessening.t:
v. 减少中（lessen 的现在分词）
n. 减轻

e.en: Doctors noticed a {lessening} of symptoms after treatment.
e.zh: 医生注意到治疗后症状有所减轻。

e.en: Tensions are slowly {lessening} between the two countries.
e.zh: 两国之间的紧张关系正在慢慢缓和。

lessens.t: v. 减少（lessen 的第三人称单数）

e.en: Regular exercise {lessens} your risk of heart disease.
e.zh: 经常锻炼能降低你患心脏病的风险。

e.en: A good night's sleep {lessens} stress more than caffeine.
e.zh: 一夜好眠比咖啡因更能缓解压力。

e.en: We chose the {lesser} of two evils in that election.
e.zh: 那场选举中我们选择了两害相权取其轻。

e.en: This artist is talented but a {lesser} known name in Asia.
e.zh: 这位艺术家很有才华，但在亚洲名气稍小。

e.en: My piano {lesson} starts at four every Tuesday afternoon.
e.zh: 我每周二下午四点开始上钢琴课。

e.en: That mistake taught me a valuable {lesson} about trust.
e.zh: 那次错误让我学到了关于信任的宝贵一课。

e.en: She takes online cooking {lessons} every Sunday morning.
e.zh: 她每周日早上上在线烹饪课。

e.en: The pandemic taught us important {lessons} about preparation.
e.zh: 这场疫情给我们上了关于准备工作的重要一课。

e.en: The {lessor} agreed to repaint the apartment before move-in.
e.zh: 出租人同意在入住前把公寓重新粉刷一遍。

e.en: Tenants must give the {lessor} thirty days written notice.
e.zh: 租户必须提前三十天书面通知出租人。

e.en: Speak softly {lest} you wake the sleeping baby.
e.zh: 说话小声点，免得吵醒熟睡的宝宝。

e.en: Save your work often {lest} the laptop battery die.
e.zh: 经常保存你的工作，以免笔记本没电。

e.en: Please {let} me know when the package finally arrives.
e.zh: 包裹到了请告诉我一声。

e.en: My parents won't {let} me stay out past midnight.
e.zh: 我父母不让我在外面待到午夜以后。

letchworth.t: n. 莱奇沃思（英国城镇）

e.en: {Letchworth} was the world's first planned garden city.
e.zh: 莱奇沃思是世界上第一座规划建成的花园城市。

e.en: We took the train to {Letchworth} for a quiet weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去莱奇沃思度过了安静的周末。

letdown.t: n. 失望；令人扫兴的事

e.en: The movie's ending was a huge {letdown} for fans.
e.zh: 这部电影的结局让粉丝们大失所望。

e.en: After all that hype, the new phone felt like a {letdown}.
e.zh: 经过那么多宣传，这款新手机让人感到失望。

e.en: Even a small dose of this drug can be {lethal}.
e.zh: 哪怕是一小剂量的这种药都可能致命。

e.en: The striker delivered a {lethal} pass in the final minute.
e.zh: 那名前锋在最后一分钟送出了一记致命传球。

e.en: Scientists are studying the virus's {lethality} in older patients.
e.zh: 科学家正在研究这种病毒对老年患者的致死率。

e.en: The new missile's {lethality} concerns many defense analysts.
e.zh: 这款新导弹的杀伤力令许多国防分析师担忧。

e.en: The snake's bite is {lethally} fast without quick treatment.
e.zh: 如果不及时治疗，这种蛇的咬伤会致命地迅速发作。

e.en: The chemical proved {lethally} toxic even at low doses.
e.zh: 这种化学物质即使低剂量也具有致命的毒性。

lethargic.t: adj. 昏昏欲睡的；无精打采的

e.en: I felt {lethargic} all afternoon after the heavy lunch.
e.zh: 那顿丰盛的午餐后，我整个下午都昏昏欲睡。

e.en: The {lethargic} economy worried investors and policymakers alike.
e.zh: 低迷的经济让投资者和政策制定者都感到担忧。

lethargically.t: adv. 无精打采地；懒洋洋地

e.en: He waved {lethargically} from the couch without looking up.
e.zh: 他懒洋洋地从沙发上挥了挥手，头都没抬。

e.en: The cat stretched {lethargically} in the warm sunlight.
e.zh: 那只猫在温暖的阳光下懒懒地伸了个懒腰。

lethargies.t: n. 倦怠；嗜睡（lethargy 的复数）

e.en: Different {lethargies} can signal different underlying health issues.
e.zh: 不同类型的倦怠可能预示着不同的潜在健康问题。

e.en: The novel explored the quiet {lethargies} of suburban life.
e.zh: 这部小说描写了郊区生活中那种安静的倦怠感。

e.en: Persistent {lethargy} can be a symptom of low iron.
e.zh: 持续的疲倦可能是缺铁的症状。

e.en: A short walk helped shake off the morning {lethargy}.
e.zh: 散个短步帮我赶走了早晨的倦意。

lets.t: v. 让（let 的第三人称单数）；出租

e.en: My boss {lets} me work from home on Fridays.
e.zh: 我老板允许我每周五在家办公。

e.en: This app {lets} you edit photos with one tap.
e.zh: 这款应用让你一键就能编辑照片。

e.en: My grandfather was a {Lett} who emigrated from Riga.
e.zh: 我祖父是一位从里加移民来的拉脱维亚人。

e.en: The old census listed him simply as a {Lett}.
e.zh: 旧的人口普查只把他登记为拉脱维亚人。

e.en: She wrote a heartfelt {letter} to her grandmother.
e.zh: 她给奶奶写了一封情真意切的信。

e.en: The first {letter} of his name is silent.
e.zh: 他名字的第一个字母不发音。

letterbox.t:
n. 信箱
n. 宽银幕显示格式

e.en: The postman dropped the parcel into our {letterbox}.
e.zh: 邮递员把包裹投进了我们的信箱。

e.en: Old films often appear in {letterbox} format on TV.
e.zh: 老电影在电视上常以宽银幕黑边的形式播放。

lettered.t: adj. 印有字母的；有学问的

e.en: The shop window was beautifully {lettered} by hand.
e.zh: 店铺橱窗上的字是手工精心写就的。

e.en: He came from a {lettered} family of scholars.
e.zh: 他出身于一个学识渊博的学者世家。

letterhead.t: n. 信头；印有信头的信纸

e.en: Please print the contract on company {letterhead}.
e.zh: 请把合同打印在公司专用信纸上。

e.en: The law firm's {letterhead} listed all senior partners.
e.zh: 那家律所的信头列出了所有高级合伙人。

e.en: The shop sign featured elegant gold {lettering}.
e.zh: 店铺招牌上有精美的金色字体。

e.en: She studies hand {lettering} as a creative hobby.
e.zh: 她把手写艺术字当作一项创意爱好来学。

letterman.t:
n. 获校名字母标志的运动员
n. 姓氏 Letterman

e.en: He proudly wore his high school {letterman} jacket.
e.zh: 他自豪地穿着自己的高中校队夹克。

e.en: Every {letterman} on the team trained six days a week.
e.zh: 队里每位获奖运动员都每周训练六天。

e.en: She prints wedding invitations on a vintage {letterpress}.
e.zh: 她用一台老式凸版印刷机印制婚礼请柬。

e.en: The book's {letterpress} edition sold out within hours.
e.zh: 这本书的凸版印刷版几小时内就售罄了。

e.en: The character {Leng} appears in classical Chinese literature.
e.zh: "冷"这个字常见于中国古典文学中。

e.en: Professor {Leng} delivered the keynote speech yesterday.
e.zh: 冷教授昨天发表了主旨演讲。

e.en: Please measure the {length} of the table in centimeters.
e.zh: 请用厘米测量桌子的长度。

e.en: She went to great {length} to finish the project on time.
e.zh: 她费尽心力按时完成了这个项目。

e.en: The tailor will {lengthen} these trousers for free.
e.zh: 裁缝会免费帮我把这条裤子加长。

e.en: Days slowly {lengthen} as spring approaches.
e.zh: 随着春天临近,白天慢慢变长。

lengthened.t:
v. 加长（过去式）
adj. 延长的

e.en: The meeting was {lengthened} by an extra hour.
e.zh: 会议又延长了一个小时。

e.en: Shadows {lengthened} as the sun dipped below the trees.
e.zh: 太阳沉到树后,影子也越拉越长。

lengthening.t:
v. 延长（进行时）
n. 加长过程

e.en: The {lengthening} queue annoyed customers waiting for service.
e.zh: 越来越长的队伍让等候的顾客很不耐烦。

e.en: Doctors recommend {lengthening} your stretches gradually over time.
e.zh: 医生建议随时间逐渐延长拉伸的时间。

lengthens.t: v. 加长（第三人称单数）

e.en: Daylight {lengthens} noticeably after the spring equinox.
e.zh: 春分过后,白昼明显变长。

e.en: Each new chapter {lengthens} the manuscript considerably.
e.zh: 每加一章,稿件都明显变长不少。

e.en: He went to extreme {lengths} to win her trust.
e.zh: 他不惜一切代价去赢得她的信任。

e.en: The store sells curtains in three standard {lengths}.
e.zh: 这家店出售三种标准长度的窗帘。

e.en: Slice the cucumber {lengthways} into thin strips.
e.zh: 把黄瓜纵向切成细条。

e.en: Fold the paper {lengthways} before making the first cut.
e.zh: 先把纸纵向对折,然后再剪第一刀。

lengthwise.t:
adv. 纵向地
adj. 纵向的

e.en: Cut the baguette {lengthwise} to make sandwiches.
e.zh: 把法棍纵向切开做三明治。

e.en: Lay the fabric {lengthwise} across the cutting table.
e.zh: 把布料纵向铺在裁剪台上。

e.en: The CEO gave a {lengthy} speech about future strategy.
e.zh: 首席执行官就未来战略发表了冗长的讲话。

e.en: After {lengthy} negotiations, both sides reached an agreement.
e.zh: 经过长时间的谈判,双方达成了协议。

e.en: The lawyer asked the judge for {leniency} in sentencing.
e.zh: 律师请求法官在量刑时从宽处理。

e.en: His honesty earned him some {leniency} from the principal.
e.zh: 他的坦诚让校长对他从轻处理。

e.en: Their parents are surprisingly {lenient} about screen time.
e.zh: 他们的父母对屏幕使用时间出人意料地宽松。

e.en: The judge was {lenient} given his clean record.
e.zh: 鉴于他没有前科,法官从轻发落。

e.en: First-time offenders are often treated {leniently} by the courts.
e.zh: 初犯者通常会受到法庭从宽处理。

e.en: The teacher graded the essays {leniently} this semester.
e.zh: 这学期老师批改作文打分相当宽松。

e.en: {Lenin} led the Bolsheviks to power in 1917.
e.zh: 列宁在1917年带领布尔什维克夺取了政权。

e.en: A statue of {Lenin} once stood in the city square.
e.zh: 市中心广场上曾经矗立着一座列宁雕像。

e.en: The siege of {Leningrad} lasted nearly nine hundred days.
e.zh: 列宁格勒围城战持续了将近九百天。

e.en: My grandmother was born in {Leningrad} before the war.
e.zh: 我奶奶在战前出生于列宁格勒。

e.en: He wrote a thesis comparing Marxism and {Leninism}.
e.zh: 他写了一篇比较马克思主义和列宁主义的论文。

e.en: {Leninism} stresses the role of a vanguard party.
e.zh: 列宁主义强调先锋党的作用。

leninist.t:
n. 列宁主义者
adj. 列宁主义的

e.en: The party adopted a {Leninist} model of organization.
e.zh: 该党采用了列宁主义的组织模式。

e.en: She studied {Leninist} theory at university last year.
e.zh: 她去年在大学里学习了列宁主义理论。

e.en: John {Lennon} co-wrote many of the Beatles' biggest hits.
e.zh: 约翰·列侬合作创作了披头士的许多热门金曲。

e.en: Fans still gather to remember {Lennon} every December.
e.zh: 每年十二月歌迷仍会聚集起来纪念列侬。

e.en: {Lennox} Lewis is one of boxing's greatest heavyweights.
e.zh: 伦诺克斯·刘易斯是拳击史上最伟大的重量级选手之一。

e.en: They named their newborn son {Lennox} after his grandfather.
e.zh: 他们给新生儿取名伦诺克斯,以纪念他的祖父。

e.en: He cleaned the camera {lens} with a soft cloth.
e.zh: 他用软布擦拭了相机镜头。

e.en: We should view this issue through an economic {lens}.
e.zh: 我们应该从经济视角来看待这个问题。

e.en: He cleaned the camera {lense} before taking the photo.
e.zh: 他在拍照前擦了擦相机镜头。

e.en: The optician replaced the cracked {lense} in her glasses.
e.zh: 配镜师更换了她眼镜上裂掉的镜片。

lensing.t: n. 透镜效应；引力透镜

e.en: Gravitational {lensing} bends light around massive galaxies.
e.zh: 引力透镜效应使光线绕过巨大星系发生弯曲。

e.en: The film keeps {lensing} every event through a child's eyes.
e.zh: 这部电影始终透过孩子的视角呈现每件事。

e.en: The veteran {lensman} captured the war's most iconic photo.
e.zh: 那位资深摄影师拍下了那场战争最具代表性的照片。

e.en: Every red carpet event needs a skilled {lensman}.
e.zh: 每场红毯活动都需要一位技艺娴熟的摄影师。

lent.t:
v. 借出（lend 的过去式）
n. 四旬斋

e.en: My friend {lent} me her charger during the flight.
e.zh: 我朋友在飞行途中借给我她的充电器。

e.en: The bank {lent} him money to start a small bakery.
e.zh: 银行借给他钱开了一家小面包店。

e.en: She gave up chocolate for her {Lenten} fast this year.
e.zh: 她今年四旬期斋戒期间戒了巧克力。

e.en: The church holds quiet {Lenten} services every Friday.
e.zh: 教堂每周五都举行安静的四旬期礼拜。

e.en: The card has a {lenticular} image that shifts as you tilt it.
e.zh: 这张卡片有一幅倾斜时会变化的光栅图像。

e.en: Strange {lenticular} clouds hovered above the mountain peak.
e.zh: 奇特的荚状云悬浮在山峰上空。

e.en: I made a warm {lentil} soup for dinner last night.
e.zh: 我昨晚晚餐做了一锅温暖的扁豆汤。

e.en: Add one cup of red {lentil} to the boiling broth.
e.zh: 在沸腾的高汤里加入一杯红扁豆。

e.en: Rinse the {lentils} thoroughly before cooking them.
e.zh: 煮之前把扁豆彻底冲洗干净。

e.en: {Lentils} are packed with protein and cheap to buy.
e.zh: 扁豆富含蛋白质，而且价格便宜。

e.en: My sister is a {Leo} and loves being the center of attention.
e.zh: 我妹妹是狮子座，特别喜欢成为众人焦点。

e.en: The bright star Regulus sits in the constellation {Leo}.
e.zh: 明亮的轩辕十四位于狮子座中。

e.en: We stopped in {Leominster} for lunch on our drive north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中在莱明斯特停下吃了午饭。

e.en: {Leominster} is a small town known for its medieval church.
e.zh: 莱明斯特是一座以中世纪教堂闻名的小镇。

e.en: My cousin {Leon} just moved to Berlin for work.
e.zh: 我表弟莱昂刚刚为了工作搬到柏林。

e.en: {Leon} won the chess tournament three years in a row.
e.zh: 莱昂连续三年赢得了国际象棋比赛冠军。

e.en: {Leonardo} da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa over many years.
e.zh: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇花了多年才画出蒙娜丽莎。

e.en: My nephew named his hamster {Leonardo} after the artist.
e.zh: 我侄子以那位艺术家的名字给仓鼠取名列奥纳多。

leone.t: n. 利昂内（人名/塞拉利昂货币）

e.en: Sergio {Leone} directed many classic spaghetti westerns.
e.zh: 塞尔吉奥·莱昂内执导了许多经典的意式西部片。

e.en: The currency of Sierra {Leone} is also called the leone.
e.zh: 塞拉利昂的货币也被称为利昂。

leonid.t: n. 列昂尼德（人名）；狮子座流星

e.en: We watched the {Leonid} meteor shower from the rooftop.
e.zh: 我们在屋顶上观看了狮子座流星雨。

e.en: The {Leonid} shower peaks every November in clear skies.
e.zh: 狮子座流星雨每年十一月在晴朗夜空达到极盛。

e.en: The actor had a thick mane of {leonine} silver hair.
e.zh: 那位演员留着一头浓密如雄狮般的银发。

e.en: His {leonine} roar of laughter filled the entire room.
e.zh: 他狮吼般的笑声充满了整个房间。

e.en: A {leopard} silently stalked its prey through the grass.
e.zh: 一只豹子悄无声息地穿过草丛追踪猎物。

e.en: She wore a {leopard} print coat to the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她穿了一件豹纹外套去画廊开幕式。

e.en: Snow {leopards} are rarely seen in the high Himalayas.
e.zh: 雪豹在喜马拉雅高海拔地区难得一见。

e.en: Conservation efforts have helped {leopards} recover slowly.
e.zh: 保护工作帮助豹子的种群慢慢恢复。

leotard.t: n. 紧身连衣裤；体操服

e.en: The dancer wore a black {leotard} for the audition.
e.zh: 那位舞者穿着黑色紧身连衣裤参加试镜。

e.en: My daughter picked a sparkly pink {leotard} for class.
e.zh: 我女儿挑了一件亮闪闪的粉色紧身衣去上课。

e.en: Birders sometimes use {lep} as shorthand for a butterfly.
e.zh: 观鸟者有时用 lep 作为蝴蝶的简称。

e.en: He took a quick {lep} over the puddle and kept walking.
e.zh: 他快速跳过水坑，继续往前走。

leper.t: n. 麻风病人；被排斥者

e.en: After the scandal, he felt like a social {leper}.
e.zh: 丑闻之后，他觉得自己像被社交圈孤立的麻风病人。

e.en: Medieval villages often isolated every {leper} outside town.
e.zh: 中世纪的村庄常把麻风病人隔离在镇外。

lepidopterist.t: n. 鳞翅目昆虫研究者

e.en: The {lepidopterist} carefully pinned a rare moth to the board.
e.zh: 那位鳞翅目学家小心地把一只稀有飞蛾别在板上。

e.en: As a child, he dreamed of becoming a {lepidopterist}.
e.zh: 他小时候梦想成为一名研究蝴蝶的学者。

letters.t: n. 信件；字母（letter 的复数）

e.en: Grandma kept all his old love {letters} in a box.
e.zh: 奶奶把他所有的旧情书都收在一个盒子里。

e.en: Children learn the {letters} of the alphabet through songs.
e.zh: 孩子们通过歌曲学习字母表里的字母。

letting.t:
v. 让；出租（let 的现在分词）
n. 出租

e.en: Thanks for {letting} me borrow your charger yesterday.
e.zh: 谢谢你昨天让我借用你的充电器。

e.en: They are {letting} the apartment for six months.
e.zh: 他们将这套公寓出租六个月。

e.en: I added crisp {lettuce} and tomatoes to the sandwich.
e.zh: 我在三明治里加了脆生菜和番茄。

e.en: Fresh {lettuce} grows quickly in our backyard garden.
e.zh: 新鲜生菜在我们的后院菜园里长得很快。

e.en: The market sells several varieties of crisp {lettuces}.
e.zh: 市场上出售好几种脆生菜。

e.en: Slugs had eaten through half the young {lettuces}.
e.zh: 鼻涕虫把一半幼嫩的生菜都啃光了。

leuchars.t: n. 卢卡斯（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The train stopped briefly at {Leuchars} station near St Andrews.
e.zh: 火车在圣安德鲁斯附近的卢卡斯车站短暂停靠。

e.en: He was stationed at the {Leuchars} airbase for two years.
e.zh: 他在卢卡斯空军基地驻扎了两年。

leucine.t: n. 亮氨酸（一种氨基酸）

e.en: {Leucine} is an essential amino acid found in meat and eggs.
e.zh: 亮氨酸是一种存在于肉类和鸡蛋中的必需氨基酸。

e.en: Athletes often supplement with {leucine} to support muscle growth.
e.zh: 运动员经常补充亮氨酸以促进肌肉生长。

e.en: A high {leucocyte} count may indicate an active infection.
e.zh: 白细胞计数偏高可能提示存在活动性感染。

e.en: Each {leucocyte} plays a specific role in the immune system.
e.zh: 每种白细胞在免疫系统中都扮演着特定角色。

e.en: She was diagnosed with {leukaemia} at age twelve.
e.zh: 她在十二岁时被诊断出患有白血病。

e.en: Modern treatments have greatly improved {leukaemia} survival rates.
e.zh: 现代治疗手段大大提高了白血病的存活率。

e.en: Childhood {leukemia} often responds well to early treatment.
e.zh: 儿童白血病往往对早期治疗反应良好。

e.en: She runs marathons to raise money for {leukemia} research.
e.zh: 她跑马拉松为白血病研究筹款。

leukemic.t:
adj. 白血病的
n. 白血病患者

e.en: The doctor explained how {leukemic} cells crowd out healthy ones.
e.zh: 医生解释了白血病细胞如何挤占了健康细胞的空间。

e.en: Most {leukemic} patients in the trial entered remission.
e.zh: 试验中大多数白血病患者都进入了缓解期。

e.en: Doctors check {leukocyte} levels to assess immune function.
e.zh: 医生通过检测白细胞水平来评估免疫功能。

e.en: Each {leukocyte} can recognize specific types of pathogens.
e.zh: 每个白细胞都能识别特定类型的病原体。

e.en: The blood test revealed mild {leukocytosis} from the infection.
e.zh: 血液检查显示因感染引起轻度白细胞增多。

e.en: {Leukocytosis} often resolves once the underlying cause is treated.
e.zh: 一旦根本病因得到治疗，白细胞增多症往往会消退。

leukotriene.t: n. 白三烯（一类炎症介质）

e.en: Asthma medications often block {leukotriene} receptors in the lungs.
e.zh: 哮喘药物常会阻断肺部的白三烯受体。

e.en: High {leukotriene} levels can trigger severe allergic reactions.
e.zh: 高水平的白三烯可能引发严重的过敏反应。

lev.t: n. 列弗（保加利亚货币单位）

e.en: I exchanged dollars for Bulgarian {lev} at the airport.
e.zh: 我在机场把美元换成了保加利亚列弗。

e.en: One {lev} is divided into one hundred stotinki.
e.zh: 一列弗等于一百斯托廷基。

levant.t: n. 黎凡特（地中海东部地区）

e.en: Spices from the {Levant} reached Europe through Venice.
e.zh: 来自地中海东部地区的香料经威尼斯传入欧洲。

e.en: The museum's exhibit focuses on ancient pottery from the {Levant}.
e.zh: 博物馆的展览聚焦于黎凡特地区的古代陶器。

levantine.t:
adj. 黎凡特的
n. 黎凡特人

e.en: The restaurant serves authentic {Levantine} cuisine like hummus and falafel.
e.zh: 这家餐厅供应正宗的黎凡特菜，如鹰嘴豆泥和炸豆丸子。

e.en: She studies {Levantine} dialects of Arabic at university.
e.zh: 她在大学里研究阿拉伯语的黎凡特方言。

e.en: The {levator} muscle lifts the upper eyelid when you blink.
e.zh: 提肌负责在眨眼时抬起上眼睑。

e.en: Surgeons must avoid damaging the {levator} during the procedure.
e.zh: 外科医生在手术过程中必须避免损伤提肌。

e.en: The {levee} broke during the hurricane, flooding nearby homes.
e.zh: 飓风期间堤坝决口，淹没了附近的房屋。

e.en: Engineers reinforced the {levee} before the rainy season.
e.zh: 工程师们在雨季来临前加固了堤坝。

level.t:
n. 级别，水平
adj. 水平的；同等的

e.en: The water {level} in the reservoir keeps dropping.
e.zh: 水库的水位还在持续下降。

e.en: She reached the next {level} in the game last night.
e.zh: 她昨晚在游戏里通到了下一关。

leveled.t: v. 夷平；使平等（level 的过去式）

e.en: The bulldozer {leveled} the old warehouse in minutes.
e.zh: 推土机几分钟内就把旧仓库夷为平地。

e.en: She {leveled} her character to the maximum cap.
e.zh: 她把角色练到了最高等级上限。

leveler.t: n. 平整器；使平等的人或物

e.en: Travel can be a great social {leveler} among strangers.
e.zh: 旅行能在陌生人之间起到很好的拉平作用。

e.en: The carpenter used a laser {leveler} to align the shelves.
e.zh: 木匠用激光水平仪来校准架子。

levelheaded.t: adj. 冷静的，头脑清醒的

e.en: We need a {levelheaded} leader during this crisis.
e.zh: 在这场危机中我们需要一位头脑冷静的领导者。

e.en: She stayed {levelheaded} even when everyone else panicked.
e.zh: 即便其他人都慌了，她仍保持着冷静的头脑。

leveling.t: v. 使平；夷平（level 的现在分词）

e.en: They spent the weekend {leveling} the ground for a patio.
e.zh: 他们花了整个周末把地面整平好铺露台。

e.en: {Leveling} up in this game requires hours of grinding.
e.zh: 在这款游戏里升级需要花上数小时刷怪。

levelled.t: v. 夷平（英式拼写，过去式）

e.en: The earthquake {levelled} several buildings in the old town.
e.zh: 地震把老城区好几栋楼夷为平地。

e.en: She {levelled} accusations of fraud against the company.
e.zh: 她对该公司提出了欺诈的指控。

leveller.t: n. 平整器；主张平等者

e.en: Public transport is a great social {leveller} in big cities.
e.zh: 公共交通在大城市里是很好的社会平等器。

e.en: He used a spirit {leveller} to hang the picture straight.
e.zh: 他用水平仪把那幅画挂得笔直。

levelling.t: v. 使平；测平（英式拼写）

e.en: The government promised a {levelling} up of regional inequalities.
e.zh: 政府承诺要缩小地区间的发展差距。

e.en: {Levelling} the floor took longer than we expected.
e.zh: 找平地面花的时间比我们预想的要长。

e.en: She looked at him {levelly} and refused to back down.
e.zh: 她平静地直视着他，毫不退让。

e.en: He spoke {levelly}, hiding any trace of anger.
e.zh: 他语气平稳地说着，丝毫不露怒色。

levels.t:
n. 级别（复数）
v. 使平

e.en: Sugar {levels} in his blood returned to normal after exercise.
e.zh: 他运动后血糖水平恢复了正常。

e.en: The game has over a hundred challenging {levels}.
e.zh: 这款游戏有超过一百个富有挑战性的关卡。

e.en: We hiked along the shores of Loch {Leven} all morning.
e.zh: 我们整个上午都沿着利文湖岸徒步。

e.en: The town of {Leven} sits on the Fife coast.
e.zh: 利文镇坐落在法夫海岸。

lever.t:
n. 杠杆；控制杆
v. 撬动

e.en: Pull the red {lever} to start the machine.
e.zh: 拉下红色的操纵杆就可以启动机器。

e.en: Tax breaks are a powerful {lever} for shaping behavior.
e.zh: 税收优惠是塑造行为的强有力杠杆。

leverage.t:
n. 杠杆作用；影响力
v. 利用

e.en: Small startups can {leverage} social media for free marketing.
e.zh: 小型创业公司可以利用社交媒体进行免费营销。

e.en: The union used its {leverage} to negotiate higher wages.
e.zh: 工会利用自身的影响力争取到了更高的工资。

leveraged.t:
adj. 杠杆化的（金融）
v. 利用

e.en: She {leveraged} her network to land the new job.
e.zh: 她借助自己的人脉拿下了这份新工作。

e.en: The fund made highly {leveraged} bets on tech stocks.
e.zh: 该基金对科技股进行了高杠杆押注。

leveraging.t: v. 利用，借助（leverage 的现在分词）

e.en: The startup is {leveraging} AI to automate customer support.
e.zh: 这家创业公司正利用人工智能来自动化客户服务。

e.en: He's {leveraging} his experience abroad to negotiate better terms.
e.zh: 他正利用海外经验争取到更好的合同条款。

e.en: He wore a faded pair of {Levi} jeans to the concert.
e.zh: 他穿着一条褪色的李维斯牛仔裤去看演唱会。

e.en: In the Bible, {Levi} was one of Jacob's twelve sons.
e.zh: 在圣经中，利未是雅各十二个儿子之一。

e.en: The tech company has grown into a corporate {leviathan}.
e.zh: 这家科技公司已发展成为一个企业巨擘。

e.en: Critics describe the new agency as a bureaucratic {leviathan}.
e.zh: 批评者把这个新机构形容为官僚巨兽。

e.en: The magician appeared to {levitate} a foot off the stage.
e.zh: 魔术师看似在舞台上腾空浮起了一英尺。

e.en: Strong magnets can {levitate} small objects in midair.
e.zh: 强磁体能让小物体悬浮在半空中。

levitating.t: v. 悬浮（levitate 的现在分词）

e.en: The yogi looked as if he were {levitating} on the mat.
e.zh: 那位瑜伽师看上去仿佛悬浮在垫子上。

e.en: Maglev trains travel by {levitating} above magnetic tracks.
e.zh: 磁悬浮列车通过悬浮在磁轨上方来行驶。

e.en: The magician performed a stunning act of {levitation} on stage.
e.zh: 魔术师在台上表演了一场惊艳的悬浮术。

e.en: Maglev trains use magnetic {levitation} to glide above the tracks.
e.zh: 磁悬浮列车利用磁力悬浮在轨道上方滑行。

e.en: The pastor read a passage from {Leviticus} during the sermon.
e.zh: 牧师在布道中朗读了《利未记》中的一段经文。

e.en: {Leviticus} contains many laws given to the ancient Israelites.
e.zh: 《利未记》记载了许多古以色列人遵守的律法。

e.en: A bit of {levity} helped lighten the tense meeting.
e.zh: 一点轻松的玩笑缓和了紧张的会议气氛。

e.en: The judge frowned at any {levity} in the courtroom.
e.zh: 法官对法庭上任何轻浮举止都皱眉以对。

levy.t:
v. 征收（税款）
n. 税款；征收

e.en: The government plans to {levy} a new tax on sugary drinks.
e.zh: 政府计划对含糖饮料征收一项新税。

e.en: Farmers protested the {levy} imposed on imported grain.
e.zh: 农民们抗议对进口谷物征收的关税。

levying.t: v. 征收（levy 的现在分词）

e.en: The city is {levying} fines on illegal parking near schools.
e.zh: 该市正在对学校附近的违章停车处以罚款。

e.en: Congress debated {levying} tariffs on foreign electric vehicles.
e.zh: 国会辩论是否对外国电动汽车征收关税。

e.en: He was arrested for making {lewd} gestures in public.
e.zh: 他因在公共场合做出猥亵动作而被捕。

e.en: The comedian's {lewd} jokes offended several audience members.
e.zh: 那位喜剧演员下流的笑话冒犯了几位观众。

e.en: The drunk man behaved {lewdly} at the bar and was kicked out.
e.zh: 那个醉汉在酒吧里行为下流,被赶了出去。

e.en: She accused him of staring {lewdly} at her colleague.
e.zh: 她指控他用淫秽的眼神盯着她的同事。

e.en: He was charged with public {lewdness} after the incident downtown.
e.zh: 事件发生后,他在市中心被控公开猥亵罪。

e.en: The film was banned for its perceived {lewdness} and violence.
e.zh: 该片因被认为含有淫秽和暴力内容而遭禁播。

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the historic town of {Lewes}.
e.zh: 我们整个周末都在游览历史悠久的刘易斯小镇。

e.en: {Lewes} is famous for its dramatic Bonfire Night celebrations.
