e.zh: 刘易斯以其盛大的篝火之夜庆典而闻名。

e.en: C.S. {Lewis} wrote the beloved Chronicles of Narnia series.
e.zh: C·S·刘易斯创作了广受喜爱的《纳尼亚传奇》系列。

e.en: {Lewis} Hamilton won another Formula One championship last season.
e.zh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿在上个赛季又赢得了一届F1冠军。

lewisham.t: n. 刘易舍姆（伦敦自治市）

e.en: She moved into a small flat in {Lewisham} last summer.
e.zh: 她去年夏天搬进了刘易舍姆的一间小公寓。

e.en: {Lewisham} hospital serves a large area of southeast London.
e.zh: 刘易舍姆医院服务于伦敦东南部的广大地区。

lex.t: n. 词法分析器；法律（拉丁语）

e.en: In Roman law, {lex} referred to a binding legal statute.
e.zh: 在罗马法中,lex 指具有约束力的法律条文。

e.en: {Lex} Luthor remains Superman's most iconic archenemy.
e.zh: 莱克斯·卢瑟仍是超人最具代表性的宿敌。

e.en: JavaScript closures rely on {lexical} scoping rules.
e.zh: JavaScript 闭包依赖于词法作用域规则。

e.en: The dictionary captures the {lexical} richness of modern English.
e.zh: 这本词典展现了现代英语丰富的词汇。

e.en: Variables declared with let are {lexically} scoped to their block.
e.zh: 用 let 声明的变量按词法作用域限定在其代码块内。

e.en: The two languages are {lexically} similar but grammatically distinct.
e.zh: 这两种语言在词汇上相似,但语法上截然不同。

e.en: Samuel Johnson was a famous English {lexicographer}.
e.zh: 塞缪尔·约翰逊是英国著名的词典编纂家。

e.en: As a {lexicographer}, she spends her days defining new slang.
e.zh: 作为一名词典编纂者,她每天都在为新俚语下定义。

e.en: Modern {lexicography} relies heavily on large digital text corpora.
e.zh: 现代词典编纂学在很大程度上依赖大型数字语料库。

e.en: She studied {lexicography} before joining the dictionary team.
e.zh: 她在加入词典团队前学习过词典编纂学。

e.en: The word "selfie" entered the English {lexicon} around 2013.
e.zh: "自拍"一词大约在2013年进入英语词汇库。

e.en: Every profession develops its own specialized {lexicon} over time.
e.zh: 每个行业都会逐渐形成自己独特的专业词汇。

lexington.t: n. 莱克星顿（美国地名）

e.en: The battle of {Lexington} sparked the American Revolution.
e.zh: 列克星敦之战点燃了美国独立战争的导火索。

e.en: They drove through {Lexington} on their way to Kentucky horse country.
e.zh: 他们驱车穿过列克星敦,前往肯塔基的马场区。

e.en: Linguists study how {lexis} evolves alongside cultural change.
e.zh: 语言学家研究词汇如何随文化变迁而演变。

e.en: Children acquire core {lexis} faster than complex grammar.
e.zh: 儿童习得核心词汇的速度比复杂语法更快。

ley.t: n. 休耕草地；轮作牧场

e.en: Some believe ancient {ley} lines connect sacred sites across Britain.
e.zh: 有人相信古老的能量线连接着英国各地的圣地。

e.en: The farmer rotated crops with a clover {ley} every few years.
e.zh: 农夫每隔几年就用三叶草草地轮作一次。

e.en: The {Leyden} jar was an early device for storing electric charge.
e.zh: 莱顿瓶是早期用于储存电荷的装置。

e.en: He visited the University of {Leyden} during his trip to Holland.
e.zh: 他在荷兰之行中参观了莱顿大学。

leyland.t: n. 利兰（英国地名/卡车品牌）

e.en: British {Leyland} once dominated the UK automotive industry.
e.zh: 英国利兰汽车公司曾主导英国汽车工业。

e.en: The old {Leyland} bus still runs on the heritage route.
e.zh: 那辆老旧的利兰巴士仍在文化遗产线路上运行。

leys.t: n. 牧草地（ley 的复数）

e.en: Hikers traced the supposed {leys} across the Wiltshire countryside.
e.zh: 徒步者沿着传说中的能量线穿越威尔特郡乡间。

e.en: The farm rotates several grass {leys} to maintain soil health.
e.zh: 该农场轮种几片草地以维持土壤肥力。

e.en: She grew up in {Leyton}, east London, before moving abroad.
e.zh: 她在伦敦东区的莱顿长大,后来移居海外。

e.en: The match was held at {Leyton} Orient's home ground.
e.zh: 比赛在莱顿东方队的主场举行。

lfa.t: n. 前沿支援地区（缩写）

e.en: The pilot completed his {LFA} certification for low-flying training.
e.zh: 那位飞行员完成了低空飞行训练的LFA认证。

e.en: Researchers study how {LFA}-1 helps immune cells stick to vessels.
e.zh: 研究人员研究 LFA-1 如何帮助免疫细胞黏附血管。

e.en: Use Git {LFS} to handle large binary files in the repository.
e.zh: 使用 Git LFS 来管理仓库中的大型二进制文件。

e.en: The video assets are tracked via {LFS} to keep clones fast.
e.zh: 视频素材通过 LFS 进行追踪,以保持克隆速度。

e.en: The Potala Palace towers above the city of {Lhasa}.
e.zh: 布达拉宫巍然耸立在拉萨城之上。

e.en: They flew into {Lhasa} to begin their Tibetan trek.
e.zh: 他们飞抵拉萨,开始西藏徒步之旅。

liability.t:
n. 法律责任；负债
n. 累赘

e.en: The company faces huge {liability} after the data breach.
e.zh: 公司在数据泄露后面临巨额赔偿责任。

e.en: His careless tweets became a real {liability} for the campaign.
e.zh: 他随意的推文成了竞选活动的真正累赘。

liable.t: adj. 有法律责任的；易于…的

e.en: Drivers are {liable} for damages caused by their negligence.
e.zh: 驾驶员需对因其疏忽造成的损害承担责任。

e.en: Cheap batteries are {liable} to overheat in hot weather.
e.zh: 廉价电池在炎热天气下容易过热。

e.en: Please {liaise} with the marketing team before the launch.
e.zh: 请在产品发布前与营销团队保持沟通协调。

e.en: Her job is to {liaise} between developers and clients.
e.zh: 她的工作是在开发人员和客户之间进行联络。

liaised.t: v. 联络（liaise 的过去式）

e.en: The project manager {liaised} closely with the design team.
e.zh: 项目经理与设计团队保持了密切联络。

e.en: Police {liaised} with local schools after the incident.
e.zh: 事件发生后,警方与当地学校进行了沟通协调。

liaises.t: v. 联络（liaise 第三人称单数）

e.en: She {liaises} between the head office and overseas branches.
e.zh: 她负责总部与海外分公司之间的联络工作。

e.en: Our nurse regularly {liaises} with patients' family doctors.
e.zh: 我们的护士定期与患者的家庭医生联系沟通。

liaising.t: v. 正在联络（liaise 的 ing 形式）

e.en: He spent the morning {liaising} with vendors about the schedule.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在与供应商沟通日程安排。

e.en: She is {liaising} with embassies to arrange the evacuation.
e.zh: 她正在与各大使馆协调安排撤离事宜。

liaison.t:
n. 联络；联络人
n. 私通

e.en: She acts as the {liaison} between students and the dean's office.
e.zh: 她担任学生与院长办公室之间的联络人。

e.en: A close {liaison} between departments improves project outcomes.
e.zh: 各部门之间的紧密协作能改善项目成果。

liaisons.t: n. 联络关系（liaison 的复数）

e.en: The agency maintains {liaisons} with several foreign partners.
e.zh: 该机构与多个外国合作伙伴保持联络关系。

e.en: Community {liaisons} help bridge gaps between police and residents.
e.zh: 社区联络员帮助弥合警方与居民之间的隔阂。

e.en: A thick {liana} hung down from the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 一根粗壮的藤本植物从雨林树冠上垂落下来。

e.en: The monkey swung gracefully from one {liana} to another.
e.zh: 那只猴子优雅地从一根藤蔓荡到另一根上。

e.en: Don't trust him — he's a notorious {liar}.
e.zh: 别相信他——他是个臭名昭著的骗子。

e.en: She called him a {liar} right in front of everyone.
e.zh: 她当着众人的面说他是骗子。

liars.t: n. 说谎者（liar 的复数）

e.en: Politicians are often dismissed as {liars} by frustrated voters.
e.zh: 愤怒的选民常常把政客们视为骗子。

e.en: The book teaches readers how to spot habitual {liars}.
e.zh: 这本书教读者如何识别惯于撒谎的人。

lib.t: n. 库（library 的缩写）；解放运动

e.en: Import the helper functions from the shared {lib} folder.
e.zh: 从共享的 lib 文件夹中导入辅助函数。

e.en: The women's {lib} movement reshaped society in the 1970s.
e.zh: 上世纪七十年代的妇女解放运动重塑了社会面貌。

e.en: He poured a {libation} of wine onto the ground in tribute.
e.zh: 他将酒洒在地上以表敬意。

e.en: The friends raised their glasses for a celebratory {libation}.
e.zh: 朋友们举杯共饮以示庆祝。

e.en: She proudly called herself a women's {libber} back in college.
e.zh: 上大学时她自豪地称自己是妇女解放主义者。

e.en: The old {libber} still attends every protest she can.
e.zh: 那位老牌妇解人士仍然参加她能去的每一场抗议。

e.en: The newspaper was sued for {libel} after the false report.
e.zh: 那家报社因虚假报道被起诉诽谤。

e.en: Proving {libel} requires showing the statement was knowingly false.
e.zh: 要证明诽谤,必须证明该陈述是明知虚假而发表的。

libellous.t: adj. 诽谤性的（英式拼写）

e.en: The magazine retracted the {libellous} article and apologised.
e.zh: 该杂志撤回了那篇诽谤性文章并公开道歉。

e.en: Her lawyer warned that the tweet could be deemed {libellous}.
e.zh: 她的律师警告说那条推文可能被认定为诽谤。

e.en: The blog post was clearly {libelous} and quickly taken down.
e.zh: 那篇博文明显具有诽谤性,很快就被撤下了。

e.en: Editors carefully review stories to avoid {libelous} claims.
e.zh: 编辑会仔细审稿以避免出现诽谤性的指控。

e.en: The medieval {liber} contained illuminated manuscripts and prayers.
e.zh: 那本中世纪典籍收录了泥金装饰手稿和祈祷文。

e.en: In Latin, {liber} can mean either "book" or "free."
e.zh: 在拉丁语中,liber 既可表示"书",也可表示"自由"。

liberal.t:
adj. 自由主义的；开明的
n. 自由派人士

e.en: She holds fairly {liberal} views on most social issues.
e.zh: 她在大多数社会议题上持相当开明的观点。

e.en: Add a {liberal} amount of olive oil to the pan.
e.zh: 在锅里倒入足量的橄榄油。

e.en: Trade {liberalisation} opened the country to global competition.
e.zh: 贸易自由化使该国向全球竞争敞开了大门。

e.en: Economists debated the pace of financial market {liberalisation}.
e.zh: 经济学家们争论金融市场自由化的步伐。

liberalise.t: v. 使自由化（英式拼写）

e.en: The government plans to {liberalise} import rules next year.
e.zh: 政府计划在明年放宽进口规定。

e.en: Reformers want to {liberalise} outdated marriage laws.
e.zh: 改革者希望放宽过时的婚姻法律。

licenses.t:
n. 许可证（复数）
v. 授权（第三人称单数）

e.en: The state issues thousands of marriage {licenses} every year.
e.zh: 该州每年颁发数千张结婚证。

e.en: Open-source {licenses} explain how others may use your code.
e.zh: 开源许可证说明了他人可以如何使用你的代码。

licensing.t:
n. 许可；授权
v. 发放许可（-ing 形式）

e.en: The {licensing} deal earned the band millions in royalties.
e.zh: 这项授权协议为乐队带来了数百万美元的版税。

e.en: Strict {licensing} rules apply to anyone selling firearms.
e.zh: 销售枪支的人必须遵守严格的许可规定。

licensure.t: n. 执照发放；执业许可

e.en: Nurses must pass an exam to obtain {licensure} in this state.
e.zh: 护士必须通过考试才能在本州获得执业资格。

e.en: The board reviewed her application for medical {licensure} last week.
e.zh: 委员会上周审核了她的医师执照申请。

licentiate.t: n. 持执照者；执业资格持有人

e.en: He earned a {licentiate} in philosophy from the university.
e.zh: 他在大学获得了哲学执教资格证书。

e.en: The {licentiate} is qualified to practice law in two countries.
e.zh: 这位持证人有资格在两个国家执业律师。

e.en: The novel was banned for its {licentious} content.
e.zh: 这部小说因内容淫秽而被禁。

e.en: Critics condemned the {licentious} behavior at the wild party.
e.zh: 评论家谴责那场狂欢派对上的放荡行为。

e.en: The film depicts the {licentiousness} of the royal court.
e.zh: 这部电影描绘了宫廷的放荡风气。

e.en: Religious leaders warned against the {licentiousness} of modern culture.
e.zh: 宗教领袖警告人们要警惕现代文化的放纵。

e.en: Gray {lichen} covered the old stone walls of the cottage.
e.zh: 灰色的地衣覆盖着小屋古老的石墙。

e.en: Scientists study {lichen} as indicators of air quality.
e.zh: 科学家研究地衣作为空气质量的指示物。

lichfield.t: n. 利奇菲尔德（英国地名）

e.en: We visited the cathedral in {Lichfield} last summer.
e.zh: 我们去年夏天参观了利奇菲尔德的大教堂。

e.en: The poet Samuel Johnson was born in {Lichfield}, England.
e.zh: 诗人塞缪尔·约翰逊出生在英格兰的利奇菲尔德。

lichtenstein.t: n. 利希滕斯坦（人名/姓氏）

e.en: Roy {Lichtenstein} became famous for his comic-style pop art.
e.zh: 罗伊·利希滕斯坦因其漫画风格的波普艺术而成名。

e.en: The museum displayed several paintings by {Lichtenstein} this season.
e.zh: 博物馆本季展出了几幅利希滕斯坦的画作。

licit.t: adj. 合法的；法律允许的

e.en: The company only deals in {licit} pharmaceutical products.
e.zh: 该公司只经营合法的药品。

e.en: There is a clear difference between {licit} and illegal trade.
e.zh: 合法贸易和非法贸易之间有明显区别。

lick.t:
v. 舔
n. 舔一下

e.en: The puppy tried to {lick} my face when I sat down.
e.zh: 我一坐下小狗就想舔我的脸。

e.en: She gave the ice cream a quick {lick} before it melted.
e.zh: 她在冰淇淋融化前快速舔了一口。

licked.t:
v. 舔（过去式）
adj. 被打败的（口语）

e.en: The cat {licked} its paws clean after eating.
e.zh: 猫吃完东西后把爪子舔干净了。

e.en: Flames {licked} at the wooden beams of the old barn.
e.zh: 火焰舔舐着旧谷仓的木梁。

licking.t:
v. 舔（-ing 形式）
n. 惨败（俚语）

e.en: The dog kept {licking} the empty bowl hoping for more food.
e.zh: 狗一直舔着空碗,希望还有更多食物。

e.en: She was {licking} the sauce off her fingers happily.
e.zh: 她开心地舔着手指上的酱汁。

licks.t:
v. 舔（第三人称单数）
n. 舔（复数）

e.en: The guitarist played some classic blues {licks} during the solo.
e.zh: 吉他手在独奏中弹出了一些经典的布鲁斯乐句。

e.en: My dog {licks} my hand whenever I come home.
e.zh: 我每次回家狗都会舔我的手。

e.en: I bought a bag of black {licorice} at the candy store.
e.zh: 我在糖果店买了一袋黑甘草糖。

e.en: The tea has a sweet {licorice} flavor that I love.
e.zh: 这茶有一种我喜欢的甘草甜味。

e.en: Make sure to put the {lid} back on the jar tightly.
e.zh: 一定要把罐子的盖子盖紧。

e.en: He lifted the {lid} of the laptop and began typing.
e.zh: 他掀开笔记本电脑的盖子开始打字。

e.en: Self-driving cars use {lidar} to detect obstacles on the road.
e.zh: 自动驾驶汽车使用激光雷达来检测路上的障碍物。

e.en: Archaeologists used {lidar} to find ruins hidden in the jungle.
e.zh: 考古学家用激光雷达发现了丛林中隐藏的遗址。

e.en: She stored the leftovers in a {lidded} glass container.
e.zh: 她把剩饭放在一个带盖的玻璃容器里。

e.en: He looked at her with heavy {lidded} eyes from exhaustion.
e.zh: 他疲惫地用沉重的眼皮看着她。

e.en: The reptile stared with cold, {lidless} eyes.
e.zh: 这只爬行动物用冷漠无睑的眼睛凝视着。

e.en: He found a {lidless} pot at the back of the cupboard.
e.zh: 他在橱柜后面发现了一个没有盖子的锅。

lido.t: n. 露天游泳池；海滨浴场

e.en: The kids spent the whole afternoon at the local {lido}.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在当地的露天泳池玩耍。

e.en: We sunbathed on the {lido} deck of the cruise ship.
e.zh: 我们在游轮的露天泳池甲板上晒太阳。

lidocaine.t: n. 利多卡因（局部麻醉药）

e.en: The dentist injected {lidocaine} before drilling the tooth.
e.zh: 牙医在钻牙之前注射了利多卡因。

e.en: This cream contains {lidocaine} to numb the skin temporarily.
e.zh: 这款乳膏含有利多卡因,可暂时麻痹皮肤。

e.en: Please match the {lids} with the correct food containers.
e.zh: 请将盖子与正确的食物容器配对。

e.en: Her tired eyes had heavy {lids} that kept drooping shut.
e.zh: 她疲倦的眼睛眼皮沉重,不停地往下垂。

lie.t:
v. 躺；位于；说谎
n. 谎言

e.en: Please don't {lie} to me about where you were last night.
e.zh: 请不要对我撒谎你昨晚在哪里。

e.en: I just want to {lie} on the couch and watch movies.
e.zh: 我只想躺在沙发上看电影。

e.en: {Liechtenstein} is one of the smallest countries in Europe.
e.zh: 列支敦士登是欧洲最小的国家之一。

e.en: We took a day trip to {Liechtenstein} from Switzerland.
e.zh: 我们从瑞士去列支敦士登一日游。

lied.t: v. 说谎（过去式）；躺（过去式）

e.en: He {lied} about his age on the dating app.
e.zh: 他在交友软件上谎报了年龄。

e.en: She {lied} to her parents about staying at a friend's house.
e.zh: 她对父母撒谎说自己在朋友家过夜。

lieder.t: n. 德语艺术歌曲（复数）

e.en: Schubert composed beautiful {lieder} based on Romantic poetry.
e.zh: 舒伯特根据浪漫主义诗歌创作了优美的艺术歌曲。

e.en: The soprano performed German {lieder} at last night's recital.
e.zh: 女高音昨晚的独唱会上演唱了德国艺术歌曲。

liege.t:
n. 君主；封建领主
adj. 效忠的

e.en: The knight pledged loyalty to his {liege} lord.
e.zh: 骑士向他的领主宣誓效忠。

e.en: Medieval vassals were bound to serve their {liege} in war.
e.zh: 中世纪的封臣有义务在战争中为其君主效劳。

e.en: The bank placed a {lien} on the property until the debt was paid.
e.zh: 银行对该房产设置了留置权,直到债务还清。

e.en: You cannot sell the car while there is a {lien} on it.
e.zh: 在车辆有留置权期间,你不能出售它。

lies.t:
n. 谎言（复数）
v. 说谎；躺（第三人称单数）

e.en: He always tells {lies} to avoid getting in trouble.
e.zh: 他总是撒谎以避免惹麻烦。

e.en: The small village {lies} in a valley between two mountains.
e.zh: 这个小村庄位于两山之间的山谷中。

lieu.t: n. 代替（常用 in lieu of）

e.en: She took extra vacation days in {lieu} of a bonus.
e.zh: 她接受了额外的休假天数代替奖金。

e.en: In {lieu} of flowers, please donate to the charity.
e.zh: 请用捐款给慈善机构来代替送花。

e.en: The report was signed by {Lieut} Smith of the navy.
e.zh: 该报告由海军史密斯中尉签署。

e.en: {Lieut} Johnson led the platoon during the training exercise.
e.zh: 约翰逊中尉在训练演习中带领该排。

e.en: He was promoted to a {lieutenancy} after three years of service.
e.zh: 服役三年后他被晋升为中尉军衔。

e.en: The {lieutenancy} carries significant responsibility within the regiment.
e.zh: 中尉职位在该团内承担着重要责任。

e.en: The {lieutenant} ordered his soldiers to take cover immediately.
e.zh: 中尉命令他的士兵立即寻找掩护。

e.en: She was promoted from sergeant to {lieutenant} last month.
e.zh: 她上个月从中士晋升为中尉。

e.en: Moving to a new city changed my {life} completely.
e.zh: 搬到一个新城市彻底改变了我的生活。

e.en: Scientists are searching for signs of {life} on Mars.
e.zh: 科学家正在火星上寻找生命的迹象。

e.en: Always wear a {lifebelt} when sailing in rough waters.
e.zh: 在波涛汹涌的水域航行时一定要穿救生圈。

e.en: The crew threw a {lifebelt} to the swimmer in distress.
e.zh: 船员向遇险的游泳者抛出了救生圈。

e.en: Tourism is the {lifeblood} of this small coastal town.
e.zh: 旅游业是这个沿海小镇的命脉。

e.en: Innovation has been the {lifeblood} of the tech industry.
e.zh: 创新一直是科技行业的命脉。

e.en: Passengers boarded the {lifeboat} as the ship began to sink.
e.zh: 船开始下沉时乘客们登上了救生艇。

e.en: Volunteers operate the local {lifeboat} during emergencies at sea.
e.zh: 志愿者在海上紧急情况下操作当地的救生艇。

e.en: The {lifeguard} blew his whistle at the kids running by the pool.
e.zh: 救生员对在泳池边奔跑的孩子们吹了哨子。

e.en: She works as a {lifeguard} at the beach every summer.
e.zh: 她每年夏天都在海滩做救生员。

e.en: The {lifeguards} rescued three swimmers caught in the riptide.
e.zh: 救生员们救出了三名被离岸流困住的游泳者。

e.en: Two {lifeguards} are always on duty during pool hours.
e.zh: 泳池开放期间总有两名救生员值班。

lifeless.t: adj. 无生命的；死气沉沉的

e.en: The desert appeared completely {lifeless} under the harsh midday sun.
e.zh: 在烈日下沙漠显得毫无生机。

e.en: Her performance felt {lifeless} and failed to engage the audience.
e.zh: 她的表演显得没有生气,无法吸引观众。

lifelessly.t: adv. 死气沉沉地；无生气地

e.en: His arms hung {lifelessly} at his sides after the long workout.
e.zh: 长时间锻炼后,他的手臂无力地垂在身体两侧。

e.en: The flag drooped {lifelessly} in the still afternoon air.
e.zh: 旗帜在静止的午后空气中无力地下垂。

e.en: The {lifelessness} of the abandoned town was eerie and unsettling.
e.zh: 被遗弃小镇的死寂让人感到诡异不安。

e.en: Critics complained about the {lifelessness} of the actor's performance.
e.zh: 评论家抱怨这位演员的表演毫无生气。

lifelike.t: adj. 逼真的；栩栩如生的

e.en: The wax figures at the museum looked incredibly {lifelike}.
e.zh: 博物馆里的蜡像看起来栩栩如生。

e.en: AI can now generate {lifelike} images from a simple description.
e.zh: 人工智能现在能根据简单描述生成逼真的图像。

e.en: The food bank is a {lifeline} for many struggling families.
e.zh: 食品银行是许多困难家庭的生命线。

e.en: Her phone became a {lifeline} during the long hospital stay.
e.zh: 在长期住院期间,她的手机成了她的生命线。

e.en: They have been {lifelong} friends since kindergarten.
e.zh: 他们从幼儿园开始就是终身的朋友。

e.en: Reading has been her {lifelong} passion and greatest joy.
e.zh: 阅读一直是她毕生的热情和最大的乐趣。

lifer.t: n. 无期徒刑犯；终身服役者

e.en: He's a {lifer} at the company, having worked there forty years.
e.zh: 他在公司工作了四十年,是个老员工。

e.en: The prison houses several {lifer} inmates convicted of serious crimes.
e.zh: 该监狱关押着几名因严重罪行被判终身监禁的囚犯。

lifesaver.t: n. 救命恩人；救急之物

e.en: Your detailed notes were a real {lifesaver} before the exam.
e.zh: 你详细的笔记在考试前真是救命稻草。

e.en: This new app is a {lifesaver} for busy parents.
e.zh: 这款新应用对忙碌的父母来说是救星。

liberalising.t: v. 使自由化（英式拼写）

e.en: The country is gradually {liberalising} its telecom industry.
e.zh: 该国正在逐步放开其电信行业。

e.en: Critics warn that {liberalising} gun laws could increase violence.
e.zh: 批评者警告放宽枪支法律可能加剧暴力事件。

liberalism.t: n. 自由主义（政治思想）

e.en: Classical {liberalism} emphasizes individual freedom and limited government.
e.zh: 古典自由主义强调个人自由和有限政府。

e.en: Modern {liberalism} often advocates for stronger social safety nets.
e.zh: 现代自由主义往往主张建立更强大的社会保障体系。

e.en: His {liberality} toward charities surprised even his closest friends.
e.zh: 他对慈善事业的慷慨连最亲近的朋友都感到惊讶。

e.en: The judge was praised for her {liberality} in interpreting the law.
e.zh: 这位法官因解释法律时的开明态度而受到赞扬。

e.en: Trade {liberalization} opened the country to foreign investors.
e.zh: 贸易自由化使该国向外国投资者敞开大门。

e.en: The {liberalization} of media laws sparked heated public debate.
e.zh: 媒体法的放宽引发了激烈的公众讨论。

liberalize.t: v. 使自由化；放宽管制

e.en: The government plans to {liberalize} visa rules next year.
e.zh: 政府计划明年放宽签证规定。

e.en: Many economists urge the country to {liberalize} its energy market.
e.zh: 许多经济学家敦促该国开放其能源市场。

liberalized.t:
v. liberalize 的过去式
adj. 已放宽的

e.en: China {liberalized} parts of its financial sector in recent decades.
e.zh: 中国近几十年开放了部分金融领域。

e.en: The newly {liberalized} rules let small firms compete with giants.
e.zh: 新放宽的规定让小公司能与巨头竞争。

e.en: They are {liberalizing} import tariffs to boost consumer choice.
e.zh: 他们正在放宽进口关税以增加消费者选择。

e.en: The party debated {liberalizing} cannabis laws for years.
e.zh: 该党就放宽大麻法规争论了多年。

e.en: She seasoned the soup {liberally} with black pepper.
e.zh: 她在汤里大量地撒了黑胡椒。

e.en: He quoted Shakespeare {liberally} throughout the speech.
e.zh: 他在整场演讲中大量引用了莎士比亚。

e.en: Many {liberals} support stronger climate regulations.
e.zh: 许多自由派支持更严格的气候法规。

e.en: The {liberals} won a clear majority in the latest election.
e.zh: 自由党在最近的选举中赢得了明显多数。

e.en: Allied troops moved to {liberate} the city in 1944.
e.zh: 盟军在1944年挺进解放该城市。

e.en: Working from home can {liberate} you from a long commute.
e.zh: 在家工作可以让你摆脱漫长的通勤。

liberated.t:
adj. 思想解放的
v. liberate 过去式

e.en: The villagers were finally {liberated} after months of occupation.
e.zh: 村民们在被占领数月后终于获得了解放。

e.en: She felt {liberated} once she quit her toxic job.
e.zh: 辞掉那份糟糕的工作后她感到无比自由。

liberates.t: v. 解放（第三人称单数）

e.en: Automation {liberates} workers from repetitive daily tasks.
e.zh: 自动化将工人从重复的日常工作中解放出来。

e.en: Meditation {liberates} the mind from constant worry.
e.zh: 冥想能让心灵从持续的焦虑中解脱。

liberating.t:
adj. 令人释怀的
v. liberate 进行时

e.en: Traveling alone was a surprisingly {liberating} experience.
e.zh: 独自旅行是一种出乎意料的解放体验。

e.en: Soldiers focused on {liberating} hostages held inside the building.
e.zh: 士兵们专注于解救被困在大楼内的人质。

e.en: The country celebrates its {liberation} day every August.
e.zh: 该国每年八月庆祝解放日。

e.en: Quitting social media brought her a sense of {liberation}.
e.zh: 戒掉社交媒体让她有一种解脱感。

e.en: She gave a passionate {liberationist} speech at the rally.
e.zh: 她在集会上发表了一场激情的解放主义演讲。

e.en: The professor wrote a book on animal {liberationist} thought.
e.zh: 这位教授写了一本关于动物解放主义思想的书。

e.en: History textbooks list several major wartime {liberations}.
e.zh: 历史教科书列出了几次重大的战时解放。

e.en: The museum exhibit details the {liberations} of European cities.
e.zh: 博物馆展览详细介绍了欧洲城市的解放过程。

e.en: He was hailed as a {liberator} when troops entered the capital.
e.zh: 军队进入首都时,他被誉为解放者。

e.en: The statue honors a famous {liberator} of the nineteenth century.
e.zh: 这座雕像纪念十九世纪的一位著名解放者。

e.en: The novel offers a {liberatory} vision for marginalized communities.
e.zh: 这部小说为边缘群体提供了一种解放性的愿景。

e.en: She studies {liberatory} education methods in graduate school.
e.zh: 她在研究生院研究解放性教育方法。

liberia.t: n. 利比里亚（西非国家）

e.en: {Liberia} is located on the west coast of Africa.
e.zh: 利比里亚位于非洲西海岸。

e.en: The capital of {Liberia} is Monrovia.
e.zh: 利比里亚的首都是蒙罗维亚。

liberian.t:
adj. 利比里亚的
n. 利比里亚人

e.en: She is a talented {Liberian} writer based in New York.
e.zh: 她是一位才华横溢、定居纽约的利比里亚作家。

e.en: The film highlights {Liberian} culture and traditions.
e.zh: 这部电影展现了利比里亚的文化与传统。

libero.t: n. 自由人（排球/足球位置）

e.en: The {libero} dove to save the ball from hitting the floor.
e.zh: 自由人飞身扑救,防止球落地。

e.en: A great {libero} reads the opponent's spike before it happens.
e.zh: 出色的自由人能在对方扣球前预判球路。

libertarian.t:
n. 自由意志主义者
adj. 自由意志主义的

e.en: He holds strong {libertarian} views about taxes and regulation.
e.zh: 他在税收和监管问题上持强烈的自由意志主义观点。

e.en: The {libertarian} candidate won only a small share of votes.
e.zh: 那位自由意志党候选人只获得了少量选票。

e.en: His essay defends {libertarianism} as a coherent political philosophy.
e.zh: 他的文章将自由意志主义辩护为一种自洽的政治哲学。

e.en: American {libertarianism} differs noticeably from European versions.
e.zh: 美国的自由意志主义与欧洲的明显不同。

e.en: Citizens fought hard to protect their civil {liberties}.
e.zh: 公民们奋力捍卫自己的公民自由。

e.en: The director took some {liberties} with the original story.
e.zh: 导演对原著做了一些自由发挥。

libertine.t:
n. 放荡不羁的人
adj. 放荡的

e.en: The novel's hero is a charming but reckless {libertine}.
e.zh: 小说的主角是一个迷人却放荡不羁的浪子。

e.en: He led a {libertine} lifestyle that scandalized polite society.
e.zh: 他过着放荡的生活,令上流社会震惊。

e.en: The Statue of {Liberty} welcomes visitors to New York Harbor.
e.zh: 自由女神像在纽约港迎接来访者。

e.en: Please take the {liberty} of helping yourself to coffee.
e.zh: 请自便,随意取用咖啡。

e.en: Freud's theory describes {libidinal} energy as a driving force.
e.zh: 弗洛伊德的理论将性本能能量描述为一种驱动力。

e.en: The film explores {libidinal} desire with surprising honesty.
e.zh: 这部电影以惊人的坦率探讨了性欲望。

e.en: The character is portrayed as charming but openly {libidinous}.
e.zh: 这个角色被刻画得迷人却毫不掩饰其好色。

e.en: Critics called the painting {libidinous} and inappropriate for children.
e.zh: 评论家称这幅画带有色欲色彩,不适合儿童观看。

e.en: Stress can significantly lower a person's {libido}.
e.zh: 压力会显著降低一个人的性欲。

e.en: The medication may affect appetite, sleep, and {libido}.
e.zh: 这种药物可能会影响食欲、睡眠和性欲。

libor.t: n. 伦敦银行同业拆借利率

e.en: Many old loan contracts were tied to the {LIBOR} rate.
e.zh: 许多旧的贷款合同与伦敦银行同业拆借利率挂钩。

e.en: Regulators phased out {LIBOR} after a major rigging scandal.
e.zh: 在重大操纵丑闻后,监管机构逐步淘汰了LIBOR。

e.en: My sister is a {Libra} and loves balance in everything.
e.zh: 我姐姐是天秤座,凡事都喜欢讲求平衡。

e.en: People born in late September are usually {Libra}.
e.zh: 九月下旬出生的人通常是天秤座。

e.en: The {librarian} helped me find a rare history book.
e.zh: 图书管理员帮我找到了一本罕见的历史书。

e.en: Ask the {librarian} if you need help with the database.
e.zh: 如果你在使用数据库时需要帮助,请咨询图书管理员。

e.en: The {librarians} organized a summer reading program for kids.
e.zh: 图书管理员们为孩子们组织了一个暑期阅读项目。

e.en: Many {librarians} now teach digital research skills.
e.zh: 如今许多图书管理员还教授数字研究技能。

librarianship.t: n. 图书馆学；图书管理员职务

e.en: She earned a master's degree in {librarianship} last year.
e.zh: 她去年取得了图书馆学硕士学位。

e.en: Modern {librarianship} involves data management and information literacy.
e.zh: 现代图书馆学涉及数据管理和信息素养。

e.en: Public {libraries} offer free Wi-Fi and quiet study spaces.
e.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费Wi-Fi和安静的学习空间。

e.en: Most JavaScript {libraries} can be installed via npm.
e.zh: 大多数JavaScript库都可以通过npm安装。

library.t:
n. 库（代码库）
n. 图书馆

e.en: I borrowed three novels from the {library} this morning.
e.zh: 今早我从图书馆借了三本小说。

e.en: This Python {library} makes data visualization much easier.
e.zh: 这个Python库让数据可视化变得简单多了。

e.en: Astronomers study the moon's {libration} to map its far side.
e.zh: 天文学家研究月球的天平动以绘制其背面地图。

e.en: {Libration} lets us glimpse slightly more than half the moon.
e.zh: 天平动让我们能看到略多于一半的月球表面。

libre.t: adj. 自由的（尤指开源软件）

e.en: He prefers {libre} software because users can modify the code.
e.zh: 他偏爱自由软件,因为用户可以修改代码。

e.en: The festival celebrates {libre} culture and open collaboration.
e.zh: 该节日庆祝自由文化与开放协作。

e.en: The {librettist} worked closely with the composer for two years.
e.zh: 剧本作者与作曲家紧密合作了两年。

e.en: A skilled {librettist} can turn a novel into a powerful opera.
e.zh: 出色的歌剧脚本作者能把小说改编成动人的歌剧。

e.en: The {libretto} for this opera was written in Italian.
e.zh: 这部歌剧的剧本是用意大利语写的。

e.en: She translated the {libretto} so the audience could follow along.
e.zh: 她翻译了歌剧脚本,以便观众能够看懂。

e.en: {Libya} sits on the southern coast of the Mediterranean Sea.
e.zh: 利比亚位于地中海南岸。

e.en: Oil exports remain crucial to {Libya}'s economy.
e.zh: 石油出口对利比亚的经济仍然至关重要。

libyan.t:
adj. 利比亚的
n. 利比亚人

e.en: The {Libyan} desert covers most of the country.
e.zh: 利比亚沙漠覆盖了该国大部分地区。

e.en: He met a {Libyan} student studying engineering in Berlin.
e.zh: 他认识了一位在柏林学工程的利比亚学生。

licence.t:
n. 许可证（英式拼写）
v. 批准

e.en: You need a driving {licence} to rent a car here.
e.zh: 在这里租车需要驾驶执照。

e.en: The bar lost its {licence} after repeated noise complaints.
e.zh: 该酒吧因屡次被投诉噪音而被吊销执照。

licenced.t: adj. 持牌照的（英式拼写）

e.en: She is a fully {licenced} therapist with years of experience.
e.zh: 她是一位拥有多年经验的持证治疗师。

e.en: Only {licenced} venues are allowed to serve alcohol after midnight.
e.zh: 只有持证场所才被允许在午夜后供应酒精。

licencee.t: n. 持牌照者（英式拼写）

e.en: The {licencee} must follow all safety rules listed in the agreement.
e.zh: 持证人必须遵守协议中列出的所有安全规定。

e.en: As {licencee}, the manager is responsible for the pub's conduct.
e.zh: 作为持证人,经理对酒吧的经营行为负有责任。

e.en: The agency issues fishing {licences} every spring.
e.zh: 该机构每年春天发放捕鱼许可证。

e.en: Some software {licences} allow only personal, non-commercial use.
e.zh: 某些软件许可证仅允许个人非商业使用。

licencing.t: v. 发放许可（英式拼写）

e.en: The {licencing} process for new drugs can take years.
e.zh: 新药的审批许可流程可能需要数年。

e.en: They are reviewing the {licencing} fees for street vendors.
e.zh: 他们正在审查街头摊贩的执照费用。

license.t:
n. 许可证
v. 批准；授权

e.en: Don't forget to bring your driver's {license} to the airport.
e.zh: 别忘了带驾照去机场。

e.en: The studio agreed to {license} the song for a commercial.
e.zh: 工作室同意授权这首歌用于一则广告。

licensed.t: adj. 持牌照的；获授权的

e.en: She is a {licensed} electrician with twenty years of experience.
e.zh: 她是一名拥有二十年经验的持证电工。

e.en: Disney {licensed} the characters to several toy companies.
e.zh: 迪士尼将这些角色授权给几家玩具公司。

licensee.t: n. 持牌照人；被许可方

e.en: The {licensee} must display the certificate near the entrance.
e.zh: 持证人必须将证书展示在入口附近。

e.en: Each {licensee} pays an annual fee to use the trademark.
e.zh: 每个被许可方需支付年费才能使用该商标。

lifesize.t: adj. 实物大小的；真人大小的

e.en: The store displayed a {lifesize} statue of the superhero outside.
e.zh: 商店在外面展示了一尊真人大小的超级英雄雕像。

e.en: She painted a {lifesize} portrait of her grandmother.
e.zh: 她画了一幅与真人等身的祖母肖像。

e.en: The average {lifespan} of a house cat is fifteen years.
e.zh: 家猫的平均寿命是十五年。

e.en: Modern smartphones have a typical {lifespan} of three to four years.
e.zh: 现代智能手机的典型使用寿命为三到四年。

e.en: She adopted a healthier {lifestyle} after her doctor's warning.
e.zh: 在医生警告后,她开始过更健康的生活方式。

e.en: Remote work has changed the {lifestyle} of millions of people.
e.zh: 远程工作改变了数百万人的生活方式。

e.en: Different cultures embrace very different {lifestyles} and values.
e.zh: 不同的文化拥有截然不同的生活方式和价值观。

e.en: Modern {lifestyles} often involve too much screen time.
e.zh: 现代生活方式常常涉及过多的屏幕时间。

lifetime.t: n. 一生；终身；使用寿命

e.en: This software comes with a {lifetime} warranty for all users.
e.zh: 这款软件为所有用户提供终身保修。

e.en: Meeting her was the best thing in my entire {lifetime}.
e.zh: 遇见她是我一生中最美好的事情。

e.en: Some stars burn through their {lifetimes} in just a few million years.
e.zh: 有些恒星在短短几百万年内就燃尽了一生。

e.en: He has had three different careers in his two {lifetimes} of work.
e.zh: 在他两辈子般的职业生涯中他换过三种不同的工作。

e.en: Protecting endangered species became her {lifework} after college.
e.zh: 大学毕业后保护濒危物种成了她毕生的事业。

e.en: The museum showcases the artist's {lifework} in one gallery.
e.zh: 博物馆在一个展厅里集中展示了这位艺术家毕生的作品。

liffe.t: n. 伦敦国际金融期货交易所（缩写）

e.en: Traders on the {Liffe} once shouted orders across the pit floor.
e.zh: 伦敦国际金融期货交易所的交易员曾在交易池里大声喊单。

e.en: Futures contracts on the {Liffe} moved sharply after the rate decision.
e.zh: 利率决议公布后,Liffe交易所的期货合约大幅波动。

liffey.t: n. 利菲河（爱尔兰都柏林）

e.en: We walked along the {Liffey} as the sun set over Dublin.
e.zh: 夕阳西下时,我们沿着利菲河散步,俯瞰都柏林。

e.en: Several historic bridges cross the {Liffey} in the city center.
e.zh: 市中心有好几座历史悠久的桥跨越利菲河。

lift.t:
v. 举起；抬起
n. 电梯；搭便车

e.en: Can you help me {lift} this box onto the shelf?
e.zh: 你能帮我把这个箱子搬到架子上吗?

e.en: Take the {lift} to the fifth floor and turn left.
e.zh: 乘电梯到五楼,然后向左转。

lifted.t: v. 举起（lift 的过去式）

e.en: The government finally {lifted} the travel ban last week.
e.zh: 政府上周终于解除了旅行禁令。

e.en: She {lifted} the toddler onto her shoulders so he could see.
e.zh: 她把小孩举到肩上,好让他看得见。

e.en: The Olympic {lifter} broke a world record in the snatch.
e.zh: 那位奥运举重选手在抓举项目中打破了世界纪录。

e.en: This pancake {lifter} is wide enough for the biggest crepes.
e.zh: 这把煎饼铲够宽,连最大的可丽饼也能铲起来。

lifting.t:
v. 举起；提升
n. 提升；起重

e.en: Heavy {lifting} without proper form can injure your back.
e.zh: 姿势不正确地搬重物会伤到背部。

e.en: The fog is finally {lifting} and we can see the harbor.
e.zh: 雾终于散了,我们能看见港口了。

e.en: The crowd cheered as the rocket reached {liftoff} on schedule.
e.zh: 火箭按计划升空时,人群一片欢呼。

e.en: Mission control gave a final go for {liftoff} at dawn.
e.zh: 任务控制中心在黎明时分发出了最终的发射许可。

lifts.t:
n. 电梯（复数）
v. 举起

e.en: This song always {lifts} my mood on a rainy day.
e.zh: 这首歌在雨天总能让我心情变好。

e.en: The hotel has two glass {lifts} overlooking the lobby.
e.zh: 酒店有两部俯瞰大堂的玻璃电梯。

e.en: He tore a {ligament} in his knee during the match.
e.zh: 他在比赛中扭伤了膝盖韧带。

e.en: A torn {ligament} can take months to fully heal.
e.zh: 韧带撕裂可能需要几个月才能完全康复。

e.en: The drug acts as a {ligand} that binds to dopamine receptors.
e.zh: 该药物作为配体与多巴胺受体结合。

e.en: Researchers screened thousands of molecules to find a suitable {ligand}.
e.zh: 研究人员筛选了数千种分子以寻找合适的配体。

e.en: Surgeons {ligate} the blood vessel to stop the bleeding.
e.zh: 外科医生结扎血管以止血。

e.en: You need to {ligate} the DNA fragments before transformation.
e.zh: 在转化之前你需要把DNA片段连接起来。

e.en: Tubal {ligation} is a common form of permanent contraception.
e.zh: 输卵管结扎是一种常见的永久性避孕方式。

e.en: DNA {ligation} joins two fragments using a special enzyme.
e.zh: DNA连接反应利用特定酶把两个片段连接起来。

e.en: The font uses a {ligature} to combine the letters f and i.
e.zh: 这种字体用连字将f和i两个字母合并起来。

e.en: The surgeon tied a {ligature} around the artery to stop bleeding.
e.zh: 外科医生在动脉上结扎了一根线以止血。

light.t:
n. 光；灯
adj. 轻的；明亮的

e.en: Could you turn on the {light}? It's getting dark in here.
e.zh: 你能开下灯吗?屋里有点暗了。

e.en: This jacket is surprisingly {light} for how warm it keeps me.
e.zh: 这件外套这么保暖,却出乎意料地轻。

lighted.t:
v. 点亮（light 的过去式）
adj. 点亮的

e.en: The path was {lighted} by old-fashioned gas lamps.
e.zh: 小路上点着老式的煤气灯,路面被照得通亮。

e.en: She {lighted} a candle and placed it on the windowsill.
e.zh: 她点了一支蜡烛,放在窗台上。

e.en: A short walk can really {lighten} your mood after work.
e.zh: 下班后散散步真的能让心情轻松一些。

e.en: We donated old books to {lighten} our luggage before moving.
e.zh: 搬家前我们捐掉了旧书,以减轻行李重量。

e.en: Her face {lightened} when she heard the good news.
e.zh: 听到好消息时她的脸色一下子开朗起来。

e.en: The new assistant {lightened} my workload considerably this month.
e.zh: 这个月新来的助理大大减轻了我的工作量。

e.en: The sky was {lightening} as we packed up the campsite.
e.zh: 我们收拾营地时天色正在渐渐放亮。

e.en: Hiring more staff is key to {lightening} the team's burden.
e.zh: 多招几个人是减轻团队负担的关键。

e.en: A funny meme always {lightens} a stressful Monday morning.
e.zh: 一张搞笑表情包总能让紧张的周一早晨轻松起来。

e.en: This cream gradually {lightens} dark spots on the skin.
e.zh: 这款面霜能逐渐淡化皮肤上的黑斑。

lighter.t:
n. 打火机
adj. 更轻的；更亮的

e.en: Do you have a {lighter}? I need to light the grill.
e.zh: 你有打火机吗?我要点烧烤炉。

e.en: This laptop is much {lighter} than my old one.
e.zh: 这台笔记本比我以前那台轻多了。

e.en: Airline rules say you can only carry two {lighters} in your pocket.
e.zh: 航空公司规定身上最多只能携带两个打火机。

e.en: Collectible Zippo {lighters} can sell for thousands of dollars.
e.zh: 收藏版的Zippo打火机能卖到几千美元。

lightfoot.t: adj. 脚步轻快的（多为姓氏）

e.en: Mayor {Lightfoot} addressed the city council on housing reform.
e.zh: 莱特富特市长就住房改革向市议会发表了讲话。

e.en: Gordon {Lightfoot} wrote some of the most beloved Canadian folk songs.
e.zh: 戈登·莱特富特创作了一些最受欢迎的加拿大民谣。

lighthearted.t: adj. 轻松愉快的；无忧无虑的

e.en: The movie is a {lighthearted} comedy perfect for family night.
e.zh: 这部电影是一部轻松的喜剧,非常适合家庭观影夜。

e.en: She made a {lighthearted} joke to ease the awkward silence.
e.zh: 她开了个轻松的玩笑来缓解尴尬的沉默。

e.en: He {lightheartedly} brushed off the criticism and kept smiling.
e.zh: 他轻松地把那些批评一笑置之,继续保持微笑。

e.en: The host {lightheartedly} teased the guest about his cooking skills.
e.zh: 主持人轻松地拿嘉宾的厨艺开起了玩笑。

lightheartedness.t: n. 轻松愉快；无忧无虑

e.en: Her {lightheartedness} made every meeting feel less stressful.
e.zh: 她那份轻松的心态让每场会议都不那么紧张。

e.en: There was a sudden {lightheartedness} in the room after the announcement.
e.zh: 宣布消息后,屋里突然弥漫起一种轻松愉快的气氛。

e.en: The old {lighthouse} still guides ships into the harbor.
e.zh: 那座老灯塔至今仍在引导船只进港。

e.en: We climbed to the top of the {lighthouse} for sunset photos.
e.zh: 我们爬到灯塔顶上拍日落的照片。

e.en: Good {lighting} can completely transform a small bedroom.
e.zh: 好的灯光设计可以彻底改变一间小卧室的氛围。

e.en: The photographer adjusted the {lighting} before the shoot.
e.zh: 摄影师在拍摄之前调整了灯光。

e.en: The store offers various {lightings} suited for kitchens and offices.
e.zh: 这家店提供多种适合厨房和办公室的灯具。

e.en: Different stage {lightings} can drastically change the mood of a scene.
e.zh: 不同的舞台灯光可以彻底改变一场戏的氛围。

e.en: The submarine descended into the {lightless} depths of the ocean.
e.zh: 潜艇下潜到了漆黑无光的海洋深处。

e.en: Strange creatures thrive in the {lightless} caves below the surface.
e.zh: 地表之下漆黑的洞穴里生活着各种奇异的生物。

e.en: Season the salmon {lightly} with salt and lemon juice.
e.zh: 在三文鱼上轻轻撒一点盐和柠檬汁调味。

e.en: You shouldn't take this decision {lightly}, it affects everyone.
e.zh: 这个决定影响到每个人,你不该轻率对待。

e.en: I love the {lightness} of these running shoes on long runs.
e.zh: 长跑时我特别喜欢这双跑鞋的轻盈感。

e.en: There's a refreshing {lightness} in her latest novel.
e.zh: 她最新的小说里有种令人耳目一新的轻盈感。

lightning.t:
n. 闪电
adj. 极快的

e.en: A bolt of {lightning} lit up the entire night sky.
e.zh: 一道闪电照亮了整个夜空。

e.en: The new chip processes data at {lightning} speed.
e.zh: 这款新芯片以闪电般的速度处理数据。

lights.t:
n. 灯（复数）
v. 点亮

e.en: Please turn off the {lights} before you leave the room.
e.zh: 离开房间前请把灯关掉。

e.en: The city {lights} look beautiful from the rooftop bar.
e.zh: 从屋顶酒吧看去,城市的灯光美极了。

e.en: The {lightship} warned vessels away from the dangerous sandbar.
e.zh: 那艘灯船提醒来往船只避开危险的沙洲。

e.en: The retired {lightship} is now a floating museum in the harbor.
e.zh: 那艘退役的灯船如今成了港口里的一座浮动博物馆。

lightweight.t:
adj. 轻量级的
n. 轻量级选手

e.en: This {lightweight} jacket folds into its own pocket.
e.zh: 这款轻便夹克可以折叠收进自己的口袋里。

e.en: He won the {lightweight} championship after only two years of boxing.
e.zh: 他练拳击仅两年就拿下了轻量级冠军。

e.en: Botanists classify these {ligneous} stems as woody rather than herbaceous.
e.zh: 植物学家把这些木质的茎归为木本而非草本。

e.en: The plant develops a {ligneous} core as it matures.
e.zh: 这种植物成熟后会形成木质化的茎芯。

e.en: {Lignin} is what makes tree trunks rigid and strong.
e.zh: 木质素是让树干变得坚硬牢固的关键成分。

e.en: Researchers are exploring how to convert {lignin} into biofuels.
e.zh: 研究人员正在探索如何将木质素转化为生物燃料。

e.en: Germany once relied heavily on {lignite} for electricity generation.
e.zh: 德国曾经在发电方面严重依赖褐煤。

e.en: {Lignite} is the lowest grade of coal and burns inefficiently.
e.zh: 褐煤是品质最低的煤,燃烧效率也不高。

liguria.t: n. 利古里亚（意大利地区）

e.en: We spent a week eating pesto along the coast of {Liguria}.
e.zh: 我们在利古里亚海岸沿线吃了一周的青酱。

e.en: {Liguria} is famous for its colorful seaside villages and olive oil.
e.zh: 利古里亚以五彩斑斓的海边小镇和橄榄油闻名。

ligurian.t:
adj. 利古里亚的
n. 利古里亚人

e.en: The {Ligurian} coast is dotted with picturesque fishing villages.
e.zh: 利古里亚海岸点缀着风景如画的渔村。

e.en: Authentic {Ligurian} pesto is made with basil, pine nuts, and olive oil.
e.zh: 正宗的利古里亚青酱用罗勒、松子和橄榄油制成。

e.en: The candidate's {likability} matters as much as her policies.
e.zh: 这位候选人的亲和力和她的政策同样重要。

e.en: Focus groups rated the new mascot high on {likability}.
e.zh: 焦点小组在亲和力方面给新吉祥物打了高分。

likable.t: adj. 讨人喜欢的；可爱的

e.en: He's a genuinely {likable} guy that everyone wants to befriend.
e.zh: 他是个真正讨人喜欢的人,大家都想跟他做朋友。

e.en: The protagonist is flawed but still surprisingly {likable}.
e.zh: 主人公虽然有缺点,但依然意外地讨人喜欢。

like.t:
v. 喜欢
prep. 像；如同

e.en: I really {like} the new design of your website.
e.zh: 我真的很喜欢你网站的新设计。

e.en: Could you tap {like} and subscribe if you enjoyed the video?
e.zh: 如果你喜欢这个视频,能点个赞并订阅吗?

likeable.t: adj. 讨人喜欢的；招人喜爱的

e.en: The new manager is competent and very {likeable}.
e.zh: 新来的经理既能干又非常讨人喜欢。

e.en: Make your protagonist {likeable} or at least interesting to readers.
e.zh: 让你的主角讨喜,或至少让读者觉得有意思。

liked.t: v. 喜欢（like 的过去式）

e.en: I really {liked} the ending of that Netflix series.
e.zh: 我真的很喜欢那部Netflix剧集的结局。

e.en: Her post was {liked} by thousands of followers within an hour.
e.zh: 她的帖子一小时内就被几千名粉丝点了赞。

e.en: There's a high {likelihood} of rain this weekend.
e.zh: 这个周末下雨的可能性很大。

e.en: Wearing a seatbelt reduces the {likelihood} of serious injury.
e.zh: 系安全带能降低严重受伤的可能性。

e.en: The model estimates the {likelihoods} of several possible outcomes.
e.zh: 这个模型估算了几种可能结果各自的概率。

e.en: Analysts compared the {likelihoods} of recession across different scenarios.
e.zh: 分析师比较了不同情境下经济衰退的可能性。

likely.t:
adj. 可能的
adv. 很可能

e.en: It's {likely} to rain later, so bring an umbrella.
e.zh: 待会儿很可能下雨,带把伞吧。

e.en: She's the most {likely} candidate to win the election.
e.zh: 她是最有可能赢得选举的候选人。

e.en: Critics often {liken} her writing style to Hemingway's.
e.zh: 评论家常把她的写作风格比作海明威。

e.en: You can {liken} the brain to a complex computer.
e.zh: 你可以把大脑比作一台复杂的电脑。

e.en: The portrait captures a striking {likeness} of her grandmother.
e.zh: 这幅肖像生动地再现了她祖母的容貌。

e.en: There's a strong {likeness} between the two brothers.
e.zh: 两兄弟之间有着很强的相似之处。

likenesses.t: n. 相似之处；肖像（复数）

e.en: The museum displays {likenesses} of famous historical figures.
e.zh: 博物馆陈列着著名历史人物的肖像。

e.en: Subtle {likenesses} between the cousins surprised everyone.
e.zh: 表兄弟之间细微的相似之处让大家都很惊讶。

likes.t:
n. 点赞
v. 喜欢

e.en: Her latest post got thousands of {likes} overnight.
e.zh: 她最新的帖子一夜之间获得了上千个赞。

e.en: We've never seen the {likes} of this storm before.
e.zh: 我们从未见过这样的暴风雨。

e.en: She ordered coffee, and her friend did {likewise}.
e.zh: 她点了咖啡,她朋友也照样点了一杯。

e.en: Be respectful, and others will {likewise} respect you.
e.zh: 尊重他人,别人也会同样尊重你。

e.en: The new manager has taken a {liking} to her work.
e.zh: 新经理对她的工作很有好感。

e.en: This soup is too spicy for my {liking}.
e.zh: 这汤对我来说太辣了,不合我口味。

likud.t: n. 利库德集团（以色列政党）

e.en: The {Likud} party held a press conference in Jerusalem.
e.zh: 利库德集团在耶路撒冷举行了新闻发布会。

e.en: He has been a {Likud} member for over twenty years.
e.zh: 他加入利库德集团已经超过二十年了。

e.en: Wait a {lil} bit, the food is almost ready.
e.zh: 再等一小会儿,饭马上就好了。

e.en: The rapper {Lil} Wayne released a new album yesterday.
e.zh: 说唱歌手李尔·韦恩昨天发行了一张新专辑。

e.en: She painted the bedroom walls a soft {lilac}.
e.zh: 她把卧室的墙刷成了柔和的淡紫色。

e.en: The {lilac} bushes bloom beautifully every May.
e.zh: 丁香花丛每年五月都开得很美。

e.en: White {lilies} filled the church for the wedding.
e.zh: 教堂里摆满了白百合,准备举行婚礼。

e.en: She planted {lilies} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她沿着花园小径种下了百合花。

e.en: We took the train from Paris to {Lille} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们坐火车从巴黎去了里尔。

e.en: {Lille} is famous for its old town and beer culture.
e.zh: 里尔以老城和啤酒文化而闻名。

lilliput.t: n. 小人国（《格列佛游记》）

e.en: Gulliver awoke to find himself tied down in {Lilliput}.
e.zh: 格列佛醒来发现自己被绑在小人国里。

e.en: The toy village looked like a real-life {Lilliput}.
e.zh: 这个玩具村庄看起来就像现实版的小人国。

e.en: The cottage had {lilliputian} doors that adults had to duck through.
e.zh: 小屋的门小得像小人国的,大人得低头才能进。

e.en: He dismissed their concerns as {lilliputian} and trivial.
e.zh: 他把他们的顾虑视为微不足道的小事而不予理会。

e.en: Eli {Lilly} announced strong sales for its new diabetes drug.
e.zh: 礼来公司宣布其新糖尿病药物销售强劲。

e.en: {Lilly} is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical companies.
e.zh: 礼来是全球最大的制药公司之一。

lilt.t:
n. 轻快的节奏
v. 轻快地说或唱

e.en: There's a soft Irish {lilt} in her voice.
e.zh: 她的声音里带着柔和的爱尔兰腔调。

e.en: The song has a cheerful {lilt} that makes you smile.
e.zh: 这首歌有一种欢快的节奏,让人忍不住微笑。

e.en: She sang a {lilting} lullaby to the baby.
e.zh: 她给宝宝唱了一首轻快悦耳的摇篮曲。

e.en: His {lilting} accent charmed everyone at the dinner.
e.zh: 他抑扬顿挫的口音让晚宴上的每个人都很着迷。

e.en: A single white {lily} stood in the vase by the window.
e.zh: 窗边的花瓶里插着一枝白百合。

e.en: My niece {Lily} just started kindergarten this week.
e.zh: 我侄女莉莉这周刚开始上幼儿园。

e.en: We spent three days exploring {Lima} before heading to Cusco.
e.zh: 我们在利马待了三天才前往库斯科。

e.en: {Lima} beans are a healthy source of protein and fiber.
e.zh: 利马豆是蛋白质和纤维的健康来源。

limassol.t: n. 利马索尔（塞浦路斯城市）

e.en: {Limassol} has become a popular destination for tech expats.
e.zh: 利马索尔已成为科技行业外籍人士的热门居住地。

e.en: We rented an apartment near the {Limassol} marina.
e.zh: 我们在利马索尔码头附近租了一间公寓。

e.en: The cat crawled out onto a thin {limb} of the oak tree.
e.zh: 那只猫爬到了橡树的一根细枝上。

e.en: The accident left him without the use of one {limb}.
e.zh: 那次事故让他失去了一只肢体的功能。

limber.t:
adj. 柔软灵活的
v. 活动筋骨

e.en: Yoga keeps her {limber} even in her sixties.
e.zh: 瑜伽让她六十多岁了仍然身手灵活。

e.en: The dancers stretched to {limber} up before rehearsal.
e.zh: 舞者们在排练前做拉伸来活动身体。

e.en: The {limbic} system processes emotions and memory.
e.zh: 边缘系统负责处理情绪和记忆。

e.en: Stress activates the {limbic} regions of the brain.
e.zh: 压力会激活大脑的边缘区域。

e.en: Snakes are {limbless} reptiles that move by slithering.
e.zh: 蛇是没有四肢的爬行动物,通过蜿蜒游动。

e.en: The veteran wrote a memoir about life as a {limbless} survivor.
e.zh: 那位老兵写了一本回忆录,讲述失去四肢后的幸存生活。

limbo.t: n. 不确定状态；林波舞

e.en: Our visa application has been in {limbo} for months.
e.zh: 我们的签证申请已经悬而未决好几个月了。

e.en: Guests laughed as they tried the {limbo} dance at the party.
e.zh: 派对上客人们一边大笑一边尝试跳林波舞。

e.en: After the long flight, she stretched her stiff {limbs}.
e.zh: 长途飞行后,她伸展了一下僵硬的四肢。

e.en: Strong winds snapped several {limbs} from the old tree.
e.zh: 大风折断了那棵老树的好几根枝干。

e.en: Add a slice of {lime} to your sparkling water.
e.zh: 在你的气泡水里加一片青柠吧。

e.en: The walls were painted a bright {lime} green.
e.zh: 墙被刷成了鲜艳的青柠绿。

e.en: On hot days, nothing beats a glass of fresh {limeade}.
e.zh: 炎热的日子里,没有什么比一杯鲜榨青柠汁更爽的了。

e.en: She sells homemade {limeade} at the farmers market.
e.zh: 她在农夫市集上卖自制的青柠汽水。

limed.t: v. 撒石灰；用石灰处理

e.en: The farmer {limed} the soil to reduce its acidity.
e.zh: 农夫给土壤撒了石灰来降低酸度。

e.en: The carpenter {limed} the oak to give it a weathered look.
e.zh: 木匠用石灰处理橡木,让它呈现出陈旧的质感。

limehouse.t: n. 莱姆豪斯（伦敦地名）

e.en: {Limehouse} was once London's bustling Chinatown.
e.zh: 莱姆豪斯曾经是伦敦繁华的唐人街。

e.en: The novelist set his mystery in old {Limehouse}.
e.zh: 那位小说家把他的悬疑故事设定在旧时的莱姆豪斯。

e.en: The young actress quickly stepped into the {limelight}.
e.zh: 这位年轻女演员很快走进了公众的聚光灯下。

e.en: He prefers writing songs to standing in the {limelight}.
e.zh: 比起站在镁光灯下,他更喜欢写歌。

limerick.t: n. 五行打油诗；利默里克（爱尔兰城市）

e.en: He wrote a funny {limerick} about his cat.
e.zh: 他写了一首关于他家猫的搞笑五行打油诗。

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring castles near {Limerick}, Ireland.
e.zh: 我们花了一个周末在爱尔兰利默里克附近游览城堡。

e.en: The cathedral was built from local {limestone} centuries ago.
e.zh: 这座大教堂几个世纪前用当地的石灰岩建成。

e.en: Caves often form when water dissolves {limestone}.
e.zh: 溶洞通常是水溶解石灰岩后形成的。

limey.t: n. 英国人（俚语，略带贬义）

e.en: American sailors used to call British seamen {limey}.
e.zh: 美国水手过去把英国船员叫作"莱姆人"。

e.en: He jokingly calls his British coworker a {limey}.
e.zh: 他开玩笑地称呼他的英国同事为"英国佬"。

liminal.t: adj. 临界的；过渡状态的

e.en: Empty hallways at night feel strangely {liminal}.
e.zh: 夜里空荡的走廊给人一种奇怪的过渡感。

e.en: Adolescence is a {liminal} stage between childhood and adulthood.
e.zh: 青春期是介于童年与成年之间的过渡阶段。

e.en: The film explores the {liminality} of airport waiting rooms.
e.zh: 这部电影探讨了机场候机厅那种过渡性的氛围。

e.en: Anthropologists study {liminality} in coming-of-age rituals.
e.zh: 人类学家研究成年礼中的过渡阈限状态。

limit.t:
n. 限制；极限
v. 限制

e.en: There's a daily {limit} on free API requests.
e.zh: 免费 API 请求每天有数量上限。

e.en: Try not to {limit} yourself to one career path.
e.zh: 尽量不要把自己局限在单一的职业道路上。

e.en: The main {limitation} of this phone is its battery life.
e.zh: 这款手机最大的局限就是电池续航。

e.en: Knowing your own {limitation} is a kind of strength.
e.zh: 了解自己的局限,本身就是一种力量。

e.en: Every machine learning model has its {limitations}.
e.zh: 每个机器学习模型都有它的局限性。

e.en: He refused to accept the {limitations} doctors placed on him.
e.zh: 他拒绝接受医生给他设下的种种限制。

e.en: Tickets are {limited}, so book early to avoid disappointment.
e.zh: 票数有限,请尽早预订以免向隅。

e.en: My free trial gave me {limited} access to premium features.
e.zh: 我的免费试用只能有限地使用高级功能。

e.en: The audio engineer added a {limiter} to prevent clipping.
e.zh: 音频工程师加了一个限幅器来防止削波失真。

e.en: A speed {limiter} keeps the truck below 90 km/h.
e.zh: 限速器让卡车的车速保持在每小时 90 公里以下。

limiting.t:
adj. 限制性的
v. 限制（limit 的现在分词）

e.en: Self-doubt can be a {limiting} belief in your career.
e.zh: 自我怀疑可能是事业上一种自我设限的信念。

e.en: The app is {limiting} my screen time after ten p.m.
e.zh: 这个应用在晚上十点后会限制我的屏幕使用时间。

limitless.t: adj. 无限的；无边无际的

e.en: Children seem to have {limitless} energy on weekends.
e.zh: 周末时孩子们的精力似乎无穷无尽。

e.en: Cloud computing offers nearly {limitless} storage options.
e.zh: 云计算提供了几乎无限的存储选择。

e.en: Standing on the cliff, she felt the {limitlessness} of the ocean.
e.zh: 站在悬崖上,她感受到海洋的无边无际。

e.en: The book celebrates the {limitlessness} of human imagination.
e.zh: 这本书赞颂了人类想象力的无穷无尽。

limits.t:
n. 极限；界限
v. 限制（limit 的第三人称单数）

e.en: The new chip pushes the {limits} of mobile performance.
e.zh: 这款新芯片把移动端性能推向了极限。

e.en: Smoking is not allowed within city {limits}.
e.zh: 市区范围内禁止吸烟。

e.en: The novel beautifully {limns} life in a small village.
e.zh: 这部小说细腻地描绘了小村庄的生活。

e.en: Her essay tries to {limn} the mood of a generation.
e.zh: 她的散文试图勾勒出一代人的精神面貌。

e.en: The colonial {limner} painted portraits of wealthy merchants.
e.zh: 那位殖民时期的肖像画家为富商们画像。

e.en: As a {limner}, she captures faces with remarkable precision.
e.zh: 作为一位肖像画家,她对面孔的刻画极其精准。

e.en: She studies {limnology} to understand freshwater ecosystems.
e.zh: 她研究湖沼学,以了解淡水生态系统。

e.en: Climate change is reshaping the field of {limnology}.
e.zh: 气候变化正在重塑湖沼学这个领域。

limo.t: n. 豪华轿车（limousine 的缩写）

e.en: A black {limo} picked them up at the airport.
e.zh: 一辆黑色加长轿车到机场接他们。

e.en: The couple rented a {limo} for their wedding day.
e.zh: 这对新人婚礼当天租了一辆豪华轿车。

limoge.t: n. 利摩日（法国城市，以瓷器闻名）

e.en: My grandmother collects delicate {Limoge} porcelain boxes.
e.zh: 我奶奶收藏精致的利摩日瓷盒。

e.en: The shop specializes in antique {Limoge} dinnerware.
e.zh: 这家店专营古董利摩日餐具。

limousin.t: n. 利穆赞（法国大区；一种牛品种）

e.en: {Limousin} cattle are prized for their lean, tender beef.
e.zh: 利穆赞牛因其精瘦鲜嫩的牛肉而备受推崇。

e.en: We rented a farmhouse in the {Limousin} region of France.
e.zh: 我们在法国利穆赞地区租了一栋农舍。

e.en: A black {limousine} pulled up outside the hotel entrance.
e.zh: 一辆黑色豪华轿车停在酒店门口。

e.en: They rented a stretch {limousine} for the prom night.
e.zh: 他们租了一辆加长豪华轿车去参加毕业舞会。

limp.t:
v. 跛行；一瘸一拐地走
adj. 软弱的；无力的

e.en: The lettuce went {limp} after sitting in the sun.
e.zh: 生菜在太阳下放了一会儿就蔫了。

e.en: He developed a slight {limp} after the soccer match.
e.zh: 踢完那场足球赛后,他走路有点跛。

limped.t: v. 跛行（limp 的过去式）

e.en: The injured player {limped} off the field slowly.
e.zh: 受伤的球员一瘸一拐地慢慢走下场。

e.en: The damaged ship {limped} back to port at dawn.
e.zh: 受损的船只在黎明时分艰难地驶回港口。

limpet.t: n. 帽贝；难以摆脱的人

e.en: A {limpet} clung tightly to the wet rock.
e.zh: 一只帽贝紧紧吸附在湿漉漉的岩石上。

e.en: The toddler stuck to his mother like a {limpet}.
e.zh: 那个小孩像帽贝一样黏着妈妈。

e.en: We swam in the {limpid} waters of the lake.
e.zh: 我们在清澈见底的湖水里游泳。

e.en: Her writing has a {limpid} style that anyone can follow.
e.zh: 她的文笔清晰流畅,人人都能读懂。

limping.t: v. 跛行（limp 的现在分词）

e.en: The dog came {limping} home with a hurt paw.
e.zh: 那只狗一瘸一拐地回到家,爪子受了伤。

e.en: The economy is still {limping} along after the recession.
e.zh: 经济在衰退之后仍然举步维艰。

e.en: His arm hung {limply} at his side after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒之后,他的胳膊无力地垂在身侧。

e.en: She shook his hand {limply} and looked away.
e.zh: 她有气无力地握了握他的手,然后把视线移开。

e.en: The {limpness} of the flowers showed they needed water.
e.zh: 花朵的萎软表明它们需要浇水了。

e.en: He noticed a strange {limpness} in his left hand.
e.zh: 他发现自己的左手出现了奇怪的无力感。

limps.t: v. 跛行（limp 的第三人称单数）

e.en: He still {limps} a little after the knee surgery.
e.zh: 膝盖手术后他走路仍有点跛。

e.en: The startup {limps} from one funding round to the next.
e.zh: 那家初创公司勉强从一轮融资熬到下一轮。

linac.t: n. 直线加速器（linear accelerator 的缩写）

e.en: The hospital installed a new {linac} for cancer treatment.
e.zh: 医院新装了一台用于癌症治疗的直线加速器。

e.en: Engineers calibrated the {linac} before the morning sessions.
e.zh: 工程师在上午治疗前校准了这台直线加速器。

e.en: Newspapers used to charge ads by the {linage}.
e.zh: 以前报纸是按行数来收广告费的。

e.en: The editor counted the {linage} of every column.
e.zh: 编辑数着每一栏文字的行数。

linchpin.t: n. 关键人物；核心要素

e.en: Trust is the {linchpin} of any good partnership.
e.zh: 信任是任何良好合作关系的关键。

e.en: She became the {linchpin} of the entire research team.
e.zh: 她成了整个研究团队的核心人物。

e.en: President {Lincoln} signed the Emancipation Proclamation in 1863.
e.zh: 林肯总统于1863年签署了《解放奴隶宣言》。

e.en: We visited the {Lincoln} Memorial on our trip to Washington.
e.zh: 我们去华盛顿旅行时参观了林肯纪念堂。

e.en: She grew up on a farm in {Lincolnshire}, England.
e.zh: 她在英格兰林肯郡的一个农场长大。

e.en: {Lincolnshire} is famous for its flat fields and big skies.
e.zh: 林肯郡以平坦的田野和广阔的天空而闻名。

lincs.t: n. 林肯郡（Lincolnshire 的缩写）

e.en: The package was shipped from a warehouse in {Lincs}.
e.zh: 包裹是从林肯郡的一个仓库发出的。

e.en: He drives across {Lincs} every weekend to visit family.
e.zh: 他每个周末都开车穿过林肯郡去探亲。

e.en: Many countries have banned {lindane} due to health concerns.
e.zh: 许多国家因健康问题禁用了林丹这种农药。

e.en: Old shampoos containing {lindane} were used to treat lice.
e.zh: 含有林丹的老式洗发水曾被用来治疗虱子。

lindbergh.t: n. 林德伯格（美国飞行员姓氏）

e.en: {Lindbergh} flew solo across the Atlantic in 1927.
e.zh: 林白于1927年单人飞越大西洋。

e.en: The {Lindbergh} kidnapping case shocked the entire nation.
e.zh: 林白绑架案震惊了整个国家。

e.en: Bees buzzed around the blooming {linden} tree all afternoon.
e.zh: 蜜蜂整个下午都在盛开的椴树周围嗡嗡飞舞。

e.en: She poured herself a cup of warm {linden} tea.
e.zh: 她给自己倒了一杯温热的椴花茶。

lindi.t: n. 林迪（坦桑尼亚地名）

e.en: The fishing boats returned to {Lindi} harbor at sunset.
e.zh: 渔船在日落时分返回林迪港。

e.en: {Lindi} is a coastal town in southeastern Tanzania.
e.zh: 林迪是坦桑尼亚东南部的一座沿海小镇。

lindisfarne.t: n. 林迪斯法恩（英国圣岛）

e.en: Tourists cross the causeway to {Lindisfarne} only at low tide.
e.zh: 游客只能在退潮时通过堤道前往林迪斯法恩岛。

e.en: The {Lindisfarne} Gospels are a famous medieval manuscript.
e.zh: 《林迪斯法恩福音书》是一部著名的中世纪手稿。

lindy.t: n. 林迪舞（一种摇摆舞）

e.en: They learned to {Lindy} hop at a swing dance class.
e.zh: 他们在一节摇摆舞课上学会了跳林迪舞。

e.en: The couple won the {Lindy} contest with a wild routine.
e.zh: 那对舞者凭借一段火爆的舞蹈赢得了林迪舞比赛。

line.t:
n. 线；行；队列
v. 排列；衬里

e.en: Please stand in {line} and wait your turn.
e.zh: 请排队等候叫号。

e.en: Draw a straight {line} from corner to corner.
e.zh: 从一个角到另一个角画一条直线。

e.en: The festival announced an exciting {line-up} for next summer.
e.zh: 音乐节公布了明年夏天激动人心的演出阵容。

e.en: Witnesses identified the suspect from a police {line-up}.
e.zh: 目击者从警方的列队辨认中指认出了嫌疑人。

e.en: Both teams revealed their starting {line-ups} before kickoff.
e.zh: 两队在开球前公布了各自的首发阵容。

e.en: The conference posted speaker {line-ups} for all three days.
e.zh: 会议公布了三天的演讲嘉宾名单。

e.en: She traced her family {lineage} back five hundred years.
e.zh: 她把家族世系一直追溯到五百年前。

e.en: This horse has a champion racing {lineage}.
e.zh: 这匹马有冠军赛马的血统。

e.en: He is a {lineal} descendant of the original founder.
e.zh: 他是原始创始人的直系后代。

e.en: Only {lineal} heirs can inherit under this clause.
e.zh: 根据此条款,只有直系继承人才有继承权。

e.en: Every {lineament} of his face revealed deep exhaustion.
e.zh: 他脸上的每一条轮廓都流露出深深的疲惫。

e.en: Geologists mapped a major {lineament} across the desert.
e.zh: 地质学家在沙漠上标绘出一条重要的线性构造。

lineaments.t: n. 面貌特征（lineament 的复数）

e.en: The artist sketched the delicate {lineaments} of her face.
e.zh: 画家勾勒出她面庞那精致的轮廓。

e.en: Satellite images reveal the geological {lineaments} of the region.
e.zh: 卫星图像揭示了该地区的地质线性构造。

e.en: The story follows a simple {linear} timeline.
e.zh: 这个故事按简单的线性时间顺序展开。

e.en: Sales grew in a {linear} fashion throughout the year.
e.zh: 销售额全年呈线性增长。

e.en: The chart confirmed perfect {linearity} between dose and response.
e.zh: 图表证实了剂量与反应之间的完美线性关系。

e.en: Modern novels often break the {linearity} of traditional storytelling.
e.zh: 现代小说常常打破传统叙事的线性结构。

e.en: The cost increases {linearly} with the number of users.
e.zh: 成本随用户数量呈线性增长。

e.en: Children don't always learn {linearly} from chapter to chapter.
e.zh: 孩子们并不总是按章节顺序线性地学习。

linebacker.t: n. 线卫（橄榄球防守位置）

e.en: The {linebacker} crushed the quarterback behind the line.
e.zh: 那名线卫在阵线后方把四分卫扑倒。

e.en: He's built like a {linebacker} but plays the violin.
e.zh: 他身材壮得像个橄榄球线卫,却拉得一手好小提琴。

linebacking.t: n. 橄榄球中后卫的防守位置

e.en: His {linebacking} skills earned him a college scholarship.
e.zh: 他的线卫技术为他赢得了大学奖学金。

e.en: The coach praised the team's aggressive {linebacking} all season.
e.zh: 教练整个赛季都在称赞球队凶狠的线卫表现。

lined.t:
adj. 有衬里的；有线条的
v. line 的过去式

e.en: Tall trees {lined} the road on both sides.
e.zh: 高大的树木在道路两旁排列成行。

e.en: She bought a notebook with {lined} pages for class.
e.zh: 她为上课买了一本横线纸的笔记本。

lineman.t: n. 电线维修工；（橄榄球）前锋线球员

e.en: A {lineman} climbed the pole to fix the broken cable.
e.zh: 一名线路工爬上电线杆去修理断了的电缆。

e.en: The offensive {lineman} weighed over three hundred pounds.
e.zh: 那名进攻线锋体重超过三百磅。

e.en: He wore a crisp white {linen} shirt to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿了一件挺括的白色亚麻衬衫去参加婚礼。

e.en: The hotel changes the {linen} every other day.
e.zh: 酒店每隔一天更换一次床单被罩。

linens.t: n. 床单、桌布等亚麻织物

e.en: Fresh {linens} were folded neatly on every bed.
e.zh: 干净的床上用品整齐地叠放在每张床上。

e.en: She bought new table {linens} for the holiday dinner.
e.zh: 她为节日晚餐买了新的桌布。

e.en: The flanker won the {lineout} with a perfect jump.
e.zh: 边锋以一次完美的起跳赢得了边线球。

e.en: A clean {lineout} can change the momentum of a match.
e.zh: 一次干净利落的边线球可以改变比赛的走势。

e.en: The luxury cruise {liner} can carry six thousand passengers.
e.zh: 这艘豪华邮轮可容纳六千名乘客。

e.en: She applied black eye {liner} carefully before the party.
e.zh: 派对前她仔细地涂上了黑色眼线。

e.en: Place plastic {liners} in each bin before adding trash.
e.zh: 在每个垃圾桶里先套好塑料袋再丢垃圾。

e.en: Cruise {liners} dock at the harbor every Tuesday morning.
e.zh: 邮轮每周二早上停靠在港口。

lines.t:
n. 线条；台词；行
v. 排列

e.en: The actor forgot his {lines} during the second act.
e.zh: 演员在第二幕时忘了台词。

e.en: Long {lines} formed outside the new bakery.
e.zh: 新开的面包店外排起了长队。

e.en: The {linesman} raised his flag to signal offside.
e.zh: 巡边员举旗示意越位。

e.en: A {linesman} called the ball out, ending the rally.
e.zh: 司线员判球出界,结束了这一回合。

e.en: Netflix announced its {lineup} of new shows for fall.
e.zh: 奈飞公布了秋季新剧的播出阵容。

e.en: The witness picked the suspect out of a {lineup}.
e.zh: 目击者从列队辨认中认出了嫌疑人。

e.en: The fisherman caught a large {ling} off the coast.
e.zh: 渔民在近海捕到了一条大鳕鱼。

e.en: Purple {ling} covered the moors in late summer.
e.zh: 夏末时节,紫色的石南花覆盖了整片荒原。

lingcod.t: n. 北太平洋产的六线鱼

e.en: We grilled fresh {lingcod} fillets for dinner last night.
e.zh: 我们昨晚把新鲜的长身鳕鱼柳烤来吃。

e.en: {Lingcod} is a popular catch along the Pacific coast.
e.zh: 长身鳕鱼是太平洋沿岸常见的渔获。

linger.t: v. 逗留；迟迟不去；余韵萦绕

e.en: The smell of coffee tends to {linger} in the kitchen.
e.zh: 咖啡的香味往往会在厨房里久久不散。

e.en: Don't {linger} too long after the meeting ends.
e.zh: 会议结束后别逗留太久。

lingered.t: v. linger 的过去式；流连

e.en: She {lingered} by the window, hoping he would call.
e.zh: 她在窗边徘徊,希望他会打来电话。

e.en: Doubts about the decision {lingered} for weeks afterward.
e.zh: 对那个决定的疑虑在之后持续了好几周。

lingerie.t: n. 女士内衣；贴身衣物

e.en: The store has a beautiful selection of silk {lingerie}.
e.zh: 那家店里有一系列漂亮的真丝内衣。

e.en: She bought new {lingerie} as a birthday treat.
e.zh: 她买了新的内衣作为送给自己的生日礼物。

lingering.t: adj. 挥之不去的；拖延的

e.en: He still has a {lingering} cough from last month's cold.
e.zh: 上个月的感冒让他还留着挥之不去的咳嗽。

e.en: There's a {lingering} doubt about whether the data is accurate.
e.zh: 对数据是否准确仍存有挥之不去的疑虑。

lingeringly.t: adv. 依依不舍地；缓慢地

e.en: She gazed {lingeringly} at the photograph one last time.
e.zh: 她依依不舍地最后看了那张照片一眼。

e.en: The final note faded {lingeringly} into the silent hall.
e.zh: 最后一个音符在寂静的大厅里久久回荡。

lingers.t: v. linger 的第三人称单数

e.en: The smell of coffee {lingers} in the kitchen all morning.
e.zh: 咖啡的香味整个上午都弥漫在厨房里。

e.en: Doubt still {lingers} in her mind after the meeting.
e.zh: 会议结束后她心中仍有疑虑。

e.en: Tech {lingo} can confuse new employees in the office.
e.zh: 科技行话常让新员工感到困惑。

e.en: He picked up the local {lingo} after a few months abroad.
e.zh: 出国几个月后他就学会了当地的俚语。

lings.t: n. ling 的复数；石楠/鳕鱼

e.en: Fishermen caught several {lings} off the rocky coast.
e.zh: 渔民们在岩石海岸边捕到了几条鳕鱼。

e.en: The market sells fresh {lings} every Saturday morning.
e.zh: 市场每周六早上都卖新鲜的鳕鱼。

lingua.t: n. 语言（拉丁语词根）；舌

e.en: English serves as the {lingua} franca of international business.
e.zh: 英语是国际商务中的通用语言。

e.en: Latin was once the {lingua} franca of European scholars.
e.zh: 拉丁语曾是欧洲学者的通用语。

e.en: The dentist examined the {lingual} surface of her teeth.
e.zh: 牙医检查了她牙齿的舌侧表面。

e.en: Some sounds require precise {lingual} movements to pronounce.
e.zh: 有些音需要精确的舌头动作才能发出。

e.en: She ordered {linguine} with clams at the Italian restaurant.
e.zh: 她在意大利餐厅点了蛤蜊扁意面。

e.en: Fresh {linguine} cooks in just three minutes.
e.zh: 新鲜的扁意面只需三分钟就能煮好。

linguini.t: n. 意大利扁面条（linguine 异拼）

e.en: He twirled the {linguini} around his fork expertly.
e.zh: 他熟练地把扁意面卷在叉子上。

e.en: This sauce pairs perfectly with {linguini} or spaghetti.
e.zh: 这种酱料和扁意面或意粉都很搭。

linguist.t: n. 语言学家；通晓多语者

e.en: The {linguist} studies endangered languages in remote villages.
e.zh: 这位语言学家研究偏远村庄的濒危语言。

e.en: As a {linguist}, she speaks seven languages fluently.
e.zh: 作为语言学家,她能流利地说七种语言。

e.en: The book explores {linguistic} differences between dialects.
e.zh: 这本书探讨了方言之间的语言差异。

e.en: Children develop {linguistic} skills very rapidly.
e.zh: 孩子们的语言能力发展得非常迅速。

linguistically.t: adv. 语言学上；在语言方面

e.en: Switzerland is {linguistically} diverse with four official languages.
e.zh: 瑞士在语言上很多元,有四种官方语言。

e.en: The two regions are {linguistically} similar but culturally distinct.
e.zh: 这两个地区语言相近但文化迥异。

e.en: She majored in {linguistics} at university.
e.zh: 她在大学主修语言学。

e.en: Modern {linguistics} draws heavily on cognitive science.
e.zh: 现代语言学大量借鉴了认知科学。

e.en: He rubbed {liniment} on his sore back after the run.
e.zh: 跑步后他在酸痛的背上涂了搽剂。

e.en: The herbal {liniment} eased her aching muscles.
e.zh: 草药搽剂缓解了她肌肉的酸痛。

lining.t:
n. 衬里；内衬
v. line 的现在分词

e.en: The jacket has a soft silk {lining} for warmth.
e.zh: 这件外套有柔软的丝绸内衬保暖。

e.en: Every cloud has a silver {lining}, as the saying goes.
e.zh: 俗话说,每朵乌云都有银边。

link.t:
n. 链接；联系
v. 连接；关联

e.en: Click the {link} below to reset your password.
e.zh: 点击下方链接重置密码。

e.en: Scientists found a {link} between diet and longevity.
e.zh: 科学家发现饮食与长寿之间存在关联。

linkage.t: n. 联动；关联；连接方式

e.en: The study revealed a clear {linkage} between stress and illness.
e.zh: 研究揭示了压力与疾病之间的明显关联。

e.en: Engineers redesigned the mechanical {linkage} for better performance.
e.zh: 工程师重新设计了机械连杆以提高性能。

linked.t:
adj. 关联的
v. link 的过去式

e.en: Her account is {linked} to her phone number.
e.zh: 她的账户已绑定手机号码。

e.en: Researchers {linked} the outbreak to contaminated water.
e.zh: 研究人员将疫情归因于受污染的水。

linker.t: n. 链接器（编译工具）；连接者

e.en: The compiler invokes the {linker} after generating object files.
e.zh: 编译器在生成目标文件后会调用链接器。

e.en: A configuration error caused the {linker} to fail.
e.zh: 配置错误导致链接器运行失败。

linking.t:
v. 连接；关联
n. 链接

e.en: The app supports {linking} multiple bank accounts.
e.zh: 这款应用支持绑定多个银行账户。

e.en: She is {linking} her social media profiles together.
e.zh: 她正在把自己的社交媒体账号互相关联。

links.t:
n. link 的复数；高尔夫球场
v. 连接

e.en: Please share the relevant {links} in the chat.
e.zh: 请在聊天里分享相关链接。

e.en: The article {links} climate change to extreme weather.
e.zh: 这篇文章把气候变化与极端天气联系起来。

e.en: Mary Queen of Scots was born at {Linlithgow} Palace.
e.zh: 苏格兰玛丽女王出生于林利斯戈宫。

e.en: We took a day trip from Edinburgh to {Linlithgow}.
e.zh: 我们从爱丁堡出发去林利斯戈一日游。

e.en: Biologists still rely on the {Linnaean} classification system today.
e.zh: 生物学家至今仍依赖林奈分类系统。

e.en: The species was named according to {Linnaean} conventions.
e.zh: 该物种是按照林奈命名法命名的。

e.en: The {Linnean} Society of London promotes natural history research.
e.zh: 伦敦林奈学会促进博物学研究。

e.en: Darwin first presented his theory at a {Linnean} meeting.
e.zh: 达尔文最早在林奈学会的会议上发表了他的理论。

e.en: A small {linnet} sang sweetly from the hedgerow.
e.zh: 一只小红雀在树篱里婉转地鸣唱。

e.en: The {linnet} is a common songbird across Europe.
e.zh: 红雀是欧洲常见的鸣禽。

e.en: The kitchen floor is covered with old green {lino}.
e.zh: 厨房地板上铺着老旧的绿色油毡。

e.en: They peeled up the worn {lino} to expose hardwood.
e.zh: 他们揭开磨损的油毡,露出了硬木地板。

linocut.t: n. 油毡版画；油毡雕刻术

e.en: She made a beautiful {linocut} print of a bird.
e.zh: 她制作了一幅漂亮的鸟类油毡版画。

e.en: The art class learned basic {linocut} techniques today.
e.zh: 美术课今天学习了基础的油毡版画技法。

linoleum.t: n. 油毡；漆布地板材料

e.en: The diner still has its original 1950s {linoleum} floor.
e.zh: 这家餐馆还保留着1950年代的原版油毡地板。

e.en: She mopped the {linoleum} until it gleamed.
e.zh: 她把油毡地板拖得闪闪发亮。

linotype.t: n. 莱诺整行铸排机；行型活字

e.en: Newspapers once relied on {linotype} machines for typesetting.
e.zh: 报纸曾依靠莱诺铸排机进行排版。

e.en: The museum displays a working {linotype} from the 1920s.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一台1920年代仍能运转的铸排机。

e.en: He sprinkled {linseed} on his yogurt for extra fiber.
e.zh: 他在酸奶上撒了亚麻籽以补充纤维。

e.en: Painters use {linseed} oil to thin their oil paints.
e.zh: 画家用亚麻籽油来稀释油画颜料。

lint.t: n. 棉绒；绒毛；（代码）静态检查

e.en: There's some {lint} stuck to your black sweater.
e.zh: 你的黑毛衣上粘了一些棉绒。

e.en: The {lint} tool flagged several errors in my code.
e.zh: 代码检查工具在我的代码里标出了几个错误。

e.en: The stone {lintel} above the door is centuries old.
e.zh: 门上那根石头门楣已有几百年历史。

e.en: He bumped his head on the low wooden {lintel}.
e.zh: 他的头撞到了那根低矮的木门楣。

listenable.t: adj. 悦耳的；值得一听的

e.en: The new album is surprisingly {listenable} from start to finish.
e.zh: 这张新专辑从头到尾都出奇地耐听。

e.en: His voice makes even dry topics sound {listenable}.
e.zh: 他的声音让枯燥的话题也变得动听。

e.en: She {listened} patiently to every word her grandmother said.
e.zh: 她耐心地听着祖母说的每一句话。

e.en: I {listened} to that song on repeat all weekend.
e.zh: 我整个周末都在循环听那首歌。

e.en: He's a great {listener} who never interrupts you.
e.zh: 他是个很好的倾听者,从不打断别人。

e.en: Each {listener} can submit questions through the app.
e.zh: 每位听众都可以通过应用提交问题。

e.en: The podcast now has over a million regular {listeners}.
e.zh: 这档播客现在拥有超过一百万的固定听众。

e.en: Radio {listeners} called in to share their stories.
e.zh: 广播听众纷纷打电话进来分享他们的故事。

listenership.t: n. 听众人数；收听群体

e.en: The morning show's {listenership} doubled after the rebrand.
e.zh: 该晨间节目改版后听众数量翻了一倍。

e.en: Spotify reported a record {listenership} for podcasts last year.
e.zh: Spotify报告称去年播客听众数量创下历史新高。

e.en: I'm {listening} to a great audiobook right now.
e.zh: 我正在听一本很棒的有声书。

e.en: Active {listening} is the key to good communication.
e.zh: 积极倾听是良好沟通的关键。

listens.t: v. listen 的第三人称单数

e.en: The new single already has ten million {listens} on Spotify.
e.zh: 这首新单曲在Spotify上已有一千万次播放。

e.en: She always {listens} carefully when her students speak.
e.zh: 她总是认真倾听学生们的发言。

e.en: The Airbnb {lister} responded to my question within minutes.
e.zh: Airbnb房东几分钟内就回复了我的问题。

e.en: Each {lister} on the marketplace must verify their identity.
e.zh: 平台上的每位卖家都必须完成身份验证。

e.en: Several brands of cheese were recalled due to {listeria} contamination.
e.zh: 多个品牌的奶酪因李斯特菌污染被召回。

e.en: Pregnant women are advised to avoid foods that may carry {listeria}.
e.zh: 建议孕妇避免食用可能含有李斯特菌的食物。

e.en: The hospital reported three cases of {listeriosis} this week.
e.zh: 医院本周报告了三例李斯特菌病病例。

e.en: {Listeriosis} can be especially dangerous for older adults.
e.zh: 李斯特菌病对老年人来说尤其危险。

listing.t: n. 列表；(房屋、商品的) 挂牌

e.en: The Airbnb {listing} had great photos but poor reviews.
e.zh: 那个Airbnb房源照片很漂亮,但评价不太好。

e.en: The company is preparing for a stock market {listing} next month.
e.zh: 该公司正准备下个月在股市挂牌上市。

e.en: I scrolled through dozens of apartment {listings} this morning.
e.zh: 今早我刷了几十条公寓出租信息。

e.en: Job {listings} on LinkedIn surged after the new year.
e.zh: 新年过后,领英上的招聘信息激增。

listless.t: adj. 无精打采的；倦怠的

e.en: The summer heat left everyone feeling {listless} and tired.
e.zh: 夏日的炎热让每个人都无精打采、疲惫不堪。

e.en: He gave a {listless} reply and went back to bed.
e.zh: 他无力地回了一句,又回去睡觉了。

e.en: She stirred her coffee {listlessly}, lost in thought.
e.zh: 她心不在焉地搅着咖啡,陷入沉思。

e.en: The students stared {listlessly} out the classroom window.
e.zh: 学生们无精打采地望着教室窗外。

e.en: His sudden {listlessness} worried his parents and teachers.
e.zh: 他突然变得无精打采,让父母和老师都很担心。

e.en: Poor sleep often causes {listlessness} the next day.
e.zh: 睡眠不佳常导致第二天精神萎靡。

lists.t:
n. 列表（复数）
v. list 的第三人称单数

e.en: She makes {lists} for everything, from groceries to goals.
e.zh: 她什么都要列清单,从购物到目标都是。

e.en: The website {lists} the top restaurants in each city.
e.zh: 这个网站列出了每个城市最好的餐厅。

e.en: Subscribe to the department {listserv} for weekly updates.
e.zh: 订阅该系的邮件列表可以获得每周更新。

e.en: He accidentally replied to the entire company {listserv}.
e.zh: 他不小心回复给了全公司的邮件列表。

liszt.t: n. 李斯特（匈牙利作曲家）

e.en: She played a difficult {Liszt} sonata at the recital.
e.zh: 她在演奏会上弹奏了一首难度很高的李斯特奏鸣曲。

e.en: {Liszt} was famous across Europe for his piano virtuosity.
e.zh: 李斯特以其精湛的钢琴技艺闻名整个欧洲。

lit.t:
v. light 的过去式，点燃；照亮
adj. 极赞的（俚语）

e.en: She {lit} a candle and made a quiet wish.
e.zh: 她点燃了一支蜡烛,默默许下心愿。

e.en: The concert last night was absolutely {lit}.
e.zh: 昨晚的演唱会简直嗨翻了。

litany.t: n. 一长串（抱怨、问题等）；连祷文

e.en: He recited a {litany} of complaints about his old job.
e.zh: 他对自己以前的工作发了一连串的抱怨。

e.en: The report contains a {litany} of safety violations.
e.zh: 这份报告列出了一长串安全违规事项。

lite.t: adj. 精简的；低卡的（light 的变体）

e.en: I usually order the {lite} version of this beer.
e.zh: 我通常点这款啤酒的清淡版本。

e.en: The free app is a {lite} version with fewer features.
e.zh: 这款免费应用是功能较少的精简版。

e.en: Please buy a {liter} of milk on your way home.
e.zh: 回家路上请买一升牛奶。

e.en: The car's engine has a two-{liter} capacity.
e.zh: 这辆车的发动机排量为两升。

literacies.t: n. 读写能力；素养（复数）

e.en: Modern education promotes multiple {literacies}, including digital and media.
e.zh: 现代教育注重多种素养,包括数字素养和媒体素养。

e.en: Schools must address financial and emotional {literacies} too.
e.zh: 学校也必须重视金融素养和情感素养。

literacy.t: n. 识字；读写能力；某领域素养

e.en: Digital {literacy} is now essential for almost every job.
e.zh: 数字素养如今对几乎每份工作都至关重要。

e.en: The program raises adult {literacy} rates in rural areas.
e.zh: 该项目提高了农村地区成年人的识字率。

literal.t:
adj. 字面的；逐字的
n. 字面量（编程）

e.en: Don't take his comment in the {literal} sense.
e.zh: 不要从字面意义上理解他的话。

e.en: The {literal} translation often sounds awkward in English.
e.zh: 直译过来在英文里往往听起来很别扭。

literalism.t: n. 拘泥字面；直译主义

e.en: Strict {literalism} can make poetry lose its beauty.
e.zh: 过于死板的字面解读会让诗歌失去韵味。

e.en: His {literalism} in reading the contract caused real problems.
e.zh: 他对合同的死板解读真的引发了麻烦。

e.en: The {literalization} of the metaphor ruined the poem's deeper meaning.
e.zh: 将这个隐喻字面化破坏了诗的深层含义。

e.en: Critics noted the film's {literalization} of the novel's symbolic ending.
e.zh: 评论家指出这部电影把小说的象征性结尾直白化了。

literalize.t: v. 使字面化；按字面理解

e.en: Some directors {literalize} every metaphor in the original novel.
e.zh: 有些导演会把原著中的每个隐喻都拍成实景。

e.en: Don't {literalize} her words; she was being sarcastic.
e.zh: 别把她的话当真,她只是在讽刺。

literally.t: adv. 字面上地；简直（口语强调）

e.en: He was {literally} the last person to leave the office.
e.zh: 他确实是最后一个离开办公室的人。

e.en: My phone is {literally} dying as I type this message.
e.zh: 我打这条信息时手机真的快没电了。

e.en: The translator's strict {literalness} made the dialogue sound robotic.
e.zh: 译者过于死板的直译让对话听起来很生硬。

e.en: Children often interpret jokes with surprising {literalness}.
e.zh: 孩子们常常会出乎意料地从字面理解笑话。

e.en: The novel is {literarily} ambitious but commercially unsuccessful.
e.zh: 这部小说在文学上很有抱负,但商业上并不成功。

e.en: She is {literarily} gifted and writes beautiful short stories.
e.zh: 她在文学方面很有天赋,写得一手好短篇小说。

e.en: The blog posts have a surprising {literariness} for online writing.
e.zh: 这些博客文章对于网络写作来说有着出人意料的文学性。

e.en: Critics praised the screenplay's {literariness} and depth.
e.zh: 评论家称赞这部剧本的文学性与深度。

e.en: She won several {literary} awards for her debut novel.
e.zh: 她凭借处女作小说获得了多个文学奖项。

e.en: The bookstore hosts a {literary} event every Friday night.
e.zh: 那家书店每周五晚都会举办文学活动。

e.en: Most adults in the country are now fully {literate}.
e.zh: 该国大多数成年人现在都识字了。

e.en: You need to be digitally {literate} to work here.
e.zh: 在这里工作你必须懂数字技术。

e.en: The cafe was a popular gathering spot for local {literati}.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆是当地文人雅士聚会的热门地点。

e.en: The {literati} debated the new novel's merits online.
e.zh: 文人圈在网上争论这部新小说的优劣。

e.en: She majored in English {literature} at university.
e.zh: 她大学时主修英国文学。

e.en: The doctor handed me some {literature} about the new medication.
e.zh: 医生递给我一些关于新药的资料。

e.en: The car's tank holds about fifty {liters} of fuel.
e.zh: 这辆车的油箱大约能装五十升燃油。

e.en: Please buy two {liters} of milk on your way home.
e.zh: 请你回家路上买两升牛奶。

lithe.t: adj. 柔软灵活的；轻盈的

e.en: The dancer had a {lithe} and graceful figure.
e.zh: 那位舞者身姿轻盈优雅。

e.en: A {lithe} cat slipped silently through the open window.
e.zh: 一只灵活的猫悄无声息地从开着的窗户钻了进来。

e.en: She moved {lithely} across the stage during her solo.
e.zh: 独舞时她在舞台上轻盈地移动着。

e.en: The gymnast {lithely} flipped onto the balance beam.
e.zh: 体操运动员轻巧地翻上了平衡木。

e.en: Modern phones rely on rechargeable {lithium} batteries.
e.zh: 现代手机依赖可充电的锂电池。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {lithium} to stabilize his mood swings.
e.zh: 医生开了锂剂来稳定他的情绪波动。

litho.t: n. 平版印刷（lithograph 简写）

e.en: The poster was printed using a high-quality {litho} process.
e.zh: 这张海报是用高质量的平版印刷工艺印制的。

e.en: He collects vintage {litho} prints from the 1960s.
e.zh: 他收藏六十年代的复古平版印刷画。

lithograph.t:
n. 平版印刷品
v. 用平版印刷

e.en: She bought a signed {lithograph} at the gallery opening.
e.zh: 她在画廊开幕式上买了一幅有签名的平版印刷画。

e.en: The original {lithograph} sold for thousands at auction.
e.zh: 那幅原版石版画在拍卖会上以数千元成交。

lithographed.t: v. lithograph 的过去式，平版印刷

e.en: The map was beautifully {lithographed} on heavy paper.
e.zh: 那张地图用厚纸精美地平版印刷出来。

e.en: Artists {lithographed} their designs onto limited edition posters.
e.zh: 艺术家们把他们的设计石版印刷到限量版海报上。

e.en: The {lithographer} carefully prepared the stone for printing.
e.zh: 那位石版画师小心翼翼地准备好印刷用的石板。

e.en: She trained as a {lithographer} before becoming a designer.
e.zh: 她在成为设计师之前曾受过石版画师的训练。

e.en: The book features stunning {lithographic} illustrations from the 1800s.
e.zh: 这本书收录了十九世纪精美的石版画插图。

e.en: Modern chips are made using advanced {lithographic} techniques.
e.zh: 现代芯片是用先进的光刻技术制造的。

lithography.t: n. 光刻（半导体）；平版印刷

e.en: Chip manufacturers compete fiercely on advanced {lithography} machines.
e.zh: 芯片制造商在先进的光刻机上激烈竞争。

e.en: She studied {lithography} as part of her printmaking course.
e.zh: 她在版画课程中学习了石版印刷。

e.en: Earthquakes occur when plates in the {lithosphere} shift suddenly.
e.zh: 当岩石圈中的板块突然移动时就会发生地震。

e.en: The {lithosphere} forms the rigid outer shell of our planet.
e.zh: 岩石圈构成了我们星球坚硬的外壳。

e.en: The doctor recommended {lithotripsy} to break up the kidney stones.
e.zh: 医生建议做体外碎石术来击碎肾结石。

e.en: After {lithotripsy}, she recovered without needing surgery.
e.zh: 做完碎石术后,她无需手术就康复了。

e.en: {Lithuania} joined the European Union in 2004.
e.zh: 立陶宛于2004年加入了欧盟。

e.en: We spent a week exploring the old town of {Lithuania}'s capital.
e.zh: 我们花了一周时间游览立陶宛首都的老城区。

e.en: {Linz} is the third-largest city in Austria.
e.zh: 林茨是奥地利的第三大城市。

e.en: We caught the train from Vienna to {Linz} last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天我们从维也纳坐火车去了林茨。

lion.t:
n. 狮子
n. 名流、名人

e.en: A male {lion} can roar loudly enough to be heard miles away.
e.zh: 雄狮的吼声在几英里外都能听到。

e.en: The brave knight fought a {lion} in the legend.
e.zh: 传说中那位勇敢的骑士与一头狮子搏斗。

e.en: The {lioness} crouched silently before pouncing on her prey.
e.zh: 母狮悄悄蹲伏,然后猛扑向猎物。

e.en: A {lioness} usually does most of the hunting in the pride.
e.zh: 狮群中大部分捕猎工作通常由母狮承担。

e.en: The colorful {lionfish} has venomous spines along its back.
e.zh: 色彩艳丽的狮子鱼背上长着有毒的鳍刺。

e.en: Invasive {lionfish} are damaging Caribbean coral reefs.
e.zh: 入侵的狮子鱼正在破坏加勒比海的珊瑚礁。

e.en: The media tends to {lionize} young tech founders.
e.zh: 媒体往往把年轻的科技创始人捧为偶像。

e.en: Critics {lionize} her debut novel as a modern classic.
e.zh: 评论家把她的处女作奉为当代经典。

e.en: A pride of {lions} rested under the acacia tree.
e.zh: 一群狮子在金合欢树下休息。

e.en: The zoo's two new {lions} arrived from South Africa.
e.zh: 动物园的两头新狮子来自南非。

lip.t:
n. 嘴唇
n. 容器的边缘

e.en: She bit her lower {lip} nervously before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前她紧张地咬着下嘴唇。

e.en: Coffee spilled over the {lip} of the mug.
e.zh: 咖啡从杯口溢了出来。

e.en: Doctors check {lipid} levels to assess heart disease risk.
e.zh: 医生通过检查血脂水平来评估心脏病风险。

e.en: Cell membranes are made up of a {lipid} bilayer.
e.zh: 细胞膜由脂质双分子层构成。

e.en: The carved skull stared with a {lipless} grin.
e.zh: 那个雕刻的头骨露出无唇的笑容凝视着。

e.en: Some reptiles appear {lipless} due to their jaw structure.
e.zh: 由于颌骨结构,有些爬行动物看起来没有嘴唇。

e.en: Vitamin E is a {lipophilic} compound stored in fatty tissue.
e.zh: 维生素E是一种亲脂化合物,储存于脂肪组织中。

e.en: The drug's {lipophilic} nature helps it cross cell membranes.
e.zh: 该药物的亲脂性使其更易穿过细胞膜。

e.en: High-density {lipoprotein} is often called the good cholesterol.
e.zh: 高密度脂蛋白常被称为好胆固醇。

e.en: Doctors monitor {lipoprotein} levels to gauge cardiovascular health.
e.zh: 医生通过监测脂蛋白水平来评估心血管健康。

e.en: The vaccine uses a {liposome} to deliver mRNA into cells.
e.zh: 该疫苗利用脂质体将mRNA送入细胞。

e.en: Skincare brands often package vitamins inside a tiny {liposome}.
e.zh: 护肤品牌常把维生素包裹在微小的脂质体中。

e.en: She underwent {liposuction} to remove fat from her thighs.
e.zh: 她做了吸脂手术来去除大腿上的脂肪。

e.en: {Liposuction} is not a substitute for healthy diet and exercise.
e.zh: 吸脂手术不能替代健康饮食和运动。

e.en: He {lipped} the rim of the glass before drinking.
e.zh: 他在喝之前用嘴碰了一下杯沿。

e.en: The thin-{lipped} man rarely smiled in meetings.
e.zh: 那个嘴唇很薄的男人在会上很少笑。

lippy.t:
adj. 多嘴的、顶嘴的
n. 口红（俚）

e.en: Don't get {lippy} with your grandmother at dinner.
e.zh: 吃饭时不要对奶奶顶嘴。

e.en: The {lippy} teenager argued with every teacher.
e.zh: 那个嘴硬的少年和每位老师都争辩。

e.en: She painted her {lips} a deep shade of red.
e.zh: 她把嘴唇涂成了深红色。

e.en: His {lips} trembled as he tried to speak.
e.zh: 他想说话时嘴唇微微颤抖。

e.en: She applied bright red {lipstick} before heading out.
e.zh: 出门前她涂了鲜红色的口红。

e.en: This long-lasting {lipstick} stays on for twelve hours.
e.zh: 这款持久型口红可以保持十二小时不掉。

e.en: She left a {lipsticked} kiss on the napkin.
e.zh: 她在餐巾纸上留下了一个口红印的吻。

e.en: Her brightly {lipsticked} smile lit up the photo.
e.zh: 她涂着鲜艳口红的笑容点亮了整张照片。

e.en: He poured himself a cup of {Lipton} tea after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后他给自己倒了一杯立顿茶。

e.en: {Lipton} is one of the world's best-known tea brands.
e.zh: 立顿是世界上最知名的茶叶品牌之一。

e.en: The earthquake caused soil {liquefaction} beneath several buildings.
e.zh: 地震导致几栋建筑下的土壤发生液化。

e.en: Natural gas undergoes {liquefaction} for easier transport by ship.
e.zh: 天然气经过液化处理后更便于船运。

liquefied.t:
adj. 已液化的
v. liquefy 的过去式

e.en: The factory ships {liquefied} natural gas to overseas buyers.
e.zh: 该工厂将液化天然气运往海外买家。

e.en: Heat slowly until the chocolate is fully {liquefied}.
e.zh: 慢慢加热直到巧克力完全融化成液态。

e.en: Blend the fruit on high to {liquefy} it quickly.
e.zh: 将水果用高速搅拌迅速打成液体。

e.en: Extreme heat can {liquefy} certain types of metal.
e.zh: 极高的温度能使某些金属液化。

e.en: She poured a small glass of orange {liqueur} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐后她倒了一小杯橙味利口酒。

e.en: This dessert is flavored with a hint of coffee {liqueur}.
e.zh: 这款甜点带有一丝咖啡利口酒的香味。

liquid.t:
n. 液体
adj. 液态的、流动的

e.en: Pour the {liquid} slowly into the measuring cup.
e.zh: 把液体慢慢倒进量杯里。

e.en: The startup needs more {liquid} assets to cover payroll.
e.zh: 这家初创公司需要更多流动资产来支付工资。

liquidate.t:
v. 清算、变现
v. 清除、除掉

e.en: The company decided to {liquidate} its overseas branches.
e.zh: 公司决定清算其海外分支机构。

e.en: They had to {liquidate} stocks to pay off the loan.
e.zh: 他们不得不变卖股票来偿还贷款。

liquidated.t:
v. liquidate 的过去式
adj. 已清算的

e.en: The bankrupt firm was {liquidated} within six months.
e.zh: 这家破产公司在六个月内被清算。

e.en: He {liquidated} his crypto holdings before the market crashed.
e.zh: 他在市场崩盘前清仓了加密货币。

e.en: The store is having a {liquidation} sale this weekend.
e.zh: 这家店本周末正在进行清仓大甩卖。

e.en: Creditors filed for the company's immediate {liquidation}.
e.zh: 债权人申请对该公司立即进行清算。

e.en: The court appointed a {liquidator} to handle the bankrupt estate.
e.zh: 法院指定了一名清算人来处理破产财产。

e.en: The {liquidator} sold off the warehouse stock at deep discounts.
e.zh: 清算人以大幅折扣出售了仓库存货。

e.en: {Liquidise} the soup until smooth and creamy.
e.zh: 把汤搅打至细腻顺滑。

e.en: You can {liquidise} the berries to make a quick sauce.
e.zh: 可以把浆果打成液状做成简易酱料。

liquidity.t:
n. 流动性（金融）
n. 流动状态

e.en: The bank ran into a serious {liquidity} crisis last quarter.
e.zh: 该银行上季度陷入严重的流动性危机。

e.en: Crypto markets often suffer from low {liquidity} on weekends.
e.zh: 加密市场在周末经常出现流动性不足。

e.en: Airport security limits the {liquids} you can carry on board.
e.zh: 机场安检限制旅客随身携带的液体。

e.en: Drink plenty of {liquids} when you have a fever.
e.zh: 发烧时要多喝液体补充水分。

e.en: Gentle heat will {liquify} the honey in minutes.
e.zh: 轻微加热几分钟就能让蜂蜜变成液态。

e.en: The blender can {liquify} frozen fruit into a smoothie.
e.zh: 这台搅拌机能把冷冻水果打成奶昔。

e.en: You need an ID to buy {liquor} at this store.
e.zh: 在这家店买烈酒需要出示身份证。

e.en: He rarely drinks hard {liquor} on weeknights.
e.zh: 他平时工作日很少喝烈酒。

e.en: She loves the salty {liquorice} candy from Scandinavia.
e.zh: 她很喜欢北欧那种咸味甘草糖。

e.en: The tea has a faint {liquorice} aftertaste.
e.zh: 这款茶带有淡淡的甘草余味。

e.en: The Turkish {lira} dropped sharply against the dollar today.
e.zh: 今天土耳其里拉对美元大幅下跌。

e.en: He still keeps an old Italian {lira} as a souvenir.
e.zh: 他还留着一张旧的意大利里拉作纪念。

e.en: Before the euro, prices in Italy were quoted in {lire}.
e.zh: 在欧元出现之前,意大利的价格都用里拉标示。

e.en: Tourists used to exchange dollars for thousands of {lire}.
e.zh: 以前游客会把美元兑换成成千上万的里拉。

lisbon.t: n. 里斯本（葡萄牙首都）

e.en: We spent a long weekend exploring the hills of {Lisbon}.
e.zh: 我们用一个长周末游览了里斯本的山丘街区。

e.en: Direct flights from London to {Lisbon} take under three hours.
e.zh: 从伦敦直飞里斯本不到三小时。

lisburn.t: n. 利斯本（北爱尔兰城市）

e.en: {Lisburn} is one of the largest cities in Northern Ireland.
e.zh: 利斯本是北爱尔兰最大的城市之一。

e.en: The train from Belfast to {Lisburn} runs every fifteen minutes.
e.zh: 从贝尔法斯特到利斯本的火车每十五分钟一班。

e.en: He prefers fine {lisle} socks for their soft feel.
e.zh: 他偏爱精纺莱尔棉袜,因为手感柔软。

e.en: The shop sells classic {lisle} cotton dress shirts.
e.zh: 这家店出售经典莱尔棉正装衬衫。

lisp.t:
n. 大舌头、咬舌音
v. 口齿不清地说

e.en: The boy has a slight {lisp} when pronouncing the letter S.
e.zh: 那个男孩发字母S时有点大舌头。

e.en: Speech therapy helped her overcome her childhood {lisp}.
e.zh: 语言治疗帮助她克服了童年的口齿不清。

lissome.t: adj. 柔软灵活的、轻盈的

e.en: The dancer moved with a {lissome} grace across the stage.
e.zh: 那位舞者在舞台上以轻盈优雅的姿态舞动。

e.en: Her {lissome} figure made every dress look elegant.
e.zh: 她苗条柔美的身材让每件裙子都显得优雅。

list.t:
n. 列表、清单
v. 列出

e.en: Please add milk to the shopping {list} before you leave.
e.zh: 出门前请把牛奶加到购物清单里。

e.en: You can {list} your old phone on a resale app.
e.zh: 你可以把旧手机挂到二手平台上出售。

listed.t:
adj. 已列出的、上市的
v. list 的过去式

e.en: The apartment is {listed} for rent at two thousand a month.
e.zh: 这套公寓挂牌出租,月租两千。

e.en: All side effects are clearly {listed} on the label.
e.zh: 所有副作用都清楚地列在标签上。

e.en: I love to {listen} to podcasts during my commute.
e.zh: 我喜欢在通勤时听播客。

e.en: Please {listen} carefully before you give your answer.
e.zh: 请仔细听清楚再回答。

lithuanian.t:
adj. 立陶宛的
n. 立陶宛人/语

e.en: She speaks fluent {Lithuanian} as well as English.
e.zh: 她除了英语还会说一口流利的立陶宛语。

e.en: The cafe serves traditional {Lithuanian} potato dumplings.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆供应传统的立陶宛土豆饺子。

e.en: Each {litigant} was represented by experienced legal counsel.
e.zh: 每位诉讼当事人都由经验丰富的律师代理。

e.en: The judge urged both {litigant} parties to settle out of court.
e.zh: 法官敦促双方诉讼当事人庭外和解。

e.en: The company chose to {litigate} rather than settle the dispute.
e.zh: 公司选择诉讼而不是和解这起纠纷。

e.en: It's expensive to {litigate} a patent case in federal court.
e.zh: 在联邦法院打专利官司的费用很高。

litigated.t: v. litigate 的过去式；提起诉讼

e.en: The contract dispute was {litigated} for nearly three years.
