e.zh: 这起合同纠纷打了将近三年的官司。

e.en: They {litigated} the case all the way to the Supreme Court.
e.zh: 他们把这桩案子一路打到了最高法院。

e.en: The startup is currently involved in {litigation} over trademark rights.
e.zh: 这家初创公司目前正卷入一场商标权诉讼。

e.en: Lengthy {litigation} drained the small business's resources.
e.zh: 漫长的诉讼耗尽了这家小企业的资源。

e.en: She's a top {litigator} known for winning tough cases.
e.zh: 她是一位以打赢硬仗著称的顶级诉讼律师。

e.en: The firm hired an experienced {litigator} for the trial.
e.zh: 事务所聘请了一位经验丰富的诉讼律师出庭。

litigious.t: adj. 爱打官司的；好讼的

e.en: The tech industry has become increasingly {litigious} over patents.
e.zh: 科技行业在专利问题上变得越来越好诉讼。

e.en: He's known as a {litigious} neighbor who sues over everything.
e.zh: 他是个出了名爱打官司的邻居,什么事都要告。

e.en: This election is a real {litmus} test for the party.
e.zh: 这次选举是对该党派的一次真正的试金石考验。

e.en: Blue {litmus} paper turns red when dipped in acid.
e.zh: 蓝色石蕊试纸浸入酸液后会变红。

e.en: Petrol now costs almost two pounds per {litre}.
e.zh: 现在汽油每升将近两英镑。

e.en: She drinks at least one {litre} of water daily.
e.zh: 她每天至少喝一升水。

e.en: The bathtub holds about two hundred {litres} of water.
e.zh: 这个浴缸大约能装两百升水。

e.en: He drank three {litres} of coffee during the deadline week.
e.zh: 截稿那周他喝了三升咖啡。

litter.t:
n. 乱扔的垃圾；一窝幼崽
v. 乱扔

e.en: Please don't drop {litter} on the beach.
e.zh: 请不要在海滩上乱扔垃圾。

e.en: The dog gave birth to a {litter} of six puppies.
e.zh: 那只狗生了一窝六只小狗。

e.en: His desk was {littered} with empty coffee cups.
e.zh: 他的桌上散乱地堆满了空咖啡杯。

e.en: Tourists {littered} the trail with plastic bottles.
e.zh: 游客们在小路上乱扔了一地的塑料瓶。

e.en: Our puppy still plays with his {littermate} every weekend.
e.zh: 我们的小狗每周末还会和它的同窝兄弟玩耍。

e.en: The two kittens are {littermate} sisters from the shelter.
e.zh: 这两只小猫是收容所里同一窝的姐妹。

little.t:
adj. 小的；少的
adv. 几乎不

e.en: There's very {little} milk left in the fridge.
e.zh: 冰箱里剩的牛奶很少了。

e.en: My {little} brother just started kindergarten this week.
e.zh: 我弟弟这周刚上幼儿园。

littlehampton.t: n. 小汉普顿（英国地名）

e.en: We spent the weekend at the beach in {Littlehampton}.
e.zh: 我们在小汉普顿的海滩度过了周末。

e.en: {Littlehampton} is a quiet seaside town in West Sussex.
e.zh: 小汉普顿是西萨塞克斯郡一个宁静的海滨小镇。

e.en: Mr. {Littlejohn} has been our family doctor for years.
e.zh: 利特尔约翰先生当我们的家庭医生已经好几年了。

e.en: The book follows a detective named {Littlejohn} solving rural crimes.
e.zh: 这本书讲述了一位名叫利特尔约翰的侦探破解乡村案件的故事。

e.en: She was charmed by the {littleness} of the cottage.
e.zh: 她被那座小屋的小巧迷住了。

e.en: The painting captures the {littleness} of humans against vast nature.
e.zh: 这幅画捕捉到了人类在浩瀚自然面前的渺小。

littler.t: adj. little 的比较级；更小的

e.en: My puppy is {littler} than my neighbor's dog.
e.zh: 我的小狗比邻居的狗还要小一些。

e.en: Pick the {littler} apples for the kids' lunches.
e.zh: 挑那些更小的苹果给孩子们当午餐。

littleton.t: n. 利特尔顿（地名/姓氏）

e.en: She grew up in {Littleton}, a quiet suburb of Denver.
e.zh: 她在丹佛郊区一个宁静的小镇利特尔顿长大。

e.en: The conference will be held in {Littleton} next spring.
e.zh: 会议将于明年春天在利特尔顿举行。

e.en: Professor {Littlewood} made major contributions to mathematical analysis.
e.zh: 利特尔伍德教授在数学分析领域做出了重大贡献。

e.en: Joan {Littlewood} revolutionized British theatre in the twentieth century.
e.zh: 琼·利特尔伍德在二十世纪革新了英国戏剧。

littlewoods.t: n. 利特尔伍德（英国零售品牌）

e.en: My grandmother used to order clothes from the {Littlewoods} catalogue.
e.zh: 我奶奶以前常从利特尔伍德邮购目录上订购衣服。

e.en: {Littlewoods} was once a major British retail chain.
e.zh: 利特尔伍德曾是英国一家大型零售连锁店。

e.en: {Litton} Industries was a major American defense contractor.
e.zh: 利顿工业公司曾是美国一家大型国防承包商。

e.en: My grandfather worked for {Litton} for nearly forty years.
e.zh: 我祖父在利顿公司工作了将近四十年。

littoral.t:
adj. 沿岸的；滨海的
n. 沿岸地区

e.en: Many seabirds nest along the rocky {littoral} zone.
e.zh: 许多海鸟在岩石海岸带筑巢。

e.en: The navy specializes in {littoral} combat near coastlines.
e.zh: 该海军专门进行近岸海域的作战。

liturgical.t: adj. 礼拜仪式的；礼仪的

e.en: The choir sang traditional {liturgical} music during the service.
e.zh: 唱诗班在礼拜中演唱了传统的礼仪音乐。

e.en: Purple is used in {liturgical} robes during Lent.
e.zh: 在四旬期,礼仪长袍会使用紫色。

e.en: The {liturgist} carefully planned each part of the Sunday service.
e.zh: 礼仪师精心规划了周日礼拜的每个环节。

e.en: She trained as a {liturgist} at the seminary last year.
e.zh: 她去年在神学院接受了礼仪师的训练。

e.en: The Sunday {liturgy} follows centuries of Christian tradition.
e.zh: 周日的礼拜仪式沿袭了几个世纪的基督教传统。

e.en: He helped revise the {liturgy} for the new prayer book.
e.zh: 他协助修订了新祈祷书中的礼拜仪式。

e.en: The city ranks high in {livability} surveys every year.
e.zh: 该城市每年在宜居性调查中都名列前茅。

e.en: Better public transit greatly improves a neighborhood's {livability}.
e.zh: 更好的公共交通大大提升了社区的宜居性。

livable.t: adj. 适于居住的；过得去的

e.en: They renovated the basement to make it {livable} year-round.
e.zh: 他们翻修了地下室，让它一年四季都能住人。

e.en: Tokyo consistently ranks as one of the most {livable} cities.
e.zh: 东京一直被评为最宜居的城市之一。

live.t:
v. 居住；生活
adj. 现场的；直播的

e.en: The concert will be broadcast {live} on YouTube tonight.
e.zh: 今晚音乐会将在 YouTube 上现场直播。

e.en: Many artists {live} in Brooklyn for the creative scene.
e.zh: 许多艺术家因为创作氛围而住在布鲁克林。

e.en: The apartment is small but very {liveable} for one person.
e.zh: 这间公寓很小，但一个人住完全没问题。

e.en: Urban planners aim to make downtown more {liveable}.
e.zh: 城市规划者致力于让市中心更宜居。

lived.t: v. live 的过去式；居住、生活过

e.en: She {lived} in Paris for nearly a decade.
e.zh: 她在巴黎住了将近十年。

e.en: My grandfather {lived} through two world wars.
e.zh: 我祖父经历了两次世界大战。

e.en: Fishing is the main {livelihood} for this coastal village.
e.zh: 捕鱼是这个沿海村庄的主要生计。

e.en: The drought threatened the {livelihood} of thousands of farmers.
e.zh: 干旱威胁到数千名农民的生计。

e.en: I love the {liveliness} of street markets in Bangkok.
e.zh: 我喜欢曼谷街头市场的热闹劲儿。

e.en: Her writing has a {liveliness} that keeps readers engaged.
e.zh: 她的文笔生动活泼，让读者欲罢不能。

livelong.t: adj. 整个的（常用于 the livelong day）

e.en: She practiced piano the {livelong} day without a break.
e.zh: 她整整一天都在练琴，没歇过。

e.en: He waited by the phone the {livelong} afternoon.
e.zh: 他守在电话旁等了一整个下午。

e.en: We had a {lively} debate about climate policy.
e.zh: 我们就气候政策展开了一场热烈的辩论。

e.en: The café has a {lively} atmosphere on weekends.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆周末气氛非常热闹。

e.en: Some music would really {liven} up this party.
e.zh: 放点音乐会让这个派对热闹起来。

e.en: Bright colors {liven} up an otherwise dull room.
e.zh: 明亮的色彩能让原本沉闷的房间生动起来。

e.en: Drinking too much alcohol can damage your {liver}.
e.zh: 饮酒过量会损害你的肝脏。

e.en: Pan-fried {liver} with onions is a classic dish.
e.zh: 洋葱煎肝是一道经典菜肴。

e.en: A {liveried} doorman greeted guests at the hotel entrance.
e.zh: 一位身着制服的门童在酒店门口迎接客人。

e.en: The mansion still employs {liveried} staff for formal events.
e.zh: 这座豪宅在正式场合仍雇用穿着制服的仆人。

livermore.t: n. 利弗莫尔（地名/姓氏）

e.en: {Livermore} is home to a famous national laboratory in California.
e.zh: 利弗莫尔有一座著名的加州国家实验室。

e.en: They drove out to {Livermore} for the wine festival.
e.zh: 他们开车去利弗莫尔参加葡萄酒节。

e.en: The Beatles started their career in {Liverpool}.
e.zh: 披头士乐队在利物浦开始了他们的职业生涯。

e.en: {Liverpool} won the Premier League title last season.
e.zh: 利物浦上赛季夺得了英超冠军。

liverpudlian.t:
n. 利物浦人
adj. 利物浦的

e.en: His thick {Liverpudlian} accent made him hard to understand.
e.zh: 他浓重的利物浦口音让人很难听懂。

e.en: She's a proud {Liverpudlian} born and raised near the docks.
e.zh: 她是个土生土长的利物浦人，在码头附近长大。

e.en: Heavy drinkers often develop scarred {livers} over time.
e.zh: 嗜酒者的肝脏久而久之常会出现疤痕。

e.en: Chicken {livers} are a key ingredient in classic pâté.
e.zh: 鸡肝是经典肉酱的关键食材。

e.en: {Liverwort} thrives in damp, shaded areas of the forest.
e.zh: 地钱在森林里阴湿的地方生长茂盛。

e.en: Botanists study {liverwort} as one of the earliest land plants.
e.zh: 植物学家把地钱作为最早的陆生植物之一来研究。

e.en: He spread {liverwurst} on rye bread for lunch.
e.zh: 他把肝肠酱抹在黑麦面包上当午餐。

e.en: German delis usually carry several types of {liverwurst}.
e.zh: 德国熟食店通常有好几种肝肠出售。

livery.t: n. 仆役制服；（车队）涂装

e.en: The chauffeur wore the family's traditional black {livery}.
e.zh: 司机穿着这个家族传统的黑色制服。

e.en: The new train cars sport a fresh blue {livery}.
e.zh: 新列车车厢采用了崭新的蓝色涂装。

lives.t:
n. life 的复数
v. live 的第三人称单数

e.en: The earthquake claimed thousands of {lives} overnight.
e.zh: 那场地震一夜之间夺去了数千条生命。

e.en: My sister {lives} in a small town outside Boston.
e.zh: 我姐姐住在波士顿郊外的一个小镇上。

e.en: Farmers moved their {livestock} to higher ground before the flood.
e.zh: 洪水来临前，农民们把牲畜转移到了高地。

e.en: Rising feed costs hurt small {livestock} producers the most.
e.zh: 饲料价格上涨对小型牲畜养殖户打击最大。

livid.t: adj. 勃然大怒的；青灰色的

e.en: My boss was {livid} when he saw the missed deadline.
e.zh: 老板看到错过的截止日期时气炸了。

e.en: She had a {livid} bruise on her arm after the fall.
e.zh: 摔倒之后她胳膊上有一块青紫的瘀伤。

e.en: The coroner used {lividity} to estimate the time of death.
e.zh: 法医通过尸斑来估计死亡时间。

e.en: Post-mortem {lividity} typically appears within a few hours.
e.zh: 死后尸斑通常在几个小时内显现。

living.t:
n. 生计；生活
adj. 活着的

e.en: He earns a decent {living} as a freelance designer.
e.zh: 他靠自由职业设计师的工作收入不错。

e.en: There are no {living} relatives left in the family.
e.zh: 这个家族已经没有在世的亲属了。

e.en: We rearranged the {living-room} to fit a bigger sofa.
e.zh: 我们重新布置了客厅，好放下一张更大的沙发。

e.en: The kids built a fort in the {living-room}.
e.zh: 孩子们在客厅里搭了个小堡垒。

e.en: Many people in this town make their {livings} from tourism.
e.zh: 这个镇上许多人靠旅游业谋生。

e.en: Artists often piece together {livings} from multiple gigs.
e.zh: 艺术家们常常靠各种零散工作拼凑收入。

livingston.t: n. 利文斯顿（人名/地名）

e.en: {Livingston} is a popular suburb just west of Newark.
e.zh: 利文斯顿是位于纽瓦克以西的一个热门郊区。

e.en: The Livingston family has lived in {Livingston} for generations.
e.zh: 利文斯顿一家在利文斯顿已经住了好几代。

livingstone.t: n. 利文斯通（人名，英国探险家）

e.en: David {Livingstone} explored much of central Africa in the 1800s.
e.zh: 大卫·利文斯通在十九世纪探索了非洲中部大部分地区。

e.en: Tourists visit {Livingstone} for views of Victoria Falls.
e.zh: 游客前往利文斯通是为了观赏维多利亚瀑布。

livre.t: n. 里弗（法国旧货币单位）

e.en: The old {livre} was a unit of French currency before the franc.
e.zh: 古老的里弗尔是法郎之前的法国货币单位。

e.en: Historians found prices listed in {livre} on the manuscript.
e.zh: 历史学家在手稿上发现了以里弗尔为单位的价格。

e.en: A small green {lizard} darted across the garden path.
e.zh: 一只绿色小蜥蜴飞快地窜过花园小径。

e.en: My nephew keeps a {lizard} as a pet.
e.zh: 我侄子养了一只蜥蜴当宠物。

e.en: The team labeled the file simply {LJJ} for short.
e.zh: 团队把文件简单标为 LJJ 作为缩写。

e.en: Nobody could remember what the acronym {LJJ} stood for.
e.zh: 没人记得 LJJ 这个缩写到底代表什么。

ljubljana.t: n. 卢布尔雅那（斯洛文尼亚首都）

e.en: {Ljubljana} is the charming capital of Slovenia.
e.zh: 卢布尔雅那是斯洛文尼亚迷人的首都。

e.en: We spent a weekend exploring cafés in {Ljubljana}.
e.zh: 我们在卢布尔雅那花了一个周末逛咖啡馆。

e.en: A fluffy {llama} stared at us from across the fence.
e.zh: 一只毛茸茸的羊驼从栅栏另一边盯着我们看。

e.en: Andean farmers use the {llama} to carry heavy loads.
e.zh: 安第斯山区的农民用羊驼来驮运重物。

llandovery.t: n. 兰多弗里（英国威尔士城镇）

e.en: {Llandovery} is a small market town in rural Wales.
e.zh: 兰多弗里是威尔士乡村的一个集镇。

e.en: We stopped in {Llandovery} for tea on the drive north.
e.zh: 我们北上途中在兰多弗里停下喝了杯茶。

llandudno.t: n. 兰迪德诺（英国威尔士海滨城镇）

e.en: {Llandudno} has a beautiful Victorian seaside promenade.
e.zh: 兰迪德诺有一条漂亮的维多利亚式海滨步道。

e.en: Families flock to {Llandudno} every summer for the beach.
e.zh: 每到夏天，家庭们都涌向兰迪德诺的海滩。

llb.t: n. 法学学士（Bachelor of Laws）

e.en: She earned her {LLB} from the University of London.
e.zh: 她在伦敦大学获得了法学学士学位。

e.en: An {LLB} is the standard undergraduate law degree in the UK.
e.zh: 在英国，LLB 是标准的本科法学学位。

e.en: {Lloyd} insures ships against losses at sea.
e.zh: 劳合社为船舶承保海上损失险。

e.en: My friend {Lloyd} just bought his first house.
e.zh: 我朋友劳埃德刚买了他的第一套房子。

lloyds.t: n. 劳埃德银行；劳合社

e.en: I opened a savings account at {Lloyds} last week.
e.zh: 我上周在劳埃德银行开了一个储蓄账户。

e.en: {Lloyds} is one of the largest banks in Britain.
e.zh: 劳埃德银行是英国最大的银行之一。

lms.t: abbr. 学习管理系统（Learning Management System）

e.en: Our school switched to a new {LMS} for online courses.
e.zh: 我们学校换了一套新的学习管理系统来上网课。

e.en: Teachers upload assignments directly to the {LMS}.
e.zh: 老师们直接把作业上传到学习管理系统上。

lner.t: abbr. 伦敦东北铁路公司

e.en: The {LNER} ran express trains from London to Edinburgh.
e.zh: 伦敦东北铁路公司经营从伦敦到爱丁堡的特快列车。

e.en: Vintage {LNER} posters now sell for hundreds of pounds.
e.zh: 老式 LNER 海报如今能卖到几百英镑。

lng.t: abbr. 液化天然气（Liquefied Natural Gas）

e.en: Qatar is a major exporter of {LNG} to Asian markets.
e.zh: 卡塔尔是亚洲市场液化天然气的主要出口国。

e.en: The new {LNG} terminal will open next spring.
e.zh: 新的液化天然气接收站将于明年春天投入使用。

e.en: The pilot reported a {LOA} of ninety meters for the vessel.
e.zh: 飞行员报告这艘船的总长为九十米。

e.en: Marina fees are calculated based on the boat's {LOA}.
e.zh: 码头费用是根据船只总长来计算的。

e.en: A small {loach} hid under the rocks in the aquarium.
e.zh: 一条小泥鳅躲在鱼缸的石头下面。

e.en: In Korea, spicy {loach} stew is a beloved dish.
e.zh: 在韩国，辣泥鳅汤是一道人人喜爱的菜。

load.t:
v. 加载；装载
n. 负荷；工作量

e.en: The page takes forever to {load} on slow connections.
e.zh: 网速慢的时候这个页面要加载好久。

e.en: He carried a heavy {load} of groceries up the stairs.
e.zh: 他扛着一大袋杂货爬上了楼梯。

loaded.t: adj. 已加载的；装满的；富有的

e.en: The truck was fully {loaded} with construction materials.
e.zh: 卡车装满了建筑材料。

e.en: That's a {loaded} question with no easy answer.
e.zh: 那是个别有用心的问题，没有简单的答案。

e.en: The page shows a spinning {loader} while data fetches.
e.zh: 数据加载时页面会显示一个旋转的加载图标。

e.en: A front-end {loader} cleared snow from the parking lot.
e.zh: 一台前装载机清理了停车场的积雪。

loading.t:
n. 加载；装载
v. load 的现在分词

e.en: The video keeps {loading} but never actually plays.
e.zh: 视频一直在加载，但根本播放不了。

e.en: Workers were {loading} crates onto the cargo ship.
e.zh: 工人们正在把板条箱装上货船。

e.en: The {loadmaster} carefully balanced the cargo before takeoff.
e.zh: 装载员在起飞前仔细平衡了货物。

e.en: Every military transport plane has a dedicated {loadmaster}.
e.zh: 每架军用运输机都配有专职装载员。

loads.t:
n. 大量；许多
v. load 的第三人称单数

e.en: There are {loads} of restaurants in this neighborhood.
e.zh: 这附近有一大堆餐厅。

e.en: The app {loads} much faster after the latest update.
e.zh: 最新更新后这个应用加载速度快了很多。

loaf.t:
n. 一条面包
v. 闲逛；游荡

e.en: I bought a fresh {loaf} of sourdough this morning.
e.zh: 我今早买了一条新鲜的酸面包。

e.en: On Sundays I just like to {loaf} around at home.
e.zh: 周日我就喜欢在家里游手好闲地待着。

e.en: He slipped on a leather {loafer} and headed to the office.
e.zh: 他穿上一只皮乐福鞋就出门去上班了。

e.en: Don't be such a {loafer} — help with the dishes!
e.zh: 别这么懒散，过来帮忙洗碗！

e.en: Stop {loafing} around and help with the dishes.
e.zh: 别再四处闲晃了，过来帮忙洗碗。

e.en: He spent the afternoon {loafing} on the couch.
e.zh: 他整个下午都懒洋洋地躺在沙发上。

e.en: Tomatoes grow best in rich, dark {loam}.
e.zh: 番茄在肥沃的深色壤土中长得最好。

e.en: The gardener mixed sand and {loam} for drainage.
e.zh: 园丁把沙子和壤土混在一起以利排水。

e.en: This region has deep, {loamy} soil ideal for farming.
e.zh: 这个地区土层深厚，是理想的耕作壤土。

e.en: The vineyard sits on gently sloping {loamy} ground.
e.zh: 葡萄园坐落在缓坡的壤土地上。

loan.t:
n. 贷款；借款
v. 出借

e.en: She took out a {loan} to buy her first car.
e.zh: 她贷款买了人生第一辆车。

e.en: Can you {loan} me your charger for a minute?
e.zh: 能借我用一下你的充电器吗？

loaned.t: v. 借出；贷款（loan 过去式）

e.en: My friend {loaned} me her notes before the exam.
e.zh: 考试前我朋友把笔记借给了我。

e.en: The museum {loaned} the painting to a Paris gallery.
e.zh: 博物馆将这幅画借给了一家巴黎画廊。

loaner.t: n. 备用品；临时借出的东西

e.en: The garage gave me a {loaner} car during repairs.
e.zh: 修车期间车行借给我一辆备用车。

e.en: Ask the front desk for a {loaner} laptop.
e.zh: 去前台借一台备用笔记本电脑。

loans.t:
n. 贷款（复数）
v. 出借

e.en: Student {loans} can take decades to repay.
e.zh: 助学贷款可能要花几十年才能还清。

e.en: The bank offers low-interest {loans} to small businesses.
e.zh: 该银行向小企业提供低息贷款。

e.en: I am {loath} to admit that he was right.
e.zh: 我很不情愿承认他是对的。

e.en: She was {loath} to leave her hometown behind.
e.zh: 她不愿意离开自己的家乡。

e.en: I absolutely {loathe} waking up early on weekends.
e.zh: 我特别讨厌周末一大早起床。

e.en: Many people {loathe} doing their tax returns.
e.zh: 很多人都讨厌报税。

e.en: She looked at the spider with utter {loathing}.
e.zh: 她带着极度的厌恶盯着那只蜘蛛。

e.en: His voice was full of {loathing} as he spoke.
e.zh: 他说话时语气里充满了厌恶。

loathsome.t: adj. 令人厌恶的、讨厌的

e.en: The villain in the movie was truly {loathsome}.
e.zh: 电影里的反派真是令人作呕。

e.en: Cleaning the moldy fridge is a {loathsome} task.
e.zh: 清理发霉的冰箱是件令人讨厌的活儿。

e.en: She baked two {loaves} of sourdough this morning.
e.zh: 今天早上她烤了两条酸面包。

e.en: The bakery sold all its {loaves} by noon.
e.zh: 面包店中午前就把所有面包都卖完了。

lob.t:
v. 高抛、吊球
n. 高球

e.en: Just {lob} the ball over the fence to me.
e.zh: 把球轻轻抛过栅栏给我就行。

e.en: She tried to {lob} a question at the speaker.
e.zh: 她试着向演讲者抛出一个问题。

lobbied.t: v. 游说（lobby 的过去式）

e.en: Activists {lobbied} Congress for stronger climate laws.
e.zh: 活动人士游说国会通过更严格的气候法案。

e.en: Parents {lobbied} the school to extend recess time.
e.zh: 家长们游说学校延长课间休息时间。

lobbies.t:
n. 大厅；游说团体
v. 游说（第三人称单数）

e.en: Powerful {lobbies} often shape policy decisions in Washington.
e.zh: 强大的游说团体常常影响华盛顿的政策决定。

e.en: Most hotel {lobbies} now offer free coffee and Wi-Fi.
e.zh: 大多数酒店大堂现在都提供免费咖啡和无线网络。

lobby.t:
n. 大厅、门厅
v. 游说

e.en: Meet me in the hotel {lobby} at eight.
e.zh: 八点钟在酒店大堂见。

e.en: Citizens continue to {lobby} for cleaner air regulations.
e.zh: 市民们持续游说推动更严格的空气法规。

e.en: Tech companies spend millions on {lobbying} each year.
e.zh: 科技公司每年在游说上花费数百万美元。

e.en: She is {lobbying} her boss for a remote-work policy.
e.zh: 她正在游说老板推行远程办公政策。

e.en: A pharmaceutical {lobbyist} met with several senators today.
e.zh: 一名制药业说客今天与几位参议员会面。

e.en: He left law school to become a corporate {lobbyist}.
e.zh: 他从法学院退学，去当了企业说客。

e.en: The frontal {lobe} controls decision-making and personality.
e.zh: 额叶控制着决策能力和人格。

e.en: She wore a tiny stud in each ear {lobe}.
e.zh: 她在两个耳垂上都戴了一颗小耳钉。

e.en: The surgeon performed a {lobectomy} to remove the tumor.
e.zh: 外科医生做了肺叶切除术以摘除肿瘤。

e.en: Recovery from a {lobectomy} usually takes several weeks.
e.zh: 肺叶切除术的恢复通常需要几周时间。

e.en: Bright blue {lobelia} spilled over the edge of the planter.
e.zh: 鲜艳的蓝色半边莲从花盆边缘垂落下来。

e.en: She planted {lobelia} along the garden path.
e.zh: 她沿着花园小径种了一排半边莲。

e.en: Tall {loblolly} pines lined the southern highway.
e.zh: 南部高速公路两旁种着高大的火炬松。

e.en: The forest was dominated by {loblolly} pine trees.
e.zh: 这片森林以火炬松为主。

lobotomy.t: n. 脑额叶白质切除术

e.en: The {lobotomy} was once a controversial psychiatric treatment.
e.zh: 前额叶切除术曾是一种颇具争议的精神病治疗手段。

e.en: Watching that movie felt like getting a {lobotomy}.
e.zh: 看那部电影感觉就像被切了脑前叶一样麻木。

e.en: We ordered fresh {lobster} at the harborside restaurant.
e.zh: 我们在海港边的餐厅点了新鲜的龙虾。

e.en: After hours in the sun, his back was {lobster}-red.
e.zh: 在太阳下晒了几个小时，他的背红得像龙虾一样。

e.en: The old {lobsterman} checked his traps before sunrise.
e.zh: 老渔民在日出前检查他的龙虾笼。

e.en: Every {lobsterman} in the harbor knew the changing tides.
e.zh: 港口里每个捕龙虾人都熟悉潮汐的变化。

e.en: The biopsy revealed {lobular} carcinoma in the left breast.
e.zh: 活检显示左乳为小叶状癌。

e.en: Doctors examined the {lobular} structure of the liver tissue.
e.zh: 医生检查了肝组织的小叶结构。

lobule.t: n. 小叶（器官的小分叶）

e.en: Each lung {lobule} is supplied by a tiny bronchiole.
e.zh: 每个肺小叶都由一根细小的细支气管供气。

e.en: He had a small mole on his ear {lobule}.
e.zh: 他的耳垂上有一颗小痣。

local.t:
adj. 本地的、当地的
n. 当地人

e.en: We try to buy {local} produce whenever possible.
e.zh: 我们尽可能购买本地农产品。

e.en: A {local} guide showed us the hidden alleys.
e.zh: 一位本地导游带我们逛了那些隐秘的小巷。

locale.t: n. 场所；（软件）区域设置

e.en: The film was shot in a stunning tropical {locale}.
e.zh: 这部电影是在一个迷人的热带场景中拍摄的。

e.en: Change the {locale} setting to display Chinese dates.
e.zh: 更改区域设置以显示中文日期格式。

e.en: Game {localisation} requires more than just translating text.
e.zh: 游戏本地化远不止是翻译文字而已。

e.en: Our team handles the {localisation} of the app for Asia.
e.zh: 我们团队负责该应用在亚洲的本地化工作。

e.en: We need to {localise} the website for the Japanese market.
e.zh: 我们需要把网站本地化以适应日本市场。

e.en: Engineers work to {localise} the source of the network issue.
e.zh: 工程师们正努力定位网络问题的源头。

localised.t: adj. 已本地化的（英式拼写）

e.en: The pain was {localised} to her lower right abdomen.
e.zh: 疼痛局限在她的右下腹部。

e.en: The app has been {localised} into twelve languages.
e.zh: 该应用已被本地化为十二种语言。

e.en: The word "y'all" is a Southern {localism}.
e.zh: "y'all"这个词是美国南方的方言。

e.en: There is growing support for {localism} in food production.
e.zh: 食品生产中本土化的支持正在不断增长。

e.en: Several schools in the {locality} share sports facilities.
e.zh: 该地区的几所学校共用体育设施。

e.en: Crime rates in this {locality} have dropped sharply.
e.zh: 这个地区的犯罪率大幅下降。

e.en: Proper {localization} can double an app's overseas downloads.
e.zh: 良好的本地化可以让应用的海外下载量翻倍。

e.en: Brain {localization} helps neurosurgeons avoid critical regions.
e.zh: 脑功能定位有助于神经外科医生避开关键区域。

e.en: The team plans to {localize} the product for Brazil.
e.zh: 团队计划将产品本地化以进入巴西市场。

e.en: Doctors used an MRI to {localize} the tumor precisely.
e.zh: 医生用核磁共振精确定位了肿瘤。

e.en: The storm caused {localized} flooding in coastal areas.
e.zh: 暴风雨在沿海地区造成了局部洪涝。

e.en: Our software is fully {localized} for Chinese users.
e.zh: 我们的软件已完全针对中文用户进行了本地化。

e.en: All the ingredients are sourced {locally}.
e.zh: 所有食材都是本地采购的。

e.en: You can run the server {locally} on your laptop.
e.zh: 你可以在自己的笔记本电脑上本地运行这个服务器。

e.en: The {locals} recommended a tiny restaurant off the main square.
e.zh: 当地人推荐了主广场旁的一家小餐馆。

e.en: Most {locals} avoid the beach during tourist season.
e.zh: 旅游旺季时大多数本地人都不去海滩。

e.en: I can't {locate} my car keys anywhere.
e.zh: 我到处都找不到我的车钥匙。

e.en: The company plans to {locate} its new office downtown.
e.zh: 公司计划把新办公室设在市中心。

e.en: The hotel is conveniently {located} near the train station.
e.zh: 酒店位置便利，就在火车站附近。

e.en: Rescuers finally {located} the missing hiker at dawn.
e.zh: 救援人员在黎明时分终于找到了失踪的登山者。

e.en: The pet {locater} app pings her dog's collar every minute.
e.zh: 宠物定位应用每分钟向她家狗的项圈发一次信号。

e.en: He bought a key {locater} after losing his keys again.
e.zh: 又一次丢了钥匙后，他买了个钥匙定位器。

locates.t: v. 定位（第三人称单数）

e.en: This sensor quickly {locates} leaks in underground pipes.
e.zh: 这种传感器能快速定位地下管道的泄漏点。

e.en: The app {locates} the nearest charging station automatically.
e.zh: 这款应用会自动定位最近的充电站。

e.en: Rescue teams are {locating} survivors using thermal cameras.
e.zh: 救援队正在用热成像相机寻找幸存者。

e.en: I'm having trouble {locating} the file on my computer.
e.zh: 我在电脑上找不到那个文件。

e.en: Please share your {location} so I can pick you up.
e.zh: 请把你的位置发给我，我去接你。

e.en: The cafe moved to a new {location} last month.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆上个月搬到了新地址。

e.en: The store enjoys a clear {locational} advantage near the subway.
e.zh: 该店地处地铁附近，享有明显的位置优势。

e.en: {Locational} data helps retailers choose better store sites.
e.zh: 位置数据帮助零售商挑选更合适的门店地址。

e.en: The chain has over 200 {locations} across the country.
e.zh: 这家连锁店在全国有超过200家门店。

e.en: Several scenic {locations} were used for the film.
e.zh: 这部电影选用了几个风景优美的拍摄地点。

e.en: Use the store {locator} to find a branch nearby.
e.zh: 使用门店定位工具查找附近的分店。

e.en: The {locator} beacon helped rescuers find the lost climbers.
e.zh: 定位信标帮助救援人员找到了迷路的登山者。

e.en: Mist rose slowly off the surface of the Scottish {loch}.
e.zh: 薄雾缓缓从苏格兰湖面升起。

e.en: They rented a cottage overlooking a quiet {loch}.
e.zh: 他们租了一间俯瞰宁静湖泊的小屋。

lochaber.t: n. 洛哈伯（苏格兰地名）

e.en: The hiker explored the rugged hills of {Lochaber} in Scotland.
e.zh: 那位徒步者探访了苏格兰洛哈伯崎岖的山地。

e.en: A medieval warrior wielded a heavy {Lochaber} axe.
e.zh: 一名中世纪战士挥舞着沉重的洛哈伯长柄斧。

e.en: We camped beside a quiet {lochan} in the Highlands.
e.zh: 我们在高地一处宁静的小湖边露营。

e.en: The trail circles a tiny {lochan} hidden among hills.
e.zh: 小径环绕着群山间一汪隐秘的小湖。

loci.t: n. 位点、轨迹（locus 的复数）

e.en: Researchers identified several gene {loci} linked to the disease.
e.zh: 研究人员发现了若干与该疾病相关的基因位点。

e.en: The novel has multiple narrative {loci} that intersect cleverly.
e.zh: 这部小说有多个巧妙交织的叙事中心。

lock.t:
n. 锁
v. 锁上、锁定

e.en: Don't forget to {lock} the door before leaving.
e.zh: 出门前别忘了锁门。

e.en: The smart {lock} can be opened with your phone.
e.zh: 这种智能锁可以用手机打开。

e.en: Each room has a {lockable} cabinet for valuables.
e.zh: 每个房间都配有可上锁的柜子存放贵重物品。

e.en: We need a {lockable} drawer for the office files.
e.zh: 办公室文件需要一个能上锁的抽屉。

e.en: Important documents are kept in a bank {lockbox}.
e.zh: 重要文件存放在银行的保险箱里。

e.en: The agent left the key in a {lockbox} outside.
e.zh: 中介把钥匙放在屋外的密码盒里。

e.en: The city went into {lockdown} during the outbreak.
e.zh: 疫情爆发期间整座城市进入封锁状态。

e.en: Schools held a {lockdown} drill last Friday.
e.zh: 学校上周五进行了一次封锁演练。

locke.t: n. 洛克（人名，常指哲学家 John Locke）

e.en: John {Locke} influenced modern ideas about individual rights.
e.zh: 约翰·洛克影响了现代关于个人权利的观念。

e.en: Students read {Locke} in their political philosophy class.
e.zh: 学生们在政治哲学课上阅读洛克的著作。

e.en: The constitution reflects clearly {Lockean} ideas about property.
e.zh: 这部宪法明显体现了洛克关于财产的思想。

e.en: Her essay defends a {Lockean} view of consent.
e.zh: 她的论文捍卫了洛克式的同意观。

e.en: I accidentally {locked} myself out of the apartment.
e.zh: 我不小心把自己锁在了公寓外。

e.en: The phone screen is {locked} and needs a passcode.
e.zh: 手机屏幕已锁定,需要输入密码。

e.en: Leave your bag in the {locker} before swimming.
e.zh: 游泳前把包放进储物柜里。

e.en: He forgot the combination to his school {locker}.
e.zh: 他忘了学校储物柜的密码。

lockerbie.t: n. 洛克比（苏格兰城镇）

e.en: The {Lockerbie} bombing remains one of Britain's worst tragedies.
e.zh: 洛克比空难至今仍是英国最严重的悲剧之一。

e.en: A memorial in {Lockerbie} honors the 1988 victims.
e.zh: 洛克比的一处纪念碑铭记着1988年的遇难者。

locket.t: n. 挂在项链上的小盒坠

e.en: She wears a silver {locket} with her grandmother's photo.
e.zh: 她戴着一个装有祖母照片的银色小盒坠。

e.en: He gave her a heart-shaped {locket} for their anniversary.
e.zh: 周年纪念日他送了她一个心形项链盒坠。

lockheed.t: n. 洛克希德（美国航空公司）

e.en: {Lockheed} Martin builds advanced fighter jets for the military.
e.zh: 洛克希德·马丁公司为军方制造先进的战斗机。

e.en: He started his engineering career at {Lockheed} in California.
e.zh: 他在加州的洛克希德开启了工程师生涯。

locking.t: v. 锁定；上锁（lock 的现在分词）

e.en: She made sure the gate was {locking} properly.
e.zh: 她确认大门能正常锁上。

e.en: The phone keeps {locking} after thirty seconds of inactivity.
e.zh: 手机在闲置三十秒后就会自动锁屏。

lockjaw.t: n. 牙关紧闭症；破伤风

e.en: Untreated cuts can sometimes lead to {lockjaw} infections.
e.zh: 未经处理的伤口有时会引发破伤风感染。

e.en: The vaccine effectively prevents {lockjaw} in young children.
e.zh: 这种疫苗能有效预防儿童感染破伤风。

locknut.t: n. 防松螺母；锁紧螺母

e.en: Tighten the {locknut} to keep the bolt from loosening.
e.zh: 拧紧锁紧螺母以防螺栓松动。

e.en: A small {locknut} secures the wheel axle in place.
e.zh: 一个小小的锁紧螺母把轮轴固定到位。

lockout.t: n. 资方停工；锁定（账号）

e.en: The factory {lockout} lasted for over three weeks.
e.zh: 这家工厂的停工闭厂持续了三周多。

e.en: Too many wrong passwords trigger an account {lockout}.
e.zh: 密码错误次数过多会触发账户锁定。

locks.t:
n. 锁（复数）
v. 锁上（三单）

e.en: She {locks} her bike to a post every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早晨都把自行车锁在柱子上。

e.en: The boat passed slowly through the canal {locks}.
e.zh: 船缓缓地穿过运河的船闸。

e.en: We called a {locksmith} to open the jammed door.
e.zh: 我们叫了锁匠来打开卡死的门。

e.en: A skilled {locksmith} can rekey almost any lock.
e.zh: 熟练的锁匠几乎能给任何锁重新配钥匙。

e.en: The two parties voted in {lockstep} on the bill.
e.zh: 两党就这项法案步调一致地投了票。

e.en: Marketing and sales must move in {lockstep} this quarter.
e.zh: 本季度市场和销售必须紧密配合。

e.en: He spent the night in the local {lockup}.
e.zh: 他在当地的拘留所里待了一晚。

e.en: The garage doubles as a secure {lockup} for tools.
e.zh: 那间车库兼作存放工具的安全储物间。

e.en: You'd be {loco} to drive in this snowstorm.
e.zh: 在这种暴风雪里开车你简直疯了。

e.en: The crowd went totally {loco} after the winning goal.
e.zh: 制胜进球后人群彻底沸腾疯狂了。

e.en: Penguins {locomote} awkwardly on land but glide underwater.
e.zh: 企鹅在陆地上行动笨拙,水下却滑行自如。

e.en: Tiny robots can {locomote} through narrow pipes for inspection.
e.zh: 微型机器人能在狭窄管道中移动以进行检查。

e.en: Scientists study how insects achieve such efficient {locomotion}.
e.zh: 科学家研究昆虫如何实现如此高效的运动方式。

e.en: Walking is the most basic form of human {locomotion}.
e.zh: 行走是人类最基本的运动方式。

locomotions.t: n. 运动方式（locomotion 的复数）

e.en: Different animals exhibit remarkably varied {locomotions} across habitats.
e.zh: 不同动物在各种栖息地展现出截然不同的运动方式。

e.en: The robot supports several {locomotions}, including crawling and rolling.
e.zh: 这款机器人支持爬行、滚动等多种运动方式。

e.en: A steam {locomotive} pulled the vintage train into the station.
e.zh: 一台蒸汽机车把那列复古列车拉进了车站。

e.en: The diesel {locomotive} hauls freight across the country.
e.zh: 这台内燃机车牵引货物横跨全国。

e.en: Old {locomotives} are displayed at the railway museum.
e.zh: 铁路博物馆里陈列着老式机车。

e.en: Modern electric {locomotives} are quieter and far more efficient.
e.zh: 现代电力机车更安静,效率也高得多。

e.en: Cattle that eat {locoweed} can develop serious neurological problems.
e.zh: 吃了疯草的牛会出现严重的神经系统问题。

e.en: Ranchers fence off pastures to keep horses from {locoweed}.
e.zh: 牧场主用栅栏圈出牧场,防止马吃疯草。

e.en: A {locum} doctor covered the clinic during her vacation.
e.zh: 她休假期间由代班医生负责诊所。

e.en: The hospital hired a {locum} to fill the gap.
e.zh: 医院聘请了一名代班医生填补空缺。

e.en: The internet has become the {locus} of public debate.
e.zh: 互联网已成为公共讨论的中心。

e.en: Geneticists mapped the {locus} responsible for the trait.
e.zh: 遗传学家定位了控制该性状的基因位点。

e.en: A swarm of {locust} destroyed the entire wheat crop.
e.zh: 一群蝗虫把整片麦田都毁了。

e.en: Farmers fear another {locust} plague this dry season.
e.zh: 农民担心这个旱季再次爆发蝗灾。

e.en: His old-fashioned {locution} amused the younger employees.
e.zh: 他老派的措辞把年轻员工逗乐了。

e.en: That curious {locution} appears only in regional dialects.
e.zh: 这种奇特的说法只见于地方方言。

e.en: Miners discovered a rich silver {lode} deep underground.
e.zh: 矿工在地下深处发现了一条富银矿脉。

e.en: The old {lode} produced gold for nearly fifty years.
e.zh: 那条老矿脉出产黄金近五十年。

e.en: He wore a thick {loden} coat against the alpine wind.
e.zh: 他穿着一件厚厚的洛登呢大衣抵御山间寒风。

e.en: The shop sells traditional {loden} jackets from Austria.
e.zh: 这家店出售产自奥地利的传统洛登呢夹克。

lodestar.t: n. 北极星；指引方向的人或物

e.en: Honesty has been the {lodestar} of her career.
e.zh: 诚实一直是她职业生涯的指路明灯。

e.en: For sailors, the North Star served as a {lodestar}.
e.zh: 对水手来说,北极星就是指路明星。

lodestone.t: n. 天然磁石；有吸引力的事物

e.en: Ancient navigators used a {lodestone} to find magnetic north.
e.zh: 古代航海者用磁石来辨别磁北方向。

e.en: Silicon Valley remains a {lodestone} for tech talent.
e.zh: 硅谷依然是科技人才的强大磁石。

lodge.t:
n. 旅舍；门房
v. 正式提出；投宿

e.en: We stayed in a cozy mountain {lodge} last weekend.
e.zh: 上周末我们住在一家温馨的山间小屋。

e.en: She decided to {lodge} a formal complaint with management.
e.zh: 她决定向管理层正式提出投诉。

lodged.t: v. 提出（申诉）；借宿（过去式）

e.en: A fish bone {lodged} in his throat during dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭时一根鱼刺卡在了他的喉咙里。

e.en: Several residents {lodged} complaints about the new policy.
e.zh: 几位居民对新政策提出了投诉。

lodgement.t: n. 存留；（申诉）正式提出

e.en: The troops secured a {lodgement} on the enemy beach.
e.zh: 部队在敌方海滩上建立了立足点。

e.en: She made a {lodgement} of funds at the bank.
e.zh: 她把一笔款项存入了银行。

lodgepole.t: n. 扭叶松（北美针叶树）

e.en: {Lodgepole} pines dominate the slopes of the Rocky Mountains.
e.zh: 扭叶松遍布落基山脉的山坡。

e.en: The cabin was built from local {lodgepole} timber.
e.zh: 那间小屋是用当地的扭叶松木建造的。

e.en: They rent a spare room to a quiet {lodger}.
e.zh: 他们把一间空房租给了一位安静的房客。

e.en: The new {lodger} pays rent every Friday morning.
e.zh: 新来的房客每周五上午交房租。

lodges.t:
n. 旅舍（复数）
v. 提交（三单）

e.en: The resort {lodges} are booked solid for ski season.
e.zh: 度假村的小屋在滑雪季已经全部订满。

e.en: She {lodges} a complaint whenever the heater breaks down.
e.zh: 每次暖气坏了她都会投诉一次。

e.en: Affordable {lodging} can be hard to find downtown.
e.zh: 在市中心很难找到价格实惠的住处。

e.en: The university provides {lodging} for visiting researchers.
e.zh: 大学为来访的研究人员提供住宿。

e.en: He found cheap {lodgings} near the university campus.
e.zh: 他在大学校园附近找到了便宜的住处。

e.en: The travelers searched for {lodgings} before nightfall.
e.zh: 旅人们赶在天黑前寻找落脚之处。

e.en: {Lodz} is one of the largest cities in Poland.
e.zh: 罗兹是波兰最大的城市之一。

e.en: Her grandparents emigrated from {Lodz} after the war.
e.zh: 她的祖父母在战后从罗兹移居海外。

e.en: The Cornish word {loe} refers to a shallow coastal pool.
e.zh: 康沃尔语中的 loe 指浅浅的海岸潟湖。

e.en: Locals fish in the {loe} when the tide retreats.
e.zh: 潮水退去时当地人会在潟湖里捕鱼。

e.en: The fertile {loess} soil makes this region ideal for farming.
e.zh: 肥沃的黄土使这一地区非常适合耕作。

e.en: Wind-blown {loess} forms thick deposits across northern China.
e.zh: 风成黄土在中国北方形成了深厚的沉积层。

loft.t:
n. 阁楼；顶楼
v. 把球高高击出

e.en: They converted the old {loft} into a stylish studio.
e.zh: 他们把那间旧阁楼改造成了时尚的工作室。

e.en: He climbed up to the {loft} to find boxes.
e.zh: 他爬上阁楼去找箱子。

lofted.t:
v. 高高击出（过去式）
adj. 高起的

e.en: The striker {lofted} the ball over the goalkeeper.
e.zh: 前锋把球高高挑过了守门员。

e.en: She {lofted} her child onto her shoulders for the parade.
e.zh: 她把孩子高高举到肩上看游行。

e.en: He spoke {loftily} about his charitable contributions.
e.zh: 他高傲地谈论自己的慈善捐款。

e.en: She dismissed the criticism {loftily} and walked away.
e.zh: 她傲慢地无视那些批评,转身走开了。

e.en: The {loftiness} of the cathedral ceiling left visitors speechless.
e.zh: 大教堂天花板的高耸让游客哑口无言。

e.en: His {loftiness} of tone alienated the rest of the team.
e.zh: 他高傲的语气疏远了团队里的其他人。

lofty.t: adj. 崇高的；高耸的；高傲的

e.en: The startup has {lofty} goals for the next decade.
e.zh: 这家初创公司对未来十年抱有远大的目标。

e.en: We hiked through a forest of {lofty} pine trees.
e.zh: 我们穿过一片高耸的松林徒步前行。

log.t:
n. 日志；原木
v. 记录；登录

e.en: Please check the server {log} for error messages.
e.zh: 请查看服务器日志中的错误信息。

e.en: He tossed another {log} onto the campfire.
e.zh: 他又往篝火里扔了一根木头。

e.en: My cousin {Logan} just moved to Seattle for work.
e.zh: 我表弟洛根刚因工作搬去了西雅图。

e.en: We hiked up Mount {Logan} during our Yukon trip.
e.zh: 我们在育空旅行时登上了洛根山。

e.en: She moved to {London} after finishing her degree.
e.zh: 她拿到学位后搬去了伦敦。

e.en: {London} is famous for its red double-decker buses.
e.zh: 伦敦以红色双层巴士而闻名。

londonderry.t: n. 伦敦德里（北爱尔兰城市）

e.en: My grandfather was born in {Londonderry} during the war.
e.zh: 我祖父在战争期间出生于伦敦德里。

e.en: The bridge across {Londonderry} offers stunning river views.
e.zh: 横跨伦敦德里的大桥风景十分壮丽。

e.en: As a true {Londoner}, she rarely takes the tube during rush hour.
e.zh: 作为地道的伦敦人，她很少在高峰期坐地铁。

e.en: Every {Londoner} has an opinion about the best curry house.
e.zh: 每个伦敦人对最棒的咖喱店都有自己的看法。

e.en: A {lone} wolf wandered across the snowy field at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时分，一匹孤狼穿过雪原。

e.en: He was the {lone} survivor of the small plane crash.
e.zh: 他是那场小型飞机失事中唯一的幸存者。

e.en: Working from home can lead to unexpected {loneliness}.
e.zh: 在家办公有时会带来意想不到的孤独感。

e.en: She wrote a song about the {loneliness} of long tours.
e.zh: 她写了一首关于长途巡演孤独感的歌。

e.en: He felt {lonely} after moving to a new city.
e.zh: 搬到新城市后，他感到很孤单。

e.en: The cabin sits on a {lonely} stretch of coastline.
e.zh: 那间小屋坐落在一段荒凉的海岸线上。

e.en: He's a bit of a {loner} but very kind once you know him.
e.zh: 他有点独来独往，但熟了之后非常友善。

e.en: The new hire is a {loner} who prefers working night shifts.
e.zh: 新来的员工很独，喜欢上夜班。

e.en: The old cowboy sang a {lonesome} tune by the fire.
e.zh: 老牛仔在火堆旁唱着一首孤寂的曲子。

e.en: I get {lonesome} when my roommate travels for work.
e.zh: 室友出差时我会觉得很寂寞。

long.t:
adj. 长的；长时间的
v. 渴望

e.en: The meeting was way too {long} for such a simple topic.
e.zh: 这么简单的话题，会议开得太久了。

e.en: I {long} for the quiet summers of my childhood.
e.zh: 我渴望儿时那些宁静的夏天。

e.en: They've been in a {long-distance} relationship for two years.
e.zh: 他们异地恋已经两年了。

e.en: She trains every morning for {long-distance} running.
e.zh: 她每天早上都为长跑训练。

e.en: This lipstick is famous for its {long-lasting} finish.
e.zh: 这支口红以持久的妆效闻名。

e.en: The treaty created a {long-lasting} peace between the nations.
e.zh: 该条约为两国带来了持久的和平。

e.en: The new electric car has impressive {long-range} capability.
e.zh: 这款新电动车的续航能力令人印象深刻。

e.en: We need a {long-range} plan for the company's growth.
e.zh: 我们需要一份公司发展的长期规划。

e.en: They have a {long-standing} tradition of Sunday dinners.
e.zh: 他们有周日聚餐的悠久传统。

e.en: The two families share a {long-standing} feud.
e.zh: 两家有着由来已久的恩怨。

e.en: Smoking has serious {long-term} health effects.
e.zh: 吸烟会造成严重的长期健康影响。

e.en: We're looking for {long-term} renters, not vacationers.
e.zh: 我们想找长期租户，不是度假客。

e.en: She's a {long-time} fan of the band's earlier albums.
e.zh: 她是这支乐队早期专辑的多年老粉丝。

e.en: My {long-time} neighbor finally moved last month.
e.zh: 我的多年老邻居上个月终于搬走了。

e.en: His {long-winded} speech put half the audience to sleep.
e.zh: 他冗长的演讲让一半观众都睡着了。

e.en: Skip the {long-winded} intro and get to the point.
e.zh: 省掉啰嗦的开场，直接说重点。

e.en: The hunter spotted a wild {longbeard} turkey at sunrise.
e.zh: 猎人在日出时发现了一只野生长须火鸡。

e.en: That old {longbeard} gnome statue guards the garden gate.
e.zh: 那座长胡子的老侏儒雕像守着花园门口。

e.en: The Viking {longboat} glided silently into the harbor.
e.zh: 维京长船无声地驶入港口。

e.en: Sailors rowed the {longboat} toward the rocky shore.
e.zh: 水手们把长艇划向岩石海岸。

e.en: English archers used the {longbow} to devastating effect at Agincourt.
e.zh: 英国弓箭手在阿金库尔用长弓造成了毁灭性打击。

e.en: He carved a yew {longbow} the traditional way.
e.zh: 他用传统方法雕制了一把紫杉长弓。

longchamp.t: n. 珑骧（法国奢侈品牌）

e.en: She carries a foldable {Longchamp} tote to work every day.
e.zh: 她每天都背一只可折叠的珑骧手提包上班。

e.en: The {Longchamp} store on the Champs-Élysées was packed.
e.zh: 香榭丽舍大街上的珑骧专卖店挤满了人。

longer.t: adj. 更长的（long 的比较级）

e.en: The commute takes {longer} when it rains heavily.
e.zh: 下大雨时通勤要更久。

e.en: I can't wait any {longer} for the package to arrive.
e.zh: 我没法再等包裹送到了。

longest.t: adj. 最长的（long 的最高级）

e.en: The Nile is often called the {longest} river in the world.
e.zh: 尼罗河常被称为世界上最长的河流。

e.en: That was the {longest} meeting I've sat through this year.
e.zh: 那是我今年开过的最长的会议。

e.en: Regular exercise is linked to greater {longevity}.
e.zh: 经常锻炼与更长的寿命息息相关。

e.en: The brand's {longevity} in the market is impressive.
e.zh: 该品牌在市场上的长寿令人印象深刻。

e.en: We read {Longfellow}'s poem about Paul Revere in class.
e.zh: 我们在课上读了朗费罗写保罗·里维尔的诗。

e.en: {Longfellow} remains one of America's most beloved poets.
e.zh: 朗费罗至今仍是美国最受喜爱的诗人之一。

longford.t: n. 朗福德（爱尔兰郡名）

e.en: My cousin grew up on a small farm near {Longford}.
e.zh: 我表哥在朗福德附近的一个小农场长大。

e.en: {Longford} is one of the smaller counties in Ireland.
e.zh: 朗福德是爱尔兰较小的郡之一。

longhand.t: n. 普通书写（相对速记）

e.en: She still drafts her novels in {longhand} before typing them.
e.zh: 她至今仍先用手写起草小说，再打字录入。

e.en: Writing the address in {longhand} took only a moment.
e.zh: 用手写填上地址只花了一会儿。

e.en: A massive {longhorn} steer grazed in the Texas pasture.
e.zh: 一头巨大的长角牛在德州牧场上吃草。

e.en: The university's mascot is a fierce {longhorn}.
e.zh: 这所大学的吉祥物是一头威猛的长角牛。

e.en: The Iroquois {longhouse} could shelter several families together.
e.zh: 易洛魁人的长屋可供几户人家共同居住。

e.en: We toured a reconstructed {longhouse} at the museum.
e.zh: 我们在博物馆参观了一座复原的长屋。

longing.t:
n. 渴望；向往
adj. 渴望的

e.en: She gazed at the photo with deep {longing}.
e.zh: 她带着深深的思念凝视着那张照片。

e.en: There's a quiet {longing} in his latest songs.
e.zh: 他最新的歌曲里透着一种淡淡的渴望。

e.en: He stared {longingly} at the bakery window.
e.zh: 他依依不舍地望着面包店的橱窗。

e.en: She spoke {longingly} of summers spent at her grandmother's house.
e.zh: 她满怀眷恋地谈起在外婆家度过的夏天。

e.en: He has a {longish} beard that he keeps neatly trimmed.
e.zh: 他留着一把略长的胡子，修得很整齐。

e.en: It was a {longish} drive, about four hours total.
e.zh: 路程有点长，总共开了大约四个小时。

e.en: Greenwich is the reference point for zero {longitude}.
e.zh: 格林尼治是零度经线的基准点。

e.en: GPS tells you both latitude and {longitude} instantly.
e.zh: GPS 能立刻告诉你纬度和经度。

e.en: The {longitudinal} study tracked children for twenty years.
e.zh: 这项纵向研究对儿童跟踪了二十年。

e.en: Engineers added {longitudinal} beams to strengthen the bridge.
e.zh: 工程师加了纵向梁来加固桥梁。

e.en: Slice the zucchini {longitudinally} into thin strips.
e.zh: 把西葫芦顺着长边切成薄条。

e.en: The data was analyzed {longitudinally} over five years.
e.zh: 这些数据以纵向方式分析了五年。

e.en: Commercial fishermen often use {longline} gear to catch tuna.
e.zh: 商业渔民常用延绳钓具捕捞金枪鱼。

e.en: She wore a stylish {longline} blazer to the meeting.
e.zh: 她穿了一件时髦的长款西装外套去开会。

e.en: The {Longman} dictionary is popular among English learners.
e.zh: 朗文词典在英语学习者中很受欢迎。

e.en: I've used my {Longman} grammar book since high school.
e.zh: 我从高中起就一直用这本朗文语法书。

e.en: Strong {longshore} currents are reshaping the beach.
e.zh: 强劲的沿岸流正在重塑海滩。

e.en: The {longshore} drift carries sand southward each year.
e.zh: 沿岸漂移每年都把沙子带向南方。

e.en: His father worked as a {longshoreman} at the Brooklyn docks.
e.zh: 他父亲曾在布鲁克林码头当装卸工。

e.en: Every {longshoreman} on the pier joined the strike.
e.zh: 码头上的每一位装卸工都加入了罢工。

e.en: The two countries finally resolved their {longstanding} border dispute.
e.zh: 两国终于解决了由来已久的边界争端。

e.en: She has a {longstanding} friendship with her college roommate.
e.zh: 她和大学室友有着多年的深厚友谊。

e.en: My {longtime} mentor retired from the firm last spring.
e.zh: 我多年的导师去年春天从公司退休了。

e.en: The café has welcomed {longtime} regulars for decades.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆几十年来一直接待着老顾客。

lonicera.t: n. 忍冬属（金银花属植物）

e.en: The garden wall was covered with fragrant {Lonicera} blossoms.
e.zh: 花园墙上爬满了芬芳的忍冬花。

e.en: {Lonicera} attracts hummingbirds throughout the summer months.
e.zh: 忍冬属植物整个夏天都会吸引蜂鸟。

lonsdale.t: n. 朗斯代尔（姓氏/品牌）

e.en: The boxer wore a classic {Lonsdale} jacket to the press conference.
e.zh: 那位拳击手穿着经典的朗斯戴尔夹克出席记者会。

e.en: My uncle still owns a vintage {Lonsdale} championship belt.
e.zh: 我叔叔还保留着一条复古的朗斯戴尔冠军腰带。

e.en: Excuse me, where's the {loo} in this restaurant?
e.zh: 不好意思，这家餐厅的洗手间在哪里？

e.en: I need to pop to the {loo} before we leave.
e.zh: 出门前我得去趟洗手间。

e.en: We spent a sunny weekend in the fishing village of {Looe}.
e.zh: 我们在渔村卢镇度过了一个阳光明媚的周末。

e.en: {Looe} is famous for its fresh seafood and quaint harbor.
e.zh: 卢镇以新鲜的海鲜和古朴的港口闻名。

e.en: She scrubs her back with a natural {loofah} every morning.
e.zh: 她每天早上用天然丝瓜络擦背。

e.en: A dried {loofah} makes a great eco-friendly sponge.
e.zh: 晒干的丝瓜络是很好的环保海绵。

look.t:
v. 看；看起来
n. 表情；样子

e.en: Let me {look} at your homework before you submit it.
e.zh: 提交之前让我先看看你的作业。

e.en: That dress gives you a really polished {look}.
e.zh: 那条裙子让你看起来非常精致。

e.en: He's a striking {lookalike} of a famous Hollywood actor.
e.zh: 他和一位好莱坞明星长得惊人地相似。

e.en: The cafe hosted an Elvis {lookalike} contest last weekend.
e.zh: 那家咖啡馆上周末举办了猫王模仿者大赛。

e.en: The {logarithm} of one hundred to base ten equals two.
e.zh: 以10为底100的对数等于2。

e.en: Engineers often use the natural {logarithm} in growth models.
e.zh: 工程师在增长模型中常使用自然对数。

logarithmic.t: adj. 对数的；成对数关系的

e.en: The chart uses a {logarithmic} scale to show large ranges.
e.zh: 该图表使用对数刻度来展示较大的数据范围。

e.en: User growth followed a {logarithmic} curve after launch.
e.zh: 产品发布后用户增长呈对数曲线。

e.en: Server costs scale {logarithmically} with the number of users.
e.zh: 服务器成本随用户数呈对数级增长。

e.en: The volume slider increases {logarithmically} for natural hearing.
e.zh: 音量滑块按对数方式递增以贴合人耳感知。

e.en: The captain recorded the storm in his {logbook}.
e.zh: 船长把这场风暴记录在了航海日志里。

e.en: Pilots are required to keep an accurate flight {logbook}.
e.zh: 飞行员必须保存准确的飞行日志。

e.en: We watched the opera from a private {loge} above the stage.
e.zh: 我们在舞台上方的私人包厢里观看了歌剧。

e.en: The theater's front {loge} seats sold out within minutes.
e.zh: 剧院前排包厢的座位几分钟内就售罄了。

logged.t: v. 记录；登录（log 的过去式）

e.en: I {logged} into my account to check the order status.
e.zh: 我登录账户查看订单状态。

e.en: The system has {logged} every change made to the document.
e.zh: 系统已经记录了对该文档的每一次修改。

logger.t:
n. 日志记录器
n. 伐木工人

e.en: The {logger} writes detailed messages to help debug the app.
e.zh: 日志记录器会写入详细信息来帮助调试应用。

e.en: A {logger} carefully felled the old pine tree.
e.zh: 一位伐木工小心地砍倒了那棵老松树。

loggerhead.t:
n. 红海龟
n. 争吵 (at loggerheads)

e.en: The two siblings are constantly at {loggerheads} over money.
e.zh: 两兄弟总是因为钱的问题争执不下。

e.en: A {loggerhead} turtle laid her eggs on the moonlit beach.
e.zh: 一只红海龟在月光下的沙滩上产下了卵。

loggia.t: n. 凉廊（建筑中的敞廊）

e.en: We had breakfast on the sunny {loggia} overlooking the garden.
e.zh: 我们在洒满阳光、可俯瞰花园的敞廊上用了早餐。

e.en: The Renaissance villa featured a beautifully painted {loggia}.
e.zh: 那座文艺复兴别墅有一个绘饰精美的敞廊。

logging.t:
n. 日志记录（程序）
n. 伐木作业

e.en: Enable verbose {logging} to track down the error.
e.zh: 启用详细日志以便追踪这个错误。

e.en: {Logging} in the rainforest threatens many endangered species.
e.zh: 雨林中的伐木活动威胁着许多濒危物种。

e.en: Her argument followed a clear and simple {logic}.
e.zh: 她的论证遵循了清晰简单的逻辑。

e.en: There is a bug in the payment validation {logic}.
e.zh: 支付验证逻辑里有一个 bug。

logical.t: adj. 合乎逻辑的；合理的

e.en: Selling the old car was the {logical} thing to do.
e.zh: 把那辆旧车卖掉是合乎逻辑的选择。

e.en: The code groups related functions into {logical} modules.
e.zh: 这段代码把相关函数归入了合理的模块中。

e.en: {Logically}, we should fix the database before deploying.
e.zh: 按理说,我们应该先修好数据库再部署。

e.en: The chapters are {logically} arranged from basic to advanced.
e.zh: 各章节按从基础到进阶的顺序合理编排。

e.en: Aristotle is often called the first great {logician}.
e.zh: 亚里士多德常被称为第一位伟大的逻辑学家。

e.en: The {logician} carefully dissected each premise of the argument.
e.zh: 那位逻辑学家仔细剖析了论证中的每一个前提。

e.en: The actress won a {Logie} for best new talent.
e.zh: 那位女演员凭借最佳新人奖获得了洛吉奖。

e.en: Australian TV stars gathered for the annual {Logie} Awards.
e.zh: 澳大利亚的电视明星齐聚一年一度的洛吉奖颁奖礼。

e.en: The model uses a {logistic} function to predict probabilities.
e.zh: 该模型使用逻辑函数来预测概率。

e.en: They faced major {logistic} challenges shipping goods overseas.
e.zh: 他们在向海外运货时面临重大的物流难题。

logistical.t: adj. 后勤方面的；物流的

e.en: Organizing the conference was a {logistical} nightmare.
e.zh: 筹办这场会议在后勤上简直是一场噩梦。

e.en: The team solved several {logistical} problems before launch day.
e.zh: 团队在发布日之前解决了若干后勤问题。

logistically.t: adv. 从后勤角度；在物流上

e.en: {Logistically}, holding the wedding abroad will be very tricky.
e.zh: 在后勤上,把婚礼办到国外会非常棘手。

e.en: The plan is sound but {logistically} difficult to execute.
e.zh: 这个计划想法不错,但执行起来后勤上很困难。

e.en: The company specializes in global shipping and {logistics}.
e.zh: 这家公司专注于全球运输与物流业务。

e.en: We still need to figure out the {logistics} of moving day.
e.zh: 我们还得搞定搬家当天的各种安排。

logjam.t: n. 僵局；积压待办事项

e.en: The legislative {logjam} delayed the new tax bill for months.
e.zh: 立法僵局让新税法案延后了好几个月。

e.en: A merge conflict caused a {logjam} in our release pipeline.
e.zh: 一次合并冲突让我们的发布流程陷入了堵塞。

e.en: The startup unveiled its new {logo} on social media.
e.zh: 这家初创公司在社交媒体上公布了新的标志。

e.en: Every shirt is embroidered with the team {logo}.
e.zh: 每件衬衫上都绣着球队的标志。

logocentric.t: adj. 以语言文字为中心的

e.en: Derrida criticized Western philosophy for being deeply {logocentric}.
e.zh: 德里达批评西方哲学根深蒂固地以逻各斯为中心。

e.en: Her essay challenges the {logocentric} bias of academic writing.
e.zh: 她的论文挑战了学术写作中的逻各斯中心主义偏见。

logoes.t: n. logo 的复数（非标准拼写）

e.en: The brand book displays all approved company {logoes} side by side.
e.zh: 品牌手册并排展示了所有获批的公司标志。

e.en: Several team {logoes} were redesigned ahead of the new season.
e.zh: 新赛季开始前,有几支球队的标志被重新设计了。

e.en: Enter your credentials at the {logon} screen to continue.
e.zh: 在登录界面输入凭据后继续操作。

e.en: Each {logon} attempt is recorded for security auditing.
e.zh: 每一次登录尝试都会被记录以便安全审计。

logs.t:
n. 日志（复数）
v. 记录；登录

e.en: Check the server {logs} to see why the request failed.
e.zh: 查看服务器日志,看看请求为什么失败。

e.en: He stacked the {logs} neatly beside the fireplace.
e.zh: 他把木柴整齐地堆在壁炉旁。

logue.t: (罕用) 后缀，表'话语'，如 dialogue

e.en: The film opens with a haunting voice-over prologue and {logue}.
e.zh: 这部电影以一段令人难忘的画外音序幕和尾声开篇。

e.en: Many old English words use the suffix {logue}, like dialogue.
e.zh: 许多古英语词使用 -logue 这一后缀,比如 dialogue。

logwood.t: n. 洋苏木（一种染料木）

e.en: The dye came from the heartwood of the {logwood} tree.
e.zh: 这种染料来自洋苏木的心材。

e.en: Historians traded {logwood} across the Caribbean for centuries.
e.zh: 几个世纪以来,商人在加勒比地区贩卖洋苏木。

e.en: The chef seared a tender pork {loin} for dinner.
e.zh: 主厨为晚餐煎了一块嫩嫩的猪里脊。

e.en: He felt a sharp pain in his lower {loin} after lifting.
e.zh: 举重之后,他下腰部感到一阵剧痛。

e.en: The statue depicts a warrior wearing only a simple {loincloth}.
e.zh: 这尊雕像刻画了一位只缠着简单腰布的战士。

e.en: Tribal dancers performed in colorful beaded {loincloths}.
e.zh: 部落舞者穿着色彩缤纷的串珠腰布表演。

e.en: We cycled along the {Loire} river past several châteaux.
e.zh: 我们沿着卢瓦尔河骑行,经过了好几座城堡。

e.en: The {Loire} valley is famous for its crisp white wines.
e.zh: 卢瓦尔河谷以其清爽的白葡萄酒而闻名。

e.en: Please don't {loiter} in the hallway after class ends.
e.zh: 下课后请不要在走廊里逗留。

e.en: Teenagers tend to {loiter} outside the convenience store at night.
e.zh: 青少年晚上常爱在便利店外面闲逛。

e.en: A few fans {loitered} by the stage door hoping for autographs.
e.zh: 几位粉丝在后台门口徘徊,希望能要到签名。

e.en: He {loitered} near the café until his friend finally arrived.
e.zh: 他在咖啡馆附近闲晃,直到朋友终于到了。

e.en: The security guard asked the {loiterer} to move along.
e.zh: 保安让那个闲逛的人离开。

e.en: A suspicious {loiterer} caught the shopkeeper's attention.
e.zh: 一个形迹可疑的徘徊者引起了店主的注意。

loitering.t: v. 闲逛；游荡（现在分词）

e.en: The sign warned that {loitering} was strictly prohibited.
e.zh: 告示牌警告严禁逗留。

e.en: He was fined for {loitering} outside the train station.
e.zh: 他因在火车站外徘徊而被罚款。

loiters.t: v. 闲逛（第三人称单数）

e.en: He often {loiters} by the vending machine between classes.
e.zh: 课间他常在自动售货机旁逗留。

e.en: Whoever {loiters} near the gate after dark gets questioned.
e.zh: 天黑后在大门附近徘徊的人都会被盘问。

lok.t: (罕用) 常作缩写，如 Lok Sabha

e.en: The {Lok} Sabha debated the new education bill yesterday.
e.zh: 印度人民院昨天就新的教育法案展开了辩论。

e.en: He won his seat in the {Lok} Sabha by a wide margin.
e.zh: 他以巨大优势赢得了人民院的席位。

lolita.t: n. 洛丽塔（少女风格/人名）

e.en: Nabokov's {Lolita} remains one of the most controversial novels.
e.zh: 纳博科夫的《洛丽塔》至今仍是最具争议的小说之一。

e.en: She dressed in a frilly {Lolita} style for the cosplay event.
e.zh: 她在角色扮演活动上穿了一身花边的洛丽塔风格服装。

loll.t: v. 懒洋洋地靠着；伸出（舌头）

e.en: The cats {loll} on the sunny windowsill all afternoon.
e.zh: 猫咪们整个下午都懒洋洋地躺在洒满阳光的窗台上。

e.en: Tourists {loll} on the beach with cold drinks in hand.
e.zh: 游客们手拿冷饮,慵懒地躺在沙滩上。

e.en: The dentist gave each child a sugar-free {lollipop}.
e.zh: 牙医给每个孩子发了一根无糖棒棒糖。

e.en: She unwrapped a strawberry {lollipop} and smiled happily.
e.zh: 她剥开一根草莓味的棒棒糖,开心地笑了。

e.en: On hot days nothing beats an ice {lolly} from the freezer.
e.zh: 大热天里,没什么比从冰柜里拿出来的冰棒更爽了。

e.en: The kids begged Mum for another orange {lolly}.
e.zh: 孩子们缠着妈妈再要一根橙味棒棒糖。

loma.t: n. 洛马（地名常用词，意为'小丘'）

e.en: We hiked up the dusty {loma} to watch the sunset.
e.zh: 我们沿着尘土飞扬的小山丘往上爬,欣赏日落。

e.en: Their ranch sits on a gentle {loma} above the river.
e.zh: 他们的牧场坐落在河上方一座平缓的小山上。

lomas.t: n. 雾绿洲；洛马斯（地名/姓氏）

e.en: Fog drifts over the coastal {lomas} every winter morning.
e.zh: 每个冬天的清晨,海雾都飘过沿海的丘陵地带。

e.en: The {lomas} near Lima bloom briefly after seasonal mist.
e.zh: 利马附近的雾绿洲在季节性雾气过后会短暂开花。

lombard.t:
adj. 伦巴第的
n. 伦巴第人

e.en: San Francisco's {Lombard} Street is famous for its sharp curves.
e.zh: 旧金山的伦巴第街以急弯而闻名。

e.en: He took out a {Lombard} loan against his art collection.
e.zh: 他用自己的艺术收藏品作抵押申请了一笔抵押贷款。

lombardy.t: n. 伦巴第（意大利地区）

e.en: {Lombardy} is one of Italy's wealthiest northern regions.
e.zh: 伦巴第是意大利最富裕的北方大区之一。

e.en: Tall {Lombardy} poplars lined the country road.
e.zh: 高大的伦巴第杨沿乡间小路一字排开。

e.en: We rented a cottage near Loch {Lomond} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们在洛蒙德湖附近租了一间小屋过周末。

e.en: Loch {Lomond} is the largest lake by surface area in Britain.
e.zh: 洛蒙德湖是英国面积最大的湖泊。

looked.t: v. look 的过去式；看、瞧

e.en: She {looked} surprised when I told her the news.
e.zh: 我告诉她那个消息时，她看起来很惊讶。

e.en: He {looked} everywhere for his missing car keys.
e.zh: 他到处找他丢失的车钥匙。

looker.t:
n. 美人、好看的人
n. 观看者

e.en: Their new puppy is a real {looker} with bright blue eyes.
e.zh: 他们家的新小狗有双明亮的蓝眼睛，超级好看。

e.en: That vintage convertible is a real {looker}.
e.zh: 那辆老式敞篷车真是好看极了。

looking.t:
v. look 的现在分词；正在看
adj. 看起来…的

e.en: I'm {looking} forward to our trip next month.
e.zh: 我很期待下个月的旅行。

e.en: She's been {looking} for a new apartment for weeks.
e.zh: 她已经找新公寓找了好几个星期了。

lookout.t:
n. 瞭望员、警戒
n. 留心、注意

e.en: Keep a {lookout} for deer crossing the highway at dusk.
e.zh: 黄昏时要留意横穿公路的鹿。

e.en: From the {lookout}, you can see the entire valley.
e.zh: 从瞭望台可以俯瞰整个山谷。

looks.t:
n. 外貌、长相
v. look 的第三人称单数

e.en: She {looks} tired after the long flight home.
e.zh: 长途飞行回来后她看起来很疲惫。

e.en: I love the {looks} of this minimalist apartment.
e.zh: 我很喜欢这间极简公寓的外观。

lookup.t: n. 查找、检索（数据查询）

e.en: The app does a quick database {lookup} for each query.
e.zh: 该应用对每次查询都进行快速的数据库查找。

e.en: Add a phone number {lookup} feature to the contacts page.
e.zh: 在联系人页面添加电话号码查询功能。

loom.t:
v. (危险) 逼近、隐现
n. 织布机

e.en: Deadlines {loom} as the launch date approaches.
e.zh: 随着发布日期临近,截止期限步步逼近。

e.en: My grandmother weaves rugs on a wooden {loom}.
e.zh: 我外婆用一台木制织布机织地毯。

loomed.t: v. loom 的过去式；逼近、隐现

e.en: Storm clouds {loomed} over the harbor all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午乌云笼罩着港口上空。

e.en: Layoffs {loomed} after the company missed its targets.
e.zh: 公司未达目标后,裁员阴影逼近。

e.en: Engineers worry about the {looming} server capacity crisis.
e.zh: 工程师们担心即将到来的服务器容量危机。

e.en: A {looming} shadow appeared at the end of the hallway.
e.zh: 走廊尽头出现了一个隐约逼近的身影。

looms.t:
v. loom 的第三人称单数
n. 织布机（复数）

e.en: A tax deadline {looms} at the end of April.
e.zh: 四月底的报税截止日期迫在眉睫。

e.en: The factory still uses traditional wooden {looms}.
e.zh: 这家工厂仍在使用传统的木制织布机。

loon.t:
n. 潜鸟（一种水鸟）
n. 疯子、傻瓜

e.en: A {loon} called eerily across the still lake.
e.zh: 一只潜鸟在平静的湖面上发出诡异的叫声。

e.en: He acted like a complete {loon} at the party.
e.zh: 他在派对上表现得像个十足的疯子。

e.en: That conspiracy theory sounds totally {looney} to me.
e.zh: 那个阴谋论听起来对我来说完全是疯狂的。

e.en: The kids grew up watching {Looney} Tunes cartoons.
e.zh: 孩子们是看着乐一通动画片长大的。

e.en: The {loonie} dropped against the US dollar this week.
e.zh: 加元本周对美元汇率下跌。

e.en: He tossed a shiny {loonie} into the busker's hat.
e.zh: 他往街头艺人的帽子里扔了一枚亮闪闪的加元硬币。

loony.t:
adj. 疯癫的、古怪的
n. 疯子

e.en: His {loony} startup idea actually made millions.
e.zh: 他那个疯狂的创业点子居然赚了几百万。

e.en: The plan sounds {loony} but it just might work.
e.zh: 这个计划听起来很疯狂,但说不定真能行。

loop.t:
n. 循环、回路
v. 使成环、循环播放

e.en: Please keep me in the {loop} on the project.
e.zh: 项目进展请随时让我知道。

e.en: The script runs an infinite {loop} until you press stop.
e.zh: 该脚本会一直循环运行,直到你按下停止。

looped.t:
v. loop 的过去式；环绕
adj. 循环的

e.en: The video {looped} on the big screen all evening.
e.zh: 那段视频整晚都在大屏幕上循环播放。

e.en: She {looped} the scarf twice around her neck.
e.zh: 她把围巾在脖子上绕了两圈。

e.en: Guitarists use a {looper} pedal to layer riffs live.
e.zh: 吉他手用循环踏板现场叠加乐句。

e.en: The {looper} caterpillar arches its body as it crawls.
e.zh: 尺蠖在爬行时会把身体弓起来。

loophole.t: n. (法律、规则的) 漏洞、空子

e.en: Lawyers found a tax {loophole} that saved millions.
e.zh: 律师们找到了一个为公司省下数百万的税务漏洞。

e.en: The new regulation closes a major reporting {loophole}.
e.zh: 新规堵上了一个重大的申报漏洞。

looping.t:
n. 循环、成环
v. loop 的现在分词

e.en: The song kept {looping} in my head all day.
e.zh: 那首歌整天在我脑海里循环播放。

e.en: Try {looping} through the array with a forEach call.
e.zh: 试试用 forEach 遍历这个数组。

loops.t:
n. 循环（复数）
v. loop 的第三人称单数

e.en: Nested {loops} can really slow down your code.
e.zh: 嵌套循环会大大拖慢你的代码。

e.en: The roller coaster does three upside-down {loops}.
e.zh: 这个过山车有三个倒立的环形圈。

loopy.t:
adj. 古怪的、疯癫的
adj. 多环的

e.en: I felt a bit {loopy} after the dental anesthesia.
e.zh: 打完牙科麻药后我感觉有点晕乎乎的。

e.en: She has {loopy} handwriting that's hard to read.
e.zh: 她的字迹弯弯绕绕的,很难辨认。

loos.t: n. 厕所（loo 的复数，英式口语）

e.en: The pub's {loos} are tucked behind the kitchen.
e.zh: 酒吧的厕所藏在厨房后面。

e.en: Public {loos} in the park close at sunset.
e.zh: 公园里的公共厕所日落时关闭。

loose.t:
adj. 松的、宽松的
v. 松开、释放

e.en: This screw feels {loose} and needs tightening.
e.zh: 这颗螺丝有点松了,需要拧紧。

e.en: She prefers {loose} cotton shirts in the summer.
e.zh: 她夏天偏爱宽松的棉质衬衫。

e.en: I keep my notes in a {looseleaf} binder.
e.zh: 我把笔记放在活页夹里。

e.en: The teacher handed out {looseleaf} paper for the test.
e.zh: 老师为考试发了活页纸。

e.en: The film is {loosely} based on a true story.
e.zh: 这部电影松散地改编自一个真实故事。

e.en: Tie the rope {loosely} so it can slide.
e.zh: 绳子松松地系着,这样才能滑动。

e.en: Stretch first to {loosen} your tight shoulders.
e.zh: 先拉伸一下,放松僵硬的肩膀。

e.en: The central bank may {loosen} monetary policy soon.
e.zh: 央行可能很快会放松货币政策。

loosened.t: v. loosen 的过去式；松开、放松

e.en: He {loosened} his tie after the long meeting.
e.zh: 漫长的会议结束后他松开了领带。

e.en: The country gradually {loosened} its travel restrictions.
e.zh: 该国逐步放宽了旅行限制。

e.en: The {looseness} of the steering wheel worried me.
e.zh: 方向盘的松动让我很担心。

e.en: There's a pleasant {looseness} to her writing style.
e.zh: 她的写作风格有一种令人愉悦的随性感。

loosening.t:
n. 放松、松动
v. loosen 的现在分词

e.en: China is {loosening} rules on foreign investment.
e.zh: 中国正在放宽外商投资的相关规定。

e.en: She felt the knot slowly {loosening} under pressure.
e.zh: 她感到那个结在压力下慢慢松开了。

e.en: Purple {loosestrife} has invaded many North American wetlands.
e.zh: 紫千屈菜已经入侵了北美许多湿地。

e.en: Bees love the tall pink spikes of {loosestrife}.
e.zh: 蜜蜂喜爱千屈菜高高的粉色花穗。

loot.t:
n. 战利品、赃物
v. 抢劫、洗劫

e.en: Players grind dungeons hoping for rare {loot}.
e.zh: 玩家刷副本就是为了拿稀有战利品。

e.en: The pirates buried their {loot} on a remote island.
e.zh: 海盗们把战利品埋在了一个偏远的小岛上。

looted.t: v. loot 的过去式；抢劫、洗劫

e.en: Soldiers {looted} the museum during the occupation.
e.zh: 占领期间士兵们洗劫了博物馆。

e.en: The vault was {looted} of millions in cash.
e.zh: 金库里被劫走了数百万现金。

looter.t: n. 抢劫者、趁乱抢掠者

e.en: Police arrested a {looter} carrying stolen electronics.
e.zh: 警方逮捕了一名携带被盗电子产品的劫掠者。

e.en: A lone {looter} smashed the storefront window.
e.zh: 一名独行的劫掠者砸碎了店面的玻璃窗。

looting.t:
n. 抢劫、洗劫
v. loot 的现在分词

e.en: Widespread {looting} broke out after the power failure.
e.zh: 停电后各地爆发了大规模的抢劫事件。

e.en: Authorities are {looting} concerns following the riots.
e.zh: 当局在骚乱后正关注抢劫问题。

e.en: We'll {lop} a few branches off the apple tree.
e.zh: 我们要把苹果树的几根枝条砍掉。

e.en: The new chip can {lop} seconds off load times.
e.zh: 新芯片可以把加载时间缩短几秒。

lope.t:
v. 轻快地跑、大步慢跑
n. 大步慢跑

e.en: The wolf began to {lope} across the open field.
e.zh: 那匹狼开始大步穿过开阔的田野。

e.en: He moved with the easy {lope} of an athlete.
e.zh: 他迈着运动员般轻松的大步前行。

loping.t: v. lope 的现在分词；大步慢跑

e.en: A coyote came {loping} along the dusty trail.
e.zh: 一只郊狼沿着尘土飞扬的小径大步跑来。

e.en: The runner had a smooth, {loping} stride.
e.zh: 那名跑者步伐流畅而轻快。

e.en: Grab the {lopper} to cut those thick branches.
e.zh: 拿那把大剪刀来剪那些粗树枝。

e.en: A sharp {lopper} makes garden pruning much easier.
e.zh: 一把锋利的修枝剪让花园修剪轻松多了。

e.en: The shelf has a noticeable {lopside} tilt to the left.
e.zh: 那个架子明显向左倾斜。

e.en: Don't load all the books on one {lopside} of the cart.
e.zh: 别把所有的书都堆在推车的一侧。

e.en: The home team won by a {lopsided} score of 45-3.
e.zh: 主队以 45 比 3 的悬殊比分获胜。

e.en: He gave her a charming, {lopsided} smile.
e.zh: 他给了她一个迷人的、歪歪的微笑。

e.en: The painting hung {lopsidedly} above the fireplace.
e.zh: 那幅画歪歪斜斜地挂在壁炉上方。

e.en: He grinned {lopsidedly} when he heard the joke.
e.zh: 听到那个笑话时他歪着嘴笑了。

e.en: Our {loquacious} taxi driver chatted the whole ride.
e.zh: 我们那位话多的出租车司机一路都在聊天。

e.en: She becomes surprisingly {loquacious} after one glass of wine.
e.zh: 她喝了一杯酒后变得出奇地健谈。

e.en: The {loquat} tree in our yard fruits every May.
e.zh: 我们院子里的枇杷树每年五月结果。

e.en: I made syrup from fresh {loquat} for sore throats.
e.zh: 我用新鲜枇杷熬了糖浆来缓解喉咙痛。

lor.t: int. 天哪 (Lord 的口语缩略)

e.en: "{Lor}, what a mess!" she muttered to herself.
e.zh: “天哪,真是一团糟!”她自言自语地嘀咕。

e.en: "{Lor} bless you," the old woman said with a smile.
e.zh: “老天保佑你,”老太太微笑着说。

lord.t:
n. 勋爵、贵族
n. 主、上帝

e.en: The {lord} of the manor rarely visited the village.
e.zh: 庄园的领主很少到村里来。

e.en: Tech billionaires {lord} their wealth over critics online.
e.zh: 科技亿万富翁在网上向批评者炫耀财富。

e.en: He waved away the waiter with a {lordly} gesture.
e.zh: 他以一种傲慢的姿态把服务员挥退。

e.en: The CEO spoke in a {lordly} tone to interns.
e.zh: 那位 CEO 用一种高高在上的口气对实习生说话。

e.en: The doctor diagnosed mild {lordosis} in her lower spine.
e.zh: 医生诊断她下脊柱有轻度脊柱前凸。

e.en: Core exercises can help reduce excessive {lordosis}.
e.zh: 核心训练有助于改善过度的脊柱前凸。

e.en: The bill passed the Commons but stalled in the {Lords}.
e.zh: 该法案在下议院通过,却在上议院搁浅。

e.en: Medieval {lords} controlled vast estates and many serfs.
e.zh: 中世纪的领主们掌控着广阔的领地和众多农奴。

lordship.t: n. 贵族身份；对贵族的尊称

e.en: His {Lordship} will see you now in the study.
e.zh: 勋爵阁下现在将在书房见您。

e.en: The duke inherited the {lordship} from his uncle.
e.zh: 那位公爵从叔父那里继承了爵位。

lore.t: n. 传说；（某领域的）传统知识

e.en: Fans love digging into the deep {lore} of the game.
e.zh: 粉丝们热衷于挖掘这款游戏深厚的世界观。

e.en: Local fishing {lore} predicts storms by cloud shapes.
e.zh: 当地渔民的传说通过云形预测风暴。

e.en: I baked a classic quiche {Lorraine} for brunch.
e.zh: 我为早午餐烤了一份经典的洛林乳蛋饼。

e.en: The wine comes from a small village in {Lorraine}.
e.zh: 这款酒产自洛林地区的一个小村庄。

e.en: Long queues of {lorries} blocked the motorway exit.
e.zh: 长长的卡车队伍堵住了高速公路出口。

e.en: British {lorries} deliver supplies across the channel daily.
e.zh: 英国卡车每天跨海峡运送物资。

e.en: A delivery {lorry} blocked our narrow village street.
e.zh: 一辆送货卡车堵住了我们狭窄的村道。

e.en: He drives a refrigerated {lorry} from London to Edinburgh.
e.zh: 他开一辆冷藏卡车从伦敦跑到爱丁堡。

e.en: A {lorryload} of bricks arrived at the building site.
e.zh: 一卡车砖头运到了建筑工地。

e.en: They donated a whole {lorryload} of food to charity.
e.zh: 他们向慈善机构捐赠了整整一卡车的食物。

e.en: We drove past {Lorton} on the way to D.C.
e.zh: 我们去华盛顿的路上经过了洛顿。

e.en: My cousin moved to {Lorton}, Virginia last year.
e.zh: 我表弟去年搬到了弗吉尼亚州的洛顿。

los.t: n. 缩写/名称前缀（如 Los Angeles）

e.en: She booked a flight to {Los} Angeles for Christmas.
e.zh: 她订了圣诞节飞往洛杉矶的航班。

e.en: The band played a sold-out show in {Los} Angeles.
e.zh: 乐队在洛杉矶举办了一场座无虚席的演出。

e.en: Don't {lose} your passport while traveling abroad.
e.zh: 出国旅行时别把护照弄丢了。

e.en: If we {lose} this match, we're out of the tournament.
e.zh: 如果这场比赛输了,我们就被淘汰出局。

e.en: Nobody likes a sore {loser} after a friendly game.
e.zh: 没人喜欢友谊赛后输不起的人。

e.en: He felt like a total {loser} after getting rejected again.
e.zh: 再次被拒后,他觉得自己彻头彻尾是个失败者。

loses.t: v. lose 的第三人称单数；失去、输掉

e.en: She always {loses} her keys somewhere in the apartment.
e.zh: 她总是把钥匙丢在公寓某个角落。

e.en: The startup {loses} money every quarter despite growing users.
e.zh: 尽管用户增长,这家初创公司每季度都在亏钱。

losing.t:
v. lose 的现在分词
adj. 失败的

e.en: I'm {losing} my patience with this slow website.
e.zh: 这个网站这么慢,我快没耐心了。

e.en: The team is on a five-game {losing} streak.
e.zh: 球队已经连输五场了。

e.en: The company reported a huge {loss} last quarter.
e.zh: 公司上季度公布了巨额亏损。

e.en: Her sudden {loss} left the whole family devastated.
e.zh: 她的突然离世让全家悲痛欲绝。

losses.t: n. loss 的复数；多项损失

e.en: The flood caused millions in {losses} for local farmers.
e.zh: 洪水给当地农民造成了数百万的损失。

e.en: Investors cut their {losses} and sold the stock.
e.zh: 投资者及时止损,卖掉了那只股票。

e.en: RAF {Lossiemouth} is a major air base in Scotland.
e.zh: 洛西茅斯空军基地是苏格兰的重要空军基地。

e.en: They spent the weekend fishing near {Lossiemouth}.
e.zh: 他们在洛西茅斯附近度过了一个钓鱼的周末。

e.en: FLAC files use {lossless} compression to preserve audio quality.
e.zh: FLAC 文件使用无损压缩以保留音频质量。

e.en: Photographers prefer {lossless} formats like PNG for editing.
e.zh: 摄影师编辑时更喜欢 PNG 这类无损格式。

e.en: MP3 is a {lossy} format that discards some audio data.
e.zh: MP3 是一种会丢弃部分音频数据的有损格式。

e.en: JPEG compression is {lossy} but produces small file sizes.
e.zh: JPEG 压缩有损,但文件体积很小。

lost.t:
adj. 丢失的；迷路的
v. lose 的过去式

e.en: I got completely {lost} in the old part of town.
e.zh: 我在老城区彻底迷路了。

e.en: She {lost} her phone on the train this morning.
e.zh: 她今早在火车上把手机弄丢了。

e.en: The novel captures the {lostness} of life after college.
e.zh: 这部小说捕捉了大学毕业后那种迷失感。

e.en: There's a quiet {lostness} in his eyes lately.
e.zh: 他最近眼神里有种淡淡的迷茫。

e.en: There's a {lot} of work to finish before Friday.
e.zh: 周五前还有很多工作要完成。

e.en: They parked in the empty {lot} behind the mall.
e.zh: 他们把车停在商场后面空荡荡的停车场。

loth.t: adj. 不情愿的（loath 的变体）

e.en: She was {loth} to admit she had been wrong.
e.zh: 她不愿承认自己错了。

e.en: He's always {loth} to leave a good party early.
e.zh: 他向来不愿早早离开热闹的派对。

e.en: The novel's charming {lothario} broke every heart in town.
e.zh: 小说里那位风流公子让镇上每个姑娘都心碎。

e.en: He fancies himself a {lothario}, but no one's impressed.
e.zh: 他自以为是情场高手,可没人买账。

e.en: We hiked through the rolling hills of West {Lothian}.
e.zh: 我们徒步穿越了西洛锡安连绵起伏的山丘。

e.en: The bus runs from Edinburgh into East {Lothian}.
e.zh: 这班巴士从爱丁堡开往东洛锡安。

e.en: Apply sunscreen {lotion} before heading to the beach.
e.zh: 去海滩前先涂上防晒乳。

e.en: This {lotion} keeps my hands soft all winter.
e.zh: 这款润肤乳整个冬天都让我的双手保持柔嫩。

e.en: There are {lots} of cafes near the university.
e.zh: 大学附近有很多咖啡馆。

e.en: She's got {lots} of energy after her morning coffee.
e.zh: 喝完晨间咖啡后她精力充沛。

lotta.t: （口语）a lot of 的缩读；大量

e.en: That kid's got a {lotta} attitude for his age.
e.zh: 这孩子年纪不大,脾气倒不小。

e.en: There's a {lotta} talk online but no real action.
e.zh: 网上议论很多,但没什么实际行动。

lotteries.t: n. lottery 的复数；多种彩票

e.en: State {lotteries} fund schools and parks in many regions.
e.zh: 许多地区的州彩票为学校和公园提供资金。

e.en: Online {lotteries} have grown rapidly in recent years.
e.zh: 近年来网络彩票发展迅速。

e.en: He won the {lottery} and quit his job the next day.
e.zh: 他中了彩票,第二天就辞了工作。

e.en: Getting tickets to the concert felt like winning a {lottery}.
e.zh: 抢到这场演唱会的票就像中了彩票一样。

e.en: My grandma plays the {lotto} every Saturday night.
e.zh: 我奶奶每周六晚上都买乐透。

e.en: He spent twenty bucks on {lotto} tickets again.
e.zh: 他又花了二十块钱买乐透彩票。

e.en: A pink {lotus} bloomed in the temple pond.
e.zh: 一朵粉色的莲花在寺院的池塘中盛开。

e.en: She practiced meditation in the {lotus} position.
e.zh: 她以莲花坐姿冥想。

e.en: The bar had a {louche} atmosphere that drew artists at midnight.
e.zh: 那家酒吧氛围放荡不羁,午夜常吸引艺术家光顾。

e.en: He gave her a {louche} smile across the smoky room.
e.zh: 在烟雾缭绕的房间里,他对她露出一抹暧昧的微笑。

loud.t: adj. 大声的；响亮的；刺眼的

e.en: The music is too {loud} for a quiet dinner.
e.zh: 这音乐对安静的晚餐来说太吵了。

e.en: He wore a {loud} shirt covered in neon flowers.
e.zh: 他穿着一件满是霓虹花朵的花哨衬衫。

louder.t: adj. loud 的比较级；更响亮的

e.en: Could you speak a little {louder}? I can't hear you.
e.zh: 你能说大声一点吗?我听不见。

e.en: The crowd grew {louder} as the band took the stage.
e.zh: 乐队登台时,人群越发喧闹。

loudest.t: adj. loud 的最高级；最响亮的

e.en: He's the {loudest} person at every team meeting.
e.zh: 每次团队开会他都是嗓门最大的那个。

e.en: That was the {loudest} thunderclap I've ever heard.
e.zh: 那是我听过最响的一声雷。

e.en: The officer used a {loudhailer} to address the protesters.
e.zh: 警官用扩音喇叭向抗议者喊话。

e.en: The coach barked instructions through a {loudhailer}.
e.zh: 教练通过扩音喇叭大声下达指令。

e.en: The dog barked {loudly} when the doorbell rang.
e.zh: 门铃一响,狗就大声叫了起来。

e.en: She complained {loudly} about the cold soup.
e.zh: 她对汤变凉一事大声抱怨。

e.en: That {loudmouth} on the bus wouldn't stop talking.
e.zh: 公交车上那个大嘴巴一直说个不停。

e.en: Don't be such a {loudmouth} in front of his parents.
e.zh: 在他父母面前别这么大嘴巴。

e.en: You can adjust the {loudness} in the audio settings.
e.zh: 你可以在音频设置中调节音量大小。

e.en: The {loudness} of the fireworks startled the dog.
e.zh: 烟花的巨响把狗吓了一跳。

e.en: An announcement came over the airport {loudspeaker}.
e.zh: 机场扩音器里传来一则通知。

e.en: The {loudspeaker} crackled before the music started.
e.zh: 音乐响起前,扬声器先是噼啪作响。

e.en: Huge {loudspeakers} blasted dance music across the festival.
e.zh: 巨型扬声器在音乐节上轰鸣着舞曲。

e.en: The stadium {loudspeakers} announced the starting lineup.
e.zh: 体育场的扩音器宣布了首发阵容。

e.en: We rented a cottage by the {lough} in Ireland.
e.zh: 我们在爱尔兰湖边租了一间小屋。

e.en: Mist hung over the {lough} early in the morning.
e.zh: 清晨,薄雾笼罩着那片湖面。

e.en: She studied engineering at {Loughborough} University.
e.zh: 她在拉夫堡大学学习工程。

e.en: The train to {Loughborough} leaves in ten minutes.
e.zh: 开往拉夫堡的列车十分钟后发车。

e.en: He commutes from {Loughton} into central London daily.
e.zh: 他每天从拉夫顿通勤到伦敦市中心。

e.en: There's a great Italian restaurant in {Loughton}.
e.zh: 拉夫顿有一家很棒的意大利餐厅。

louisiana.t: n. 路易斯安那州（美国）

e.en: We tried real gumbo on a trip to {Louisiana}.
e.zh: 在路易斯安那州旅行时,我们尝到了正宗的秋葵浓汤。

e.en: Hurricanes regularly threaten the coast of {Louisiana}.
e.zh: 飓风经常威胁路易斯安那州的海岸。

louisville.t: n. 路易维尔（美国城市）

e.en: The Kentucky Derby is held every May in {Louisville}.
e.zh: 肯塔基德比赛马每年五月在路易斯维尔举行。

e.en: He grew up in {Louisville} and still loves bourbon.
e.zh: 他在路易斯维尔长大,至今仍钟爱波本威士忌。

lounge.t:
n. 休息室；候机厅
v. 懒散地靠坐

e.en: They relaxed in the airport {lounge} before the flight.
e.zh: 起飞前他们在机场休息室放松。

e.en: I love to {lounge} on the couch on rainy Sundays.
e.zh: 下雨的周日,我喜欢窝在沙发上懒散地待着。

e.en: She fell asleep on a {lounger} by the pool.
e.zh: 她在泳池边的躺椅上睡着了。

e.en: He's such a {lounger}—never lifts a finger at home.
e.zh: 他真是个懒虫,在家从不动一根手指。

e.en: The cat was {lounging} in a sunny patch by the window.
e.zh: 猫慵懒地躺在窗边的阳光里。

e.en: They spent the afternoon {lounging} on the beach.
e.zh: 他们在沙滩上慵懒地度过了一个下午。

e.en: The jeweler examined the diamond through a {loupe}.
e.zh: 珠宝商用放大镜仔细查看那颗钻石。

e.en: Photographers once used a {loupe} to inspect film negatives.
e.zh: 摄影师过去用放大镜检查胶片底片。

e.en: Dark clouds began to {lour} over the mountain peaks.
e.zh: 乌云开始在山峰上空阴沉地聚拢。

e.en: His face seemed to {lour} whenever the topic came up.
e.zh: 每当谈到这个话题,他的脸色就阴沉下来。

lourdes.t: n. 卢尔德（法国朝圣地）

e.en: Pilgrims travel to {Lourdes} hoping for healing miracles.
e.zh: 朝圣者前往卢尔德祈求治愈的奇迹。

e.en: The shrine at {Lourdes} draws millions every year.
e.zh: 卢尔德的圣地每年吸引数百万游客。

louse.t:
n. 虱子
n. 讨厌鬼

e.en: The doctor checked the child's hair for a {louse}.
e.zh: 医生检查了孩子的头发是否有虱子。

e.en: What a {louse}—he stole money from his own brother.
e.zh: 真是个卑鄙小人,他居然偷了亲哥哥的钱。

e.en: I had a {lousy} day at work and just want sleep.
e.zh: 我今天上班糟透了,只想睡觉。

e.en: The hotel had {lousy} Wi-Fi and rude staff.
e.zh: 那家酒店 Wi-Fi 糟糕,服务员还态度恶劣。

e.en: Some {lout} kicked over the trash bins last night.
e.zh: 昨晚有个粗鄙的家伙把垃圾桶踢翻了。

e.en: Don't act like a {lout} at your sister's wedding.
e.zh: 在你姐姐的婚礼上别表现得像个粗人。

e.en: County {Louth} is the smallest county in Ireland.
e.zh: 劳斯郡是爱尔兰最小的郡。

e.en: Her grandparents still live in {Louth}, Lincolnshire.
e.zh: 她的祖父母仍住在林肯郡的劳斯。

e.en: His {loutish} behavior at the bar got him kicked out.
e.zh: 他在酒吧的粗鲁行为让他被赶了出去。

e.en: The fans were rowdy but never truly {loutish}.
e.zh: 球迷虽然喧闹,但从未真正粗野无礼。

e.en: The {louver} above the door lets hot air escape.
e.zh: 门上方的百叶窗让热空气排出。

e.en: He adjusted the {louver} to block the afternoon sun.
e.zh: 他调整了百叶窗以挡住下午的阳光。

e.en: The cabin has {louvered} shutters on every window.
e.zh: 小屋的每扇窗户都装有百叶窗。

e.en: She painted the {louvered} closet doors a soft white.
e.zh: 她把百叶门衣柜漆成了柔和的白色。

louvre.t:
n. 卢浮宫
n. 百叶窗

e.en: We waited two hours to enter the {louvre} in Paris.
e.zh: 我们在巴黎排了两小时队才进入卢浮宫。

e.en: The {louvre} houses thousands of priceless artworks.
e.zh: 卢浮宫收藏着数千件无价艺术品。

e.en: The bathroom has a small {louvred} window for ventilation.
e.zh: 浴室有一扇小百叶窗用于通风。

e.en: He installed {louvred} doors on the laundry room.
e.zh: 他在洗衣房装上了百叶门。

lovable.t: adj. 讨人喜欢的；可爱的

e.en: Their puppy is the most {lovable} dog I've ever met.
e.zh: 他们的小狗是我见过最讨人喜欢的狗。

e.en: The character is goofy but completely {lovable}.
e.zh: 这个角色虽然傻乎乎的,却特别招人喜欢。

e.en: She added fresh {lovage} to the chicken soup.
e.zh: 她在鸡汤里加了些新鲜的圆叶当归。

e.en: The herb garden has rosemary, thyme, and {lovage}.
e.zh: 香草园里种着迷迭香、百里香和圆叶当归。

e.en: The doctor prescribed {lovastatin} to lower his cholesterol.
e.zh: 医生开了洛伐他汀来降低他的胆固醇。

e.en: {lovastatin} is taken once daily with the evening meal.
e.zh: 洛伐他汀每天晚餐时服用一次。

e.en: He wore a {lovat} green tweed jacket to the wedding.
e.zh: 他穿着一件灰绿色花呢外套去参加婚礼。

e.en: The kilt was woven in a soft {lovat} shade.
e.zh: 这条苏格兰短裙织成了柔和的灰绿色。

love.t:
n. 爱；爱情
v. 喜爱；爱

e.en: I {love} the new design of your website.
e.zh: 我超喜欢你网站的新设计。

e.en: Their {love} for each other has only grown stronger.
e.zh: 他们对彼此的爱只增不减。

loveable.t: adj. 可爱的；讨人喜欢的

e.en: She's quirky, messy, and totally {loveable}.
e.zh: 她古怪又邋遢,但特别讨人喜欢。

e.en: The cartoon mascot was designed to be instantly {loveable}.
e.zh: 这个卡通吉祥物设计得让人一见就喜欢。

lovebird.t:
n. 情侣鹦鹉
n. 热恋中的人

e.en: She keeps a pair of {lovebird} in a large cage.
e.zh: 她在大笼子里养了一对爱情鸟。

e.en: The newlyweds were acting like total {lovebird}s at dinner.
e.zh: 这对新婚夫妇在晚餐时像一对小情侣一样腻歪。

loved.t:
adj. 深爱的
v. 爱（过去式）

e.en: Everyone {loved} the surprise birthday party.
e.zh: 大家都很喜欢这个惊喜生日派对。

e.en: She always felt {loved} and supported by her family.
e.zh: 她总能感受到家人的爱与支持。

e.en: Ada {lovelace} is celebrated as the first computer programmer.
e.zh: 阿达·洛芙莱斯被誉为第一位计算机程序员。

e.en: The school named its coding lab after Ada {lovelace}.
e.zh: 学校以阿达·洛芙莱斯的名字命名了编程实验室。

e.en: They stayed in a {loveless} marriage for the kids.
e.zh: 为了孩子,他们维持着一段没有爱的婚姻。

e.en: The novel paints a bleak, {loveless} childhood.
e.zh: 小说描绘了一个凄凉、缺爱的童年。

e.en: The garden's {loveliness} took my breath away.
e.zh: 花园的美丽让我屏住了呼吸。

e.en: There's a quiet {loveliness} to small mountain villages.
e.zh: 山间小村庄有一种宁静的可爱之美。

lovelock.t: n. 垂在额前的一缕长发

e.en: Couples attach a {lovelock} to the bridge as a vow.
e.zh: 情侣们把同心锁挂在桥上作为誓言。

e.en: She fastened a tiny {lovelock} to the railing in Paris.
e.zh: 她在巴黎的栏杆上扣了一把小小的爱情锁。

e.en: The {lovelorn} teenager wrote sad poems every night.
e.zh: 那个失恋的少年每晚都写伤感的诗。

e.en: He sent {lovelorn} texts she never answered.
e.zh: 他发了一堆痴情短信,她却从未回复。

e.en: What a {lovely} surprise to see you here!
e.zh: 在这里见到你真是个美好的惊喜!

e.en: The garden looks {lovely} in the spring sunshine.
e.zh: 花园在春日的阳光下显得格外可爱。

e.en: The poem describes their tender {lovemaking} that night.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了他们那晚温柔的亲密时光。

e.en: Soft music played during their slow {lovemaking}.
e.zh: 轻柔的音乐伴随着他们缓慢的亲密相拥。

lover.t:
n. 恋人；情人
n. 爱好者

e.en: She's a huge {lover} of indie horror films.
e.zh: 她是独立恐怖片的超级爱好者。

e.en: The poet wrote endless letters to his {lover}.
e.zh: 这位诗人给他的恋人写了无数封信。

e.en: Coffee {lovers} will appreciate this single-origin espresso.
e.zh: 咖啡爱好者一定会欣赏这款单一产地的浓缩咖啡。

e.en: The two {lovers} met secretly in the garden.
e.zh: 这对恋人在花园里偷偷相会。

loves.t: v. 爱；喜爱（第三人称单数）

e.en: My daughter {loves} drawing dinosaurs after school.
e.zh: 我女儿放学后特别喜欢画恐龙。

e.en: He {loves} his job more than anything else.
e.zh: 他比任何事都更热爱他的工作。

e.en: The {LTA} announced new bus routes for the suburbs.
e.zh: 陆路交通管理局公布了通往郊区的新公交路线。

e.en: Wimbledon is run under {LTA} regulations.
e.zh: 温网赛事按英国草地网球协会规则举办。

e.en: Old {LTB} buses once dominated London's streets.
e.zh: 昔日的伦敦交通局巴士曾遍布伦敦街头。

e.en: The {LTB} report outlined the new transit plan.
e.zh: 伦敦交通局的报告概述了新的交通规划。

ltd.t: abbr. limited（有限公司，公司名后缀）

e.en: He registered the business as Smith Trading {Ltd}.
e.zh: 他将公司注册为史密斯贸易有限公司。

e.en: The contract was signed by Acme {Ltd} this morning.
e.zh: 合同今天上午由阿克米有限公司签署。

ltp.t: abbr. Last Traded Price（最新成交价）

e.en: The stock's {LTP} jumped sharply after the earnings report.
e.zh: 财报发布后,该股最新成交价大幅跳升。

e.en: Traders watched the {LTP} closely throughout the session.
e.zh: 交易员在整个交易时段紧盯最新成交价。

ltte.t: abbr. 泰米尔伊拉姆猛虎解放组织

e.en: The {LTTE} fought a long civil war in Sri Lanka.
e.zh: 猛虎组织在斯里兰卡进行了长期内战。

e.en: Government forces defeated the {LTTE} in 2009.
e.zh: 政府军于2009年击败了猛虎组织。

luanda.t: n. 罗安达（安哥拉首都）

e.en: {Luanda} is the bustling capital of Angola.
e.zh: 罗安达是安哥拉繁忙的首都。

e.en: Oil exports have transformed {Luanda} into a major port.
e.zh: 石油出口已将罗安达变成一个重要港口。

e.en: The resort hosts a traditional Hawaiian {luau} every Friday.
e.zh: 度假村每周五都举办传统的夏威夷烤猪宴。

e.en: We wore flower leis to the beach {luau}.
e.zh: 我们戴着花环去参加海滩上的夏威夷宴会。

lubbers.t: n. 笨拙的人；旱鸭子水手

e.en: Sailors mocked the new recruits as clumsy land {lubbers}.
e.zh: 水手们嘲笑新兵是笨手笨脚的旱鸭子。

e.en: The veteran crew laughed at the seasick {lubbers} aboard.
e.zh: 老船员们嘲笑船上晕船的旱鸭子。

lube.t:
n. 润滑油
v. 给…加润滑油

e.en: I need to {lube} the bike chain before the ride.
e.zh: 骑行前我得给自行车链条上点润滑油。

e.en: The mechanic charged extra for an oil and {lube} job.
e.zh: 修车师傅加收了换油和润滑的费用。

e.en: Apply a small amount of {lubricant} to the squeaky hinge.
e.zh: 在吱吱响的合页上涂少量润滑剂。

e.en: Trust acts as a {lubricant} in business relationships.
e.zh: 信任在商业关系中起着润滑剂的作用。

e.en: Remember to {lubricate} the gears every few months.
e.zh: 记得每隔几个月给齿轮上一次润滑油。

e.en: A few drinks helped {lubricate} the awkward conversation.
e.zh: 几杯酒帮助缓和了尴尬的谈话。

e.en: The chain runs smoothly when properly {lubricated}.
e.zh: 链条润滑得当时运转得很顺畅。

e.en: Well-{lubricated} bearings last much longer in machinery.
e.zh: 润滑良好的轴承在机械中寿命要长得多。

e.en: He is {lubricating} the door hinges to stop the squeak.
e.zh: 他正在给门铰链上油以消除吱吱声。

e.en: The engine requires special {lubricating} oil for cold weather.
e.zh: 该发动机在寒冷天气需要特殊的润滑油。

e.en: Regular {lubrication} extends the life of moving parts.
e.zh: 定期润滑可以延长运动部件的寿命。

e.en: The bearing failed due to insufficient {lubrication}.
e.zh: 由于润滑不足,轴承出现了故障。

e.en: Critics called the novel's love scenes shockingly {lubricious}.
e.zh: 评论家称这部小说的爱情场面淫秽得令人震惊。

e.en: The film was banned for its {lubricious} content.
e.zh: 该影片因内容淫秽被禁映。

e.en: Lord {Lucan} disappeared in 1974 and was never found.
e.zh: 卢肯勋爵于1974年失踪,此后再未被找到。

e.en: The Roman poet {Lucan} wrote about civil war.
e.zh: 罗马诗人卢坎写过关于内战的作品。

e.en: We spent the afternoon walking the medieval walls of {Lucca}.
e.zh: 我们下午在卢卡的中世纪城墙上漫步。

e.en: {Lucca} is famous for its olive oil and Tuscan cuisine.
e.zh: 卢卡以橄榄油和托斯卡纳美食闻名。

luce.t: n. 成年梭鱼；人名 Luce

e.en: Henry {Luce} founded Time magazine in 1923.
e.zh: 亨利·卢斯于1923年创办了《时代》杂志。

e.en: The fisherman caught a large {luce} in the lake.
e.zh: 渔夫在湖里钓到了一条大梭子鱼。

lucerne.t: n. 卢塞恩（瑞士城市）；紫花苜蓿

e.en: We took a boat trip across Lake {Lucerne}.
e.zh: 我们乘船游览了卢塞恩湖。

e.en: Farmers grow {lucerne} as feed for their cattle.
e.zh: 农民种植紫花苜蓿作为牛的饲料。

lucid.t: adj. 清晰易懂的；神志清醒的

e.en: She gave a clear and {lucid} explanation of the theory.
e.zh: 她对这个理论给出了清晰明了的解释。

e.en: The patient had a brief {lucid} moment before falling asleep.
e.zh: 病人在入睡前短暂地清醒了一下。

e.en: The essay is admired for its {lucidity} and insight.
e.zh: 这篇文章因其清晰和洞察力而备受赞赏。

e.en: Even in old age, she retained remarkable mental {lucidity}.
e.zh: 即使年迈,她依然保持着惊人的思维清晰。

e.en: He explained the complex topic {lucidly} to the students.
e.zh: 他向学生们清晰地解释了这个复杂的话题。

e.en: The author writes {lucidly} about quantum physics.
e.zh: 作者把量子物理写得通俗易懂。

lucifer.t: n. 路西法（堕落天使/撒旦）

e.en: In Christian tradition, {Lucifer} fell from heaven.
e.zh: 在基督教传统中,路西法从天堂坠落。

e.en: The villain was portrayed as a modern-day {Lucifer}.
e.zh: 那个反派被塑造成现代版的路西法。

e.en: Fireflies glow because of an enzyme called {luciferase}.
e.zh: 萤火虫发光是因为一种叫荧光素酶的酶。

e.en: Scientists use {luciferase} to track gene expression in cells.
e.zh: 科学家利用荧光素酶来追踪细胞中的基因表达。

e.en: Good {luck} with your job interview tomorrow!
e.zh: 祝你明天面试好运!

e.en: Winning the lottery was pure {luck}, nothing more.
e.zh: 中彩票纯属运气,仅此而已。

e.en: That guy is a real {lucker} — three jackpots in a row.
e.zh: 那家伙真是个幸运儿,连中三次大奖。

e.en: Don't call him a {lucker}; he worked hard for it.
e.zh: 别叫他幸运儿,他是靠努力得来的。

e.en: {Luckily}, no one was hurt in the accident.
e.zh: 幸运的是,事故中没有人受伤。

e.en: {Luckily}, I saved a copy of the file before it crashed.
e.zh: 幸好我在崩溃前保存了一份文件副本。

e.en: The {luckless} traveler missed his flight by minutes.
e.zh: 那位倒霉的旅客只差几分钟就赶上了航班。

e.en: A {luckless} gambler lost everything in one night.
e.zh: 一个倒霉的赌徒一夜之间输光了一切。

e.en: {Lucknow} is famous for its rich Mughlai cuisine.
e.zh: 勒克瑙以其丰富的莫卧儿菜肴而闻名。

e.en: We visited the historic Bara Imambara in {Lucknow}.
e.zh: 我们参观了勒克瑙历史悠久的巴拉伊玛目巴拉。

lucky.t: adj. 幸运的；带来好运的

e.en: You're {lucky} to have such supportive parents.
e.zh: 你能有这么支持你的父母真是幸运。

e.en: She wore her {lucky} socks to the championship game.
e.zh: 她穿着幸运袜去参加冠军赛。

lucozade.t: n. 葡萄适（英国功能饮料品牌）

e.en: Runners often drink {Lucozade} to refuel after long races.
e.zh: 跑步者常在长距离比赛后喝葡萄适来补充体力。

e.en: My mum always gave me {Lucozade} when I was sick.
e.zh: 我小时候生病妈妈总会给我喝葡萄适。

lucrative.t: adj. 赚钱的；有利可图的

e.en: Software consulting can be a highly {lucrative} career.
e.zh: 软件咨询可以是一份非常赚钱的职业。

e.en: She turned her hobby into a {lucrative} side business.
e.zh: 她把爱好变成了一项赚钱的副业。

e.en: He chased filthy {lucre} at the expense of his integrity.
e.zh: 他为了铜臭味的金钱而牺牲了自己的正直。

e.en: The politician was accused of seeking only {lucre}.
e.zh: 那名政客被指控只追求钱财。

lucubrate.t: v. 挑灯夜读；苦心撰写

e.en: Scholars often {lucubrate} late into the night over manuscripts.
e.zh: 学者们常常深夜还在挑灯研读手稿。

e.en: He would {lucubrate} for hours on obscure philosophical texts.
e.zh: 他会花数小时苦读晦涩的哲学文献。

e.en: They cuddled up on the velvet {loveseat}.
e.zh: 他们依偎在天鹅绒双人沙发上。

e.en: The living room has a small {loveseat} by the window.
e.zh: 客厅靠窗放着一张小双人沙发。

lovesick.t: adj. 害相思病的；苦恋的

e.en: He's been {lovesick} ever since she moved away.
e.zh: 自从她搬走后,他就一直相思成疾。

e.en: The {lovesick} hero stares at her photo all day.
e.zh: 那位害相思病的主角整天盯着她的照片看。

e.en: The toddler can't sleep without her favorite {lovey}.
e.zh: 小宝宝没有她最爱的安抚玩偶就睡不着。

e.en: They were being all {lovey} on the couch.
e.zh: 他们在沙发上腻腻歪歪地秀恩爱。

loving.t: adj. 充满爱意的；深情的

e.en: She gave her son a {loving} hug before school.
e.zh: 她在儿子上学前给了他一个充满爱意的拥抱。

e.en: I'm really {loving} this new playlist on Spotify.
e.zh: 我真的超爱这个新出的Spotify歌单。

lovingly.t: adv. 充满爱意地；深情地

e.en: He {lovingly} restored the old wooden boat himself.
e.zh: 他亲手满怀深情地修复了这艘旧木船。

e.en: She {lovingly} packed a lunch for her husband.
e.zh: 她充满爱意地为丈夫打包了午餐。

low.t:
adj. 低的；低下的
n. 最低点

e.en: The phone battery is getting dangerously {low}.
e.zh: 手机电量已经低到危险的程度了。

e.en: He spoke in a {low} voice so no one would hear.
e.zh: 他压低嗓门说话以免被人听见。

e.en: This is a {low-risk} investment for beginners.
e.zh: 这对新手来说是一项低风险投资。

e.en: The procedure is considered {low-risk} for healthy adults.
e.zh: 对健康的成年人来说这个手术被认为是低风险的。

e.en: His {lowbred} manners shocked the dinner guests.
e.zh: 他粗鄙的举止震惊了晚宴的客人们。

e.en: The novel mocks the so-called {lowbred} characters.
e.zh: 小说嘲讽了那些所谓出身低微的角色。

lowbrow.t: adj. 低俗的；趣味不高的

e.en: The show is fun but pretty {lowbrow} comedy.
e.zh: 这部剧很搞笑,但属于比较低俗的喜剧。

e.en: He prefers {lowbrow} reality TV after a long day.
e.zh: 忙了一天后他更喜欢看通俗的真人秀。

lowdown.t:
n. 内幕消息
adj. 卑鄙的

e.en: Give me the {lowdown} on what happened at the meeting.
e.zh: 给我讲讲会上到底发生了什么。

e.en: She got the {lowdown} on the new office gossip.
e.zh: 她打听到了办公室最新八卦的内幕。

e.en: Robert {lowell} is one of America's great confessional poets.
e.zh: 罗伯特·洛威尔是美国伟大的自白派诗人之一。

e.en: We visited the historic mills in {lowell}, Massachusetts.
e.zh: 我们参观了马萨诸塞州洛厄尔的历史工厂。

lower.t:
v. 降低；放下
adj. 较低的
