e.en: Please {lower} the volume; the baby is sleeping.
e.zh: 请把音量调小,宝宝在睡觉。

e.en: Prices are much {lower} during the summer sale.
e.zh: 夏季促销期间价格要低得多。

lowercase.t:
adj. 小写的
n. 小写字母

e.en: The password must include both uppercase and {lowercase} letters.
e.zh: 密码必须同时包含大写和小写字母。

e.en: Type your username in all {lowercase} letters.
e.zh: 用户名请全部用小写字母输入。

lowered.t: v. 降低（lower 的过去式）

e.en: He {lowered} his voice and leaned closer.
e.zh: 他压低嗓音,凑得更近了些。

e.en: The store {lowered} prices on all winter coats.
e.zh: 店里把所有冬季外套都降价了。

lowering.t:
v. 降低中
adj. 阴沉的

e.en: The Fed is considering {lowering} interest rates again.
e.zh: 美联储正在考虑再次降息。

e.en: {lowering} the thermostat at night saves energy.
e.zh: 晚上调低恒温器温度可以节省能源。

e.en: The {lowermost} branch of the tree nearly touched the ground.
e.zh: 那棵树最低的枝条几乎触到了地面。

e.en: Store heavy items on the {lowermost} shelf.
e.zh: 重物请放在最下层的架子上。

lowers.t: v. 降低（第三人称单数）

e.en: Regular exercise {lowers} your risk of heart disease.
e.zh: 经常锻炼能降低你患心脏病的风险。

e.en: The app automatically {lowers} screen brightness at night.
e.zh: 这个应用会在夜间自动调低屏幕亮度。

e.en: This site guarantees the {lowest} prices on flights.
e.zh: 这个网站保证机票价格最低。

e.en: Morale hit its {lowest} point after the layoffs.
e.zh: 裁员之后士气跌到了最低点。

lowestoft.t: n. 洛斯托夫特（英国地名）

e.en: {lowestoft} is the easternmost town in the United Kingdom.
e.zh: 洛斯托夫特是英国最东端的城镇。

e.en: We bought fresh herring straight off the {lowestoft} boats.
e.zh: 我们直接从洛斯托夫特的渔船上买了新鲜的鲱鱼。

lowing.t:
n. 牛的哞叫声
v. (牛) 哞叫

e.en: The {lowing} of cattle drifted across the misty field.
e.zh: 牛的低鸣声飘过雾蒙蒙的田野。

e.en: At dawn, the herd's gentle {lowing} woke the farmer.
e.zh: 黎明时分,牛群轻轻的哞声唤醒了农夫。

e.en: The ceiling is a bit {lowish} for tall guests.
e.zh: 对个子高的客人来说天花板有点偏低。

e.en: His salary is {lowish} for someone with his experience.
e.zh: 以他的经验来说,薪水算是偏低的。

e.en: Rice grows well in the warm {lowland} regions.
e.zh: 水稻在温暖的低地地区长势良好。

e.en: The {lowland} villages flooded after days of rain.
e.zh: 连日大雨后,低地村庄被淹了。

e.en: Mist often blankets the Scottish {lowlands} at dawn.
e.zh: 清晨苏格兰低地常常笼罩着雾气。

e.en: Farmers in the {lowlands} grow mostly wheat and barley.
e.zh: 低地的农民主要种植小麦和大麦。

lowlife.t: n. 社会底层之人；无赖

e.en: The bar attracted every {lowlife} in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 那家酒吧吸引了附近所有的混混。

e.en: Don't waste your time on that cheating {lowlife}.
e.zh: 别把时间浪费在那个出轨的渣男身上。

lowlight.t: n. 低调光；不精彩之处

e.en: Missing the playoffs was the season's biggest {lowlight}.
e.zh: 无缘季后赛是本赛季最糟糕的时刻。

e.en: The camera works surprisingly well in {lowlight} conditions.
e.zh: 这款相机在弱光环境下表现出奇地好。

lowly.t: adj. 地位低下的；卑微的

e.en: He started as a {lowly} intern and became CEO.
e.zh: 他从一名卑微的实习生做起,最终成为了首席执行官。

e.en: Even the {lowly} ant plays a role in the ecosystem.
e.zh: 即使是不起眼的蚂蚁也在生态系统中扮演着角色。

e.en: His candy-red {lowrider} bounced down the boulevard.
e.zh: 他那辆糖果红的低底盘改装车在大道上一路弹跳。

e.en: The car show featured a row of classic {lowrider}s.
e.zh: 车展上展出了一排经典的低底盘改装车。

e.en: Every relationship has its highs and {lows}.
e.zh: 每段感情都有高潮和低谷。

e.en: Overnight {lows} will drop below freezing this week.
e.zh: 本周夜间最低气温将降到冰点以下。

e.en: I ordered a bagel with cream cheese and {lox}.
e.zh: 我点了一个抹奶油芝士配烟熏三文鱼的贝果。

e.en: The brunch menu features {lox} on toasted rye bread.
e.zh: 早午餐菜单上有烤黑麦面包配烟熏三文鱼。

e.en: He has been a {loyal} customer for over ten years.
e.zh: 他做我们的忠实顾客已经超过十年了。

e.en: Dogs are famously {loyal} to their owners.
e.zh: 狗以对主人忠诚而闻名。

loyalist.t: n. 忠诚支持者；保皇派

e.en: The party {loyalist} refused to criticize the leader.
e.zh: 那位党的忠实拥护者拒绝批评领导人。

e.en: Many {loyalist} families fled north during the war.
e.zh: 许多保皇派家庭在战争期间逃往北方。

e.en: She has {loyally} supported the team through every season.
e.zh: 每个赛季她都忠诚地支持着球队。

e.en: The staff served the company {loyally} for decades.
e.zh: 员工们几十年来忠诚地为公司效力。

loyalties.t: n. 忠诚（复数）；效忠对象

e.en: His {loyalties} are divided between work and family.
e.zh: 他的忠诚在工作和家庭之间难以取舍。

e.en: Tribal {loyalties} still shape local politics here.
e.zh: 部族间的忠诚至今仍影响着当地政治。

e.en: The app rewards customer {loyalty} with monthly discounts.
e.zh: 该应用通过每月折扣回馈顾客的忠诚度。

e.en: Her {loyalty} to her friends is unwavering.
e.zh: 她对朋友的忠诚从不动摇。

loyola.t: n. 罗耀拉（人名/大学名）

e.en: She earned her law degree at {Loyola} University.
e.zh: 她在洛约拉大学拿到了法律学位。

e.en: {Loyola} is named after the founder of the Jesuits.
e.zh: 洛约拉是以耶稣会创始人的名字命名的。

e.en: I sucked on a throat {lozenge} to ease my cough.
e.zh: 我含了一颗润喉糖来缓解咳嗽。

e.en: The window was decorated with a {lozenge} pattern.
e.zh: 窗户装饰着菱形花纹。

e.en: Many rural homes still cook with {LPG} cylinders.
e.zh: 许多农村家庭仍用液化石油气罐做饭。

e.en: The taxi was converted to run on {LPG}.
e.zh: 这辆出租车被改装成使用液化石油气。

lrt.t: n. 轻轨交通（light rail transit）

e.en: Take the {LRT} to get downtown faster than driving.
e.zh: 坐轻轨进城比开车更快。

e.en: The new {LRT} line opens next month.
e.zh: 新的轻轨线路下个月开通。

e.en: Researchers are studying {LSD} as a treatment for depression.
e.zh: 研究人员正在研究迷幻药作为抑郁症的治疗手段。

e.en: He was arrested for selling {LSD} at the festival.
e.zh: 他因在音乐节上贩卖迷幻药被捕。

lse.t: n. 伦敦政治经济学院；伦敦证交所

e.en: She was accepted to study economics at the {LSE}.
e.zh: 她被伦敦政治经济学院录取攻读经济学。

e.en: The company is listed on the {LSE} main market.
e.zh: 该公司在伦敦证券交易所主板上市。

e.en: Search engines once relied on {LSI} to understand context.
e.zh: 搜索引擎曾经依靠潜在语义索引来理解上下文。

e.en: The chip uses {LSI} technology for better integration.
e.zh: 该芯片采用大规模集成电路技术以实现更高集成度。

lud.t: n. 法官大人（旧式称呼）

e.en: The barrister addressed the judge as "my {Lud}" in court.
e.zh: 律师在法庭上称法官为"大人"。

e.en: "My {Lud}," he said, "the witness has arrived."
e.zh: "法官大人,"他说,"证人已到。"

luddite.t: n. 反对新技术的人；卢德分子

e.en: My grandfather is a total {Luddite} — he refuses to use email.
e.zh: 我爷爷是个彻底的反技术派,他拒绝用电子邮件。

e.en: Critics called the protesters {Luddite} for opposing automation.
e.zh: 批评者称反对自动化的抗议者是反技术派。

e.en: The artist's {ludic} style turns serious topics into playful art.
e.zh: 这位艺术家俏皮的风格将严肃话题变成了好玩的艺术。

e.en: Children learn quickly through {ludic} activities and games.
e.zh: 孩子们通过游戏化的活动学得很快。

ludicrous.t: adj. 荒唐可笑的；滑稽的

e.en: The price they're asking for that bag is absolutely {ludicrous}.
e.zh: 他们那个包要的价格简直荒唐。

e.en: He told a {ludicrous} story about meeting aliens at the supermarket.
e.zh: 他讲了个荒诞的故事,说在超市遇见了外星人。

e.en: The new phone is {ludicrously} expensive for what it offers.
e.zh: 这款新手机相对其功能贵得离谱。

e.en: She arrived {ludicrously} early and waited two hours alone.
e.zh: 她到得早得离谱,独自等了两个小时。

ludlow.t: n. 勒德洛（英国地名/姓氏）

e.en: We spent the weekend exploring the medieval castle in {Ludlow}.
e.zh: 我们周末去拉德洛参观了那座中世纪城堡。

e.en: {Ludlow} is famous for its food festival every September.
e.zh: 拉德洛以每年九月的美食节而闻名。

ludo.t: n. 卢多棋；类似飞行棋的游戏

e.en: The kids played {ludo} on the rug all afternoon.
e.zh: 孩子们整个下午都在地毯上玩飞行棋。

e.en: My grandmother taught me how to play {ludo} as a child.
e.zh: 我小时候是奶奶教我玩飞行棋的。

luff.t:
v. 船迎风而行
n. 帆的前缘

e.en: The sails began to {luff} as the wind shifted suddenly.
e.zh: 风向突变,船帆开始抖动。

e.en: Tighten the sheet to stop the {luff} from flapping.
e.zh: 拉紧帆脚索,别让前缘再抖动了。

e.en: The German word {Luft} simply means "air" in English.
e.zh: 德语单词Luft在英语里就是"空气"的意思。

e.en: He hummed a tune from "Ein Bisschen {Luft}" all morning.
e.zh: 他整个上午都在哼那首《一点空气》。

lufthansa.t: n. 德国汉莎航空公司

e.en: I booked a {Lufthansa} flight from Frankfurt to Tokyo.
e.zh: 我订了一张汉莎航空从法兰克福到东京的机票。

e.en: {Lufthansa} cabin crew went on strike again last week.
e.zh: 汉莎航空的乘务员上周又一次罢工了。

e.en: The documentary covered the {Luftwaffe}'s role in World War II.
e.zh: 那部纪录片讲述了德国空军在二战中的作用。

e.en: British pilots fought the {Luftwaffe} in the Battle of Britain.
e.zh: 英国飞行员在不列颠之战中与德国空军作战。

lug.t:
v. 吃力地拖、拉
n. 柄；耳状突出物

e.en: I had to {lug} three suitcases up four flights of stairs.
e.zh: 我不得不把三个行李箱拖上四层楼。

e.en: Don't forget to tighten every wheel {lug} before driving.
e.zh: 开车前别忘了把每颗轮毂螺母拧紧。

e.en: We took the train to {Lugano} for a weekend by the lake.
e.zh: 我们坐火车去卢加诺湖边度过了个周末。

e.en: {Lugano} blends Swiss order with Italian charm beautifully.
e.zh: 卢加诺把瑞士的秩序和意大利的风情融合得很美。

luge.t: n. 单人仰卧雪橇（运动）

e.en: She won a bronze medal in the women's {luge} event.
e.zh: 她在女子无舵雪橇项目中获得了铜牌。

e.en: Riding a {luge} at 90 mph looks absolutely terrifying.
e.zh: 以每小时九十英里滑无舵雪橇看起来真的吓人。

e.en: The collector paid a fortune for an antique German {Luger}.
e.zh: 那位收藏家花重金买下一把古董德国鲁格手枪。

e.en: A vintage {Luger} pistol was displayed behind thick glass.
e.zh: 一把老式鲁格手枪陈列在厚玻璃后面。

e.en: The airline lost my {luggage} on the connecting flight.
e.zh: 那家航空公司在转机时把我的行李弄丢了。

e.en: Please keep your {luggage} with you at all times.
e.zh: 请始终随身保管好您的行李。

lugged.t: v. lug 的过去式；拖、拉

e.en: He {lugged} the heavy toolbox across the parking lot.
e.zh: 他把那只沉重的工具箱拖过整个停车场。

e.en: She {lugged} groceries home in the pouring rain.
e.zh: 她在倾盆大雨中把杂货拎回了家。

e.en: An old fishing {lugger} was tied up at the harbor.
e.zh: 一艘旧的小帆渔船停泊在港口。

e.en: The {lugger} sailed out at dawn with a full crew.
e.zh: 那艘小帆渔船在黎明时分载着满员船员出海。

lugubrious.t: adj. 忧郁的；愁眉苦脸的

e.en: He gave a {lugubrious} speech about the company's decline.
e.zh: 他做了一番阴郁的演讲,谈公司的衰落。

e.en: The dog wore a {lugubrious} expression after the vet visit.
e.zh: 看完兽医后,那只狗一脸忧郁的表情。

e.en: He sighed {lugubriously} and stared out the rainy window.
e.zh: 他忧郁地叹了口气,望着窗外的雨。

e.en: The cellist played {lugubriously}, filling the hall with sorrow.
e.zh: 大提琴手哀伤地演奏着,整个大厅都弥漫着忧愁。

lugworm.t: n. 沙蚕；海钓用的饵虫

e.en: Anglers dig for {lugworm} on the beach at low tide.
e.zh: 垂钓者会在退潮时去沙滩上挖沙蚕作饵。

e.en: The {lugworm} leaves coiled casts of sand on the shore.
e.zh: 沙蚕会在海滩上留下盘绕的沙堆。

lukewarm.t:
adj. 微温的
adj. 不热情的；冷淡的

e.en: My coffee went {lukewarm} while I was on the call.
e.zh: 我打电话的时候咖啡都凉得不温不热了。

e.en: The audience gave the new film a {lukewarm} reception.
e.zh: 观众对这部新电影反应平平。

lull.t:
v. 使平静；哄（入睡）
n. 间歇；暂停

e.en: There was a brief {lull} in the storm around midnight.
e.zh: 午夜前后,暴风雨短暂地平静了一会儿。

e.en: Soft music can {lull} a baby to sleep within minutes.
e.zh: 轻柔的音乐能在几分钟内哄宝宝入睡。

e.en: She sang a gentle {lullaby} to her newborn daughter.
e.zh: 她为刚出生的女儿唱了一首温柔的摇篮曲。

e.en: That old {lullaby} always reminds me of my grandmother.
e.zh: 那首老摇篮曲总让我想起外婆。

lulling.t: adj. 令人放松的；催眠的

e.en: The {lulling} rhythm of the train soon put me to sleep.
e.zh: 火车那让人昏昏欲睡的节奏很快把我催眠了。

e.en: Her {lulling} voice calmed the anxious children instantly.
e.zh: 她舒缓的声音瞬间让焦躁的孩子们安静下来。

lulu.t: n. 极出色或极糟糕的人/物

e.en: That last storm was a real {lulu} — trees down everywhere.
e.zh: 上一场风暴真是惊人,到处都是倒下的树。

e.en: Her excuse for being late was a {lulu}.
e.zh: 她迟到的借口真是离谱。

e.en: Grandpa complains about his {lumbago} every cold morning.
e.zh: 每到寒冷的早晨,爷爷就抱怨他的腰痛。

e.en: The doctor prescribed stretches to relieve his chronic {lumbago}.
e.zh: 医生开了拉伸动作来缓解他长期的腰痛。

e.en: She injured her {lumbar} spine while lifting a heavy box.
e.zh: 她在搬重箱子时伤到了腰椎。

e.en: This office chair has good {lumbar} support for long hours.
e.zh: 这把办公椅的腰部支撑很适合长时间使用。

lumber.t:
n. 木材
v. 笨重地移动

e.en: We bought {lumber} at the hardware store to build a deck.
e.zh: 我们在五金店买了木材来搭露台。

e.en: Bears {lumber} slowly through the forest looking for berries.
e.zh: 熊在森林里笨重地走着,寻找浆果。

lumbering.t:
adj. 行动笨拙的
n. 伐木业

e.en: A {lumbering} elephant emerged from the trees near the river.
e.zh: 一头笨重的大象从河边的树丛中走了出来。

e.en: The old bus came {lumbering} up the steep hillside road.
e.zh: 那辆旧巴士笨重地驶上陡峭的山坡。

e.en: He grew a thick beard and looked like a {lumberjack}.
e.zh: 他留了浓密的胡子,看上去像个伐木工。

e.en: The {lumberjack} felled the giant pine in under an hour.
e.zh: 那位伐木工不到一小时就放倒了那棵巨大的松树。

e.en: The old {lumberman} knew every trail in the northern woods.
e.zh: 那位老伐木工人熟悉北方林区的每一条小路。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {lumberman} in Oregon for decades.
e.zh: 他祖父在俄勒冈州当了几十年伐木工。

e.en: I drove to the {lumberyard} to pick up some plywood.
e.zh: 我开车去木材场买了些胶合板。

e.en: The {lumberyard} closes early on Sundays during winter.
e.zh: 那家木材场冬天的星期天会提前打烊。

e.en: This LED bulb produces 800 {lumen} using only nine watts.
e.zh: 这只LED灯泡只用九瓦就能发出八百流明的光。

e.en: Higher {lumen} ratings mean a brighter projector image.
e.zh: 流明数值越高,投影画面就越亮。

e.en: The doctor examined the {luminal} surface of the artery.
e.zh: 医生检查了动脉的内腔表面。

e.en: Cells lining the {luminal} side absorb nutrients efficiently.
e.zh: 排列在管腔一侧的细胞能高效吸收养分。

e.en: Adjust the {luminance} setting to reduce eye strain at night.
e.zh: 调整亮度设置可以减轻夜间的眼部疲劳。

e.en: This monitor measures peak {luminance} at 1000 nits.
e.zh: 这台显示器的峰值亮度可达一千尼特。

luminaria.t: n. 纸袋烛灯（节日装饰）

e.en: They lit paper {luminaria} along the driveway on Christmas Eve.
e.zh: 平安夜他们沿着车道点起了纸袋灯。

e.en: Each {luminaria} flickered softly in the cold desert night.
e.zh: 每盏纸袋灯在寒冷的沙漠夜里轻轻闪烁。

luminary.t:
n. 杰出人物；权威
n. 发光体

e.en: She became a {luminary} in the field of climate science.
e.zh: 她成为了气候科学领域的杰出人物。

e.en: The conference attracted every {luminary} in modern architecture.
e.zh: 这次会议吸引了现代建筑界的每一位泰斗。

e.en: The {luminescence} of fireflies lit up the warm summer field.
e.zh: 萤火虫的微光点亮了温暖的夏夜田野。

e.en: Deep-sea creatures use {luminescence} to attract their prey.
e.zh: 深海生物利用发光来吸引猎物。

e.en: The watch dial has {luminescent} markers visible in total darkness.
e.zh: 这块手表的表盘上有完全黑暗中也能看见的夜光刻度。

e.en: Tiny {luminescent} plankton glowed as the boat cut through waves.
e.zh: 小船破浪而行时,微小的发光浮游生物闪闪发亮。

luminist.t: n. 光派画家（19世纪美国风景画流派）

e.en: The gallery features paintings by a nineteenth-century American {luminist}.
e.zh: 画廊展出了一位十九世纪美国光感派画家的作品。

e.en: Every {luminist} obsessed over capturing soft, glowing light.
e.zh: 每一位光感派画家都痴迷于捕捉柔和而发光的光线。

luminol.t: n. 鲁米诺（刑侦用血迹检测试剂）

e.en: Forensic teams sprayed {luminol} to reveal traces of blood.
e.zh: 鉴证人员喷洒鲁米诺以显示血迹的痕迹。

e.en: {Luminol} glows blue when it reacts with iron in hemoglobin.
e.zh: 鲁米诺与血红蛋白中的铁反应时会发出蓝光。

e.en: Astronomers measure a star's {luminosity} to estimate its size.
e.zh: 天文学家通过测量恒星的光度来估算其大小。

e.en: Her skin had a natural {luminosity} after the spa treatment.
e.zh: 做完水疗后,她的皮肤呈现出自然的光泽。

e.en: The hands of the watch are {luminous} and easy to read.
e.zh: 手表的指针带夜光,在黑暗中也容易看清。

e.en: She gave a {luminous} performance in the new musical.
e.zh: 她在这部新音乐剧中的表演光彩照人。

e.en: The full moon shone {luminously} above the silent lake.
e.zh: 满月在寂静的湖面上方明亮地闪耀。

e.en: Her face glowed {luminously} when she heard the good news.
e.zh: 听到好消息时,她的脸上焕发出光彩。

lummox.t: n. 笨手笨脚的人；蠢货

e.en: Don't be such a {lummox} — pick up your feet when you walk.
e.zh: 别这么笨手笨脚的,走路时把脚抬起来。

e.en: That clumsy {lummox} knocked over my entire glass of wine.
e.zh: 那个笨蛋把我整杯红酒都打翻了。

lump.t:
n. 块；肿块
v. 归为一类

e.en: She found a small {lump} on her arm and called the doctor.
e.zh: 她在手臂上发现一个小肿块,就给医生打了电话。

e.en: Add one {lump} of sugar to my tea, please.
e.zh: 请在我的茶里加一块方糖。

lumpectomy.t: n. 肿块切除术（尤指乳房）

e.en: Doctors recommended a {lumpectomy} rather than a full mastectomy.
e.zh: 医生建议做肿块切除术,而不是全乳切除。

e.en: She recovered quickly after her {lumpectomy} last spring.
e.zh: 去年春天做完肿块切除手术后,她恢复得很快。

lumped.t: v. 归为一类（lump 的过去式）

e.en: Critics often {lumped} the two writers together unfairly.
e.zh: 评论家常把这两位作家不公平地归为一类。

e.en: All the expenses were {lumped} into a single category.
e.zh: 所有的开销都被归到一个类别里了。

lumpen.t: adj. 流氓无产阶级的；粗俗的

e.en: He dismissed the protesters as a {lumpen} mob with no goals.
e.zh: 他把抗议者贬为一群没有目标的乌合之众。

e.en: The novel portrays the {lumpen} underclass of nineteenth-century Paris.
e.zh: 小说描绘了十九世纪巴黎的底层流氓阶层。

lumper.t: n. 码头装卸工；合并派学者

e.en: In taxonomy, a {lumper} groups species into broader categories.
e.zh: 在分类学中,合并派学者倾向于把物种归入更大的类别。

e.en: The dock {lumper} unloaded crates from dawn until noon.
e.zh: 码头装卸工从天亮一直卸货到中午。

e.en: Whisk the batter to remove any {lumpiness} before baking.
e.zh: 在烘烤前把面糊搅匀,去除任何结块。

e.en: The {lumpiness} of the old mattress kept me awake all night.
e.zh: 旧床垫凹凸不平,让我整晚都睡不着。

e.en: He sat in a {lumpish} heap on the couch all afternoon.
e.zh: 他整个下午就笨重地瘫在沙发上。

e.en: The clay figure looked {lumpish} and unfinished.
e.zh: 那个泥塑看起来粗笨,还没完工。

lumpur.t: n. 吉隆坡（Kuala Lumpur）的后半

e.en: Kuala {Lumpur} is the bustling capital of Malaysia.
e.zh: 吉隆坡是马来西亚繁华的首都。

e.en: Our flight lands in Kuala {Lumpur} early tomorrow morning.
e.zh: 我们的航班明天一早降落在吉隆坡。

lumpy.t: adj. 多疙瘩的；不平整的

e.en: The gravy turned out {lumpy} because she stirred too late.
e.zh: 她搅得太晚,肉汁结成了块。

e.en: I can't sleep on this {lumpy} old mattress.
e.zh: 我没法睡在这张坑坑洼洼的旧床垫上。

e.en: A pale {luna} moth landed on the screen door.
e.zh: 一只淡绿色的月神蛾停在了纱门上。

e.en: Ancient poets often called the moon {Luna} in their verses.
e.zh: 古代诗人常在诗中把月亮称作露娜。

lunacy.t: n. 愚蠢行为；精神失常

e.en: Driving in this storm would be sheer {lunacy}.
e.zh: 在这种暴风雨里开车简直是疯狂之举。

e.en: He called the new policy economic {lunacy}.
e.zh: 他把这项新政策称为经济上的疯狂。

e.en: China celebrates {Lunar} New Year with family reunions.
e.zh: 中国人会与家人团聚共庆农历新年。

e.en: The astronauts collected rocks during the {lunar} mission.
e.zh: 宇航员在登月任务中采集了岩石样本。

lunatic.t:
n. 疯子
adj. 疯狂的

e.en: Some {lunatic} was honking at three in the morning.
e.zh: 凌晨三点有个疯子在那儿按喇叭。

e.en: His ideas sound {lunatic} but somehow they work.
e.zh: 他的想法听起来很疯,但不知怎的就是管用。

lunch.t:
n. 午餐
v. 吃午饭

e.en: Let's grab {lunch} at the new ramen place.
e.zh: 我们去那家新开的拉面店吃午饭吧。

e.en: I usually pack {lunch} to save money at work.
e.zh: 我通常自己带午饭去公司省钱。

e.en: She decorated her son's {lunchbox} with cartoon stickers.
e.zh: 她在儿子的午餐盒上贴了卡通贴纸。

e.en: My {lunchbox} keeps food warm for several hours.
e.zh: 我的午餐盒能保温好几个小时。

e.en: The charity {luncheon} raised thousands for local schools.
e.zh: 那场慈善午宴为当地学校筹集了数千美元。

e.en: She gave a short speech at the awards {luncheon}.
e.zh: 她在颁奖午宴上做了简短的致辞。

e.en: We grabbed coffee at a tiny corner {luncheonette}.
e.zh: 我们在街角的小快餐店买了杯咖啡。

e.en: The old {luncheonette} still serves classic egg sandwiches.
e.zh: 那家老式简餐店依然在卖经典的鸡蛋三明治。

e.en: School {lunches} have improved a lot in recent years.
e.zh: 近几年学校午餐有了很大改善。

e.en: He packs healthy {lunches} for the kids every morning.
e.zh: 他每天早上为孩子们准备健康的午餐。

e.en: The kids gossip loudly in the school {lunchroom}.
e.zh: 孩子们在学校的食堂里大声八卦。

e.en: Our office {lunchroom} has a microwave and free coffee.
e.zh: 我们公司的午餐间有微波炉和免费咖啡。

e.en: I'll call you back at {lunchtime}.
e.zh: 我午饭时间再给你回电话。

e.en: The cafe gets crowded around {lunchtime}.
e.zh: 这家咖啡馆在午餐时间人很多。

e.en: Most {lunchtimes} I just eat at my desk.
e.zh: 大多数午餐时间我都在工位上吃。

e.en: Office {lunchtimes} are her favorite social break.
e.zh: 办公室的午餐时间是她最喜欢的社交时刻。

lund.t: n. 隆德（瑞典城市／姓氏）

e.en: {Lund} is a charming university town in southern Sweden.
e.zh: 隆德是瑞典南部一座迷人的大学城。

e.en: She's pursuing her PhD at {Lund} University.
e.zh: 她正在隆德大学攻读博士学位。

lundy.t: n. 伦迪（姓氏／英国岛名）

e.en: {Lundy} Island is famous for its puffin colonies.
e.zh: 隆迪岛以其海鹦群落而闻名。

e.en: We took the ferry to {Lundy} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐渡轮去隆迪岛过周末。

e.en: The artist sketched a thin {lune} along the page.
e.zh: 艺术家在页边勾出一道细细的新月形。

e.en: Geometry students learn to calculate the area of a {lune}.
e.zh: 几何学生要学会计算月牙形的面积。

lunette.t: n. 半月形窗；新月形装饰

e.en: A stained-glass {lunette} crowns the cathedral doorway.
e.zh: 教堂大门上方有一扇彩绘玻璃半月窗。

e.en: The painter filled the {lunette} with floating angels.
e.zh: 画家在半月形墙面上画满了飘浮的天使。

e.en: Smoking can severely damage {lung} tissue over time.
e.zh: 长期吸烟会严重损害肺部组织。

e.en: She took a deep breath, filling each {lung}.
e.zh: 她深深吸了一口气,把每个肺都填满。

e.en: The dog made a sudden {lunge} for the squirrel.
e.zh: 那只狗突然朝松鼠猛扑了过去。

e.en: Add a few {lunge} reps to strengthen your legs.
e.zh: 做几组弓步练习来强化腿部力量。

lungful.t: n. 一肺的量（一大口气）

e.en: He took a deep {lungful} of mountain air.
e.zh: 他深深吸了一大口山间的空气。

e.en: She coughed out a {lungful} of smoke from the fire.
e.zh: 她咳出了从火场里吸进的一大口烟。

lunging.t: v. 猛扑（lunge 的现在分词）

e.en: The cat kept {lunging} at the dangling toy.
e.zh: 那只猫不停地扑向悬挂的玩具。

e.en: He fell while {lunging} for the tennis ball.
e.zh: 他扑接网球时摔倒了。

e.en: Runners gradually build stronger {lungs} through training.
e.zh: 跑步者通过训练逐渐让肺部变得更强。

e.en: The baby cried at the top of her {lungs}.
e.zh: 宝宝声嘶力竭地哭了起来。

e.en: He landed a real {lunker} bass at the lake.
e.zh: 他在湖里钓到了一条超大的鲈鱼。

e.en: That trophy {lunker} is mounted above his fireplace.
e.zh: 那条作为战利品的大鱼挂在他的壁炉上方。

e.en: Tall purple {lupin} flowers lined the country path.
e.zh: 高高的紫色羽扇豆花沿着乡间小路盛开。

e.en: She added {lupin} seeds to her vegetarian recipe.
e.zh: 她在素食食谱里加了羽扇豆种子。

lupine.t:
adj. 狼的；似狼的
n. 羽扇豆

e.en: The hero gave the wolf a sharp {lupine} stare.
e.zh: 那位英雄对狼投以锐利的狼一般的目光。

e.en: Wild {lupine} blooms across the meadow each spring.
e.zh: 每年春天野生羽扇豆都会开满草地。

e.en: She manages her {lupus} symptoms with daily medication.
e.zh: 她靠每天服药来控制狼疮的症状。

e.en: Doctors finally diagnosed his fatigue as {lupus}.
e.zh: 医生最终诊断他的疲劳是由狼疮引起的。

e.en: The bus gave a violent {lurch} as it stopped.
e.zh: 公交车停车时猛地颠了一下。

e.en: My ex left me in the {lurch} before the wedding.
e.zh: 我前任在婚礼前把我撇在一边不管了。

e.en: Her rescued {lurcher} loves chasing rabbits in the field.
e.zh: 她领养的混血灵缇喜欢在田野里追兔子。

e.en: That {lurcher} sleeps curled up by the fireplace all evening.
e.zh: 那只猎犬整晚都蜷在壁炉边睡觉。

lurching.t: v. 踉跄（lurch 的现在分词）

e.en: The old truck came {lurching} down the muddy road.
e.zh: 那辆旧卡车在泥泞的路上颠簸前行。

e.en: The economy keeps {lurching} from one crisis to another.
e.zh: 经济不断从一场危机踉跄走入另一场危机。

lure.t:
v. 引诱；诱惑
n. 诱饵

e.en: Free shipping is a classic {lure} for online shoppers.
e.zh: 免运费是吸引网购者的经典诱饵。

e.en: They tried to {lure} him back with a bigger salary.
e.zh: 他们试图用更高的薪水把他吸引回去。

lurex.t: n. 卢勒克斯（金属光泽纱线品牌）

e.en: Her party dress shimmered with woven {lurex} threads.
e.zh: 她的派对裙因织入金银丝线而闪闪发光。

e.en: The eighties loved sweaters laced with {lurex} sparkle.
e.zh: 八十年代很流行带金银丝亮片的毛衣。

lurid.t: adj. 耸人听闻的；骇人的；刺眼的

e.en: Tabloids printed all the {lurid} details of the scandal.
e.zh: 小报把这桩丑闻的种种骇人细节都登了出来。

e.en: The sky turned a {lurid} orange before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨来临前,天空变成了刺目的橘红色。

luridly.t: adv. 骇人地；耸人听闻地

e.en: The novel describes the murder scene quite {luridly}.
e.zh: 小说对凶案现场的描写相当骇人。

e.en: Neon signs glowed {luridly} along the rainy street.
e.zh: 霓虹灯沿着雨夜的街道发出刺眼的光。

lurk.t: v. 潜伏；潜水（只看不发言）

e.en: Hackers often {lurk} in unsecured public Wi-Fi networks.
e.zh: 黑客常潜伏在不安全的公共 Wi-Fi 中。

e.en: I just {lurk} on that forum without ever posting.
e.zh: 我在那个论坛只是潜水,从不发帖。

lurker.t: n. 潜水者（论坛只看不发言的人）

e.en: Most chatrooms have far more {lurkers} than active posters.
e.zh: 大多数聊天室里潜水者远比活跃发帖者多。

e.en: A silent {lurker} suddenly answered my question today.
e.zh: 一个一直潜水的人今天突然回答了我的问题。

lurking.t:
adj. 潜伏的
v. 潜伏（lurk 的现在分词）

e.en: A bug was {lurking} in the code for months.
e.zh: 那个 bug 在代码里潜伏了好几个月。

e.en: Suspicious figures were {lurking} near the parking lot.
e.zh: 有可疑人物在停车场附近徘徊。

lusaka.t: n. 卢萨卡（赞比亚首都）

e.en: {Lusaka} is the capital and largest city of Zambia.
e.zh: 卢萨卡是赞比亚的首都和最大城市。

e.en: Our team flew into {Lusaka} for the conference.
e.zh: 我们团队飞到卢萨卡参加会议。

e.en: The bakery sells {luscious} chocolate cakes every Friday.
e.zh: 那家面包店每周五都卖香甜诱人的巧克力蛋糕。

e.en: She wore a {luscious} red lipstick to the gala.
e.zh: 她涂着艳丽诱人的红唇出席了晚会。

e.en: The mango tasted {lusciously} sweet and ripe.
e.zh: 那颗芒果吃起来甜美多汁,熟得正好。

e.en: Her hair fell {lusciously} over her shoulders.
e.zh: 她的头发柔顺浓密地垂在肩上。

e.en: Bali is known for its {lush} green rice terraces.
e.zh: 巴厘岛以郁郁葱葱的梯田而闻名。

e.en: The film has a {lush} orchestral soundtrack.
e.zh: 这部电影有一段华丽丰富的管弦配乐。

e.en: Tourists admired the {lushness} of the rainforest canopy.
e.zh: 游客们赞叹雨林林冠的繁茂葱郁。

e.en: Spring rains restored the garden's former {lushness}.
e.zh: 春雨让花园重现昔日的茂盛景象。

lusitania.t: n. 卢西塔尼亚号（沉没客轮）

e.en: The sinking of the {Lusitania} shocked the world in 1915.
e.zh: 1915 年卢西塔尼亚号的沉没震惊了世界。

e.en: Historians still debate what really doomed the {Lusitania}.
e.zh: 历史学家至今仍在争论卢西塔尼亚号沉没的真正原因。

lust.t:
n. 强烈欲望；色欲
v. 渴望

e.en: His {lust} for power eventually destroyed his career.
e.zh: 他对权力的贪欲最终毁掉了自己的事业。

e.en: Many investors {lust} after the next big tech stock.
e.zh: 许多投资者都渴望追逐下一只热门科技股。

e.en: Her diamond ring still has its original {luster}.
e.zh: 她的钻戒依然保持着最初的光泽。

e.en: Years of scandal stripped the {luster} from his name.
e.zh: 多年的丑闻让他的名声尽失光彩。

e.en: Her once shiny hair looked dry and {lusterless}.
e.zh: 她曾经亮丽的头发如今干枯无光。

e.en: The team gave a {lusterless} performance in the final.
e.zh: 球队在决赛中表现毫无亮点。

e.en: He gave her a {lustful} glance across the bar.
e.zh: 他隔着吧台向她投去欲念的一瞥。

e.en: The novel explores a {lustful} obsession turned dangerous.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了一段欲望沉迷如何走向危险。

e.en: He stared {lustfully} at the dessert tray.
e.zh: 他充满渴望地盯着甜点车。

e.en: The villain eyed the treasure {lustfully}.
e.zh: 那个反派贪婪地盯着宝藏。

lustily.t: adv. 精力充沛地；嘹亮地

e.en: The crowd sang {lustily} along with the chorus.
e.zh: 人群兴致勃勃地跟着合唱起来。

e.en: The newborn cried {lustily} the moment he arrived.
e.zh: 新生儿一出生就放声大哭。

lustre.t: n. 光泽（luster 的英式拼法）

e.en: Polishing restored the silverware's beautiful {lustre}.
e.zh: 擦拭后,银器恢复了美丽的光泽。

e.en: The old movie star never lost her {lustre}.
e.zh: 那位老牌影星始终没有失去她的光彩。

e.en: Her hair looked dry and {lustreless} after months of bleaching.
e.zh: 她的头发漂染数月后显得干枯无光泽。

e.en: The old painting had a dull, {lustreless} surface.
e.zh: 那幅旧画的表面暗淡无光。

e.en: She brushed her long, {lustrous} black hair before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前梳理着那一头乌黑亮丽的长发。

e.en: The pearls had a soft, {lustrous} glow under the lamp.
e.zh: 珍珠在灯下泛着柔和的光泽。

lusts.t:
n. 欲望（复数）
v. 渴望（第三人称单数）

e.en: He {lusts} after fame more than money.
e.zh: 他对名声的渴望胜过对金钱的追求。

e.en: The novel explores the {lusts} and fears of its characters.
e.zh: 这部小说探讨了人物的欲望与恐惧。

lusty.t: adj. 强健的；精力充沛的

e.en: The baby gave a {lusty} cry the moment she was born.
e.zh: 婴儿一出生就发出响亮的哭声。

e.en: They sang a {lusty} chorus at the football match.
e.zh: 他们在足球赛上放声合唱。

e.en: He played a soft melody on the {lute}.
e.zh: 他用鲁特琴弹奏了一段柔和的旋律。

e.en: The Renaissance {lute} has many delicate strings.
e.zh: 文艺复兴时期的鲁特琴有许多纤细的琴弦。

e.en: Spinach is rich in {lutein}, which supports eye health.
e.zh: 菠菜富含叶黄素,有助于眼睛健康。

e.en: Doctors recommend {lutein} supplements for aging eyes.
e.zh: 医生建议年长者补充叶黄素以保护眼睛。

lutheran.t:
adj. 路德宗的
n. 路德宗信徒

e.en: She grew up attending a {Lutheran} church in Minnesota.
e.zh: 她从小在明尼苏达的一所路德教会长大。

e.en: The {Lutheran} tradition emphasizes salvation through faith.
e.zh: 路德宗传统强调因信称义。

e.en: Our flight landed at {Luton} airport just before midnight.
e.zh: 我们的航班在午夜前降落在卢顿机场。

e.en: {Luton} is a town just north of London.
e.zh: 卢顿是伦敦以北的一座城镇。

lutz.t: n. 勒茨跳（花样滑冰动作）

e.en: She landed a triple {lutz} to win the gold medal.
e.zh: 她完成了一个三周勾手跳,夺得金牌。

e.en: The {lutz} is one of the hardest jumps in figure skating.
e.zh: 勾手跳是花样滑冰中最难的跳跃之一。

luv.t: n. 亲爱的（love 的口语变体）

e.en: Thanks for the help, {luv}, you're a star.
e.zh: 谢谢你的帮忙,亲爱的,你真棒。

e.en: What can I get you, {luv}?
e.zh: 亲爱的,你想要点什么?

e.en: Office lighting should be at least 500 {lux} for reading.
e.zh: 办公室照明用于阅读时应至少有500勒克斯。

e.en: The brand markets a {lux} version of every product.
e.zh: 该品牌为每款产品都推出了豪华版。

e.en: {Luxembourg} is one of the smallest countries in Europe.
e.zh: 卢森堡是欧洲最小的国家之一。

e.en: Many EU institutions have offices in {Luxembourg}.
e.zh: 许多欧盟机构在卢森堡设有办事处。

luxemburg.t: n. 卢森堡（Luxembourg 的变体拼写）

e.en: Rosa {Luxemburg} was a famous Marxist theorist.
e.zh: 罗莎·卢森堡是著名的马克思主义理论家。

e.en: The older spelling {Luxemburg} appears in historical texts.
e.zh: 旧式拼写 Luxemburg 多见于历史文献中。

e.en: We visited the temples of {Luxor} on our Egypt trip.
e.zh: 我们在埃及之行中参观了卢克索的神庙。

e.en: {Luxor} sits on the east bank of the Nile.
e.zh: 卢克索位于尼罗河东岸。

e.en: The garden's {luxuriance} surprised every visitor.
e.zh: 花园的繁茂景色令每位访客惊叹。

e.en: She admired the {luxuriance} of the tropical rainforest.
e.zh: 她赞叹热带雨林的繁茂葱郁。

e.en: The valley was covered in {luxuriant} green vegetation.
e.zh: 山谷被茂盛的绿色植被覆盖。

e.en: He had a {luxuriant} beard that reached his chest.
e.zh: 他留着一把浓密的胡子,一直垂到胸前。

e.en: Vines grew {luxuriantly} along the old stone wall.
e.zh: 藤蔓沿着古老的石墙茂盛地生长。

e.en: Her hair fell {luxuriantly} over her shoulders.
e.zh: 她的头发茂密地垂落在肩头。

e.en: I love to {luxuriate} in a hot bath after work.
e.zh: 我喜欢下班后泡个热水澡尽情享受。

e.en: They {luxuriate} in the warm Mediterranean sun.
e.zh: 他们尽情享受着温暖的地中海阳光。

e.en: Sleep and free time feel like {luxuries} these days.
e.zh: 睡眠和空闲时间最近简直成了奢侈品。

e.en: The hotel offers all the {luxuries} you'd expect.
e.zh: 这家酒店提供你能想到的各种奢华享受。

e.en: They stayed in a {luxurious} suite overlooking the ocean.
e.zh: 他们入住了一间俯瞰大海的豪华套房。

e.en: The sofa felt incredibly soft and {luxurious}.
e.zh: 那张沙发感觉柔软无比,十分奢华。

e.en: The cat stretched {luxuriously} in the patch of sunlight.
e.zh: 猫在那片阳光里舒展身体,惬意至极。

e.en: The room was {luxuriously} furnished with silk and velvet.
e.zh: 房间用丝绸和天鹅绒奢华地装饰着。

luxury.t:
n. 奢华；奢侈品
adj. 奢华的

e.en: For her, a quiet morning is the greatest {luxury}.
e.zh: 对她来说,一个安静的早晨就是最大的奢侈。

e.en: They drove off in a sleek {luxury} sedan.
e.zh: 他们驾着一辆造型流畅的豪华轿车离去。

e.en: She named her daughter {Luz}, meaning 'light' in Spanish.
e.zh: 她给女儿取名 Luz,在西班牙语中意为‘光’。

e.en: {Luz} is a common given name across Latin America.
e.zh: Luz 是拉丁美洲常见的女性名字。

luzon.t: n. 吕宋岛（菲律宾最大岛）

e.en: Manila is the capital city on the island of {Luzon}.
e.zh: 马尼拉是位于吕宋岛上的首都。

e.en: A typhoon swept through northern {Luzon} last week.
e.zh: 上周一场台风席卷了吕宋岛北部。

e.en: She typed '{lve} you' instead of 'love you' by mistake.
e.zh: 她不小心把‘love you’打成了‘lve you’。

e.en: Autocorrect changed '{lve}' back to 'love' in my message.
e.zh: 自动更正把我消息里的‘lve’改回了‘love’。

e.en: {LVMH} owns brands like Louis Vuitton and Dior.
e.zh: LVMH 旗下拥有路易威登和迪奥等品牌。

e.en: Shares of {LVMH} rose after strong quarterly earnings.
e.zh: LVMH 股价在强劲季度财报后上涨。

lvov.t: n. 利沃夫（乌克兰城市）

e.en: {Lvov} is the older Russian name for the Ukrainian city Lviv.
e.zh: Lvov 是乌克兰城市利沃夫的旧俄语名称。

e.en: My grandparents emigrated from {Lvov} before the war.
e.zh: 我祖父母在战前从利沃夫移民他乡。

lwt.t: n. 伦敦周末电视台（London Weekend Television）

e.en: {LWT} produced many classic British TV shows in the eighties.
e.zh: LWT 在八十年代制作了许多经典英国电视节目。

e.en: The old {LWT} logo is still remembered by fans.
e.zh: 老牌 LWT 的台标至今仍被粉丝记住。

e.en: In folklore, a {lycanthrope} transforms into a wolf at full moon.
e.zh: 民间传说中,狼人会在满月时变身为狼。

e.en: The film's hero turns out to be a tortured {lycanthrope}.
e.zh: 影片的主角最终被揭示为一名痛苦的狼人。

e.en: She studies philosophy at a Parisian {lycee}.
e.zh: 她在巴黎的一所中学读哲学。

e.en: French students take the bac at the end of {lycee}.
e.zh: 法国学生在中学末年参加高中毕业会考。

e.en: The town's old {lyceum} now hosts public lectures and concerts.
e.zh: 小镇的老学园如今举办公共讲座和音乐会。

e.en: Aristotle taught at the {Lyceum} in ancient Athens.
e.zh: 亚里士多德曾在古雅典的吕克昂学园授课。

e.en: I ordered a {lychee} martini at the bar.
e.zh: 我在酒吧点了一杯荔枝马天尼。

e.en: Fresh {lychee} is sweet and fragrant in summer.
e.zh: 夏天的新鲜荔枝甜美又香气扑鼻。

e.en: Tomatoes are a great source of {lycopene}, an antioxidant.
e.zh: 西红柿是抗氧化剂番茄红素的良好来源。

e.en: Cooking tomatoes actually increases their {lycopene} content.
e.zh: 煮熟番茄反而能提高其番茄红素含量。

lycra.t: n. 莱卡（弹性纤维品牌）

e.en: The leggings stretch easily thanks to the {lycra} blend.
e.zh: 这条紧身裤因含莱卡而非常具有弹性。

e.en: Cyclists often wear tight {lycra} shorts for comfort.
e.zh: 骑行者常穿紧身莱卡短裤以求舒适。

lye.t: n. 碱液；氢氧化钠溶液

e.en: Soap makers handle {lye} carefully because it's caustic.
e.zh: 肥皂制作者会小心处理碱液,因为它具有腐蚀性。

e.en: Pretzels are dipped in a {lye} solution before baking.
e.zh: 椒盐卷饼在烘烤前会浸入碱水中。

lying.t:
v. 说谎；躺着
n. 撒谎

e.en: He admitted he had been {lying} about his whereabouts.
e.zh: 他承认自己一直在谎报行踪。

e.en: The cat was {lying} in the sun all afternoon.
e.zh: 那只猫整个下午都躺在阳光下。

e.en: A tick bite gave her {Lyme} disease last summer.
e.zh: 去年夏天一次蜱虫叮咬让她得了莱姆病。

e.en: Hikers should check for ticks to avoid {Lyme} disease.
e.zh: 徒步者应检查蜱虫以避免感染莱姆病。

e.en: The doctor felt the swollen {lymph} nodes in my neck.
e.zh: 医生触诊到我颈部肿大的淋巴结。

e.en: {Lymph} fluid carries white blood cells around the body.
e.zh: 淋巴液在体内运送白细胞。

e.en: The scan revealed {lymphadenopathy} in the patient's chest.
e.zh: 扫描显示该患者胸部出现淋巴结肿大。

e.en: Persistent {lymphadenopathy} should always be investigated.
e.zh: 持续性的淋巴结肿大都应进行检查。

lymphatic.t:
adj. 淋巴的
n. 淋巴管

e.en: Massage can help drain the {lymphatic} system.
e.zh: 按摩有助于淋巴系统的排毒。

e.en: Cancer cells sometimes spread through {lymphatic} vessels.
e.zh: 癌细胞有时会通过淋巴管扩散。

e.en: She developed {lymphedema} in her arm after breast surgery.
e.zh: 她在乳腺手术后手臂出现了淋巴水肿。

e.en: Compression sleeves can help manage {lymphedema}.
e.zh: 加压袖套有助于控制淋巴水肿。

e.en: The boy was diagnosed with acute {lymphoblastic} leukemia.
e.zh: 那个男孩被诊断出急性淋巴细胞白血病。

e.en: {Lymphoblastic} lymphoma often affects young patients.
e.zh: 淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤常发生于年轻患者。

e.en: A {lymphocyte} is a type of white blood cell.
e.zh: 淋巴细胞是一种白细胞。

e.en: Vaccines train each {lymphocyte} to recognize the virus.
e.zh: 疫苗训练每个淋巴细胞识别这种病毒。

e.en: He is being treated for chronic {lymphocytic} leukemia.
e.zh: 他正在接受慢性淋巴细胞白血病的治疗。

e.en: The biopsy showed a {lymphocytic} infiltrate in the tissue.
e.zh: 活检显示组织中有淋巴细胞浸润。

lymphoid.t: adj. 淋巴样的；淋巴组织的

e.en: The tonsils are part of the body's {lymphoid} tissue.
e.zh: 扁桃体是人体淋巴组织的一部分。

e.en: Doctors examined the {lymphoid} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 医生在显微镜下检查了淋巴细胞。

e.en: He was diagnosed with non-Hodgkin {lymphoma} last year.
e.zh: 他去年被诊断出患有非霍奇金淋巴瘤。

e.en: Modern treatments have made {lymphoma} much more survivable.
e.zh: 现代疗法大大提高了淋巴瘤的生存率。

lynch.t:
v. 处以私刑
n. 林奇（姓氏）

e.en: David {Lynch} directed many surreal and unsettling films.
e.zh: 大卫·林奇导演了许多超现实而不安的电影。

e.en: An angry mob threatened to {lynch} the suspect.
e.zh: 愤怒的人群扬言要私刑处死嫌疑人。

e.en: The museum documents the history of {lynching} in America.
e.zh: 该博物馆记录了美国私刑迫害的历史。

e.en: Online {lynching} can destroy a person's reputation overnight.
e.zh: 网络上的群起攻击能在一夜之间毁掉一个人的名声。

e.en: She is the {lynchpin} of the entire research team.
e.zh: 她是整个研究团队的核心人物。

e.en: Trust is the {lynchpin} of any healthy relationship.
e.zh: 信任是任何健康关系的关键所在。

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking near {Lyndhurst} in the New Forest.
e.zh: 我们周末在新福里斯特的林德赫斯特附近徒步。

e.en: {Lyndhurst} is a charming village popular with tourists.
e.zh: 林德赫斯特是一座深受游客喜爱的迷人村庄。

e.en: We spent the weekend hiking around {Lynton} in north Devon.
e.zh: 我们周末在北德文郡的林顿附近徒步。

e.en: The cliff railway connects {Lynton} to the village below.
e.zh: 悬崖缆车把林顿和山下的村子连了起来。

e.en: A {lynx} crossed the snowy trail just ahead of us.
e.zh: 一只猞猁从我们前方的雪道穿了过去。

e.en: The Iberian {lynx} was nearly extinct two decades ago.
e.zh: 伊比利亚猞猁二十年前几乎灭绝了。

e.en: We took the train from Paris to {Lyon} for the weekend.
e.zh: 我们坐火车从巴黎去里昂过周末。

e.en: {Lyon} is famous for its bouchons and silk-weaving history.
e.zh: 里昂以小酒馆和丝织历史而闻名。

e.en: She ordered the salade {lyonnais} with poached egg and bacon.
e.zh: 她点了配水波蛋和培根的里昂式沙拉。

e.en: The chef trained in classic {lyonnais} cuisine for years.
e.zh: 那位厨师学习经典里昂菜多年。

e.en: My grandmother used to take me to {Lyons} tea shops.
e.zh: 我奶奶以前常带我去莱昂斯茶馆。

e.en: The {Lyons} family runs a small bakery downtown.
e.zh: 莱昂斯一家在市中心经营一间小面包店。

e.en: The ancient poet sang while strumming a small {lyre}.
e.zh: 那位古代诗人一边弹着小竖琴一边吟唱。

e.en: A bronze {lyre} was unearthed from the Greek tomb.
e.zh: 考古人员从希腊墓中出土了一把青铜竖琴。

lyric.t:
n. 歌词
adj. 抒情的

e.en: That one {lyric} from the chorus has been stuck in my head.
e.zh: 副歌里那一句歌词在我脑里一直循环。

e.en: She prefers {lyric} poetry to long narrative epics.
e.zh: 她喜欢抒情诗,胜过冗长的叙事史诗。

lyrical.t: adj. 抒情的；感情充沛的

e.en: The novel's prose is surprisingly {lyrical} and dreamlike.
e.zh: 这本小说的文笔出人意料地抒情如梦。

e.en: He waxed {lyrical} about his hometown for an hour.
e.zh: 他滔滔不绝地夸赞了一个小时他的家乡。

e.en: The album is {lyrically} darker than her earlier work.
e.zh: 这张专辑在歌词上比她早期作品更阴郁。

e.en: She writes {lyrically} about ordinary moments of grief.
e.zh: 她以抒情笔调描写日常中的悲伤瞬间。

e.en: Critics praised the film's quiet visual {lyricism}.
e.zh: 影评人盛赞这部电影安静的视觉抒情感。

e.en: His {lyricism} sets him apart from other rappers today.
e.zh: 他的歌词功底让他在当今说唱歌手中脱颖而出。

e.en: The {lyricist} won a Tony for the Broadway musical.
e.zh: 那位作词人凭这部百老汇音乐剧获得了托尼奖。

e.en: She works as a {lyricist} for several K-pop groups.
e.zh: 她为几个韩国流行组合担任作词人。

e.en: Top {lyricists} can earn royalties for decades after release.
e.zh: 顶级作词人在歌曲发行后还能拿几十年版税。

e.en: The festival honored three legendary Broadway {lyricists}.
e.zh: 该音乐节向三位传奇百老汇作词人致敬。

e.en: I always check the {lyrics} when a song moves me.
e.zh: 一首歌打动我时,我总会去查歌词。

e.en: She forgot the {lyrics} halfway through the second verse.
e.zh: 她唱到第二段一半时忘了歌词。

e.en: The fleur-de-{lys} appears on many French royal banners.
e.zh: 鸢尾花纹章出现在许多法国王室旗帜上。

e.en: The river {Lys} flows through Belgium and northern France.
e.zh: 利斯河流经比利时和法国北部。

e.en: We centrifuged the cell {lysate} to remove debris.
e.zh: 我们将细胞裂解液离心以去除杂质。

e.en: The protein was purified from bacterial {lysate} overnight.
e.zh: 该蛋白连夜从细菌裂解物中纯化出来。

lysine.t: n. 赖氨酸（一种氨基酸）

e.en: {Lysine} is an essential amino acid the body cannot produce.
e.zh: 赖氨酸是人体无法自行合成的必需氨基酸。

e.en: She takes {lysine} supplements to manage cold sores.
e.zh: 她服用赖氨酸补充剂来控制唇疱疹。

e.en: Cell {lysis} releases proteins for downstream analysis.
e.zh: 细胞裂解会释放蛋白质,用于后续分析。

e.en: The buffer triggers rapid {lysis} of red blood cells.
e.zh: 该缓冲液会迅速使红细胞裂解。

e.en: Tay-Sachs is a serious {lysosomal} storage disorder.
e.zh: 泰萨氏症是一种严重的溶酶体贮积病。

e.en: The drug targets a specific {lysosomal} enzyme deficiency.
e.zh: 该药物针对一种特定的溶酶体酶缺乏症。

e.en: The {lysosome} digests worn-out parts inside the cell.
e.zh: 溶酶体负责分解细胞内老化的部件。

e.en: A damaged {lysosome} can leak enzymes into the cytoplasm.
e.zh: 受损的溶酶体可能会向细胞质泄漏酶。

e.en: Tears contain {lysozyme}, which kills harmful bacteria.
e.zh: 眼泪中含有溶菌酶,可以杀灭有害细菌。

e.en: Egg whites are a classic source of {lysozyme}.
e.zh: 蛋清是溶菌酶的经典来源。

e.en: The Open Championship returned to {Lytham} St Annes that year.
e.zh: 那一年英国公开赛重回利瑟姆圣安妮举办。

e.en: They retired to a quiet bungalow near {Lytham}.
e.zh: 他们退休后住到了利瑟姆附近一栋安静的小屋。

e.en: The virus enters the {lytic} cycle and destroys the host cell.
e.zh: 病毒进入裂解周期,摧毁宿主细胞。

e.en: Doctors found {lytic} lesions on the patient's spine.
e.zh: 医生在病人的脊椎上发现了溶骨性病灶。

lyttelton.t: n. 利特尔顿（人名/地名）

e.en: Ships dock at {Lyttelton} harbour just outside Christchurch.
e.zh: 船只停靠在基督城外的利特尔顿港。

e.en: We drove through the tunnel into {Lyttelton} for lunch.
e.zh: 我们穿过隧道去利特尔顿吃午饭。

e.en: The Hon. Mrs. {Lyttleton} hosted the charity dinner.
e.zh: 利特尔顿夫人主持了那场慈善晚宴。

e.en: Records mention a {Lyttleton} estate in Worcestershire.
e.zh: 史料提到伍斯特郡有一处利特尔顿庄园。

e.en: Edward Bulwer-{Lytton} wrote the famous "dark and stormy night" line.
e.zh: 爱德华·布尔沃-利顿写下了那句著名的"漆黑的暴风雨之夜"。

e.en: A wildfire devastated the village of {Lytton} in 2021.
e.zh: 2021年一场山火摧毁了利顿村。

leary.t: adj. 警惕的；谨慎的（leery 变体）

lamest.t: a. 跛足的, 僵痛的, 不完全的, 金属薄板, 不知内情的人\nvi. 变跛\nvt. 使成残废, 使无用

landsmen.t: n. 同胞, 未出过海的人

largest.t: a. 大的, 大量的, 宽大的, 广博的\nadv. 大大地, 夸大地

lawmen.t: n. [律] 执法官, 警察, 警官

laymen.t: n. 俗人, 门外汉, 凡人\n[医] 外行, 业外人

laziest.t: a. 懒惰的, 怠惰的, 缓慢的\nvi. 懒散

lazier.t: a. 懒惰的, 怠惰的, 缓慢的\nvi. 懒散

leakiest.t: a. 有漏洞的, 易泄漏秘密的, 爱哭的\n[电] 漏的

leapt.t: n. 跳跃, 剧增, 急变, 被越过之物\nvi. 跳跃, 突然经过\nvt. 跃过, 使跃过

leggier.t: a. 长腿的, 腿细长的, 茎长的

lengthier.t: a. 冗长的, 漫长的

lengthiest.t: a. 冗长的, 漫长的

lain.t: n. 谎言, 假象, 位置\nvi. 躺着, 说谎, 位于, 展现, 存在, 停泊\nvt. 谎骗

lightest.t:
n. 光, 光亮, 灯, 日光, 发光体, 光源, 杰出人物, 火花, 眼光
a. 轻的, 少量的, 轻微的, 轻快的, 轻浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的
vt. 点燃, 照亮
vi. 点着, 变亮, 突降, 偶然碰到
adv. 轻地

likeliest.t: a. 有可能的, 合适的, 前途有望的\nadv. 或许, 可能

limpest.t: n. 跛行\na. 柔软的, 无力的, 软弱的\nvi. 跛行

linemen.t: n. 线务员, 线路工人, 护路工, 养路工

linesmen.t: n. 常备步兵, 线路保养工, 边线裁判员

livelier.t: a. 活泼的, 鲜明的, 生动的

liveliest.t: a. 活泼的, 鲜明的, 生动的

loftier.t: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的

loftiest.t: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的

loneliest.t: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的

lonelier.t: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的

looniest.t: a. 发狂的, 极蠢的\nn. 疯子

lice.t: n. 虱子, 寄生虫\n[医] 虱

lousier.t: a. 污秽的, 恶心的, 生虱的

loveliest.t: a. 可爱的, 有趣的

lovelier.t: a. 可爱的, 有趣的

lowlier.t: a. 地位低的, 卑下的, 谦卑的\nadv. 位置低下的, 低声地, 谦逊地

luckier.t: a. 幸运的, 吉祥的, 好运的, 侥幸的

luckiest.t: a. 幸运的, 吉祥的, 好运的, 侥幸的

lumpier.t: a. 多瘤的, 波浪起伏的, 粗笨的

lushest.t: a. 苍翠繁茂的, 多青草的, 丰富的\nn. 酒, 酒鬼\nv. 饮

lustier.t: a. 健壮的, 精力充沛的

e.en: The poem ends with a brief {l'envoi}.
e.zh: 这首诗以一段简短的结尾短节收束。

e.en: Her {l'envoi} addresses the patron directly.
e.zh: 她的诗歌结尾短节直接向赞助人致意。

e.en: The radio used an {L-antenna} for better reception.
e.zh: 这台收音机使用L形天线来改善接收效果。

e.en: An {L-antenna} can fit where a straight antenna cannot.
e.zh: L形天线能装在直天线放不下的位置。

e.en: The satellite sends navigation data over the {L-band}.
e.zh: 这颗卫星通过L波段发送导航数据。

e.en: Engineers tested the {L-band} receiver in heavy rain.
e.zh: 工程师在大雨中测试了L波段接收器。

e.en: Doctors prescribed {L-dopa} for his Parkinson's symptoms.
e.zh: 医生给他开了左旋多巴来缓解帕金森症状。

e.en: The study measured how quickly {L-dopa} entered the bloodstream.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了左旋多巴进入血液的速度。

la-de-da.t: 装腔作势的；矫揉造作的

e.en: She sounded rather {la-de-da} at the dinner party.
e.zh: 她在晚宴上听起来相当装腔作势。

e.en: He mocked their {la-de-da} manners after they left.
e.zh: 他们离开后，他嘲笑他们那套矫揉造作的礼仪。

la-di-da.t: 装腔作势的；矫揉造作的

e.en: Don't give me that {la-di-da} voice.
e.zh: 别用那种装腔作势的语气跟我说话。

e.en: The hotel felt too {la-di-da} for our simple trip.
e.zh: 这家酒店对我们这趟简单旅行来说显得太做作了。

e.en: The geologist identified {laavenite} in the thin section.
e.zh: 地质学家在薄片中鉴定出了钠锰锆硅酸盐矿物。

e.en: Tiny crystals of {laavenite} lined the rock cavity.
e.zh: 岩石空洞内排列着细小的钠锰锆硅酸盐矿物晶体。

e.en: She put on a {lab-coat} before handling the samples.
e.zh: 处理样本前，她穿上了实验室白大褂。

e.en: The {lab-coat} had several ink stains on the sleeve.
e.zh: 那件实验室白大褂的袖子上有几处墨水污渍。

e.en: A {lab-technician} checked the blood samples twice.
e.zh: 一名实验室技术员把血液样本检查了两遍。

e.en: The school hired a new {lab-technician} for the chemistry department.
e.zh: 学校为化学系聘请了一名新的实验室技术员。

e.en: The choreographer recorded the sequence in {labanotation}.
e.zh: 编舞者用拉班舞谱记录了这段动作。

e.en: Students learned {labanotation} to analyze historical dances.
e.zh: 学生学习拉班舞谱来分析历史舞蹈。

e.en: The manuscript shows several {labara} carried before the emperor.
e.zh: 手稿中画着几面在皇帝前方举着的君士坦丁军旗。

e.en: Historians debated whether the {labara} were ceremonial or military.
e.zh: 历史学家争论这些君士坦丁军旗是礼仪用还是军事用。

e.en: The emperor's {labarum} bore a Christian symbol.
e.zh: 皇帝的君士坦丁军旗上带有基督教标志。

e.en: A faded {labarum} appears in the old mosaic.
e.zh: 那幅古老马赛克中出现了一面褪色的君士坦丁军旗。

e.en: The perfume used {labdanum} for a warm resinous note.
e.zh: 这款香水用岩蔷薇树脂营造温暖的树脂香调。

e.en: Ancient traders valued {labdanum} as an aromatic gum.
e.zh: 古代商人把劳丹脂视为珍贵的芳香树脂。

e.en: The scandal caused the {labefaction} of public trust.
e.zh: 这桩丑闻导致公众信任受到动摇。

e.en: Repeated failures led to a slow {labefaction} of his confidence.
e.zh: 反复失败使他的信心逐渐被削弱。

e.en: The orchid's {labellum} attracts insects with bright markings.
e.zh: 兰花的唇瓣用鲜艳斑纹吸引昆虫。

e.en: Under the microscope, the fly's {labellum} looked like a soft pad.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，苍蝇的下唇状结构像一个柔软的垫子。

labellums.t: 唇瓣；下唇状结构的复数

e.en: The orchids had unusually wide {labellums}.
e.zh: 这些兰花有异常宽大的唇瓣。

e.en: Researchers compared the {labellums} of several fly species.
e.zh: 研究人员比较了几种苍蝇的下唇状结构。

e.en: Her {labelmate} released an album the same week.
e.zh: 她的同唱片公司艺人在同一周发行了专辑。

e.en: The rapper toured with a younger {labelmate} from Chicago.
e.zh: 这名说唱歌手和一位来自芝加哥的年轻同唱片公司艺人一起巡演。

e.en: The dialect shows {labialisation} before rounded vowels.
e.zh: 这种方言在圆唇元音前会出现唇音化。

e.en: Her thesis examined {labialisation} in several Celtic languages.
e.zh: 她的论文研究了几种凯尔特语言中的唇音化现象。

e.en: Some speakers {labialise} the consonant in that position.
e.zh: 有些说话者会把那个位置的辅音唇音化。

e.en: Children may {labialise} sounds while learning this dialect.
e.zh: 儿童学习这种方言时可能会把某些音唇音化。

e.en: The teacher pointed out the {labialism} in the old pronunciation.
e.zh: 老师指出了这种旧读音里的唇音特征。

e.en: Linguists used {labialism} to classify the consonant shift.
e.zh: 语言学家用唇音性来分类这次辅音变化。

e.en: The sound's {labiality} is clear in slow speech.
e.zh: 慢速说话时，这个音的唇音性很明显。

e.en: The analysis measured degrees of {labiality} across dialects.
e.zh: 这项分析测量了不同方言中的唇部发音程度。

e.en: The consonant underwent {labialization} in the northern dialect.
e.zh: 这个辅音在北部方言中发生了唇音化。

e.en: The textbook explains {labialization} with simple mouth diagrams.
e.zh: 教材用简单的口形图解释唇音化。

e.en: Speakers often {labialize} the sound before a rounded vowel.
e.zh: 说话者常在圆唇元音前把这个音唇音化。

e.en: The notation marks when to {labialize} a consonant.
e.zh: 这个记号标明何时要把辅音唇音化。

e.en: The word begins with a {labialized} consonant.
e.zh: 这个词以一个唇音化辅音开头。

e.en: She practiced the {labialized} sound until it felt natural.
e.zh: 她反复练习那个唇音化的音，直到发得自然。

e.en: In this dialect, the following vowel {labializes} the consonant.
e.zh: 在这种方言中，后面的元音会使辅音唇化。

e.en: The speaker {labializes} several sounds before rounded vowels.
e.zh: 这位说话人在圆唇元音前会把几个音发成唇化音。

e.en: The linguist described a {labializing} effect in the recording.
e.zh: 这位语言学家描述了录音中的唇化作用。

e.en: Students practiced {labializing} the consonant before the vowel.
e.zh: 学生们练习在元音前把这个辅音唇化。

e.en: The flower has a clearly {labiate} shape.
e.zh: 这朵花有明显的唇瓣状外形。

e.en: A {labiate} consonant is made with the lips.
e.zh: 唇音是用嘴唇发出的辅音。

e.en: The orchid has {labiated} petals near its center.
e.zh: 这株兰花中心附近有唇状花瓣。

e.en: The old grammar notes a {labiated} consonant in this word.
e.zh: 那本旧语法书注明这个词里有一个唇化辅音。

e.en: Extreme heat can {labilise} the chemical mixture.
e.zh: 高温会使这种化学混合物变得不稳定。

e.en: The crisis may {labilise} the fragile political system.
e.zh: 这场危机可能使脆弱的政治体系变得动荡。

e.en: The report warned of market {labilization} after the shock.
e.zh: 报告警告说冲击过后市场可能出现不稳定化。

e.en: Protein {labilization} occurred during prolonged heating.
e.zh: 长时间加热过程中发生了蛋白质不稳定化。

e.en: Moisture can {labilize} the stored compound.
e.zh: 水分会使储存的化合物变得不稳定。

e.en: Sudden rumors may {labilize} investor confidence.
e.zh: 突如其来的谣言可能动摇投资者信心。

e.en: English f is a {labiodental} sound.
e.zh: 英语中的 f 是一个唇齿音。

e.en: The child had trouble producing {labiodental} consonants.
e.zh: 这个孩子发唇齿辅音有困难。

e.en: The researcher marked the symbol as a {labionasal} consonant.
e.zh: 研究者把这个符号标为唇鼻辅音。

e.en: Some languages contrast oral and {labionasal} sounds.
e.zh: 有些语言区分口腔音和唇鼻音。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {labioplasty} with the patient.
e.zh: 外科医生和患者讨论了唇部整形术。

e.en: Recovery after {labioplasty} depends on the procedure.
e.zh: 唇部整形术后的恢复情况取决于具体手术方式。

e.en: The language has a rare {labiovelar} stop.
e.zh: 这种语言有一个少见的唇软腭塞音。

e.en: He analyzed the {labiovelar} consonant in the recording.
e.zh: 他分析了录音中的唇软腭辅音。

e.en: Some speakers {labiovelarize} the consonant in casual speech.
e.zh: 有些说话者在随意讲话时会把这个辅音唇软腭化。

e.en: The rule can {labiovelarize} a plain velar sound.
e.zh: 这条规则可以使普通软腭音变成唇软腭音。

e.en: The insect's {labium} helps it handle food.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的下唇帮助它处理食物。

e.en: The doctor examined the injured {labium} carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了受伤的阴唇部位。

e.en: The diagram labels the two {labiums} separately.
e.zh: 图示把两个唇状部位分别标了出来。

e.en: Several specimens had damaged {labiums} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下有几个标本的唇状部受损。

e.en: Farmers planted {lablab} as a cover crop.
e.zh: 农民把扁豆藤种作覆盖作物。

e.en: The stew included tender {lablab} beans.
e.zh: 这道炖菜里放了鲜嫩的扁豆。

e.en: The box had a misspelled {lable} on it.
e.zh: 盒子上贴着一个把 label 拼错的标签。

e.en: She typed {lable} instead of label in the form.
e.zh: 她在表格里把 label 误打成了 lable。

e.en: Farming remains {labor-intensive} in many regions.
e.zh: 在许多地区，农业仍然是劳动密集型行业。

e.en: The repair process is slow and {labor-intensive}.
e.zh: 维修过程很慢，而且需要大量人工。

e.en: The factory bought new {labor-saving} machines.
e.zh: 工厂购买了新的省力机器。

e.en: A dishwasher is a useful {labor-saving} device.
e.zh: 洗碗机是一种实用的省力设备。

e.en: The team followed strict {laboratorial} procedures.
e.zh: 团队遵循严格的实验室程序。

e.en: His work focused on {laboratorial} analysis of blood samples.
e.zh: 他的工作侧重于对血液样本进行实验室分析。

e.en: The {laboratorian} prepared the samples before noon.
e.zh: 实验室工作人员在中午前准备好了样本。

e.en: A skilled {laboratorian} noticed the contamination early.
e.zh: 一名熟练的实验室人员很早就发现了污染。

e.en: He dreamed of a {laborless} life of comfort.
e.zh: 他梦想过一种不必劳作的舒适生活。

e.en: The advertised method promised {laborless} weight loss.
e.zh: 广告中的方法号称可以不费力地减肥。

e.en: They installed {laborsaving} equipment in the kitchen.
e.zh: 他们在厨房安装了省力设备。

e.en: Modern software offers many {laborsaving} features.
e.zh: 现代软件提供许多节省人工的功能。

e.en: The old road made travel {laborsome} and slow.
e.zh: 那条旧路让旅途既费力又缓慢。

e.en: Copying the records by hand was {laborsome} work.
e.zh: 手工抄写这些记录是一项辛苦的工作。

e.en: Women make up half the {labour-force} in the sector.
e.zh: 女性占该行业劳动力的一半。

e.en: The ageing {labour-force} worries many economists.
e.zh: 劳动力人口老龄化让许多经济学家担忧。

e.en: Textile production can be {labour-intensive}.
e.zh: 纺织生产可能是劳动密集型的。

e.en: The project was expensive because it was {labour-intensive}.
e.zh: 这个项目成本高，因为它需要大量人工。

laches.t: 因拖延而丧失权利或诉权；懈怠

e.en: The court dismissed the claim because of {laches}.
e.zh: 法院因原告拖延过久而驳回了诉讼请求。

e.en: Her lawyer warned that {laches} could weaken the case.
e.zh: 她的律师警告说，长期懈怠可能削弱这个案子。

e.en: The doctor examined the {lachrymal} duct carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了泪管。

e.en: A {lachrymal} response followed the irritating smoke.
e.zh: 刺激性的烟雾引发了流泪反应。

e.en: The chemical caused severe {lachrymation} within seconds.
e.zh: 这种化学物质几秒内就引起了严重流泪。

e.en: Persistent {lachrymation} may signal an eye infection.
e.zh: 持续流泪可能是眼部感染的信号。

e.en: Tear gas is a powerful {lachrymator}.
e.zh: 催泪瓦斯是一种强效催泪剂。

e.en: The onion releases a mild {lachrymator} when cut.
e.zh: 洋葱被切开时会释放一种轻微催泪物质。

e.en: The lab tested the spray's {lachrymatory} effect.
e.zh: 实验室测试了这种喷雾的催泪效果。

e.en: A small ancient {lachrymatory} was found in the tomb.
e.zh: 墓中发现了一个小型古代盛泪瓶。

e.en: His speech slipped into sentimental {lachrymosity}.
e.zh: 他的演讲变得伤感而多泪。

e.en: The critic disliked the film's heavy {lachrymosity}.
e.zh: 评论家不喜欢这部电影过重的煽情感。

lacier.t: 更像蕾丝的；更有网眼的

e.en: She chose the {lacier} blouse for the party.
e.zh: 她为聚会挑了那件更有蕾丝感的上衣。

e.en: The fabric became {lacier} after repeated washing.
e.zh: 这种布料反复清洗后变得更像网眼织物。

laciest.t: 最像蕾丝的；最有网眼的

e.en: This is the {laciest} dress in the collection.
e.zh: 这是整个系列里最有蕾丝感的连衣裙。

e.en: The baker made the {laciest} sugar decoration.
e.zh: 烘焙师做出了最细密如蕾丝的糖饰。

e.en: The curtains hung {lacily} over the window.
e.zh: 窗帘像蕾丝一样轻柔地垂在窗前。

e.en: Frost spread {lacily} across the glass.
e.zh: 霜花在玻璃上呈网眼状蔓延开来。

e.en: The scarf's {laciness} made it look delicate.
e.zh: 围巾的蕾丝感让它显得很精致。

e.en: Architects admired the ironwork's airy {laciness}.
e.zh: 建筑师欣赏这件铁艺通透细密的网状美感。

e.en: Each petal has a narrow {lacinia} at its edge.
e.zh: 每片花瓣边缘都有一个狭长的细裂片。

e.en: The insect's mouthpart includes a small {lacinia}.
e.zh: 这种昆虫的口器包含一个小的裂片结构。

laciniae.t: 细裂片；流苏状部分复数

e.en: The botanist counted the flower's tiny {laciniae}.
e.zh: 植物学家数了这朵花上的细小裂片。

e.en: Several {laciniae} fringe the insect's mouthparts.
e.zh: 昆虫口器边缘有几个流苏状的小裂片。

laciniate.t: 边缘深裂的；呈流苏状的

e.en: The plant has {laciniate} leaves with jagged edges.
e.zh: 这种植物有边缘深裂、参差不齐的叶子。

e.en: A {laciniate} border decorated the old manuscript.
e.zh: 那份旧手稿上装饰着流苏状的边框。

e.en: The specimen showed a {laciniated} leaf margin.
e.zh: 这个标本显示出深裂的叶缘。

e.en: Her costume had {laciniated} strips of silk.
e.zh: 她的服装上有流苏状的丝绸条带。

e.en: The leaf's {laciniation} helps identify the species.
e.zh: 叶片的深裂形态有助于识别这个物种。

e.en: The designer used {laciniation} to create a fringed effect.
e.zh: 设计师用裂片状处理营造出流苏效果。

e.en: A tiny {lacinula} appears near the petal tip.
e.zh: 花瓣尖端附近有一个细小裂片。

e.en: The microscope revealed a delicate {lacinula}.
e.zh: 显微镜显示出一个精细的小流苏状部分。

lack-in-office.t: 懒散失职的人；不称职官员

e.en: The pamphlet mocked him as a {lack-in-office}.
e.zh: 那本小册子嘲笑他是个懒散失职的官员。

e.en: Voters grew tired of the old {lack-in-office}.
e.zh: 选民厌倦了那个老是不称职的在任者。

e.en: {Lackaday}, the old house is gone.
e.zh: 唉，那座老房子已经不在了。

e.en: She cried, "{lackaday}, what shall we do now?"
e.zh: 她喊道：“哎呀，我们现在该怎么办？”

e.en: Only a {lackwit} would ignore that warning.
e.zh: 只有傻瓜才会无视那个警告。

e.en: The play presents the servant as a comic {lackwit}.
e.zh: 这出戏把仆人塑造成一个滑稽的笨人。

e.en: The chemist prepared a {lacmoid} indicator solution.
e.zh: 化学家配制了一种类石蕊指示剂溶液。

e.en: A {lacmoid} stain colored the sample faintly blue.
e.zh: 类石蕊染料把样品染成了淡蓝色。

e.en: Old texts often use {lacmus} for litmus.
e.zh: 旧文献常用lacmus来指石蕊。

e.en: The solution turned the {lacmus} paper red.
e.zh: 这种溶液使石蕊试纸变红了。

e.en: His reply was unusually {laconical}.
e.zh: 他的回答异常简洁。

e.en: The editor preferred a {laconical} style.
e.zh: 编辑更喜欢言简意赅的文风。

e.en: The dispute became a serious {labour-relation} issue.
e.zh: 这场纠纷变成了严重的劳资关系问题。

e.en: She studies {labour-relation} law at university.
e.zh: 她在大学研究劳资关系法律。

e.en: Good {labour-relations} helped the factory avoid strikes.
e.zh: 良好的劳资关系帮助工厂避免了罢工。

e.en: The minister met unions to discuss {labour-relations}.
e.zh: 部长会见工会，讨论劳资关系问题。

e.en: The farm bought {labour-saving} machines for harvesting.
e.zh: 农场购买了节省劳力的收割机器。

e.en: A dishwasher is a useful {labour-saving} device.
e.zh: 洗碗机是一种实用的省力设备。

e.en: The contract included a separate {labour-service} fee.
e.zh: 合同中包含一项单独的劳务服务费用。

e.en: Some prisoners were assigned to {labour-service} units.
e.zh: 一些囚犯被分配到劳动役单位。

e.en: The form misspelled laboratory as {labouratory}.
e.zh: 表格把 laboratory 误拼成了 labouratory。

e.en: Her teacher marked {labouratory} as a spelling error.
e.zh: 老师把 labouratory 标为拼写错误。

e.en: The climb was slow and {labourious}.
e.zh: 这次攀登缓慢而费力。

e.en: He wrote in a careful, {labourious} hand.
e.zh: 他用认真而吃力的笔迹书写。

e.en: She {labouriously} copied every line by hand.
e.zh: 她费力地用手抄下每一行。

e.en: The old truck moved {labouriously} up the hill.
e.zh: 那辆旧卡车艰难地爬上山坡。

e.en: The {labouriousness} of the task surprised everyone.
e.zh: 这项任务的费力程度让所有人吃惊。

e.en: Critics noticed the {labouriousness} of his prose.
e.zh: 评论家注意到他的散文有一种吃力感。

labourist.t: 工党支持者；劳工主义者

e.en: He described himself as a committed {labourist}.
e.zh: 他称自己是坚定的工党支持者。

e.en: The pamphlet argued from a {labourist} position.
e.zh: 这本小册子从劳工主义立场展开论述。

e.en: The newspaper called her a lifelong {labourite}.
e.zh: 报纸称她是一名终身工党支持者。

e.en: A young {labourite} challenged the council's decision.
e.zh: 一名年轻工党党员质疑了市议会的决定。

e.en: They advertised a new {laboursaving} kitchen tool.
e.zh: 他们宣传了一种新的省力厨房工具。

e.en: Modern software offers many {laboursaving} features.
e.zh: 现代软件提供许多节省劳力的功能。

e.en: It was a {laboursome} journey through deep mud.
e.zh: 那是一段穿过深泥的艰难旅程。

e.en: The translation proved more {laboursome} than expected.
e.zh: 这项翻译比预想的更费力。

e.en: Their {labradoodle} loves swimming in the lake.
e.zh: 他们的拉布拉多贵宾犬喜欢在湖里游泳。

e.en: A {labradoodle} can inherit traits from both breeds.
e.zh: 拉布拉多贵宾犬可能继承两个犬种的特点。

e.en: The ring was set with polished {labradorite}.
e.zh: 这枚戒指镶着抛光的拉长石。

e.en: Blue flashes appeared when the {labradorite} caught light.
e.zh: 拉长石受光时显出蓝色闪光。

e.en: She wore a silver {labret} below her lower lip.
e.zh: 她在下唇下方戴着一枚银色唇钉。

e.en: The museum displayed an ancient stone {labret}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件古代石制唇饰。

e.en: The diver photographed a colorful {labrid} near the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员在礁石附近拍到一条色彩鲜艳的隆头鱼科鱼。

e.en: This {labrid} changes color as it matures.
e.zh: 这种隆头鱼科鱼成熟时会改变颜色。

e.en: The guide identified several {labroid} fishes on the reef.
e.zh: 向导在珊瑚礁上认出了几种似隆头鱼的鱼。

e.en: Its {labroid} shape helps it move through coral.
e.zh: 它类似隆头鱼的体形有助于在珊瑚间游动。

e.en: The technician sterilized all the {labware} before testing.
e.zh: 技术员在检测前给所有实验室器具消毒。

e.en: Glass {labware} must be handled with care.
e.zh: 玻璃实验室器具必须小心处理。

e.en: The surgeon discussed {labyrinthectomy} as a last resort.
e.zh: 外科医生把迷路切除术作为最后手段来讨论。

e.en: After the {labyrinthectomy}, his vertigo finally stopped.
e.zh: 迷路切除术后，他的眩晕终于停止了。

e.en: The tax code is famously {labyrinthian}.
e.zh: 这套税法以迷宫般复杂而出名。

e.en: They wandered through {labyrinthian} streets after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜后他们在迷宫般的街道中徘徊。

e.en: The doctor suspected a {labyrinthic} disorder.
e.zh: 医生怀疑是内耳迷路方面的疾病。

e.en: The poem has a {labyrinthic} structure of echoes.
e.zh: 这首诗有一种迷宫般回环的结构。

e.en: Severe {labyrinthitis} can cause dizziness and nausea.
e.zh: 严重的迷路炎会导致头晕和恶心。

e.en: She missed work while recovering from {labyrinthitis}.
e.zh: 她因迷路炎康复而没去上班。

e.en: The fossil belonged to a large {labyrinthodont}.
e.zh: 这块化石属于一只大型迷齿类两栖动物。

e.en: A {labyrinthodont} had teeth with complex folded enamel.
e.zh: 迷齿类两栖动物的牙齿有复杂褶皱的釉质。

e.en: The old map labels the water as {lac-lake}.
e.zh: 旧地图把这片水域标作 lac-lake。

e.en: In some names, {lac-lake} simply repeats the idea of lake.
e.zh: 在一些名称中，lac-lake 只是重复了“湖”的意思。

e.en: The artisan sealed the box with {lacca}.
e.zh: 工匠用虫胶封涂了这个盒子。

e.en: Old recipes mention {lacca} as a red dye.
e.zh: 旧配方提到紫胶可用作红色染料。

e.en: The conservator tested the {laccal} coating before cleaning the cabinet.
e.zh: 修复师在清洁柜子前检测了这层虫胶涂层。

e.en: Old recipes sometimes mention {laccal} varnish for a glossy finish.
e.zh: 旧配方有时会提到用虫胶清漆做出光亮表面。

e.en: The fungus produces {laccase} to help break down wood fibers.
e.zh: 这种真菌会产生漆酶来帮助分解木质纤维。

e.en: Researchers added {laccase} to the dye treatment process.
e.zh: 研究人员在染料处理过程中加入了漆酶。

e.en: The chemist identified {laccol} in the resin sample.
e.zh: 化学家在树脂样品中鉴定出了漆酚。

e.en: Exposure to {laccol} can irritate sensitive skin.
e.zh: 接触漆酚可能会刺激敏感皮肤。

e.en: The map marks a buried {laccolite} beneath the ridge.
e.zh: 地图标出了山脊下方一处埋藏的岩盖。

e.en: Students compared the {laccolite} with a nearby volcanic dike.
e.zh: 学生们把这个饼状侵入岩同附近的火山岩脉作比较。

e.en: A {laccolith} can lift the rock layers above it into a dome.
e.zh: 岩盖能把上方岩层顶起形成穹隆。

e.en: The geologist dated the {laccolith} to the early Miocene.
e.zh: 地质学家把这处透镜状侵入岩体定年为中新世早期。

e.en: The hills have a {laccolithic} structure under the surface.
e.zh: 这些山丘地下具有岩盖状结构。

e.en: They studied the {laccolithic} intrusion using seismic data.
e.zh: 他们利用地震数据研究这次岩盖式侵入。

e.en: He mocked their {lace-curtain} manners at dinner.
e.zh: 他嘲笑他们晚餐时那种装腔作势的中产派头。

e.en: The phrase {lace-curtain} Irish once implied social pretension.
e.zh: “lace-curtain Irish”这个说法曾暗指爱尔兰裔的社会攀附姿态。

e.en: She bought black {lace-up} boots for winter.
e.zh: 她买了一双黑色系带靴过冬。

e.en: Please {lace-up} your shoes before running.
e.zh: 跑步前请把鞋带系好。

e.en: His polished {lace-ups} matched the dark suit.
e.zh: 他擦亮的系带皮鞋很配那套深色西装。

e.en: The hikers chose sturdy {lace-ups} for the muddy trail.
e.zh: 徒步者为泥泞小路选了结实的系带靴。

e.en: A {lacebug} left pale spots on the azalea leaves.
e.zh: 一只网蝽在杜鹃叶上留下了浅色斑点。

e.en: Gardeners often find {lacebug} damage during dry summers.
e.zh: 园丁常在干燥的夏季发现网蝽造成的损害。

e.en: He prefers {laceless} sneakers for quick walks.
e.zh: 他散步时更喜欢穿无鞋带运动鞋。

e.en: The dress was plain and {laceless} by design.
e.zh: 这条裙子的设计本来就朴素，没有花边。

e.en: Frost made {lacelike} patterns on the window.
e.zh: 霜在窗户上结出了花边般的图案。

e.en: The leaf skeleton looked thin and {lacelike}.
e.zh: 那片叶脉残骸看起来纤薄而网眼状。

e.en: Her grandmother taught {lacemaking} in a village workshop.
e.zh: 她的祖母在村里的作坊教授蕾丝制作。

e.en: Traditional {lacemaking} requires patience and steady hands.
e.zh: 传统花边编织需要耐心和稳定的双手。

e.en: The surgeon avoided the {lacerable} tissue near the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生避开了伤口附近容易撕裂的组织。

e.en: This thin membrane is highly {lacerable} under pressure.
e.zh: 这层薄膜在压力下极易割裂。

e.en: The report described the blade as a {lacerant} weapon.
e.zh: 报告把这把刀描述为造成割裂伤的武器。

e.en: His {lacerant} criticism left the team silent.
e.zh: 他尖锐刺痛的批评让团队沉默下来。

e.en: The broken glass had a {lacerative} edge.
e.zh: 碎玻璃有一道会割裂皮肤的边缘。

e.en: Her {lacerative} remarks reopened an old dispute.
e.zh: 她伤人的话重新挑起了一场旧争执。

e.en: The actor wore a {lacerna} in the Roman scene.
e.zh: 演员在罗马场景中披着一件古罗马斗篷。

e.en: A wool {lacerna} protected travelers from cold rain.
e.zh: 羊毛外披风能保护旅人免受寒雨侵袭。

e.en: The fossil showed several {lacertian} features.
e.zh: 这块化石显示出若干蜥蜴类特征。

e.en: Its quick, {lacertian} movement startled the hikers.
e.zh: 它像蜥蜴般迅捷的动作吓了徒步者一跳。

e.en: The museum displays a small {lacertilian} skeleton.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一具小型蜥蜴类骨架。

e.en: He specialized in {lacertilian} evolution and island species.
e.zh: 他专门研究蜥蜴类演化和岛屿物种。

e.en: A {lacertine} shape slipped between the stones.
e.zh: 一个蜥蜴般的身影从石块间溜过。

e.en: The paper compares {lacertine} jaws across several families.
e.zh: 论文比较了几个科的蜥蜴类颌部结构。

e.en: She threaded the {lacet} through the small metal eyelets.
e.zh: 她把细带穿过那些小金属孔眼。

e.en: The old bodice was fastened with a narrow {lacet}.
e.zh: 那件旧胸衣是用一条窄花边带系紧的。

e.en: The cabinetmaker chose {lacewood} for the drawer fronts.
e.zh: 木匠选用花边木来做抽屉正面。

e.en: Polished {lacewood} shows a striking speckled grain.
e.zh: 抛光后的花边木呈现醒目的斑点纹理。

laconicism.t: 简洁寡言的表达风格或原则

e.en: Her {laconicism} made every reply sound final.
e.zh: 她说话简洁寡言，让每个回答都像定论。

e.en: The poet valued {laconicism} over decorative language.
e.zh: 这位诗人重视简练表达，而不是华丽辞藻。

laconism.t: 简洁寡言；斯巴达式简练

e.en: His {laconism} annoyed people who wanted details.
e.zh: 他寡言简短，让想听细节的人很恼火。

e.en: The speech showed a harsh Spartan {laconism}.
e.zh: 那篇演讲带有严厉的斯巴达式简练。

e.en: The museum displayed Japanese {lacquerware} from the Edo period.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了江户时期的日本漆器。

e.en: She bought a small {lacquerware} box for jewelry.
e.zh: 她买了一个小漆盒来放首饰。

e.en: The cabinet's {lacquerwork} took months to finish.
e.zh: 这个柜子的漆艺花了数月才完成。

e.en: Traditional {lacquerwork} requires patience and careful polishing.
e.zh: 传统漆器制作需要耐心和细致打磨。

e.en: The minister treated every assistant like a {lacquey}.
e.zh: 那位部长把每个助手都当作仆从使唤。

e.en: He refused to play the {lacquey} for powerful donors.
e.zh: 他拒绝在有权势的捐助者面前卑躬屈膝。

e.en: The chemical fumes made my eyes {lacrimate}.
e.zh: 化学烟雾让我双眼流泪。

e.en: Patients may {lacrimate} during the eye examination.
e.zh: 病人在眼科检查时可能会分泌泪液。

e.en: Onion vapors can cause sudden {lacrimation}.
e.zh: 洋葱挥发物会突然引起流泪。

e.en: The doctor noted excessive {lacrimation} in the left eye.
e.zh: 医生注意到左眼泪液分泌过多。

e.en: The gas acted as a powerful {lacrimator}.
e.zh: 这种气体起到了强烈催泪剂的作用。

e.en: Police identified the compound as a military {lacrimator}.
e.zh: 警方确认该化合物是一种军用催泪物质。

e.en: A glass {lacrimatory} was found in the ancient tomb.
e.zh: 古墓中发现了一个玻璃盛泪瓶。

e.en: The report described a {lacrimatory} reaction to the fumes.
e.zh: 报告描述了烟雾引起的流泪反应。

e.en: The actor gave a {lacrimose} farewell speech.
e.zh: 那位演员发表了一场催人泪下的告别演说。

e.en: She became unusually {lacrimose} after the news.
e.zh: 听到这个消息后，她变得异常爱哭。

e.en: The surgeon examined the {lacrymal} duct carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了泪管。

e.en: A {lacrymal} infection can make the eye swollen.
e.zh: 泪腺感染会使眼睛肿胀。

e.en: The archaeologist catalogued a Roman {lacrymatory}.
e.zh: 考古学家登记了一只罗马盛泪瓶。

e.en: The substance produced a {lacrymatory} effect within seconds.
e.zh: 这种物质几秒内就产生了催泪效果。

e.en: Early physiologists called muscle glycogen {lactacidogen}.
e.zh: 早期生理学家把肌肉糖原称为乳酸生成物。

e.en: The textbook mentioned {lactacidogen} in an obsolete theory of fatigue.
e.zh: 教科书在一种过时的疲劳理论中提到了乳酸生成物。

e.en: Fenugreek is sometimes used as a {lactagogue}.
e.zh: 胡芦巴有时被用作催乳剂。

e.en: The midwife warned that no {lactagogue} works for everyone.
e.zh: 助产士提醒说，没有哪种促乳物对所有人都有效。

e.en: The chemist studied a {lactal} derivative in the lab.
e.zh: 化学家在实验室研究一种乳糖相关衍生物。

e.en: Older writers used {lactal} to mean relating to milk.
e.zh: 早期作者用lactal表示与乳汁有关。

lactalbumin.t: 乳白蛋白；乳清蛋白成分

e.en: Whey contains {lactalbumin} and other soluble proteins.
e.zh: 乳清含有乳白蛋白和其他可溶性蛋白。

e.en: The formula lists {lactalbumin} as a major ingredient.
e.zh: 配方把乳白蛋白列为主要成分。

lactam.t: 内酰胺；环状酰胺化合物

e.en: A beta-{lactam} antibiotic attacks bacterial cell walls.
e.zh: β-内酰胺类抗生素会攻击细菌细胞壁。

e.en: The chemist synthesized a new {lactam} ring.
e.zh: 化学家合成了一个新的内酰胺环。

lactamase.t: 内酰胺酶；抗药性相关酶

e.en: Some bacteria produce {lactamase} to resist antibiotics.
e.zh: 有些细菌会产生内酰胺酶来抵抗抗生素。

e.en: The lab tested the isolate for beta-{lactamase}.
e.zh: 实验室检测了该分离菌株是否产生β-内酰胺酶。

e.en: The old chemistry text referred to {lactamid}.
e.zh: 那本旧化学教材提到了乳酰胺。

e.en: They prepared {lactamid} from a lactic acid derivative.
e.zh: 他们用乳酸衍生物制备了乳酰胺。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {lactanilide}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量乳酰苯胺。

e.en: Few modern courses discuss {lactanilide} in detail.
e.zh: 如今很少有课程详细讨论乳酰苯胺。

lactarazulene.t: 乳菇薁；蘑菇色素化合物

e.en: Researchers isolated {lactarazulene} from a mushroom species.
e.zh: 研究人员从一种蘑菇中分离出乳菇薁。

e.en: The blue pigment was identified as {lactarazulene}.
e.zh: 这种蓝色色素被鉴定为乳菇薁。

e.en: The estate kept a small {lactary} near the barns.
e.zh: 庄园在谷仓附近设有一个小乳制品间。

e.en: Visitors watched butter being made in the {lactary}.
e.zh: 游客在乳品厂里观看黄油制作。

e.en: The doctor examined the {lacteal} ducts carefully.
e.zh: 医生仔细检查了乳管。

e.en: A {lacteal} fluid seeped from the plant stem.
e.zh: 一种乳状液体从植物茎中渗出。

e.en: The liquid shone {lacteally} under the lamp.
e.zh: 那液体在灯下呈现乳汁般的光泽。

e.en: The sap spread {lacteally} across the cut bark.
e.zh: 树液像乳汁一样在割开的树皮上扩散。

e.en: A {lactean} haze softened the evening sky.
e.zh: 乳白色的薄雾让傍晚的天空显得柔和。

e.en: The mineral left a {lactean} stain on the stone.
e.zh: 这种矿物在石头上留下了乳白色污痕。

e.en: The medicine formed a {lacteous} mixture in water.
e.zh: 这种药在水中形成了乳状混合物。

e.en: A {lacteous} glow filled the cloudy night.
e.zh: 乳白色的光辉充满了多云的夜晚。

e.en: The botanist noted the plant's {lactescence} after cutting it.
e.zh: 植物学家记录了植物被切开后的乳状分泌现象。

e.en: Cooling caused a faint {lactescence} in the solution.
e.zh: 冷却使溶液出现了轻微的乳白变化。

e.en: The broken stem released a {lactescent} sap.
e.zh: 折断的茎流出了乳白色汁液。

e.en: The mixture became {lactescent} as it cooled.
e.zh: 混合物冷却时变得乳白。

e.en: The chemist purified {lactide} for polymer production.
e.zh: 化学家提纯丙交酯用于聚合物生产。

e.en: Medical sutures can be made from {lactide} polymers.
e.zh: 医用缝线可以由丙交酯聚合物制成。

e.en: The surgeon avoided damaging the {lactiferous} ducts.
e.zh: 外科医生避免损伤输乳管。

e.en: Some plants have {lactiferous} tissues that release white sap.
e.zh: 有些植物有会释放白色汁液的乳汁组织。

e.en: The herb was once believed to be {lactific}.
e.zh: 这种草药曾被认为能促进乳汁生成。

e.en: Researchers tested the formula for possible {lactific} effects.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了该配方是否有促乳作用。

e.en: The physician prescribed a {lactifuge} after the miscarriage.
e.zh: 流产后，医生开了一种抑制泌乳的药。

e.en: Old medical texts list sage as a possible {lactifuge}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献把鼠尾草列为可能的退乳药。

e.en: The molecule can shift into a {lactim} form.
e.zh: 这种分子可以转变为内酰亚胺醇式体。

e.en: Spectroscopy confirmed the presence of the {lactim} tautomer.
e.zh: 光谱分析证实存在内酰亚胺醇式互变异构体。

e.en: Older pharmacists sometimes called milk sugar {lactin}.
e.zh: 早期药剂师有时把乳糖称为lactin。

e.en: The label listed {lactin} among the powder's ingredients.
e.zh: 标签把乳糖列在这种粉末的成分中。

e.en: A {lacto-vegetarian} diet includes milk but excludes eggs.
e.zh: 奶素饮食包括牛奶，但不吃鸡蛋。

e.en: The restaurant marked several dishes as {lacto-vegetarian}.
e.zh: 餐厅把几道菜标为奶素菜。

e.en: Whey contains {lactoalbumin} and other useful proteins.
e.zh: 乳清含有乳白蛋白和其他有用蛋白质。

e.en: The lab measured {lactoalbumin} levels in the milk sample.
e.zh: 实验室测量了奶样中的乳白蛋白含量。

e.en: Yogurt contains live {lactobacilli} that ferment milk.
e.zh: 酸奶含有能发酵牛奶的活乳酸杆菌。

e.en: Antibiotics may reduce beneficial {lactobacilli} in the gut.
e.zh: 抗生素可能减少肠道中的有益乳酸杆菌。

e.en: A {lactobacillus} strain is used to make yogurt.
e.zh: 一种乳酸杆菌菌株被用于制作酸奶。

e.en: The supplement contains {lactobacillus} for digestive health.
e.zh: 这种补充剂含有有助消化健康的乳酸杆菌。

e.en: Scientists once used {lactochrome} as a name for riboflavin.
e.zh: 科学家曾用乳黄素这个名称指核黄素。

e.en: The yellow color was linked to {lactochrome} in the sample.
e.zh: 样品中的黄色与乳黄素有关。

e.en: The old analysis described a fine {lactoconium} in milk.
e.zh: 旧分析记录了牛奶中的细微沉淀物。

e.en: Heating produced visible {lactoconium} at the bottom of the flask.
e.zh: 加热后，烧瓶底部出现了可见的乳中沉淀物。

e.en: Breast milk is rich in {lactoferrin}.
e.zh: 母乳富含乳铁蛋白。

e.en: The study examined whether {lactoferrin} helps immune defense.
e.zh: 这项研究考察乳铁蛋白是否有助于免疫防御。

e.en: Early nutrition papers called riboflavin {lactoflavin}.
e.zh: 早期营养学论文把核黄素称为乳黄素。

e.en: The vitamin sample contained a yellow pigment, {lactoflavin}.
e.zh: 维生素样品含有一种黄色色素，即乳黄素。

e.en: Placental {lactogen} affects metabolism during pregnancy.
e.zh: 胎盘催乳激素会影响孕期代谢。

e.en: The compound was tested as a possible {lactogen}.
e.zh: 这种化合物被测试是否可能促乳。

e.en: Hormonal changes trigger {lactogenesis} after birth.
e.zh: 分娩后的激素变化会触发乳汁生成。

e.en: Delayed {lactogenesis} can make breastfeeding harder.
e.zh: 泌乳开始延迟会让母乳喂养更困难。

e.en: Prolactin is a {lactogenic} hormone.
e.zh: 催乳素是一种促乳激素。

e.en: The team studied the plant's possible {lactogenic} effect.
e.zh: 团队研究了这种植物可能的催乳作用。

e.en: The biologist described the leaf as {lacunose} under the lens.
e.zh: 生物学家在镜下把这片叶子描述为多孔隙。

e.en: A {lacunose} texture made the old bone look fragile.
e.zh: 这种布满小孔的质地让旧骨头显得很脆弱。

lacunosis.t: 空隙形成；组织多孔状态

e.en: The scan showed early {lacunosis} in the affected tissue.
e.zh: 扫描显示受影响组织出现早期空隙形成。

e.en: Doctors used {lacunosis} to describe the porous change in the bone.
e.zh: 医生用空隙形成来描述骨骼的多孔变化。

e.en: Each tiny {lacunula} held a drop of trapped fluid.
e.zh: 每个小陷窝里都困着一滴液体。

e.en: The drawing marked a {lacunula} between the mineral layers.
e.zh: 图中标出了矿物层之间的一个小空隙。

e.en: A single {lacunule} appeared in the magnified tissue sample.
e.zh: 放大的组织样本中出现了一个小陷窝。

e.en: The shell's surface had a {lacunule} near its edge.
e.zh: 贝壳表面靠近边缘处有一个小凹隙。

e.en: The team studied {lacustrian} sediments from the ancient basin.
e.zh: 团队研究了古盆地中的湖泊沉积物。

e.en: A {lacustrian} community once lived along these shallow waters.
e.zh: 曾有一个湖居群体生活在这些浅水边。

e.en: The perfume used {ladanum} for a warm resinous note.
e.zh: 这款香水用岩蔷薇树脂带出温暖的树脂气息。

e.en: Ancient traders sold {ladanum} as a fragrant gum.
e.zh: 古代商人把劳丹脂当作芳香树脂出售。

ladar.t: 激光雷达；激光探测测距

e.en: The robot used {ladar} to map the dark corridor.
e.zh: 机器人用激光雷达绘制黑暗走廊的地图。

e.en: Engineers tested {ladar} on the autonomous vehicle.
e.zh: 工程师在自动驾驶车辆上测试激光探测测距。

e.en: She bought a {ladder-back} chair for the kitchen.
e.zh: 她给厨房买了一把梯背式椅子。

e.en: The {ladder-back} design gave the room a rustic feel.
e.zh: 这种梯背式设计让房间有了乡村质感。

e.en: These tights are advertised as {ladder-proof}.
e.zh: 这些连裤袜广告称具有防抽丝功能。

e.en: She chose {ladder-proof} stockings for the long trip.
e.zh: 她为长途旅行选了不易脱线的长袜。

e.en: A wooden {ladderback} stood beside the farmhouse table.
e.zh: 一把木制梯背椅放在农舍餐桌旁。

e.en: The room was furnished with simple {ladderback} chairs.
e.zh: 房间里摆着几把朴素的梯背式椅子。

e.en: The plant had a {ladderlike} pattern on its stem.
e.zh: 这株植物的茎上有梯状花纹。

e.en: A {ladderlike} structure connected the two platforms.
e.zh: 一个像梯子的结构连接着两个平台。

e.en: The {ladderman} climbed quickly to the second-floor window.
e.zh: 云梯消防员迅速爬到二楼窗前。

e.en: A skilled {ladderman} secured the ladder before repairs began.
e.zh: 熟练的架梯工在维修开始前固定好了梯子。

e.en: The label promised {ladderproof} nylon stockings.
e.zh: 标签上承诺这是防抽丝的尼龙长袜。

e.en: She packed {ladderproof} tights for the performance.
e.zh: 她为演出带上了不易脱线的连裤袜。

e.en: A {laddertruck} arrived minutes after the alarm.
e.zh: 警报响起几分钟后，一辆云梯消防车赶到。

e.en: The crew raised the {laddertruck} boom toward the roof.
e.zh: 消防队员把云梯消防车的伸展臂升向屋顶。

e.en: The miners descended through a narrow {ladderway}.
e.zh: 矿工们沿着狭窄的梯道下行。

e.en: A metal {ladderway} gave access to the maintenance platform.
e.zh: 一条金属梯道通向维修平台。

e.en: His {laddic} humor amused the younger players.
e.zh: 他那种小伙子气的幽默逗乐了年轻队员。

e.en: The novel captures a rough, {laddic} energy.
e.zh: 这部小说抓住了一种粗犷的男孩气活力。

laddish.t: 小伙子气的；粗野逞强的

e.en: His {laddish} jokes annoyed several colleagues.
e.zh: 他那些粗野逞强的玩笑惹恼了几位同事。

e.en: The film celebrates a very {laddish} kind of friendship.
e.zh: 这部电影颂扬了一种很小伙子气的友情。

e.en: Workers {lade} the carts with fresh coal each morning.
e.zh: 工人们每天早上把新煤装上手推车。

e.en: She used a dipper to {lade} water from the barrel.
e.zh: 她用长柄勺从桶里舀水。

e.en: The tabloid called her a {ladette} after the party.
e.zh: 派对之后，小报称她是个豪放粗鲁的年轻女子。

e.en: The character rejects the old {ladette} stereotype.
e.zh: 这个角色拒绝那种旧式豪放女刻板印象。

ladied.t: 有女士陪伴的；女士化的

e.en: The once rough tavern was now {ladied} by polite guests.
e.zh: 这家曾经粗野的酒馆如今有礼貌的女士客人不少。

e.en: His speech sounded strangely {ladied} and careful.
e.zh: 他的讲话听起来异常文雅而谨慎，像被女士化了一样。

e.en: The queen entered with two {ladies-in-waiting}.
e.zh: 女王在两名宫廷女官陪同下入场。

e.en: Her {ladies-in-waiting} managed letters and formal visits.
e.zh: 她的侍女们负责处理信件和正式拜访。

e.en: The school tried to make the girls more {ladified}.
e.zh: 学校试图把女孩们塑造成更像淑女的样子。

e.en: Her rough manners were never fully {ladified}.
e.zh: 她粗率的举止从未完全被改造成淑女派头。

e.en: Her aunt wanted to {ladify} the rebellious teenager.
e.zh: 她姑妈想把这个叛逆少女调教得像淑女。

e.en: The editor tried to {ladify} the hero's blunt dialogue.
e.zh: 编辑试图把男主角直白的台词改得更文雅。

e.en: The chemist marked the sample as {laevo}.
e.zh: 化学家把这个样品标为左旋。

e.en: Older texts sometimes use {laevo} before compound names.
e.zh: 旧文献有时在化合物名称前使用laevo表示左旋。

e.en: The paper compared dextroglucose with {laevoglucose}.
e.zh: 这篇论文比较了右旋葡萄糖和左旋葡萄糖。

e.en: Pure {laevoglucose} is rarely discussed outside chemistry.
e.zh: 纯左旋葡萄糖很少在化学以外的场合被讨论。

e.en: The solution was described as {laevogyrate} in the report.
e.zh: 报告中把这种溶液描述为左旋。

e.en: A {laevogyrate} substance turns polarized light to the left.
e.zh: 左旋物质会使偏振光向左旋转。

e.en: Only the {laevoisomer} showed the expected biological effect.
e.zh: 只有左旋异构体表现出预期的生物效应。

e.en: The drug's {laevoisomer} may behave differently in the body.
e.zh: 这种药物的左旋异构体在体内可能表现不同。

e.en: The sample proved to be {laevorotary} under polarized light.
e.zh: 在偏振光下，样品被证明是左旋的。

e.en: A {laevorotary} compound rotates the light beam leftward.
e.zh: 左旋化合物会使光束向左旋转。

e.en: The instrument measured strong {laevorotation} in the liquid.
e.zh: 仪器测出这种液体有明显的左旋性。

e.en: Temperature can change the observed {laevorotation} slightly.
e.zh: 温度会使观测到的左旋程度略有变化。

e.en: The molecule is {laevorotatory} in this solvent.
e.zh: 这种分子在该溶剂中具有左旋性。

e.en: They separated the {laevorotatory} form from the mixture.
e.zh: 他们从混合物中分离出了左旋形式。

e.en: The old formula listed {laevulin} among the sugars.
e.zh: 旧配方把左旋糖列在糖类成分中。

e.en: Some nineteenth-century chemists used {laevulin} for fructose.
e.zh: 一些十九世纪化学家用laevulin指果糖。

e.en: Older textbooks often call fructose {laevulose}.
e.zh: 旧教科书常把果糖称为左旋糖。

e.en: The syrup contained a high proportion of {laevulose}.
e.zh: 这种糖浆含有很高比例的果糖。

e.en: He {laffed} at the silly joke.
e.zh: 他听到那个傻笑话后大笑起来。

e.en: The comic spelling {laffed} made the dialogue sound rough.
e.zh: laffed这种滑稽拼法让对白显得粗俗随意。

e.en: The movie still gets big {laffs} from children.
e.zh: 这部电影仍能让孩子们笑声不断。

e.en: He writes cheap {laffs} for late-night comedy shows.
e.zh: 他为深夜喜剧节目写廉价笑料。

lag-lead.t: 滞后超前的；滞后超前校正

e.en: The engineer designed a {lag-lead} compensator for the motor.
e.zh: 工程师为电机设计了滞后超前补偿器。

e.en: A {lag-lead} network can improve control-system stability.
e.zh: 滞后超前网络可以改善控制系统的稳定性。

e.en: The anatomist identified the {lagena} in the specimen.
e.zh: 解剖学家在标本中辨认出了内耳壶腹。

e.en: In many fish, the {lagena} helps with balance and hearing.
e.zh: 在许多鱼类中，内耳壶腹有助于平衡和听觉。

e.en: The {Ladinos} preserved old songs in their community.
e.zh: 拉迪诺人在自己的社区里保留了古老的歌曲。

e.en: The frontier traders called themselves {ladinos}.
e.zh: 边境商人自称是懂世故的拉迪诺人。

e.en: The villagers feared the {ladrone} in the hills.
e.zh: 村民害怕山里的强盗。

e.en: Old maps warned sailors about {ladrones} near the coast.
e.zh: 旧地图提醒水手提防海岸附近的海盗。

e.en: She added sliced {lady's-finger} to the curry.
e.zh: 她把切好的秋葵加进咖喱里。

e.en: The dessert used {lady's-fingers} soaked in coffee.
e.zh: 这道甜点用了浸过咖啡的手指饼干。

e.en: Her {lady's-maid} arranged the silk gown carefully.
e.zh: 她的贴身女仆仔细整理那件丝绸礼服。

e.en: The novel follows a {lady's-maid} in a great house.
e.zh: 这部小说讲述一位大宅贵妇贴身女仆的生活。

e.en: Pink {lady's-smock} grew beside the wet meadow.
e.zh: 粉色的白花碎米荠长在潮湿草地旁。

e.en: The botanist pointed out {lady's-smock} near the stream.
e.zh: 植物学家指出溪边的白花碎米荠。

e.en: He brought a {lady-friend} to the dinner.
e.zh: 他带了一位女性朋友来吃晚饭。

e.en: The phrase {lady-friend} now sounds rather old-fashioned.
e.zh: “女性朋友”这个说法现在听起来相当老派。

e.en: A {lady-in-waiting} stood beside the queen.
e.zh: 一名宫廷女侍站在女王身旁。

e.en: The diary belonged to a former {lady-in-waiting}.
e.zh: 这本日记属于一位前宫廷侍女。

e.en: Everyone joked that Mark was a {lady-killer}.
e.zh: 大家都开玩笑说马克是个很会迷倒女人的男人。

e.en: The actor played a smooth {lady-killer} in the film.
e.zh: 那位演员在电影里饰演一个风流迷人的男子。

e.en: Those young {lady-killers} filled the dance hall.
e.zh: 那些迷人的年轻男子挤满了舞厅。

e.en: The magazine called them Hollywood {lady-killers}.
e.zh: 那本杂志称他们为好莱坞的万人迷男子。

e.en: The article discussed the word {ladyboy} carefully.
e.zh: 那篇文章谨慎地讨论了“人妖”这个词。

e.en: Some performers were billed as {ladyboys} for tourists.
e.zh: 有些表演者被面向游客宣传为泰国人妖。

e.en: His rough manners were suddenly {ladyfied} at dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐时，他粗鲁的举止突然变得像装出的淑女派头。

e.en: The costume made the comic character look {ladyfied}.
e.zh: 这套服装让那个喜剧角色显得女性化。

e.en: Dip each {ladyfinger} quickly into the espresso.
e.zh: 把每根手指饼干快速蘸一下浓缩咖啡。

e.en: In some countries, {ladyfinger} means okra.
e.zh: 在一些国家，ladyfinger 指的是秋葵。

e.en: A silver {ladyfish} leapt from the shallow water.
e.zh: 一条银色海鲢从浅水中跃起。

e.en: Anglers often release {ladyfish} after catching them.
e.zh: 钓鱼者抓到海鲢后常常把它们放生。

e.en: The tutor tried to {ladyfy} the unruly heiress.
e.zh: 家庭教师试图把那位不守规矩的女继承人培养得像淑女。

e.en: The comedy used clothes to {ladyfy} the character.
e.zh: 这出喜剧用服装让角色显得女性化。

e.en: She rejected narrow ideas of {ladyhood}.
e.zh: 她拒绝关于淑女身份的狭隘观念。

e.en: The memoir describes her passage into {ladyhood}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录描写她逐渐进入女性成人阶段的经历。

e.en: His {ladyish} manners amused the guests.
e.zh: 他那种像淑女般的举止逗乐了客人。

e.en: She disliked the {ladyish} softness expected of her.
e.zh: 她不喜欢别人期待她表现出的那种矫作柔弱。

e.en: The singer's smile made him a {ladykiller}.
e.zh: 那位歌手的笑容让他成了迷倒女人的男人。

e.en: He played the old {ladykiller} with comic charm.
e.zh: 他把那个老派万人迷演得幽默又迷人。

e.en: Come here, my little {ladykin}, said the nurse.
e.zh: “过来，我的小淑女，”保姆说道。

e.en: The archaic word {ladykin} sounds playful today.
e.zh: ladykin 这个古词如今听起来带着玩笑意味。

e.en: The knight wrote poems to his {ladylove}.
e.zh: 那位骑士给他心爱的女子写诗。

e.en: He called his wife his {ladylove} in old letters.
e.zh: 他在旧信里称妻子为自己的爱人。

e.en: The crystal showed a {laeotropic} rotation under light.
e.zh: 这种晶体在光下显示出向左旋的旋转。

e.en: Chemists described the compound as {laeotropic}.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物描述为左旋性的。

e.en: The bishop approved his {laicization} after years of doubt.
e.zh: 多年疑虑之后，主教批准他还俗。

e.en: The historian studied the {laicization} of church schools.
e.zh: 这位历史学家研究教会学校的世俗化。

laicize.t: 使神职人员还俗；使世俗化

e.en: The church may {laicize} a priest for serious misconduct.
e.zh: 教会可能因严重不当行为让一名神父还俗。

e.en: Reformers hoped to {laicize} education across the country.
e.zh: 改革者希望在全国范围内使教育世俗化。

e.en: The {laicized} priest later became a teacher.
e.zh: 那位还俗的神父后来成了一名教师。

e.en: Many hospitals were {laicized} during the reforms.
e.zh: 改革期间，许多医院被世俗化。

e.en: The ruling {laicizes} clergy who abandon their vows.
e.zh: 这项裁定让放弃誓愿的神职人员还俗。

e.en: The policy {laicizes} several public institutions.
e.zh: 这项政策使若干公共机构世俗化。

e.en: They discussed {laicizing} the former monastery.
e.zh: 他们讨论将那座旧修道院世俗化。

e.en: The court considered {laicizing} the accused priest.
e.zh: 法庭考虑让那名被控神父还俗。

e.en: She has a {laid-back} attitude at work.
e.zh: 她在工作中态度很随和。

e.en: The island felt quiet and {laid-back}.
e.zh: 这座岛给人的感觉安静又悠闲。

e.en: Hundreds of workers were {laid-off} last month.
e.zh: 上个月有数百名工人被裁员。

e.en: A {laid-off} engineer started her own company.
e.zh: 一名被裁的工程师创办了自己的公司。

e.en: The cottage stood on {laigh} ground near the burn.
e.zh: 那间小屋坐落在溪边的低洼地上。

e.en: He spoke in a {laigh} voice by the fire.
e.zh: 他在炉火旁低声说话。

e.en: The cattle waited overnight in the {lairage}.
e.zh: 牛群在牲畜暂养栏里过了一夜。

e.en: Inspectors checked the {lairage} for clean water.
e.zh: 检查员查看待宰圈舍是否有干净的水。

e.en: Several {lairages} were added behind the market.
e.zh: 市场后面增设了几个牲畜暂养栏。

e.en: The report criticized overcrowded {lairages} at the port.
e.zh: 报告批评港口的待宰圈舍过度拥挤。

lairy.t: 吵闹张扬的；粗鲁挑衅的

e.en: The crowd grew {lairy} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜过后，人群变得吵闹张扬。

e.en: He wore a {lairy} orange jacket to the meeting.
e.zh: 他穿着一件扎眼的橙色夹克去开会。

e.en: The mayor took a {laisser-faire} approach to business.
e.zh: 市长对商业采取自由放任的做法。

e.en: Her {laisser-faire} parenting gave the children unusual freedom.
e.zh: 她不太干预的育儿方式给了孩子们少见的自由。

e.en: The government defended its {laissez-faire} economic policy.
e.zh: 政府为其自由放任的经济政策辩护。

e.en: His {laissez-faire} style frustrated the new employees.
e.zh: 他不加干预的管理风格让新员工很沮丧。

e.en: The refugee received a {laissez-passer} for the border crossing.
e.zh: 这名难民拿到了一份过境通行证。

e.en: Diplomats used a {laissez-passer} instead of a passport.
e.zh: 外交人员使用临时旅行证件而不是护照。

laitance.t: 混凝土浮浆；乳状沉积物

e.en: Workers removed the {laitance} before applying the coating.
e.zh: 工人在涂覆前清除了混凝土表面的浮浆。

e.en: A thin {laitance} formed on the fresh concrete.
e.zh: 新浇混凝土表面形成了一层薄薄的浮浆。

e.en: The biologist compared the fish {lagenae} under a microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下比较鱼的瓶状内耳器官。

e.en: Ancient writers used {lagenae} for narrow-necked flasks.
e.zh: 古代作者用lagenae指细颈瓶。

e.en: The diagram labels the paired {lagenas} beside the inner ear.
e.zh: 图中标出了内耳旁成对的瓶状器官。

e.en: Several Roman {lagenas} were found in the cellar.
e.zh: 地窖里发现了几只罗马细颈瓶。

e.en: A {lager-lout} shouted abuse outside the pub.
e.zh: 一个喝醉闹事的年轻人在酒吧外大声辱骂。

e.en: The headline blamed {lager-louts} for the broken windows.
e.zh: 标题把窗户被砸归咎于醉酒闹事的年轻人。

e.en: The cooper replaced a cracked {laggin} on the old cask.
e.zh: 箍桶匠更换了旧酒桶上一块裂开的桶板。

e.en: Each {laggin} had to fit tightly against the next.
e.zh: 每块桶板都必须和旁边的板严密贴合。

e.en: The shopkeeper added a ribbon as {lagnappe}.
e.zh: 店主额外送了一条丝带作为小添头。

e.en: Her handwritten note felt like {lagnappe} with the gift.
e.zh: 她的手写便条让这份礼物多了一点额外心意。

e.en: The old medical text used {lagnesis} for sexual desire.
e.zh: 那本旧医学书用lagnesis表示性欲。

e.en: Victorian doctors discussed {lagnesis} in clinical language.
e.zh: 维多利亚时代的医生用临床语言讨论性欲。
