less-than-truckload.t: 零担货运的；不满整车装载的

e.en: We chose {less-than-truckload} shipping for the smaller pallets.
e.zh: 这些较小的托盘我们选择了零担货运。

e.en: A {less-than-truckload} carrier combined our shipment with others.
e.zh: 零担承运商把我们的货和其他货物拼在一起运输。

lesser-known.t: 较不知名的；鲜为人知的

e.en: The guide mentioned several {lesser-known} temples nearby.
e.zh: 导游提到了附近几座较不知名的寺庙。

e.en: She prefers {lesser-known} writers to famous prize winners.
e.zh: 相比著名获奖作家，她更喜欢鲜为人知的作者。

lestobiosis.t: 盗寄生生活；蚁类偷食共生现象

e.en: The paper described {lestobiosis} in a colony of small ants.
e.zh: 论文描述了一群小蚂蚁中的盗寄生生活现象。

e.en: Researchers use {lestobiosis} to explain how the insects steal food.
e.zh: 研究人员用盗寄生生活来解释这些昆虫如何偷取食物。

e.en: The {lestobiotic} ants lived close to a larger colony.
e.zh: 这些盗寄生蚂蚁生活在一个较大蚁群附近。

e.en: A {lestobiotic} relationship lets one species take stored food.
e.zh: 盗寄生关系让一个物种夺取储存的食物。

e.en: The teacher {let-off} the class early because of the storm.
e.zh: 因为暴风雨，老师提前放了全班同学。

e.en: His apology earned him a {let-off} from the judge.
e.zh: 他的道歉让法官对他从轻处理。

e.en: Please {let-out} the dog before dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭前请把狗放出去。

e.en: The tailor {let-out} the waist of my trousers.
e.zh: 裁缝把我裤子的腰围放宽了。

e.en: The rain showed no {let-up} all afternoon.
e.zh: 整个下午雨势都没有减弱。

e.en: There was no {let-up} in the pressure at work.
e.zh: 工作上的压力一直没有缓和。

let-ups.t: 减弱；暂停；松懈的复数形式

e.en: Brief {let-ups} in the fighting allowed civilians to leave.
e.zh: 战斗短暂缓和时，平民得以离开。

e.en: The team could not afford any {let-ups} before the final.
e.zh: 决赛前球队不能有任何松懈。

e.en: Everyone avoided the old {letch} at the party.
e.zh: 聚会上大家都避开那个老色鬼。

e.en: He would {letch} after actresses in every magazine.
e.zh: 他会对每本杂志上的女演员猥琐地垂涎。

e.en: After the fever, she remained {lethargical} for several days.
e.zh: 发烧过后，她好几天都昏昏沉沉。

e.en: The report described a {lethargical} mood in the market.
e.zh: 报告称市场情绪显得无精打采。

e.en: The heavy meal seemed to {lethargize} everyone in the room.
e.zh: 这顿丰盛的饭似乎让屋里所有人都昏昏欲睡。

e.en: Too much routine can {lethargize} a creative team.
e.zh: 过多例行事务会让创意团队变得迟钝无力。

lethargized.t: 被弄得昏睡的；变得迟钝无力的

e.en: The patients were {lethargized} by the strong medication.
e.zh: 病人被强效药物弄得昏昏欲睡。

e.en: Years of delay had {lethargized} the committee.
e.zh: 多年的拖延让委员会变得迟钝无力。

lethargizing.t: 使人昏睡的；令人迟钝的

e.en: The lecture had a {lethargizing} effect on the audience.
e.zh: 这场讲座让听众昏昏欲睡。

e.en: They criticized the {lethargizing} routines of the office.
e.zh: 他们批评办公室那些令人迟钝的例行事务。

e.en: He longed for a {lethean} sleep after the tragedy.
e.zh: 悲剧之后，他渴望一场能忘却一切的沉睡。

e.en: The poem imagines a {lethean} river washing memory away.
e.zh: 诗中想象一条遗忘之河冲走记忆。

letheed.t: 被遗忘之水洗去记忆的；忘却的

e.en: In the allegory, the souls were {letheed} before returning to life.
e.zh: 在寓言中，灵魂重返人世前被遗忘之水洗去记忆。

e.en: His {letheed} mind could not recall the old promise.
e.zh: 他忘却的头脑再也想不起那个旧承诺。

e.en: The doctor used {letheomania} to describe his obsession with forgetting.
e.zh: 医生用遗忘狂来描述他对忘却的执念。

e.en: In the novel, {letheomania} becomes a symbol of escape.
e.zh: 在小说中，遗忘狂成了逃避的象征。

e.en: The old text warned of a {lethiferous} poison.
e.zh: 古文献警告说有一种致死毒药。

e.en: They feared the swamp's {lethiferous} vapors at night.
e.zh: 他们害怕沼泽夜间散发的致命瘴气。

lethologica.t: 一时想不起词语的现象

e.en: Her {lethologica} made the actor's name impossible to recall.
e.zh: 她一时想不起词，怎么也记不起那位演员的名字。

e.en: Stress can make {lethologica} happen more often.
e.zh: 压力会让一时想不起词的情况更常发生。

letter-bomb.t: 邮件炸弹；寄信炸弹袭击

e.en: Police intercepted a {letter-bomb} before anyone was hurt.
e.zh: 警方截获了一枚邮件炸弹，避免了人员受伤。

e.en: The activist survived a {letter-bomb} attack in the 1990s.
e.zh: 这名活动人士在二十世纪九十年代的一次邮件炸弹袭击中幸存。

letter-box.t: 信箱；投信口；宽银幕黑边格式

e.en: Drop the form into the {letter-box}.
e.zh: 把表格投进那个信箱里。

e.en: The film was shown in {letter-box} format.
e.zh: 这部电影以带上下黑边的宽银幕格式播放。

e.en: She pushed the envelope through the {letter-drop}.
e.zh: 她把信封从投信口塞了进去。

e.en: The lobby has a secure {letter-drop}.
e.zh: 大厅里有一个安全的信件投递处。

letter-high.t: 字母高度的；只高一个字母的

e.en: The tiny mark was only {letter-high}.
e.zh: 那个小标记只有一个字母那么高。

e.en: Use a {letter-high} guide for the initials.
e.zh: 给首字母使用字母高度的参照线。

e.en: They signed a {letter-of-intent} before negotiating the contract.
e.zh: 他们在谈判合同前签署了一份意向书。

e.en: Her university asked for a {letter-of-intent}.
e.zh: 她申请的大学要求提交一封意向函。

letter-perfect.t: 一字不差的；背得滚瓜烂熟

e.en: His speech was {letter-perfect} at rehearsal.
e.zh: 他在彩排时把演讲背得一字不差。

e.en: The choir gave a {letter-perfect} performance.
e.zh: 合唱团完成了一场几乎毫无差错的演出。

letter-size.t: 信纸尺寸的；美国信纸规格

e.en: Print the document on {letter-size} paper.
e.zh: 请把文件打印在美国信纸尺寸的纸上。

e.en: The folder holds {letter-size} pages easily.
e.zh: 这个文件夹能轻松装下信纸规格的页面。

letter-string.t: 字母串；由字母组成的序列

e.en: The program checks each {letter-string} for errors.
e.zh: 程序会检查每个字母串是否有错误。

e.en: A random {letter-string} appeared on the screen.
e.zh: 屏幕上出现了一串随机字母。

e.en: She was a careful {letter-writer}.
e.zh: 她写信一向很认真。

e.en: The guide teaches a young {letter-writer} polite phrases.
e.zh: 这本指南教年轻写信者使用礼貌用语。

e.en: We practiced {letter-writing} in English class.
e.zh: 我们在英语课上练习写信。

e.en: Formal {letter-writing} requires a clear opening.
e.zh: 正式书信写作需要有清楚的开头。

lettercard.t: 折叠式明信片；简短信卡

e.en: He sent a {lettercard} from the station.
e.zh: 他从车站寄出了一张折叠式明信片。

e.en: The old {lettercard} still carried her handwriting.
e.zh: 那张旧信卡上仍留着她的笔迹。

e.en: The designer adjusted each {letterform} carefully.
e.zh: 设计师仔细调整了每个字母形体。

e.en: A medieval {letterform} inspired the logo.
e.zh: 这个标志的灵感来自一种中世纪字体笔形。

lettergram.t: 电报式信件；字母图案信息

e.en: The museum displayed an old {lettergram}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一份旧式电报信件。

e.en: She arranged a playful {lettergram} for the puzzle.
e.zh: 她为这个谜题设计了一条有趣的字母图案信息。

letterless.t: 没有信件的；没有字母的

e.en: He felt lonely after a {letterless} month abroad.
e.zh: 在国外一个月没有收到信后，他感到很孤单。

e.en: The ancient mark seemed {letterless} but meaningful.
e.zh: 那个古老符号看似没有字母，却很有意义。

lettermen.t: 校队字母奖获得者；运动校队成员

e.en: The school honored its senior {lettermen}.
e.zh: 学校表彰了高年级的校队字母奖获得者。

e.en: Several {lettermen} returned for the reunion game.
e.zh: 几名校队老成员回来参加了重聚比赛。

letterset.t: 字母组合；一套字母；信纸套装

e.en: The font includes a full {letterset}.
e.zh: 这款字体包含完整的一套字母。

e.en: She bought a floral {letterset} for thank-you notes.
e.zh: 她买了一套花纹信纸，用来写感谢信。

e.en: Increase the {letterspacing} in the title.
e.zh: 把标题里的字母间距调大一些。

e.en: Poor {letterspacing} made the sign hard to read.
e.zh: 字距处理不好，让这个标牌很难读。

letterweight.t: 字体笔画粗细；字母重量

e.en: Choose a heavier {letterweight} for the heading.
e.zh: 标题请选择笔画更粗的字体重量。

e.en: The uneven {letterweight} spoiled the logo.
e.zh: 字母笔画粗细不均破坏了这个标志。

letterwood.t: 字母木；用于刻字的木料

e.en: The printer carved initials into {letterwood}.
e.zh: 印刷工把首字母刻进刻字木料里。

e.en: Old workshops stored blocks of {letterwood}.
e.zh: 老作坊里存放着一块块用于刻字的木料。

lettrism.t: 字母主义；重视字母形式的艺术流派

e.en: The essay traces {lettrism} in postwar poetry.
e.zh: 这篇文章追溯了战后诗歌中的字母主义。

e.en: Her posters borrow techniques from {lettrism}.
e.zh: 她的海报借用了字母主义的一些技法。

e.en: The rain showed no {letup} all night.
e.zh: 这场雨整晚都没有减弱。

e.en: There was no {letup} in the pressure.
e.zh: 压力一直没有放松的迹象。

leu.t: 罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦货币单位列伊

e.en: The taxi fare was fifty {leu}.
e.zh: 出租车费是五十列伊。

e.en: One {leu} bought a small loaf then.
e.zh: 那时一列伊能买一个小面包。

leukotine.t: 一种白细胞相关物质或制剂

e.en: The old pharmacology text mentioned {leukotine} only briefly.
e.zh: 那本旧药理学教材只简略提到白细胞相关制剂。

e.en: Researchers once described {leukotine} as affecting white blood cells.
e.zh: 研究人员曾把leukotine描述为会影响白细胞的物质。

e.en: The hospital stopped performing {leukotomy} decades ago.
e.zh: 这家医院几十年前就停止实施脑白质切断术。

e.en: Modern psychiatry views {leukotomy} as a troubling historical procedure.
e.zh: 现代精神医学把脑白质切断术视为令人不安的历史疗法。

e.en: The paper classified the agent as a {leukovirus}.
e.zh: 论文把这种病原体归为白细胞病毒。

e.en: A suspected {leukovirus} was found in the blood sample.
e.zh: 血液样本中发现了一种疑似白细胞病毒。

e.en: The protocol listed {leurocristine} among the chemotherapy drugs.
e.zh: 治疗方案把leurocristine列为化疗药物之一。

e.en: Doctors monitored the patient closely after giving {leurocristine}.
e.zh: 医生在给予leurocristine后密切观察病人。

e.en: The taxi fare was twenty {leva}.
e.zh: 出租车费是二十列弗。

e.en: She exchanged euros for {leva} at the airport.
e.zh: 她在机场把欧元换成了列弗。

e.en: We followed the {levada} through the mountain forest.
e.zh: 我们沿着山林中的引水渠前行。

e.en: The village depends on a narrow {levada} for irrigation.
e.zh: 这个村庄依靠一条狭窄的引水渠灌溉。

e.en: The doctor used {levallorphan} to reverse opioid effects.
e.zh: 医生使用左洛啡烷来逆转阿片类药物的作用。

e.en: Older studies compared {levallorphan} with naloxone.
e.zh: 早期研究曾将左洛啡烷与纳洛酮作比较。

e.en: The veterinarian prescribed {levamisole} for the sheep.
e.zh: 兽医给这些羊开了左旋咪唑驱虫。

e.en: Some illegal cocaine samples contain {levamisole}.
e.zh: 一些非法可卡因样品中含有左旋咪唑。

e.en: Certain bacteria produce {levan} from sucrose.
e.zh: 某些细菌能从蔗糖中产生果聚糖levan。

e.en: The food scientist studied {levan} as a natural thickener.
e.zh: 食品科学家研究levan作为天然增稠剂的用途。

e.en: The enzyme {levansucrase} converts sucrose into levan.
e.zh: 果聚糖蔗糖酶能把蔗糖转化为levan。

e.en: They measured {levansucrase} activity in the bacterial culture.
e.zh: 他们测量了细菌培养物中的果聚糖蔗糖酶活性。

e.en: A strong {levantera} delayed the fishing boats.
e.zh: 一阵强劲的地中海东风耽误了渔船出海。

e.en: Sailors watched the sky for signs of the {levantera}.
e.zh: 水手们观察天空，寻找地中海东风将至的迹象。

e.en: Critics detected a trace of {levantinism} in his manners.
e.zh: 评论者在他的举止中察觉到一丝黎凡特习俗色彩。

e.en: The novel treats {levantinism} with both curiosity and suspicion.
e.zh: 这部小说以好奇又怀疑的态度描写黎凡特风格。

e.en: The nurse prepared {levarterenol} for the emergency infusion.
e.zh: 护士为急救输液准备了去甲肾上腺素。

e.en: Older labels may call norepinephrine {levarterenol}.
e.zh: 较旧的标签可能把去甲肾上腺素称为levarterenol。

e.en: The river broke through the old {leve} after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜后，河水冲破了旧堤坝。

e.en: Workers raised the {leve} before the spring floods.
e.zh: 工人们在春汛前加高了堤岸。

e.en: The car stopped at the {level-crossing} as the barriers fell.
e.zh: 栏杆落下时，汽车停在铁路平交道口前。

e.en: A warning light flashed beside the {level-crossing}.
e.zh: 铁路平交道口旁的警示灯闪了起来。

e.en: She stayed {level-headed} during the crisis.
e.zh: 危机中她始终保持冷静明智。

e.en: We need a {level-headed} manager for this negotiation.
e.zh: 这场谈判需要一位冷静明智的经理。

e.en: The {levelman} checked the slope before construction began.
e.zh: 开工前，测量水准员检查了坡度。

e.en: A careful {levelman} can prevent costly surveying errors.
e.zh: 细心的测量水准员能避免代价高昂的测量错误。

e.en: The surveyor placed a {levelpeg} beside the road.
e.zh: 测量员在路边放置了一根水准标桩。

e.en: Each {levelpeg} marked the planned height of the foundation.
e.zh: 每根水准标桩都标明了地基的设计高度。

e.en: A tiny {leveret} hid in the long grass.
e.zh: 一只小幼野兔躲在高草丛里。

e.en: The farmer found a {leveret} near the hedge.
e.zh: 农夫在树篱旁发现了一只幼野兔。

e.en: Two {leverets} crouched silently under the bushes.
e.zh: 两只幼野兔静静蜷伏在灌木下。

e.en: Mother hares leave their {leverets} hidden for hours.
e.zh: 母野兔会把幼兔藏起来好几个小时。

e.en: The {leverman} changed the points for the incoming train.
e.zh: 扳杆员为进站列车转换了道岔。

e.en: An experienced {leverman} kept the old machinery running.
e.zh: 一名经验丰富的操纵杆工让旧机器继续运转。

leucaemia.t: 白血病，白血症旧拼法或变体

e.en: The old report called the illness {leucaemia}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这种病称为白血病。

e.en: Doctors now usually spell {leucaemia} as leukaemia in Britain.
e.zh: 如今英国医生通常把leucaemia拼作leukaemia。

e.en: The sample contained traces of {leucaenine}.
e.zh: 样品中含有微量银合欢碱。

e.en: Researchers measured {leucaenine} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测定了植物提取物中的银合欢碱。

leucaenol.t: 银合欢酚，一种植物化合物

e.en: Chemists isolated {leucaenol} from the leaves.
e.zh: 化学家从叶片中分离出银合欢酚。

e.en: The paper described {leucaenol} as a minor compound.
e.zh: 论文把银合欢酚描述为一种次要化合物。

leucanaemia.t: 白血病，白血症罕见变体

e.en: The physician used {leucanaemia} in an early case note.
e.zh: 那位医生在早期病历中使用了leucanaemia这个词。

e.en: Modern texts rarely mention {leucanaemia}.
e.zh: 现代文献很少提到leucanaemia这一白血病旧称。

e.en: The diagnosis was recorded as {leucemia}.
e.zh: 诊断被记录为白血病。

e.en: Older American articles sometimes used {leucemia}.
e.zh: 较早的美国文章有时使用leucemia这个拼法。

e.en: The fodder analysis detected {leucenine}.
e.zh: 饲料分析检测到了银合欢碱。

e.en: Excess {leucenine} can affect animal nutrition.
e.zh: 过量银合欢碱可能影响动物营养。

e.en: The textbook listed {leucin} among amino acids.
e.zh: 那本教材把leucin列在氨基酸之中。

e.en: Modern chemistry usually writes {leucin} as leucine.
e.zh: 现代化学通常把leucin写作leucine。

e.en: The reaction produced a small amount of {leucinimide}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了少量亮氨酰亚胺。

e.en: They purified {leucinimide} before testing it.
e.zh: 他们在测试前先纯化了亮氨酰亚胺。

leucinosis.t: 亮氨酸代谢病；枫糖尿病

e.en: The infant was screened for {leucinosis}.
e.zh: 这名婴儿接受了亮氨酸代谢病筛查。

e.en: Untreated {leucinosis} can damage the nervous system.
e.zh: 未经治疗的亮氨酸代谢病会损害神经系统。

leucite.t: 白榴石，一种钾铝硅酸盐矿物

e.en: The volcanic rock contains abundant {leucite}.
e.zh: 这种火山岩含有大量白榴石。

e.en: Mineralogists identified the crystal as {leucite}.
e.zh: 矿物学家确认这种晶体是白榴石。

leucitite.t: 白榴岩，富含白榴石的火成岩

e.en: The quarry exposed a dark band of {leucitite}.
e.zh: 采石场露出了一条深色白榴岩层。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {leucitite} around the volcano.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了火山周围白榴岩的分布图。

leucitoeder.t: 白榴石晶形，旧称白榴面体

e.en: The mineral displayed a clear {leucitoeder}.
e.zh: 这种矿物呈现出清晰的白榴石晶形。

e.en: Old crystallography texts use {leucitoeder} for that form.
e.zh: 旧晶体学文献用leucitoeder表示那种晶形。

leucitohedron.t: 白榴面体，类似白榴石的晶形

e.en: The crystal was described as a {leucitohedron}.
e.zh: 该晶体被描述为白榴面体。

e.en: A {leucitohedron} resembles the common form of leucite.
e.zh: 白榴面体类似白榴石常见的晶形。

leucitophyre.t: 白榴斑岩，含白榴石的斑岩

e.en: The old map labels this unit {leucitophyre}.
e.zh: 旧地图把这个岩体标为白榴斑岩。

e.en: Samples of {leucitophyre} were collected near the crater.
e.zh: 研究人员在火山口附近采集了白榴斑岩样品。

e.en: The assay showed strong {leucoagglutination}.
e.zh: 该检测显示出明显的白细胞凝集现象。

e.en: Researchers observed {leucoagglutination} under the microscope.
e.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察到白细胞凝集。

e.en: The serum contained a potent {leucoagglutinin}.
e.zh: 血清中含有一种强效白细胞凝集素。

e.en: They tested the antibody as a possible {leucoagglutinin}.
e.zh: 他们测试该抗体是否可能是白细胞凝集素。

leucoalizarin.t: 无色茜素，还原态茜素染料

e.en: The dye bath formed {leucoalizarin} during reduction.
e.zh: 染浴在还原过程中形成了无色茜素。

e.en: Oxidation converts {leucoalizarin} back to alizarin.
e.zh: 氧化会把无色茜素转回茜素。

e.en: The reaction mixture contained {leucoaniline}.
e.zh: 反应混合物中含有无色苯胺。

e.en: Oxidizing {leucoaniline} produced a colored compound.
e.zh: 氧化无色苯胺生成了有色化合物。

leucoblast.t: 白细胞母细胞，早期白细胞

e.en: The smear showed an abnormal {leucoblast}.
e.zh: 涂片显示出一个异常白细胞母细胞。

e.en: A {leucoblast} can develop into a mature white cell.
e.zh: 白细胞母细胞可以发育成成熟白细胞。

leucocidin.t: 杀白细胞素，破坏白细胞的毒素

e.en: The bacterium secretes {leucocidin}.
e.zh: 这种细菌会分泌杀白细胞素。

e.en: {Leucocidin} can destroy human white blood cells.
e.zh: 杀白细胞素能破坏人体白细胞。

leucocrate.t: 浅色岩石，浅色矿物占多者

e.en: The sample is a coarse {leucocrate}.
e.zh: 这个样品是一种粗粒浅色岩石。

e.en: Field notes described the intrusion as {leucocrate}.
e.zh: 野外记录把该侵入体描述为浅色岩石。

leucocratic.t: 浅色的，含浅色矿物较多的

e.en: The granite is notably {leucocratic}.
e.zh: 这种花岗岩明显偏浅色。

e.en: A {leucocratic} vein cuts through the darker rock.
e.zh: 一条浅色矿物较多的岩脉切穿了较深色岩石。

leucocyanidin.t: 无色花青素，植物黄烷类化合物

e.en: The seeds contain {leucocyanidin}.
e.zh: 这些种子含有无色花青素。

e.en: Scientists analyzed {leucocyanidin} in the fruit extract.
e.zh: 科学家分析了果实提取物中的无色花青素。

leucocythaemia.t: 白血病；白细胞过多症状

e.en: The old report described the illness as {leucocythaemia}.
e.zh: 那份旧报告把这种病称为白血病。

e.en: Doctors now rarely use {leucocythaemia} in modern notes.
e.zh: 如今医生很少在现代病历中使用leucocythaemia这个旧称。

e.en: The diagnosis was once written as {leucocythemia}.
e.zh: 这个诊断过去曾写作白血病。

e.en: A medical historian explained the term {leucocythemia}.
e.zh: 一位医学史学者解释了leucocythemia这个术语。

e.en: The blood test showed mild {leucocytosis}.
e.zh: 血液检查显示有轻度白细胞增多。

e.en: Infection can cause temporary {leucocytosis} in many patients.
e.zh: 感染可能导致许多患者暂时出现白细胞增多症。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed the pale patches as {leucoderma}.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生诊断这些浅色斑块为白斑病。

e.en: She learned that {leucoderma} can affect visible skin.
e.zh: 她了解到白斑病可能影响外露皮肤。

e.en: The collector labeled the pale mineral {leucogarnet}.
e.zh: 收藏者把这种浅色矿物标为浅色石榴石。

e.en: A small piece of {leucogarnet} lay in the cabinet.
e.zh: 柜子里放着一小块浅色石榴石。

e.en: The chemist tested {leucoline} under bright light.
e.zh: 化学师在强光下测试了白色染料leucoline。

e.en: Old dye manuals mention {leucoline} only briefly.
e.zh: 旧染料手册只简略提到leucoline这种物质。

e.en: The sample showed signs of {leucolysis}.
e.zh: 样本显示出白细胞溶解的迹象。

e.en: Improper storage may lead to {leucolysis} before testing.
e.zh: 保存不当可能在检测前导致白细胞溶解。

e.en: The eye injury left a dense {leucoma}.
e.zh: 眼部损伤留下了一块明显的角膜白斑。

e.en: A surgeon examined the patient's {leucoma} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生仔细检查了患者的角膜白斑。

e.en: Early toxicology texts discussed {leucomaine} formation.
e.zh: 早期毒理学著作讨论过白胺的形成。

e.en: The lecturer called {leucomaine} an obsolete biochemical term.
e.zh: 讲师称leucomaine是一个过时的生化术语。

e.en: The specimen was described as a {leucon}.
e.zh: 这个标本被描述为白色型个体。

e.en: The rare {leucon} stood out among darker forms.
e.zh: 这个罕见的白色型在较深色的类型中很显眼。

e.en: The medication caused severe {leucopenia}.
e.zh: 这种药物导致了严重的白细胞减少症。

e.en: Patients with {leucopenia} need careful monitoring.
e.zh: 白细胞减少症患者需要密切监测。

e.en: The fish skin contains a reflective {leucophore}.
e.zh: 鱼皮中含有一种反光的白色素细胞。

e.en: Researchers studied how a {leucophore} scatters light.
e.zh: 研究人员研究白色素细胞如何散射光线。

e.en: A {leucoplast} stores starch in the plant cell.
e.zh: 白色体在植物细胞中储存淀粉。

e.en: Under the microscope, the {leucoplast} lacked green pigment.
e.zh: 在显微镜下，这个白色体没有绿色色素。

e.en: The textbook used {leucoplastid} for a colorless plastid.
e.zh: 课本用leucoplastid指无色质体。

e.en: Each {leucoplastid} in the root cell stored nutrients.
e.zh: 根细胞中的每个白色体都储存营养物质。

e.en: The marrow disorder reduced normal {leucopoiesis}.
e.zh: 这种骨髓疾病降低了正常白细胞生成。

e.en: Doctors monitored {leucopoiesis} during chemotherapy recovery.
e.zh: 医生在化疗恢复期监测白细胞生成。

e.en: The butterfly wings contain {leucopterin}.
e.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀中含有白蝶呤。

e.en: Chemists isolated {leucopterin} from pale insect scales.
e.zh: 化学家从浅色昆虫鳞片中分离出白蝶呤。

e.en: The vein contained traces of {leucopyrite}.
e.zh: 这条矿脉中含有少量白砷铁矿。

e.en: Miners confused {leucopyrite} with another pale ore.
e.zh: 矿工把白砷铁矿同另一种浅色矿石混淆了。

leucorrhea.t: 白带异常；阴道白色分泌物

e.en: Persistent {leucorrhea} should be discussed with a doctor.
e.zh: 持续的白带异常应向医生咨询。

e.en: The clinic leaflet explained common causes of {leucorrhea}.
e.zh: 诊所传单解释了白带异常的常见原因。

leucorrhoea.t: 白带异常；阴道白色分泌物

e.en: The British report used the spelling {leucorrhoea}.
e.zh: 这份英国报告使用了leucorrhoea这一拼法。

e.en: She sought treatment for recurrent {leucorrhoea}.
e.zh: 她因反复白带异常而就医治疗。

e.en: The veterinarian suspected bovine {leucosis}.
e.zh: 兽医怀疑是牛白血病。

e.en: Older articles sometimes used {leucosis} for leukemia.
e.zh: 较早的文章有时用leucosis表示白血病。

e.en: The reaction produced colorless {leucothionine}.
e.zh: 该反应生成了无色硫堇。

e.en: Oxidation changed {leucothionine} back into a colored dye.
e.zh: 氧化作用把无色硫堇重新变成有色染料。

e.en: The museum displayed an old {leucotome}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件旧式脑白质切断器。

e.en: Surgeons once used a {leucotome} in psychosurgery.
e.zh: 外科医生过去曾在精神外科中使用脑白质切断器。

e.en: The patient underwent {leucotomy} decades ago.
e.zh: 这名患者几十年前接受过脑白质切断术。

e.en: Modern psychiatry regards {leucotomy} as a historical procedure.
e.zh: 现代精神医学把脑白质切断术视为一种历史性手术。

leucovorin.t: 亚叶酸钙；甲酰四氢叶酸

e.en: The oncologist prescribed {leucovorin} after chemotherapy.
e.zh: 肿瘤科医生在化疗后开了亚叶酸钙。

e.en: {Leucovorin} can reduce certain drug toxicities.
e.zh: 亚叶酸钙可以减轻某些药物毒性。

e.en: The enzyme reaction produced a little {leucrose}.
e.zh: 酶反应生成了少量白蔗糖。

e.en: Food chemists measured {leucrose} in the syrup sample.
e.zh: 食品化学家测定了糖浆样品中的白蔗糖。

leverrierite.t: 水铝硅酸盐黏土矿物的一种

e.en: The geologist identified {leverrierite} in the clay sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在黏土样本中鉴定出勒维里埃石。

e.en: Rare {leverrierite} can alter the texture of sedimentary rock.
e.zh: 稀有的勒维里埃石会改变沉积岩的质地。

e.en: The tax is {leviable} on imported goods.
e.zh: 这项税可对进口商品征收。

e.en: Only certain fees are {leviable} under the new law.
e.zh: 根据新法律，只有某些费用可以征收。

e.en: This mineral is {levigable} after soaking in water.
e.zh: 这种矿物浸水后可以研磨成细粉。

e.en: The pharmacist chose a {levigable} clay for the preparation.
e.zh: 药剂师选用一种可细磨的黏土来配制药品。

e.en: They {levigate} the pigment before mixing the paint.
e.zh: 他们先把颜料研磨淘洗，再调制油漆。

e.en: The old recipe says to {levigate} the herbs with water.
e.zh: 这份旧配方要求用水把草药磨成细粉。

e.en: The ointment contains finely {levigated} zinc oxide.
e.zh: 这种软膏含有细磨过的氧化锌。

e.en: The {levigated} clay felt smooth between her fingers.
e.zh: 这种研磨淘洗过的黏土摸起来很细滑。

levigating.t: 正在研磨淘洗；细磨过程

e.en: The technician is {levigating} the powder with alcohol.
e.zh: 技术员正在用酒精研磨淘洗粉末。

e.en: Careful {levigating} removes coarse particles from the mixture.
e.zh: 仔细研磨淘洗能去除混合物中的粗颗粒。

e.en: {Levigation} made the medicinal powder smoother.
e.zh: 研磨淘洗使这种药粉更加细腻。

e.en: The workshop teaches {levigation} of traditional pigments.
e.zh: 这个工坊教授传统颜料的研磨淘洗方法。

e.en: The lab bought a new {levigator} for mineral powders.
e.zh: 实验室买了一台新的矿物粉末研磨淘洗器。

e.en: A skilled {levigator} can produce an even paste.
e.zh: 熟练的研磨者能制出均匀的糊状物。

e.en: The coal sample showed traces of {levigelinite}.
e.zh: 这份煤样显示出少量勒维凝胶质组分。

e.en: Researchers measured {levigelinite} under reflected light.
e.zh: 研究人员在反射光下测量了勒维凝胶质组分。

e.en: The horse ran like a {leviner} across the field.
e.zh: 那匹马像闪电般的东西一样掠过田野。

e.en: Critics called the young sprinter a {leviner}.
e.zh: 评论家把这位年轻短跑选手称作闪电般的人。

e.en: The tribe still practiced {levirate} in some villages.
e.zh: 这个部族在一些村庄仍实行夫兄弟婚。

e.en: Anthropologists studied {levirate} as a kinship custom.
e.zh: 人类学家把娶寡嫂制作为亲属习俗来研究。

leviratic.t: 娶寡嫂制的；夫兄弟婚的

e.en: The story reflects a {leviratic} marriage custom.
e.zh: 这个故事反映了一种夫兄弟婚习俗。

e.en: Scholars debated the {leviratic} duty described in the text.
e.zh: 学者们讨论文本中描述的娶寡嫂义务。

e.en: The passage has a {leviratical} meaning in biblical law.
e.zh: 这段文字在圣经律法中有与娶寡嫂制有关的含义。

e.en: They compared several {leviratical} traditions across cultures.
e.zh: 他们比较了不同文化中几种夫兄弟婚传统。

e.en: The device uses {levitational} force to hold the object.
e.zh: 这个装置利用悬浮力托住物体。

e.en: Her act included a dramatic {levitational} illusion.
e.zh: 她的表演包含一个戏剧性的悬浮幻象。

levitically.t: 按照利未律法地；祭司式地

e.en: The ritual was performed {levitically} by the priests.
e.zh: 这项仪式由祭司按照利未律法执行。

e.en: He interpreted the rule {levitically}, not politically.
e.zh: 他按利未律法的方式解释这条规则，而非从政治角度解释。

e.en: The chemist labeled the compound as {levo}.
e.zh: 化学家把这种化合物标为左旋型。

e.en: In optics, {levo} describes rotation toward the left.
e.zh: 在光学中，levo表示向左旋转。

levodopa.t: 左旋多巴；帕金森病药物

e.en: The doctor prescribed {levodopa} for Parkinson's symptoms.
e.zh: 医生开了左旋多巴来缓解帕金森病症状。

e.en: Long-term {levodopa} treatment may cause side effects.
e.zh: 长期使用左旋多巴治疗可能产生副作用。

levoglucosan.t: 左旋葡聚糖；燃烧标志物

e.en: Scientists measured {levoglucosan} in the smoke particles.
e.zh: 科学家测量了烟雾颗粒中的左旋葡聚糖。

e.en: High {levoglucosan} levels suggest recent biomass burning.
e.zh: 左旋葡聚糖含量高说明近期有生物质燃烧。

e.en: The sample contained a small amount of {levoglucose}.
e.zh: 样品中含有少量左旋葡萄糖。

e.en: Older texts sometimes mention {levoglucose} in sugar chemistry.
e.zh: 较旧的文献有时会在糖化学中提到左旋葡萄糖。

e.en: The chemist noted that the sample was {levogyrate} under polarized light.
e.zh: 化学家注意到样品在偏振光下呈左旋性。

e.en: Certain sugars can {levogyrate} a beam of polarized light.
e.zh: 某些糖能使一束偏振光向左旋转。

e.en: The instrument measured the molecule's {levogyration} precisely.
e.zh: 仪器精确测量了该分子的左旋性。

e.en: Early papers described the {levogyration} of the solution in detail.
e.zh: 早期论文详细描述了这种溶液的左旋现象。

e.en: A {levogyric} compound rotates polarized light to the left.
e.zh: 左旋化合物会使偏振光向左旋转。

e.en: The botanist used {levogyric} to describe the spiral pattern.
e.zh: 植物学家用左旋来描述这种螺旋形态。

e.en: The surgeon described the structure as slightly {levoid}.
e.zh: 外科医生把这个结构描述为略微偏左。

e.en: The old anatomy text used {levoid} for a left-like formation.
e.zh: 那本旧解剖书用levoid表示类似左侧的形态。

e.en: The laboratory tested {levomycin} against several bacterial strains.
e.zh: 实验室测试了左霉素对几种细菌菌株的作用。

e.en: Older medical notes mention {levomycin} as an antibiotic option.
e.zh: 较早的医疗记录把左霉素列为一种抗生素选择。

e.en: The paper discussed {levophacetoperane} as a stimulant compound.
e.zh: 论文把左旋苯乙哌啶作为一种兴奋剂化合物讨论。

e.en: Regulators classified {levophacetoperane} with related psychoactive drugs.
e.zh: 监管机构将左旋苯乙哌啶归入相关精神活性药物。

e.en: The therapist recorded an unusual case of {levophobia}.
e.zh: 治疗师记录了一例罕见的左侧恐惧症。

e.en: His {levophobia} made him avoid sitting on the left side.
e.zh: 他的左侧恐惧让他避免坐在左边。

e.en: A {levorotary} substance turns polarized light leftward.
e.zh: 左旋物质会使偏振光向左偏转。

e.en: The label identified the solution as {levorotary}.
e.zh: 标签标明该溶液具有左旋性。

e.en: The experiment confirmed {levorotation} in the purified sample.
e.zh: 实验确认了纯化样品的左旋性。

e.en: Temperature changes affected the degree of {levorotation}.
e.zh: 温度变化影响了左旋程度。

e.en: The chemist separated the {levorotatory} isomer from the mixture.
e.zh: 化学家从混合物中分离出左旋异构体。

e.en: A {levorotatory} liquid rotates plane-polarized light counterclockwise.
e.zh: 左旋性液体会使平面偏振光逆时针旋转。

e.en: The prescription mentioned {levorphan} as a strong analgesic.
e.zh: 处方中提到左啡诺是一种强效镇痛药。

e.en: Researchers compared {levorphan} with other opioid medications.
e.zh: 研究人员将左啡诺与其他阿片类药物进行比较。

e.en: The chemist isolated {levulin} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学家从植物提取物中分离出果糖苷。

e.en: Older texts sometimes describe {levulin} as related to inulin.
e.zh: 旧文献有时把果糖苷描述为与菊粉相关的物质。

e.en: The synthesis produced {levulinamide} in modest yield.
e.zh: 这次合成以中等收率生成了乙酰丙酰胺。

e.en: They analyzed {levulinamide} with a standard chromatographic method.
e.zh: 他们用标准色谱方法分析乙酰丙酰胺。

e.en: The solution showed clear {levulorotation} during the optical test.
e.zh: 该溶液在光学测试中显示出明显左旋。

e.en: Scientists measured {levulorotation} to identify the sugar sample.
e.zh: 科学家通过测量左旋性来鉴定糖样品。

e.en: The reaction formed yellow crystals of {levulosazone}.
e.zh: 反应生成了黄色的果糖脎晶体。

e.en: Students identified {levulosazone} under the microscope.
e.zh: 学生们在显微镜下鉴定了果糖脎。

e.en: Older chemistry books often call fructose {levulose}.
e.zh: 较早的化学书常把果糖称为levulose。

e.en: The syrup contained glucose and {levulose}.
e.zh: 这种糖浆含有葡萄糖和果糖。

e.en: The physician suspected {levulosemia} after reviewing the blood tests.
e.zh: 医生查看血液检查后怀疑是果糖血症。

e.en: Rare metabolic disorders can include {levulosemia}.
e.zh: 罕见的代谢紊乱可能包括果糖血症。

e.en: The geologist found {levyne} in the volcanic rock sample.
e.zh: 地质学家在火山岩样本中发现了菱沸石。

e.en: Collectors value clear crystals of {levyne}.
e.zh: 收藏者看重透明的菱沸石晶体。

e.en: The play presents him as a foolish {lewdster}.
e.zh: 这部戏把他塑造成一个愚蠢的好色之徒。

e.en: A pamphlet called the scandalous poet a {lewdster}.
e.zh: 一本小册子称那位丑闻缠身的诗人为淫荡之徒。

e.en: Take a {lewie} after the gas station.
e.zh: 过了加油站后向左拐。

e.en: He missed the {lewie} and drove around the block.
e.zh: 他错过了那个左转口，只好绕着街区开。

e.en: The report identified {lewisite} as a blister agent.
e.zh: 报告认定路易氏剂是一种糜烂性毒剂。

e.en: Protective gear is essential when handling {lewisite}.
e.zh: 处理路易氏剂时必须使用防护装备。

e.en: The dictionary treats run as one {lexeme}.
e.zh: 这本词典把run看作一个词位。

e.en: Each {lexeme} may have several word forms.
e.zh: 每个词位可能有好几个词形。

e.en: The study compares {lexemic} patterns across languages.
e.zh: 这项研究比较不同语言的词位模式。

e.en: She marked every {lexemic} difference in the text.
e.zh: 她标出了文本中每处词位差异。

e.en: The corpus revealed a rare {lexic} pattern.
e.zh: 语料库显示出一种少见的词汇模式。

e.en: His notes focus on {lexic} meaning rather than grammar.
e.zh: 他的笔记关注词汇意义，而不是语法。

e.en: Several old {lexica} list this spelling.
e.zh: 几部旧词典都列出了这种拼写。

e.en: The project builds bilingual {lexica} for learners.
e.zh: 这个项目为学习者建立双语词汇表。

e.en: Languages may {lexicalise} the same idea differently.
e.zh: 不同语言可能用不同方式把同一概念词汇化。

e.en: Speakers often {lexicalise} new technologies quickly.
e.zh: 说话者常常很快用词来表达新技术。

e.en: The phrase underwent {lexicalization} over time.
e.zh: 这个短语随着时间逐渐词汇化。

e.en: Researchers traced the {lexicalization} of slang terms.
e.zh: 研究人员追踪了俚语词汇化的过程。

e.en: The expression became {lexicalized} in everyday speech.
e.zh: 这个表达在日常话语中已经词汇化。

e.en: Some gestures are {lexicalized} in sign languages.
e.zh: 有些手势在手语中已成为固定词项。

e.en: Her {lexicographical} work took ten years.
e.zh: 她的词典编纂工作花了十年。

e.en: The team followed strict {lexicographical} principles.
e.zh: 团队遵循严格的词典编纂原则。

e.en: The names are sorted {lexicographically} in the index.
e.zh: 这些名称在索引中按词典顺序排列。

e.en: Compare the strings {lexicographically}, not numerically.
e.zh: 要按词典顺序比较这些字符串，而不是按数值。

e.en: The {lexicographist} checked every citation carefully.
e.zh: 这位词典编纂者仔细核对了每条引文。

e.en: A patient {lexicographist} can spot subtle usage changes.
e.zh: 耐心的词典编纂者能发现细微的用法变化。

e.en: The paper offers a {lexicological} analysis of slang.
e.zh: 这篇论文对俚语作了词汇学分析。

e.en: They discussed {lexicological} evidence in the seminar.
e.zh: 他们在研讨会上讨论了词汇学证据。

e.en: The {lexicologist} studies how words change meaning.
e.zh: 这位词汇学家研究词义如何变化。

e.en: A {lexicologist} may work closely with dictionary editors.
e.zh: 词汇学家可能会与词典编辑密切合作。

e.en: She teaches {lexicology} at the university.
e.zh: 她在大学教授词汇学。

e.en: Modern {lexicology} uses large language corpora.
e.zh: 现代词汇学使用大型语言语料库。

e.en: Editors may {lexiconize} a new technical term.
e.zh: 编辑可能会把一个新的技术术语收入词典。

e.en: Communities often {lexiconize} shared experiences in slang.
e.zh: 社群常用俚语把共同经历词汇化。

e.en: They used a {lexicostatistic} method to compare languages.
e.zh: 他们用词汇统计方法比较语言。

e.en: The {lexicostatistic} results suggested distant relatedness.
e.zh: 词汇统计结果显示它们可能有较远的亲缘关系。

e.en: Each {lexie} was tagged with its grammatical class.
e.zh: 每个词项都标注了语法类别。

e.en: The database stores one {lexie} per entry.
e.zh: 数据库每个条目存放一个词汇单位。

e.en: The ape selected a {lexigram} on the board.
e.zh: 那只猿在板上选了一个词符。

e.en: Each {lexigram} represented a simple object or action.
e.zh: 每个词汇符号代表一个简单物体或动作。

lexigraphic.t: 词汇图式的；词典图表的

e.en: The article includes a {lexigraphic} map of word families.
e.zh: 文章包含一张词族的词汇图式。

e.en: Her {lexigraphic} notation made the entries easier to compare.
e.zh: 她的词典图表标注让各条目更容易比较。

e.en: He studied {lexigraphy} before joining the dictionary project.
e.zh: 他在加入词典项目之前学过词典编纂。

e.en: Digital {lexigraphy} can visualize relationships between words.
e.zh: 数字词汇图示可以呈现词语之间的关系。

e.en: The {libellee} denied publishing the false accusation.
e.zh: 诽谤案中的被告否认发布了那项虚假指控。

e.en: A court may order the {libellee} to answer the complaint.
e.zh: 法院可以命令被控诽谤的一方回应起诉。

e.en: The pamphlet's {libellist} hid behind a false name.
e.zh: 那本小册子的诽谤作者用假名隐藏身份。

e.en: He was branded a {libellist} after the malicious article appeared.
e.zh: 那篇恶意文章发表后，他被指为写诽谤文字的人。

e.en: She chose a {liberal-arts} college in Vermont.
e.zh: 她选择了佛蒙特州的一所文科学院。

e.en: The program gives engineers a strong {liberal-arts} background.
e.zh: 这个项目让工程师具备扎实的通识教育背景。

e.en: He campaigned as a {liberal-democrat} in the local election.
e.zh: 他在地方选举中以自由民主主义者身份竞选。

e.en: A {liberal-democrat} may support both civil rights and market reforms.
e.zh: 自由民主主义者可能同时支持公民权利和市场改革。

e.en: The {liberal-democrats} opposed the emergency powers bill.
e.zh: 自由民主主义者们反对那项紧急权力法案。

e.en: Many {liberal-democrats} favored compromise on tax reform.
e.zh: 许多自由民主主义者赞成在税制改革上妥协。

e.en: Her {liberal-minded} parents encouraged open debate at dinner.
e.zh: 她思想开明的父母鼓励晚餐时自由讨论。

e.en: The school became more {liberal-minded} about student dress.
e.zh: 这所学校在学生着装方面变得更加宽容。

e.en: The old {liberalist} defended freedom of speech passionately.
e.zh: 那位老自由主义者热情地捍卫言论自由。

e.en: As a religious {liberalist}, she rejected strict dogma.
e.zh: 作为宗教上的自由主义者，她反对僵硬的教条。

e.en: His {liberalistic} views irritated the conservative board.
e.zh: 他带有自由主义倾向的观点激怒了保守的董事会。

e.en: The novel has a mildly {liberalistic} tone about social reform.
e.zh: 这部小说在社会改革问题上带有温和的自由主义色彩。

liberaloid.t: 似自由派的人；伪自由派

e.en: The columnist mocked him as a {liberaloid} without principles.
e.zh: 那位专栏作家嘲笑他是没有原则的伪自由派。

e.en: Her speech sounded {liberaloid} but avoided any real reform.
e.zh: 她的演讲听起来像自由派，却避开了任何真正的改革。

e.en: His essays link feminism with broader {liberationism}.
e.zh: 他的文章把女权主义同更广泛的解放主义联系起来。

e.en: The movement's {liberationism} challenged both church and state.
e.zh: 这场运动的解放论同时挑战了教会和国家。

e.en: Writing became a {liberative} practice for the prisoners.
e.zh: 写作成了囚犯们一种具有解放意义的实践。

e.en: The therapy felt {liberative} after years of silence.
e.zh: 多年沉默之后，这种治疗让人感到获得释放。

e.en: His version of {libertarism} rejects most state control.
e.zh: 他所主张的自由意志主义反对大多数国家管制。

e.en: The lecture compared socialism, liberalism, and {libertarism}.
e.zh: 那场讲座比较了社会主义、自由主义和自由意志主义。

e.en: Critics called the surveillance law {liberticidal}.
e.zh: 批评者称那部监控法律是在扼杀自由。

e.en: A {liberticidal} regime fears independent newspapers.
e.zh: 扼杀自由的政权害怕独立报纸。

e.en: The decree was condemned as an act of {liberticide}.
e.zh: 这项法令被谴责为扼杀自由的行为。

e.en: The tyrant entered history as a {liberticide}.
e.zh: 这个暴君以毁灭自由者的形象载入史册。

e.en: The memoir describes years of Parisian {libertinage}.
e.zh: 这本回忆录描写了多年巴黎式的放荡生活。

e.en: Moralists blamed the court's {libertinage} for the scandal.
e.zh: 道德家把这场丑闻归咎于宫廷的纵欲风气。

e.en: The preacher denounced {libertinism} from the pulpit.
e.zh: 牧师在讲坛上谴责放荡主义。

e.en: Some Enlightenment writers explored {libertinism} as intellectual rebellion.
e.zh: 一些启蒙时代作家把纵欲观念作为思想反叛来探讨。

e.en: The former slave became a {libertyman} after the war.
e.zh: 战争结束后，那名曾经的奴隶成了自由民。

e.en: Records list him as a {libertyman} working near the harbor.
e.zh: 记录把他列为在港口附近工作的获释自由民。

e.en: The child wrote {librarain} instead of librarian.
e.zh: 那个孩子把“图书管理员”这个词误写成了librarain。

e.en: The teacher corrected {librarain} in the spelling test.
e.zh: 老师在拼写测验中纠正了librarain这个错拼。

librate.t: 轻微摆动；天平保持平衡

e.en: The suspended lamp seemed to {librate} in the breeze.
e.zh: 悬挂的灯似乎在微风中轻轻摆动。

e.en: The scale would {librate} before settling at zero.
e.zh: 天平会先摆动一下，然后稳定在零点。

librated.t: 轻微摆动过；保持平衡的

e.en: The moon {librated} enough to reveal more of its edge.
e.zh: 月球发生了足够的天平动，露出了更多边缘。

e.en: The needle {librated} gently before it came to rest.
e.zh: 指针在静止前轻轻摆动了一下。

e.en: The Moon {librates} as seen from Earth.
e.zh: 从地球上看，月球会发生天平动。

e.en: The hanging sign {librates} whenever the door slams.
e.zh: 门一摔上，悬挂的招牌就会轻微摆动。

librating.t: 轻微摆动的；作天平动的

e.en: The {librating} needle made the reading uncertain.
e.zh: 不断轻微摆动的指针让读数变得不确定。

e.en: Astronomers modeled the {librating} motion of the Moon.
e.zh: 天文学家模拟了月球的天平动运动。

e.en: The paper analyzed the Moon's {librational} motion.
e.zh: 论文分析了月球的天平动运动。

e.en: Small {librational} errors affected the instrument's accuracy.
e.zh: 细微的摆动误差影响了仪器的精度。

libratory.t: 像书本的；图书馆的；关于图书的

e.en: The archive used a {libratory} system to classify rare pamphlets.
e.zh: 档案馆采用一种图书馆式的系统来分类稀有小册子。

e.en: His essay has a dry, almost {libratory} tone.
e.zh: 他的文章语气干涩，几乎像图书馆资料一样。

e.en: The composer kept several old {libretti} on his desk.
e.zh: 作曲家把几本旧歌剧脚本放在书桌上。

e.en: Modern {libretti} often use plain, direct language.
e.zh: 现代歌剧脚本常使用朴素直接的语言。

e.en: The artist made a {libriform} sculpture from folded paper.
e.zh: 艺术家用折纸做了一件书状雕塑。

e.en: Botanists described the layered structure as {libriform}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种分层结构描述为像书本一样。

e.en: The debate concerned the {liceity} of the proposed action.
e.zh: 这场辩论涉及拟议行动的合法性。

e.en: Medieval writers discussed the {liceity} of lending money for profit.
e.zh: 中世纪作者讨论过放贷牟利是否合乎许可。

e.en: In the old poem, the {lich} was carried to the churchyard.
e.zh: 在那首古诗里，尸体被抬到教堂墓地。

e.en: The game casts the {lich} as an undead sorcerer.
e.zh: 这款游戏把巫妖设定为不死的术士。

e.en: They waited under the {lich-gate} during the rain.
e.zh: 下雨时，他们在墓地入口的有顶门廊下等候。

e.en: The old {lich-gate} still marks the churchyard entrance.
e.zh: 那座古老的墓园门廊仍标示着教堂墓地的入口。

e.en: She added fresh {lichee} to the fruit salad.
e.zh: 她把新鲜荔枝加进水果沙拉里。

e.en: The dessert had a light {lichee} fragrance.
e.zh: 这道甜点有淡淡的荔枝香味。

e.en: The dermatologist diagnosed the rash as {licheniasis}.
e.zh: 皮肤科医生把这片皮疹诊断为苔藓样皮肤病。

e.en: Older medical texts used {licheniasis} for several rough skin eruptions.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献用苔藓样皮肤病指几种粗糙皮疹。

e.en: The paper describes a rare {lichenicole} found in alpine forests.
e.zh: 论文描述了一种在高山森林中发现的罕见地衣寄生生物。

e.en: A {lichenicole} may depend entirely on one host lichen.
e.zh: 一种地衣寄生生物可能完全依赖某种宿主地衣。

e.en: Repeated scratching caused severe {lichenification} on her arm.
e.zh: 反复抓挠导致她手臂皮肤严重苔藓样增厚。

e.en: The doctor noted {lichenification} around the chronic eczema.
e.zh: 医生注意到慢性湿疹周围出现皮肤苔藓样增厚。

licheniformin.t: 地衣菌素；芽孢杆菌抗菌肽

e.en: Researchers tested {licheniformin} against resistant bacterial strains.
e.zh: 研究人员测试了地衣菌素对耐药菌株的作用。

e.en: The peptide {licheniformin} is produced by certain Bacillus bacteria.
e.zh: 这种名为地衣菌素的肽由某些芽孢杆菌产生。

e.en: Some lichens contain {lichenin} as a storage carbohydrate.
e.zh: 一些地衣含有地衣淀粉作为储存性碳水化合物。

e.en: The chemist isolated {lichenin} from dried Iceland moss.
e.zh: 化学家从干燥的冰岛苔中分离出地衣多糖。

e.en: Some fungi {lichenize} only with specific algae.
e.zh: 有些真菌只与特定藻类形成地衣共生体。

e.en: The spores may {lichenize} after finding a suitable partner.
e.zh: 孢子找到合适伙伴后可能形成地衣共生体。

lichenol.t: 地衣醇；地衣相关化合物

e.en: The extract contained traces of {lichenol}.
e.zh: 提取物中含有微量地衣醇。

e.en: Older chemistry notes mention {lichenol} among lichen substances.
e.zh: 较早的化学笔记把地衣醇列为地衣物质之一。

e.en: The museum keeps an important {lichenological} collection.
e.zh: 博物馆保存着一批重要的地衣学藏品。

e.en: Her {lichenological} research focuses on polluted urban walls.
e.zh: 她的地衣学研究关注受污染的城市墙面。

e.en: A {lichenologist} identified the species on the old oak.
e.zh: 一位地衣学家鉴定了老橡树上的物种。

e.en: The {lichenologist} spent years mapping mountain lichens.
e.zh: 这位地衣学家花了多年绘制山区地衣分布图。

e.en: She studied {lichenology} before joining the ecology lab.
e.zh: 她加入生态实验室前研究过地衣学。

e.en: Modern {lichenology} combines taxonomy, chemistry, and climate science.
e.zh: 现代地衣学结合了分类学、化学和气候科学。

e.en: The team used {lichenometric} evidence to date the rockfall.
e.zh: 团队用地衣测年证据来确定岩崩年代。

e.en: A {lichenometric} survey can estimate when a surface was exposed.
e.zh: 地衣测年调查可以估算表面暴露的时间。

e.en: They applied {lichenometry} to study the glacier's retreat.
e.zh: 他们用地衣测年法研究冰川退缩。

e.en: {Lichenometry} works best where lichen growth rates are known.
e.zh: 在已知地衣生长速率的地方，地衣测年法效果最好。

e.en: A {lichenous} crust covered the damp stone wall.
e.zh: 潮湿的石墙上覆盖着一层似地衣的硬壳。

e.en: The path led past {lichenous} rocks and twisted roots.
e.zh: 小路经过长满地衣的岩石和盘曲的树根。

e.en: The old specimen contained traces of {lichenstarch}.
e.zh: 那件旧标本含有少量地衣淀粉。

e.en: Chemists once classified {lichenstarch} as a plant carbohydrate.
e.zh: 化学家曾把地衣淀粉归为植物碳水化合物。

e.en: They paused beneath the {lichgate} before entering the churchyard.
e.zh: 他们进墓园前在有顶门廊下停了停。

e.en: The village {lichgate} was repaired with oak beams.
e.zh: 村里的墓园门廊用橡木梁修好了。

e.en: She peeled a fresh {lichi} after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后她剥了一颗新鲜荔枝。

e.en: The dessert was flavored with {lichi} syrup.
e.zh: 这道甜点用了荔枝糖浆调味。

e.en: The botanist described the sample as {licigen}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这个样本描述为产地衣酸的。

e.en: A {licigen} fungus may alter the surrounding bark.
e.zh: 产地衣酸的真菌可能改变周围树皮。

e.en: The child gave the cake a {lickerish} stare.
e.zh: 那孩子贪嘴地盯着蛋糕看。

e.en: His {lickerish} remarks made everyone uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他那些好色的话让大家都不舒服。

e.en: She looked {lickerishly} at the tray of pastries.
e.zh: 她贪嘴地看着那盘点心。

e.en: He smiled {lickerishly} during the awkward conversation.
e.zh: 在那场尴尬的谈话中，他好色地笑了笑。

e.en: His {lickerishness} was obvious at the banquet.
e.zh: 在宴会上，他的贪嘴显而易见。

e.en: The novel treats {lickerishness} as a moral weakness.
e.zh: 这部小说把好色写成一种道德弱点。

e.en: The kids ran {lickety-split} down the hill.
e.zh: 孩子们飞快地跑下山坡。

e.en: Finish this report {lickety-split}, please.
e.zh: 请马上把这份报告做完。

e.en: Nobody trusted the mayor's newest {lickspit}.
e.zh: 没人信任市长身边新来的那个马屁精。

e.en: He acted like a {lickspit} whenever the boss arrived.
e.zh: 老板一来，他就表现得像个拍马屁的人。

e.en: The minister surrounded himself with {lickspittle} advisers.
e.zh: 部长身边围着一群谄媚的顾问。

e.en: She refused to become a {lickspittle} for promotion.
e.zh: 她不愿为了升职变成马屁精。

e.en: The paper measured {licopersicin} in tomato leaves.
e.zh: 论文测定了番茄叶中的番茄碱类物质。

e.en: Researchers studied whether {licopersicin} affects insects.
e.zh: 研究人员考察番茄碱类物质是否会影响昆虫。

e.en: A {lictor} walked before the Roman magistrate.
e.zh: 一名古罗马执杖侍从走在长官前面。

e.en: The painting shows a {lictor} carrying the fasces.
e.zh: 这幅画描绘了一名执杖侍从扛着束棒。

e.en: The old farmer scolded every {lie-abed} in the house.
e.zh: 老农夫责骂屋里每个赖床的人。

e.en: He was no {lie-abed} when work was waiting.
e.zh: 有活儿等着时，他绝不是赖床的人。

e.en: The suspect agreed to a {lie-detector} test.
e.zh: 嫌疑人同意接受测谎仪测试。

e.en: A {lie-detector} cannot prove every statement false.
e.zh: 测谎仪不能证明每句话都是假的。

e.en: I need a short {lie-down} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后我需要躺下休息一会儿。

e.en: She had a {lie-down} before the evening shift.
e.zh: 上晚班前她躺下休息了一会儿。

e.en: We enjoyed a long {lie-in} on Sunday.
e.zh: 星期天我们痛快地睡了个懒觉。

e.en: Students staged a {lie-in} outside the office.
e.zh: 学生们在办公室外举行静卧抗议。

e.en: Grandmother called him a lazy {lieabed}.
e.zh: 祖母说他是个懒惰的赖床鬼。

e.en: No {lieabed} survived long in that strict household.
e.zh: 在那个严厉的家庭里，赖床的人待不长。

e.en: I would as {lief} stay at home tonight.

e.zh: 研究人员比较了同一通路中的几种连接酶。

e.en: The knight owed {ligeance} to his lord.
e.zh: 那名骑士向自己的领主效忠。

e.en: Old law treated {ligeance} as a serious obligation.
e.zh: 旧法律把臣属效忠视为严肃义务。

liger.t: 狮虎兽；雄狮雌虎杂交种

e.en: A {liger} is born from a lion and a tiger.
e.zh: 狮虎兽是由狮子和老虎杂交产生的。

e.en: The zoo displayed a large {liger} for visitors.
e.zh: 动物园向游客展示了一只体型很大的狮虎兽。

e.en: The coating contains {light-absorbing} particles.
e.zh: 这种涂层含有能吸收光线的颗粒。

e.en: Plants use {light-absorbing} pigments during photosynthesis.
e.zh: 植物在光合作用中使用吸光色素。

e.en: The eye becomes {light-adapted} in bright conditions.
e.zh: 眼睛在明亮环境中会进入明适应状态。

e.en: Scientists tested {light-adapted} cells under the microscope.
e.zh: 科学家在显微镜下测试了适应光照的细胞。

e.en: A {light-armed} patrol moved quickly through the valley.
e.zh: 一支轻武装巡逻队快速穿过山谷。

e.en: The commander preferred {light-armed} troops for scouting.
e.zh: 指挥官更愿意派轻装部队去侦察。

e.en: She wore a {light-blue} jacket to school.
e.zh: 她穿着一件浅蓝色夹克去学校。

e.en: The map marks rivers in {light-blue}.
e.zh: 这张地图用淡蓝色标出河流。

e.en: Choose {light-colored} curtains for a brighter room.
e.zh: 选择浅色窗帘会让房间更明亮。

e.en: He wore {light-colored} clothes in the summer heat.
e.zh: 炎热夏天里他穿着颜色较淡的衣服。

light-curve.t: 光变曲线；亮度变化曲线

e.en: Astronomers studied the star's {light-curve} for months.
e.zh: 天文学家研究了这颗恒星数月的光变曲线。

e.en: The planet was detected from a tiny dip in the {light-curve}.
e.zh: 这颗行星是通过光变曲线中的微小下降发现的。

e.en: This {light-duty} truck is useful for small deliveries.
e.zh: 这辆轻型卡车适合小规模送货。

e.en: The worker returned on {light-duty} tasks after surgery.
e.zh: 手术后这名工人回来做轻负荷工作。

e.en: A {light-emittingdiode} converts electricity into visible light.
e.zh: 发光二极管能把电能转化为可见光。

e.en: The display uses a small {light-emittingdiode} as an indicator.
e.zh: 这个显示器用一个小发光二极管作指示灯。

e.en: The artist chose {light-fast} pigments for the mural.
e.zh: 艺术家为壁画选择了耐光颜料。

e.en: This fabric is more {light-fast} than the cheaper one.
e.zh: 这种布料比便宜的那种更不易褪色。

light-fingered.t: 手脚不干净的；善偷窃的

e.en: The hotel warned guests about {light-fingered} pickpockets.
e.zh: 酒店提醒客人小心手脚不干净的扒手。

e.en: His {light-fingered} habits soon got him arrested.
e.zh: 他爱偷东西的习惯很快让他被捕。

e.en: Her {light-fingeredness} caused trouble in every shop.
e.zh: 她手脚不干净，在每家店都惹出麻烦。

e.en: The novel treats {light-fingeredness} with dark humor.
e.zh: 这部小说用黑色幽默描写小偷小摸。

e.en: The {light-flyweight} won by a narrow decision.
e.zh: 这名次蝇量级拳击手以微弱点数获胜。

e.en: She trained as a {light-flyweight} for the tournament.
e.zh: 她以次蝇量级选手身份备战锦标赛。

e.en: The {light-footed} dancer crossed the stage silently.
e.zh: 那位脚步轻盈的舞者无声地穿过舞台。

e.en: A {light-footed} thief slipped past the guards.
e.zh: 一个身手敏捷的小偷溜过了守卫。

light-handed.t: 手法轻柔的；处理宽和的

e.en: Use a {light-handed} touch when seasoning the fish.
e.zh: 给鱼调味时下手要轻一些。

e.en: The editor took a {light-handed} approach to the essay.
e.zh: 编辑对这篇文章采取了温和克制的处理方式。

e.en: She painted the shadows {light-handedly}.
e.zh: 她轻柔地描绘了阴影部分。

e.en: The judge dealt {light-handedly} with the first offender.
e.zh: 法官对初犯者处理得较为宽和。

e.en: Her {light-handedness} kept the sauce from tasting heavy.
e.zh: 她下手轻巧，所以酱汁尝起来不厚重。

e.en: The policy showed unusual {light-handedness} for the agency.
e.zh: 这项政策显示出该机构少见的宽和克制。

e.en: I felt {light-headed} after standing up too quickly.
e.zh: 我起身太快后感到头晕。

e.en: His {light-headed} comments made the meeting awkward.
e.zh: 他轻率的评论让会议气氛变得尴尬。

light-hearted.t: 轻松愉快的；无忧无虑的

e.en: We watched a {light-hearted} film after dinner.
e.zh: 晚饭后我们看了一部轻松愉快的电影。

e.en: Her {light-hearted} reply eased the tension.
e.zh: 她轻松的回答缓和了紧张气氛。

e.en: He spoke {light-heartedly} about his old mistakes.
e.zh: 他轻松地谈起自己过去的错误。

e.en: She laughed {light-heartedly} at the small delay.
e.zh: 她对这点小耽搁不以为意地笑了。

light-heavyweight.t: 轻重量级拳手；轻重量级的

e.en: The {light-heavyweight} won the title in June.
e.zh: 那名轻重量级拳手在六月赢得了冠军。

e.en: He moved into the {light-heavyweight} division last year.
e.zh: 他去年转入了轻重量级别。

e.en: Two {light-heavyweights} will fight for the vacant belt.
e.zh: 两名轻重量级拳手将争夺空缺的金腰带。

e.en: The gym trains several promising {light-heavyweights}.
e.zh: 这家拳馆训练着几名有前途的轻重量级选手。

e.en: The {light-heeled} messenger reached the town by dusk.
e.zh: 那个脚步轻快的信使在黄昏前赶到了城里。

e.en: A {light-heeled} runner soon overtook the others.
e.zh: 一名跑得很快的选手很快超过了其他人。

e.en: A {light-horseman} rode ahead to scout the road.
e.zh: 一名轻骑兵骑在前面侦察道路。

e.en: The old painting shows a {light-horseman} with a curved sword.
e.zh: 那幅旧画中有一名佩弯刀的轻装骑手。

light-middleweight.t: 轻中量级拳手；轻中量级的

e.en: The {light-middleweight} defended his title in London.
e.zh: 那名轻中量级拳手在伦敦卫冕成功。

e.en: She entered the {light-middleweight} class this season.
e.zh: 她本赛季参加了轻中量级比赛。

e.en: The two {light-middleweights} traded sharp jabs.
e.zh: 两名轻中量级拳手互相打出凌厉的刺拳。

e.en: Several {light-middleweights} are chasing a world ranking.
e.zh: 几名轻中量级选手正在争取世界排名。

e.en: His {light-minded} attitude annoyed the committee.
e.zh: 他轻浮的态度惹恼了委员会。

e.en: The novel mocks a {light-minded} society obsessed with fashion.
e.zh: 这部小说讽刺了一个沉迷时尚、轻浮不严肃的社会。

e.en: He answered {light-mindedly} despite the serious question.
e.zh: 尽管问题很严肃，他还是轻浮地作答。

e.en: They {light-mindedly} dismissed every warning.
e.zh: 他们不严肃地把每个警告都一笑置之。

e.en: Her {light-mindedness} frustrated the careful planner.
e.zh: 她的轻浮让那位谨慎的策划者很沮丧。

e.en: The essay criticizes public {light-mindedness} about war.
e.zh: 这篇文章批评公众对战争的不严肃态度。

e.en: The lab reported a {light-negative} reaction in the sample.
e.zh: 实验室报告样本呈弱阴性反应。

e.en: The old photograph survived only as a {light-negative} plate.
e.zh: 那张老照片只以浅色负片底板的形式保存下来。

e.en: The ballad calls her a {light-o'-love} in the final verse.
e.zh: 那首民谣在最后一节称她为轻佻的情人。

e.en: He used {light-o'-love} as an old insult.
e.zh: 他把“轻佻女子”这个旧词当作辱骂语来用。

e.en: The archaic phrase {light-o-love} appears in the play.
e.zh: 这个古旧短语“轻佻情人”出现在剧中。

e.en: She rejected the label {light-o-love} as cruel gossip.
e.zh: 她拒绝接受“放荡女子”这个恶毒流言标签。

e.en: The pamphlet sneered at her as a {light-of-love}.
e.zh: 那本小册子嘲讽她是个轻佻的情人。

e.en: In older English, {light-of-love} could mean a promiscuous woman.
e.zh: 在较早的英语中，light-of-love 可指放荡女子。

e.en: The fireworks will {light-off} at midnight.
e.zh: 烟花将在午夜点燃升空。

e.en: Check that every {light-off} indicator is working.
e.zh: 检查每个灯灭指示器是否正常工作。

e.en: The test gave a {light-positive} result.
e.zh: 检测结果呈弱阳性。

e.en: The archive keeps a {light-positive} copy of the image.
e.zh: 档案馆保存着这张图像的浅色正片副本。

e.en: Einstein described a {light-quantum} carrying energy.
e.zh: 爱因斯坦描述了携带能量的光量子。

e.en: Each {light-quantum} can eject an electron from the surface.
e.zh: 每个光量子都可能从表面击出一个电子。

e.en: A single {light-ray} entered through the crack.
e.zh: 一道光线从裂缝中射了进来。

e.en: The diagram shows how a {light-ray} bends in water.
e.zh: 这张图展示了光线在水中如何弯折。

e.en: The museum installed a new {light-sculpture} in the atrium.
e.zh: 博物馆在中庭安装了一件新的光雕塑。

e.en: Her {light-sculpture} changes color as visitors move around it.
e.zh: 她的灯光装置艺术会随着观众走动而变色。

e.en: Store the {light-sensitive} film in a dark drawer.
e.zh: 把感光胶片存放在黑暗的抽屉里。

e.en: Some patients are {light-sensitive} after taking this medicine.
e.zh: 有些病人服用这种药后会对光敏感。

e.en: The concert ended with a huge {light-show}.
e.zh: 音乐会以一场大型灯光秀结束。

e.en: They watched a colorful {light-show} over the river.
e.zh: 他们观看了河面上方色彩绚丽的灯光表演。

e.en: The dancers wore {light-skirts} that moved with every step.
e.zh: 舞者穿着轻薄裙子，每一步都会随之摆动。

e.en: In summer, she prefers {light-skirts} and cotton shirts.
e.zh: 夏天她更喜欢浅色裙子和棉衬衫。

light-struck.t: 受光损坏的；被光照变质的

e.en: The wine tasted {light-struck} after sitting near the window.
e.zh: 那瓶酒放在窗边后尝起来有光照变质的味道。

e.en: Photographers discarded the {light-struck} negatives immediately.
e.zh: 摄影师立刻丢弃了受光损坏的底片。

e.en: She found the {light-switch} beside the door.
e.zh: 她在门旁找到了电灯开关。

e.en: Please turn off the {light-switch} before leaving.
e.zh: 离开前请关掉电灯开关。

e.en: Keep the chemicals in a {light-tight} container.
e.zh: 把这些化学品放在不透光的容器里。

e.en: The camera bag must be {light-tight} to protect the film.
e.zh: 相机包必须避光密封，以保护胶片。

e.en: A {light-wave} can travel through empty space.
e.zh: 光波可以穿过真空传播。

e.en: The prism split each {light-wave} into different colors.
e.zh: 棱镜把每道光波分成不同颜色。

e.en: The kitchen receives sun through a narrow {light-well}.
e.zh: 厨房通过一条狭窄的采光井获得阳光。

e.en: Their apartment overlooks the building's central {light-well}.
e.zh: 他们的公寓俯瞰楼房中央的天井。

e.en: A {light-year} measures distance, not time.
e.zh: 光年衡量的是距离，不是时间。

e.en: The star is about one {light-year} away in the story.
e.zh: 故事里那颗恒星大约有一光年远。

e.en: The galaxy is millions of {light-years} from Earth.
e.zh: 那个星系距离地球有数百万光年。

e.en: Their service is {light-years} ahead of the competition.
e.zh: 他们的服务远远领先于竞争对手。

e.en: A {lightboat} marked the dangerous rocks offshore.
e.zh: 一艘灯船标示着近海危险的礁石。

e.en: The old {lightboat} was repaired for the harbor museum.
e.zh: 那艘旧灯标船被修复后送进了港口博物馆。

e.en: The photographer checked the slides on a {lightbox}.
e.zh: 摄影师在灯箱上检查幻灯片。

e.en: The shop installed a bright {lightbox} above the entrance.
e.zh: 商店在入口上方安装了一个明亮的灯箱。

e.en: The {lightbulb} in the hallway burned out.
e.zh: 走廊里的灯泡烧坏了。

e.en: A {lightbulb} moment came during the meeting.
e.zh: 会议中他突然有了灵感。

e.en: This {lightduty} truck is suitable for city deliveries.
e.zh: 这辆轻型卡车适合城市配送。

e.en: The doctor put him on {lightduty} work for two weeks.
e.zh: 医生让他做两周轻负荷工作。

e.en: Balloons rise because helium is {lighter-than-air}.
e.zh: 气球会上升，因为氦气比空气轻。

e.en: The company tested a {lighter-than-air} surveillance craft.
e.zh: 公司测试了一种比空气轻的监视飞行器。

e.en: The port charged extra for {lighterage} during the strike.
e.zh: 罢工期间港口额外收取驳船运输费。

e.en: Old records describe {lighterage} along the crowded river.
e.zh: 旧记录描述了繁忙河道上的驳运。

e.en: The {lighterman} guided the barge through the fog.
e.zh: 驳船船夫引导驳船穿过浓雾。

e.en: His grandfather worked as a {lighterman} on the Thames.
e.zh: 他的祖父曾在泰晤士河上当驳运工。

e.en: The {lightermen} unloaded coal before sunrise.
e.zh: 驳运工人在日出前卸下煤炭。

e.en: Several {lightermen} protested the new harbor fees.
e.zh: 几名驳船船夫抗议新的港口费用。

e.en: The editor changed the heading to {lightface}.
e.zh: 编辑把标题改成了细体字。

e.en: Use {lightface} for notes and bold for warnings.
e.zh: 备注用淡体字，警告用粗体。

e.en: The {lightfaced} caption looked too weak on the poster.
e.zh: 海报上用细体字排的说明显得太弱。

e.en: Only the footnotes were {lightfaced} in the old book.
e.zh: 那本旧书里只有脚注是用细体字排的。

e.en: The museum requires {lightfast} inks for display prints.
e.zh: 博物馆要求展览印刷品使用耐光不褪色的油墨。

e.en: This fabric is not {lightfast} in strong sunlight.
e.zh: 这种布料在强烈阳光下并不耐光。

e.en: The lab tested the dye's {lightfastness} for outdoor use.
e.zh: 实验室测试了这种染料用于户外的耐光牢度。

e.en: Poor {lightfastness} makes the poster fade quickly.
e.zh: 耐晒性差会让海报很快褪色。

e.en: The poet described a {lightful} valley after dawn.
e.zh: 诗人描写了黎明后充满光的山谷。

e.en: Her old letters used the word {lightful} for happy days.
e.zh: 她的旧信里用明亮的这个词来形容快乐日子。

e.en: He was dismissed as a {lighthead} by older colleagues.
e.zh: 年长同事把他看作一个轻浮的人而不予理会。

e.en: Only a {lighthead} would ignore such clear warnings.
e.zh: 只有没头脑的人才会无视这样明确的警告。

e.en: She felt {lightheaded} after standing up too quickly.
e.zh: 她起身太快后觉得头晕。

e.en: His {lightheaded} plan ignored the real costs.
e.zh: 他那个轻率的计划忽视了实际成本。

e.en: The {lighthouseman} kept the lamp burning through the storm.
e.zh: 灯塔看守人在暴风雨中让灯一直亮着。

e.en: An old {lighthouseman} told stories about wrecks on the coast.
e.zh: 一位老灯塔看守人讲述海岸沉船的故事。

e.en: The walls were painted a {lightish} blue.
e.zh: 墙壁刷成了略浅的蓝色。

e.en: Choose a {lightish} jacket for the cool evening.
e.zh: 傍晚有点凉，选一件稍轻便的外套。

e.en: The {lightkeeper} checked the beacon before sunset.
e.zh: 灯塔看守人在日落前检查了灯标。

e.en: Her grandfather worked as a {lightkeeper} on a remote island.
e.zh: 她祖父曾在一座偏远岛上当灯塔看守人。

e.en: The barn had a {lightning-rod} on its roof.
e.zh: 谷仓屋顶上装着一根避雷针。

e.en: The policy became a {lightning-rod} for public anger.
e.zh: 这项政策成了公众怒火的集中目标。

e.en: The old tower was never made {lightningproof}.
e.zh: 那座老塔从未做过防雷处理。

e.en: They installed {lightningproof} wiring in the mountain station.
e.zh: 他们在山间站点安装了防雷线路。

e.en: The designer used a {lightpen} to select points on the screen.
e.zh: 设计师用光笔在屏幕上选择点位。

e.en: Early computers sometimes accepted input from a {lightpen}.
e.zh: 早期计算机有时用光笔输入信息。

e.en: A {lightplane} landed on the grass runway.
e.zh: 一架轻型飞机降落在草地跑道上。

e.en: They surveyed the valley from a small {lightplane}.
e.zh: 他们乘一架小型轻型飞机勘察山谷。

e.en: Store the film in a {lightproof} bag.
e.zh: 把胶片存放在不透光的袋子里。

e.en: The laboratory used {lightproof} curtains during the test.
e.zh: 实验室在测试期间使用了遮光窗帘。

e.en: At summer camp, {lights-out} was at ten.
e.zh: 夏令营晚上十点熄灯。

e.en: One punch left the boxer {lights-out} on the canvas.
e.zh: 一拳就把那名拳击手打倒在拳台上昏了过去。

e.en: She crossed the room with a {lightsome} step.
e.zh: 她迈着轻盈的步子穿过房间。

e.en: The poem has a {lightsome} and playful tone.
e.zh: 这首诗语调欢快又俏皮。

e.en: The dancers moved {lightsomely} across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者们轻盈地穿过舞台。

e.en: He spoke {lightsomely}, though the news was serious.
e.zh: 尽管消息很严肃，他说话仍显得轻松欢快。

e.en: Nothing with mass can travel at {lightspeed}.
e.zh: 有质量的物体无法以光速移动。

e.en: The rumor spread at {lightspeed} through the office.
e.zh: 这个谣言在办公室里飞快传开。

e.en: The chemist discarded the {lightstruck} sample.
e.zh: 化学师丢弃了受光损坏的样品。

e.en: That beer tastes stale because it is {lightstruck}.
e.zh: 那瓶啤酒因受光照影响，味道发闷变质。

e.en: The camera back must be completely {lighttight}.
e.zh: 相机后盖必须完全不漏光。

e.en: He built a {lighttight} box for developing film.
e.zh: 他做了一个不漏光的盒子来冲洗胶片。

e.en: A {lightwave} can carry information through glass fiber.
e.zh: 光波可以通过玻璃纤维传送信息。

e.en: The instrument measured each {lightwave} reflected by the surface.
e.zh: 仪器测量了表面反射出的每一道光波。

e.en: The model boat was made from {lightwood}.
e.zh: 这艘模型船是用轻木做的。

e.en: They gathered dry {lightwood} to start the fire.
e.zh: 他们捡来干燥的易燃木材生火。

e.en: A {lightyear} measures distance, not time.
e.zh: 光年衡量的是距离，不是时间。

e.en: The star is about one {lightyear} farther away than expected.
e.zh: 那颗恒星比预期远约一光年。

e.en: The galaxy lies millions of {lightyears} from Earth.
e.zh: 那个星系距离地球数百万光年。

e.en: Their new software is {lightyears} ahead of the old version.
e.zh: 他们的新软件比旧版本先进得多。

e.en: The old herbal text mentions {lign} as a medicinal wood.
e.zh: 那本古老草药书提到木质药材。

e.en: The craftsman chose dense {lign} for the handle.
e.zh: 工匠为手柄选择了致密的木材。

e.en: The chest smelled faintly of {lignaloes}.
e.zh: 箱子里隐约有沉香木的气味。

e.en: Old trade records listed {lignaloes} among costly spices.
e.zh: 旧贸易记录把沉香木列为昂贵香料之一。

e.en: The survey recorded several {lignicolous} fungi on fallen logs.
e.zh: 调查记录了几种生长在倒木上的真菌。

e.en: A {lignicolous} beetle may spend its life inside dead timber.
e.zh: 一种栖木甲虫可能一生都在枯木里度过。

e.en: The botanist studied {ligniferous} tissue in the stem.
e.zh: 植物学家研究了茎中的含木质组织。

e.en: Some {ligniferous} plants form hard, woody stems.
e.zh: 一些产木质的植物会形成坚硬的木质茎。

e.en: The stem becomes rigid through {lignification}.
e.zh: 茎通过木质化变得坚硬。

e.en: Drought can change the timing of {lignification} in young plants.
e.zh: 干旱会改变幼苗木质化的时间。

e.en: The plant's {lignified} stems survived the dry season.
e.zh: 这种植物木质化的茎熬过了旱季。

e.en: Older cells become {lignified} as the tissue hardens.
e.zh: 随着组织变硬，老细胞会变得木质化。

e.en: The stem {lignifies} as the plant matures.
e.zh: 植物成熟时，茎会木质化。

e.en: This process {lignifies} the cell walls over time.
e.zh: 这个过程会逐渐使细胞壁木质化。

e.en: The fossil had a {ligniform} texture under the lens.
e.zh: 在镜头下，这块化石呈现木状纹理。

e.en: A {ligniform} mass blocked the narrow channel.
e.zh: 一团似木的硬块堵住了狭窄通道。

e.en: Young shoots begin to {lignify} near the base.
e.zh: 嫩枝会从基部附近开始木质化。

e.en: Heat can help {lignify} certain plant fibers.
e.zh: 热处理能帮助某些植物纤维木质化。

e.en: The museum found {ligniperdous} insects in the old beams.
e.zh: 博物馆在旧梁木中发现了蛀木昆虫。

e.en: A {ligniperdous} fungus weakened the ship's timbers.
e.zh: 一种毁木真菌削弱了船上的木料。

e.en: The region contains several {lignitic} coal seams.
e.zh: 该地区含有几层褐煤煤层。

e.en: A dark {lignitic} deposit appeared beneath the clay.
e.zh: 黏土下面出现了一层深色的似褐煤沉积物。

e.en: Miners mapped the {lignitiferous} layers beneath the valley.
e.zh: 矿工绘制了山谷地下含褐煤地层的分布图。

e.en: The survey identified a {lignitiferous} basin near the coast.
e.zh: 勘测发现海岸附近有一个含褐煤盆地。

e.en: Buried wood may {lignitize} under pressure and time.
e.zh: 埋藏的木材在压力和时间作用下可能变成褐煤。

e.en: The swamp conditions helped {lignitize} ancient plant remains.
e.zh: 沼泽环境促使古代植物遗骸褐煤化。

e.en: Termites are well-known {lignivorous} insects.
e.zh: 白蚁是人们熟知的食木昆虫。

e.en: The {lignivorous} larvae tunneled through the floorboards.
e.zh: 这些蛀木幼虫在地板里钻出了通道。

e.en: The dentist injected {lignocaine} before the extraction.
e.zh: 牙医在拔牙前注射了利多卡因。

e.en: A {lignocaine} spray numbed the patient's throat.
e.zh: 利多卡因喷雾使病人的喉咙麻木。

e.en: Straw contains abundant {lignocellulose} for biofuel production.
e.zh: 秸秆含有大量可用于生物燃料生产的木质纤维素。

e.en: Fungi can break down {lignocellulose} in fallen trees.
e.zh: 真菌能分解倒木中的木质纤维素。

e.en: The company processes {lignocellulosic} waste into ethanol.
e.zh: 这家公司把木质纤维素废料加工成乙醇。

e.en: Researchers studied {lignocellulosic} fibers from bamboo.
e.zh: 研究人员研究了竹子的木质纤维素纤维。

e.en: The lab detected {lignocerylsphingosine} in the lipid sample.
e.zh: 实验室在脂质样本中检测到木蜡酰鞘氨醇。

e.en: A rare disorder can alter {lignocerylsphingosine} levels.
e.zh: 一种罕见疾病可能改变木蜡酰鞘氨醇水平。

e.en: The sample gave a {lignose} reaction in the test.
e.zh: 样品在测试中出现了含木质素的反应。

e.en: A {lignose} residue remained after the fibers were treated.
e.zh: 纤维处理后留下了木质残渣。

e.en: Builders added {lignosulphonate} to improve the concrete mix.
e.zh: 建筑工人加入木质素磺酸盐来改善混凝土拌合料。

e.en: The mill sells {lignosulphonate} as a chemical by-product.
e.zh: 这家工厂把木质素磺酸盐作为化学副产品出售。

e.en: The botanist examined the {lignum} under a microscope.
e.zh: 植物学家在显微镜下观察木质部。

e.en: Dense {lignum} made the tool handle unusually heavy.
e.zh: 致密的木材使工具柄格外沉重。

e.en: The old pulley used {lignumvitae} for its bearing.
e.zh: 这个旧滑轮用愈创木木材做轴承。

e.en: A {lignumvitae} tree grows slowly in the Caribbean.
e.zh: 愈创木树在加勒比地区生长缓慢。

e.en: The chemist washed the residue with {ligroin}.
e.zh: 化学家用石油醚清洗残渣。

e.en: Keep {ligroin} away from sparks and open flames.
e.zh: 要让轻质汽油远离火花和明火。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {liguistic} structure near the wound.
e.zh: 外科医生注意到伤口附近有一个舌状结构。

e.en: A {liguistic} fold projected from the small organ.
e.zh: 一个舌状褶皱从小器官上伸出。

e.en: The grass blade has a tiny {ligula} at its base.
e.zh: 这片草叶基部有一个很小的叶舌。

e.en: Each flower showed a yellow {ligula} around the center.
e.zh: 每朵花的中心周围都有黄色舌状小片。

e.en: The botanist compared the {ligulae} of several grasses.
e.zh: 植物学家比较了几种禾草的叶舌。

e.en: Yellow {ligulae} formed a ring around the flower head.
e.zh: 黄色舌状小片在花头周围形成一圈。

e.en: The student sketched the {ligulas} on the grass specimens.
e.zh: 学生画下了草本标本上的叶舌。

e.en: Long {ligulas} made the ray flowers easy to identify.
e.zh: 较长的舌状小片让这些舌状花容易辨认。

e.en: The botanist noted the flower's {ligulate} ray florets.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到这朵花有舌状的舌状花。

e.en: Some grasses have a clearly {ligulate} leaf base.
e.zh: 有些草的叶基部有明显的舌状小片。

e.en: The specimen has {ligulated} petals around the center.
e.zh: 这个标本的中心周围长着舌状花瓣。

e.en: A {ligulated} membrane appears where the blade meets the sheath.
e.zh: 叶片与叶鞘相接处可见一个舌状膜。

e.en: The grass {ligule} helped identify the species.
e.zh: 这株草的叶舌有助于辨认物种。

e.en: Each ray flower has a small {ligule}.
e.zh: 每朵舌状花都有一个小舌片。

ligure.t: 利古尔宝石；古代宝石名

e.en: The old text mentions a {ligure} among sacred stones.
e.zh: 那部古书把利古尔宝石列在圣石之中。

e.en: No one knows exactly which gem {ligure} named.
e.zh: 没人确切知道ligure当时指哪种宝石。

like-minded.t: 志趣相投的；想法相近的

e.en: She joined a club for {like-minded} readers.
e.zh: 她加入了一个由志趣相投的读者组成的俱乐部。

e.en: The campaign brought {like-minded} activists together.
e.zh: 这场运动把理念相近的活动人士聚到了一起。

e.en: They worked {like-mindedly} toward the same reform.
e.zh: 他们志同道合地推动同一项改革。

e.en: The volunteers {like-mindedly} rejected the unfair rule.
e.zh: 志趣相投的志愿者们一致反对那条不公平规定。

e.en: Rain is {likelier} in the afternoon.
e.zh: 下午下雨的可能性更大。

e.en: She is the {likelier} candidate to win.
e.zh: 她是更有希望获胜的候选人。

e.en: The {likeliness} of snow increases after midnight.
e.zh: 午夜之后下雪的可能性会增加。

e.en: The portrait's {likeliness} pleased the family.
e.zh: 这幅肖像的相似程度让家人很满意。

e.en: The child had a {likesome} smile.
e.zh: 那个孩子有一张讨人喜欢的笑脸。

e.en: It was a simple but {likesome} little song.
e.zh: 那是一首简单却惹人喜爱的小歌。

e.en: Neighbors gathered for the old {likewake}.
e.zh: 邻居们聚在一起参加旧式守灵。

e.en: The poem describes a midnight {likewake}.
e.zh: 这首诗描写了一场午夜守灵。

e.en: Merchants complained about the {likin} on goods.
e.zh: 商人们抱怨货物要缴纳厘金。

e.en: The treaty discussed abolishing the {likin} tax.
e.zh: 条约讨论了废除厘金税的问题。

likuta.t: 利库塔；刚果货币小单位

e.en: The price was listed as one {likuta}.
e.zh: 价格标为一利库塔。

e.en: He kept a worn {likuta} coin as a souvenir.
e.zh: 他留着一枚磨旧的利库塔硬币作纪念。

e.en: The evening sky turned {lilacky} after rain.
e.zh: 雨后傍晚的天空变成了淡紫色。

e.en: She chose a soft, {lilacky} fabric for the dress.
e.zh: 她为裙子选了一种柔和的淡紫色布料。

lilacy.t: 淡紫色的；有紫丁香香气的

e.en: A {lilacy} scent drifted through the garden.
e.zh: 一阵紫丁香般的香气飘过花园。

e.en: The room was painted a pale {lilacy} shade.
e.zh: 房间被刷成了浅淡紫色。

lilangeni.t: 里兰吉尼；斯威士兰货币

e.en: The meal cost fifty {lilangeni}.
e.zh: 这顿饭花了五十里兰吉尼。

e.en: She exchanged dollars for {lilangeni} at the bank.
e.zh: 她在银行把美元兑换成里兰吉尼。

e.en: The plant has {liliaceous} flowers with six petals.
e.zh: 这种植物有六片花瓣的百合状花。

e.en: Botanists once grouped onions with {liliaceous} plants.
e.zh: 植物学家曾把洋葱归入百合科植物。

e.en: The chapel had a {lilied} border painted around the ceiling.
e.zh: 小教堂的天花板四周画着百合花饰边。

e.en: She unfolded a {lilied} cloth from the old chest.
e.zh: 她从旧箱子里展开一块饰有百合花的布。

e.en: The medieval shield bore a small {lilion} near the top.
e.zh: 那面中世纪盾牌上方有一个小小的百合花形图案。

e.en: A carved {lilion} decorated the corner of the stone frame.
e.zh: 石框的一角装饰着雕刻的百合花纹。

e.en: The historian quoted {Lillibullero} in a lecture on seventeenth-century politics.
e.zh: 那位历史学家在讲十七世纪政治时引用了《利利布勒罗》。

e.en: The soldiers marched while someone whistled {Lillibullero}.
e.zh: 士兵们行进时，有人吹着《利利布勒罗》的曲调。

e.en: We floated on a {lilo} in the hotel pool.
e.zh: 我们躺在酒店泳池里的充气垫上漂着。

e.en: He packed a small {lilo} for the beach holiday.
e.zh: 他为海滩假期带了一个小充气床垫。

e.en: The plant opened with a {lily-like} white bloom.
e.zh: 那株植物开出一朵像百合花的白色花。

e.en: Her dress had a soft, {lily-like} elegance.
e.zh: 她的裙子带着一种柔和的百合般优雅。

e.en: The captain called the deserter a {lily-livered} coward.
e.zh: 船长骂那个逃兵是个胆小怯懦的懦夫。

e.en: Only a {lily-livered} official would avoid such an easy decision.
e.zh: 只有怯懦的官员才会回避这么简单的决定。

e.en: A {lily-trotter} stepped lightly across the floating leaves.
e.zh: 一只水雉轻巧地踩过漂浮的叶片。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {lily-trotter} near the marsh edge.
e.zh: 向导指给我们看沼泽边的一只水雉。

e.en: The bride carried a {lily-white} bouquet down the aisle.
e.zh: 新娘手捧洁白的花束走过通道。

e.en: He tried to present a {lily-white} record to the committee.
e.zh: 他试图向委员会展示一份清白无瑕的履历。

e.en: The perfume had a delicate, {lilylike} scent.
e.zh: 这款香水有一种细腻的百合般香气。

e.en: A {lilylike} flower grew beside the narrow stream.
e.zh: 一朵像百合的花长在狭窄的小溪旁。

e.en: She added {lima-beans} to the vegetable soup.
e.zh: 她往蔬菜汤里加了利马豆。

e.en: The children pushed every {lima-bean} to the side of the plate.
e.zh: 孩子们把盘子里的每颗利马豆都拨到一边。

e.en: The creature left a {limaceous} trail across the damp stone.
e.zh: 那生物在潮湿的石头上留下了像蛞蝓一样的痕迹。

e.en: The biologist described its {limaceous} body in careful detail.
e.zh: 生物学家仔细描述了它蛞蝓般的身体。

e.en: The larva had a soft, {limaciform} body.
e.zh: 这只幼虫有着柔软的蛞蝓状身体。

e.en: A {limaciform} animal moved slowly under the wet leaves.
e.zh: 一只蛞蝓状动物在湿叶下缓慢移动。

e.en: The shell had nearly vanished in this {limacine} species.
e.zh: 在这个蛞蝓类物种中，外壳几乎已经消失。

e.en: Its {limacine} movement made it easy to spot on the glass.
e.zh: 它像蛞蝓一样的移动方式让人很容易在玻璃上发现它。

e.en: The equation produced a {limacon} with an inner loop.
e.zh: 这个方程生成了一条带内环的蜗牛线。

e.en: She sketched a {limacon} during the geometry lesson.
e.zh: 她在几何课上画了一条蜗牛线。

e.en: The old manual recommends {limation} before planting wheat.
e.zh: 那本旧手册建议种小麦前先施石灰。

e.en: Careful {limation} reduced the soil's acidity.
e.zh: 细致的石灰处理降低了土壤酸性。

e.en: The doctor examined the {limbal} area of her eye.
e.zh: 医生检查了她眼睛的角膜缘区域。

e.en: A {limbal} incision can help protect central vision.
e.zh: 角膜缘切口有助于保护中央视力。

e.en: The butterfly had {limbate} wings with pale margins.
e.zh: 那只蝴蝶的翅膀带有浅色边缘。

e.en: A {limbate} leaf often shows a clear colored border.
e.zh: 有边的叶片常会显出清楚的彩色边框。

e.en: The alchemist heated wine in a glass {limbeck}.
e.zh: 炼金术士把酒放在玻璃蒸馏器里加热。

e.en: Poets once used {limbeck} as an image of refinement.
e.zh: 诗人过去常用蒸馏器来象征提炼和精化。

e.en: Several ducks showed {limberneck} after eating spoiled feed.
e.zh: 几只鸭子吃了变质饲料后出现软颈病。

e.en: Farmers feared {limberneck} because it could kill birds quickly.
e.zh: 农民害怕软颈病，因为它能很快害死禽鸟。

e.en: The surgeon compared the two corneal {limbi}.
e.zh: 外科医生比较了两个角膜缘。

e.en: In old diagrams, the {limbi} mark the borders of the disk.
e.zh: 在旧图中，这些边缘标出圆盘的边界。

e.en: The geologist identified the dark sample as {limburgite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把那块深色样品鉴定为霞橄岩。

e.en: Fresh {limburgite} may contain visible olivine crystals.
e.zh: 新鲜的霞橄岩可能含有可见的橄榄石晶体。

e.en: Inflammation appeared near the {limbus} of the eye.
e.zh: 炎症出现在眼睛角膜缘附近。

e.en: The map's {limbus} was decorated with tiny stars.
e.zh: 地图的边缘装饰着细小的星星。

e.en: The {limby} oak cast shadows across the path.
e.zh: 枝杈繁多的橡树把影子投在小路上。

e.en: A {limby} coral shape filled the corner of the painting.
e.zh: 画角里填着一种有肢状分枝的珊瑚形状。

e.en: Rhododendron is often a {lime-hater} in garden guides.
e.zh: 园艺指南常把杜鹃列为嫌石灰植物。

e.en: A {lime-hater} may turn yellow in alkaline soil.
e.zh: 厌钙植物在碱性土壤中可能会发黄。

e.en: She bought a small {lime-juicer} for cocktails.
e.zh: 她买了一个小青柠榨汁器来调鸡尾酒。

e.en: The metal {lime-juicer} squeezes every drop out.
e.zh: 这个金属青柠榨汁器能榨出每一滴汁。

e.en: The abandoned {lime-kiln} stood beside the quarry.
e.zh: 废弃的石灰窑立在采石场旁边。

e.en: Workers burned limestone in the {lime-kiln} overnight.
e.zh: 工人们整夜在石灰窑里烧制石灰石。

e.en: Early theaters used {lime-light} to illuminate the stage.
e.zh: 早期剧院用石灰光照亮舞台。

e.en: The scandal pushed him into the {lime-light}.
e.zh: 那场丑闻把他推到了公众关注之中。

e.en: The walls were built from pale {lime-stone}.
e.zh: 这些墙是用浅色石灰岩砌成的。

e.en: Rain slowly dissolves {lime-stone} in the hills.
e.zh: 雨水会慢慢溶解山中的石灰岩。

e.en: The {limeburner} worked near the hot kiln all day.
e.zh: 烧石灰工整天在滚烫的窑旁工作。

e.en: A village {limeburner} supplied mortar for nearby farms.
e.zh: 村里的石灰窑工为附近农场供应灰浆。

e.en: This {limejuicer} is easier to clean than the old one.
e.zh: 这个青柠榨汁器比旧的更容易清洗。

e.en: He pressed half a lime in the {limejuicer}.
e.zh: 他把半个青柠放进榨汁器里压汁。

e.en: The deed mentions a {limekilm} behind the mill.
e.zh: 地契提到磨坊后面有一座石灰窑。

e.en: In the diary, {limekilm} appears as an old spelling.
e.zh: 在日记里，limekilm 是一种旧式拼法。

e.en: Smoke rose from the {limekiln} at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时石灰窑里升起了烟。

e.en: The old {limekiln} is now a protected ruin.
e.zh: 那座旧石灰窑如今是受保护的遗迹。

e.en: The experiment measured the {limen} of hearing.
e.zh: 实验测量了听觉的感觉阈限。

e.en: He paused at the {limen} of a new life.
e.zh: 他停在新生活的门槛上。

e.en: Different senses have different {limens}.
e.zh: 不同感官有不同的感觉阈限。

e.en: The poem returns to doors, borders, and {limens}.
e.zh: 这首诗反复写到门、边界和门槛。

e.en: The kettle was coated with hard {limescale}.
e.zh: 水壶里结了一层坚硬的水垢。

e.en: Vinegar can remove {limescale} from bathroom taps.
e.zh: 醋可以去除浴室水龙头上的水垢。

e.en: The mineral tray included a piece of {limespar}.
e.zh: 矿物托盘里有一块方解石。

e.en: Clear {limespar} can show double refraction.
e.zh: 透明方解石能显示双折射现象。

e.en: The recipe calls for one fresh {limette}.
e.zh: 这个食谱需要一个新鲜青柠。

e.en: She added {limette} peel to the dessert.
e.zh: 她在甜点里加了青柠皮。

e.en: They covered the cottage walls with white {limewash}.
e.zh: 他们用白色石灰水涂料粉刷小屋墙壁。

e.en: We decided to {limewash} the stable before winter.
e.zh: 我们决定入冬前给马厩刷上石灰水。

e.en: Carbon dioxide turns clear {limewater} cloudy.
e.zh: 二氧化碳会使澄清石灰水变浑浊。

e.en: The teacher poured {limewater} into a glass tube.
e.zh: 老师把石灰水倒进一根玻璃管里。

e.en: The carver chose {limewood} for the delicate figure.
e.zh: 雕刻师选用椴木来制作这个精细人像。

e.en: Old drawers made of {limewood} felt light but sturdy.
e.zh: 用椴木做的旧抽屉手感轻巧却很结实。

e.en: The abandoned {limeworks} stood beside the quarry.
e.zh: 废弃的石灰厂就立在采石场旁边。

e.en: Smoke from the {limeworks} once covered the village.
e.zh: 石灰厂冒出的烟曾经笼罩整个村子。

e.en: The marsh survey recorded each {limicole} near the reeds.
e.zh: 沼泽调查记录了芦苇附近的每一只涉禽。

e.en: A {limicole} feeds by probing soft mud with its bill.
e.zh: 泥栖鸟会用喙探入软泥中觅食。

e.en: The biologist studied {limicoline} birds on the tidal flats.
e.zh: 生物学家研究潮滩上的涉禽类鸟类。

e.en: Their {limicoline} habits make them sensitive to wetland loss.
e.zh: 它们泥栖的习性使其容易受湿地减少影响。

e.en: Several {limicolous} worms appeared after the tide withdrew.
e.zh: 潮水退去后，几条生活在泥中的蠕虫露了出来。

e.en: The pond supports many {limicolous} insects and larvae.
e.zh: 这个池塘养育着许多泥栖昆虫和幼虫。

e.en: The hunter trusted his {limier} to follow the trail.
e.zh: 猎人相信他的追踪猎犬能循迹前进。

e.en: In the old tale, a {limier} found the missing child.
e.zh: 在那个古老故事里，一只追踪犬找到了失踪的孩子。

e.en: The experiment measured the visual {limina} of each participant.
e.zh: 实验测量了每位参与者的视觉阈限。

e.en: Ancient temples marked sacred {limina} between worlds.
e.zh: 古代神庙标示着不同世界之间的神圣门槛。

e.en: The committee held a {liminary} discussion before the vote.
e.zh: 委员会在投票前进行了初步讨论。

e.en: She paused in the {liminary} space between doubt and decision.
e.zh: 她停在怀疑与决定之间那种临界状态里。

e.en: The cocktail had a bright {liminess} that balanced the sugar.
e.zh: 这杯鸡尾酒有明亮的酸橙味，正好平衡了甜味。

e.en: The soil's {liminess} made it suitable for certain herbs.
e.zh: 土壤的石灰质特性使它适合种植某些香草。

e.en: The damage is {limitable} if repairs begin today.
e.zh: 如果今天开始维修，损害是可以限制的。

e.en: Some risks are not fully {limitable} by policy.
e.zh: 有些风险无法完全靠政策加以限制。

e.en: A {limitarian} argues that extreme wealth should have a ceiling.
e.zh: 限制主义者认为极端财富应当设有上限。

e.en: The senator took a {limitarian} view of executive power.
e.zh: 那位参议员对行政权力持限制主义看法。

e.en: The treaty included {limitary} clauses on troop movement.
e.zh: 条约包含限制部队调动的条款。

e.en: A river often serves a {limitary} function between provinces.
e.zh: 河流常常在省份之间起到边界作用。

e.en: The report focused on {limitational} effects of the new rule.
e.zh: 报告重点分析了新规定带来的限制性影响。

e.en: Her theory has a {limitational} aspect that critics often ignore.
e.zh: 她的理论有一个限制性层面，批评者常常忽视。

e.en: The contract uses {limitative} language to define liability.
e.zh: 合同用限制性措辞来界定责任。

e.en: A {limitative} reading would exclude several common cases.
e.zh: 如果作限定性解读，就会排除几种常见情况。

e.en: The circuit includes a {limitator} to protect the sensor.
e.zh: 电路中包含一个限幅器，用来保护传感器。

e.en: In the debate, he acted as a {limitator} of extravagant claims.
e.zh: 在辩论中，他起到了限制夸大说法的作用。

e.en: The two {limitrophe} states shared a difficult border.
e.zh: 这两个相邻国家共用一段棘手的边境。

e.en: Trade grew quickly in the {limitrophe} districts.
e.zh: 接壤地区的贸易迅速增长。

e.en: The {limivorous} fish filters nutrients from river mud.
e.zh: 这种食泥鱼会从河泥中过滤养分。

e.en: Researchers observed {limivorous} larvae in the shallow pond.
e.zh: 研究人员在浅池中观察到食泥幼虫。

e.en: The theorist described the {limma} in ancient tuning systems.
e.zh: 这位理论家描述了古代调律体系中的小音程。

e.en: A {limma} is too subtle for many casual listeners to notice.
e.zh: 这种小音程很细微，许多普通听众难以察觉。

e.en: The old play calls the thief a shameless {limmer}.
e.zh: 那部老戏把小偷称作无耻恶棍。

e.en: She laughed at the insult and answered like a bold {limmer}.
e.zh: 她听到辱骂后大笑，并像个大胆泼辣的女人那样回应。

e.en: A {limnaeid} snail can host several parasite stages.
e.zh: 椎实螺科的螺可能寄宿几种寄生虫阶段。

e.en: The student identified the shell as {limnaeid} during the survey.
e.zh: 学生在调查中认出这个贝壳属于椎实螺科。

e.en: The {limnetic} zone receives enough light for plankton growth.
e.zh: 湖泊开阔水区有足够光照，适合浮游生物生长。

e.en: Scientists sampled {limnetic} water far from the shore.
e.zh: 科学家采集了远离岸边的湖沼水样。

e.en: The team studied {limnic} sediments from the ancient lake.
e.zh: 研究小组研究了这座古湖的湖泊沉积物。

e.en: Several insects have adapted to {limnic} habitats.
e.zh: 几种昆虫已经适应了湖泊栖息环境。

e.en: The old {limnimeter} recorded the lake level every morning.
e.zh: 那台旧湖水位测量仪每天早晨记录湖面高度。

e.en: Engineers installed a {limnimeter} near the reservoir wall.
e.zh: 工程师在水库坝墙附近安装了一台湖水位测量仪。

limnobiology.t: 湖沼生物学；淡水生物学

e.en: She specializes in {limnobiology} and studies freshwater plankton.
e.zh: 她专攻湖沼生物学，研究淡水浮游生物。

e.en: The course introduces {limnobiology} through fieldwork on local ponds.
e.zh: 这门课通过本地池塘的实地调查介绍淡水生物学。

e.en: A {limnograph} tracked changes in the river's height.
e.zh: 一台水位自动记录仪追踪了河水高度的变化。

e.en: The technician repaired the {limnograph} before the storm arrived.
e.zh: 技术员在暴风雨到来前修好了水位自动记录仪。

e.en: The report presents a {limnologic} analysis of the basin.
e.zh: 这份报告对该流域进行了湖沼学分析。

e.en: They gathered {limnologic} data during the summer survey.
e.zh: 他们在夏季调查中收集了淡水学数据。

e.en: The institute published a {limnological} map of the region.
e.zh: 该研究所发布了一张该地区的湖沼学地图。

e.en: Her {limnological} research focuses on nutrient cycles in lakes.
e.zh: 她的湖沼学研究关注湖泊中的营养物质循环。

e.en: The two lakes are {limnologically} very different.
e.zh: 从湖沼学角度看，这两个湖差异很大。

e.en: The reservoir was {limnologically} unstable after the algae bloom.
e.zh: 藻华过后，这座水库在湖沼学上处于不稳定状态。

e.en: The {limnologist} collected water samples at dawn.
e.zh: 那位湖沼学家在黎明时采集了水样。

e.en: A {limnologist} explained why the lake had turned green.
e.zh: 一位淡水学家解释了湖水为什么变绿。

e.en: Orange peels contain a fragrant oil called {limonene}.
e.zh: 橙皮含有一种叫柠檬烯的芳香油。

e.en: The cleaner smells citrusy because it includes {limonene}.
e.zh: 这种清洁剂闻起来有柑橘味，因为里面含有柠檬烯。

e.en: The hillside was stained brown by {limonite}.
e.zh: 山坡被褐铁矿染成了棕色。

e.en: Miners once extracted iron from deposits of {limonite}.
e.zh: 矿工过去曾从褐铁矿矿床中提炼铁。

limonitic.t: 含褐铁矿的；褐铁矿质的

e.en: The drill sample showed a {limonitic} layer near the surface.
e.zh: 钻探样本显示近地表有一层褐铁矿质层。

e.en: Geologists mapped the {limonitic} soil across the ridge.
e.zh: 地质学家绘制了山脊上含褐铁矿土壤的分布图。

e.en: Citrus seeds contain bitter compounds called {limonoids}.
e.zh: 柑橘种子含有被称为柠檬苦素类化合物的苦味成分。

e.en: Researchers tested whether {limonoids} could affect insect feeding.
e.zh: 研究人员测试柠檬苦素类化合物是否会影响昆虫取食。

e.en: The doctor used {limosis} to describe the patient's abnormal hunger.
e.zh: 医生用异常饥饿来描述这名患者的不正常饥饿感。

e.en: Older medical texts sometimes mention {limosis} after long fevers.
e.zh: 较早的医学文献有时会提到长期发热后的病态食欲。

limp-wristed.t: 手腕无力的；贬称柔弱娘气的

e.en: He gave a {limp-wristed} wave from the sofa.
e.zh: 他从沙发上手腕无力地挥了挥手。

e.en: The insult {limp-wristed} is dated and offensive.
e.zh: “limp-wristed”这个侮辱说法已经过时且冒犯人。

e.en: She served warm {limpa} with butter and cheese.
e.zh: 她端上温热的瑞典黑麦面包，配黄油和奶酪。

e.en: The bakery's {limpa} has a sweet hint of orange.
e.zh: 这家面包店的瑞典黑麦面包带有淡淡的橙香甜味。

e.en: The rain began to {limpen} the paper decorations.
e.zh: 雨水开始把纸质装饰弄得软塌塌的。

e.en: His arms seemed to {limpen} after the long climb.
e.zh: 长时间攀爬后，他的双臂似乎变得无力。

e.en: Visitors admired the {limpidity} of the mountain stream.
e.zh: 游客赞叹这条山涧溪水的清澈。

e.en: Her prose has a rare {limpidity} and calm rhythm.
e.zh: 她的散文有一种少见的明晰感和从容节奏。

e.en: A {limpkin} called loudly from the marsh grass.
e.zh: 一只秧鹤在沼泽草丛中大声鸣叫。

e.en: The guide identified the brown bird as a {limpkin}.
e.zh: 向导认出那只棕色鸟是一只秧鹤。

e.en: The cheap fabric felt thin and {limpsy}.
e.zh: 这种廉价布料摸起来又薄又软塌塌。

e.en: After the flu, he was too {limpsy} to walk far.
e.zh: 流感过后，他虚弱得走不了多远。

limpwort.t: 一种玄参科草本植物；药用草本植物名

e.en: The herbalist identified the roadside plant as {limpwort}.
e.zh: 草药师认出路边那株植物是limpwort。

e.en: Old botany books sometimes mention {limpwort} among medicinal herbs.
e.zh: 旧植物学书有时把limpwort列在药用草本中。

e.en: The fossil had a broad, {limuloid} shell.
e.zh: 这块化石有宽阔、像鲎一样的外壳。

e.en: Researchers compared the {limuloid} creature with modern horseshoe crabs.
e.zh: 研究人员把这种鲎状生物与现代鲎作比较。

e.en: A {limy} crust covered the old pipe.
e.zh: 旧水管上覆盖着一层含石灰的硬壳。

e.en: The pond stones felt {limy} underfoot.
e.zh: 池塘里的石头踩上去有些黏滑。

e.en: The blank map is {linable} with a ruler.
e.zh: 这张空白地图可以用尺子画上线。

e.en: The posts were {linable} along the garden path.
e.zh: 这些柱子可以沿花园小径排成一线。

e.en: The old pharmacy text listed the herb as a {linagogue}.
e.zh: 那本旧药学书把这种草药列为通经剂。

e.en: Doctors no longer prescribe a {linagogue} without clear evidence.
e.zh: 没有明确证据时，医生已不再开催月经药。

e.en: The perfume contains {linalol} from lavender oil.
e.zh: 这款香水含有来自薰衣草油的芳樟醇。

e.en: Chemists tested the sample for traces of {linalol}.
e.zh: 化学师检测样品中是否有芳樟醇的痕迹。

e.en: Lavender owes much of its scent to {linalool}.
e.zh: 薰衣草的香气很大程度来自芳樟醇。

e.en: The label warns that {linalool} may irritate sensitive skin.
e.zh: 标签提醒芳樟醇可能刺激敏感皮肤。

linatron.t: 线性电子加速器；医用直线加速器

e.en: The hospital installed a {linatron} for radiation therapy.
e.zh: 医院安装了一台用于放射治疗的线性加速器。

e.en: Engineers calibrated the {linatron} before the experiment.
e.zh: 工程师在实验前校准了这台直线加速器。

e.en: Trust is the {linch-pin} of the partnership.
e.zh: 信任是这段合作关系的关键。

e.en: She became the {linch-pin} of the rescue plan.
e.zh: 她成了救援计划中的关键人物。

e.en: The infection responded well to {lincomycin}.
e.zh: 这次感染对林可霉素反应良好。

e.en: The veterinarian prescribed {lincomycin} for the animal.
e.zh: 兽医给这只动物开了林可霉素。

lincrusta.t: 浮雕墙纸；压花墙面材料

e.en: The hallway was decorated with painted {lincrusta}.
e.zh: 走廊用上了上漆的压花墙面材料装饰。

e.en: Restorers carefully cleaned the Victorian {lincrusta}.
e.zh: 修复人员小心清洁维多利亚时期的浮雕墙纸。

e.en: She took a spoonful of {linctus} before bed.
e.zh: 她睡前喝了一勺止咳糖浆。

e.en: The pharmacist recommended a mild {linctus} for the dry cough.
e.zh: 药剂师建议用一种温和的止咳糖浆缓解干咳。

linctuses.t: 止咳糖浆；黏稠咳嗽药复数

e.en: Several {linctuses} were kept behind the pharmacy counter.
e.zh: 药房柜台后放着好几种止咳糖浆。

e.en: Older {linctuses} often tasted strongly of syrup.
e.zh: 较老式的止咳糖浆常有很重的糖浆味。

linderazulene.t: 林德薁；植物来源蓝色烃类化合物

e.en: The chemist isolated {linderazulene} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 化学师从植物提取物中分离出林德薁。

e.en: Spectroscopy confirmed the presence of {linderazulene} in the sample.
e.zh: 光谱分析确认样品中存在林德薁。

lindgrenite.t: 林德格伦矿；一种铜钼酸盐矿物

e.en: The collection includes a small crystal of {lindgrenite}.
e.zh: 这个收藏中有一小块林德格伦矿晶体。

e.en: Geologists found {lindgrenite} in the oxidized ore zone.
e.zh: 地质学家在氧化矿带中发现了林德格伦矿。

e.en: The book includes a simple {line-drawing} of the old church.
e.zh: 这本书里有一幅那座老教堂的简单线条画。

e.en: She made a quick {line-drawing} before adding color.
e.zh: 她先快速画了一张线稿，然后再上色。

e.en: The soldiers practiced {line-firing} on the training ground.
e.zh: 士兵们在训练场练习列队齐射。

e.en: The old manual explains {line-firing} in great detail.
e.zh: 那本旧手册详细讲解了排枪射击。

e.en: The company reduced costs by improving its {line-haul} routes.
e.zh: 公司通过优化干线运输路线降低了成本。

e.en: Most {line-haul} trucks travel overnight between cities.
e.zh: 大多数长途货运卡车夜间在城市之间行驶。

e.en: Their captain won the {line-out} near the goal line.
e.zh: 他们的队长在得分线附近赢下了边线球。

e.en: The coach drilled the forwards on {line-out} timing.
e.zh: 教练训练前锋掌握界外球争夺的时机。

e.en: The rescue team used a {line-shooter} to reach the stranded boat.
e.zh: 救援队用射绳器接近那艘搁浅的小船。

e.en: A compact {line-shooter} can throw rope across a wide gap.
e.zh: 小型抛缆器可以把绳索抛过很宽的间隔。

e.en: The crew practiced {line-shooting} during the safety drill.
e.zh: 船员们在安全演练中练习抛缆作业。

e.en: Accurate {line-shooting} helped them secure the rescue rope.
e.zh: 准确射绳帮助他们固定了救援绳。

e.en: The editor made a {line-to-line} comparison of the two drafts.
e.zh: 编辑对两份草稿做了逐行比较。

e.en: The diagram shows a {line-to-line} voltage measurement.
e.zh: 图中显示的是线对线电压测量。

e.en: The blank chart is {lineable} with any spacing you choose.
e.zh: 这张空白图表可以按你选择的间距画线。

e.en: Only the straight sections are {lineable} on this rough map.
e.zh: 在这张粗略地图上，只有笔直的部分能连成线。

e.en: The proof depends on the {lineality} of the solution set.
e.zh: 这个证明取决于解集的线性。

e.en: The artist rejected strict {lineality} in favor of curved forms.
e.zh: 这位艺术家放弃严格的直线性，转而采用曲线形态。

e.en: The portrait has a delicate {lineamental} quality.
e.zh: 这幅肖像有一种精细的线条感。

e.en: Geologists studied the {lineamental} patterns in the satellite image.
e.zh: 地质学家研究了卫星图像中的线性构造图案。

e.en: The engineer chose a {linear-phase} filter for cleaner audio.
e.zh: 工程师选择了线性相位滤波器，以获得更干净的音频。

e.en: A {linear-phase} response preserves the shape of the signal.
e.zh: 线性相位响应能保持信号的形状。

e.en: We can {linearise} the equation near this point.
