e.zh: 我们可以在这一点附近将方程线性化。

e.en: The software helps engineers {linearise} complex control models.
e.zh: 这款软件帮助工程师把复杂控制模型线性化。

e.en: The model uses {linearization} to simplify the calculation.
e.zh: 这个模型用线性化来简化计算。

e.en: Local {linearization} gives a useful first estimate.
e.zh: 局部线性近似能给出有用的初步估计。

linearize.t: 使线性化；转为线性形式

e.en: The program can {linearize} the curve around the operating point.
e.zh: 程序可以在工作点附近把曲线线性化。

e.en: Researchers often {linearize} nonlinear systems before analysis.
e.zh: 研究人员在分析前常把非线性系统转为线性形式。

e.en: The {linearized} model matched the data surprisingly well.
e.zh: 这个已线性化的模型与数据吻合得出乎意料地好。

e.en: They solved the {linearized} equations first.
e.zh: 他们先求解了线性化后的方程。

e.en: The amplifier needs a {linearizer} to reduce distortion.
e.zh: 这个放大器需要线性化器来减少失真。

e.en: A digital {linearizer} corrected the sensor output.
e.zh: 数字线性化装置修正了传感器输出。

e.en: The assistant will {lineate} the manuscript before printing.
e.zh: 助手会在打印前给手稿标上线条。

e.en: Artists sometimes {lineate} a surface to guide later shading.
e.zh: 艺术家有时会在表面画线，以便后续明暗处理。

e.en: The beetle has a finely {lineated} shell.
e.zh: 这种甲虫有带细线纹的外壳。

e.en: A {lineated} pattern ran across the stone surface.
e.zh: 石头表面横贯着一道道线状纹理。

e.en: The geologist measured the {lineation} in the rock face.
e.zh: 地质学家测量了岩面上的线理。

e.en: Careful {lineation} gives the drawing a sense of movement.
e.zh: 细致的线条排列让这幅画有了动感。

e.en: The guide identified a {linebacked} species in the grass.
e.zh: 向导在草丛中认出了一种背部有线纹的物种。

e.en: A {linebacked} pattern made the animal easy to spot.
e.zh: 背部线纹让这只动物很容易被发现。

e.en: The farmer kept a {linebred} strain of sheep.
e.zh: 农民保留了一支近亲繁育出的绵羊品系。

e.en: A {linebred} dog may show very predictable traits.
e.zh: 近亲繁育出的狗可能表现出很稳定的特征。

e.en: Some breeders {linebreed} animals to preserve rare traits.
e.zh: 一些育种者通过品系繁育来保留稀有特征。

e.en: They chose to {linebreed} the horses carefully.
e.zh: 他们选择谨慎地对这些马进行品系繁育。

e.en: {Linebreeding} can strengthen desired traits in cattle.
e.zh: 品系繁育可以强化牛群中理想的性状。

e.en: The kennel avoided excessive {linebreeding}.
e.zh: 这家犬舍避免过度近亲繁殖。

e.en: The old newspaper employed a skilled {linecaster}.
e.zh: 那家老报社雇用了一名熟练的整行铸字机操作员。

e.en: A {linecaster} prepared metal type for the press.
e.zh: 整行铸字机操作员为印刷机准备金属活字。

e.en: {Linecasting} changed the speed of newspaper production.
e.zh: 整行铸字排版改变了报纸生产的速度。

e.en: The museum displays early {linecasting} machines.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了早期的整行铸字排版机器。

e.en: The book included a small {linecut} of the church.
e.zh: 书中收有一幅教堂的小线刻版画。

e.en: Her {linecut} used sharp black outlines.
e.zh: 她的线刻版画用了鲜明的黑色轮廓线。

e.en: A {linelike} scar crossed his palm.
e.zh: 一道像线一样的疤痕横过他的手掌。

e.en: The drawing uses {linelike} marks for rain.
e.zh: 这幅画用线状笔触表现雨水。

e.en: The village {linendraper} sold sheets and towels.
e.zh: 村里的亚麻布商出售床单和毛巾。

e.en: A {linendraper} once occupied this narrow shop.
e.zh: 这间狭窄店铺从前是一家布料商的铺面。

e.en: The chemist mentioned {linene} in the old report.
e.zh: 化学家在那份旧报告中提到了亚麻烯。

e.en: {Linene} appears only in specialized chemical texts.
e.zh: 亚麻烯只出现在专业化学文献中。

e.en: The curtains were made of cheap {linenette}.
e.zh: 窗帘是用廉价的仿亚麻织物做的。

e.en: She chose {linenette} because it washed easily.
e.zh: 她选择仿亚麻织物，因为它容易清洗。

e.en: The cabinet door had a carved {linenfold} pattern.
e.zh: 柜门上有亚麻褶饰样式的木雕。

e.en: {Linenfold} panels were common in Tudor furniture.
e.zh: 亚麻褶饰嵌板在都铎式家具中很常见。

e.en: The shell has a {lineolate} surface.
e.zh: 这个贝壳表面有细线纹。

e.en: A {lineolate} leaf shows many tiny streaks.
e.zh: 有细线纹的叶子会显出许多细小条纹。

e.en: The old computer room kept a noisy {lineprinter}.
e.zh: 旧机房里保留着一台嘈杂的行式打印机。

e.en: A {lineprinter} printed whole lines at once.
e.zh: 行式打印机会一次打印整行文字。

e.en: The factory buys {linerboard} for shipping boxes.
e.zh: 工厂采购箱板纸来制作运输纸箱。

e.en: Strong {linerboard} protects the corrugated package.
e.zh: 结实的瓦楞面纸能保护瓦楞包装。

e.en: The workshop machines ran from one {lineshaft}.
e.zh: 车间里的机器由一根传动长轴带动。

e.en: A belt slipped off the old {lineshaft}.
e.zh: 一条皮带从旧传动长轴上滑了下来。

e.en: Workers cleared weeds from the {lineside} path.
e.zh: 工人清除了铁路沿线路径上的杂草。

e.en: A {lineside} signal warned approaching trains.
e.zh: 铁路沿线的信号灯警示驶近的列车。

e.en: The {linesider} checked the track after heavy rain.
e.zh: 暴雨后，铁路沿线工作人员检查了轨道。

e.en: A veteran {linesider} knew every curve of the route.
e.zh: 一名老铁路沿线工作人员熟悉这条线路的每个弯道。

e.en: The printer's {lineskipper} failed during the job.
e.zh: 打印机的跳行装置在作业中失灵了。

e.en: A careless {lineskipper} missed two rows of text.
e.zh: 粗心的跳行者漏看了两行文字。

e.en: The script uses {lineto} to draw the border.
e.zh: 脚本用画线到某点的命令来绘制边框。

e.en: Add a {lineto} command after the starting point.
e.zh: 在起点之后加入一个画线到某点的命令。

e.en: The {linewalker} inspected the power poles daily.
e.zh: 巡线员每天检查电线杆。

e.en: A railway {linewalker} reported damage near the bridge.
e.zh: 一名铁路巡线员报告桥边有损坏。

e.en: Increase the {linewidth} to make the chart clearer.
e.zh: 把线宽加大，可以让图表更清楚。

e.en: The editor wraps text based on the {linewidth}.
e.zh: 编辑器会根据行宽来换行。

e.en: Her comic art has clean {linework}.
e.zh: 她的漫画作品线条画法很干净。

e.en: The tattoo artist refined the {linework} first.
e.zh: 纹身师先细化了线描部分。

e.en: The old map looked faded and {liney}.
e.zh: 那张旧地图显得褪色，而且线条很多。

e.en: His {liney} sketch captured the street quickly.
e.zh: 他那幅线条感很强的速写很快捕捉了街景。

e.en: The sauce was made with tart {lingonberries}.
e.zh: 这种酱是用酸味越橘做的。

e.en: She sprinkled frozen {lingonberries} over the yogurt.
e.zh: 她把冷冻越橘撒在酸奶上。

e.en: A spoonful of {lingonberry} jam brightened the meal.
e.zh: 一勺越橘果酱让这顿饭更有味道。

e.en: The {lingonberry} grows in cold northern forests.
e.zh: 越橘生长在寒冷的北方森林里。

e.en: The shell has a narrow {linguate} shape.
e.zh: 这个贝壳呈狭长的舌状。

e.en: Botanists described the petal as {linguate}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这片花瓣描述为舌状。

e.en: The fossil showed a small {linguiform} plate.
e.zh: 这块化石上有一片小小的舌形板。

e.en: A {linguiform} leaf emerged from the stem.
e.zh: 一片舌形叶从茎上长了出来。

e.en: The {linguistician} studied sounds in village speech.
e.zh: 这位语言学家研究村民说话中的语音。

e.en: A historical {linguistician} compared old manuscripts.
e.zh: 一位历史语言学家比较了古老手稿。

e.en: Her essays show a deep interest in {linguistry}.
e.zh: 她的文章显示出对语言研究的浓厚兴趣。

e.en: The course treats {linguistry} as both science and art.
e.zh: 这门课把语言学视为科学也视为艺术。

e.en: The doctor pointed to the {lingula} on the scan.
e.zh: 医生在扫描图上指出了小舌状部。

e.en: A tiny {lingula} projects from the shell.
e.zh: 一个细小的舌状结构从壳上伸出。

e.en: The insect has a {lingulate} mouthpart.
e.zh: 这种昆虫有一个舌状口器。

e.en: The flower's {lingulate} rays are bright yellow.
e.zh: 这朵花的舌状花冠呈亮黄色。

e.en: Some speakers pronounce it with a {linguodental} sound.
e.zh: 有些说话者把它发成舌齿音。

e.en: The therapist checked his {linguodental} articulation.
e.zh: 治疗师检查了他的舌齿部位发音。

e.en: The paper offers a {linguostylistic} analysis of the poem.
e.zh: 这篇论文对诗歌作了语言风格学分析。

e.en: Her {linguostylistic} choices make the dialogue vivid.
e.zh: 她在语言风格上的选择让对话很生动。

e.en: The two systems need a secure {link-up}.
e.zh: 这两个系统需要安全连接。

e.en: The charity planned a {link-up} with local schools.
e.zh: 这家慈善机构计划与当地学校合作。

linkboy.t: 旧时持火把引路的男孩

e.en: A {linkboy} guided travelers through the dark street.
e.zh: 一个持火把的男孩引导旅人穿过黑暗的街道。

e.en: The novel mentions a poor {linkboy} outside the theater.
e.zh: 小说提到剧院外一个贫穷的引路男孩。

e.en: The old report named him as the {linkman} between the groups.
e.zh: 那份旧报告称他是两个团体之间的联络人。

e.en: Police arrested the {linkman} after months of surveillance.
e.zh: 警方经过数月监视后逮捕了那名中间人。

e.en: Several {linkmen} carried messages across the border.
e.zh: 几名联络员把消息带过了边境。

e.en: The investigation focused on the network's trusted {linkmen}.
e.zh: 调查重点放在该网络中受信任的中间人身上。

e.en: The veteran {linksman} handled the windy course calmly.
e.zh: 那位老练的高尔夫球手从容应对了多风的球场。

e.en: Every {linksman} feared the deep bunker near the green.
e.zh: 每个高尔夫球手都忌惮果岭旁的深沙坑。

e.en: The two systems need a stable {linkup} before launch.
e.zh: 这两个系统在上线前需要稳定连接。

e.en: Their {linkup} at the station was delayed by traffic.
e.zh: 他们在车站的会合因交通而推迟。

e.en: The bracelet's fine {linkwork} showed remarkable skill.
e.zh: 手镯精细的链式工艺显示出高超技艺。

e.en: Medieval gates often used iron {linkwork} for strength.
e.zh: 中世纪的门常用铁链结构来增强牢固度。

e.en: We heard the {linn} before we saw the water.
e.zh: 我们还没看见水流，就先听见了瀑布声。

e.en: Salmon gathered in the dark {linn} below the rocks.
e.zh: 鲑鱼聚集在岩石下方幽深的水潭里。

e.en: The label lists sodium {linoleate} among the ingredients.
e.zh: 标签在成分中列出了亚油酸钠。

e.en: Researchers measured the {linoleate} level in the oil sample.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了油样中的亚油酸盐含量。

e.en: Sunflower oil is rich in {linoleic} acid.
e.zh: 葵花籽油富含亚油酸。

e.en: The diet provided more {linoleic} fat than expected.
e.zh: 这种饮食提供的亚油酸类脂肪比预期更多。

e.en: Chemists separated {linolein} from the vegetable oil.
e.zh: 化学家从植物油中分离出亚油精。

e.en: The old textbook describes {linolein} as a glyceride.
e.zh: 那本旧教材把亚油精描述为一种甘油酯。

e.en: The supplement contains a small amount of {linolenate}.
e.zh: 这种补充剂含有少量亚麻酸盐。

e.en: Scientists tracked {linolenate} changes during storage.
e.zh: 科学家追踪了储存期间亚麻酸酯的变化。

e.en: The analysis detected {linolenin} in the seed oil.
e.zh: 分析在种子油中检测到了亚麻精。

e.en: Pure {linolenin} is mainly discussed in chemistry texts.
e.zh: 纯亚麻精主要出现在化学文本的讨论中。

e.en: The paper identified {linoleodistearin} in the fat mixture.
e.zh: 论文在脂肪混合物中鉴定出了亚油二硬脂精。

e.en: Few students encounter {linoleodistearin} outside lipid chemistry.
e.zh: 很少有学生会在脂质化学以外遇到亚油二硬脂精。

e.en: The ointment used {linolin} to soften dry skin.
e.zh: 这种软膏用羊毛脂来软化干燥皮肤。

e.en: Old formulas sometimes spell lanolin as {linolin}.
e.zh: 旧配方有时把羊毛脂拼作linolin。

e.en: A spotted {linsang} slipped through the forest at night.
e.zh: 一只斑点林狸夜里穿过森林。

e.en: The museum displayed a rare {linsang} specimen.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一件罕见的林狸标本。

e.en: Her plain dress was made of coarse {linsey}.
e.zh: 她那件朴素的裙子是用粗糙的亚麻羊毛混纺布做的。

e.en: The shop sold {linsey} for work clothes and blankets.
e.zh: 这家店出售亚麻羊毛混纺布，用来做工装和毯子。

linsey-woolsey.t: 亚麻羊毛混纺布；混杂物

e.en: The settler wore a coat of {linsey-woolsey}.
e.zh: 那名殖民者穿着一件亚麻羊毛混纺布外套。

e.en: His speech was a {linsey-woolsey} of facts and rumors.
e.zh: 他的讲话把事实和传闻混杂在一起。

e.en: The inventory listed several bolts of {linseys}.
e.zh: 库存清单列出了几匹亚麻羊毛混纺布。

e.en: Colonial households valued sturdy {linseys} for winter clothing.
e.zh: 殖民地家庭看重结实的亚麻羊毛混纺布，用来做冬衣。

e.en: The gunner raised the {linstock} toward the cannon.
e.zh: 炮手举起火绳杆伸向大炮。

e.en: A carved {linstock} hung beside the old artillery display.
e.zh: 一根雕刻过的火绳杆挂在旧火炮展品旁。

e.en: The old emblem suggested {lionship} and royal courage.
e.zh: 那枚旧徽章让人想到狮子般的气质和王者的勇气。

e.en: He claimed a kind of {lionship} over the small literary circle.
e.zh: 他声称自己在那个小文学圈里有某种狮王般的地位。

e.en: Their concern was only {lip-deep} after the cameras left.
e.zh: 摄像机离开后，他们的关心只是嘴上说说而已。

e.en: The reform remained {lip-deep}, with no real change in policy.
e.zh: 这项改革仍然很肤浅，政策上没有真正变化。

e.en: She put on clear {lip-gloss} before the interview.
e.zh: 面试前她涂了透明唇彩。

e.en: This {lip-gloss} tastes slightly like vanilla.
e.zh: 这款唇蜜尝起来有一点香草味。

e.en: The teacher used {lip-language} to support the deaf student.
e.zh: 老师用唇语帮助那名失聪学生理解。

e.en: Across the noisy room, their {lip-language} looked almost secret.
e.zh: 隔着嘈杂的房间，他们的读唇交流看起来几乎像秘密暗号。

e.en: She learned to {lip-read} after losing much of her hearing.
e.zh: 听力大幅下降后，她学会了读唇。

e.en: I could {lip-read} the warning from across the room.
e.zh: 我能从房间另一头看口型读出那句警告。

e.en: A skilled {lip-reader} helped the police review the video.
e.zh: 一名熟练的读唇者帮助警方查看录像。

e.en: As a {lip-reader}, he watched faces more than gestures.
e.zh: 作为会读唇的人，他看脸比看手势更多。

e.en: She {lip-reads} most conversations in crowded places.
e.zh: 在拥挤的地方，她大多靠读唇理解谈话。

e.en: The witness {lip-reads} the suspect's words on the silent footage.
e.zh: 证人在无声录像中看口型读出了嫌疑人的话。

e.en: The company paid {lip-service} to diversity but changed nothing.
e.zh: 公司口头支持多元化，却什么也没改变。

e.en: His apology sounded like {lip-service} rather than real regret.
e.zh: 他的道歉听起来像敷衍的空话，而不是真正后悔。

e.en: The viral {lip-syncer} copied every gesture from the music video.
e.zh: 那位走红的对口型表演者模仿了音乐视频里的每个手势。

e.en: A professional {lip-syncer} can make silent filming look convincing.
e.zh: 专业的对口型表演者能让无声拍摄显得很逼真。

e.en: The singer denied {lip-syncing} during the televised concert.
e.zh: 那名歌手否认在电视转播演唱会上假唱对口型。

e.en: Their {lip-syncing} video made the whole office laugh.
e.zh: 他们的对口型视频逗得整个办公室大笑。

e.en: He {lip-syncs} old pop songs on social media.
e.zh: 他在社交媒体上给老流行歌对口型。

e.en: The performer {lip-syncs} when the dance routine becomes too demanding.
e.zh: 舞蹈动作太吃力时，那位表演者会假唱对口型。

e.en: The script used {lip-syne} as an odd spelling of lip-sync.
e.zh: 剧本把lip-sync写成了少见的拼法lip-syne。

e.en: Editors corrected {lip-syne} before the poster went to print.
e.zh: 海报付印前，编辑把lip-syne这个异拼改正了。

e.en: The lab report mentioned {lipacidemia} after the fasting blood test.
e.zh: 空腹验血后，化验报告提到了血脂过多症。

e.en: Doctors monitored his {lipacidemia} while adjusting the diet.
e.zh: 医生在调整饮食时监测他的脂血症。

e.en: Severe {lipaemia} can make a blood sample look milky.
e.zh: 严重脂血症会让血样看起来呈乳白色。

e.en: The veterinarian suspected {lipaemia} in the pony's test results.
e.zh: 兽医怀疑那匹小马的检测结果显示脂血症。

e.en: The hillside contained pale {liparite} from an ancient eruption.
e.zh: 山坡上有古代喷发形成的浅色流纹岩。

e.en: Geologists once used {liparite} for certain volcanic rocks.
e.zh: 地质学家曾用liparite指称某些火山岩。

e.en: The pancreas produces {lipase} to help digest fats.
e.zh: 胰腺会产生脂肪酶来帮助消化脂肪。

e.en: High {lipase} levels may suggest inflammation of the pancreas.
e.zh: 脂肪酶水平偏高可能提示胰腺发炎。

e.en: Use a {lipbrush} to apply the dark lipstick neatly.
e.zh: 用唇刷可以把深色口红涂得更整齐。

e.en: She cleaned the {lipbrush} after every makeup session.
e.zh: 每次化妆后，她都会清洁那支唇刷。

e.en: The clinic performs several {lipectomies} each month.
e.zh: 这家诊所每个月会做几例脂肪切除术。

e.en: Some {lipectomies} are reconstructive rather than cosmetic.
e.zh: 有些脂肪切除术属于重建手术，而不是美容手术。

e.en: She asked about recovery time after a {lipectomy}.
e.zh: 她询问脂肪切除术后的恢复时间。

e.en: A {lipectomy} may remove excess tissue after major weight loss.
e.zh: 大幅减重后，脂肪切除术可以去除多余组织。

e.en: Her pink {lipgloss} matched the dress.
e.zh: 她的粉色唇彩和裙子很配。

e.en: This {lipgloss} adds shine without feeling sticky.
e.zh: 这款唇蜜能增加光泽，而且不会觉得黏。

e.en: The researcher measured {lipidal} changes in the cell membrane.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了细胞膜中的脂质变化。

e.en: A {lipidal} layer can affect how the drug is absorbed.
e.zh: 脂质层会影响药物的吸收方式。

e.en: The cream has a {lipidic} base that protects dry skin.
e.zh: 这款乳霜含有脂质基底，可以保护干燥皮肤。

e.en: Scientists studied the {lipidic} structure around the virus.
e.zh: 科学家研究了病毒周围的脂质结构。

e.en: The biopsy suggested {lipidosis} in the liver cells.
e.zh: 活检显示肝细胞可能有脂质沉积症。

e.en: Severe {lipidosis} can disrupt normal organ function.
e.zh: 严重的脂肪变性会影响器官的正常功能。

e.en: The researcher measured each {lipin} fraction separately.
e.zh: 研究人员分别测量了每一种脂质成分。

e.en: Older papers used {lipin} for several fatlike substances.
e.zh: 早期论文用脂质一词指多种脂肪样物质。

e.en: The flower had a {liplike} lower petal.
e.zh: 这朵花有一片像嘴唇的下瓣。

e.en: A {liplike} fold protected the small opening.
e.zh: 一道唇状褶皱保护着那个小开口。

e.en: The movie ended with a dramatic {liplock}.
e.zh: 电影以一个戏剧性的热吻收尾。

e.en: Reporters described their public {liplock} in detail.
e.zh: 记者详细描写了他们在公众场合的长时间接吻。

e.en: The infant was diagnosed with {lipoblastomatosis} after imaging.
e.zh: 影像检查后，这名婴儿被诊断为脂肪母细胞瘤病。

e.en: Diffuse {lipoblastomatosis} may require repeated surgery.
e.zh: 弥漫性脂肪母细胞瘤病可能需要多次手术。

e.en: Pathologists noted {lipoblastosis} in the tissue sample.
e.zh: 病理医生在组织样本中发现脂肪母细胞增生。

e.en: The report distinguished {lipoblastosis} from a malignant tumor.
e.zh: 报告把脂肪母细胞增生与恶性肿瘤区分开来。

e.en: Early studies proposed a {lipocaic} factor from the pancreas.
e.zh: 早期研究提出胰腺中存在一种脂肪代谢因子。

e.en: The term {lipocaic} is now mostly historical.
e.zh: 脂肪代谢因子的这个术语如今多属历史用法。

e.en: The specimen had a pale {lipoceratous} surface.
e.zh: 标本表面呈淡色的油蜡状。

e.en: A {lipoceratous} layer formed around the old tissue.
e.zh: 旧组织周围形成了一层脂蜡质层。

e.en: The section showed areas of {lipochondria} under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下切片显示有脂肪软骨样组织区域。

e.en: Doctors discussed whether the mass contained {lipochondria}.
e.zh: 医生讨论这个肿块是否含有脂肪软骨样组织。

e.en: Carotene is a common {lipochrome} in plants.
e.zh: 胡萝卜素是植物中常见的脂溶性色素。

e.en: The yellow color came from {lipochrome} deposits.
e.zh: 这种黄色来自脂色素沉积。

e.en: Each {lipocyte} stores energy as fat droplets.
e.zh: 每个脂肪细胞都以脂滴形式储存能量。

e.en: The microscope image showed an enlarged {lipocyte}.
e.zh: 显微图像显示一个增大的脂肪细胞。

e.en: The surgeon removed a small {lipodermoid} near the eye.
e.zh: 外科医生切除了眼旁一个小的脂性皮样瘤。

e.en: A congenital {lipodermoid} may remain stable for years.
e.zh: 先天性脂性皮样瘤可能多年保持稳定。

e.en: The chart used {lipodystrophia} as the older diagnosis.
e.zh: 病历中用脂肪营养不良症这个旧称作为诊断。

e.en: Generalized {lipodystrophia} affects fat distribution across the body.
e.zh: 全身性脂肪营养不良症会影响全身脂肪分布。

e.en: Some patients develop {lipodystrophy} after long treatment.
e.zh: 有些患者在长期治疗后会出现脂肪营养不良症。

e.en: Inherited {lipodystrophy} changes how the body stores fat.
e.zh: 遗传性脂肪营养不良症会改变身体储存脂肪的方式。

e.en: Insulin can increase {lipogenesis} after a meal.
e.zh: 饭后胰岛素会促进脂肪生成。

e.en: The drug reduced hepatic {lipogenesis} in the trial.
e.zh: 试验中这种药降低了肝脏脂质合成。

e.en: The team studied a {lipogenous} pathway in liver tissue.
e.zh: 团队研究了肝组织中的一条生脂途径。

e.en: Some hormones influence {lipogenous} activity after feeding.
e.zh: 进食后某些激素会影响生脂活动。

e.en: His poem was a {lipogram} without the letter e.
e.zh: 他的诗是一篇不用字母e的避字文。

e.en: Writing a {lipogram} forces unusual word choices.
e.zh: 写避字文会迫使作者选择不寻常的词。

e.en: The novel follows a strict {lipogrammatic} rule.
e.zh: 这部小说遵循严格的避字文规则。

e.en: Her {lipogrammatic} experiment avoided one vowel entirely.
e.zh: 她的省字文实验完全避开了一个元音字母。

e.en: The {lipogrammatist} rewrote every sentence without an e.
e.zh: 这位避字文作者把每个句子都改写到不含字母e。

e.en: A patient {lipogrammatist} can make constraints feel invisible.
e.zh: 有耐心的避字文作者能让限制显得不露痕迹。

e.en: He treated {lipography} as a playful literary challenge.
e.zh: 他把避字写作当作一种有趣的文学挑战。

e.en: Classical {lipography} often omits a chosen letter.
e.zh: 古典省字法常常省去一个选定的字母。

e.en: The blood sample showed marked {lipohemia}.
e.zh: 血液样本显示明显的脂血症。

e.en: Severe {lipohemia} can make serum appear milky.
e.zh: 严重脂血症会使血清看起来呈乳白色。

e.en: The disease involved {lipoid} deposits in the lungs.
e.zh: 这种疾病涉及肺部的类脂沉积。

e.en: Cholesterol was once grouped with {lipoid} substances.
e.zh: 胆固醇曾被归入脂质样物质。

e.en: The physician noted {lipoidaemia} in the laboratory report.
e.zh: 医生在化验报告中注意到脂血症。

e.en: Persistent {lipoidaemia} may signal a metabolic disorder.
e.zh: 持续性脂血症可能提示代谢异常。

e.en: You can {liquidize} the soup in a blender.
e.zh: 你可以用搅拌机把汤搅成液体状。

e.en: The plant can {liquidize} organic waste for processing.
e.zh: 这座工厂能将有机废料液化后再处理。

e.en: The cook added the {liquidized} vegetables to the sauce.
e.zh: 厨师把搅成泥状的蔬菜加进酱汁里。

e.en: The gas was {liquidized} under extreme pressure.
e.zh: 这种气体在极高压力下被液化了。

e.en: She made the smoothie in a {liquidizer}.
e.zh: 她用食物搅拌机做了这杯冰沙。

e.en: The laboratory bought a new {liquidizer} for samples.
e.zh: 实验室买了一台新的样品液化装置。

e.en: The kitchen keeps two {liquidizers} on the shelf.
e.zh: 厨房架子上放着两台食物搅拌机。

e.en: Industrial {liquidizers} can handle thick mixtures.
e.zh: 工业液化装置能处理浓稠的混合物。

e.en: This blender {liquidizes} fruit in seconds.
e.zh: 这台搅拌机几秒钟就能把水果搅成液体。

e.en: The machine {liquidizes} the material before filtering it.
e.zh: 机器会先把材料液化，然后再过滤。

e.en: She was {liquidizing} tomatoes for the sauce.
e.zh: 她正在把番茄搅成液体来做酱汁。

e.en: The process begins by {liquidizing} the raw material.
e.zh: 这个流程从液化原材料开始。

e.en: The material had a strange {liquidoid} texture.
e.zh: 这种材料有一种奇怪的类液体质感。

e.en: Scientists described the substance as {liquidoid} rather than solid.
e.zh: 科学家称这种物质更像液状，而不是固体。

e.en: The engineer checked the tank with a {liquidometer}.
e.zh: 工程师用液体测量仪检查了储罐。

e.en: A broken {liquidometer} gave the wrong reading.
e.zh: 坏掉的液体测量仪给出了错误读数。

liquidus.t: 液相线；完全液态温度线

e.en: The alloy crosses the {liquidus} at high temperature.
e.zh: 这种合金在高温下越过液相线。

e.en: Metallurgists plotted the {liquidus} on the phase diagram.
e.zh: 冶金学家把液相线标在相图上。

e.en: The report described soil {liquifaction} after the earthquake.
e.zh: 报告描述了地震后的土壤液化现象。

e.en: Gas {liquifaction} requires cooling and pressure.
e.zh: 气体液化需要降温和加压。

e.en: The chemist prepared a transparent {liquogel}.
e.zh: 化学家制备了一种透明的液凝胶。

e.en: This {liquogel} changes shape when heated.
e.zh: 这种液凝胶受热时会改变形状。

e.en: The cake had a faintly {liquorish} flavor.
e.zh: 这块蛋糕有一点像酒的味道。

e.en: His {liquorish} habits worried the family.
e.zh: 他爱喝酒的习惯让家人担心。

e.en: A {liquorous} smell drifted from the cellar.
e.zh: 地窖里飘出一股酒味。

e.en: The novel portrays a {liquorous} old sailor.
e.zh: 小说描写了一位嗜酒的老水手。

e.en: The dessert tasted rich and {liquory}.
e.zh: 这道甜点味道浓郁，还带着酒味。

e.en: A {liquory} warmth spread through the drink.
e.zh: 这杯饮料里散开一种像酒般的暖意。

e.en: The medieval hood ended in a long {liripipe}.
e.zh: 那顶中世纪兜帽末端拖着一条长尾。

e.en: His academic gown had a narrow {liripipe}.
e.zh: 他的学位袍上有一条细长的垂带。

e.en: The sample had a {lipoidal} texture under the microscope.
e.zh: 显微镜下，这个样本呈现出类脂质的质地。

e.en: Some drugs collect in {lipoidal} tissues more readily.
e.zh: 有些药物更容易聚集在脂质样组织中。

e.en: The biopsy suggested early {lipoidosis} in the liver.
e.zh: 活检结果提示肝脏出现早期脂质沉积症。

e.en: Inherited {lipoidosis} can affect several organs.
e.zh: 遗传性脂质沉积症可能影响多个器官。

e.en: Exercise can increase {lipolysis} during prolonged activity.
e.zh: 长时间运动时，运动会增加脂肪分解。

e.en: The hormone stimulates {lipolysis} in fat cells.
e.zh: 这种激素会刺激脂肪细胞中的脂肪分解。

e.en: The researchers measured the enzyme's {lipolytic} activity.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了这种酶的脂肪分解活性。

e.en: Caffeine may have a mild {lipolytic} effect.
e.zh: 咖啡因可能有轻微的促脂肪分解作用。

e.en: The doctor said the lump was a harmless {lipoma}.
e.zh: 医生说这个肿块是无害的脂肪瘤。

e.en: A large {lipoma} can sometimes press on nearby nerves.
e.zh: 较大的脂肪瘤有时会压迫附近神经。

e.en: Several small {lipomas} appeared on his upper arm.
e.zh: 他的上臂出现了几个小脂肪瘤。

e.en: Most {lipomas} do not need treatment unless they hurt.
e.zh: 大多数脂肪瘤如果不疼，并不需要治疗。

e.en: The scan showed diffuse {lipomatosis} around the pancreas.
e.zh: 扫描显示胰腺周围有弥漫性脂肪过多。

e.en: Familial {lipomatosis} may cause many benign lumps.
e.zh: 家族性脂肪瘤病可能造成许多良性肿块。

e.en: Pathology confirmed a {lipomatous} tumor in the thigh.
e.zh: 病理检查确认大腿内有脂肪瘤性肿瘤。

e.en: The mass had mostly {lipomatous} tissue on imaging.
e.zh: 影像显示这个肿块主要由脂肪样组织构成。

e.en: The old report described {liponephrosis} in the kidney tissue.
e.zh: 旧报告描述了肾组织中的肾脂肪变性。

e.en: Severe metabolic disease may lead to {liponephrosis}.
e.zh: 严重代谢性疾病可能导致肾脂肪变性。

e.en: The paper mentioned a {lipopectic} reaction in the cells.
e.zh: 论文提到细胞内发生了一种使脂肪凝固的反应。

e.en: Older physiology texts used {lipopectic} for fat-fixing processes.
e.zh: 较早的生理学教材用lipopectic指固定脂肪的过程。

e.en: The author used {lipopexia} to describe fat fixation in tissue.
e.zh: 作者用lipopexia来描述组织中的脂肪固定作用。

e.en: Few modern clinicians use the term {lipopexia}.
e.zh: 现在很少有临床医生使用lipopexia这个术语。

e.en: The study examined {lipophagia} inside damaged cells.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了受损细胞内的吞噬脂肪作用。

e.en: Macrophages may show {lipophagia} near injured tissue.
e.zh: 巨噬细胞在受伤组织附近可能表现出吞噬脂肪作用。

e.en: Bacterial {lipopolysaccharide} can trigger a strong immune response.
e.zh: 细菌脂多糖会触发强烈的免疫反应。

e.en: The lab added {lipopolysaccharide} to activate the cells.
e.zh: 实验室加入脂多糖来激活这些细胞。

e.en: The surgeon removed a rare {liposarcoma} from her leg.
e.zh: 外科医生从她腿部切除了一个罕见的脂肪肉瘤。

e.en: A {liposarcoma} may look like a benign fatty lump at first.
e.zh: 脂肪肉瘤起初可能看起来像良性的脂肪肿块。

e.en: The supplement label listed {lipositol} among its ingredients.
e.zh: 这款补充剂标签把脂肌醇列为成分之一。

e.en: Researchers discussed {lipositol} in relation to lipid metabolism.
e.zh: 研究人员讨论了脂肌醇与脂质代谢的关系。

e.en: Vitamin D is {liposoluble} and stored in body fat.
e.zh: 维生素D是脂溶性的，会储存在体脂中。

e.en: A {liposoluble} compound may cross cell membranes easily.
e.zh: 脂溶性化合物可能较容易穿过细胞膜。

e.en: The drug was delivered in a {liposomal} formulation.
e.zh: 这种药物以脂质体制剂形式递送。

e.en: Some vaccines use {liposomal} particles to carry antigens.
e.zh: 有些疫苗使用脂质体颗粒来携带抗原。

e.en: Choline is often described as a {lipotropic} nutrient.
e.zh: 胆碱常被描述为促进脂肪代谢的营养素。

e.en: The toxin showed {lipotropic} behavior in laboratory tests.
e.zh: 实验室测试中，这种毒素表现出亲脂性。

e.en: The pituitary gland can produce {lipotropin}.
e.zh: 垂体可以产生促脂解素。

e.en: Scientists studied {lipotropin} because it affects fat metabolism.
e.zh: 科学家研究促脂解素，因为它会影响脂肪代谢。

e.en: The molecule's {lipotropism} helped it enter fatty tissue.
e.zh: 这种分子的亲脂性帮助它进入脂肪组织。

e.en: Researchers measured viral {lipotropism} in cultured cells.
e.zh: 研究人员在培养细胞中测量了病毒的趋脂性。

e.en: Soybeans contain {lipoxidase}, which can affect flavor.
e.zh: 大豆含有脂氧合酶，会影响风味。

e.en: The assay detected {lipoxidase} activity in the extract.
e.zh: 检测发现提取物中有脂氧合酶活性。

e.en: You can {lippen} to his word in this matter.
e.zh: 在这件事上，你可以相信他的话。

e.en: The old farmer would {lippen} on fair weather.
e.zh: 那位老农会指望天气晴好。

e.en: She put a red {lippie} in her bag.
e.zh: 她把一支红色口红放进包里。

e.en: That glossy {lippie} lasts through lunch.
e.zh: 那支亮面唇膏能撑过午餐。

e.en: She learned to {lipread} after losing her hearing.
e.zh: 她失去听力后学会了读唇语。

e.en: It is hard to {lipread} someone wearing a mask.
e.zh: 对着戴口罩的人读唇语很难。

e.en: She learned {lipreading} after losing her hearing.
e.zh: 她失去听力后学会了读唇。

e.en: Accurate {lipreading} takes patience and practice.
e.zh: 准确读唇需要耐心和练习。

e.en: He {lipreads} most conversations in noisy rooms.
e.zh: 在嘈杂房间里，他大多靠读唇理解谈话。

e.en: The witness {lipreads} the silent security video.
e.zh: 证人通过读唇解读那段无声监控录像。

e.en: She chose a dark {liprouge} for the evening.
e.zh: 她为晚上的场合选了一支深色口红。

e.en: The old advertisement praised its waterproof {liprouge}.
e.zh: 那则旧广告称赞它的防水口红。

e.en: He kept {lipsalve} in his coat pocket.
e.zh: 他把润唇膏放在外套口袋里。

e.en: Cold wind made her reach for {lipsalve}.
e.zh: 冷风吹得她赶紧去拿护唇膏。

e.en: A {lipspeaker} repeated the speech silently for her.
e.zh: 一名唇语员为她无声地转述演讲内容。

e.en: The court provided a {lipspeaker} for the deaf witness.
e.zh: 法庭为那位失聪证人安排了唇语员。

e.en: The cup had a {lipsticky} mark on the rim.
e.zh: 杯沿上有一道沾着口红的痕迹。

e.en: Her {lipsticky} smile brightened the photograph.
e.zh: 她带着口红色泽的笑容让照片亮了起来。

e.en: The geologist identified the sample as {liptobiolite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这块样品鉴定为富沥青生物岩。

e.en: Layers of {liptobiolite} formed from ancient organic matter.
e.zh: 这些富沥青生物岩层由古老有机质形成。

e.en: The lab report noted possible {lipuria}.
e.zh: 化验报告提示可能有脂尿。

e.en: Doctors investigated {lipuria} after the unusual urine test.
e.zh: 尿检异常后，医生进一步检查脂尿问题。

e.en: Metallurgists {liquate} the alloy to separate impurities.
e.zh: 冶金师将合金熔化分离以去除杂质。

e.en: Heat can {liquate} certain metals before others soften.
e.zh: 加热可使某些金属先熔化分离，再让其他金属软化。

e.en: The {liquated} metal collected at the bottom.
e.zh: 熔化分离出的金属聚集在底部。

e.en: They tested the {liquated} material for purity.
e.zh: 他们检测了已熔化分离材料的纯度。

e.en: The chemist added a {liquefacient} to the mixture.
e.zh: 化学家向混合物中加入了一种液化剂。

e.en: Steam had a {liquefacient} effect on the wax.
e.zh: 蒸汽对蜡产生了液化作用。

e.en: The enzyme has a {liquefactive} action on tissue.
e.zh: 这种酶对组织有液化作用。

e.en: They studied the {liquefactive} stage of decomposition.
e.zh: 他们研究了分解过程中的液化阶段。

e.en: Natural gas is {liquefiable} under high pressure.
e.zh: 天然气在高压下可以液化。

e.en: The engineer chose a {liquefiable} fuel for storage.
e.zh: 工程师选择了一种可液化燃料便于储存。

e.en: The old text described a {liquefid} substance.
e.zh: 那本旧书描述了一种液态物质。

e.en: Heat turned the resin into a {liquefid} mass.
e.zh: 加热使树脂变成一团流质物。

e.en: The plant installed a new gas {liquefier}.
e.zh: 工厂安装了一台新的气体液化器。

e.en: This additive acts as a {liquefier} in the mix.
e.zh: 这种添加剂在混合物中起液化剂作用。

e.en: The old {liquer} stored barrels beneath the shop.
e.zh: 那位老酒商把木桶存放在店铺下面。

e.en: A skilled {liquer} blended herbs with clear spirits.
e.zh: 熟练的制酒者把草药与清澈烈酒调配在一起。

e.en: The crystals {liquesce} when exposed to damp air.
e.zh: 这些晶体遇到潮湿空气会液化。

e.en: Under steady heat, the wax began to {liquesce}.
e.zh: 在持续加热下，蜡开始融化成液体。

e.en: The experiment measured the salt's {liquescence}.
e.zh: 实验测量了这种盐的液化过程。

e.en: Early {liquescence} appeared along the sample's edge.
e.zh: 样品边缘较早出现了融化状态。

e.en: Humidity increased the powder's {liquescency}.
e.zh: 湿度提高了这种粉末的液化性。

e.en: The material's {liquescency} made storage difficult.
e.zh: 这种材料易液化，使储存变得困难。

e.en: The {liquescent} crystals clung to the glass.
e.zh: 正在液化的晶体粘在玻璃上。

e.en: They stored the {liquescent} compound in a dry room.
e.zh: 他们把这种易融化合物存放在干燥房间里。

e.en: The rocket used a {liquid-fueled} engine.
e.zh: 这枚火箭使用液体燃料发动机。

e.en: A {liquid-fueled} stove works well in cold weather.
e.zh: 液体燃料炉在寒冷天气中很好用。

e.en: A tall {liquidambar} shaded the garden path.
e.zh: 一棵高大的枫香树遮住了花园小径。

e.en: The nursery sells {liquidambar} for its autumn color.
e.zh: 苗圃出售枫香树，因为它秋色鲜艳。

lisianthus.t: 洋桔梗；草原龙胆花属植物

e.en: She carried a bouquet of white {lisianthus} at the wedding.
e.zh: 婚礼上她捧着一束白色洋桔梗。

e.en: The florist said {lisianthus} lasts well in a vase.
e.zh: 花店老板说洋桔梗插在花瓶里很耐放。

lispingly.t: 带咬舌音地；口齿不清地

e.en: The child spoke {lispingly} but with great confidence.
e.zh: 那个孩子说话带着咬舌音，却很有自信。

e.en: He read the line {lispingly} for comic effect.
e.zh: 他故意含糊带咬舌地念那句台词来制造喜剧效果。

lissom.t: 柔软轻盈的；身姿优雅的

e.en: The dancer moved with a {lissom} grace.
e.zh: 舞者动作柔软轻盈，姿态优雅。

e.en: A {lissom} branch bent in the wind.
e.zh: 一根柔韧的树枝在风中弯了下来。

e.en: The study described the group as {lissotrichous}.
e.zh: 那项研究把这个群体描述为直发特征。

e.en: She used the technical word {lissotrichous} in her anthropology paper.
e.zh: 她在 anthropology 论文中用了“直发的”这个专业词。

e.en: Each {listee} received a confirmation email.
e.zh: 名单上的每个人都收到了一封确认邮件。

e.en: The charity checked whether the {listee} still needed support.
e.zh: 慈善机构核实名单上的人是否仍需要帮助。

e.en: A narrow {listel} framed the marble panel.
e.zh: 一条细窄的装饰线脚围住了大理石板。

e.en: The restorer replaced the broken {listel} above the doorway.
e.zh: 修复师更换了门楣上破损的小嵌条。

e.en: The operator could {listen-in} on the call.
e.zh: 接线员可以监听那通电话。

e.en: Students were allowed to {listen-in} during the seminar.
e.zh: 学生获准旁听那场研讨会。

e.en: A silent {listener-in} heard the entire discussion.
e.zh: 一名沉默的旁听者听完了整场讨论。

e.en: The radio host welcomed every {listener-in} from abroad.
e.zh: 电台主持人欢迎每一位海外收听者。

e.en: The army built a {listening-post} near the border.
e.zh: 军方在边境附近建立了一个监听哨。

e.en: The embassy served as a political {listening-post}.
e.zh: 那座大使馆成了政治情报观察点。

listerize.t: 用防腐法处理；消毒灭菌

e.en: Surgeons once tried to {listerize} instruments with antiseptic spray.
e.zh: 外科医生曾尝试用防腐喷雾给器械消毒。

e.en: The old manual explained how to {listerize} a wound.
e.zh: 那本旧手册说明了如何用防腐法处理伤口。

listeth.t: 倾听；古体第三人称单数

e.en: He {listeth} to the tale in silence.
e.zh: 他静静地听着那个故事。

e.en: The old verse says that wisdom {listeth} before speaking.
e.zh: 那句古诗说，智慧在开口前先倾听。

lisztomania.t: 李斯特狂热；偶像式狂迷

e.en: The pianist's tour inspired a kind of {lisztomania}.
e.zh: 那位钢琴家的巡演引发了一种李斯特式狂热。

e.en: Critics compared the fans' screams to nineteenth-century {lisztomania}.
e.zh: 评论家把粉丝的尖叫比作十九世纪的李斯特狂热。

e.en: She found {lit-crit} harder than the novels themselves.
e.zh: 她觉得文学批评比小说本身还难。

e.en: His {lit-crit} seminar focused on modern poetry.
e.zh: 他的文学评论研讨课聚焦现代诗。

e.en: She peeled a fresh {litchi} after lunch.
e.zh: 午饭后她剥了一颗新鲜荔枝。

e.en: The dessert had a light {litchi} flavor.
e.zh: 这道甜点带有淡淡的荔枝味。

literal-minded.t: 按字面理解的；死板认真的

e.en: A {literal-minded} reader may miss the joke.
e.zh: 按字面理解的读者可能会错过这个笑点。

e.en: His {literal-minded} answer frustrated the teacher.
e.zh: 他过于死板认真的回答让老师很无奈。

e.en: The director chose to {literalise} the metaphor on stage.
e.zh: 导演选择在舞台上把这个隐喻具体字面化。

e.en: Do not {literalise} every image in the poem.
e.zh: 不要把诗里的每个意象都按字面解释。

literalist.t: 字面主义者；按字面解释者

e.en: A biblical {literalist} rejected symbolic readings.
e.zh: 一位圣经字面主义者拒绝象征性的解读。

e.en: The lawyer sounded like a strict {literalist}.
e.zh: 那位律师听起来像个严格按字面解释的人。

literalistic.t: 字面主义的；拘泥字面的

e.en: Her {literalistic} reading ignored the poem's irony.
e.zh: 她拘泥字面的解读忽略了诗中的反讽。

e.en: The film gave a {literalistic} version of the myth.
e.zh: 这部电影把神话处理成了非常字面化的版本。

e.en: The joke depends on the {literality} of the phrase.
e.zh: 这个笑话依赖于那句话的字面性。

e.en: She questioned the {literality} of the translation.
e.zh: 她质疑这段译文是否过于照字面理解。

literarycritical.t: 文学批评的；文学评论的

e.en: Her {literarycritical} essay challenged the usual reading of the poem.
e.zh: 她的文学批评论文挑战了对这首诗的通常解读。

e.en: The journal publishes mainly {literarycritical} studies of modern fiction.
e.zh: 这本期刊主要发表关于现代小说的文学评论研究。

e.en: The sentence sounded elegant, but its {literaryism} felt forced.
e.zh: 这个句子听起来优雅，但其中的文学腔显得勉强。

e.en: Critics noted a subtle {literaryism} borrowed from older prose.
e.zh: 评论家注意到一种从旧散文中借来的细微文学用语。

e.en: The clerk copied the statement {literatim} into the record.
e.zh: 书记员把那份陈述逐字抄进记录里。

e.en: She quoted the old contract {literatim} during the hearing.
e.zh: 她在听证会上逐字引用了那份旧合同。

e.en: The scholar studied the {literation} of sounds in early manuscripts.
e.zh: 这位学者研究早期手稿中声音的文字表达。

e.en: Different systems of {literation} made the name appear in several forms.
e.zh: 不同的字母化书写体系让这个名字出现了几种形式。

e.en: The {literator} chose a spelling that matched the local pronunciation.
e.zh: 这名转写者选择了符合当地发音的拼写。

e.en: A careful {literator} preserves both sound and readability.
e.zh: 细心的音译者会同时保留读音和可读性。

e.en: The old catalogue used {literatrue} where modern editors would write literature.
e.zh: 这本旧目录用了literatrue这个词，现代编辑会写作literature。

e.en: He treated the misspelled {literatrue} as a historical variant.
e.zh: 他把这个拼写有异的literatrue视为历史变体。

e.en: The retired professor lived like a quiet {literatus} among his books.
e.zh: 这位退休教授像安静的文人一样生活在书堆里。

e.en: In the novel, the village {literatus} writes letters for everyone.
e.zh: 在小说中，村里的读书人为大家代写书信。

e.en: The fragment was labeled {lith} in the mineral cabinet.
e.zh: 这块碎片在矿物柜中被标为石类样本。

e.en: Older chemistry notes sometimes used {lith} for lithium compounds.
e.zh: 较早的化学笔记有时用lith指锂化合物。

e.en: The physician prescribed a {lithagogue} to help pass the stone.
e.zh: 医生开了一种排石药，帮助排出结石。

e.en: Old medical texts praised this herb as a mild {lithagogue}.
e.zh: 旧医学文献称赞这种草药是一种温和的促排石剂。

e.en: The chemist identified the deposit as {lithamide} in an old report.
e.zh: 化学家在一份旧报告中把沉积物鉴定为尿酸铵。

e.en: Few modern students encounter the term {lithamide} outside historical chemistry.
e.zh: 现代学生很少在化学史以外遇到lithamide这个术语。

e.en: The glaze contained {litharge}, which made the pottery dangerous.
e.zh: 这种釉料含有一氧化铅，使陶器变得危险。

e.en: Medieval painters sometimes used {litharge} in preparing pigments.
e.zh: 中世纪画家有时用密陀僧来制备颜料。

e.en: The doctor found a {lithate} deposit in the sample.
e.zh: 医生在样本中发现了尿酸盐沉积。

e.en: Old laboratory notes describe the crystals as {lithate}.
e.zh: 旧实验记录把这些晶体描述为尿酸盐。

e.en: The diagnosis of {lithemia} explained his recurring joint pain.
e.zh: 血尿酸过多症的诊断解释了他反复出现的关节痛。

e.en: Diet was once considered central in treating {lithemia}.
e.zh: 过去人们认为饮食是治疗血尿酸过多症的关键。

e.en: The paper discussed {lithergol} as an experimental vascular drug.
e.zh: 论文讨论了作为实验性血管药物的利舍戈尔。

e.en: Patients receiving {lithergol} were monitored for blood pressure changes.
e.zh: 接受利舍戈尔治疗的患者会被监测血压变化。

e.en: The dancer moved with a {lithesome} grace across the stage.
e.zh: 舞者以柔软轻盈的姿态穿过舞台。

e.en: Despite his age, he remained surprisingly {lithesome}.
e.zh: 尽管年纪不小，他仍然出人意料地敏捷。

e.en: The spring was advertised as rich in {lithia}.
e.zh: 这处泉水被宣传为富含锂成分。

e.en: The analysis detected traces of {lithia} in the mineral sample.
e.zh: 分析在矿物样本中检测到微量氧化锂。

e.en: Kidney pain may be a sign of {lithiasis}.
e.zh: 肾部疼痛可能是结石病的征兆。

e.en: The study examined risk factors for biliary {lithiasis}.
e.zh: 这项研究考察了胆道结石形成的风险因素。

e.en: Archaeologists found {lithic} tools near the riverbank.
e.zh: 考古学家在河岸附近发现了石器工具。

e.en: The sculpture has a rough, {lithic} surface.
e.zh: 这座雕塑有粗糙的石质表面。

e.en: Pressure and minerals drive the {lithification} of loose sediment.
e.zh: 压力和矿物质推动松散沉积物发生岩化作用。

e.en: The textbook explains {lithification} as a key step in forming sedimentary rock.
e.zh: 教材把成岩过程解释为形成沉积岩的关键步骤。

e.en: Over time, the buried sand will {lithify} into sandstone.
e.zh: 随着时间推移，被埋的沙子会岩化成砂岩。

e.en: Mineral cement can {lithify} layers of loose sediment.
e.zh: 矿物胶结物可以使松散沉积层岩化。

e.en: The geologist classified the specimen as a dark {lithite}.
e.zh: 地质学家把这个标本归为一种深色石质岩。

e.en: Old mineral guides used {lithite} for certain lithium-bearing stones.
e.zh: 旧矿物指南用lithite指某些含锂石类。

e.en: Water seeped through a narrow {lithoclase} in the cliff.
e.zh: 水从悬崖上一道狭窄的岩石裂隙渗出。

e.en: The survey mapped each {lithoclase} before drilling began.
e.zh: 钻探开始前，测量人员绘制了每条石裂面的位置。

e.en: The biologist observed a {lithocyst} under the microscope.
e.zh: 生物学家在显微镜下观察到一个平衡囊。

e.en: In some organisms, a {lithocyst} helps detect gravity.
e.zh: 在某些生物中，平衡囊有助于感知重力。

e.en: The {lithodomous} mollusk bored into the soft limestone.
e.zh: 这种钻石而居的软体动物钻入了较软的石灰岩。

e.en: Divers found {lithodomous} shells embedded in the reef.
e.zh: 潜水员发现穿岩贝壳嵌在礁石中。

e.en: The shale belongs to a deep-water {lithofacies}.
e.zh: 这层页岩属于深水岩相。

e.en: Mapping each {lithofacies} helped reconstruct the ancient shoreline.
e.zh: 绘制每个岩性相有助于重建古海岸线。

e.en: The paper discusses {lithogenesy} in volcanic islands.
e.zh: 这篇论文讨论火山岛的岩石成因。

e.en: Understanding {lithogenesy} helps explain the basin's history.
e.zh: 了解成岩过程有助于解释这个盆地的历史。

e.en: The museum preserves several {lithographical} posters from the 1890s.
e.zh: 博物馆保存着几张十九世纪九十年代的平版印刷海报。

e.en: Her {lithographical} technique produced soft, detailed shadows.
e.zh: 她的石版画技法呈现出柔和而细致的阴影。

e.en: The maps were reproduced {lithographically} for wider distribution.
e.zh: 这些地图用平版印刷方式复制，以便更广泛发行。

e.en: He rendered the portrait {lithographically} rather than engraving it.
e.zh: 他用石版画方式表现这幅肖像，而不是雕版。

e.en: The tumor contained a hard, {lithoid} mass.
e.zh: 肿瘤里有一块坚硬的石状团块。

e.en: Weathering gave the clay a {lithoid} texture.
e.zh: 风化作用使黏土呈现出似石的质地。

e.en: The surgeon recommended {litholapaxy} for the bladder stone.
e.zh: 外科医生建议对膀胱结石做碎石洗出术。

e.en: Modern {litholapaxy} usually requires careful irrigation afterward.
e.zh: 现代碎石洗出术通常之后需要仔细冲洗。

e.en: The team mapped every {lithologic} change in the core.
e.zh: 团队标记了岩芯中的每一次岩性变化。

e.en: A {lithologic} description accompanied each sample.
e.zh: 每个样本都附有岩石学描述。

e.en: The report includes a detailed {lithological} column.
e.zh: 报告包含一份详细的岩性柱状图。

e.en: They compared the {lithological} features of two valleys.
e.zh: 他们比较了两个山谷的岩石学特征。

e.en: Different {lithologies} respond differently to erosion.
e.zh: 不同岩性类型对侵蚀的反应不同。

e.en: The basin contains several mixed {lithologies}.
e.zh: 这个盆地包含几种混合岩石组合。

e.en: The well log records the {lithology} at each depth.
e.zh: 测井记录了每个深度的岩性。

e.en: She studied {lithology} before joining the survey team.
e.zh: 她在加入勘测队之前学过岩石学。

e.en: The novel mentions {lithomancy} in a medieval ritual.
e.zh: 小说在一个中世纪仪式中提到了石占术。

e.en: Some occult traditions used {lithomancy} for guidance.
e.zh: 一些神秘传统用石头占卜来寻求指引。

e.en: The deposit included soft white {lithomarge}.
e.zh: 这个矿床含有柔软的白色石脂土。

e.en: Miners once mistook {lithomarge} for a poor ore.
e.zh: 矿工们曾把高岭质黏土误认为贫矿。

e.en: A dust storm is a common {lithometeor} in dry regions.
e.zh: 沙尘暴是干旱地区常见的大气尘粒现象。

e.en: The observer recorded haze as a {lithometeor}.
e.zh: 观测员把霾记录为一种尘象。

e.en: The old textbook describes {lithonephrotomy} in detail.
e.zh: 这本旧教材详细描述了肾切开取石术。

e.en: Before modern techniques, {lithonephrotomy} carried serious risks.
e.zh: 在现代技术出现以前，肾切开取石术风险很高。

e.en: The doctor discussed a {lithontriptic} treatment for the stones.
e.zh: 医生讨论了一种针对结石的碎石治疗。

e.en: An old pharmacopoeia listed several {lithontriptic} remedies.
e.zh: 一本旧药典列出了几种溶石药方。

e.en: Some {lithophagous} mollusks bore into limestone.
e.zh: 一些钻石而生的软体动物会钻入石灰岩。

e.en: The legend described a {lithophagous} creature under the mountain.
e.zh: 传说描写了山下一种食石生物。

e.en: The lamp shade contained a delicate {lithophane}.
e.zh: 灯罩里嵌着一件精致的透光瓷画。

e.en: A {lithophane} reveals its image when backlit.
e.zh: 薄瓷浮雕在背光照射下会显出图像。

e.en: The workshop taught traditional {lithophany} to ceramic artists.
e.zh: 工作坊向陶艺家教授传统透光瓷画工艺。

e.en: Her interest in {lithophany} began with antique lamps.
e.zh: 她对透光瓷画工艺的兴趣始于古董灯具。

e.en: Magnesium is classified as a {lithophile} element.
e.zh: 镁被归类为亲石元素。

e.en: The survey recorded each {lithophile} growing on exposed rock.
e.zh: 调查记录了每种生长在裸露岩石上的喜岩生物。

e.en: These {lithophilous} plants thrive on bare cliffs.
e.zh: 这些喜岩植物在裸露峭壁上生长良好。

e.en: Oxygen is strongly {lithophilous} in geochemical classification.
e.zh: 在地球化学分类中，氧具有很强的亲石性。

e.en: The rhyolite sample showed a clear {lithophysa}.
e.zh: 这块流纹岩样本显示出清晰的石泡构造。

e.en: A {lithophysa} can form as gases expand in cooling lava.
e.zh: 石泡可在冷却熔岩中气体膨胀时形成。

e.en: The fern is a {lithophyte} that roots in rock cracks.
e.zh: 这种蕨类是岩生植物，会扎根在岩缝里。

e.en: Early naturalists sometimes called corals a {lithophyte}.
e.zh: 早期博物学家有时把珊瑚称为石生生物。

e.en: The guide lists several {lithophytic} orchids.
e.zh: 这本指南列出了几种岩生兰花。

e.en: Coral was once described as a {lithophytic} organism.
e.zh: 珊瑚曾被描述为石生生物。

e.en: The factory used {lithopone} in white paint.
e.zh: 工厂在白色油漆中使用立德粉。

e.en: Old formulas mixed {lithopone} with other pigments.
e.zh: 旧配方把锌钡白颜料与其他颜料混合。

e.en: The archive acquired a rare {lithoprint} of the harbor.
e.zh: 档案馆购入了一幅罕见的港口平版印刷品。

e.en: They chose to {lithoprint} the illustrations cheaply.
e.zh: 他们选择用石版印刷廉价制作插图。

e.en: The hillside was covered with shallow {lithosol}.
e.zh: 山坡上覆盖着浅薄的石质土。

e.en: Crops struggle in {lithosol} because it holds little water.
e.zh: 作物在石质土中生长困难，因为它蓄水很少。

e.en: Her dissertation in {liturgiology} compared Eastern and Western rites.
e.zh: 她的礼拜仪式学论文比较了东西方礼仪。

e.en: The seminar treated {liturgiology} as a historical discipline.
e.zh: 研讨课把礼拜仪式学作为一门历史学科来讲。

liturgism.t: 重视礼拜仪式；礼仪主义

e.en: His strict {liturgism} shaped every Sunday service.
e.zh: 他严格的礼仪主义影响了每个主日礼拜。

e.en: Critics saw the reform as excessive {liturgism}.
e.zh: 批评者认为这项改革过分重视礼拜仪式。

live-action.t: 真人实拍的；现场动作的

e.en: The studio announced a {live-action} remake of the cartoon.
e.zh: 制片厂宣布要把这部动画翻拍成真人实拍版。

e.en: The director mixed animation with {live-action} scenes.
e.zh: 导演把动画和真人实拍场景结合在一起。

e.en: Their neighborhood follows a {live-and-let-live} attitude.
e.zh: 他们社区奉行互相宽容、各过各的态度。

e.en: After years of arguing, they chose a {live-and-let-live} arrangement.
e.zh: 争吵多年后，他们选择了互不干涉的相处方式。

e.en: The fisherman bought {live-bait} before dawn.
e.zh: 渔夫天亮前买了活饵。

e.en: Some lakes ban {live-bait} to protect native fish.
e.zh: 一些湖泊为保护本地鱼类禁止使用活饵。

e.en: A guppy is a common {live-bearer} in home aquariums.
e.zh: 孔雀鱼是家用水族箱里常见的胎生鱼。

e.en: The breeder separated each pregnant {live-bearer}.
e.zh: 饲养员把每条怀孕的胎生鱼都隔离开。

e.en: He kept the minnows fresh in a {live-box}.
e.zh: 他把小鱼放在活饵箱里保持鲜活。

e.en: The boat's {live-box} held the day's catch.
e.zh: 船上的活鱼舱装着当天捕到的鱼。

e.en: The gardener planted {live-forever} along the stone path.
e.zh: 园丁在石径旁种了长生草。

e.en: Old herbals praised {live-forever} for its hardiness.
e.zh: 旧草药书称赞长生草生命力顽强。

e.en: They hired a {live-in} nurse for their father.
e.zh: 他们为父亲雇了一名住家护士。

e.en: Her {live-in} partner works nights.
e.zh: 她的同居伴侣上夜班。

e.en: The farm moved its {live-stock} before the storm.
e.zh: 暴风雨前，农场把牲畜转移走了。

e.en: Disease can spread quickly among crowded {live-stock}.
e.zh: 疾病会在拥挤的家畜中迅速传播。

live-wire.t: 带电电线；精力旺盛的人

e.en: Never touch a fallen {live-wire}.
e.zh: 千万不要碰掉落的带电电线。

e.en: At parties, Maya is a real {live-wire}.
e.zh: 在聚会上，玛雅真是个精力充沛的人。

e.en: The city improved its {liveability} with better parks.
e.zh: 这座城市通过改善公园提升了宜居性。

e.en: High rents have reduced the area's {liveability}.
e.zh: 高房租降低了这个地区的宜居程度。

e.en: The poster described the film as {liveaction}.
e.zh: 海报称这部电影是真人实拍作品。

e.en: Fans debated whether {liveaction} suited the story.
e.zh: 粉丝们争论真人实拍是否适合这个故事。

e.en: The molly is a hardy {livebearer}.
e.zh: 玛丽鱼是一种耐养的胎生鱼。

e.en: Each {livebearer} was moved to a separate tank.
e.zh: 每条胎生鱼都被移到单独的鱼缸里。

e.en: The report counted only {liveborn} infants.
e.zh: 这份报告只统计活产婴儿。

e.en: A {liveborn} calf needs warmth immediately.
e.zh: 活产的小牛出生后马上需要保暖。

lived-in.t: 有人住过的；舒适自然的

e.en: The apartment had a warm, {lived-in} feeling.
e.zh: 这套公寓有一种温暖而自然的居家感。

e.en: His jacket looked soft and {lived-in}.
e.zh: 他的夹克看起来柔软又穿得很顺手。

e.en: She spoke {livelily} about her travels.
e.zh: 她生动地谈起自己的旅行。

e.en: The tune was played {livelily} by the band.
e.zh: 乐队把这支曲子演奏得很活泼。

e.en: The printer locked the {liveplate} into the press.
e.zh: 印刷工把活版板固定进印刷机。

e.en: Do not touch the {liveplate} during the test.
e.zh: 测试期间不要触碰带电板。

e.en: He blamed his fatigue on a {liver-complaint}.
e.zh: 他把疲劳归咎于肝脏不适。

e.en: Old medical notes mention a chronic {liver-complaint}.
e.zh: 旧病历提到一种慢性肝病。

e.en: After the heavy meal, he felt {liverish}.
e.zh: 吃完那顿油腻的大餐后，他觉得肝胃不适。

e.en: She woke in a {liverish} mood.
e.zh: 她醒来时心情烦躁、脾气很差。

e.en: The {litoral} villages depend on fishing.
e.zh: 这些沿海村庄依靠捕鱼为生。

e.en: Scientists studied the {litoral} plants near the lake.
e.zh: 科学家研究了湖滨一带的植物。

e.en: Calling the disaster 'not ideal' was classic {litotes}.
e.zh: 把这场灾难说成“不太理想”是典型的反叙法。

e.en: Her speech used {litotes} to sound modest.
e.zh: 她的演讲用了曲言法，听起来更谦逊。

e.en: The {litten} candles warmed the dark chapel.
e.zh: 点燃的蜡烛让黑暗的小教堂显得温暖。

e.en: A {litten} window glowed across the street.
e.zh: 街对面一扇亮着的窗户发出光来。

e.en: She tossed the receipt into the {litter-basket}.
e.zh: 她把收据扔进了废纸篓。

e.en: The office {litter-basket} was already full.
e.zh: 办公室的垃圾篮已经满了。

e.en: Please put the wrapper in the {litter-bin}.
e.zh: 请把包装纸放进垃圾箱。

e.en: A metal {litter-bin} stood by the bus stop.
e.zh: 公交站旁放着一个金属废物箱。

e.en: The sign warned every {litter-lout} about fines.
e.zh: 告示警告每个乱扔垃圾的人会被罚款。

e.en: No one wants a {litter-lout} spoiling the park.
e.zh: 没人希望有乱扔垃圾的人破坏公园环境。

e.en: The aging {litterateur} wrote essays in a cafe.
e.zh: 那位上了年纪的文人在咖啡馆里写散文。

e.en: Critics saw him as a refined {litterateur}.
e.zh: 评论家认为他是一位高雅的文学家。

e.en: The clerk copied the order {litteratim}.
e.zh: 职员逐字照抄了那份命令。

e.en: She quoted the old rule {litteratim} in court.
e.zh: 她在法庭上逐字引用了那条旧规定。

e.en: The young {litteratrice} published reviews and poems.
e.zh: 这位年轻女文人发表了评论和诗歌。

e.en: Paris salons welcomed the famous {litteratrice}.
e.zh: 巴黎沙龙欢迎那位著名女文学家。

e.en: Keep a {litterbag} in the car for wrappers.
e.zh: 车里放个垃圾袋，用来装包装纸。

e.en: The airline provided a small {litterbag}.
e.zh: 航空公司提供了一个小杂物袋。

e.en: He dropped the cup into the {litterbin}.
e.zh: 他把杯子丢进了垃圾箱。

e.en: The council installed a new {litterbin} outside school.
e.zh: 市政部门在学校外安装了一个新的废物箱。

e.en: Don't be a {litterbug} on the beach.
e.zh: 在海滩上别做乱扔垃圾的人。

e.en: The campaign asked every {litterbug} to change habits.
e.zh: 这场宣传活动呼吁乱扔垃圾的人改变习惯。

e.en: The park hired guards to catch {litterbugs}.
e.zh: 公园雇了保安来抓乱扔垃圾的人。

e.en: Local children made posters shaming {litterbugs}.
e.zh: 当地孩子制作海报谴责乱扔垃圾的人。

littery.t: 满是垃圾的；杂乱肮脏的

e.en: The alley looked {littery} after the festival.
e.zh: 节日过后，那条小巷显得满是垃圾。

e.en: He disliked the {littery} beach near the pier.
e.zh: 他不喜欢码头附近那片脏乱的海滩。

e.en: Her {little-appreciated} research later changed medicine.
e.zh: 她那项鲜少受赏识的研究后来改变了医学。

e.en: The museum highlights {little-appreciated} local artists.
e.zh: 博物馆重点介绍鲜少受赏识的本地艺术家。

e.en: The book reveals a {little-known} fact about Lincoln.
e.zh: 这本书揭示了一个关于林肯的鲜为人知的事实。

e.en: They visited a {little-known} village in the mountains.
e.zh: 他们参观了山里一个鲜为人知的村庄。

e.en: We ordered steamed {littleneck} clams for dinner.
e.zh: 晚餐我们点了清蒸小圆蛤。

e.en: The chef added {littlenecks} to the chowder.
e.zh: 厨师在浓汤里加了小蛤蜊。

e.en: The {littlest} child wanted another story.
e.zh: 最小的孩子还想再听一个故事。

e.en: She kept the {littlest} piece for herself.
e.zh: 她把最小的一块留给了自己。

e.en: The room felt {littlish} for six guests.
e.zh: 这个房间住六位客人显得有点小。

e.en: He gave a {littlish} smile and looked away.
e.zh: 他露出一个略小而含蓄的微笑，然后移开视线。

e.en: The biologist found a {littorinid} on the rock.
e.zh: 生物学家在岩石上发现了一只滨螺科软体动物。

e.en: Each {littorinid} clung tightly during low tide.
e.zh: 退潮时，每只滨螺科动物都紧紧附着着。

e.en: The museum displayed bronze {litui} from antiquity.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了古代青铜弯号。

e.en: Priests carried {litui} in the old ceremony.
e.zh: 祭司们在古老仪式中携带弯杖。

e.en: The choir followed the {liturgic} calendar closely.
e.zh: 唱诗班严格遵循礼拜仪式日历。

e.en: He studied old {liturgic} texts in Latin.
e.zh: 他研究用拉丁文写成的古老礼仪文本。

liturgician.t: 礼仪学者；礼拜仪式专家

e.en: A {liturgician} advised the church on the service.
e.zh: 一位礼仪学者为教会的礼拜安排提供建议。

e.en: The {liturgician} explained the meaning of each prayer.
e.zh: 礼拜仪式专家解释了每段祷文的含义。

e.en: She teaches {liturgics} at a theological college.
e.zh: 她在一所神学院教授礼仪学。

e.en: His article links music and {liturgics}.
e.zh: 他的文章把音乐与礼拜仪式研究联系起来。

liturgiologist.t: 礼仪学家；礼拜仪式研究者

e.en: The {liturgiologist} compared Eastern and Western rites.
e.zh: 这位礼仪学家比较了东西方礼仪。

e.en: A careful {liturgiologist} traced the prayer's history.
e.zh: 一位严谨的礼拜仪式研究者追溯了这段祷文的历史。

e.en: The geologist mapped each {lithosome} separately.
e.zh: 地质学家把每个岩石体分别标出。

e.en: This {lithosome} records an ancient shoreline.
e.zh: 这个岩相单元记录了一条古海岸线。

e.en: The earthquake began along a {lithospheric} fault.
e.zh: 这次地震始于一条岩石圈断层。

e.en: Scientists modeled {lithospheric} plates beneath the ocean.
e.zh: 科学家模拟了海洋下方的岩石圈板块。

e.en: The team revised the {lithostratigraphic} boundaries.
e.zh: 研究团队修订了岩石地层学界线。

e.en: A {lithostratigraphic} unit can span several fossil zones.
e.zh: 一个岩石地层学单位可能跨越几个化石带。

e.en: She specializes in {lithostratigraphy} of desert basins.
e.zh: 她专攻沙漠盆地的岩石地层学。

e.en: The report used {lithostratigraphy} to compare the drill cores.
e.zh: 报告用岩石地层学来比较这些钻芯。

e.en: The museum displayed a delicate {lithotint}.
e.zh: 博物馆展出了一幅精细的石版淡彩画。

e.en: Her {lithotint} softened the harsh mountain scene.
e.zh: 她的石版淡彩画让严峻的山景显得柔和。

e.en: The old surgeon kept a silver {lithotome}.
e.zh: 那位老外科医生保存着一把银制膀胱结石切开刀。

e.en: A {lithotome} was used before modern urology advanced.
e.zh: 现代泌尿外科发展前，人们会使用膀胱结石切开刀。

e.en: The archive described a {lithotomic} procedure in detail.
e.zh: 档案详细描述了一次膀胱结石切开术。

e.en: His {lithotomic} instruments looked frightening today.
e.zh: 他的膀胱结石切开术器械如今看来很吓人。

e.en: The book included {lithotomical} diagrams for students.
e.zh: 这本书为学生收录了膀胱结石切开术图解。

e.en: She studied {lithotomical} methods from eighteenth-century texts.
e.zh: 她从十八世纪文献中研究膀胱结石切开术方法。

e.en: The {lithotomist} worked before anesthesia was common.
e.zh: 那位膀胱结石切开术医师行医时麻醉还不普及。

e.en: A skilled {lithotomist} could save many patients.
e.zh: 熟练的膀胱结石切开术医师能救治许多病人。

e.en: Doctors once had to {lithotomize} patients with bladder stones.
e.zh: 医生过去有时必须为膀胱结石患者施行切开术。

e.en: The text explains how to {lithotomize} safely by old standards.
e.zh: 这篇文本说明按旧标准如何安全施行膀胱结石切开术。

e.en: He survived {lithotomy} at a young age.
e.zh: 他年轻时做过膀胱结石切开术并活了下来。

e.en: The {lithotomy} position is still used in surgery.
e.zh: 截石位至今仍用于外科手术。

e.en: The surgeon inserted a {lithotrite} carefully.
e.zh: 外科医生小心地插入碎石器。

e.en: This antique {lithotrite} crushed stones inside the bladder.
e.zh: 这件古董碎石器曾用于粉碎膀胱内的结石。

e.en: The {lithotritist} treated bladder stones without open surgery.
e.zh: 这位碎石术医师不用开放手术治疗膀胱结石。

e.en: A famous {lithotritist} lectured at the hospital.
e.zh: 一位著名碎石术医师在医院授课。

e.en: They planned to {lithotritize} the stone instead of cutting.
e.zh: 他们计划用碎石术粉碎结石，而不是切开。

e.en: The device could {lithotritize} small bladder stones.
e.zh: 这种装置能粉碎较小的膀胱结石。

e.en: The {lithotritor} replaced more invasive tools.
e.zh: 碎石器取代了更具侵入性的工具。

e.en: He demonstrated the {lithotritor} to medical students.
e.zh: 他向医学生演示了碎石器。

e.en: Early {lithotrity} reduced the need for cutting.
e.zh: 早期碎石术减少了切开手术的需要。

e.en: The paper compares {lithotrity} with traditional lithotomy.
e.zh: 这篇论文比较了碎石术和传统膀胱结石切开术。

e.en: Each {lithotype} was logged in the core description.
e.zh: 每种岩性类型都记录在岩芯描述中。

e.en: The printer prepared a new {lithotype} for the illustration.
e.zh: 印刷工为插图准备了一块新的石印版。

e.en: The atlas was {lithotyped} in fine color.
e.zh: 这本地图集用精美彩色石印制成。

e.en: The samples were {lithotyped} before chemical testing.
e.zh: 样品在化学测试前先按岩性分类。

e.en: The workshop taught traditional {lithotyping} techniques.
e.zh: 工作坊教授传统石印术技巧。

e.en: Accurate {lithotyping} improved the reservoir model.
e.zh: 准确的岩性分类改进了储层模型。

e.en: The physician noted {lithuria} in the patient.
e.zh: 医生注意到病人尿中有尿酸砂。

e.en: Persistent {lithuria} may signal a metabolic problem.
e.zh: 持续尿中含尿酸砂可能提示代谢问题。

e.en: The path was dry and {lithy}.
e.zh: 这条小路干燥而多石。

e.en: A {lithy} soil made farming difficult there.
e.zh: 那里的石质土壤使耕作变得困难。

e.en: The lawyer said the claim was {litigable}.
e.zh: 律师说这项主张可以诉讼。

e.en: Not every workplace dispute is {litigable}.
e.zh: 并非每一起职场纠纷都可以诉诸法律。

e.en: The manuscript spells little as {litle}.
e.zh: 这份手稿把 little 拼作 litle。

e.en: He owned a {litle} house by the river.
e.zh: 他在河边有一所小房子。

e.en: The culture was sensitive to {litmocidin}.
e.zh: 这种培养菌对利特莫西丁敏感。

e.en: Researchers tested {litmocidin} against several bacteria.
e.zh: 研究人员用利特莫西丁测试了几种细菌。

liverishness.t: 肝病样不适；烦躁阴郁感

e.en: After the heavy meal, his {liverishness} kept him awake.
e.zh: 吃完那顿油腻饭后，他那种肝病似的不适让他睡不着。

e.en: A tone of {liverishness} colored her reply.
e.zh: 她的回答里带着一种烦躁阴郁的味道。

e.en: The {liverleaf} bloomed before most woodland flowers.
e.zh: 獐耳细辛比大多数林地花卉开得更早。

e.en: Old herbals praised {liverleaf} for liver complaints.
e.zh: 旧草药书称赞肝叶草可用于肝脏不适。

e.en: {Livermorium} has the atomic number 116.
e.zh: 𫟷的原子序数是116。

e.en: Scientists produced {livermorium} in a particle accelerator.
e.zh: 科学家在粒子加速器中合成了𫟷。

e.en: The collector labeled the dark specimen {liverstone}.
e.zh: 收藏者把那块深色标本标为肝石。

e.en: Miners used {liverstone} to describe its brownish color.
e.zh: 矿工用肝色矿石来形容它偏褐的颜色。

liveryman.t: 同业公会会员；穿制服仆役

e.en: The {liveryman} attended the guild dinner in London.
e.zh: 那名同业公会会员参加了伦敦的公会晚宴。

e.en: A {liveryman} opened the carriage door for the guest.
e.zh: 一名穿制服的仆役为客人打开马车门。

livesteam.t: 现场蒸汽；实用蒸汽模型

e.en: The museum runs {livesteam} engines on weekends.
e.zh: 博物馆周末会运行实用蒸汽模型机车。

e.en: A {livesteam} pipe can cause severe burns.
e.zh: 现场蒸汽管道可能造成严重烫伤。

livetrap.t: 活捕陷阱；用活捕笼捕捉

e.en: They set a {livetrap} behind the shed.
e.zh: 他们在棚屋后面放了一个活捕陷阱。

e.en: The team will {livetrap} the fox and move it safely.
e.zh: 团队会用活捕笼抓住那只狐狸并安全转移。

e.en: The calf's {liveweight} increased quickly in spring.
e.zh: 那头小牛的活重在春天增长得很快。

e.en: Farmers sell cattle by {liveweight} at the market.
e.zh: 农民在市场上按活重出售牛只。

e.en: The family hired a {living-in} nanny.
e.zh: 这家人雇了一名住在家里的保姆。

e.en: {Living-in} staff receive meals as part of their pay.
e.zh: 住在雇主家中的员工会把膳食算作待遇的一部分。

e.en: She preferred a {living-out} position in the city.
e.zh: 她更愿意在城里找一份不住雇主家的工作。

e.en: The college allows {living-out} students to use the library late.
e.zh: 学院允许外宿学生在较晚时间使用图书馆。

e.en: Each soldier had a small {living-quarter} near the base.
e.zh: 每名士兵在基地附近都有一间小宿舍。

e.en: The ship's {living-quarter} was cramped but clean.
e.zh: 船上的居住区很拥挤，但很干净。

e.en: The apartment has limited {living-space} for a family.
e.zh: 这套公寓给一家人住的空间有限。

e.en: Plants can make a {living-space} feel calmer.
e.zh: 植物能让生活空间显得更安静舒适。

e.en: The children watched cartoons in the {livingroom}.
e.zh: 孩子们在客厅里看动画片。

e.en: We moved the sofa into the {livingroom}.
e.zh: 我们把沙发搬进了起居室。

livonian.t: 利沃尼亚的；利沃尼亚语

e.en: She studied {Livonian} songs from the Baltic coast.
e.zh: 她研究波罗的海沿岸的利沃尼亚歌曲。

e.en: Only a few people still know {Livonian} well.
e.zh: 如今只有少数人仍然熟悉利沃尼亚语。

e.en: The chemist poured the {lixivia} into a glass vessel.
e.zh: 化学师把碱液倒进玻璃容器里。

e.en: Wood ash was once used to make {lixivia}.
e.zh: 过去人们曾用木灰来制取碱液。

e.en: The sample had a strong {lixivial} odor.
e.zh: 这个样品有一股很重的碱液气味。

e.en: They studied the {lixivial} salts left after washing.
e.zh: 他们研究清洗后留下的浸滤盐类。

e.en: Workers {lixiviate} the ash to obtain alkaline salts.
e.zh: 工人用水浸滤灰烬以取得碱性盐。

e.en: Rain can {lixiviate} minerals from loose soil.
e.zh: 雨水会从疏松土壤中淋洗出矿物质。

e.en: The {lixiviated} ore was then dried in the sun.
e.zh: 经浸滤的矿石随后在阳光下晒干。

e.en: Nutrients had been {lixiviated} from the sandy soil.
e.zh: 养分已经从沙质土壤中被淋洗掉。

e.en: The chemist used {lixiviation} to extract soluble salts from the ash.
e.zh: 化学师用浸滤法从灰烬中提取可溶性盐。

e.en: Old manuals describe {lixiviation} as a way to make lye.
e.zh: 旧手册把浸滤描述为制作碱液的方法。

e.en: The waste left a {lixivious} liquid in the bottom of the barrel.
e.zh: 废料在桶底留下了一种碱液状液体。

e.en: A {lixivious} solution slowly dissolved the mineral surface.
e.zh: 一种浸滤性溶液慢慢溶解了矿物表面。

e.en: The old recipe called the strained ash water {lixivium}.
e.zh: 这份老配方把过滤后的灰水称为碱液。

e.en: Workers collected the {lixivium} after rain passed through the ore pile.
e.zh: 雨水渗过矿石堆后，工人收集了浸滤液。

e.en: The sample contained green {lizardite} mixed with other serpentine minerals.
e.zh: 样品中含有绿色利蛇纹石，并混有其他蛇纹石类矿物。

e.en: Geologists identified {lizardite} in the altered ultramafic rock.
e.zh: 地质学家在蚀变的超镁铁质岩石中鉴定出利蛇纹石。

e.en: The {llanero} rode across the flooded plain at dawn.
e.zh: 黎明时，那名南美草原牧人骑马穿过被水淹没的平原。

e.en: Folk songs often praise the courage of the {llanero}.
e.zh: 民歌常常赞颂南美草原牧人的勇气。

e.en: Cattle grazed on the wide {llano} after the rains ended.
e.zh: 雨季结束后，牛群在辽阔的南美大草原上吃草。

e.en: The road crossed a dry {llano} before reaching the river.
e.zh: 道路穿过一片干燥的热带草原后才到达河边。

e.en: The {llanos} flood during the wet season.
e.zh: 雨季时，南美热带草原地带会被洪水淹没。

e.en: Many ranches spread across the Venezuelan {llanos}.
e.zh: 许多牧场分布在委内瑞拉的热带草原地带。

e.en: The chart helps {llustrate} the change in prices.
e.zh: 这张图有助于说明价格的变化。

e.en: She used sketches to {llustrate} the children's book.
e.zh: 她用素描为那本儿童书配图说明。

e.en: That joke was so unexpected, {lmao}.
e.zh: 那个笑话太出人意料了，笑死我了。

e.en: He replied with {lmao} instead of a serious answer.
e.zh: 他没有认真回答，只回了个“哈哈哈”。

e.en: She studies with {lo-fi} music playing softly.
e.zh: 她学习时会轻声放着低保真音乐。

e.en: The film has a charming {lo-fi} look.
e.zh: 这部电影有一种迷人的粗粝质感。

e.en: Do not remove that {load-bearing} wall.
e.zh: 不要拆掉那面承重墙。

e.en: The engineer inspected every {load-bearing} beam after the quake.
e.zh: 地震后，工程师检查了每一根承重梁。

e.en: The city announced {load-shedding} during the evening peak.
e.zh: 该市宣布晚高峰期间实行轮流限电。

e.en: Automatic {load-shedding} protected the grid from collapse.
e.zh: 自动减负荷保护了电网，避免其崩溃。

e.en: The software team tested the {loadability} of each module.
e.zh: 软件团队测试了每个模块的可加载性。

e.en: Engineers measured the bridge's {loadability} under heavy traffic.
e.zh: 工程师测量了桥梁在重车流下的承载能力。

e.en: The truck bed is {loadable} from either side.
e.zh: 这辆卡车的货厢两侧都可以装货。

e.en: The plugin is {loadable} without restarting the app.
e.zh: 这个插件无需重启应用就可以加载。

e.en: The captain checked the ship's {loadage} before departure.
e.zh: 船长在出发前核查了船只的装载量。

e.en: The invoice included a small {loadage} for handling the cargo.
e.zh: 发票中列了一笔少量装货费，用于货物处理。

e.en: The engineer checked the {loadometer} before lifting the beam.
e.zh: 工程师在吊起横梁前检查了测载计。

e.en: A faulty {loadometer} can make the crane unsafe.
e.zh: 有故障的载荷计会让起重机变得不安全。

e.en: Sailors once used the {loadstar} to find north.
e.zh: 水手过去用北极星来辨认北方。

e.en: Justice became her {loadstar} throughout the campaign.
e.zh: 正义成了她整个运动中的指引。

e.en: The old compass needle moved toward the {loadstone}.
e.zh: 旧罗盘的指针朝磁石转去。

e.en: The city became a {loadstone} for ambitious artists.
e.zh: 这座城市成了有抱负艺术家的吸引之地。

e.en: The {loamless} hillside could not hold much moisture.
e.zh: 那片无肥土的山坡留不住多少水分。

e.en: Farmers struggled with the {loamless} fields after years of erosion.
e.zh: 多年侵蚀后，农民难以耕作这些缺壤土的田地。

e.en: He borrowed money from a {loan-shark} and soon regretted it.
e.zh: 他向放高利贷者借了钱，很快就后悔了。

e.en: The police investigated a violent {loan-shark} in the neighborhood.
e.zh: 警方调查了附近一个暴力放高利贷者。

e.en: Sushi is a Japanese {loan-word} in English.
e.zh: sushi 是英语中的一个日语外来词。

e.en: The teacher explained how each {loan-word} changed pronunciation.
e.zh: 老师解释了每个借词的发音怎样发生变化。

e.en: Only the museum's duplicate prints are {loanable}.
e.zh: 博物馆只有复制版画可以借出。

e.en: The bank listed the property as {loanable} collateral.
e.zh: 银行把这处房产列为可贷款抵押物。

e.en: The term is a {loanblend} formed from English and Japanese parts.
e.zh: 这个词是由英语和日语成分构成的混合借词。

e.en: Linguists traced the {loanblend} to early trade contact.
e.zh: 语言学家把这个混合借词追溯到早期贸易接触。

e.en: The {loanee} must repay the bank by Friday.
e.zh: 借款人必须在周五前还清银行贷款。

e.en: The young striker joined the club as a {loanee}.
e.zh: 这名前锋小将以租借球员身份加盟俱乐部。

e.en: The word shows a {loanshift} from an older foreign meaning.
e.zh: 这个词体现了从较早外来意义发生的借用义变。

e.en: A {loanshift} can make a native word carry a borrowed sense.
e.zh: 借词转义会让本族词承载外来的意思。

e.en: Kindergarten is a German {loanword} in English.
e.zh: kindergarten 是英语里的一个德语外来词。

e.en: The dictionary marks each {loanword} with its source language.
e.zh: 词典给每个借词标出来源语言。

e.en: He gave the proposal a {loathful} glance.
e.zh: 他厌恶地看了那项提议一眼。

e.en: The novel describes a {loathful} act of betrayal.
e.zh: 小说描写了一次令人厌恶的背叛行为。

e.en: She felt {loathy} about accepting his help.
e.zh: 她很不情愿接受他的帮助。

e.en: His {loathy} expression made the guests uncomfortable.
e.zh: 他厌恶的表情让客人们感到不自在。

e.en: The baker stacked the freshly {loaved} dough on trays.
e.zh: 面包师把刚做成面包状的面团堆在托盘上。

e.en: A {loaved} offering lay beside the wine.
e.zh: 一份面包供品放在酒旁边。

e.en: The scan showed {lobar} pneumonia in the right lung.
e.zh: 扫描显示右肺有肺叶性肺炎。

e.en: Doctors discussed the {lobar} structure of the brain.
e.zh: 医生们讨论了大脑的分叶结构。

e.en: The plant has broad {lobate} leaves.
e.zh: 这种植物有宽大的裂片状叶子。

e.en: A {lobate} outline made the fossil easy to identify.
e.zh: 分叶状轮廓让这块化石容易辨认。

e.en: The drawing showed a {lobated} leaf edge.
e.zh: 图中显示了有裂片的叶缘。

e.en: The organ appeared {lobated} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这个器官在显微镜下呈分叶状。

e.en: The margin is {lobately} divided near the tip.
e.zh: 边缘在顶端附近呈裂片状分开。

e.en: The coral grows {lobately} across the rock surface.
e.zh: 珊瑚沿岩石表面呈裂片状生长。

e.en: The botanist measured the leaf's {lobation}.
e.zh: 植物学家测量了叶片的分裂程度。

e.en: Abnormal {lobation} can affect the organ's appearance.
e.zh: 异常分叶会影响器官的外观。

e.en: Critics blamed {lobbyism} for weakening the reform bill.
e.zh: 批评者认为游说活动削弱了改革法案。

e.en: The article studies {lobbyism} in nineteenth-century politics.
e.zh: 这篇文章研究十九世纪政治中的院外活动。

e.en: The {lobbyman} waited outside the committee room.
e.zh: 那名游说者在委员会会议室外等候。

e.en: A hotel {lobbyman} helped guests with their luggage.
e.zh: 酒店门厅服务员帮客人搬运行李。

e.en: The coelacanth is a {lobe-finned} fish.
e.zh: 腔棘鱼是一种肉鳍鱼。

e.en: Scientists study {lobe-finned} fossils to understand early limbs.
e.zh: 科学家研究肉鳍类化石，以了解早期四肢。

e.en: A {lobefin} has fleshy fins supported by bones.
e.zh: 肉鳍鱼有由骨骼支撑的肉质鳍。

e.en: The fossil {lobefin} helped explain vertebrate evolution.
e.zh: 这块肉鳍鱼化石有助于解释脊椎动物演化。

lobelanidine.t: 洛贝兰尼定；半边莲碱衍生物

e.en: Researchers isolated {lobelanidine} from the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员从植物提取物中分离出洛贝兰尼定。

e.en: The paper compared {lobelanidine} with related alkaloids.
e.zh: 论文将洛贝兰尼定与相关生物碱作了比较。

e.en: Each {lobelet} was examined under the microscope.
e.zh: 每个小叶都在显微镜下接受检查。

e.en: A tiny {lobelet} protruded from the edge of the leaf.
e.zh: 叶缘伸出一个细小的裂片。

lobeliaceous.t: 半边莲科的；似半边莲的

e.en: The flower has a {lobeliaceous} structure.
e.zh: 这朵花具有半边莲科植物的结构。

e.en: Several {lobeliaceous} plants grow near the stream.
e.zh: 溪边生长着几种半边莲科植物。

e.en: The study measured {lobeline} in dried leaves.
e.zh: 这项研究测量了干叶中的山梗菜碱含量。

e.en: Doctors once tested {lobeline} as a smoking treatment.
e.zh: 医生曾试验用山梗菜碱来治疗烟瘾。

e.en: The guide called the wild wolf a {lobo}.
e.zh: 向导把那只野狼称作lobo。

e.en: A large {lobo} fish was caught offshore.
e.zh: 近海捕到了一条大型狼鱼。

e.en: The families discussed {lobola} before the wedding.
e.zh: 两家人在婚礼前商谈了彩礼。

e.en: In that community, {lobola} still carries social meaning.
e.zh: 在那个社群里，聘礼仍有社会意义。

e.en: Doctors used to {lobotomise} some psychiatric patients.
e.zh: 医生过去曾给一些精神病患者做脑叶切除术。

e.en: The critic said the policy would {lobotomise} public debate.
e.zh: 评论者说这项政策会让公共辩论变得麻木。

e.en: Surgeons once tried to {lobotomize} severe cases.
e.zh: 外科医生曾试图给重症患者做脑叶切除术。

e.en: The editor joked that the cuts would {lobotomize} the novel.
e.zh: 编辑开玩笑说，这些删改会让小说失去灵魂。

lobotomized.t: 被脑叶切除的；麻木迟钝的

e.en: A {lobotomized} patient appears in the documentary.
e.zh: 纪录片中出现了一名做过脑叶切除术的患者。

e.en: After hours of meetings, he felt {lobotomized}.
e.zh: 开了几个小时会后，他觉得脑子都麻木了。

lobotomizing.t: 进行脑叶切除；使人麻木的

e.en: The hospital stopped {lobotomizing} patients decades ago.
e.zh: 那家医院几十年前就停止给患者做脑叶切除术。

e.en: The job was repetitive and {lobotomizing}.
e.zh: 这份工作重复乏味，让人变得麻木。

e.en: The sailors ate hot {lobscouse} after watch.
e.zh: 水手们值班后吃了热乎的炖肉。

e.en: Her grandmother made {lobscouse} with potatoes and beef.
e.zh: 她祖母用土豆和牛肉做利物浦炖菜。

lobster-eyed.t: 眼睛突出的；龙虾眼似的

e.en: The cartoon villain looked {lobster-eyed} and furious.
e.zh: 漫画里的反派眼睛突出，显得怒气冲冲。

e.en: A {lobster-eyed} telescope can catch wide X-ray views.
e.zh: 龙虾眼式望远镜能捕捉宽视野的X射线图像。

e.en: The colonists mocked the {lobsterback} in the street.
e.zh: 殖民地居民在街上嘲笑那个红衣英国兵。

e.en: A {lobsterback} appears in the historical novel.
e.zh: 那部历史小说里出现了一名红衣兵。

e.en: The aquarium displayed a tiny {lobsterling}.
e.zh: 水族馆展出了一只小龙虾。

e.en: A {lobsterling} hides among the rocks.
e.zh: 一只幼龙虾躲在岩石之间。

e.en: The {lobstermen} left before sunrise.
e.zh: 捕龙虾的渔民在日出前就出海了。

e.en: Local {lobstermen} opposed the new fishing limits.
e.zh: 当地龙虾渔民反对新的捕捞限制。

lobstick.t: 削枝作标记的树；航标树

e.en: Explorers used a {lobstick} to mark the route.
e.zh: 探险者用削枝作标记的树来标出路线。

e.en: The old {lobstick} still stood by the river.
e.zh: 那棵旧航标树仍立在河边。

e.en: The whale began to {lobtail} near the boat.
e.zh: 鲸鱼开始在船边用尾巴拍水。

e.en: A loud {lobtail} echoed across the bay.
e.zh: 响亮的尾拍水声回荡在海湾上。

lobulate.t: 分成小叶的；使成小叶状

e.en: The gland may {lobulate} as it develops.
e.zh: 腺体在发育过程中可能会分成小叶。

e.en: A {lobulate} outline is visible on the scan.
e.zh: 扫描图上可以看到小叶状轮廓。

e.en: The scan showed clear {lobulation} of the mass.
e.zh: 扫描显示肿块有明显的小叶状结构。

e.en: Normal {lobulation} can appear during organ development.
e.zh: 器官发育过程中可能出现正常的小叶形成。

e.en: He used a {lobworm} to bait the hook.
e.zh: 他用沙蚕给鱼钩上饵。

e.en: A {lobworm} burrowed into the wet sand.
e.zh: 一条沙蚕钻进了潮湿的沙子里。

e.en: The song calls the dancer {loca}.
e.zh: 那首歌把舞者称作疯狂的女人。

e.en: In Spanish slang, {loca} can mean a crazy woman.
e.zh: 在西班牙语俚语中，loca可指疯狂的女人。

local-storage.t: 本地存储；浏览器本地储存

e.en: The app saves preferences in {local-storage}.
e.zh: 这个应用把偏好设置保存在本地存储中。

e.en: Clear {local-storage} if the page keeps crashing.
e.zh: 如果页面一直崩溃，就清除浏览器本地储存。

e.en: Open {localhost} to test the website.
e.zh: 打开本地主机地址来测试这个网站。

e.en: The database only accepts connections from {localhost}.
e.zh: 这个数据库只接受来自本机服务器的连接。

e.en: A friendly {localite} showed us the shortcut.
e.zh: 一位友好的当地居民给我们指了近路。

e.en: The article quoted a {localite} from the village.
e.zh: 文章引用了一位村里本地人的话。

localitis.t: 地方主义；过分本地偏见

e.en: The mayor warned against {localitis} in planning.
e.zh: 市长警告规划中不要有过分的地方主义。

e.en: Extreme {localitis} made regional cooperation difficult.
e.zh: 极端的本地偏见让区域合作变得困难。

e.en: The team tested the app's {localizability} before translating it.
e.zh: 团队在翻译前测试了这个应用的可本地化性。

e.en: Good {localizability} makes future language support cheaper.
e.zh: 良好的可本地化性会降低以后支持多语言的成本。

e.en: All menu labels must be {localizable}.
e.zh: 所有菜单标签都必须是可本地化的。

e.en: The designer kept dates and prices {localizable}.
e.zh: 设计师让日期和价格都保持可本地化。

e.en: The sentence uses a {locative} phrase after the verb.
e.zh: 这个句子在动词后用了表示位置的短语。

e.en: Some languages mark place with a {locative} case.
e.zh: 有些语言用方位格来标记地点。

e.en: As a {locavore}, she buys vegetables from nearby farms.
e.zh: 作为本地食物主义者，她从附近农场买蔬菜。

e.en: The restaurant attracts every serious {locavore} in town.
e.zh: 这家餐厅吸引了城里许多认真的本地食物主义者。

e.en: The canal company collected {lochage} from each boat.
e.zh: 运河公司向每艘船收取船闸通行费。

e.en: Slow {lochage} delayed the barge for an hour.
e.zh: 缓慢的过闸让驳船耽搁了一个小时。

e.en: The old recipe calls for a small {loche}.
e.zh: 这道老菜谱需要一条小的泥鳅类鱼。

e.en: A {loche} hid under the stones in the stream.
e.zh: 一条淡水鱼躲在溪流的石头下面。

e.en: The nurse explained that {lochia} is normal after birth.
e.zh: 护士解释说，产后出现恶露是正常的。

e.en: Heavy {lochia} should be reported to a doctor.
e.zh: 如果恶露量很大，应该告诉医生。

e.en: A {lochus} formed part of the ancient army.
e.zh: 一个古希腊小队是古代军队的一部分。

e.en: The historian described how each {lochus} was arranged.
e.zh: 历史学家描述了每个古希腊小队的编制方式。

e.en: He secured the gate with a heavy {lock-chain}.
e.zh: 他用一条沉重的锁链把大门锁住。

e.en: The old {lock-chain} helped control the canal gate.
e.zh: 那条旧闸门链条用来控制运河闸门。

e.en: The {lock-gate} opened slowly for the narrowboat.
e.zh: 船闸闸门慢慢打开，让窄船通过。

e.en: Workers repaired the damaged {lock-gate} before dawn.
e.zh: 工人在黎明前修好了受损的船闸闸门。

e.en: The contract created a costly vendor {lock-in}.
e.zh: 这份合同造成了代价高昂的供应商锁定。

e.en: A late-night pub {lock-in} kept everyone inside.
e.zh: 酒吧深夜闭门留客，让所有人都待在里面。

e.en: The {lock-keeper} signaled when we could enter.
e.zh: 船闸管理员示意我们可以进入。

e.en: A retired {lock-keeper} still lived beside the canal.
e.zh: 一位退休的船闸管理员仍住在运河旁。

e.en: The missile achieved {lock-on} before launch.
e.zh: 导弹在发射前完成了目标锁定。

e.en: The camera's {lock-on} kept the runner in focus.
e.zh: 相机的锁定功能让跑者一直保持清晰。

e.en: We bought a brass {lock-set} for the front door.
e.zh: 我们给前门买了一套黄铜门锁。

e.en: The locksmith replaced the broken {lock-set} quickly.
e.zh: 锁匠很快换掉了坏掉的成套门锁。

e.en: Please {lock-up} the shop before you leave.
e.zh: 离开前请把店门锁好。

e.en: He spent the night in the village {lock-up}.
e.zh: 他在村里的拘留所过了一夜。

e.en: The boat paid {lockage} at the canal office.
e.zh: 那艘船在运河办事处缴了船闸通行费。

e.en: Bad weather slowed the day's {lockage}.
e.zh: 恶劣天气拖慢了当天的过闸速度。

e.en: Customers felt {locked-in} by the long contract.
e.zh: 客户觉得自己被长期合同锁住了。

e.en: The rate is {locked-in} for five years.
e.zh: 这个利率会固定五年不变。

e.en: The tools were {lockedup} in the shed.
e.zh: 工具被锁在棚屋里。

e.en: He felt {lockedup} after weeks indoors.
e.zh: 在屋里待了几个星期后，他觉得像被关起来一样。

e.en: The chest was held {lockfast} by an iron hasp.
e.zh: 箱子被一个铁搭扣牢牢锁住。

e.en: A rusty {lockfast} kept the door from opening.
e.zh: 一个生锈的锁扣让门打不开。

e.en: The {lockgate} creaked as the water level rose.
e.zh: 水位上涨时，船闸闸门吱呀作响。

e.en: Engineers inspected the wooden {lockgate} for leaks.
e.zh: 工程师检查了木制船闸闸门是否漏水。

e.en: Light came through the tiny {lockhole}.
e.zh: 光从小小的锁孔里透进来。

e.en: She bent down and looked through the {lockhole}.
e.zh: 她弯下腰，从锁孔往里看。

e.en: The old {lockhouse} stands beside the canal.
e.zh: 那座旧船闸看守屋就在运河旁。

e.en: They turned the empty {lockhouse} into a cafe.
e.zh: 他们把空置的船闸看守屋改成了咖啡馆。

e.en: The essay takes a {Lockian} view of property.
e.zh: 这篇文章采用了洛克哲学中的财产权观点。

e.en: Her argument sounds strongly {Lockian}.
e.zh: 她的论证听起来很有洛克哲学色彩。

e.en: The contract creates a {locking-in} effect for customers.
e.zh: 这份合同会对客户产生锁定效应。

e.en: Early choices can cause {locking-in} of bad habits.
e.zh: 早期选择可能使坏习惯固定下来。

e.en: The {lockkeeper} opened the gates for the barge.
e.zh: 看管水闸的人为驳船打开了闸门。

e.en: An old {lockkeeper} lived beside the canal.
e.zh: 一位老水闸管理员住在运河旁。

e.en: The shed had a {lockless} wooden door.
e.zh: 那间棚屋装着一扇没有锁的木门。

e.en: The software uses a {lockless} design for speed.
e.zh: 这个软件为了提高速度采用无锁设计。

e.en: The {lockmaker} repaired the antique chest lock.
e.zh: 制锁匠修好了那只古董箱子的锁。

e.en: A skilled {lockmaker} can copy a key by hand.
e.zh: 熟练的制锁匠能手工复制钥匙。

e.en: He studied {lockmaking} in a small workshop.
e.zh: 他在一家小作坊学习制锁工艺。

e.en: Traditional {lockmaking} requires precise metalwork.
e.zh: 传统制锁需要精细的金属加工。

e.en: The {lockman} guided the boat through the canal.
e.zh: 水闸管理员引导船只通过运河。

e.en: A local {lockman} fitted the new door lock.
e.zh: 当地的制锁工安装了新门锁。

e.en: The {lockmaster} checked the canal level before dawn.
e.zh: 水闸主管在黎明前检查了运河水位。

e.en: In the game, the {lockmaster} opens every sealed gate.
e.zh: 在游戏里，开锁高手能打开每一道封闭的大门。

e.en: The detective found a {lockpick} in the drawer.
e.zh: 侦探在抽屉里发现了一件开锁工具。

e.en: She learned to {lockpick} during a security course.
e.zh: 她在一门安防课程中学会了用工具开锁。

e.en: The {lockpicker} opened the cabinet without damage.
e.zh: 开锁的人没有损坏柜子就把它打开了。

e.en: Police arrested a suspected {lockpicker} near the shop.
e.zh: 警方在商店附近逮捕了一名涉嫌撬锁的人。

e.en: A broken {lockpin} jammed the door mechanism.
e.zh: 一根断裂的锁销卡住了门锁机构。

e.en: The locksmith replaced each tiny {lockpin} carefully.
e.zh: 锁匠小心地更换了每个细小的锁内弹子。

e.en: The sailors carried sacks made of {lockram}.
e.zh: 水手们扛着用粗麻布做成的袋子。

e.en: A strip of {lockram} covered the old wound.
e.zh: 一条旧式亚麻布盖住了那处旧伤。

e.en: Tighten the {lockring} before riding the bicycle.
e.zh: 骑自行车前要拧紧固定环。

e.en: The mechanic removed the rusty {lockring} with pliers.
e.zh: 机械师用钳子拆下了生锈的锁环。

e.en: The {locksman} waved the narrowboat forward.
e.zh: 水闸管理员挥手示意窄船向前。

e.en: Every {locksman} knew the river's difficult moods.
e.zh: 每个闸工都熟悉这条河难以捉摸的水情。

e.en: He learned {locksmithery} from his grandfather.
e.zh: 他从祖父那里学会了锁匠手艺。

e.en: Modern {locksmithery} includes electronic access systems.
e.zh: 现代锁具业包括电子门禁系统。

e.en: This machine makes a strong {lockstitch}.
e.zh: 这台机器能缝出牢固的锁式线迹。

e.en: The tailor chose a {lockstitch} for the seam.
e.zh: 裁缝为这道缝选择了平缝。

lockstitcher.t: 锁式线迹缝纫机；平缝机

e.en: The factory bought a new {lockstitcher} for denim.
e.zh: 工厂买了一台新的平缝机来缝牛仔布。

e.en: A skilled operator adjusted the {lockstitcher} quickly.
e.zh: 熟练的操作员很快调好了锁式线迹缝纫机。

e.en: Install a {lockwasher} under the bolt head.
e.zh: 在螺栓头下面装一个防松垫圈。

e.en: The missing {lockwasher} made the joint loosen.
e.zh: 少了弹簧垫圈，接头就松动了。

e.en: The old box looked oddly {locky} and secretive.
e.zh: 那个旧盒子看起来很像带锁的东西，透着神秘感。

e.en: Her hair fell in {locky} curls over her face.
e.zh: 她一绺绺卷发垂在脸上。

locodescriptive.t: 描述地点的；地点描写的

e.en: The report used {locodescriptive} labels for each habitat.
e.zh: 报告为每处栖息地使用了描述地点的标签。

e.en: A {locodescriptive} passage places the reader in the village.
e.zh: 一段地点描写把读者带入了那个村庄。

locofoco.t: 自燃火柴；激进民主派成员

e.en: He lit the candle with a {locofoco}.
e.zh: 他用一根自燃火柴点亮了蜡烛。

e.en: The paper mocked him as a {locofoco} radical.
e.zh: 那家报纸嘲笑他是激进民主派分子。

e.en: The rancher feared {locoism} in the grazing horses.
e.zh: 牧场主担心吃草的马患上疯草中毒。

e.en: The novel treats his obsession as a kind of {locoism}.
e.zh: 小说把他的执念写成一种疯癫状态。

e.en: The {locoman} checked the pressure before departure.
e.zh: 机车司机在出发前检查了压力。

e.en: An experienced {locoman} heard the fault immediately.
e.zh: 经验丰富的铁路机务员立刻听出了故障。

locomobile.t: 自行移动的；蒸汽机动车

e.en: The inventor displayed a {locomobile} engine at the fair.
e.zh: 发明家在展会上展示了一台蒸汽机动车。

e.en: The robot's {locomobile} platform crossed the room.
e.zh: 机器人的自行移动平台穿过了房间。

e.en: The disease gradually reduced his {locomotivity}.
e.zh: 这种疾病逐渐削弱了他的运动能力。

e.en: Engineers tested the robot's {locomotivity} on rough ground.
e.zh: 工程师在崎岖地面上测试机器人的移动能力。

e.en: The injury affected her {locomotor} skills.
e.zh: 这次受伤影响了她的运动技能。

e.en: Children develop {locomotor} control through active play.
e.zh: 儿童通过积极玩耍发展移动控制能力。

locomotory.t: 运动的；移动功能的；运动器官的；能自行运动的

e.en: The therapy improved the patient's {locomotory} control after surgery.
e.zh: 这种疗法改善了患者术后的运动控制能力。

e.en: Some simple animals have no specialized {locomotory} organs.
e.zh: 有些简单动物没有专门的运动器官。

locoplant.t: 以根固定的植物；固着植物

e.en: The old text describes seaweed as a {locoplant} rather than a free-floating form.
e.zh: 那本旧书把海藻描述为固着植物，而不是自由漂浮的形态。

e.en: A {locoplant} remains anchored while currents pass over it.
e.zh: 固着植物会保持扎根不动，让水流从上方掠过。

locoregional.t: 局部区域的；局部及区域性的

e.en: The scan showed no {locoregional} spread of the tumor.
e.zh: 扫描显示肿瘤没有局部区域扩散。

e.en: Doctors recommended {locoregional} therapy before considering wider treatment.
e.zh: 医生建议先进行局部区域治疗，再考虑更广泛的治疗。

loctal.t: 八脚电子管的；锁扣式管座的

e.en: The radio used a {loctal} tube with a locking base.
e.zh: 这台收音机使用带锁扣底座的八脚电子管。

e.en: He replaced the broken {loctal} socket in the vintage amplifier.
e.zh: 他更换了老式放大器里损坏的锁扣式管座。

locular.t: 小室的；分腔的；子房室的

e.en: The botanist counted the {locular} divisions inside the ovary.
e.zh: 植物学家数了子房内部的小室分隔。

e.en: A {locular} structure can be seen clearly under magnification.
e.zh: 放大后可以清楚看到分腔结构。

e.en: The surgeon noted a {loculate} abscess on the image.
e.zh: 外科医生在影像上注意到一个分隔成小腔的脓肿。

e.en: Some fruits are {loculate} and contain several seed chambers.
e.zh: 有些果实有多个小室，里面含有几个种子腔。

e.en: Ultrasound revealed {loculation} within the pleural fluid.
e.zh: 超声显示胸腔积液内形成了分隔小腔。

e.en: The seed pod's {loculation} helps botanists identify the species.
e.zh: 种荚的小室结构有助于植物学家识别物种。

e.en: Each {locule} of the fruit held a row of seeds.
e.zh: 果实的每个小室里都有一排种子。

e.en: The cyst had one small {locule} filled with fluid.
e.zh: 这个囊肿有一个充满液体的小腔。

loculicidal.t: 室背开裂的；沿子房室裂开的

e.en: Cotton capsules open by {loculicidal} dehiscence when mature.
e.zh: 棉铃成熟时会以室背开裂的方式打开。

e.en: The professor used a {loculicidal} fruit to demonstrate seed release.
e.zh: 教授用一个室背开裂的果实演示种子释放。

e.en: The mushroom's stem was {loculose} rather than solid.
e.zh: 这种蘑菇的菌柄是多腔的，而不是实心的。

e.en: A {loculose} fruit contains many small compartments for seeds.
e.zh: 多小室果实含有许多容纳种子的小隔间。

e.en: The ancient tomb had a narrow {loculus} cut into the wall.
e.zh: 古墓墙上凿有一个狭窄的小龛。

e.en: A single {loculus} in the ovary contained several developing seeds.
e.zh: 子房中的一个小室含有几粒正在发育的种子。

e.en: The botanist identified the grass flower as a {locusta}.
e.zh: 植物学家把这种草的花序识别为小穗。

e.en: In older texts, {locusta} may simply mean a locust.
e.zh: 在较早的文本中，locusta 可能只是指蝗虫。

e.en: Birds fed on the ripe {locustberry} near the fence.
e.zh: 鸟儿在栅栏旁啄食成熟的刺槐浆果。

e.en: The guide pointed out a {locustberry} shrub along the trail.
e.zh: 向导指出了小路旁的一株刺槐浆果灌木。

locutionary.t: 话语行为的；表达层面的

e.en: The sentence's {locutionary} meaning was clear, even if its intention was not.
e.zh: 这句话的表达层面意义很清楚，尽管意图并不明确。

e.en: Linguists distinguish {locutionary} acts from the effects they produce.
e.zh: 语言学家把话语行为本身同其产生的效果区分开来。

e.en: The visitor waited in the {locutorium} of the monastery.
e.zh: 来访者在修道院的会客室里等候。

e.en: Nuns could speak with relatives through the screen in the {locutorium}.
e.zh: 修女可以隔着会客室的屏风与亲属交谈。

e.en: The monk entered the {locutory} to meet the visitor.
e.zh: 那位修士走进会客室去见来访者。

e.en: Her essay focuses on the {locutory} force of the phrase.
e.zh: 她的论文关注这个短语的话语表达力量。

lodgeable.t: 可住宿的；可寄存的；可提出的

e.en: The cabin is {lodgeable} for two guests in winter.
e.zh: 这间小屋冬天可供两位客人住宿。

e.en: The complaint is {lodgeable} only within thirty days.
e.zh: 这项投诉只能在三十天内提出。

e.en: He rented a small room in a {lodging-house} near the station.
e.zh: 他在车站附近的一家寄宿公寓租了个小房间。

e.en: The old {lodging-house} was converted into student flats.
e.zh: 那栋旧寄宿公寓被改造成了学生公寓。

lodgment.t: 存放；安置；立足点；沉积物

e.en: The army secured a {lodgment} on the far bank.
e.zh: 军队在对岸取得了一个立足点。

e.en: Heavy rain caused a {lodgment} of silt in the drain.
e.zh: 大雨使排水沟里沉积了一层淤泥。

lodgments.t: 存放物；安置处；立足点；沉积物

e.en: The survey recorded several {lodgments} of gravel after the flood.
e.zh: 调查记录了洪水过后的几处砾石沉积。

e.en: The first {lodgments} of troops were made before dawn.
e.zh: 第一批部队在黎明前建立了立足点。

lodicule.t: 浆片；禾本科花中小鳞片

e.en: A swollen {lodicule} helps open the grass floret.
e.zh: 膨大的浆片有助于打开禾本科小花。

e.en: The student drew each {lodicule} beside the ovary.
e.zh: 学生把子房旁的每个浆片都画了出来。

e.en: Early {loemology} mixed observation with speculation.
e.zh: 早期瘟疫学把观察和猜测混在一起。

e.en: The manuscript used {loemology} to describe epidemic disease.
e.zh: 这份手稿用瘟疫学来描述流行性疾病。

e.en: The doctor suspected {loeschiasis} after the stool test.
e.zh: 粪便检查后，医生怀疑是洛施原虫病。

e.en: Untreated {loeschiasis} can cause severe intestinal symptoms.
e.zh: 未经治疗的洛施原虫病可能引起严重肠道症状。

e.en: The valley walls showed thick {loessial} deposits.
e.zh: 谷壁上露出厚厚的黄土沉积层。

e.en: Farmers valued the fine {loessial} soil.
e.zh: 农民很看重这种细腻的黄土质土壤。

e.en: The sample was identified as {loewigite} under the microscope.
e.zh: 这块样品在显微镜下被鉴定为勒维吉石。

e.en: Collectors rarely find good crystals of {loewigite}.
e.zh: 收藏者很少能找到优质的勒维吉石晶体。

e.en: She studies with {lofi} beats in the background.
e.zh: 她学习时会放低保真节拍作背景音乐。

e.en: The film has a charming {lofi} style.
e.zh: 这部电影有一种迷人的粗粝随性风格。

e.en: The shipyard hired a skilled {loftsman}.
e.zh: 造船厂雇了一名熟练的放样工。

e.en: A {loftsman} marked the full-size pattern on the floor.
e.zh: 一名放样工在地板上标出了实尺样板。

e.en: We picked ripe {loganberries} behind the cottage.
e.zh: 我们在小屋后面采了成熟的罗甘莓。

e.en: The jam contains {loganberries} and a little apple.
e.zh: 这款果酱含有罗甘莓和少量苹果。

e.en: A {loganberry} tastes like a cross between berries.
e.zh: 罗甘莓尝起来像几种浆果的杂交味道。

e.en: She baked a tart with {loganberry} filling.
e.zh: 她烤了一个罗甘莓馅的挞。

e.en: The botanist noted its {loganiaceous} features.
e.zh: 植物学家注意到它具有马钱科特征。

e.en: Several {loganiaceous} shrubs grow in this region.
e.zh: 这一地区生长着几种马钱科灌木。

e.en: Researchers measured {loganin} in the plant extract.
e.zh: 研究人员测量了植物提取物中的马钱苷含量。

e.en: The compound {loganin} appears in several medicinal herbs.
e.zh: 马钱苷这种化合物存在于几种药用草本中。

e.en: The ode follows a {logaoedic} rhythm.
e.zh: 这首颂歌采用长短格混合的诗律。

e.en: Her paper analyzed {logaoedic} meter in Greek poetry.
e.zh: 她的论文分析了希腊诗歌中的长短格混合韵律。

e.en: The old map showed a {logar} near the coast.
e.zh: 旧地图上标出海岸附近有一艘印度式轻便帆船。

e.en: Sailors loaded spices onto the {logar}.
e.zh: 水手们把香料装上那艘轻便帆船。

e.en: The experiment used a {logatom} to test memory.
e.zh: 这个实验用无义音节来测试记忆。

e.en: Each {logatom} sounded possible but had no meaning.
e.zh: 每个假词听起来像真词，却没有意义。

e.en: The archive includes notes on {logetronography}.
e.zh: 档案中有关于语音记录法的笔记。

e.en: Early {logetronography} tried to capture speech mechanically.
e.zh: 早期语音记录法试图用机械方式记录言语。

e.en: Check the {logfile} for the error message.
e.zh: 查看日志文件，找出那条错误信息。

e.en: The server writes each request to a {logfile}.
